steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Seal-condition engineering handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐區核對感測器、材料批號、尾隙及異常處置，抽查一個漏點能否追到環號與時序；設備主管確認剩餘風險和接管責任，所有受壓維護只依專業核准程序執行。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：未交接的局部缺料可能讓下一班只看總表而誤認正常，更換感測器未重建基準又造成假改善；缺乏版本和位置資訊會直接削弱故障診斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit sensors, batches, clearance and responses by zone and trace a leakage point to ring and time; the equipment lead confirms residual risk and handover responsibility, with pressurized maintenance restricted to approved specialist procedures. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Unreported local starvation lets the next shift trust a normal total, while a sensor change without a new baseline creates false improvement. Missing versions and locations directly undermine diagnosis. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 密封狀態工程移交：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Seal-condition engineering handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「密封狀態工程移交」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Seal-condition engineering handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未交接的局部缺料可能讓下一班只看總表而誤認正常，更換感測器未重建基準又造成假改善；缺乏版本和位置資訊會直接削弱故障診斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unreported local starvation lets the next shift trust a normal total, while a sensor change without a new baseline creates false improvement. Missing versions and locations directly undermine diagnosis. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：未交接的局部缺料可能讓下一班只看總表而誤認正常，更換感測器未重建基準又造成假改善；缺乏版本和位置資訊會直接削弱故障診斷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Missing versions and locations directly undermine diagnosis.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「監測資料覆蓋比例高，就可以忽略相鄰缺測區的風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High overall monitoring coverage permits ignoring risk in adjacent unmeasured zones." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未交接的局部缺料可能讓下一班只看總表而誤認正常，更換感測器未重建基準又造成假改善；缺乏版本和位置資訊會直接削弱故障診斷。
knowledge.textEn: Unreported local starvation lets the next shift trust a normal total, while a sensor change without a new baseline creates false improvement. Missing versions and locations directly undermine diagnosis.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「密封狀態工程移交」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Seal-condition engineering handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
未交接的局部缺料可能讓下一班只看總表而誤認正常，更換感測器未重建基準又造成假改善；缺乏版本和位置資訊會直接削弱故障診斷。
多道密封即使共用失效供應，也能直接按獨立機率相乘。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Unreported local starvation lets the next shift trust a normal total, while a sensor change without a new baseline creates false improvement.
Multiple seals sharing a failed supply still justify multiplying independent failure probabilities.
quiz.explanation: 未交接的局部缺料可能讓下一班只看總表而誤認正常，更換感測器未重建基準又造成假改善；缺乏版本和位置資訊會直接削弱故障診斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unreported local starvation lets the next shift trust a normal total, while a sensor change without a new baseline creates false improvement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 潛盾機刀具磨耗管理
summary: 本課聚焦以刀具軌跡、接觸荷重與磨耗證據解釋掘進刀具壽命。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on explain cutter life using trajectories, contact loads and wear evidence. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設刀位半徑5 m、轉速4 rpm，切向速度v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s；不代表建議轉速。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設推進30 mm/min、轉速3 rpm，每轉進尺p=10 mm/rev；未提供刀具容許荷重。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume cutter radius 5 m and rotation 4 rpm; tangential speed v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s, not a recommended speed. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume advance 30 mm/min and rotation 3 rpm; penetration p=10 mm/rev, without specifying allowable cutter load. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「刀具半徑與行程」與「貫入與每轉進尺」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cutter radius and travel" and "Penetration per revolution": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 刀具半徑與行程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cutter radius and travel: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「刀具半徑與行程」如何影響潛盾機刀具磨耗管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cutter radius and travel” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM cutter-wear management”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 不同半徑刀具每轉走過不同距離，外緣刀即使承受相同轉數也有較長接觸路徑。磨耗比較須規一化里程或體積並保留刀位，不能用更換次數直接推斷材料品質。 假設刀位半徑5 m、轉速4 rpm，切向速度v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s；不代表建議轉速。 把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「刀具半徑與行程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tools at different radii travel different distances per revolution. Outer cutters therefore accumulate longer contact paths at equal revolutions, requiring wear normalization by travel or excavation and retention of cutter position rather than replacement count alone. Assume cutter radius 5 m and rotation 4 rpm; tangential speed v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s, not a recommended speed. Attributing faster outer wear solely to material defects misjudges quality, while retaining old travel after relocation corrupts trends. The resulting life model loses comparability for the next geological reach. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cutter radius and travel” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有刀位轉數相同時，接觸行程和磨耗需求也完全相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal revolutions give identical contact travel and wear demand at every cutter position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「刀具半徑與行程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cutter radius and travel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 刀具半徑與行程
knowledge.text: 不同半徑刀具每轉走過不同距離，外緣刀即使承受相同轉數也有較長接觸路徑。磨耗比較須規一化里程或體積並保留刀位，不能用更換次數直接推斷材料品質。
knowledge.textEn: Tools at different radii travel different distances per revolution. Outer cutters therefore accumulate longer contact paths at equal revolutions, requiring wear normalization by travel or excavation and retention of cutter position rather than replacement count alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有刀位轉數相同時，接觸行程和磨耗需求也完全相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal revolutions give identical contact travel and wear demand at every cutter position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「刀具半徑與行程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cutter radius and travel" is correct?
options: 所有刀位轉數相同時，接觸行程和磨耗需求也完全相同。
不同半徑刀具每轉走過不同距離，外緣刀即使承受相同轉數也有較長接觸路徑。
每轉進尺越大就必定代表切削效率和刀具壽命越好。
optionsEn: Equal revolutions give identical contact travel and wear demand at every cutter position.
Tools at different radii travel different distances per revolution.
Greater penetration per revolution necessarily improves cutting efficiency and cutter life.
quiz.explanation: 不同半徑刀具每轉走過不同距離，外緣刀即使承受相同轉數也有較長接觸路徑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tools at different radii travel different distances per revolution. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 刀具半徑與行程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cutter radius and travel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「刀具半徑與行程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cutter radius and travel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設刀位半徑5 m、轉速4 rpm，切向速度v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s；不代表建議轉速。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume cutter radius 5 m and rotation 4 rpm; tangential speed v=2πrn/60=2.094 m/s, not a recommended speed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Combine cutter map, revolutions and geology to calculate travel and compare measured wear for like tools; group outer and center positions separately and do not rank life from records lacking position traceability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 以刀位圖、轉數及地層日誌計算接觸行程，對照同類刀具的量測磨耗；將外緣與中心刀分組比較，無法追溯位置的磨耗資料不得直接用於壽命排名。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

The resulting life model loses comparability for the next geological reach. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 刀具半徑與行程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cutter radius and travel: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「刀具半徑與行程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cutter radius and travel” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Attributing faster outer wear solely to material defects misjudges quality, while retaining old travel after relocation corrupts trends. The resulting life model loses comparability for the next geological reach. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The resulting life model loses comparability for the next geological reach.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有刀位轉數相同時，接觸行程和磨耗需求也完全相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal revolutions give identical contact travel and wear demand at every cutter position." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。
knowledge.textEn: Attributing faster outer wear solely to material defects misjudges quality, while retaining old travel after relocation corrupts trends. The resulting life model loses comparability for the next geological reach.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「刀具半徑與行程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cutter radius and travel" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

把外緣刀較快磨耗全歸於材料缺陷會錯判供應品質，刀位更換後仍沿用舊行程又會污染趨勢；壽命模型因此對下一段地層失去可比性。
每轉進尺越大就必定代表切削效率和刀具壽命越好。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Attributing faster outer wear solely to material defects misjudges quality, while retaining old travel after relocation corrupts trends.
Greater penetration per revolution necessarily improves cutting efficiency and cutter life.

quiz.explanationEn: Attributing faster outer wear solely to material defects misjudges quality, while retaining old travel after relocation corrupts trends. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 貫入與每轉進尺：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Penetration per revolution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「貫入與每轉進尺」如何影響潛盾機刀具磨耗管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Penetration per revolution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM cutter-wear management”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每轉進尺把推進速率與轉速連結，反映刀具每次通過的切入尺度，但它也受岩體裂隙與刀具間距影響。高進尺未必代表高效率，過大載重可能使刀環或軸承提早失效。 假設推進30 mm/min、轉速3 rpm，每轉進尺p=10 mm/rev；未提供刀具容許荷重。 轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「貫入與每轉進尺」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Penetration per revolution links advance and rotation to cutting scale, but also depends on fractures and spacing. High penetration is not automatically efficient if excessive load damages cutter rings or bearings prematurely. Assume advance 30 mm/min and rotation 3 rpm; penetration p=10 mm/rev, without specifying allowable cutter load. Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting. Increasing load on that evidence may exceed tool capability when harder ground returns. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Penetration per revolution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每轉進尺越大就必定代表切削效率和刀具壽命越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Greater penetration per revolution necessarily improves cutting efficiency and cutter life." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「貫入與每轉進尺」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Penetration per revolution”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 貫入與每轉進尺
knowledge.text: 每轉進尺把推進速率與轉速連結，反映刀具每次通過的切入尺度，但它也受岩體裂隙與刀具間距影響。高進尺未必代表高效率，過大載重可能使刀環或軸承提早失效。
knowledge.textEn: Penetration per revolution links advance and rotation to cutting scale, but also depends on fractures and spacing. High penetration is not automatically efficient if excessive load damages cutter rings or bearings prematurely.

knowledge.text: 誤解：每轉進尺越大就必定代表切削效率和刀具壽命越好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Greater penetration per revolution necessarily improves cutting efficiency and cutter life. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「貫入與每轉進尺」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Penetration per revolution" is correct?
options: 每轉進尺越大就必定代表切削效率和刀具壽命越好。
總推力除刀具數就能得到每顆刀實際承受的峰值荷重。
每轉進尺把推進速率與轉速連結，反映刀具每次通過的切入尺度，但它也受岩體裂隙與刀具間距影響。
optionsEn: Greater penetration per revolution necessarily improves cutting efficiency and cutter life.
Total thrust divided by cutter count gives each cutter's actual peak load.
Penetration per revolution links advance and rotation to cutting scale, but also depends on fractures and spacing.
quiz.explanation: 每轉進尺把推進速率與轉速連結，反映刀具每次通過的切入尺度，但它也受岩體裂隙與刀具間距影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步推進、轉速、推力與扭矩，將相同地層與刀具狀態下的區段比較；刀具工程師需核對載重範圍與振動，不能只以提高每轉進尺作績效目標。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

The previous stratum's mean wear rate predicts life in the next stratum unconditionally.
Normal shift-average torque means no localized cutter impact fatigue is occurring.

steps.title: 貫入與每轉進尺：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Penetration per revolution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「貫入與每轉進尺」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Penetration per revolution” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步推進、轉速、推力與扭矩，將相同地層與刀具狀態下的區段比較；刀具工程師需核對載重範圍與振動，不能只以提高每轉進尺作績效目標。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize advance, rotation, thrust and torque and compare intervals with similar geology and tool condition; cutter engineers check loads and vibration instead of treating greater penetration per revolution as the sole performance objective. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting. Increasing load on that evidence may exceed tool capability when harder ground returns. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄貫入與每轉進尺的資料來源與適用條件。同步推進、轉速、推力與扭矩，將相同地層與刀具狀態下的區段比較；刀具工程師需核對載重範圍與振動，不能只以提高每轉進尺作績效目標。

Synchronize advance, rotation, thrust and torque and compare intervals with similar geology and tool condition; cutter engineers check loads and vibration instead of treating greater penetration per revolution as the sole performance objective.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Synchronize advance, rotation, thrust and torque and compare intervals with similar geology and tool condition; cutter engineers check loads and vibration instead of treating greater penetration per revolution as the sole performance objective. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting. Increasing load on that evidence may exceed tool capability when harder ground returns.

quiz.question: 要驗證「貫入與每轉進尺」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Penetration per revolution"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
同步推進、轉速、推力與扭矩，將相同地層與刀具狀態下的區段比較；刀具工程師需核對載重範圍與振動，不能只以提高每轉進尺作績效目標。
只更換刀環就可以把未更換軸承的累積使用時間歸零。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Synchronize advance, rotation, thrust and torque and compare intervals with similar geology and tool condition.
Replacing only the ring resets accumulated service time of the unchanged bearing.
quiz.explanation: 同步推進、轉速、推力與扭矩，將相同地層與刀具狀態下的區段比較；刀具工程師需核對載重範圍與振動，不能只以提高每轉進尺作績效目標。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize advance, rotation, thrust and torque and compare intervals with similar geology and tool condition; cutter engineers check loads and vibration instead of treating greater penetration per revolution as the sole performance objective. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 貫入與每轉進尺：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Penetration per revolution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「貫入與每轉進尺」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Penetration per revolution” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting. Increasing load on that evidence may exceed tool capability when harder ground returns. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Increasing load on that evidence may exceed tool capability when harder ground returns.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每轉進尺越大就必定代表切削效率和刀具壽命越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Greater penetration per revolution necessarily improves cutting efficiency and cutter life." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。
knowledge.textEn: Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting. Increasing load on that evidence may exceed tool capability when harder ground returns.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「貫入與每轉進尺」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Penetration per revolution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
總推力除刀具數就能得到每顆刀實際承受的峰值荷重。
轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Total thrust divided by cutter count gives each cutter's actual peak load.
Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting.
quiz.explanation: 轉速讀值或里程時間不一致會製造假高進尺，軟弱帶自然崩解也可能看似切削優秀；若據此增加荷重，進入硬岩後可能超出刀具能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unsynchronized speed and distance create false high penetration, while weak-ground disintegration can mimic excellent cutting. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「推力分配與偏載」與「切削比能與條件」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thrust distribution and uneven loading" and "Specific cutting energy and conditions": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 推力分配與偏載：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thrust distribution and uneven loading: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「推力分配與偏載」如何影響潛盾機刀具磨耗管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thrust distribution and uneven loading” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM cutter-wear management”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 總推力包含刀具切削、盾體摩擦及其他阻力，除以刀具數只是粗略平均。混合面與刀盤變形會造成偏載，真正限制可能是單刀峰值而非平均，所以需要位置與工況證據。 假設扣除非切削阻力後有效推力10 MN分到40刀，平均250 kN/刀；不等於每刀實際受力。 少數刀先接觸硬塊時可能承受高衝擊而平均推力正常，若忽略偏載便無法解釋局部刀環崩裂；盲目增加總推力可能使問題惡化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「推力分配與偏載」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Total thrust includes cutting, shield friction and other resistance, making division by cutter count only a rough mean. Mixed ground and cutterhead deformation create uneven loads, with individual peaks potentially governing instead of the average. Assume effective cutting thrust 10 MN after removing other resistance, shared by 40 tools; the mean is 250 kN/tool, not each tool's actual load. A few tools meeting a hard inclusion can suffer high impact with normal mean thrust. Ignoring uneven loading leaves localized ring fracture unexplained and may worsen it through increased total thrust. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thrust distribution and uneven loading” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總推力除刀具數就能得到每顆刀實際承受的峰值荷重。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total thrust divided by cutter count gives each cutter's actual peak load." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「推力分配與偏載」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thrust distribution and uneven loading”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 推力分配與偏載
knowledge.text: 總推力包含刀具切削、盾體摩擦及其他阻力，除以刀具數只是粗略平均。混合面與刀盤變形會造成偏載，真正限制可能是單刀峰值而非平均，所以需要位置與工況證據。
knowledge.textEn: Total thrust includes cutting, shield friction and other resistance, making division by cutter count only a rough mean. Mixed ground and cutterhead deformation create uneven loads, with individual peaks potentially governing instead of the average.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總推力除刀具數就能得到每顆刀實際承受的峰值荷重。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total thrust divided by cutter count gives each cutter's actual peak load. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「推力分配與偏載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thrust distribution and uneven loading" is correct?
options: 總推力包含刀具切削、盾體摩擦及其他阻力，除以刀具數只是粗略平均。
總推力除刀具數就能得到每顆刀實際承受的峰值荷重。
旋轉比能增加只能由岩石變硬造成，與排碴無關。
optionsEn: Total thrust includes cutting, shield friction and other resistance, making division by cutter count only a rough mean.
Total thrust divided by cutter count gives each cutter's actual peak load.
Higher rotational specific energy can only come from harder rock, never muck removal.
quiz.explanation: 總推力包含刀具切削、盾體摩擦及其他阻力，除以刀具數只是粗略平均。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Total thrust includes cutting, shield friction and other resistance, making division by cutter count only a rough mean. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 推力分配與偏載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thrust distribution and uneven loading: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「推力分配與偏載」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thrust distribution and uneven loading” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設扣除非切削阻力後有效推力10 MN分到40刀，平均250 kN/刀；不等於每刀實際受力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume effective cutting thrust 10 MN after removing other resistance, shared by 40 tools; the mean is 250 kN/tool, not each tool's actual load. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對總推力與摩擦估算，結合刀位、混合面和可用單刀量測檢查偏載；分析報告列明平均值用途和未量測峰值，不把均分模型當作所有刀具符合能力的證明。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check thrust and friction estimates against cutter positions, mixed-face geometry and available individual measurements; state the mean's limited use and unresolved peaks instead of treating equal sharing as proof of adequate capacity everywhere.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設扣除非切削阻力後有效推力10 MN分到40刀，平均250 kN/刀；不等於每刀實際受力。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume effective cutting thrust 10 MN after removing other resistance, shared by 40 tools; the mean is 250 kN/tool, not each tool's actual load.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「推力分配與偏載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thrust distribution and uneven loading", which statement holds?
options: 刀環剩餘直徑足夠就證明軸承和轉動狀態也正常。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
相同刀間距貫入比在所有岩性都會有同樣最佳切削效果。
optionsEn: Adequate remaining ring diameter proves that bearings and rotation are also healthy.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
The same spacing-penetration ratio gives identical optimum cutting in every rock type.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 推力分配與偏載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thrust distribution and uneven loading: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「推力分配與偏載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thrust distribution and uneven loading” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對總推力與摩擦估算，結合刀位、混合面和可用單刀量測檢查偏載；分析報告列明平均值用途和未量測峰值，不把均分模型當作所有刀具符合能力的證明。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：少數刀先接觸硬塊時可能承受高衝擊而平均推力正常，若忽略偏載便無法解釋局部刀環崩裂；盲目增加總推力可能使問題惡化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check thrust and friction estimates against cutter positions, mixed-face geometry and available individual measurements; state the mean's limited use and unresolved peaks instead of treating equal sharing as proof of adequate capacity everywhere. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A few tools meeting a hard inclusion can suffer high impact with normal mean thrust. Ignoring uneven loading leaves localized ring fracture unexplained and may worsen it through increased total thrust. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄推力分配與偏載的資料來源與適用條件。核對總推力與摩擦估算，結合刀位、混合面和可用單刀量測檢查偏載；分析報告列明平均值用途和未量測峰值，不把均分模型當作所有刀具符合能力的證明。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for thrust distribution and uneven loading. Check thrust and friction estimates against cutter positions, mixed-face geometry and available individual measurements; state the mean's limited use and unresolved peaks instead of treating equal sharing as proof of adequate capacity everywhere.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：少數刀先接觸硬塊時可能承受高衝擊而平均推力正常，若忽略偏載便無法解釋局部刀環崩裂；盲目增加總推力可能使問題惡化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A few tools meeting a hard inclusion can suffer high impact with normal mean thrust. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Check thrust and friction estimates against cutter positions, mixed-face geometry and available individual measurements; state the mean's limited use and unresolved peaks instead of treating equal sharing as proof of adequate capacity everywhere. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A few tools meeting a hard inclusion can suffer high impact with normal mean thrust. Ignoring uneven loading leaves localized ring fracture unexplained and may worsen it through increased total thrust.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄推力分配與偏載的資料來源與適用條件。核對總推力與摩擦估算，結合刀位、混合面和可用單刀量測檢查偏載；分析報告列明平均值用途和未量測峰值，不把均分模型當作所有刀具符合能力的證明。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for thrust distribution and uneven loading. Check thrust and friction estimates against cutter positions, mixed-face geometry and available individual measurements; state the mean's limited use and unresolved peaks instead of treating equal sharing as proof of adequate capacity everywhere.

quiz.question: 要驗證「推力分配與偏載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thrust distribution and uneven loading"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
刀具平均磨耗很低就能排除任何單刀卡死風險。
核對總推力與摩擦估算，結合刀位、混合面和可用單刀量測檢查偏載；分析報告列明平均值用途和未量測峰值，不把均分模型當作所有刀具符合能力的證明。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Low average cutter wear excludes any possibility of one seized cutter.
Check thrust and friction estimates against cutter positions, mixed-face geometry and available individual measurements.
quiz.explanation: 核對總推力與摩擦估算，結合刀位、混合面和可用單刀量測檢查偏載；分析報告列明平均值用途和未量測峰值，不把均分模型當作所有刀具符合能力的證明。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check thrust and friction estimates against cutter positions, mixed-face geometry and available individual measurements; state the mean's limited use and unresolved peaks instead of treating equal sharing as proof of adequate capacity everywhere. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 推力分配與偏載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thrust distribution and uneven loading: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「推力分配與偏載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thrust distribution and uneven loading” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 少數刀先接觸硬塊時可能承受高衝擊而平均推力正常，若忽略偏載便無法解釋局部刀環崩裂；盲目增加總推力可能使問題惡化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A few tools meeting a hard inclusion can suffer high impact with normal mean thrust. Ignoring uneven loading leaves localized ring fracture unexplained and may worsen it through increased total thrust. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：少數刀先接觸硬塊時可能承受高衝擊而平均推力正常，若忽略偏載便無法解釋局部刀環崩裂；盲目增加總推力可能使問題惡化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring uneven loading leaves localized ring fracture unexplained and may worsen it through increased total thrust.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總推力除刀具數就能得到每顆刀實際承受的峰值荷重。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total thrust divided by cutter count gives each cutter's actual peak load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 少數刀先接觸硬塊時可能承受高衝擊而平均推力正常，若忽略偏載便無法解釋局部刀環崩裂；盲目增加總推力可能使問題惡化。
knowledge.textEn: A few tools meeting a hard inclusion can suffer high impact with normal mean thrust. Ignoring uneven loading leaves localized ring fracture unexplained and may worsen it through increased total thrust.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「推力分配與偏載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thrust distribution and uneven loading" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 少數刀先接觸硬塊時可能承受高衝擊而平均推力正常，若忽略偏載便無法解釋局部刀環崩裂；盲目增加總推力可能使問題惡化。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
旋轉比能增加只能由岩石變硬造成，與排碴無關。
optionsEn: A few tools meeting a hard inclusion can suffer high impact with normal mean thrust.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Higher rotational specific energy can only come from harder rock, never muck removal.
quiz.explanation: 少數刀先接觸硬塊時可能承受高衝擊而平均推力正常，若忽略偏載便無法解釋局部刀環崩裂；盲目增加總推力可能使問題惡化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A few tools meeting a hard inclusion can suffer high impact with normal mean thrust. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 切削比能與條件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Specific cutting energy and conditions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「切削比能與條件」如何影響潛盾機刀具磨耗管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Specific cutting energy and conditions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM cutter-wear management”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 扭矩功除以開挖體積得到旋轉比能，可比較破岩代價但不包含全部系統能耗。磨耗、節理及運碴再研磨都會影響它，必須將機械狀態和地質相符的區段放在一起比較。 假設平均扭矩2 MN·m、轉10圈、開挖20 m³，E=2πTn/V=6.283 MJ/m³，僅旋轉部分。 運碴不良造成重複碾碎會抬高比能，若誤當岩石變硬便可能錯調推力；出土體積估錯又讓能量指標看似改善而實際效率下降。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「切削比能與條件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rotational work per excavated volume measures cutting cost but excludes other system energy. Wear, joints and regrinding affect it, requiring matched geological and mechanical conditions for meaningful comparisons. Assume mean torque 2 MN·m, 10 revolutions and excavation 20 m³; E=2πTn/V=6.283 MJ/m³ for rotation only. Poor muck removal raises energy through regrinding and may be misread as harder rock. Incorrect excavated volume can conversely make the energy index appear better while actual efficiency deteriorates. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Specific cutting energy and conditions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「旋轉比能增加只能由岩石變硬造成，與排碴無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher rotational specific energy can only come from harder rock, never muck removal." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「切削比能與條件」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Specific cutting energy and conditions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 切削比能與條件
knowledge.text: 扭矩功除以開挖體積得到旋轉比能，可比較破岩代價但不包含全部系統能耗。磨耗、節理及運碴再研磨都會影響它，必須將機械狀態和地質相符的區段放在一起比較。
knowledge.textEn: Rotational work per excavated volume measures cutting cost but excludes other system energy. Wear, joints and regrinding affect it, requiring matched geological and mechanical conditions for meaningful comparisons.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：旋轉比能增加只能由岩石變硬造成，與排碴無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher rotational specific energy can only come from harder rock, never muck removal. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「切削比能與條件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Specific cutting energy and conditions" is correct?
options: 旋轉比能增加只能由岩石變硬造成，與排碴無關。
扭矩功除以開挖體積得到旋轉比能，可比較破岩代價但不包含全部系統能耗。
前一岩層的平均磨耗率可以無條件預測下一岩層壽命。
optionsEn: Higher rotational specific energy can only come from harder rock, never muck removal.
Rotational work per excavated volume measures cutting cost but excludes other system energy.
The previous stratum's mean wear rate predicts life in the next stratum unconditionally.
quiz.explanation: 扭矩功除以開挖體積得到旋轉比能，可比較破岩代價但不包含全部系統能耗。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rotational work per excavated volume measures cutting cost but excludes other system energy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 切削比能與條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Specific cutting energy and conditions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「切削比能與條件」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Specific cutting energy and conditions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平均扭矩2 MN·m、轉10圈、開挖20 m³，E=2πTn/V=6.283 MJ/m³，僅旋轉部分。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume mean torque 2 MN·m, 10 revolutions and excavation 20 m³; E=2πTn/V=6.283 MJ/m³ for rotation only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將扭矩積分與實測開挖體積核對，標記停機、空轉及換刀，對照碴片尺寸與地質；比能突升先查多種成因，再由刀具與地工人員決定是否需要獨立檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check integrated torque work against measured excavation volume and mark stops, idle rotation and replacements; compare chips and geology and investigate competing causes before cutter and geotechnical specialists select further checks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平均扭矩2 MN·m、轉10圈、開挖20 m³，E=2πTn/V=6.283 MJ/m³，僅旋轉部分。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume mean torque 2 MN·m, 10 revolutions and excavation 20 m³; E=2πTn/V=6.283 MJ/m³ for rotation only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「切削比能與條件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Specific cutting energy and conditions", which statement holds?
options: 班平均扭矩正常就表示沒有局部刀具衝擊疲勞。
只更換刀環就可以把未更換軸承的累積使用時間歸零。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Normal shift-average torque means no localized cutter impact fatigue is occurring.
Replacing only the ring resets accumulated service time of the unchanged bearing.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

knowledge.text: 將扭矩積分與實測開挖體積核對，標記停機、空轉及換刀，對照碴片尺寸與地質；比能突升先查多種成因，再由刀具與地工人員決定是否需要獨立檢查。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：運碴不良造成重複碾碎會抬高比能，若誤當岩石變硬便可能錯調推力；出土體積估錯又讓能量指標看似改善而實際效率下降。

Incorrect excavated volume can conversely make the energy index appear better while actual efficiency deteriorates.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄切削比能與條件的資料來源與適用條件。將扭矩積分與實測開挖體積核對，標記停機、空轉及換刀，對照碴片尺寸與地質；比能突升先查多種成因，再由刀具與地工人員決定是否需要獨立檢查。

quiz.question: 要驗證「切削比能與條件」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Specific cutting energy and conditions"?
options: 將扭矩積分與實測開挖體積核對，標記停機、空轉及換刀，對照碴片尺寸與地質；比能突升先查多種成因，再由刀具與地工人員決定是否需要獨立檢查。

steps.title: 切削比能與條件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Specific cutting energy and conditions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「切削比能與條件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Specific cutting energy and conditions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 運碴不良造成重複碾碎會抬高比能，若誤當岩石變硬便可能錯調推力；出土體積估錯又讓能量指標看似改善而實際效率下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Poor muck removal raises energy through regrinding and may be misread as harder rock. Incorrect excavated volume can conversely make the energy index appear better while actual efficiency deteriorates. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：運碴不良造成重複碾碎會抬高比能，若誤當岩石變硬便可能錯調推力；出土體積估錯又讓能量指標看似改善而實際效率下降。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Incorrect excavated volume can conversely make the energy index appear better while actual efficiency deteriorates.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「旋轉比能增加只能由岩石變硬造成，與排碴無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher rotational specific energy can only come from harder rock, never muck removal." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 運碴不良造成重複碾碎會抬高比能，若誤當岩石變硬便可能錯調推力；出土體積估錯又讓能量指標看似改善而實際效率下降。
knowledge.textEn: Poor muck removal raises energy through regrinding and may be misread as harder rock. Incorrect excavated volume can conversely make the energy index appear better while actual efficiency deteriorates.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「切削比能與條件」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Specific cutting energy and conditions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
運碴不良造成重複碾碎會抬高比能，若誤當岩石變硬便可能錯調推力；出土體積估錯又讓能量指標看似改善而實際效率下降。
前一岩層的平均磨耗率可以無條件預測下一岩層壽命。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Poor muck removal raises energy through regrinding and may be misread as harder rock.
The previous stratum's mean wear rate predicts life in the next stratum unconditionally.
quiz.explanation: 運碴不良造成重複碾碎會抬高比能，若誤當岩石變硬便可能錯調推力；出土體積估錯又讓能量指標看似改善而實際效率下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Poor muck removal raises energy through regrinding and may be misread as harder rock. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「磨耗率與地層分段」與「刀環磨耗與軸承故障」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wear rate by geological reach" and "Ring wear and bearing failure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 磨耗率與地層分段：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wear rate by geological reach: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「磨耗率與地層分段」如何影響潛盾機刀具磨耗管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wear rate by geological reach” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM cutter-wear management”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 刀環徑向損失反映磨蝕，但壽命並非沿全程固定線性；礦物、顆粒與含水改變會使速率跳變。計算前需把更換和刀位移動分開，且保留接近極限時的非線性劣化可能。 假設徑向磨耗3 mm歷經600 m，平均0.005 mm/m；此率不能無條件外推到下一岩層。 跨岩性平均會低估磨蝕帶的即時消耗，量具基準改變又會製造假回復；錯誤壽命預估可能讓需要計畫檢查的刀具過晚被辨識。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「磨耗率與地層分段」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Radial loss measures abrasion, but life is not uniformly linear along a drive. Mineralogy, grains and water change rates abruptly. Separate replacements and relocation and retain the possibility of accelerated deterioration near a limiting condition. Assume radial wear 3 mm over 600 m; mean rate is 0.005 mm/m, not transferable unconditionally to the next stratum. Averaging across lithologies understates current wear in an abrasive band, while changed measuring datums create false recovery. The resulting life estimate identifies tools requiring planned inspection too late. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wear rate by geological reach” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「前一岩層的平均磨耗率可以無條件預測下一岩層壽命。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The previous stratum's mean wear rate predicts life in the next stratum unconditionally." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「磨耗率與地層分段」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wear rate by geological reach”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 磨耗率與地層分段
knowledge.text: 刀環徑向損失反映磨蝕，但壽命並非沿全程固定線性；礦物、顆粒與含水改變會使速率跳變。計算前需把更換和刀位移動分開，且保留接近極限時的非線性劣化可能。
knowledge.textEn: Radial loss measures abrasion, but life is not uniformly linear along a drive. Mineralogy, grains and water change rates abruptly.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：前一岩層的平均磨耗率可以無條件預測下一岩層壽命。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The previous stratum's mean wear rate predicts life in the next stratum unconditionally. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「磨耗率與地層分段」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wear rate by geological reach" is correct?
options: 前一岩層的平均磨耗率可以無條件預測下一岩層壽命。
刀環剩餘直徑足夠就證明軸承和轉動狀態也正常。
刀環徑向損失反映磨蝕，但壽命並非沿全程固定線性；礦物、顆粒與含水改變會使速率跳變。
optionsEn: The previous stratum's mean wear rate predicts life in the next stratum unconditionally.
Adequate remaining ring diameter proves that bearings and rotation are also healthy.
Radial loss measures abrasion, but life is not uniformly linear along a drive.
quiz.explanation: 刀環徑向損失反映磨蝕，但壽命並非沿全程固定線性；礦物、顆粒與含水改變會使速率跳變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Radial loss measures abrasion, but life is not uniformly linear along a drive. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 磨耗率與地層分段：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wear rate by geological reach: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「磨耗率與地層分段」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wear rate by geological reach” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設徑向磨耗3 mm歷經600 m，平均0.005 mm/m；此率不能無條件外推到下一岩層。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume radial wear 3 mm over 600 m; mean rate is 0.005 mm/m, not transferable unconditionally to the next stratum. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用一致量具和基準量測刀環，將磨耗對里程、轉數和岩性分段圖示；比較相似刀位與材料，壽命外推需由刀具工程師說明穩態假設，不能以全程平均掩蓋短高磨耗區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure with consistent gauges and datum and plot wear against chainage, revolutions and geology; compare like positions and materials and require engineers to justify steady-rate extrapolation rather than hide a short severe zone in a route average.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設徑向磨耗3 mm歷經600 m，平均0.005 mm/m；此率不能無條件外推到下一岩層。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume radial wear 3 mm over 600 m; mean rate is 0.005 mm/m, not transferable unconditionally to the next stratum.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「磨耗率與地層分段」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wear rate by geological reach", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
相同刀間距貫入比在所有岩性都會有同樣最佳切削效果。
刀具平均磨耗很低就能排除任何單刀卡死風險。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
The same spacing-penetration ratio gives identical optimum cutting in every rock type.
Low average cutter wear excludes any possibility of one seized cutter.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

quiz.question: 要驗證「刀環磨耗與軸承故障」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ring wear and bearing failure"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
總推力除刀具數就能得到每顆刀實際承受的峰值荷重。
比較同工況刀具的溫度與振動基線，檢查平磨面、偏磨及轉動狀態的核准檢查紀錄；設備主管需區分散熱環境和軸承異常，所有接近刀盤檢查遵守專業安全程序。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Total thrust divided by cutter count gives each cutter's actual peak load.
Compare temperature and vibration baselines under matched conditions with approved records of flat spots, uneven wear and rotation.
quiz.explanation: 比較同工況刀具的溫度與振動基線，檢查平磨面、偏磨及轉動狀態的核准檢查紀錄；設備主管需區分散熱環境和軸承異常，所有接近刀盤檢查遵守專業安全程序。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare temperature and vibration baselines under matched conditions with approved records of flat spots, uneven wear and rotation; equipment leads distinguish cooling changes from bearing faults, with cutterhead access restricted to specialist procedures. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 刀環磨耗與軸承故障：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ring wear and bearing failure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「刀環磨耗與軸承故障」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ring wear and bearing failure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 卡死刀具會由滾動變滑動，局部發熱和刀環損失加速，總扭矩初期卻未必明顯；只靠平均刀盤訊號可能漏掉早期單刀故障。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A seized tool slides rather than rolls, accelerating heat and local wear while total torque may initially change little. Average cutterhead signals can therefore miss the early failure of one cutter. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：卡死刀具會由滾動變滑動，局部發熱和刀環損失加速，總扭矩初期卻未必明顯；只靠平均刀盤訊號可能漏掉早期單刀故障。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Average cutterhead signals can therefore miss the early failure of one cutter.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「刀環剩餘直徑足夠就證明軸承和轉動狀態也正常。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate remaining ring diameter proves that bearings and rotation are also healthy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 卡死刀具會由滾動變滑動，局部發熱和刀環損失加速，總扭矩初期卻未必明顯；只靠平均刀盤訊號可能漏掉早期單刀故障。
knowledge.textEn: A seized tool slides rather than rolls, accelerating heat and local wear while total torque may initially change little. Average cutterhead signals can therefore miss the early failure of one cutter.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「刀環磨耗與軸承故障」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ring wear and bearing failure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 卡死刀具會由滾動變滑動，局部發熱和刀環損失加速，總扭矩初期卻未必明顯；只靠平均刀盤訊號可能漏掉早期單刀故障。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
班平均扭矩正常就表示沒有局部刀具衝擊疲勞。
optionsEn: A seized tool slides rather than rolls, accelerating heat and local wear while total torque may initially change little.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Normal shift-average torque means no localized cutter impact fatigue is occurring.
quiz.explanation: 卡死刀具會由滾動變滑動，局部發熱和刀環損失加速，總扭矩初期卻未必明顯；只靠平均刀盤訊號可能漏掉早期單刀故障。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A seized tool slides rather than rolls, accelerating heat and local wear while total torque may initially change little. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「衝擊與混合面循環」與「刀間距與碴片形成」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Impact and mixed-face cycling" and "Cutter spacing and chip formation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 衝擊與混合面循環：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Impact and mixed-face cycling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「衝擊與混合面循環」如何影響潛盾機刀具磨耗管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Impact and mixed-face cycling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM cutter-wear management”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 刀具每轉穿越硬軟界面會反覆載入卸載，平均力無法代表疲勞與衝擊。界面位置、硬塊尺寸和旋轉速度共同控制循環數與幅值，需把事件和刀位路徑對齊。 假設每轉有2次硬軟轉換、轉速3 rpm、持續100 h，轉換次數2×3×60×100=36000次。 取樣頻率不足會把衝擊平均掉，刀具卻持續承受疲勞；只統計轉數又忽略硬軟界面轉換，可能誤把局部崩裂當成偶然製造缺陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「衝擊與混合面循環」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crossing a hard-soft interface repeatedly loads and unloads a tool. Mean force cannot represent fatigue and impact; interface position, inclusion size and rotation together control cycling, requiring events to be aligned with cutter trajectories. Assume 2 transitions per revolution at 3 rpm over 100 h; transition count is 2×3×60×100=36000. Slow sampling averages impacts away while fatigue continues. Counting revolutions without interface crossings may wrongly classify localized chipping as a random manufacturing defect rather than repeated loading. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Impact and mixed-face cycling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「班平均扭矩正常就表示沒有局部刀具衝擊疲勞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal shift-average torque means no localized cutter impact fatigue is occurring." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「衝擊與混合面循環」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Impact and mixed-face cycling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 衝擊與混合面循環
knowledge.text: 刀具每轉穿越硬軟界面會反覆載入卸載，平均力無法代表疲勞與衝擊。界面位置、硬塊尺寸和旋轉速度共同控制循環數與幅值，需把事件和刀位路徑對齊。
knowledge.textEn: Crossing a hard-soft interface repeatedly loads and unloads a tool. Mean force cannot represent fatigue and impact; interface position, inclusion size and rotation together control cycling, requiring events to be aligned with cutter trajectories.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：班平均扭矩正常就表示沒有局部刀具衝擊疲勞。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Normal shift-average torque means no localized cutter impact fatigue is occurring. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「衝擊與混合面循環」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Impact and mixed-face cycling" is correct?
options: 班平均扭矩正常就表示沒有局部刀具衝擊疲勞。
刀具每轉穿越硬軟界面會反覆載入卸載，平均力無法代表疲勞與衝擊。
相同刀間距貫入比在所有岩性都會有同樣最佳切削效果。
optionsEn: Normal shift-average torque means no localized cutter impact fatigue is occurring.
Crossing a hard-soft interface repeatedly loads and unloads a tool.
The same spacing-penetration ratio gives identical optimum cutting in every rock type.
quiz.explanation: 刀具每轉穿越硬軟界面會反覆載入卸載，平均力無法代表疲勞與衝擊。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Crossing a hard-soft interface repeatedly loads and unloads a tool. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 衝擊與混合面循環：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Impact and mixed-face cycling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「衝擊與混合面循環」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Impact and mixed-face cycling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設每轉有2次硬軟轉換、轉速3 rpm、持續100 h，轉換次數2×3×60×100=36000次。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 2 transitions per revolution at 3 rpm over 100 h; transition count is 2×3×60×100=36000. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：利用地質面形與旋轉訊號對照週期性衝擊，保留高頻資料而非僅班平均；刀具工程師依實際載荷幅和材料資料評估損傷，循環數本身不能換成未經驗證的剩餘壽命。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare face geometry with rotation-synchronized impacts and retain high-frequency records rather than shift means; specialists assess damage using actual amplitudes and material data, not cycle count alone as an unvalidated remaining-life prediction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設每轉有2次硬軟轉換、轉速3 rpm、持續100 h，轉換次數2×3×60×100=36000次。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 2 transitions per revolution at 3 rpm over 100 h; transition count is 2×3×60×100=36000.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「衝擊與混合面循環」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Impact and mixed-face cycling", which statement holds?
options: 刀具平均磨耗很低就能排除任何單刀卡死風險。
每轉進尺越大就必定代表切削效率和刀具壽命越好。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Low average cutter wear excludes any possibility of one seized cutter.
Greater penetration per revolution necessarily improves cutting efficiency and cutter life.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 衝擊與混合面循環：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Impact and mixed-face cycling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「衝擊與混合面循環」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Impact and mixed-face cycling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 利用地質面形與旋轉訊號對照週期性衝擊，保留高頻資料而非僅班平均；刀具工程師依實際載荷幅和材料資料評估損傷，循環數本身不能換成未經驗證的剩餘壽命。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：取樣頻率不足會把衝擊平均掉，刀具卻持續承受疲勞；只統計轉數又忽略硬軟界面轉換，可能誤把局部崩裂當成偶然製造缺陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare face geometry with rotation-synchronized impacts and retain high-frequency records rather than shift means; specialists assess damage using actual amplitudes and material data, not cycle count alone as an unvalidated remaining-life prediction. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Slow sampling averages impacts away while fatigue continues. Counting revolutions without interface crossings may wrongly classify localized chipping as a random manufacturing defect rather than repeated loading. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄衝擊與混合面循環的資料來源與適用條件。利用地質面形與旋轉訊號對照週期性衝擊，保留高頻資料而非僅班平均；刀具工程師依實際載荷幅和材料資料評估損傷，循環數本身不能換成未經驗證的剩餘壽命。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for impact and mixed-face cycling. Compare face geometry with rotation-synchronized impacts and retain high-frequency records rather than shift means; specialists assess damage using actual amplitudes and material data, not cycle count alone as an unvalidated remaining-life prediction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：取樣頻率不足會把衝擊平均掉，刀具卻持續承受疲勞；只統計轉數又忽略硬軟界面轉換，可能誤把局部崩裂當成偶然製造缺陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Slow sampling averages impacts away while fatigue continues. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 利用地質面形與旋轉訊號對照週期性衝擊，保留高頻資料而非僅班平均；刀具工程師依實際載荷幅和材料資料評估損傷，循環數本身不能換成未經驗證的剩餘壽命。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：取樣頻率不足會把衝擊平均掉，刀具卻持續承受疲勞；只統計轉數又忽略硬軟界面轉換，可能誤把局部崩裂當成偶然製造缺陷。
knowledge.textEn: Compare face geometry with rotation-synchronized impacts and retain high-frequency records rather than shift means; specialists assess damage using actual amplitudes and material data, not cycle count alone as an unvalidated remaining-life prediction. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Slow sampling averages impacts away while fatigue continues. Counting revolutions without interface crossings may wrongly classify localized chipping as a random manufacturing defect rather than repeated loading.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄衝擊與混合面循環的資料來源與適用條件。利用地質面形與旋轉訊號對照週期性衝擊，保留高頻資料而非僅班平均；刀具工程師依實際載荷幅和材料資料評估損傷，循環數本身不能換成未經驗證的剩餘壽命。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for impact and mixed-face cycling. Compare face geometry with rotation-synchronized impacts and retain high-frequency records rather than shift means; specialists assess damage using actual amplitudes and material data, not cycle count alone as an unvalidated remaining-life prediction.

quiz.question: 要驗證「衝擊與混合面循環」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Impact and mixed-face cycling"?
options: 利用地質面形與旋轉訊號對照週期性衝擊，保留高頻資料而非僅班平均；刀具工程師依實際載荷幅和材料資料評估損傷，循環數本身不能換成未經驗證的剩餘壽命。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
旋轉比能增加只能由岩石變硬造成，與排碴無關。
optionsEn: Compare face geometry with rotation-synchronized impacts and retain high-frequency records rather than shift means.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Higher rotational specific energy can only come from harder rock, never muck removal.
quiz.explanation: 利用地質面形與旋轉訊號對照週期性衝擊，保留高頻資料而非僅班平均；刀具工程師依實際載荷幅和材料資料評估損傷，循環數本身不能換成未經驗證的剩餘壽命。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare face geometry with rotation-synchronized impacts and retain high-frequency records rather than shift means; specialists assess damage using actual amplitudes and material data, not cycle count alone as an unvalidated remaining-life prediction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 衝擊與混合面循環：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Impact and mixed-face cycling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「衝擊與混合面循環」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Impact and mixed-face cycling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 取樣頻率不足會把衝擊平均掉，刀具卻持續承受疲勞；只統計轉數又忽略硬軟界面轉換，可能誤把局部崩裂當成偶然製造缺陷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Slow sampling averages impacts away while fatigue continues. Counting revolutions without interface crossings may wrongly classify localized chipping as a random manufacturing defect rather than repeated loading. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：取樣頻率不足會把衝擊平均掉，刀具卻持續承受疲勞；只統計轉數又忽略硬軟界面轉換，可能誤把局部崩裂當成偶然製造缺陷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Counting revolutions without interface crossings may wrongly classify localized chipping as a random manufacturing defect rather than repeated loading.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「班平均扭矩正常就表示沒有局部刀具衝擊疲勞。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal shift-average torque means no localized cutter impact fatigue is occurring." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 刀間距與碴片形成：機制與系統路徑
