steps.title: 防火與爆裂驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fire and spalling verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「防火與爆裂驗證」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fire and spalling verification” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把無載小試直接代表受壓環片可能低估爆裂或接縫效應，保護層局部剝落又使鋼筋快速升溫；忽略試驗邊界會產生錯誤耐火結論。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An unloaded small test may underrepresent spalling or joint effects in loaded segments. Local cover loss also heats steel rapidly, making unexamined test boundaries a source of false fire-resistance conclusions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把無載小試直接代表受壓環片可能低估爆裂或接縫效應，保護層局部剝落又使鋼筋快速升溫；忽略試驗邊界會產生錯誤耐火結論。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Local cover loss also heats steel rapidly, making unexamined test boundaries a source of false fire-resistance conclusions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「熱擴散尺度就是實際爆裂深度和必需耐火厚度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thermal diffusion scale equals actual spalling depth and required fire-protection thickness." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把無載小試直接代表受壓環片可能低估爆裂或接縫效應，保護層局部剝落又使鋼筋快速升溫；忽略試驗邊界會產生錯誤耐火結論。
knowledge.textEn: An unloaded small test may underrepresent spalling or joint effects in loaded segments. Local cover loss also heats steel rapidly, making unexamined test boundaries a source of false fire-resistance conclusions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「防火與爆裂驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fire and spalling verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
完好混凝土擴散係數可以完整代表貫穿裂縫的傳輸。
把無載小試直接代表受壓環片可能低估爆裂或接縫效應，保護層局部剝落又使鋼筋快速升溫；忽略試驗邊界會產生錯誤耐火結論。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
An intact-concrete diffusion coefficient fully represents transport through a through-crack.
An unloaded small test may underrepresent spalling or joint effects in loaded segments.
quiz.explanation: 把無載小試直接代表受壓環片可能低估爆裂或接縫效應，保護層局部剝落又使鋼筋快速升溫；忽略試驗邊界會產生錯誤耐火結論。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An unloaded small test may underrepresent spalling or joint effects in loaded segments. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「耐久擴散與保護層」與「環片序號與品質交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Durability diffusion and cover" and "Segment serials and quality handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 耐久擴散與保護層：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Durability diffusion and cover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「耐久擴散與保護層」如何影響隧道管片預鑄與養護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Durability diffusion and cover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-segment precasting and curing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 離子與水分進入混凝土的速度受孔隙結構、裂縫和接縫影響，完好材料的擴散模型不能涵蓋所有快速通道。保護層需兼顧製造公差與裂縫控制，不能只依名義厚度預測壽命。 假設純擴散尺度t≈x²/D，x由40增50 mm，其餘相同，時間比(50/40)²=1.5625；非壽命保證。 局部保護層不足或貫穿裂縫會主導劣化，平均厚度合格仍可能出現早期鏽蝕；以完好材料係數算出長壽命，無法彌補未處理快速通道。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「耐久擴散與保護層」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Moisture and ions enter through matrix pores, cracks and joints. Intact-material diffusion misses preferential paths, so cover must consider manufacturing tolerance and cracking rather than predicting life from nominal thickness alone. Under assumed diffusion scaling t≈x²/D, increasing x from 40 to 50 mm gives time ratio 1.5625 at unchanged D, not a service-life guarantee. Local thin cover or through-cracks can govern early corrosion despite an acceptable mean. A long life calculated with intact-material coefficients does not compensate for unaddressed preferential transport paths. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Durability diffusion and cover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完好混凝土擴散係數可以完整代表貫穿裂縫的傳輸。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An intact-concrete diffusion coefficient fully represents transport through a through-crack." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「耐久擴散與保護層」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Durability diffusion and cover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An intact-concrete diffusion coefficient fully represents transport through a through-crack. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「耐久擴散與保護層」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Durability diffusion and cover" is correct?
options: 離子與水分進入混凝土的速度受孔隙結構、裂縫和接縫影響，完好材料的擴散模型不能涵蓋所有快速通道。

steps.title: 耐久擴散與保護層：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Durability diffusion and cover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「耐久擴散與保護層」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Durability diffusion and cover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設純擴散尺度t≈x²/D，x由40增50 mm，其餘相同，時間比(50/40)²=1.5625；非壽命保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Under assumed diffusion scaling t≈x²/D, increasing x from 40 to 50 mm gives time ratio 1.5625 at unchanged D, not a service-life guarantee. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測實際保護層、裂縫及吸水或遷移試驗指標，對照暴露環境和接縫細節；耐久設計需分列材料擴散與裂縫通道，評估試驗加速條件如何轉換到使用期。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure actual cover, cracking and absorption or migration indices against exposure and joint details; separate matrix transport from crack pathways and justify transfer from accelerated tests to service conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設純擴散尺度t≈x²/D，x由40增50 mm，其餘相同，時間比(50/40)²=1.5625；非壽命保證。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Under assumed diffusion scaling t≈x²/D, increasing x from 40 to 50 mm gives time ratio 1.5625 at unchanged D, not a service-life guarantee.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「耐久擴散與保護層」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Durability diffusion and cover", which statement holds?

optionsEn: The mean of a few specimens is the characteristic design strength of the whole batch.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Same-direction dimensional biases can be combined like independent random errors by root-sum-square.

steps.title: 耐久擴散與保護層：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Durability diffusion and cover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「耐久擴散與保護層」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Durability diffusion and cover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測實際保護層、裂縫及吸水或遷移試驗指標，對照暴露環境和接縫細節；耐久設計需分列材料擴散與裂縫通道，評估試驗加速條件如何轉換到使用期。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：局部保護層不足或貫穿裂縫會主導劣化，平均厚度合格仍可能出現早期鏽蝕；以完好材料係數算出長壽命，無法彌補未處理快速通道。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure actual cover, cracking and absorption or migration indices against exposure and joint details; separate matrix transport from crack pathways and justify transfer from accelerated tests to service conditions. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Local thin cover or through-cracks can govern early corrosion despite an acceptable mean. A long life calculated with intact-material coefficients does not compensate for unaddressed preferential transport paths. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄耐久擴散與保護層的資料來源與適用條件。量測實際保護層、裂縫及吸水或遷移試驗指標，對照暴露環境和接縫細節；耐久設計需分列材料擴散與裂縫通道，評估試驗加速條件如何轉換到使用期。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for durability diffusion and cover. Measure actual cover, cracking and absorption or migration indices against exposure and joint details; separate matrix transport from crack pathways and justify transfer from accelerated tests to service conditions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部保護層不足或貫穿裂縫會主導劣化，平均厚度合格仍可能出現早期鏽蝕；以完好材料係數算出長壽命，無法彌補未處理快速通道。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local thin cover or through-cracks can govern early corrosion despite an acceptable mean. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Measure actual cover, cracking and absorption or migration indices against exposure and joint details; separate matrix transport from crack pathways and justify transfer from accelerated tests to service conditions. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Local thin cover or through-cracks can govern early corrosion despite an acceptable mean. A long life calculated with intact-material coefficients does not compensate for unaddressed preferential transport paths.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄耐久擴散與保護層的資料來源與適用條件。量測實際保護層、裂縫及吸水或遷移試驗指標，對照暴露環境和接縫細節；耐久設計需分列材料擴散與裂縫通道，評估試驗加速條件如何轉換到使用期。

Measure actual cover, cracking and absorption or migration indices against exposure and joint details; separate matrix transport from crack pathways and justify transfer from accelerated tests to service conditions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「耐久擴散與保護層」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Durability diffusion and cover"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
同一環片的吊運支點移動不會改變暫態彎矩。
量測實際保護層、裂縫及吸水或遷移試驗指標，對照暴露環境和接縫細節；耐久設計需分列材料擴散與裂縫通道，評估試驗加速條件如何轉換到使用期。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Moving handling support points cannot change transient bending in the same segment.
Measure actual cover, cracking and absorption or migration indices against exposure and joint details.
quiz.explanation: 量測實際保護層、裂縫及吸水或遷移試驗指標，對照暴露環境和接縫細節；耐久設計需分列材料擴散與裂縫通道，評估試驗加速條件如何轉換到使用期。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure actual cover, cracking and absorption or migration indices against exposure and joint details; separate matrix transport from crack pathways and justify transfer from accelerated tests to service conditions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 耐久擴散與保護層：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Durability diffusion and cover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「耐久擴散與保護層」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Durability diffusion and cover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部保護層不足或貫穿裂縫會主導劣化，平均厚度合格仍可能出現早期鏽蝕；以完好材料係數算出長壽命，無法彌補未處理快速通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local thin cover or through-cracks can govern early corrosion despite an acceptable mean. A long life calculated with intact-material coefficients does not compensate for unaddressed preferential transport paths. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：局部保護層不足或貫穿裂縫會主導劣化，平均厚度合格仍可能出現早期鏽蝕；以完好材料係數算出長壽命，無法彌補未處理快速通道。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A long life calculated with intact-material coefficients does not compensate for unaddressed preferential transport paths.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完好混凝土擴散係數可以完整代表貫穿裂縫的傳輸。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An intact-concrete diffusion coefficient fully represents transport through a through-crack." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部保護層不足或貫穿裂縫會主導劣化，平均厚度合格仍可能出現早期鏽蝕；以完好材料係數算出長壽命，無法彌補未處理快速通道。
knowledge.textEn: Local thin cover or through-cracks can govern early corrosion despite an acceptable mean. A long life calculated with intact-material coefficients does not compensate for unaddressed preferential transport paths.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「耐久擴散與保護層」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Durability diffusion and cover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 局部保護層不足或貫穿裂縫會主導劣化，平均厚度合格仍可能出現早期鏽蝕；以完好材料係數算出長壽命，無法彌補未處理快速通道。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
掃碼成功就代表環片資料內容已完成工程品質審查。
optionsEn: Local thin cover or through-cracks can govern early corrosion despite an acceptable mean.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A successful barcode scan means the segment records have passed engineering quality review.
quiz.explanation: 局部保護層不足或貫穿裂縫會主導劣化，平均厚度合格仍可能出現早期鏽蝕；以完好材料係數算出長壽命，無法彌補未處理快速通道。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Local thin cover or through-cracks can govern early corrosion despite an acceptable mean. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 環片序號與品質交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Segment serials and quality handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「環片序號與品質交接」如何影響隧道管片預鑄與養護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Segment serials and quality handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-segment precasting and curing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 環片從模具、材料批次到組裝位置形成長資料鏈，任何環節失去身份都會削弱缺陷追蹤。交接應讓一個裂縫回到製造和運輸事件，也讓異常批次找到所有已安裝位置。 假設一批120片有118片可完整追溯，比例98.33%；缺失2片不能因整體比例高而自動驗收。 重複序號或替換未登記會把缺陷批次定位到錯誤環，資料完整表象反而增加誤信；只有可雙向追溯的鏈才能支援針對性檢查與維護。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環片序號與品質交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Segments form a data chain from mould and batch to installed position. Lost identity impairs defect tracing; handover must connect a crack to manufacturing and handling events and locate every installed piece from an affected batch. If 118 of an assumed 120 segments are fully traceable, the rate is 98.33%; the remaining 2 do not qualify automatically because the overall rate is high. Duplicate serials or undocumented substitutions locate defective batches in the wrong ring, creating false confidence from apparent completeness. Only bidirectional traceability supports targeted inspection and subsequent maintenance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Segment serials and quality handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「掃碼成功就代表環片資料內容已完成工程品質審查。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A successful barcode scan means the segment records have passed engineering quality review." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「環片序號與品質交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Segment serials and quality handover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環片序號與品質交接
knowledge.text: 環片從模具、材料批次到組裝位置形成長資料鏈，任何環節失去身份都會削弱缺陷追蹤。交接應讓一個裂縫回到製造和運輸事件，也讓異常批次找到所有已安裝位置。
knowledge.textEn: Segments form a data chain from mould and batch to installed position. Lost identity impairs defect tracing; handover must connect a crack to manufacturing and handling events and locate every installed piece from an affected batch.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：掃碼成功就代表環片資料內容已完成工程品質審查。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A successful barcode scan means the segment records have passed engineering quality review. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環片序號與品質交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Segment serials and quality handover" is correct?
options: 掃碼成功就代表環片資料內容已完成工程品質審查。
環片從模具、材料批次到組裝位置形成長資料鏈，任何環節失去身份都會削弱缺陷追蹤。
永久成環荷載合格就代表運輸和吊運階段必定合格。
optionsEn: A successful barcode scan means the segment records have passed engineering quality review.
Segments form a data chain from mould and batch to installed position.
Adequate permanent-ring capacity necessarily proves adequate transport and handling performance.
quiz.explanation: 環片從模具、材料批次到組裝位置形成長資料鏈，任何環節失去身份都會削弱缺陷追蹤。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Segments form a data chain from mould and batch to installed position. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環片序號與品質交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Segment serials and quality handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環片序號與品質交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Segment serials and quality handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設一批120片有118片可完整追溯，比例98.33%；缺失2片不能因整體比例高而自動驗收。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 118 of an assumed 120 segments are fully traceable, the rate is 98.33%; the remaining 2 do not qualify automatically because the overall rate is high. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽取已裝環片逆查材料、試驗、尺寸、修補與運輸單，另由批號正查安裝位置；品質主管將缺漏和限制逐件簽認，數位掃碼成功不等於資料內容已通過工程審查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace installed pieces backward through materials, tests, dimensions, repairs and transport, and trace batches forward to locations; quality leads resolve gaps individually, since successful scanning does not constitute engineering acceptance of content.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Segment serials and quality handover", which statement holds?

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環片序號與品質交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Segment serials and quality handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 抽取已裝環片逆查材料、試驗、尺寸、修補與運輸單，另由批號正查安裝位置；品質主管將缺漏和限制逐件簽認，數位掃碼成功不等於資料內容已通過工程審查。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：重複序號或替換未登記會把缺陷批次定位到錯誤環，資料完整表象反而增加誤信；只有可雙向追溯的鏈才能支援針對性檢查與維護。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace installed pieces backward through materials, tests, dimensions, repairs and transport, and trace batches forward to locations; quality leads resolve gaps individually, since successful scanning does not constitute engineering acceptance of content. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Duplicate serials or undocumented substitutions locate defective batches in the wrong ring, creating false confidence from apparent completeness. Only bidirectional traceability supports targeted inspection and subsequent maintenance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄環片序號與品質交接的資料來源與適用條件。抽取已裝環片逆查材料、試驗、尺寸、修補與運輸單，另由批號正查安裝位置；品質主管將缺漏和限制逐件簽認，數位掃碼成功不等於資料內容已通過工程審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for segment serials and quality handover. Trace installed pieces backward through materials, tests, dimensions, repairs and transport, and trace batches forward to locations; quality leads resolve gaps individually, since successful scanning does not constitute engineering acceptance of content.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重複序號或替換未登記會把缺陷批次定位到錯誤環，資料完整表象反而增加誤信；只有可雙向追溯的鏈才能支援針對性檢查與維護。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Duplicate serials or undocumented substitutions locate defective batches in the wrong ring, creating false confidence from apparent completeness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 環片序號與品質交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Segment serials and quality handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環片序號與品質交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Segment serials and quality handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重複序號或替換未登記會把缺陷批次定位到錯誤環，資料完整表象反而增加誤信；只有可雙向追溯的鏈才能支援針對性檢查與維護。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Duplicate serials or undocumented substitutions locate defective batches in the wrong ring, creating false confidence from apparent completeness. Only bidirectional traceability supports targeted inspection and subsequent maintenance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：重複序號或替換未登記會把缺陷批次定位到錯誤環，資料完整表象反而增加誤信；只有可雙向追溯的鏈才能支援針對性檢查與維護。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Only bidirectional traceability supports targeted inspection and subsequent maintenance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「掃碼成功就代表環片資料內容已完成工程品質審查。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A successful barcode scan means the segment records have passed engineering quality review." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重複序號或替換未登記會把缺陷批次定位到錯誤環，資料完整表象反而增加誤信；只有可雙向追溯的鏈才能支援針對性檢查與維護。
knowledge.textEn: Duplicate serials or undocumented substitutions locate defective batches in the wrong ring, creating false confidence from apparent completeness. Only bidirectional traceability supports targeted inspection and subsequent maintenance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環片序號與品質交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Segment serials and quality handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
重複序號或替換未登記會把缺陷批次定位到錯誤環，資料完整表象反而增加誤信；只有可雙向追溯的鏈才能支援針對性檢查與維護。
永久成環荷載合格就代表運輸和吊運階段必定合格。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Duplicate serials or undocumented substitutions locate defective batches in the wrong ring, creating false confidence from apparent completeness.
Adequate permanent-ring capacity necessarily proves adequate transport and handling performance.
quiz.explanation: 重複序號或替換未登記會把缺陷批次定位到錯誤環，資料完整表象反而增加誤信；只有可雙向追溯的鏈才能支援針對性檢查與維護。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Duplicate serials or undocumented substitutions locate defective batches in the wrong ring, creating false confidence from apparent completeness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 隧道管片防水墊圈安裝
summary: 本課聚焦把止水墊壓縮、接縫偏移與長期鬆弛連到可驗證的水密性。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on connect gasket compression, joint offset and long-term relaxation to verifiable watertightness. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設有效原高20 mm、壓後15 mm，壓縮率(20−15)/20=25%；非任何產品的允收值。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水水頭50 m，壓差ρgh=0.4905 MPa；這是教學換算，未含設計裕度及暫態。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume effective initial height 20 mm and compressed height 15 mm; compression is 25%, not an acceptance value for any product. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed fresh-water head of 50 m gives ρgh=0.4905 MPa, a teaching conversion excluding design allowance and transients. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」與「水頭與試驗壓差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Compression and groove geometry" and "Water head and test differential": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 壓縮量與溝槽幾何：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Compression and groove geometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」如何影響隧道管片防水墊圈安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compression and groove geometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Segmental-lining gasket installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 止水墊靠受壓變形建立連續接觸，壓縮不足留通道，過度壓縮又可能損傷橡膠或環片邊緣。應以實際溝槽和接縫幾何計算，名義墊高不能單獨代表安裝後接觸狀態。 假設有效原高20 mm、壓後15 mm，壓縮率(20−15)/20=25%；非任何產品的允收值。 溝槽過深即使墊高正確也可能壓縮不足，局部砂粒又造成點壓和旁側通道；只看外露高度一致會漏掉真正接觸不連續的區域。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A gasket deforms under compression to establish continuous contact. Insufficient compression leaves paths, while excessive compression can damage rubber or concrete. Actual groove and joint geometry, not nominal gasket height alone, governs installed contact. Assume effective initial height 20 mm and compressed height 15 mm; compression is 25%, not an acceptance value for any product. An overly deep groove can undercompress a correctly sized gasket, while grit creates point loading and adjacent paths. Uniform visible height can therefore conceal discontinuous contact where leakage originates. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Compression and groove geometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只量止水墊原始高度就能知道安裝後的實際壓縮率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Original gasket height alone determines its actual installed compression ratio." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Compression and groove geometry”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓縮量與溝槽幾何
knowledge.text: 止水墊靠受壓變形建立連續接觸，壓縮不足留通道，過度壓縮又可能損傷橡膠或環片邊緣。應以實際溝槽和接縫幾何計算，名義墊高不能單獨代表安裝後接觸狀態。
knowledge.textEn: A gasket deforms under compression to establish continuous contact. Insufficient compression leaves paths, while excessive compression can damage rubber or concrete.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只量止水墊原始高度就能知道安裝後的實際壓縮率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Original gasket height alone determines its actual installed compression ratio. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Compression and groove geometry" is correct?
options: 只量止水墊原始高度就能知道安裝後的實際壓縮率。
止水墊靠受壓變形建立連續接觸，壓縮不足留通道，過度壓縮又可能損傷橡膠或環片邊緣。
短時間不漏水就保證所有老化和變形情境都合格。
optionsEn: Original gasket height alone determines its actual installed compression ratio.
A gasket deforms under compression to establish continuous contact.
Brief absence of leakage proves adequacy under every aging and deformation scenario.
quiz.explanation: 止水墊靠受壓變形建立連續接觸，壓縮不足留通道，過度壓縮又可能損傷橡膠或環片邊緣。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A gasket deforms under compression to establish continuous contact. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓縮量與溝槽幾何：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Compression and groove geometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓縮量與溝槽幾何」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Compression and groove geometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設有效原高20 mm、壓後15 mm，壓縮率(20−15)/20=25%；非任何產品的允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume effective initial height 20 mm and compressed height 15 mm; compression is 25%, not an acceptance value for any product. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測止水墊、溝槽與實際縫寬，核對產品及環片核准圖面，對照力位移試驗曲線；品質主管需確認組合公差而非只驗單件尺寸，算例百分比不構成安裝規格。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure gasket, groove and actual gap against approved product and segment drawings and load-displacement curves; quality review checks combined tolerances, and the example percentage is not an installation specification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 水頭與試驗壓差：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「水頭與試驗壓差」如何影響隧道管片防水墊圈安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water head and test differential” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Segmental-lining gasket installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水密需求取決於地下水頭、內外壓及局部高度，不只是隧道埋深。試驗壓差須代表核准設計情境並保留溫度、持時和變形條件，不能把一次短暫不漏水等同全壽期性能。 假設淡水水頭50 m，壓差ρgh=0.4905 MPa；這是教學換算，未含設計裕度及暫態。 忽略感測器高程或管線損失會錯估實際試件壓差，過短持時又可能看不到慢漏；標稱水壓相同的兩次試驗因此未必有相同嚴格程度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水頭與試驗壓差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Watertight demand depends on head, internal-external pressure and elevation, not cover depth alone. Testing must represent approved pressure, temperature, duration and deformation, since brief absence of leakage does not establish lifetime performance. An assumed fresh-water head of 50 m gives ρgh=0.4905 MPa, a teaching conversion excluding design allowance and transients. Ignoring gauge elevation or line loss misstates specimen pressure, while short duration misses slow leakage. Two tests with the same nominal pressure can therefore impose materially different demands. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Water head and test differential” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 將試驗水壓計與試件高程校正，核對供水側及量測側壓力，觀察持時漏量與接縫幾何；試驗負責人依核准規格判定，不採用本課水頭自訂產品認證。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：忽略感測器高程或管線損失會錯估實際試件壓差，過短持時又可能看不到慢漏；標稱水壓相同的兩次試驗因此未必有相同嚴格程度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Correct pressure for gauge and specimen elevation and compare supply and measured sides while monitoring duration, leakage and gap geometry; test leads apply the approved specification, not an improvised product certification based on this example. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Ignoring gauge elevation or line loss misstates specimen pressure, while short duration misses slow leakage. Two tests with the same nominal pressure can therefore impose materially different demands. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 水頭與試驗壓差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Water head and test differential: failure diagnosis

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Water head and test differential” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略感測器高程或管線損失會錯估實際試件壓差，過短持時又可能看不到慢漏；標稱水壓相同的兩次試驗因此未必有相同嚴格程度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring gauge elevation or line loss misstates specimen pressure, while short duration misses slow leakage. Two tests with the same nominal pressure can therefore impose materially different demands. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：忽略感測器高程或管線損失會錯估實際試件壓差，過短持時又可能看不到慢漏；標稱水壓相同的兩次試驗因此未必有相同嚴格程度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Two tests with the same nominal pressure can therefore impose materially different demands.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「短時間不漏水就保證所有老化和變形情境都合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Brief absence of leakage proves adequacy under every aging and deformation scenario." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水頭與試驗壓差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。

忽略感測器高程或管線損失會錯估實際試件壓差，過短持時又可能看不到慢漏；標稱水壓相同的兩次試驗因此未必有相同嚴格程度。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Separate gap and offset compliance guarantees watertightness for every combination.
Ignoring gauge elevation or line loss misstates specimen pressure, while short duration misses slow leakage.

quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring gauge elevation or line loss misstates specimen pressure, while short duration misses slow leakage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「錯台與接觸寬度」與「壓縮反力與混凝土」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Offset and contact width" and "Compression force and concrete": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 錯台與接觸寬度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Offset and contact width: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「錯台與接觸寬度」如何影響隧道管片防水墊圈安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Offset and contact width” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Segmental-lining gasket installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接縫錯台使兩側止水墊橫向錯開，接觸寬度下降並可能扭轉局部橡膠。縫寬和錯台應組合評估，同一錯台在不同壓縮量下可有不同水密效果，不能分項合格就推定組合合格。 假設簡化接觸寬30 mm、錯台5 mm，幾何重疊25 mm、保留83.3%；未包含橡膠側向變形。 兩項各自接近允許邊界時組合可能失水密，錯台集中於角部又更不利；只用平均縫寬會把局部接觸寬度不足掩蓋掉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「錯台與接觸寬度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint offset reduces overlapping contact and may twist rubber. Gap and offset interact, with the same offset behaving differently at different compression, so separate dimensional compliance does not establish combined watertightness. Assume nominal contact width 30 mm and offset 5 mm; geometric overlap is 25 mm or 83.3%, excluding lateral rubber deformation. Two individually acceptable near-limit dimensions can fail when combined, especially at corners. Mean gap measurements conceal local loss of contact width and the continuous leakage path it can create. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Offset and contact width” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「縫寬和錯台分別合格就代表任何組合都一定水密。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Separate gap and offset compliance guarantees watertightness for every combination." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「錯台與接觸寬度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Offset and contact width”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 錯台與接觸寬度
knowledge.text: 接縫錯台使兩側止水墊橫向錯開，接觸寬度下降並可能扭轉局部橡膠。縫寬和錯台應組合評估，同一錯台在不同壓縮量下可有不同水密效果，不能分項合格就推定組合合格。
knowledge.textEn: Joint offset reduces overlapping contact and may twist rubber. Gap and offset interact, with the same offset behaving differently at different compression, so separate dimensional compliance does not establish combined watertightness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：縫寬和錯台分別合格就代表任何組合都一定水密。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Separate gap and offset compliance guarantees watertightness for every combination. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「錯台與接觸寬度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Offset and contact width" is correct?
options: 接縫錯台使兩側止水墊橫向錯開，接觸寬度下降並可能扭轉局部橡膠。
縫寬和錯台分別合格就代表任何組合都一定水密。
止水墊反力越大越好，不必檢查混凝土溝槽劈裂。
optionsEn: Joint offset reduces overlapping contact and may twist rubber.
Separate gap and offset compliance guarantees watertightness for every combination.
Greater gasket reaction is always better without checking concrete groove splitting.
quiz.explanation: 接縫錯台使兩側止水墊橫向錯開，接觸寬度下降並可能扭轉局部橡膠。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint offset reduces overlapping contact and may twist rubber. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 錯台與接觸寬度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Offset and contact width: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錯台與接觸寬度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Offset and contact width” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設簡化接觸寬30 mm、錯台5 mm，幾何重疊25 mm、保留83.3%；未包含橡膠側向變形。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume nominal contact width 30 mm and offset 5 mm; geometric overlap is 25 mm or 83.3%, excluding lateral rubber deformation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以代表性最不利縫寬和錯台組合做核准水密試驗，記錄接觸印痕及漏點；測量安裝後幾何時保留方位，品質主管需確認組合落在試驗覆蓋範圍而非只比較單一公差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test approved adverse gap-offset combinations and record contact impressions and leak paths; preserve angular position in installed measurements and verify that combinations fall inside tested coverage rather than checking isolated tolerances.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設簡化接觸寬30 mm、錯台5 mm，幾何重疊25 mm、保留83.3%；未包含橡膠側向變形。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume nominal contact width 30 mm and offset 5 mm; geometric overlap is 25 mm or 83.3%, excluding lateral rubber deformation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「錯台與接觸寬度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.instructionEn: Gasket compression transmits reaction into the concrete groove. Assume line reaction 30 kN/m over 2 m; total force is 60 kN, while groove stress still requires contact area and detailing analysis. High reaction can crack groove edges before leakage appears, and damaged geometry then undermines sealing. Rubber-only material tests do not reveal this coupled system failure mechanism under assembly loading. Measure load-displacement in representative grooves and inspect concrete cracking against reinforcement and corner details; include assembly deformation and require structural and seal designers to confirm compatible reaction and water resistance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓縮反力與混凝土」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Compression force and concrete"?
options: 以實際溝槽試件量測力位移並檢查混凝土裂縫，對照環片配筋與角部細節；試驗須涵蓋組裝變形，結構及止水設計者共同確認力與水密的相容性。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只量止水墊原始高度就能知道安裝後的實際壓縮率。
optionsEn: Measure load-displacement in representative grooves and inspect concrete cracking against reinforcement and corner details.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Original gasket height alone determines its actual installed compression ratio.
quiz.explanation: 以實際溝槽試件量測力位移並檢查混凝土裂縫，對照環片配筋與角部細節；試驗須涵蓋組裝變形，結構及止水設計者共同確認力與水密的相容性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure load-displacement in representative grooves and inspect concrete cracking against reinforcement and corner details; include assembly deformation and require structural and seal designers to confirm compatible reaction and water resistance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓縮反力與混凝土：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compression force and concrete: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓縮反力與混凝土」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compression force and concrete” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高反力可在尚未出現滲漏前損傷溝槽邊緣，裂損後幾何又降低密封效果；只用橡膠材料試驗無法看出這種系統性反作用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High reaction can crack groove edges before leakage appears, and damaged geometry then undermines sealing. Rubber-only material tests do not reveal this coupled system failure mechanism under assembly loading. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：高反力可在尚未出現滲漏前損傷溝槽邊緣，裂損後幾何又降低密封效果；只用橡膠材料試驗無法看出這種系統性反作用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Rubber-only material tests do not reveal this coupled system failure mechanism under assembly loading.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「止水墊反力越大越好，不必檢查混凝土溝槽劈裂。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Greater gasket reaction is always better without checking concrete groove splitting." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高反力可在尚未出現滲漏前損傷溝槽邊緣，裂損後幾何又降低密封效果；只用橡膠材料試驗無法看出這種系統性反作用。
knowledge.textEn: High reaction can crack groove edges before leakage appears, and damaged geometry then undermines sealing. Rubber-only material tests do not reveal this coupled system failure mechanism under assembly loading.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓縮反力與混凝土」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Compression force and concrete" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
高反力可在尚未出現滲漏前損傷溝槽邊緣，裂損後幾何又降低密封效果；只用橡膠材料試驗無法看出這種系統性反作用。
橡膠外觀沒有裂紋就證明接觸力沒有長期鬆弛。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
High reaction can crack groove edges before leakage appears, and damaged geometry then undermines sealing.
An uncracked rubber appearance proves that contact force has not relaxed over time.
quiz.explanation: 高反力可在尚未出現滲漏前損傷溝槽邊緣，裂損後幾何又降低密封效果；只用橡膠材料試驗無法看出這種系統性反作用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: High reaction can crack groove edges before leakage appears, and damaged geometry then undermines sealing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「長期應力鬆弛」與「角部與交叉接點」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Long-term stress relaxation" and "Corners and intersecting joints": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 長期應力鬆弛：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-term stress relaxation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「長期應力鬆弛」如何影響隧道管片防水墊圈安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-term stress relaxation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Segmental-lining gasket installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 橡膠維持壓縮時接觸力可能隨時間下降，溫度與介質改變又影響老化。初始反力不是永久反力，壓縮永久變形和應力鬆弛也不是同一指標，必須按功能分別檢驗。 假設初始接觸力100 kN、特定試驗後70 kN，力保留70%；不得由此直接推算實際50年壽命。 外觀無裂紋不表示接觸力未下降，使用不適當加速因子又可能誇大壽命；若老化後接縫再張開，原先短期試驗的水密證據不足以涵蓋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「長期應力鬆弛」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compressed rubber can lose contact force over time, with temperature and medium affecting aging. Initial reaction is not permanent reaction, and compression set differs from stress relaxation; the two need separate functional assessment. Assume initial contact force 100 kN and 70 kN after a specified test; retention is 70%, not a direct prediction of 50-year service life. An uncracked appearance does not prove retained contact force, and an inappropriate acceleration factor exaggerates life. Subsequent joint opening can exceed what the original short-term test actually demonstrated. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Long-term stress relaxation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橡膠外觀沒有裂紋就證明接觸力沒有長期鬆弛。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An uncracked rubber appearance proves that contact force has not relaxed over time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「長期應力鬆弛」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Long-term stress relaxation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長期應力鬆弛
knowledge.text: 橡膠維持壓縮時接觸力可能隨時間下降，溫度與介質改變又影響老化。初始反力不是永久反力，壓縮永久變形和應力鬆弛也不是同一指標，必須按功能分別檢驗。
knowledge.textEn: Compressed rubber can lose contact force over time, with temperature and medium affecting aging. Initial reaction is not permanent reaction, and compression set differs from stress relaxation; the two need separate functional assessment.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橡膠外觀沒有裂紋就證明接觸力沒有長期鬆弛。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An uncracked rubber appearance proves that contact force has not relaxed over time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長期應力鬆弛」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-term stress relaxation" is correct?
options: 橡膠外觀沒有裂紋就證明接觸力沒有長期鬆弛。
直線墊條試驗合格就可以省略全部角部交會試驗。
橡膠維持壓縮時接觸力可能隨時間下降，溫度與介質改變又影響老化。
optionsEn: An uncracked rubber appearance proves that contact force has not relaxed over time.
Passing straight-strip tests makes all corner-intersection testing unnecessary.
Compressed rubber can lose contact force over time, with temperature and medium affecting aging.
quiz.explanation: 橡膠維持壓縮時接觸力可能隨時間下降，溫度與介質改變又影響老化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compressed rubber can lose contact force over time, with temperature and medium affecting aging. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長期應力鬆弛：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-term stress relaxation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長期應力鬆弛」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long-term stress relaxation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設初始接觸力100 kN、特定試驗後70 kN，力保留70%；不得由此直接推算實際50年壽命。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume initial contact force 100 kN and 70 kN after a specified test; retention is 70%, not a direct prediction of 50-year service life. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對加速老化試驗的溫度、時間及液體環境，測量老化後力位移與水密而非只看外觀；材料工程師需說明時間溫度外推的適用範圍，保留實際長期資料作核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review accelerated-aging temperature, duration and medium and test aged force-displacement and watertightness, not appearance alone; materials engineers justify extrapolation scope and compare available long-term observations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設初始接觸力100 kN、特定試驗後70 kN，力保留70%；不得由此直接推算實際50年壽命。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume initial contact force 100 kN and 70 kN after a specified test; retention is 70%, not a direct prediction of 50-year service life.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長期應力鬆弛」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-term stress relaxation", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
夾雜硬顆粒時增加閉合力必定能恢復完整止水。
產品通過證書可以取代現地接縫幾何和批次追溯。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Increasing closure force always restores complete sealing when hard debris is trapped.
A product pass certificate replaces field joint geometry and batch traceability.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長期應力鬆弛：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-term stress relaxation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長期應力鬆弛」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-term stress relaxation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對加速老化試驗的溫度、時間及液體環境，測量老化後力位移與水密而非只看外觀；材料工程師需說明時間溫度外推的適用範圍，保留實際長期資料作核對。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：外觀無裂紋不表示接觸力未下降，使用不適當加速因子又可能誇大壽命；若老化後接縫再張開，原先短期試驗的水密證據不足以涵蓋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review accelerated-aging temperature, duration and medium and test aged force-displacement and watertightness, not appearance alone; materials engineers justify extrapolation scope and compare available long-term observations. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: An uncracked appearance does not prove retained contact force, and an inappropriate acceleration factor exaggerates life. Subsequent joint opening can exceed what the original short-term test actually demonstrated. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄長期應力鬆弛的資料來源與適用條件。核對加速老化試驗的溫度、時間及液體環境，測量老化後力位移與水密而非只看外觀；材料工程師需說明時間溫度外推的適用範圍，保留實際長期資料作核對。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for long-term stress relaxation. Review accelerated-aging temperature, duration and medium and test aged force-displacement and watertightness, not appearance alone; materials engineers justify extrapolation scope and compare available long-term observations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：外觀無裂紋不表示接觸力未下降，使用不適當加速因子又可能誇大壽命；若老化後接縫再張開，原先短期試驗的水密證據不足以涵蓋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An uncracked appearance does not prove retained contact force, and an inappropriate acceleration factor exaggerates life. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對加速老化試驗的溫度、時間及液體環境，測量老化後力位移與水密而非只看外觀；材料工程師需說明時間溫度外推的適用範圍，保留實際長期資料作核對。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：外觀無裂紋不表示接觸力未下降，使用不適當加速因子又可能誇大壽命；若老化後接縫再張開，原先短期試驗的水密證據不足以涵蓋。

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: An uncracked appearance does not prove retained contact force, and an inappropriate acceleration factor exaggerates life. Subsequent joint opening can exceed what the original short-term test actually demonstrated.

knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for long-term stress relaxation. Review accelerated-aging temperature, duration and medium and test aged force-displacement and watertightness, not appearance alone; materials engineers justify extrapolation scope and compare available long-term observations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長期應力鬆弛」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-term stress relaxation"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
核對加速老化試驗的溫度、時間及液體環境，測量老化後力位移與水密而非只看外觀；材料工程師需說明時間溫度外推的適用範圍，保留實際長期資料作核對。

optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

steps.title: 長期應力鬆弛：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-term stress relaxation: failure diagnosis

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 1 of 4 assumed corners has an unverified connection, corner coverage is missing 25%; its small fraction of total perimeter does not justify ignoring the risk. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「角部與交叉接點」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Corners and intersecting joints" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 角部接合微缺陷可能在低壓時不漏、變形後才連通，檢查只沿直線段便會漏失；若修補改變角部厚度，也可能使鄰近壓縮不均。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
止水墊黏貼固定良好就可以不考慮最終接縫壓縮。
optionsEn: A small corner-connection defect may leak only after deformation, escaping straight-length inspection.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Secure gasket bonding eliminates the need to consider final joint compression.
quiz.explanation: 角部接合微缺陷可能在低壓時不漏、變形後才連通，檢查只沿直線段便會漏失；若修補改變角部厚度，也可能使鄰近壓縮不均。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A small corner-connection defect may leak only after deformation, escaping straight-length inspection. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「黏貼與表面相容」與「安裝污染與局部缺陷」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bonding and surface compatibility" and "Assembly contamination and local defects": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 黏貼與表面相容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bonding and surface compatibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「黏貼與表面相容」如何影響隧道管片防水墊圈安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bonding and surface compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Segmental-lining gasket installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 黏貼使止水墊在運輸和組裝前維持位置，但最終水密仍依賴正確壓縮與連續接觸。溝槽污染、含水和不相容材料可能降低固定效果，必須遵循核准產品系統而非任意混用。 假設長2 m墊條有0.1 m未固定，缺失長度5%；即使比例小，局部移位仍可能切斷止水線。 運輸中脫落再臨時塞回可能留下扭轉，外觀似乎就位卻接觸不連續；不相容材料也可能讓橡膠膨潤，尺寸正確不代表長期功能正常。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「黏貼與表面相容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bonding holds a gasket through handling and assembly, but final sealing still depends on compression and continuous contact. Contamination, moisture and incompatible materials weaken retention, requiring an approved system rather than improvised substitutions. If an assumed 2 m strip has 0.1 m unretained, the missing length is 5%; a small displaced portion can still interrupt the sealing line. A strip that detaches and is hastily reseated may remain twisted with discontinuous contact. Incompatible materials can swell rubber, so apparently correct dimensions do not establish sustained functionality. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bonding and surface compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「止水墊黏貼固定良好就可以不考慮最終接縫壓縮。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Secure gasket bonding eliminates the need to consider final joint compression." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「黏貼與表面相容」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bonding and surface compatibility”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 黏貼與表面相容
knowledge.text: 黏貼使止水墊在運輸和組裝前維持位置，但最終水密仍依賴正確壓縮與連續接觸。溝槽污染、含水和不相容材料可能降低固定效果，必須遵循核准產品系統而非任意混用。
knowledge.textEn: Bonding holds a gasket through handling and assembly, but final sealing still depends on compression and continuous contact. Contamination, moisture and incompatible materials weaken retention, requiring an approved system rather than improvised substitutions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：止水墊黏貼固定良好就可以不考慮最終接縫壓縮。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Secure gasket bonding eliminates the need to consider final joint compression. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「黏貼與表面相容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bonding and surface compatibility" is correct?
options: 止水墊黏貼固定良好就可以不考慮最終接縫壓縮。
黏貼使止水墊在運輸和組裝前維持位置，但最終水密仍依賴正確壓縮與連續接觸。
夾雜硬顆粒時增加閉合力必定能恢復完整止水。
optionsEn: Secure gasket bonding eliminates the need to consider final joint compression.
Bonding holds a gasket through handling and assembly, but final sealing still depends on compression and continuous contact.
Increasing closure force always restores complete sealing when hard debris is trapped.
quiz.explanation: 黏貼使止水墊在運輸和組裝前維持位置，但最終水密仍依賴正確壓縮與連續接觸。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 黏貼與表面相容：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bonding and surface compatibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「黏貼與表面相容」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bonding and surface compatibility” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設長2 m墊條有0.1 m未固定，缺失長度5%；即使比例小，局部移位仍可能切斷止水線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed 2 m strip has 0.1 m unretained, the missing length is 5%; a small displaced portion can still interrupt the sealing line. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按供應者核准方法檢查表面狀態、材料批次及固定品質，安裝前核對是否移位或扭曲；任何相容性變更須有試驗與審查，課程不指定黏著劑、溶劑或施工配方。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect surface condition, batch and retention under the supplier-approved method and check displacement or twisting before assembly; compatibility changes require tests and review, with no adhesive, solvent or application recipe prescribed here.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 黏貼與表面相容：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bonding and surface compatibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「黏貼與表面相容」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bonding and surface compatibility” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按供應者核准方法檢查表面狀態、材料批次及固定品質，安裝前核對是否移位或扭曲；任何相容性變更須有試驗與審查，課程不指定黏著劑、溶劑或施工配方。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：運輸中脫落再臨時塞回可能留下扭轉，外觀似乎就位卻接觸不連續；不相容材料也可能讓橡膠膨潤，尺寸正確不代表長期功能正常。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect surface condition, batch and retention under the supplier-approved method and check displacement or twisting before assembly; compatibility changes require tests and review, with no adhesive, solvent or application recipe prescribed here. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A strip that detaches and is hastily reseated may remain twisted with discontinuous contact. Incompatible materials can swell rubber, so apparently correct dimensions do not establish sustained functionality. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄黏貼與表面相容的資料來源與適用條件。按供應者核准方法檢查表面狀態、材料批次及固定品質，安裝前核對是否移位或扭曲；任何相容性變更須有試驗與審查，課程不指定黏著劑、溶劑或施工配方。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for bonding and surface compatibility. Inspect surface condition, batch and retention under the supplier-approved method and check displacement or twisting before assembly; compatibility changes require tests and review, with no adhesive, solvent or application recipe prescribed here.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：運輸中脫落再臨時塞回可能留下扭轉，外觀似乎就位卻接觸不連續；不相容材料也可能讓橡膠膨潤，尺寸正確不代表長期功能正常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A strip that detaches and is hastily reseated may remain twisted with discontinuous contact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 砂粒、混凝土碎屑與墊條折疊會把連續接觸切成局部橋接，水沿未壓緊處繞行。這類缺陷不一定改變整體縫寬，因此需要可追溯外觀檢查與後續漏點對照。 假設一條2 m密封線有5 mm夾雜區，占0.25%；此比例不能代表水密損失只有0.25%。 增大組裝力可能把硬碎屑壓進橡膠並切傷，短時閉合更緊卻留下長期漏道；若缺陷照片未保留，後續漏水容易被錯怪為材料老化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「安裝污染與局部缺陷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grit, concrete chips and folded rubber interrupt continuous contact and let water bypass uncompressed areas. Such defects need not change the overall gap, requiring traceable visual checks and later comparison with leakage locations. An assumed 5 mm contaminated patch along a 2 m sealing line is 0.25%; it does not imply only 0.25% loss of watertight performance. More closure force can embed hard debris and cut rubber, producing tighter initial closure but a lasting path. Without defect photographs, later leakage may be wrongly attributed to material aging. knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing closure force always restores complete sealing when hard debris is trapped. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「安裝污染與局部缺陷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Assembly contamination and local defects" is correct?
options: 夾雜硬顆粒時增加閉合力必定能恢復完整止水。
共同模具偏差可當作彼此獨立的小誤差互相抵消。
砂粒、混凝土碎屑與墊條折疊會把連續接觸切成局部橋接，水沿未壓緊處繞行。
optionsEn: Increasing closure force always restores complete sealing when hard debris is trapped.
Shared mould biases can be treated as independent small errors that cancel each other.
Grit, concrete chips and folded rubber interrupt continuous contact and let water bypass uncompressed areas.
quiz.explanation: 砂粒、混凝土碎屑與墊條折疊會把連續接觸切成局部橋接，水沿未壓緊處繞行。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 安裝污染與局部缺陷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Assembly contamination and local defects: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「安裝污染與局部缺陷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Assembly contamination and local defects” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設一條2 m密封線有5 mm夾雜區，占0.25%；此比例不能代表水密損失只有0.25%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 5 mm contaminated patch along a 2 m sealing line is 0.25%; it does not imply only 0.25% loss of watertight performance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：於核准組裝檢查點拍攝墊條連續性與槽面，記錄缺陷方位、環片序號及處置；發現夾雜或折疊需由品質負責人依程序處理，不能用增加閉合力自動彌補。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Photograph continuity and groove condition at approved inspection points with position, serial and response; quality leads resolve contamination or folds through the procedure rather than automatically applying more closure force.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 安裝污染與局部缺陷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Assembly contamination and local defects: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「安裝污染與局部缺陷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Assembly contamination and local defects” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 於核准組裝檢查點拍攝墊條連續性與槽面，記錄缺陷方位、環片序號及處置；發現夾雜或折疊需由品質負責人依程序處理，不能用增加閉合力自動彌補。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：增大組裝力可能把硬碎屑壓進橡膠並切傷，短時閉合更緊卻留下長期漏道；若缺陷照片未保留，後續漏水容易被錯怪為材料老化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Photograph continuity and groove condition at approved inspection points with position, serial and response; quality leads resolve contamination or folds through the procedure rather than automatically applying more closure force. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: More closure force can embed hard debris and cut rubber, producing tighter initial closure but a lasting path. Without defect photographs, later leakage may be wrongly attributed to material aging. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
