steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for assembly contamination and local defects. Photograph continuity and groove condition at approved inspection points with position, serial and response; quality leads resolve contamination or folds through the procedure rather than automatically applying more closure force.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：增大組裝力可能把硬碎屑壓進橡膠並切傷，短時閉合更緊卻留下長期漏道；若缺陷照片未保留，後續漏水容易被錯怪為材料老化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: More closure force can embed hard debris and cut rubber, producing tighter initial closure but a lasting path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 安裝污染與局部缺陷：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Assembly contamination and local defects” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 增大組裝力可能把硬碎屑壓進橡膠並切傷，短時閉合更緊卻留下長期漏道；若缺陷照片未保留，後續漏水容易被錯怪為材料老化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Without defect photographs, later leakage may be wrongly attributed to material aging. stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「公差組合與水密包絡」與「水密試驗與追溯」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tolerance combinations and sealing envelope" and "Watertight tests and traceability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 公差組合與水密包絡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tolerance combinations and sealing envelope: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「公差組合與水密包絡」如何影響隧道管片防水墊圈安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tolerance combinations and sealing envelope” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Segmental-lining gasket installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 實際接縫同時有張開、錯台與轉角，水密試驗應涵蓋其組合而非各自最大值的孤立試驗。公差統計若有共同模具偏差也不獨立，分析須保留最不利但合理的情境。 假設兩個獨立尺寸標準差1與2 mm，合成2.24 mm；若同向系統偏差則直接相加3 mm。 錯把共同偏差視為獨立會低估累積縫寬，未試過的張開加錯台組合又可能成為現地常態；高平均通過率不能掩蓋整批偏移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「公差組合與水密包絡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Real joints combine opening, offset and rotation. Testing needs their combinations rather than isolated maxima, and shared mould bias makes tolerance statistics dependent. Preserve adverse but physically plausible combinations in the sealing envelope. Two assumed independent dimensional standard deviations of 1 and 2 mm combine to 2.24 mm; same-direction systematic biases instead add to 3 mm. Treating shared bias as independent understates accumulated gap, while untested opening-offset combinations may be routine in the field. A high average pass rate cannot conceal a systematic batch displacement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tolerance combinations and sealing envelope” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

只量止水墊原始高度就能知道安裝後的實際壓縮率。
optionsEn: A product pass certificate replaces field joint geometry and batch traceability.
Watertightness belongs to the combined rubber, groove, segment and deformation system.
Original gasket height alone determines its actual installed compression ratio.
quiz.explanation: 止水性能屬於橡膠、溝槽、環片與變形條件的整體，供應證書不能取代安裝品質紀錄。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Watertightness belongs to the combined rubber, groove, segment and deformation system. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水密試驗與追溯：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Watertight tests and traceability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水密試驗與追溯」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Watertight tests and traceability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設20組試件有18組達核准要求，通過90%；其餘2組需個別查因，不能用平均結果接受全部。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 18 of an assumed 20 assemblies meet approved criteria, the pass rate is 90%; the remaining 2 need individual investigation rather than acceptance by averaging. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交付原始壓力時間、漏量、位移及照片，核對試件與現地產品和公差是否一致；材料、結構和品質負責人共同確認適用範圍及未解決項，避免把條件性通過寫成無條件保證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Deliver raw pressure-time, leakage, displacement and photographs and check agreement with field products and tolerances; materials, structural and quality leads confirm applicability and unresolved items rather than turning conditional evidence into an unconditional guarantee.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 水密試驗與追溯：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Watertight tests and traceability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水密試驗與追溯」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Watertight tests and traceability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交付原始壓力時間、漏量、位移及照片，核對試件與現地產品和公差是否一致；材料、結構和品質負責人共同確認適用範圍及未解決項，避免把條件性通過寫成無條件保證。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只留下通過證書而沒有試驗幾何，就無法判斷現地錯台是否被涵蓋；批次或配方更動未登記則切斷證據鏈，後續無從辨認性能差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Deliver raw pressure-time, leakage, displacement and photographs and check agreement with field products and tolerances; materials, structural and quality leads confirm applicability and unresolved items rather than turning conditional evidence into an unconditional guarantee. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A pass certificate without test geometry cannot show whether field offset was covered. Undocumented batch or formulation changes break the evidence chain and prevent interpreting later differences in performance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄水密試驗與追溯的資料來源與適用條件。交付原始壓力時間、漏量、位移及照片，核對試件與現地產品和公差是否一致；材料、結構和品質負責人共同確認適用範圍及未解決項，避免把條件性通過寫成無條件保證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for watertight tests and traceability. Deliver raw pressure-time, leakage, displacement and photographs and check agreement with field products and tolerances; materials, structural and quality leads confirm applicability and unresolved items rather than turning conditional evidence into an unconditional guarantee.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只留下通過證書而沒有試驗幾何，就無法判斷現地錯台是否被涵蓋；批次或配方更動未登記則切斷證據鏈，後續無從辨認性能差異。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A pass certificate without test geometry cannot show whether field offset was covered. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 水密試驗與追溯：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Watertight tests and traceability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水密試驗與追溯」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Watertight tests and traceability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只留下通過證書而沒有試驗幾何，就無法判斷現地錯台是否被涵蓋；批次或配方更動未登記則切斷證據鏈，後續無從辨認性能差異。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A pass certificate without test geometry cannot show whether field offset was covered. Undocumented batch or formulation changes break the evidence chain and prevent interpreting later differences in performance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只留下通過證書而沒有試驗幾何，就無法判斷現地錯台是否被涵蓋；批次或配方更動未登記則切斷證據鏈，後續無從辨認性能差異。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Undocumented batch or formulation changes break the evidence chain and prevent interpreting later differences in performance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「產品通過證書可以取代現地接縫幾何和批次追溯。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A product pass certificate replaces field joint geometry and batch traceability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.explanationEn: A pass certificate without test geometry cannot show whether field offset was covered. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 隧道管片接頭結構驗證
summary: 本課聚焦用軸力彎矩、接觸張開與螺栓行為檢核環片接縫。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on check segment joints through axial force, bending, contact opening and bolt behavior. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設N=1000 kN、M=50 kN·m，e=M/N=0.05 m；是否張開仍取決於接觸面幾何。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設接觸深度h=0.30 m，核心界線h/6=0.05 m；此幾何值不是所有接縫的固定門檻。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume N=1000 kN and M=50 kN·m; eccentricity e=M/N=0.05 m, with opening still dependent on contact geometry. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed contact depth h=0.30 m, the kern boundary is h/6=0.05 m, a geometry-specific value rather than a universal joint threshold. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「軸力彎矩與偏心」與「接觸核心與張開」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Axial force bending and eccentricity" and "Contact kern and opening": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 軸力彎矩與偏心：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Axial force bending and eccentricity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「軸力彎矩與偏心」如何影響隧道管片接頭結構驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Axial force bending and eccentricity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Structural verification of segment joints”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接縫軸壓和彎矩共同決定接觸區，偏心增加會使一側壓力升高而另一側可能張開。把接縫當完整混凝土斷面會高估拉力傳遞，應先確定是否容許拉開及由哪些元件承擔拉力。 假設N=1000 kN、M=50 kN·m，e=M/N=0.05 m；是否張開仍取決於接觸面幾何。 忽略偏心會低估局部壓碎，錯用完整斷面拉應力又會假設不存在的抗拉連續性；兩種誤用可能同時讓接縫看似剛硬且承載充足。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「軸力彎矩與偏心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compression and bending determine contact area. Increasing eccentricity raises pressure on one edge and may open the other. Treating the joint as monolithic concrete overstates tensile transfer unless the actual tension-carrying components are identified. Assume N=1000 kN and M=50 kN·m; eccentricity e=M/N=0.05 m, with opening still dependent on contact geometry. Ignoring eccentricity understates local crushing, while monolithic tensile stress assumes nonexistent continuity. Together these mistakes can make a joint appear both stiffer and stronger than its actual contact permits. knowledge.title: 軸力彎矩與偏心

knowledge.textEn: Compression and bending determine contact area. Increasing eccentricity raises pressure on one edge and may open the other.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Modest joint axial force eliminates the need to consider eccentric bending and local contact. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Contact kern and opening” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Structural verification of segment joints”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 矩形接觸面在線性全壓條件下有核心範圍，偏心超出後會出現計算拉應力，表示全接觸假設需改變。這不是混凝土突然破壞，而是應轉成不承拉接觸及連接件共同作用模型。 假設接觸深度h=0.30 m，核心界線h/6=0.05 m；此幾何值不是所有接縫的固定門檻。 接觸面翹曲可使全壓理論失效更早，若仍用完整面積平均壓力會掩蓋角部高應力；試驗與模型差異需先查接觸幾何。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接觸核心與張開」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A rectangular contact has a kern under linear compression. Beyond it, calculated tension signals loss of the full-contact assumption rather than immediate concrete failure, requiring no-tension contact and connector action to be modeled together. For assumed contact depth h=0.30 m, the kern boundary is h/6=0.05 m, a geometry-specific value rather than a universal joint threshold. Warped faces can invalidate full contact earlier than ideal theory, and mean pressure over the whole area conceals concentrated corner stress. Model-test discrepancies should therefore prompt a contact-geometry review first. steps.title: 接觸核心與張開：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Contact kern and opening: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接觸核心與張開」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Contact kern and opening” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設接觸深度h=0.30 m，核心界線h/6=0.05 m；此幾何值不是所有接縫的固定門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed contact depth h=0.30 m, the kern boundary is h/6=0.05 m, a geometry-specific value rather than a universal joint threshold. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測接觸面尺寸及平整度，以壓敏材料或位移計檢查受載後接觸分布；分析中逐步檢視張開位置與螺栓受力，將幾何不完美納入而非只檢查名義矩形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure contact dimensions and flatness and observe loaded contact with appropriate film or gauges; track opening and bolt force in analysis, including imperfections rather than checking only a nominal rectangular surface.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 接觸核心與張開：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Contact kern and opening” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測接觸面尺寸及平整度，以壓敏材料或位移計檢查受載後接觸分布；分析中逐步檢視張開位置與螺栓受力，將幾何不完美納入而非只檢查名義矩形。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：接觸面翹曲可使全壓理論失效更早，若仍用完整面積平均壓力會掩蓋角部高應力；試驗與模型差異需先查接觸幾何。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure contact dimensions and flatness and observe loaded contact with appropriate film or gauges; track opening and bolt force in analysis, including imperfections rather than checking only a nominal rectangular surface. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Warped faces can invalidate full contact earlier than ideal theory, and mean pressure over the whole area conceals concentrated corner stress. Model-test discrepancies should therefore prompt a contact-geometry review first. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄接觸核心與張開的資料來源與適用條件。量測接觸面尺寸及平整度，以壓敏材料或位移計檢查受載後接觸分布；分析中逐步檢視張開位置與螺栓受力，將幾何不完美納入而非只檢查名義矩形。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：接觸面翹曲可使全壓理論失效更早，若仍用完整面積平均壓力會掩蓋角部高應力；試驗與模型差異需先查接觸幾何。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Warped faces can invalidate full contact earlier than ideal theory, and mean pressure over the whole area conceals concentrated corner stress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 接觸核心與張開：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Contact kern and opening: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接觸核心與張開」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Contact kern and opening” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接觸面翹曲可使全壓理論失效更早，若仍用完整面積平均壓力會掩蓋角部高應力；試驗與模型差異需先查接觸幾何。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Warped faces can invalidate full contact earlier than ideal theory, and mean pressure over the whole area conceals concentrated corner stress. Model-test discrepancies should therefore prompt a contact-geometry review first. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：接觸面翹曲可使全壓理論失效更早，若仍用完整面積平均壓力會掩蓋角部高應力；試驗與模型差異需先查接觸幾何。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Model-test discrepancies should therefore prompt a contact-geometry review first.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「偏心超出核心就表示混凝土已必然立即破壞。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Eccentricity outside the kern necessarily means immediate concrete failure has already occurred." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接觸面翹曲可使全壓理論失效更早，若仍用完整面積平均壓力會掩蓋角部高應力；試驗與模型差異需先查接觸幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Warped faces can invalidate full contact earlier than ideal theory, and mean pressure over the whole area conceals concentrated corner stress. Model-test discrepancies should therefore prompt a contact-geometry review first.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接觸核心與張開」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
螺栓扭矩相同就保證實際預力相同，不受摩擦影響。
接觸面翹曲可使全壓理論失效更早，若仍用完整面積平均壓力會掩蓋角部高應力；試驗與模型差異需先查接觸幾何。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal bolt torque guarantees equal preload regardless of friction conditions.
Warped faces can invalidate full contact earlier than ideal theory, and mean pressure over the whole area conceals concentrated corner stress.
quiz.explanation: 接觸面翹曲可使全壓理論失效更早，若仍用完整面積平均壓力會掩蓋角部高應力；試驗與模型差異需先查接觸幾何。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Warped faces can invalidate full contact earlier than ideal theory, and mean pressure over the whole area conceals concentrated corner stress. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「螺栓預力與摩擦離散」與「轉動剛度與非線性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bolt preload and friction scatter" and "Rotational stiffness and nonlinearity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 螺栓預力與摩擦離散：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bolt preload and friction scatter: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「螺栓預力與摩擦離散」如何影響隧道管片接頭結構驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bolt preload and friction scatter” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Structural verification of segment joints”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鎖付扭矩透過螺紋和支承摩擦轉成預力，摩擦差異會讓同扭矩產生不同拉力。預力維持接觸但也增加局部荷載，不能將扭矩值本身當成已驗證的螺栓受力。 假設示意T=KdF，K=0.2、d=0.024 m、F=100 kN，T=480 N·m；非現場鎖付規格。 摩擦偏大時扭矩達標但預力不足，偏小時又可能過度拉伸；若接縫後續鬆弛未被追蹤，初始合格紀錄也不能證明長期接觸狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「螺栓預力與摩擦離散」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tightening torque becomes preload through thread and bearing friction, so equal torque can produce different tension. Preload maintains contact while adding local loads, making torque alone insufficient evidence of actual bolt force. For assumed T=KdF with K=0.2, d=0.024 m and F=100 kN, T=480 N·m, not a field tightening specification. High friction gives inadequate preload at the target torque, while low friction can overstrain the bolt. Untracked relaxation also means initial compliance does not prove sustained joint contact throughout service. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bolt preload and friction scatter” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「螺栓扭矩相同就保證實際預力相同，不受摩擦影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal bolt torque guarantees equal preload regardless of friction conditions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「螺栓預力與摩擦離散」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bolt preload and friction scatter”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 螺栓預力與摩擦離散
knowledge.text: 鎖付扭矩透過螺紋和支承摩擦轉成預力，摩擦差異會讓同扭矩產生不同拉力。預力維持接觸但也增加局部荷載，不能將扭矩值本身當成已驗證的螺栓受力。
knowledge.textEn: Tightening torque becomes preload through thread and bearing friction, so equal torque can produce different tension. Preload maintains contact while adding local loads, making torque alone insufficient evidence of actual bolt force.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：螺栓扭矩相同就保證實際預力相同，不受摩擦影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal bolt torque guarantees equal preload regardless of friction conditions. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「螺栓預力與摩擦離散」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bolt preload and friction scatter" is correct?
options: 鎖付扭矩透過螺紋和支承摩擦轉成預力，摩擦差異會讓同扭矩產生不同拉力。
螺栓扭矩相同就保證實際預力相同，不受摩擦影響。

optionsEn: Tightening torque becomes preload through thread and bearing friction, so equal torque can produce different tension.
Equal bolt torque guarantees equal preload regardless of friction conditions.
Initial joint rotational stiffness applies directly at any large rotation.
quiz.explanation: 鎖付扭矩透過螺紋和支承摩擦轉成預力，摩擦差異會讓同扭矩產生不同拉力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.instruction: 接縫彎矩對轉角曲線通常隨接觸區縮小和螺栓啟動而改變斜率，不是一個固定彈簧。全環模型若使用等效剛度，必須說明載重範圍和軸力條件，避免把初始斜率外推到大轉角。 假設某區間ΔM=20 kN·m、Δθ=0.002 rad，割線增量剛度10 MN·m/rad；非全曲線常數。 固定高剛度會低估局部轉角並錯分彎矩，固定低剛度又可能低估環整體約束；模型看似收斂不代表接縫接觸機制已被正確描述。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉動剛度與非線性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

A fixed high stiffness understates local rotation and misallocates moment, while a fixed low value understates ring restraint. Numerical convergence alone does not establish physically correct contact behavior in the joint. steps.title: 轉動剛度與非線性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rotational stiffness and nonlinearity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉動剛度與非線性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rotational stiffness and nonlinearity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在多軸力情境試驗量測彎矩轉角及張開，區分初始、割線和卸載剛度；設計者應比較全環對不同剛度的敏感度，並保留接縫模型適用範圍與實驗來源。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：固定高剛度會低估局部轉角並錯分彎矩，固定低剛度又可能低估環整體約束；模型看似收斂不代表接縫接觸機制已被正確描述。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure moment, rotation and opening at several axial loads, distinguishing initial, secant and unloading stiffness; designers assess ring sensitivity and retain the applicable range and experimental basis of each joint model. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A fixed high stiffness understates local rotation and misallocates moment, while a fixed low value understates ring restraint. Numerical convergence alone does not establish physically correct contact behavior in the joint. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄轉動剛度與非線性的資料來源與適用條件。在多軸力情境試驗量測彎矩轉角及張開，區分初始、割線和卸載剛度；設計者應比較全環對不同剛度的敏感度，並保留接縫模型適用範圍與實驗來源。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for rotational stiffness and nonlinearity. Measure moment, rotation and opening at several axial loads, distinguishing initial, secant and unloading stiffness; designers assess ring sensitivity and retain the applicable range and experimental basis of each joint model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：固定高剛度會低估局部轉角並錯分彎矩，固定低剛度又可能低估環整體約束；模型看似收斂不代表接縫接觸機制已被正確描述。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A fixed high stiffness understates local rotation and misallocates moment, while a fixed low value understates ring restraint. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Measure moment, rotation and opening at several axial loads, distinguishing initial, secant and unloading stiffness; designers assess ring sensitivity and retain the applicable range and experimental basis of each joint model. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A fixed high stiffness understates local rotation and misallocates moment, while a fixed low value understates ring restraint. Numerical convergence alone does not establish physically correct contact behavior in the joint.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉動剛度與非線性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rotational stiffness and nonlinearity"?
options: 在多軸力情境試驗量測彎矩轉角及張開，區分初始、割線和卸載剛度；設計者應比較全環對不同剛度的敏感度，並保留接縫模型適用範圍與實驗來源。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
接縫軸力不大時就不必考慮偏心彎矩與局部接觸。
optionsEn: Measure moment, rotation and opening at several axial loads, distinguishing initial, secant and unloading stiffness.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Modest joint axial force eliminates the need to consider eccentric bending and local contact.
quiz.explanation: 在多軸力情境試驗量測彎矩轉角及張開，區分初始、割線和卸載剛度；設計者應比較全環對不同剛度的敏感度，並保留接縫模型適用範圍與實驗來源。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure moment, rotation and opening at several axial loads, distinguishing initial, secant and unloading stiffness; designers assess ring sensitivity and retain the applicable range and experimental basis of each joint model. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉動剛度與非線性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rotational stiffness and nonlinearity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉動剛度與非線性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rotational stiffness and nonlinearity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 固定高剛度會低估局部轉角並錯分彎矩，固定低剛度又可能低估環整體約束；模型看似收斂不代表接縫接觸機制已被正確描述。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A fixed high stiffness understates local rotation and misallocates moment, while a fixed low value understates ring restraint. Numerical convergence alone does not establish physically correct contact behavior in the joint. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：固定高剛度會低估局部轉角並錯分彎矩，固定低剛度又可能低估環整體約束；模型看似收斂不代表接縫接觸機制已被正確描述。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Numerical convergence alone does not establish physically correct contact behavior in the joint.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接縫初始轉動剛度可以直接套用到任何大轉角。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Initial joint rotational stiffness applies directly at any large rotation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 固定高剛度會低估局部轉角並錯分彎矩，固定低剛度又可能低估環整體約束；模型看似收斂不代表接縫接觸機制已被正確描述。
knowledge.textEn: A fixed high stiffness understates local rotation and misallocates moment, while a fixed low value understates ring restraint. Numerical convergence alone does not establish physically correct contact behavior in the joint.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉動剛度與非線性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rotational stiffness and nonlinearity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
固定高剛度會低估局部轉角並錯分彎矩，固定低剛度又可能低估環整體約束；模型看似收斂不代表接縫接觸機制已被正確描述。
接縫中心平均縫寬就是止水線實際承受的最大張開。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A fixed high stiffness understates local rotation and misallocates moment, while a fixed low value understates ring restraint.
Mean gap at the joint center equals maximum actual opening at the sealing line.
quiz.explanation: 固定高剛度會低估局部轉角並錯分彎矩，固定低剛度又可能低估環整體約束；模型看似收斂不代表接縫接觸機制已被正確描述。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A fixed high stiffness understates local rotation and misallocates moment, while a fixed low value understates ring restraint. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接縫轉角與止水張開」與「錯縫排列與環間傳力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint rotation and seal opening" and "Staggered joints and ring interaction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接縫轉角與止水張開：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint rotation and seal opening: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接縫轉角與止水張開」如何影響隧道管片接頭結構驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint rotation and seal opening” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Structural verification of segment joints”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 結構接縫的轉角會在止水線位置放大或減少縫寬，水密檢核需要知道止水墊距轉動中心的距離。只看接縫中心位移可能漏掉邊緣張開，結構與防水模型必須使用相同幾何。 假設小轉角θ=0.003 rad、止水線距中心0.2 m，轉動造成張開θy=0.6 mm；另加平移分量。 若轉動中心位置假設錯誤，會把張開側和壓縮側顛倒，漏水位置因而無法解釋；以中心平均縫寬代替止水線縫寬會低估需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接縫轉角與止水張開」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint rotation changes opening at the sealing line according to distance from the rotation center. Center displacement can miss edge opening, requiring structural and waterproofing models to share the same geometry and sign convention. Assume small rotation θ=0.003 rad and sealing-line offset y=0.2 m; rotational opening is θy=0.6 mm, added to translational opening. An incorrect rotation center can reverse predicted opening and compression sides and mislocate leakage. Substituting mean center gap for the actual seal-line gap understates the deformation demand on the gasket. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint rotation and seal opening” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接縫中心平均縫寬就是止水線實際承受的最大張開。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mean gap at the joint center equals maximum actual opening at the sealing line." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接縫轉角與止水張開」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint rotation and seal opening”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接縫轉角與止水張開
knowledge.text: 結構接縫的轉角會在止水線位置放大或減少縫寬，水密檢核需要知道止水墊距轉動中心的距離。只看接縫中心位移可能漏掉邊緣張開，結構與防水模型必須使用相同幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Joint rotation changes opening at the sealing line according to distance from the rotation center. Center displacement can miss edge opening, requiring structural and waterproofing models to share the same geometry and sign convention.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接縫中心平均縫寬就是止水線實際承受的最大張開。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Mean gap at the joint center equals maximum actual opening at the sealing line. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接縫轉角與止水張開」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint rotation and seal opening" is correct?
options: 接縫中心平均縫寬就是止水線實際承受的最大張開。
只要環片錯縫排列就可以把多環當成完全黏結整體。
結構接縫的轉角會在止水線位置放大或減少縫寬，水密檢核需要知道止水墊距轉動中心的距離。
optionsEn: Mean gap at the joint center equals maximum actual opening at the sealing line.
Staggering segments permits modeling multiple rings as a perfectly bonded monolithic structure.
Joint rotation changes opening at the sealing line according to distance from the rotation center.
quiz.explanation: 結構接縫的轉角會在止水線位置放大或減少縫寬，水密檢核需要知道止水墊距轉動中心的距離。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint rotation changes opening at the sealing line according to distance from the rotation center. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接縫轉角與止水張開：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint rotation and seal opening: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接縫轉角與止水張開」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint rotation and seal opening” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設小轉角θ=0.003 rad、止水線距中心0.2 m，轉動造成張開θy=0.6 mm；另加平移分量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume small rotation θ=0.003 rad and sealing-line offset y=0.2 m; rotational opening is θy=0.6 mm, added to translational opening. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時量測接縫中心和邊緣位移，與止水墊試驗包絡對照；結構及防水工程師確認轉角方向、偏心與錯台組合，不能用不同基準的兩份報告各自宣布合格。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure center and edge movement together and compare the gasket test envelope; structural and waterproofing engineers align rotation, eccentricity and offset combinations rather than separately approving reports with inconsistent geometry.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設小轉角θ=0.003 rad、止水線距中心0.2 m，轉動造成張開θy=0.6 mm；另加平移分量。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume small rotation θ=0.003 rad and sealing-line offset y=0.2 m; rotational opening is θy=0.6 mm, added to translational opening.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接縫轉角與止水張開」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint rotation and seal opening", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
外露螺栓完好就代表其周邊混凝土錨定也一定完好。
結構和水密報告各自通過就無須統一張開幾何定義。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
An intact exposed bolt guarantees intact anchorage in its surrounding concrete.
Separate structural and sealing approvals eliminate the need for a common opening definition.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 接縫轉角與止水張開：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint rotation and seal opening: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接縫轉角與止水張開」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint rotation and seal opening” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時量測接縫中心和邊緣位移，與止水墊試驗包絡對照；結構及防水工程師確認轉角方向、偏心與錯台組合，不能用不同基準的兩份報告各自宣布合格。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：若轉動中心位置假設錯誤，會把張開側和壓縮側顛倒，漏水位置因而無法解釋；以中心平均縫寬代替止水線縫寬會低估需求。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure center and edge movement together and compare the gasket test envelope; structural and waterproofing engineers align rotation, eccentricity and offset combinations rather than separately approving reports with inconsistent geometry. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: An incorrect rotation center can reverse predicted opening and compression sides and mislocate leakage. Substituting mean center gap for the actual seal-line gap understates the deformation demand on the gasket. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄接縫轉角與止水張開的資料來源與適用條件。同時量測接縫中心和邊緣位移，與止水墊試驗包絡對照；結構及防水工程師確認轉角方向、偏心與錯台組合，不能用不同基準的兩份報告各自宣布合格。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for joint rotation and seal opening. Measure center and edge movement together and compare the gasket test envelope; structural and waterproofing engineers align rotation, eccentricity and offset combinations rather than separately approving reports with inconsistent geometry.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若轉動中心位置假設錯誤，會把張開側和壓縮側顛倒，漏水位置因而無法解釋；以中心平均縫寬代替止水線縫寬會低估需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An incorrect rotation center can reverse predicted opening and compression sides and mislocate leakage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 接縫轉角與止水張開：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint rotation and seal opening: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接縫轉角與止水張開」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint rotation and seal opening” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若轉動中心位置假設錯誤，會把張開側和壓縮側顛倒，漏水位置因而無法解釋；以中心平均縫寬代替止水線縫寬會低估需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An incorrect rotation center can reverse predicted opening and compression sides and mislocate leakage. Substituting mean center gap for the actual seal-line gap understates the deformation demand on the gasket. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若轉動中心位置假設錯誤，會把張開側和壓縮側顛倒，漏水位置因而無法解釋；以中心平均縫寬代替止水線縫寬會低估需求。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接縫中心平均縫寬就是止水線實際承受的最大張開。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mean gap at the joint center equals maximum actual opening at the sealing line." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要環片錯縫排列就可以把多環當成完全黏結整體。

optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Staggering segments permits modeling multiple rings as a perfectly bonded monolithic structure.
An incorrect rotation center can reverse predicted opening and compression sides and mislocate leakage.

quiz.explanationEn: An incorrect rotation center can reverse predicted opening and compression sides and mislocate leakage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 錯縫排列與環間傳力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Staggered joints and ring interaction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「錯縫排列與環間傳力」如何影響隧道管片接頭結構驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Staggered joints and ring interaction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Structural verification of segment joints”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰環錯開縱向接縫可改變彎矩與剪力傳遞，但效果取決於環間接觸、連接件與摩擦。不能把錯縫自動等同完整連續襯砌，施工階段尚未形成同樣約束時尤其需要分開分析。 假設環間剪力200 kN由4個有效連接區平均分擔，平均50 kN/區；實際分配仍可能偏心。 把環間完全黏結會高估荷載重分配能力，若某環接觸不足，原先假定的旁路傳力可能消失；單環試驗又不能直接證明多環錯縫效果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「錯縫排列與環間傳力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Staggering longitudinal joints changes bending and shear transfer through adjacent rings, depending on contact, connectors and friction. It does not automatically create a monolithic lining, especially before construction-stage restraints are established. Assume 200 kN inter-ring shear shared equally by 4 effective connection zones; the mean is 50 kN per zone, with actual eccentric distribution unresolved. Perfect inter-ring bonding overstates redistribution. Inadequate contact can remove an assumed alternate load path, while a single-ring test cannot directly demonstrate the effects of staggered multiring interaction in service. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Staggered joints and ring interaction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要環片錯縫排列就可以把多環當成完全黏結整體。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Staggering segments permits modeling multiple rings as a perfectly bonded monolithic structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「錯縫排列與環間傳力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Staggered joints and ring interaction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 錯縫排列與環間傳力
knowledge.text: 相鄰環錯開縱向接縫可改變彎矩與剪力傳遞，但效果取決於環間接觸、連接件與摩擦。不能把錯縫自動等同完整連續襯砌，施工階段尚未形成同樣約束時尤其需要分開分析。
knowledge.textEn: Staggering longitudinal joints changes bending and shear transfer through adjacent rings, depending on contact, connectors and friction. It does not automatically create a monolithic lining, especially before construction-stage restraints are established.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要環片錯縫排列就可以把多環當成完全黏結整體。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Staggering segments permits modeling multiple rings as a perfectly bonded monolithic structure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「錯縫排列與環間傳力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Staggered joints and ring interaction" is correct?
options: 相鄰環錯開縱向接縫可改變彎矩與剪力傳遞，但效果取決於環間接觸、連接件與摩擦。
只要環片錯縫排列就可以把多環當成完全黏結整體。
疲勞循環次數足夠多就能不看幅值直接決定剩餘壽命。
optionsEn: Staggering longitudinal joints changes bending and shear transfer through adjacent rings, depending on contact, connectors and friction.
Staggering segments permits modeling multiple rings as a perfectly bonded monolithic structure.
A large cycle count determines remaining fatigue life without considering amplitudes.
quiz.explanation: 相鄰環錯開縱向接縫可改變彎矩與剪力傳遞，但效果取決於環間接觸、連接件與摩擦。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Staggering longitudinal joints changes bending and shear transfer through adjacent rings, depending on contact, connectors and friction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 錯縫排列與環間傳力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Staggered joints and ring interaction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錯縫排列與環間傳力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Staggered joints and ring interaction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設環間剪力200 kN由4個有效連接區平均分擔，平均50 kN/區；實際分配仍可能偏心。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 200 kN inter-ring shear shared equally by 4 effective connection zones; the mean is 50 kN per zone, with actual eccentric distribution unresolved. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多環模型或代表性試驗檢查環間滑移和連接件受力，核對實際錯縫角度及施工順序；分析者需比較低摩擦和局部脫開情境，不能只採理想黏結模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use multiring analysis or representative tests to examine slip and connector force with actual stagger and sequence; compare low-friction and local separation cases rather than relying solely on ideal bonding.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

steps.title: 錯縫排列與環間傳力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Staggered joints and ring interaction: failure diagnosis

Inadequate contact can remove an assumed alternate load path, while a single-ring test cannot directly demonstrate the effects of staggered multiring interaction in service. stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「循環載重與鬆弛」與「局部裂縫與連接錨定」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cyclic loading and relaxation" and "Local cracks and connector anchorage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 循環載重與鬆弛：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cyclic loading and relaxation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「循環載重與鬆弛」如何影響隧道管片接頭結構驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cyclic loading and relaxation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Structural verification of segment joints”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 列車、溫度或水壓變動使接縫反覆變形，螺栓預力可能鬆弛且接觸面磨耗。循環次數只有配合幅值、平均力和連接細節才有疲勞意義，不能單憑次數推斷必然破壞。 假設每日100次代表循環、30年、365日/年，總次數1,095,000；不含不同幅值合併。 用總循環數套單一高幅值會過度保守，完全忽略少數高幅值又可能危險；若監測只記日平均，接縫反覆開合的真實幅度會被抹去。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「循環載重與鬆弛」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Traffic, thermal and water-pressure cycles repeatedly deform joints, potentially relaxing preload and wearing contacts. Cycle count has fatigue meaning only alongside amplitude, mean force and connector detail, not as a standalone failure prediction. Assume 100 representative cycles per day for 30 years at 365 days/year; total count is 1095000, without combining different amplitude ranges. Applying one high amplitude to every cycle exaggerates damage, while ignoring rare large cycles can be unsafe. Daily averages erase the actual opening-closing amplitudes that govern connection behavior. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cyclic loading and relaxation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「疲勞循環次數足夠多就能不看幅值直接決定剩餘壽命。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A large cycle count determines remaining fatigue life without considering amplitudes." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「循環載重與鬆弛」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cyclic loading and relaxation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 循環載重與鬆弛
knowledge.text: 列車、溫度或水壓變動使接縫反覆變形，螺栓預力可能鬆弛且接觸面磨耗。循環次數只有配合幅值、平均力和連接細節才有疲勞意義，不能單憑次數推斷必然破壞。
knowledge.textEn: Traffic, thermal and water-pressure cycles repeatedly deform joints, potentially relaxing preload and wearing contacts. Cycle count has fatigue meaning only alongside amplitude, mean force and connector detail, not as a standalone failure prediction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：疲勞循環次數足夠多就能不看幅值直接決定剩餘壽命。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A large cycle count determines remaining fatigue life without considering amplitudes. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「循環載重與鬆弛」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 循環載重與鬆弛：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cyclic loading and relaxation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「循環載重與鬆弛」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設每日100次代表循環、30年、365日/年，總次數1,095,000；不含不同幅值合併。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 100 representative cycles per day for 30 years at 365 days/year; total count is 1095000, without combining different amplitude ranges. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測代表載重譜和螺栓力或接縫開合，區分服務循環與施工一次性載重；疲勞檢核使用適用細節與試驗資料，維護計畫保留預力或位移基線以識別長期改變。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄循環載重與鬆弛的資料來源與適用條件。量測代表載重譜和螺栓力或接縫開合，區分服務循環與施工一次性載重；疲勞檢核使用適用細節與試驗資料，維護計畫保留預力或位移基線以識別長期改變。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for cyclic loading and relaxation. Measure representative spectra and bolt force or joint opening, separating service cycles from one-time construction loads; use appropriate detail and test evidence for fatigue and retain preload or movement baselines for long-term comparison.

quiz.question: 要驗證「循環載重與鬆弛」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cyclic loading and relaxation"?
options: 量測代表載重譜和螺栓力或接縫開合，區分服務循環與施工一次性載重；疲勞檢核使用適用細節與試驗資料，維護計畫保留預力或位移基線以識別長期改變。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
接縫初始轉動剛度可以直接套用到任何大轉角。
optionsEn: Measure representative spectra and bolt force or joint opening, separating service cycles from one-time construction loads.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Initial joint rotational stiffness applies directly at any large rotation.
quiz.explanation: 量測代表載重譜和螺栓力或接縫開合，區分服務循環與施工一次性載重；疲勞檢核使用適用細節與試驗資料，維護計畫保留預力或位移基線以識別長期改變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure representative spectra and bolt force or joint opening, separating service cycles from one-time construction loads; use appropriate detail and test evidence for fatigue and retain preload or movement baselines for long-term comparison. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 循環載重與鬆弛：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cyclic loading and relaxation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「循環載重與鬆弛」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cyclic loading and relaxation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用總循環數套單一高幅值會過度保守，完全忽略少數高幅值又可能危險；若監測只記日平均，接縫反覆開合的真實幅度會被抹去。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying one high amplitude to every cycle exaggerates damage, while ignoring rare large cycles can be unsafe. Daily averages erase the actual opening-closing amplitudes that govern connection behavior. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：用總循環數套單一高幅值會過度保守，完全忽略少數高幅值又可能危險；若監測只記日平均，接縫反覆開合的真實幅度會被抹去。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Daily averages erase the actual opening-closing amplitudes that govern connection behavior.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「疲勞循環次數足夠多就能不看幅值直接決定剩餘壽命。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A large cycle count determines remaining fatigue life without considering amplitudes." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用總循環數套單一高幅值會過度保守，完全忽略少數高幅值又可能危險；若監測只記日平均，接縫反覆開合的真實幅度會被抹去。
knowledge.textEn: Applying one high amplitude to every cycle exaggerates damage, while ignoring rare large cycles can be unsafe. Daily averages erase the actual opening-closing amplitudes that govern connection behavior.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「循環載重與鬆弛」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cyclic loading and relaxation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
用總循環數套單一高幅值會過度保守，完全忽略少數高幅值又可能危險；若監測只記日平均，接縫反覆開合的真實幅度會被抹去。
外露螺栓完好就代表其周邊混凝土錨定也一定完好。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Applying one high amplitude to every cycle exaggerates damage, while ignoring rare large cycles can be unsafe.
An intact exposed bolt guarantees intact anchorage in its surrounding concrete.
quiz.explanation: 用總循環數套單一高幅值會過度保守，完全忽略少數高幅值又可能危險；若監測只記日平均，接縫反覆開合的真實幅度會被抹去。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Applying one high amplitude to every cycle exaggerates damage, while ignoring rare large cycles can be unsafe. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 局部裂縫與連接錨定：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Local cracks and connector anchorage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「局部裂縫與連接錨定」如何影響隧道管片接頭結構驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local cracks and connector anchorage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Structural verification of segment joints”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 螺栓或榫鍵把力集中輸入環片，周邊混凝土需要足夠錨定與劈裂控制。整體接縫力小不代表局部安全，孔位、公差和缺角會改變有效受力區，須結合構造細節檢查。 假設錨定區合力120 kN、有效受力面0.02 m²，名義應力6 MPa；不是混凝土局部承載驗算全式。 孔周裂縫可能使有效錨定逐步減少，外露螺栓仍完好卻已失去設計傳力；若只檢查金屬件而不查混凝土，局部失效會被漏掉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「局部裂縫與連接錨定」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bolts and keys introduce concentrated forces requiring adequate anchorage and splitting control. Modest global joint force does not ensure local safety; hole location, tolerances and chips change the effective resisting region and must be checked with detailing. Assumed anchorage force 120 kN over effective area 0.02 m² gives nominal stress 6 MPa, not a complete local concrete-capacity check. Cracking around the recess can progressively reduce anchorage while the exposed bolt still looks intact. Inspecting metal alone misses loss of the intended load path within the surrounding concrete. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local cracks and connector anchorage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外露螺栓完好就代表其周邊混凝土錨定也一定完好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An intact exposed bolt guarantees intact anchorage in its surrounding concrete." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「局部裂縫與連接錨定」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Local cracks and connector anchorage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 螺栓或榫鍵把力集中輸入環片，周邊混凝土需要足夠錨定與劈裂控制。整體接縫力小不代表局部安全，孔位、公差和缺角會改變有效受力區，須結合構造細節檢查。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外露螺栓完好就代表其周邊混凝土錨定也一定完好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An intact exposed bolt guarantees intact anchorage in its surrounding concrete. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「局部裂縫與連接錨定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Local cracks and connector anchorage" is correct?
options: 外露螺栓完好就代表其周邊混凝土錨定也一定完好。
足尺接縫試驗不需要扣除設備柔度與支座就位效應。
螺栓或榫鍵把力集中輸入環片，周邊混凝土需要足夠錨定與劈裂控制。
optionsEn: An intact exposed bolt guarantees intact anchorage in its surrounding concrete.
Full-scale joint tests never require correction for frame compliance or seating effects.
Bolts and keys introduce concentrated forces requiring adequate anchorage and splitting control.
quiz.explanation: 螺栓或榫鍵把力集中輸入環片，周邊混凝土需要足夠錨定與劈裂控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Bolts and keys introduce concentrated forces requiring adequate anchorage and splitting control. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 局部裂縫與連接錨定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Local cracks and connector anchorage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「局部裂縫與連接錨定」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Local cracks and connector anchorage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設錨定區合力120 kN、有效受力面0.02 m²，名義應力6 MPa；不是混凝土局部承載驗算全式。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed anchorage force 120 kN over effective area 0.02 m² gives nominal stress 6 MPa, not a complete local concrete-capacity check. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對連接件位置、配筋及混凝土缺陷，利用核准試驗或分析檢查拔出、劈裂和局部壓碎；損傷照片須能追到環片及接縫位置，由結構工程師決定可否修復使用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check connector location, reinforcement and defects and assess pullout, splitting and crushing through approved analysis or tests; trace damage photographs to segment and joint for structural review of repairability and use.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 局部裂縫與連接錨定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Local cracks and connector anchorage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「局部裂縫與連接錨定」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Local cracks and connector anchorage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 孔周裂縫可能使有效錨定逐步減少，外露螺栓仍完好卻已失去設計傳力；若只檢查金屬件而不查混凝土，局部失效會被漏掉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cracking around the recess can progressively reduce anchorage while the exposed bolt still looks intact. Inspecting metal alone misses loss of the intended load path within the surrounding concrete. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：孔周裂縫可能使有效錨定逐步減少，外露螺栓仍完好卻已失去設計傳力；若只檢查金屬件而不查混凝土，局部失效會被漏掉。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inspecting metal alone misses loss of the intended load path within the surrounding concrete.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外露螺栓完好就代表其周邊混凝土錨定也一定完好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An intact exposed bolt guarantees intact anchorage in its surrounding concrete." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「局部裂縫與連接錨定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Local cracks and connector anchorage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
足尺接縫試驗不需要扣除設備柔度與支座就位效應。
孔周裂縫可能使有效錨定逐步減少，外露螺栓仍完好卻已失去設計傳力；若只檢查金屬件而不查混凝土，局部失效會被漏掉。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Full-scale joint tests never require correction for frame compliance or seating effects.
Cracking around the recess can progressively reduce anchorage while the exposed bolt still looks intact.
quiz.explanation: 孔周裂縫可能使有效錨定逐步減少，外露螺栓仍完好卻已失去設計傳力；若只檢查金屬件而不查混凝土，局部失效會被漏掉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Cracking around the recess can progressively reduce anchorage while the exposed bolt still looks intact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「足尺試驗與邊界」與「接縫驗證與工程簽認」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Full-scale tests and boundaries" and "Joint verification and engineering signoff": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 足尺試驗與邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Full-scale tests and boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「足尺試驗與邊界」如何影響隧道管片接頭結構驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Full-scale tests and boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Structural verification of segment joints”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接縫試驗需重現軸力、彎矩、接觸與支承，試驗架剛度也會影響量到的轉角。足尺不代表所有邊界都正確，須區分試體變形、設備柔度與局部就位，才能用於模型校準。 假設總量測轉角0.004 rad、設備柔度貢獻0.001 rad，試體轉角0.003 rad；扣除需有校準證據。 設備就位滑移若被當成接縫柔度，模型會過度柔軟，反過來忽略局部量測可把框架轉動扣錯；錯誤校準會污染所有後續環分析。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「足尺試驗與邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint tests must reproduce force, moment, contact and support, while frame stiffness influences measured rotation. Full size does not guarantee correct boundaries; separate specimen deformation, machine compliance and seating before calibrating a model. Assume total measured rotation 0.004 rad with machine contribution 0.001 rad; specimen rotation is 0.003 rad, provided the subtraction has calibration evidence. Frame seating slip mistaken for joint flexibility makes the model too soft, while poor local measurements cause incorrect rotation subtraction. Either calibration error propagates into every subsequent ring analysis. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Full-scale tests and boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「足尺接縫試驗不需要扣除設備柔度與支座就位效應。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Full-scale joint tests never require correction for frame compliance or seating effects." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「足尺試驗與邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Full-scale tests and boundaries”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 足尺試驗與邊界
knowledge.text: 接縫試驗需重現軸力、彎矩、接觸與支承，試驗架剛度也會影響量到的轉角。足尺不代表所有邊界都正確，須區分試體變形、設備柔度與局部就位，才能用於模型校準。
knowledge.textEn: Joint tests must reproduce force, moment, contact and support, while frame stiffness influences measured rotation. Full size does not guarantee correct boundaries; separate specimen deformation, machine compliance and seating before calibrating a model.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：足尺接縫試驗不需要扣除設備柔度與支座就位效應。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Full-scale joint tests never require correction for frame compliance or seating effects. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「足尺試驗與邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Full-scale tests and boundaries" is correct?
options: 接縫試驗需重現軸力、彎矩、接觸與支承，試驗架剛度也會影響量到的轉角。
足尺接縫試驗不需要扣除設備柔度與支座就位效應。
結構和水密報告各自通過就無須統一張開幾何定義。
optionsEn: Joint tests must reproduce force, moment, contact and support, while frame stiffness influences measured rotation.
Full-scale joint tests never require correction for frame compliance or seating effects.
Separate structural and sealing approvals eliminate the need for a common opening definition.
quiz.explanation: 接縫試驗需重現軸力、彎矩、接觸與支承，試驗架剛度也會影響量到的轉角。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint tests must reproduce force, moment, contact and support, while frame stiffness influences measured rotation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 足尺試驗與邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Full-scale tests and boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「足尺試驗與邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Full-scale tests and boundaries” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設總量測轉角0.004 rad、設備柔度貢獻0.001 rad，試體轉角0.003 rad；扣除需有校準證據。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume total measured rotation 0.004 rad with machine contribution 0.001 rad; specimen rotation is 0.003 rad, provided the subtraction has calibration evidence. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用獨立位移量測區分試件與試驗架，記錄載入順序、軸力及接觸狀態；模型先預測再與試驗比對，差異需檢查邊界和材料，不以任意調剛度消除全部殘差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use independent measurements to distinguish specimen and frame, documenting sequence, axial load and contact; predict before comparing the test and investigate boundaries and material rather than arbitrarily adjusting stiffness to erase every residual.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設總量測轉角0.004 rad、設備柔度貢獻0.001 rad，試體轉角0.003 rad；扣除需有校準證據。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume total measured rotation 0.004 rad with machine contribution 0.001 rad; specimen rotation is 0.003 rad, provided the subtraction has calibration evidence.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「足尺試驗與邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Full-scale tests and boundaries", which statement holds?
options: 偏心超出核心就表示混凝土已必然立即破壞。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
接縫初始轉動剛度可以直接套用到任何大轉角。
optionsEn: Eccentricity outside the kern necessarily means immediate concrete failure has already occurred.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Initial joint rotational stiffness applies directly at any large rotation.

steps.title: 足尺試驗與邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Full-scale tests and boundaries: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「足尺試驗與邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Full-scale tests and boundaries” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用獨立位移量測區分試件與試驗架，記錄載入順序、軸力及接觸狀態；模型先預測再與試驗比對，差異需檢查邊界和材料，不以任意調剛度消除全部殘差。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：設備就位滑移若被當成接縫柔度，模型會過度柔軟，反過來忽略局部量測可把框架轉動扣錯；錯誤校準會污染所有後續環分析。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use independent measurements to distinguish specimen and frame, documenting sequence, axial load and contact; predict before comparing the test and investigate boundaries and material rather than arbitrarily adjusting stiffness to erase every residual.
