Either calibration error propagates into every subsequent ring analysis. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for full-scale tests and boundaries. Use independent measurements to distinguish specimen and frame, documenting sequence, axial load and contact; predict before comparing the test and investigate boundaries and material rather than arbitrarily adjusting stiffness to erase every residual.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：設備就位滑移若被當成接縫柔度，模型會過度柔軟，反過來忽略局部量測可把框架轉動扣錯；錯誤校準會污染所有後續環分析。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 使用獨立位移量測區分試件與試驗架，記錄載入順序、軸力及接觸狀態；模型先預測再與試驗比對，差異需檢查邊界和材料，不以任意調剛度消除全部殘差。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：設備就位滑移若被當成接縫柔度，模型會過度柔軟，反過來忽略局部量測可把框架轉動扣錯；錯誤校準會污染所有後續環分析。

quiz.question: 要驗證「足尺試驗與邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

結構分析與水密試驗採不同張開定義會造成介面空白，所有報告各自合格仍可能漏掉真實組合；未記錄外推範圍也會讓後續修改超出原驗證。
接縫軸力不大時就不必考慮偏心彎矩與局部接觸。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Different opening definitions in structural and sealing evidence create an interface gap despite separate approvals.
Modest joint axial force eliminates the need to consider eccentric bending and local contact.
quiz.explanation: 結構分析與水密試驗採不同張開定義會造成介面空白，所有報告各自合格仍可能漏掉真實組合；未記錄外推範圍也會讓後續修改超出原驗證。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Different opening definitions in structural and sealing evidence create an interface gap despite separate approvals. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 盾尾空隙同步灌漿
summary: 本課聚焦以環隙體積、漿體時變行為與環片浮力驗證盾尾背填。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on verify tail-void backfill through annular volume, time-dependent grout and lining buoyancy. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設開挖徑6.4 m、環片外徑6.2 m、環寬1.5 m，V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設計量4.0 m³、管線儲增0.3 m³、確認回流0.2 m³，未扣其他漏失前可歸入3.5 m³。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume excavation diameter 6.4 m, segment outer diameter 6.2 m and width 1.5 m; V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume metered volume 4.0 m³, line-storage increase 0.3 m³ and confirmed returns 0.2 m³; 3.5 m³ remains before other losses are resolved. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「理論環隙與超挖」與「輸送收支與有效填充」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Theoretical annulus and overbreak" and "Delivery balance and effective filling": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 理論環隙與超挖：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Theoretical annulus and overbreak: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「理論環隙與超挖」如何影響盾尾空隙同步灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Theoretical annulus and overbreak” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 盾殼退出後留下的環隙須由背填材料接替支承，理論圓環體積只是基準。超挖、地層變形與盾體姿態使實際空隙不同，不能用單一名義體積推定填充已完整。 假設開挖徑6.4 m、環片外徑6.2 m、環寬1.5 m，V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³。 名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「理論環隙與超挖」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Backfill replaces support in the void left by the shield. A circular annular volume is only a reference, since overbreak, ground deformation and shield attitude change the actual space; nominal volume alone does not prove complete filling. Assume excavation diameter 6.4 m, segment outer diameter 6.2 m and width 1.5 m; V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³. Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Theoretical annulus and overbreak” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「注入量達理論環隙體積就證明頂部不可能留下空洞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Delivering the theoretical annular volume proves that no crown void can remain." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「理論環隙與超挖」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Theoretical annulus and overbreak”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 理論環隙與超挖
knowledge.text: 盾殼退出後留下的環隙須由背填材料接替支承，理論圓環體積只是基準。超挖、地層變形與盾體姿態使實際空隙不同，不能用單一名義體積推定填充已完整。
knowledge.textEn: Backfill replaces support in the void left by the shield. A circular annular volume is only a reference, since overbreak, ground deformation and shield attitude change the actual space; nominal volume alone does not prove complete filling.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：注入量達理論環隙體積就證明頂部不可能留下空洞。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Delivering the theoretical annular volume proves that no crown void can remain. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「理論環隙與超挖」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Theoretical annulus and overbreak" is correct?
options: 注入量達理論環隙體積就證明頂部不可能留下空洞。
盾殼退出後留下的環隙須由背填材料接替支承，理論圓環體積只是基準。
泵浦計量總量就是全部有效進入目標環隙的材料量。
optionsEn: Delivering the theoretical annular volume proves that no crown void can remain.
Backfill replaces support in the void left by the shield.
The total metered pump quantity all effectively enters the intended annulus.
quiz.explanation: 盾殼退出後留下的環隙須由背填材料接替支承，理論圓環體積只是基準。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Backfill replaces support in the void left by the shield. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 理論環隙與超挖：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Theoretical annulus and overbreak: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「理論環隙與超挖」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Theoretical annulus and overbreak” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設開挖徑6.4 m、環片外徑6.2 m、環寬1.5 m，V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume excavation diameter 6.4 m, segment outer diameter 6.2 m and width 1.5 m; V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設開挖徑6.4 m、環片外徑6.2 m、環寬1.5 m，V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume excavation diameter 6.4 m, segment outer diameter 6.2 m and width 1.5 m; V=π(6.4²−6.2²)×1.5/4=2.969 m³.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「理論環隙與超挖」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Theoretical annulus and overbreak", which statement holds?
options: 流動度合格就可以不再檢查漿體泌水或材料分離。
計算環片浮力時應使用混凝土材料體積作排開漿體體積。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Passing a flow test removes any need to inspect bleeding or segregation.
Concrete material volume should be used as displaced grout volume when calculating ring buoyancy.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 理論環隙與超挖：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Theoretical annulus and overbreak: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「理論環隙與超挖」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Theoretical annulus and overbreak” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄理論環隙與超挖的資料來源與適用條件。核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for theoretical annulus and overbreak. Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。
knowledge.textEn: Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄理論環隙與超挖的資料來源與適用條件。核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for theoretical annulus and overbreak. Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill.

quiz.question: 要驗證「理論環隙與超挖」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Theoretical annulus and overbreak"?
options: 核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
自由試樣收縮百分比必定等於現場環隙的空洞率。
optionsEn: Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Free specimen shrinkage percentage necessarily equals field annular void ratio.
quiz.explanation: 核對刀盤與環片幾何、環寬及盾體軌跡，將實際注入量換算到每環共同基準；對偏心與超挖做情境範圍，填充判斷需另有壓力、位移或檢查證據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check cutter and segment geometry, ring width and shield path and normalize delivered volume by ring; bound eccentricity and overbreak, requiring pressure, movement or inspection evidence in addition to quantity when assessing fill. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 理論環隙與超挖：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Theoretical annulus and overbreak: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「理論環隙與超挖」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Theoretical annulus and overbreak” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space. Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating all excess as waste or all target volume as successful filling both misinterpret the balance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「注入量達理論環隙體積就證明頂部不可能留下空洞。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Delivering the theoretical annular volume proves that no crown void can remain." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

名義體積足夠仍可能沿裂隙外流而留下頂部空洞，地層擠入也會減小容積；把任何超額都當浪費或任何達量都當合格都會誤判。
泵浦計量總量就是全部有效進入目標環隙的材料量。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Nominally adequate grout can escape through fissures while leaving a crown void, whereas ground intrusion reduces space.
The total metered pump quantity all effectively enters the intended annulus.

steps.title: 輸送收支與有效填充：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Delivery balance and effective filling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「輸送收支與有效填充」如何影響盾尾空隙同步灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Delivery balance and effective filling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泵送總量包含管線儲存、回流和外漏，只有到達目標環隙的部分才與支承有關。每環收支需追蹤時間延遲，否則計量器在本環記錄的材料可能到下一環才排出。 假設計量4.0 m³、管線儲增0.3 m³、確認回流0.2 m³，未扣其他漏失前可歸入3.5 m³。 管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輸送收支與有效填充」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pumped quantity includes line storage, returns and leakage; only delivery into the intended annulus contributes there. Ring accounting needs transport delay because volume registered in one ring may arrive during the next. Assume metered volume 4.0 m³, line-storage increase 0.3 m³ and confirmed returns 0.2 m³; 3.5 m³ remains before other losses are resolved. Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. Without separate balances, normal pressure may reflect pipe resistance rather than a filled annulus behind the lining. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Delivery balance and effective filling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵浦計量總量就是全部有效進入目標環隙的材料量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The total metered pump quantity all effectively enters the intended annulus." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「輸送收支與有效填充」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Delivery balance and effective filling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Pumped quantity includes line storage, returns and leakage; only delivery into the intended annulus contributes there. Ring accounting needs transport delay because volume registered in one ring may arrive during the next.

knowledge.text: 誤解：泵浦計量總量就是全部有效進入目標環隙的材料量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「輸送收支與有效填充」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 泵浦計量總量就是全部有效進入目標環隙的材料量。
泵端壓力可以不修正高程與管損直接當環片外壓。
泵送總量包含管線儲存、回流和外漏，只有到達目標環隙的部分才與支承有關。
optionsEn: The total metered pump quantity all effectively enters the intended annulus.
Pump-end pressure directly equals lining pressure without elevation or line-loss correction.
Pumped quantity includes line storage, returns and leakage; only delivery into the intended annulus contributes there.

steps.title: 輸送收支與有效填充：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輸送收支與有效填充」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Delivery balance and effective filling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設計量4.0 m³、管線儲增0.3 m³、確認回流0.2 m³，未扣其他漏失前可歸入3.5 m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume metered volume 4.0 m³, line-storage increase 0.3 m³ and confirmed returns 0.2 m³; 3.5 m³ remains before other losses are resolved. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以儲槽質量或容積校準計量器，記錄回流和清洗材料並對齊環號時序；比較理論空隙及注入口分配，未閉合差額由灌漿工程師查因，不以泵浦轉數直接當有效填充證明。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate metering against tank mass or volume, record returns and cleaning material and align ring timing; compare annulus and port distribution and investigate unclosed differences rather than using pump revolutions as proof of effective fill.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

A short mean line residence guarantees that material in every dead zone remains fresh.

steps.title: 輸送收支與有效填充：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Delivery balance and effective filling: testing and verification

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Delivery balance and effective filling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以儲槽質量或容積校準計量器，記錄回流和清洗材料並對齊環號時序；比較理論空隙及注入口分配，未閉合差額由灌漿工程師查因，不以泵浦轉數直接當有效填充證明。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate metering against tank mass or volume, record returns and cleaning material and align ring timing; compare annulus and port distribution and investigate unclosed differences rather than using pump revolutions as proof of effective fill. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. Without separate balances, normal pressure may reflect pipe resistance rather than a filled annulus behind the lining. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：管線清洗液若混入注入量會虛增填充，計量滑漏又會使材料到量不足；沒有收支分項時，壓力正常也可能只是管內阻力而非環隙填滿。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Including flush liquid inflates fill quantity, while meter slip understates missing delivery. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 漿體自重使不同高程注入口壓力不同，管線損失又使泵端壓力高於環隙。環片和地層實際承受的是局部外壓，必須以相同高程及量測位置比較，避免將泵壓直接套到結構。 假設漿密度1800 kg/m³、高差6 m，靜壓差ρgΔz=105.95 kPa；流動時另有管損。 把低處壓力當頂部壓力會高估頂部填充或錯估結構載重，堵塞管線又可形成高壓假象；若只記單一泵表，難以定位問題所在。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高程壓差與傳遞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grout weight changes pressure with elevation while line loss separates pump and annulus readings. steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume grout density 1800 kg/m³ and elevation difference 6 m; static difference ρgΔz=105.95 kPa, with additional losses during flow. steps.title: 流變與泌水分離：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「流變與泌水分離」如何影響盾尾空隙同步灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rheology and bleed separation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 漿體需流入狹窄環隙又保持均勻，屈服阻力過高限制擴散，泌水則使初始體積在硬化前縮小。流動度、泌水及凝結時間必須一起評估，不能用最容易泵送作唯一品質目標。 假設1 L試樣析水30 mL，泌水比例3%；不等於現地空隙必定增加3%。 高流動性可能伴隨大量泌水而在頂部留下空隙，過度增稠又可能只充滿注入口附近；單一流動度合格無法排除這兩種相反失效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「流變與泌水分離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grout must enter narrow voids while remaining uniform. Excess yield resistance limits spread, whereas bleeding reduces effective volume before hardening. Flow, bleed and set time require joint assessment rather than easiest pumping as the sole quality target. If an assumed 1 L sample releases 30 mL water, bleed is 3%; this does not mean the field void necessarily increases by 3%. High flowability may come with bleeding that leaves crown voids, while thick grout fills only near ports. Passing one flow test cannot exclude either of these opposing failure mechanisms in practice. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rheology and bleed separation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「流動度合格就可以不再檢查漿體泌水或材料分離。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing a flow test removes any need to inspect bleeding or segregation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「流變與泌水分離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rheology and bleed separation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 流變與泌水分離
knowledge.text: 漿體需流入狹窄環隙又保持均勻，屈服阻力過高限制擴散，泌水則使初始體積在硬化前縮小。流動度、泌水及凝結時間必須一起評估，不能用最容易泵送作唯一品質目標。
knowledge.textEn: Grout must enter narrow voids while remaining uniform. Excess yield resistance limits spread, whereas bleeding reduces effective volume before hardening.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：流動度合格就可以不再檢查漿體泌水或材料分離。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing a flow test removes any need to inspect bleeding or segregation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「流變與泌水分離」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rheology and bleed separation" is correct?
options: 流動度合格就可以不再檢查漿體泌水或材料分離。
漿體需流入狹窄環隙又保持均勻，屈服阻力過高限制擴散，泌水則使初始體積在硬化前縮小。
平均管線停留短就保證所有死區材料都尚未老化。
optionsEn: Passing a flow test removes any need to inspect bleeding or segregation.
Grout must enter narrow voids while remaining uniform.
A short mean line residence guarantees that material in every dead zone remains fresh.
quiz.explanation: 漿體需流入狹窄環隙又保持均勻，屈服阻力過高限制擴散，泌水則使初始體積在硬化前縮小。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Grout must enter narrow voids while remaining uniform. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 流變與泌水分離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rheology and bleed separation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「流變與泌水分離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rheology and bleed separation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設1 L試樣析水30 mL，泌水比例3%；不等於現地空隙必定增加3%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed 1 L sample releases 30 mL water, bleed is 3%; this does not mean the field void necessarily increases by 3%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按核准方法同時試驗流動性、泌水和時間變化，保留溫度、材料批次與混合歷程；灌漿工程師需核對試樣和現場剪切環境，將未驗證尺度轉換列為限制。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test flow, bleed and time dependence using approved methods with temperature, batches and mixing history; grout engineers compare specimen and field shear conditions and identify unverified scale transfer explicitly.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 流變與泌水分離：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「流變與泌水分離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rheology and bleed separation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按核准方法同時試驗流動性、泌水和時間變化，保留溫度、材料批次與混合歷程；灌漿工程師需核對試樣和現場剪切環境，將未驗證尺度轉換列為限制。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：高流動性可能伴隨大量泌水而在頂部留下空隙，過度增稠又可能只充滿注入口附近；單一流動度合格無法排除這兩種相反失效。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: High flowability may come with bleeding that leaves crown voids, while thick grout fills only near ports. Passing one flow test cannot exclude either of these opposing failure mechanisms in practice. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Test flow, bleed and time dependence using approved methods with temperature, batches and mixing history; grout engineers compare specimen and field shear conditions and identify unverified scale transfer explicitly.

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 流變與泌水分離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rheology and bleed separation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「流變與泌水分離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 高流動性可能伴隨大量泌水而在頂部留下空隙，過度增稠又可能只充滿注入口附近；單一流動度合格無法排除這兩種相反失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High flowability may come with bleeding that leaves crown voids, while thick grout fills only near ports. Passing one flow test cannot exclude either of these opposing failure mechanisms in practice. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「凝結時間與輸送延遲」與「環片浮力與抬升」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Setting time and delivery delay" and "Lining buoyancy and uplift": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 凝結時間與輸送延遲：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Setting time and delivery delay: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「凝結時間與輸送延遲」如何影響盾尾空隙同步灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Setting time and delivery delay” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 材料從混合到到達環隙經歷管路停留與剪切，凝結或增稠會改變可用流動時間。時間估算需包括停機和死區，平均停留短並不保證所有材料都未老化，尤其多組分系統更需明確控制體。 假設有效管容0.12 m³、流量0.004 m³/s，名義停留30 s；不含停機和非理想混合。 只看平均停留會漏掉死區已凝材料，壓降逐漸增加可能被誤認為環隙已滿；在錯誤判讀下減少填充，會把堵塞問題轉成背填空洞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「凝結時間與輸送延遲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mixed material ages and shears during transport, changing its workable time. Include stoppages and dead zones: a short mean residence does not guarantee fresh material everywhere, especially in multicomponent systems with distinct mixing locations. Assume effective line volume 0.12 m³ and flow 0.004 m³/s; nominal residence is 30 s, excluding stoppages and nonideal mixing. Mean residence misses hardened material in dead zones, and rising loss may be mistaken for a full annulus. Reducing delivery on that interpretation turns a line blockage into an unfilled support void. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Setting time and delivery delay” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均管線停留短就保證所有死區材料都尚未老化。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A short mean line residence guarantees that material in every dead zone remains fresh." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「凝結時間與輸送延遲」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 凝結時間與輸送延遲
knowledge.text: 材料從混合到到達環隙經歷管路停留與剪切，凝結或增稠會改變可用流動時間。時間估算需包括停機和死區，平均停留短並不保證所有材料都未老化，尤其多組分系統更需明確控制體。
knowledge.textEn: Mixed material ages and shears during transport, changing its workable time. Include stoppages and dead zones: a short mean residence does not guarantee fresh material everywhere, especially in multicomponent systems with distinct mixing locations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均管線停留短就保證所有死區材料都尚未老化。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A short mean line residence guarantees that material in every dead zone remains fresh. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「凝結時間與輸送延遲」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Setting time and delivery delay" is correct?

計算環片浮力時應使用混凝土材料體積作排開漿體體積。

optionsEn: A short mean line residence guarantees that material in every dead zone remains fresh.
Concrete material volume should be used as displaced grout volume when calculating ring buoyancy.
Mixed material ages and shears during transport, changing its workable time.
quiz.explanation: 材料從混合到到達環隙經歷管路停留與剪切，凝結或增稠會改變可用流動時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixed material ages and shears during transport, changing its workable time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 凝結時間與輸送延遲：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Setting time and delivery delay: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「凝結時間與輸送延遲」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Setting time and delivery delay” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設有效管容0.12 m³、流量0.004 m³/s，名義停留30 s；不含停機和非理想混合。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume effective line volume 0.12 m³ and flow 0.004 m³/s; nominal residence is 30 s, excluding stoppages and nonideal mixing. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將混合位置、管線容積、流量及材料時間試驗對齊，檢查停機重啟是否產生老化團塊；設備和材料負責人共同核准方案，本課不提供促凝比例或管路處理操作。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align mixing location, volume and flow with time-dependent material tests and inspect restart evidence for aged lumps; equipment and materials leads approve the scheme, with no accelerator ratio or line-treatment procedure prescribed here.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 凝結時間與輸送延遲：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Setting time and delivery delay” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看平均停留會漏掉死區已凝材料，壓降逐漸增加可能被誤認為環隙已滿；在錯誤判讀下減少填充，會把堵塞問題轉成背填空洞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 環片浮力與抬升：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lining buoyancy and uplift: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「環片浮力與抬升」如何影響盾尾空隙同步灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lining buoyancy and uplift” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 新鮮漿體對環片產生浮力，未形成硬化支承前的環片重量、連接與約束共同抵抗抬升。局部非均勻壓力還會造成轉動，不能只用總注入量推定環片位置穩定。 假設外壓近似靜水分布，有效排開漿體體積15 m³（非混凝土體積）、密度1200 kg/m³，浮力176.58 kN；環重12 t為117.72 kN，未計約束淨上力58.86 kN。 環片抬升會改變接縫張開與軌道淨空，若高程監測太晚只看到硬化後位置，短暫移動造成的接縫損傷可能被漏掉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環片浮力與抬升」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fresh grout creates buoyancy resisted by lining weight, connections and restraints before hard support forms. Uneven local pressures also cause rotation, so total delivery cannot establish positional stability of the ring. Assume near-hydrostatic external pressure and effective displaced grout volume of 15 m³, not concrete volume, at 1200 kg/m³; buoyancy is 176.58 kN. A 12 t ring weighs 117.72 kN, leaving 58.86 kN before restraints. Uplift changes joint opening and track clearance. If elevation is checked only after hardening, temporary movement and the joint damage it caused may remain absent from the record used for acceptance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lining buoyancy and uplift” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

Concrete material volume should be used as displaced grout volume when calculating ring buoyancy.

quiz.explanation: 新鮮漿體對環片產生浮力，未形成硬化支承前的環片重量、連接與約束共同抵抗抬升。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fresh grout creates buoyancy resisted by lining weight, connections and restraints before hard support forms. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環片浮力與抬升：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lining buoyancy and uplift: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環片浮力與抬升」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lining buoyancy and uplift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設外壓近似靜水分布，有效排開漿體體積15 m³（非混凝土體積）、密度1200 kg/m³，浮力176.58 kN；環重12 t為117.72 kN，未計約束淨上力58.86 kN。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume near-hydrostatic external pressure and effective displaced grout volume of 15 m³, not concrete volume, at 1200 kg/m³; buoyancy is 176.58 kN. A 12 t ring weighs 117.72 kN, leaving 58.86 kN before restraints. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步環片高程、姿態與注入分區時序，核對新鮮漿體密度及支承形成時間；結構工程師需評估接縫與臨時約束路徑，不能把淨上力直接變成未核准的固定或加載措施。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize ring elevation and attitude with zonal injection and check fresh density and support-development time; structural engineers assess joint and temporary restraint paths rather than converting net uplift into an unapproved fixing or loading measure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

A 12 t ring weighs 117.72 kN, leaving 58.86 kN before restraints.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「環片浮力與抬升」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Delivering the theoretical annular volume proves that no crown void can remain.

steps.title: 環片浮力與抬升：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lining buoyancy and uplift: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環片浮力與抬升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lining buoyancy and uplift” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步環片高程、姿態與注入分區時序，核對新鮮漿體密度及支承形成時間；結構工程師需評估接縫與臨時約束路徑，不能把淨上力直接變成未核准的固定或加載措施。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：環片抬升會改變接縫張開與軌道淨空，若高程監測太晚只看到硬化後位置，短暫移動造成的接縫損傷可能被漏掉。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize ring elevation and attitude with zonal injection and check fresh density and support-development time; structural engineers assess joint and temporary restraint paths rather than converting net uplift into an unapproved fixing or loading measure. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Uplift changes joint opening and track clearance. If elevation is checked only after hardening, temporary movement and the joint damage it caused may remain absent from the record used for acceptance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for lining buoyancy and uplift. Synchronize ring elevation and attitude with zonal injection and check fresh density and support-development time; structural engineers assess joint and temporary restraint paths rather than converting net uplift into an unapproved fixing or loading measure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：環片抬升會改變接縫張開與軌道淨空，若高程監測太晚只看到硬化後位置，短暫移動造成的接縫損傷可能被漏掉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uplift changes joint opening and track clearance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環片浮力與抬升」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lining buoyancy and uplift"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
泵端壓力可以不修正高程與管損直接當環片外壓。

Pump-end pressure directly equals lining pressure without elevation or line-loss correction.

quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize ring elevation and attitude with zonal injection and check fresh density and support-development time; structural engineers assess joint and temporary restraint paths rather than converting net uplift into an unapproved fixing or loading measure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 環片浮力與抬升：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lining buoyancy and uplift: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環片浮力與抬升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lining buoyancy and uplift” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 環片抬升會改變接縫張開與軌道淨空，若高程監測太晚只看到硬化後位置，短暫移動造成的接縫損傷可能被漏掉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uplift changes joint opening and track clearance. If elevation is checked only after hardening, temporary movement and the joint damage it caused may remain absent from the record used for acceptance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：環片抬升會改變接縫張開與軌道淨空，若高程監測太晚只看到硬化後位置，短暫移動造成的接縫損傷可能被漏掉。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If elevation is checked only after hardening, temporary movement and the joint damage it caused may remain absent from the record used for acceptance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「計算環片浮力時應使用混凝土材料體積作排開漿體體積。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Concrete material volume should be used as displaced grout volume when calculating ring buoyancy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 環片抬升會改變接縫張開與軌道淨空，若高程監測太晚只看到硬化後位置，短暫移動造成的接縫損傷可能被漏掉。
knowledge.textEn: Uplift changes joint opening and track clearance. If elevation is checked only after hardening, temporary movement and the joint damage it caused may remain absent from the record used for acceptance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環片浮力與抬升」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
最終硬化模數可直接代表剛注入時漿體的支承剛度。
optionsEn: Uplift changes joint opening and track clearance.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Final hardened modulus directly represents support stiffness immediately after injection.
quiz.explanation: 環片抬升會改變接縫張開與軌道淨空，若高程監測太晚只看到硬化後位置，短暫移動造成的接縫損傷可能被漏掉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uplift changes joint opening and track clearance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「早齡剛度與荷載接替」與「收縮與失水容積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Early stiffness and load transfer" and "Shrinkage and volume loss": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 早齡剛度與荷載接替：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Early stiffness and load transfer: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「早齡剛度與荷載接替」如何影響盾尾空隙同步灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Early stiffness and load transfer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 背填從流體逐漸變成可傳遞剪力與壓縮的固體，這段轉換控制地層和襯砌何時互相支承。早期抗壓強度與剛度不是同一性質，支承模型需使用相應時間的材料狀態。 假設等效壓縮模數50 MPa、應變0.001，線彈性示意應力0.05 MPa=50 kPa；不代表破壞強度。 以最終高模數套早期環隙會高估支承而低估沉陷，反之忽略硬化又可能錯估長期環彎矩；同一材料需要隨時間更新而非單一常數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「早齡剛度與荷載接替」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Backfill changes from fluid to a solid carrying compression and shear, governing when ground and lining support one another. Early compressive strength differs from stiffness, so support models must use the material state at the relevant age. Assume compression modulus 50 MPa and strain 0.001; illustrative elastic stress is 0.05 MPa=50 kPa, not failure strength. Using final stiffness at early age overstates support and understates settlement, while ignoring later hardening misstates ring moments. The same material therefore needs time-dependent characterization rather than one constant. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Early stiffness and load transfer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最終硬化模數可直接代表剛注入時漿體的支承剛度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Final hardened modulus directly represents support stiffness immediately after injection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「早齡剛度與荷載接替」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Early stiffness and load transfer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「早齡剛度與荷載接替」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.instruction: 泌水、化學收縮與地層吸水會改變背填硬化後容積，各機制發生時間和位置不同。試樣自由收縮不等於現場受約束空洞，但可提示需要核對密實度與長期接觸，不能只看初期注滿。 假設初始填充3 m³、自由體積縮減2%，變化0.06 m³；現地是否成空洞取決於補給與約束。 地層吸水可能使注入口附近迅速增稠而遠端未填，後期收縮又加大接觸缺口；若只在早期量一次漿體強度，便看不到這些容積機制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「收縮與失水容積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bleeding, chemical shrinkage and ground absorption alter hardened volume at different times and locations. Free specimen shrinkage is not directly a restrained field void, but signals a need to examine density and lasting contact beyond initial filling. Assume initial fill 3 m³ and free volumetric reduction 2%; change is 0.06 m³, with field void formation dependent on replenishment and restraint. Ground absorption can thicken grout near ports before distant voids fill, and later shrinkage enlarges contact gaps. A single early strength measurement does not reveal either of these volume-related processes. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Shrinkage and volume loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「空洞檢測與非唯一性」與「背填證據工程移交」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Void detection and nonuniqueness" and "Backfill evidence and handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 空洞檢測與非唯一性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Void detection and nonuniqueness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「空洞檢測與非唯一性」如何影響盾尾空隙同步灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Void detection and nonuniqueness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 襯砌背後缺陷可由聲學、雷達或其他核准方法提供線索，但反射異常也可能來自含水、材料界面或鋼筋。檢測須校準到現場構造並有獨立查證，不能把色圖每個異常直接當空洞。 假設100 m²檢查面中10 m²無有效資料，可評估覆蓋90%；未量區不能併入無缺陷面積。 鋼筋反射被誤當空洞會造成無謂修復，潮濕漿體又可能掩蓋真缺陷；沒有檢出限與盲區圖的檢測報告無法支持全面密實宣稱。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「空洞檢測與非唯一性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Approved acoustic, radar or other methods can indicate defects behind lining, but reflections also arise from water, interfaces and steel. Calibrate to actual construction and verify independently rather than labeling every colored anomaly a void. If an assumed 100 m² inspection area includes 10 m² without valid data, coverage is 90%; unmeasured areas cannot count as defect-free. Mistaking steel reflections for voids prompts unnecessary repair, while wet grout may conceal real defects. Without detection limits and blind-zone maps, a survey cannot support a claim of complete filling. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Void detection and nonuniqueness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「非破壞檢測圖上的每一個反射異常都必定是空洞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every reflection anomaly on a nondestructive survey necessarily represents a void." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「空洞檢測與非唯一性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Void detection and nonuniqueness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Approved acoustic, radar or other methods can indicate defects behind lining, but reflections also arise from water, interfaces and steel. Calibrate to actual construction and verify independently rather than labeling every colored anomaly a void.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：非破壞檢測圖上的每一個反射異常都必定是空洞。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every reflection anomaly on a nondestructive survey necessarily represents a void. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 空洞檢測與非唯一性：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「空洞檢測與非唯一性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Void detection and nonuniqueness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設100 m²檢查面中10 m²無有效資料，可評估覆蓋90%；未量區不能併入無缺陷面積。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed 100 m² inspection area includes 10 m² without valid data, coverage is 90%; unmeasured areas cannot count as defect-free. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用已知構造或代表試件評估檢測辨識能力，將異常與注入量、壓力及沉陷交叉比對；確認範圍由工程師指定合適方法，任何鑽查需另有核准，課程不提供現場穿孔步驟。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Assess detection on known construction or representative specimens and compare anomalies with quantities, pressures and movement; engineers select confirmation methods, with any intrusive investigation separately approved rather than instructed by this course.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「空洞檢測與非唯一性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Void detection and nonuniqueness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鋼筋反射被誤當空洞會造成無謂修復，潮濕漿體又可能掩蓋真缺陷；沒有檢出限與盲區圖的檢測報告無法支持全面密實宣稱。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mistaking steel reflections for voids prompts unnecessary repair, while wet grout may conceal real defects. Without detection limits and blind-zone maps, a survey cannot support a claim of complete filling. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鋼筋反射被誤當空洞會造成無謂修復，潮濕漿體又可能掩蓋真缺陷；沒有檢出限與盲區圖的檢測報告無法支持全面密實宣稱。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every reflection anomaly on a nondestructive survey necessarily represents a void." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「空洞檢測與非唯一性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。

optionsEn: Mistaking steel reflections for voids prompts unnecessary repair, while wet grout may conceal real defects.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A normal shift-average fill ratio permits waiving individual ring anomaly resolution.
quiz.explanation: 鋼筋反射被誤當空洞會造成無謂修復，潮濕漿體又可能掩蓋真缺陷；沒有檢出限與盲區圖的檢測報告無法支持全面密實宣稱。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mistaking steel reflections for voids prompts unnecessary repair, while wet grout may conceal real defects. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 背填證據工程移交：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Backfill evidence and handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「背填證據工程移交」如何影響盾尾空隙同步灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backfill evidence and handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Synchronous tail-void grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 背填品質是體積、材料、壓力和幾何的一致證據，不是單一到量記錄。交接應把每環分區資料與環片位置、地層和檢測相連，讓後續發現滲漏或沉陷時可追查原始成因。 假設10環中8環收支閉合且證據完整，覆蓋80%；其餘2環要逐環列出缺項與審查決定。 只保留每班總量會使局部空洞無法定位，材料批次更換又可能與硬化差異錯配；資料齊全但時間不同步仍不能建立可信的因果鏈。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「背填證據工程移交」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Backfill quality requires consistent volume, material, pressure and geometry evidence rather than one delivered-quantity record. Link each ring and zone to lining location, geology and inspection so later leakage or settlement remains diagnosable. If 8 of an assumed 10 rings have closed balances and complete evidence, coverage is 80%; the other 2 require individual gaps and review decisions. Shift totals cannot locate local voids, and unaligned batch changes misassign hardening differences. Even complete records fail to establish a credible causal chain when their timestamps are inconsistent across systems. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Backfill evidence and handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「整班平均填充比正常就可以省略個別環異常處置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A normal shift-average fill ratio permits waiving individual ring anomaly resolution." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「背填證據工程移交」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Backfill evidence and handover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 背填證據工程移交
knowledge.text: 背填品質是體積、材料、壓力和幾何的一致證據，不是單一到量記錄。交接應把每環分區資料與環片位置、地層和檢測相連，讓後續發現滲漏或沉陷時可追查原始成因。
knowledge.textEn: Backfill quality requires consistent volume, material, pressure and geometry evidence rather than one delivered-quantity record. Link each ring and zone to lining location, geology and inspection so later leakage or settlement remains diagnosable.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：整班平均填充比正常就可以省略個別環異常處置。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A normal shift-average fill ratio permits waiving individual ring anomaly resolution. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「背填證據工程移交」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Backfill evidence and handover" is correct?
options: 整班平均填充比正常就可以省略個別環異常處置。
背填品質是體積、材料、壓力和幾何的一致證據，不是單一到量記錄。
注入量達理論環隙體積就證明頂部不可能留下空洞。
optionsEn: A normal shift-average fill ratio permits waiving individual ring anomaly resolution.
Backfill quality requires consistent volume, material, pressure and geometry evidence rather than one delivered-quantity record.
Delivering the theoretical annular volume proves that no crown void can remain.
quiz.explanation: 背填品質是體積、材料、壓力和幾何的一致證據，不是單一到量記錄。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Backfill quality requires consistent volume, material, pressure and geometry evidence rather than one delivered-quantity record. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 背填證據工程移交：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Backfill evidence and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「背填證據工程移交」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Backfill evidence and handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10環中8環收支閉合且證據完整，覆蓋80%；其餘2環要逐環列出缺項與審查決定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 8 of an assumed 10 rings have closed balances and complete evidence, coverage is 80%; the other 2 require individual gaps and review decisions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽查一環由材料批次到泵送、注入口、姿態和後期檢測的全鏈，核對時鐘與版本；灌漿、結構及地工負責人共同簽認限制，不能將整體平均充填比代替每環異常處置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace a ring through batches, pumping, ports, pose and later inspection with consistent clocks and versions; grout, structural and geotechnical leads accept limitations explicitly instead of substituting an average fill ratio for individual anomaly resolution.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 8 of an assumed 10 rings have closed balances and complete evidence, coverage is 80%; the other 2 require individual gaps and review decisions.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「背填證據工程移交」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 背填證據工程移交：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Backfill evidence and handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只保留每班總量會使局部空洞無法定位，材料批次更換又可能與硬化差異錯配；資料齊全但時間不同步仍不能建立可信的因果鏈。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shift totals cannot locate local voids, and unaligned batch changes misassign hardening differences. Even complete records fail to establish a credible causal chain when their timestamps are inconsistent across systems. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只保留每班總量會使局部空洞無法定位，材料批次更換又可能與硬化差異錯配；資料齊全但時間不同步仍不能建立可信的因果鏈。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「整班平均填充比正常就可以省略個別環異常處置。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A normal shift-average fill ratio permits waiving individual ring anomaly resolution." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

title: 潛盾發進與到達端止水
titleEn: Water sealing at shield launch and reception
summary: 本課聚焦以始發到達介面、地層水文和暫態受力驗證止水轉換。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on verify launch and reception sealing transitions through interfaces, hydrogeology and temporary load paths. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設4個階段的獨立屏障數為2、1、2、2，最低為1；平均1.75不能代表關鍵階段冗餘。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水水頭差20 m，Δp=196.2 kPa；作用於10 m²平面合力1.962 MN，未計壓力梯度。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed barrier counts 2,1,2 and 2 across four stages, the minimum is 1; the mean 1.75 does not describe redundancy at the critical transition. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume freshwater head difference 20 m; Δp=196.2 kPa and force on a uniformly loaded 10 m² plane is 1.962 MN, excluding pressure variation. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「始發到達控制體」與「水頭基準與外水力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Launch and reception control volumes" and "Head datum and external water force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 始發到達控制體：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Launch and reception control volumes: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「始發到達控制體」如何影響潛盾發進與到達端止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Launch and reception control volumes” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water sealing at shield launch and reception”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 穿越井壁時，機器、井體和地層之間的支護與止水邊界會改變，不能只檢查最終貫通狀態。應按位置畫出每個階段仍存在的屏障和力流，特別辨識暫時只剩單一道防護的區間。 假設4個階段的獨立屏障數為2、1、2、2，最低為1；平均1.75不能代表關鍵階段冗餘。 屏障移交時序若有空檔，總體設計看似完整卻可能短暫直接連通水土；責任只按專業分工而無介面確認，會讓關鍵空檔無人審查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「始發到達控制體」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crossing a shaft wall changes support and sealing boundaries among machine, shaft and ground. Checking only final breakthrough misses transitions; map barriers and load paths by position, identifying intervals with only one remaining barrier. For assumed barrier counts 2,1,2 and 2 across four stages, the minimum is 1; the mean 1.75 does not describe redundancy at the critical transition. A timing gap between barriers can temporarily connect water and ground despite an apparently complete overall design. Discipline-only responsibilities without interface review leave the critical interval unowned and unchecked. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Launch and reception control volumes” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最終止水屏障完整就代表過渡階段絕不會出現空檔。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Complete final sealing barriers guarantee no gap during intermediate transitions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「始發到達控制體」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Launch and reception control volumes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Complete final sealing barriers guarantee no gap during intermediate transitions. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「始發到達控制體」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Launch and reception control volumes" is correct?
options: 最終止水屏障完整就代表過渡階段絕不會出現空檔。
穿越井壁時，機器、井體和地層之間的支護與止水邊界會改變，不能只檢查最終貫通狀態。

Crossing a shaft wall changes support and sealing boundaries among machine, shaft and ground.
Shaft depth equals the actual pressure head from every aquifer at the opening.

steps.title: 始發到達控制體：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Launch and reception control volumes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「始發到達控制體」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Launch and reception control volumes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設4個階段的獨立屏障數為2、1、2、2，最低為1；平均1.75不能代表關鍵階段冗餘。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed barrier counts 2,1,2 and 2 across four stages, the minimum is 1; the mean 1.75 does not describe redundancy at the critical transition. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用核准施工階段圖逐項對照井壁、止水裝置、地層處理與機器位置，做介面責任審查；每個屏障需有驗證證據與失效條件，不能以最終成品圖代替暫態審查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review approved stage drawings against shaft wall, seals, treated ground and machine position with assigned interface owners; each barrier needs evidence and invalidation conditions, not only a final-state drawing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
