steps.title: 水頭基準與外水力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Head datum and external water force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水頭基準與外水力」如何影響潛盾發進與到達端止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Head datum and external water force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water sealing at shield launch and reception”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 井內外水頭差決定潛在流入驅動，地表水位、承壓含水層和施工排水不一定一致。壓力計高程與測段連通性需清楚，不能把井深或某個遠處水位直接當成所有位置的水頭。 假設淡水水頭差20 m，Δp=196.2 kPa；作用於10 m²平面合力1.962 MN，未計壓力梯度。 把表壓與絕對壓混用或忽略承壓層會錯估外水力，長期排水又可能改變鄰近地層有效應力；只保護井口而忽略周邊沉陷並不完整。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水頭基準與外水力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The head difference across the shaft drives potential inflow, but surface level, confined groundwater and construction drainage may differ. Gauge elevation and interval connectivity matter; neither shaft depth nor one distant water level represents every location. Assume freshwater head difference 20 m; Δp=196.2 kPa and force on a uniformly loaded 10 m² plane is 1.962 MN, excluding pressure variation. Confusing gauge and absolute pressure or missing a confined aquifer misstates water load. Prolonged pumping also changes surrounding effective stress, so protecting only the opening overlooks neighboring settlement effects. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Head datum and external water force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「井深就是所有含水層作用於井口的實際壓力水頭。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shaft depth equals the actual pressure head from every aquifer at the opening." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水頭基準與外水力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Head datum and external water force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水頭基準與外水力

knowledge.text: 井內外水頭差決定潛在流入驅動，地表水位、承壓含水層和施工排水不一定一致。壓力計高程與測段連通性需清楚，不能把井深或某個遠處水位直接當成所有位置的水頭。
knowledge.textEn: The head difference across the shaft drives potential inflow, but surface level, confined groundwater and construction drainage may differ. Gauge elevation and interval connectivity matter; neither shaft depth nor one distant water level represents every location.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：井深就是所有含水層作用於井口的實際壓力水頭。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Shaft depth equals the actual pressure head from every aquifer at the opening. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水頭基準與外水力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Head datum and external water force" is correct?
options: 井深就是所有含水層作用於井口的實際壓力水頭。
少數高強度處理體試件可以排除所有貫通薄弱通道。
井內外水頭差決定潛在流入驅動，地表水位、承壓含水層和施工排水不一定一致。
optionsEn: Shaft depth equals the actual pressure head from every aquifer at the opening.
A few strong treated-ground specimens exclude every connected weak pathway.
The head difference across the shaft drives potential inflow, but surface level, confined groundwater and construction drainage may differ.
quiz.explanation: 井內外水頭差決定潛在流入驅動，地表水位、承壓含水層和施工排水不一定一致。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水水頭差20 m，Δp=196.2 kPa；作用於10 m²平面合力1.962 MN，未計壓力梯度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume freshwater head difference 20 m; Δp=196.2 kPa and force on a uniformly loaded 10 m² plane is 1.962 MN, excluding pressure variation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用多深度水位或孔壓資料建立水頭範圍，將感測器高程換到共同基準，核對抽排水時序；地工與結構工程師需確認最不利水情及平面受壓假設，不將算例當測試加壓值。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「處理體連續性與薄弱通道」與「滲流梯度與尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 處理體連續性與薄弱通道：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Treated-ground continuity and weak paths: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「處理體連續性與薄弱通道」如何影響潛盾發進與到達端止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Treated-ground continuity and weak paths” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water sealing at shield launch and reception”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地層處理體的作用取決於連續性和與井壁的接合，平均強度或滲透性不能排除細小貫通通道。幾何覆蓋、施工偏差和天然透水夾層須一起審查，避免把處理體當成理想均質方塊。 假設串聯兩層各厚1 m，k1=10⁻⁶、k2=10⁻⁸ m/s，法向等效k=2/(10⁶+10⁸)=1.98×10⁻⁸ m/s；旁通不適用。 高強度區樣本容易取得，弱通道卻可能被漏採；串聯低透水公式若實際有旁通便失效，開口後集中滲流可能遠高於平均材料估算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「處理體連續性與薄弱通道」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A treated block depends on continuity and its interface with the wall. Average strength or permeability does not exclude a narrow connected path, requiring geometry, construction deviations and permeable interbeds to be assessed together. Assume two 1 m layers in series with k1=10⁻⁶ and k2=10⁻⁸ m/s; normal equivalent k=1.98×10⁻⁸ m/s, excluding bypass paths. Strong areas are easier to sample while weak paths may be missed. A series-layer calculation fails in the presence of bypass, and concentrated inflow can greatly exceed the average-material estimate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Treated-ground continuity and weak paths” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A few strong treated-ground specimens exclude every connected weak pathway." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「處理體連續性與薄弱通道」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Treated-ground continuity and weak paths”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instructionEn: Head difference over path length gives a mean gradient, but the shortest route may follow a wall interface or crack. Assume head difference 10 m over effective path 5 m, giving i=2; a 1 m crack path gives i=10, before three-dimensional flow effects. Using total block thickness as the shortest path understates interface leakage, while distant pressure readings miss local gradients. Initially small flow carrying fines can indicate an evolving pathway rather than a harmless stable condition. options: 由地質、接合面與孔壓觀測建立可行流路，對比完好體及局部缺陷情境；試驗和模型應由地工工程師確認尺度，梯度算例不能作現場注水或開口許可。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
最終止水屏障完整就代表過渡階段絕不會出現空檔。
optionsEn: Construct plausible paths from geology, interfaces and pressure observations and compare intact and defective scenarios.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Complete final sealing barriers guarantee no gap during intermediate transitions.
quiz.explanation: 由地質、接合面與孔壓觀測建立可行流路，對比完好體及局部缺陷情境；試驗和模型應由地工工程師確認尺度，梯度算例不能作現場注水或開口許可。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Construct plausible paths from geology, interfaces and pressure observations and compare intact and defective scenarios; geotechnical engineers validate test scale, and the gradient exercise does not authorize injection or opening work. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 滲流梯度與尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Seepage gradient and scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「滲流梯度與尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Seepage gradient and scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以處理體總厚度當最短流路會低估界面漏水，若只量遠處孔壓也可能漏掉局部高梯度；流量初小但帶砂可意味通道正在演化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using total block thickness as the shortest path understates interface leakage, while distant pressure readings miss local gradients. Initially small flow carrying fines can indicate an evolving pathway rather than a harmless stable condition. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以處理體總厚度當最短流路會低估界面漏水，若只量遠處孔壓也可能漏掉局部高梯度；流量初小但帶砂可意味通道正在演化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Initially small flow carrying fines can indicate an evolving pathway rather than a harmless stable condition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「處理體總厚度永遠就是地下水能走過的最短路徑。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The full treated-block thickness always equals the shortest possible groundwater path." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以處理體總厚度當最短流路會低估界面漏水，若只量遠處孔壓也可能漏掉局部高梯度；流量初小但帶砂可意味通道正在演化。
knowledge.textEn: Using total block thickness as the shortest path understates interface leakage, while distant pressure readings miss local gradients. Initially small flow carrying fines can indicate an evolving pathway rather than a harmless stable condition.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「滲流梯度與尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Seepage gradient and scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
以處理體總厚度當最短流路會低估界面漏水，若只量遠處孔壓也可能漏掉局部高梯度；流量初小但帶砂可意味通道正在演化。
平均止水環壓縮正常就能排除偏心造成的局部失去接觸。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using total block thickness as the shortest path understates interface leakage, while distant pressure readings miss local gradients.
Normal mean sealing-ring compression excludes local loss of contact from eccentricity.
quiz.explanation: 以處理體總厚度當最短流路會低估界面漏水，若只量遠處孔壓也可能漏掉局部高梯度；流量初小但帶砂可意味通道正在演化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using total block thickness as the shortest path understates interface leakage, while distant pressure readings miss local gradients. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「止水環壓縮與偏心」與「角度誤差與穿越長度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity" and "Angular error through the opening": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 止水環壓縮與偏心：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「止水環壓縮與偏心」如何影響潛盾發進與到達端止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water sealing at shield launch and reception”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 始發到達止水裝置需適應機器外形與偏心，環狀接觸不均時局部壓縮不足可能先漏。機器姿態與井口幾何是共同介面，不能只由止水材料單方證書判定整體可用。 假設名義壓縮12 mm、偏心4 mm，簡化兩側壓縮8與16 mm；實際柔性變形需試驗確認。 機器偏斜可能一側擠壞密封而另一側失去接觸，平均壓縮仍正常；若以增加單側作用力補救而未審查，還可能加劇井口或機器偏位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「止水環壓縮與偏心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Launch or reception seals must accommodate machine shape and eccentricity. Uneven annular contact leaves locally undercompressed zones, making machine pose and opening geometry a shared interface beyond what a material certificate alone can establish. Assume nominal compression 12 mm and eccentricity 4 mm; simplified opposite compressions are 8 and 16 mm, with actual flexibility requiring testing. Misalignment can overcompress one side and lose contact on the other despite a normal mean. An unreviewed unilateral correction may worsen opening or machine displacement rather than restore a compatible interface. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均止水環壓縮正常就能排除偏心造成的局部失去接觸。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal mean sealing-ring compression excludes local loss of contact from eccentricity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「止水環壓縮與偏心」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 止水環壓縮與偏心
knowledge.text: 始發到達止水裝置需適應機器外形與偏心，環狀接觸不均時局部壓縮不足可能先漏。機器姿態與井口幾何是共同介面，不能只由止水材料單方證書判定整體可用。
knowledge.textEn: Launch or reception seals must accommodate machine shape and eccentricity. Uneven annular contact leaves locally undercompressed zones, making machine pose and opening geometry a shared interface beyond what a material certificate alone can establish.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均止水環壓縮正常就能排除偏心造成的局部失去接觸。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Normal mean sealing-ring compression excludes local loss of contact from eccentricity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「止水環壓縮與偏心」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity" is correct?
options: 平均止水環壓縮正常就能排除偏心造成的局部失去接觸。
機器中心點對準就不需要再檢查俯仰偏航和穿越長度。
始發到達止水裝置需適應機器外形與偏心，環狀接觸不均時局部壓縮不足可能先漏。
optionsEn: Normal mean sealing-ring compression excludes local loss of contact from eccentricity.
A correctly positioned machine center removes the need to check pitch, yaw and crossing length.
Launch or reception seals must accommodate machine shape and eccentricity.
quiz.explanation: 始發到達止水裝置需適應機器外形與偏心，環狀接觸不均時局部壓縮不足可能先漏。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Launch or reception seals must accommodate machine shape and eccentricity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 止水環壓縮與偏心：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「止水環壓縮與偏心」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設名義壓縮12 mm、偏心4 mm，簡化兩側壓縮8與16 mm；實際柔性變形需試驗確認。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume nominal compression 12 mm and eccentricity 4 mm; simplified opposite compressions are 8 and 16 mm, with actual flexibility requiring testing. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將井口測量、機器外徑與姿態資料對照核准止水裝置試驗範圍，保留最不利組合；設備與土建負責人共同確認幾何條件，任何材料或尺寸變更需重新審查介面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare opening survey, machine diameter and pose with the approved seal test envelope, retaining adverse combinations; equipment and civil leads jointly confirm geometry and review the interface after material or dimensional changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設名義壓縮12 mm、偏心4 mm，簡化兩側壓縮8與16 mm；實際柔性變形需試驗確認。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume nominal compression 12 mm and eccentricity 4 mm; simplified opposite compressions are 8 and 16 mm, with actual flexibility requiring testing.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「止水環壓縮與偏心」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
井內沒有看見漏水就證明地層不可能向其他空間流失。
始發到達成功就代表拆除臨時密封後永久止水也已合格。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
No visible shaft leakage proves that ground cannot be flowing into other spaces.
Successful launch or reception proves permanent sealing after temporary barriers are removed.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 止水環壓縮與偏心：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「止水環壓縮與偏心」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將井口測量、機器外徑與姿態資料對照核准止水裝置試驗範圍，保留最不利組合；設備與土建負責人共同確認幾何條件，任何材料或尺寸變更需重新審查介面。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：機器偏斜可能一側擠壞密封而另一側失去接觸，平均壓縮仍正常；若以增加單側作用力補救而未審查，還可能加劇井口或機器偏位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare opening survey, machine diameter and pose with the approved seal test envelope, retaining adverse combinations; equipment and civil leads jointly confirm geometry and review the interface after material or dimensional changes. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Misalignment can overcompress one side and lose contact on the other despite a normal mean. An unreviewed unilateral correction may worsen opening or machine displacement rather than restore a compatible interface. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄止水環壓縮與偏心的資料來源與適用條件。將井口測量、機器外徑與姿態資料對照核准止水裝置試驗範圍，保留最不利組合；設備與土建負責人共同確認幾何條件，任何材料或尺寸變更需重新審查介面。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for sealing-ring compression and eccentricity. Compare opening survey, machine diameter and pose with the approved seal test envelope, retaining adverse combinations; equipment and civil leads jointly confirm geometry and review the interface after material or dimensional changes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：機器偏斜可能一側擠壞密封而另一側失去接觸，平均壓縮仍正常；若以增加單側作用力補救而未審查，還可能加劇井口或機器偏位。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Misalignment can overcompress one side and lose contact on the other despite a normal mean. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將井口測量、機器外徑與姿態資料對照核准止水裝置試驗範圍，保留最不利組合；設備與土建負責人共同確認幾何條件，任何材料或尺寸變更需重新審查介面。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：機器偏斜可能一側擠壞密封而另一側失去接觸，平均壓縮仍正常；若以增加單側作用力補救而未審查，還可能加劇井口或機器偏位。
knowledge.textEn: Compare opening survey, machine diameter and pose with the approved seal test envelope, retaining adverse combinations; equipment and civil leads jointly confirm geometry and review the interface after material or dimensional changes. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Misalignment can overcompress one side and lose contact on the other despite a normal mean. An unreviewed unilateral correction may worsen opening or machine displacement rather than restore a compatible interface.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄止水環壓縮與偏心的資料來源與適用條件。將井口測量、機器外徑與姿態資料對照核准止水裝置試驗範圍，保留最不利組合；設備與土建負責人共同確認幾何條件，任何材料或尺寸變更需重新審查介面。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for sealing-ring compression and eccentricity. Compare opening survey, machine diameter and pose with the approved seal test envelope, retaining adverse combinations; equipment and civil leads jointly confirm geometry and review the interface after material or dimensional changes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「止水環壓縮與偏心」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
將井口測量、機器外徑與姿態資料對照核准止水裝置試驗範圍，保留最不利組合；設備與土建負責人共同確認幾何條件，任何材料或尺寸變更需重新審查介面。
井深就是所有含水層作用於井口的實際壓力水頭。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Compare opening survey, machine diameter and pose with the approved seal test envelope, retaining adverse combinations.
Shaft depth equals the actual pressure head from every aquifer at the opening.
quiz.explanation: 將井口測量、機器外徑與姿態資料對照核准止水裝置試驗範圍，保留最不利組合；設備與土建負責人共同確認幾何條件，任何材料或尺寸變更需重新審查介面。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare opening survey, machine diameter and pose with the approved seal test envelope, retaining adverse combinations; equipment and civil leads jointly confirm geometry and review the interface after material or dimensional changes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 止水環壓縮與偏心：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「止水環壓縮與偏心」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sealing-ring compression and eccentricity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.

steps.instruction: 機器中心位置正確但姿態偏斜，沿穿越長度仍會產生側向偏差，影響止水接觸與井壁淨距。坐標點與機器軸線必須一起審查，不能以某一瞬間中心點在容許圈內就接受全部幾何。 假設穿越長10 m、角偏0.2°，側向偏差10tan0.2°=34.91 mm；非允許偏角。 長機身的小角偏可在後方形成大碰撞風險，目標點桿臂設定錯誤又會讓畫面中心看似正確；若未核對整體輪廓，止水和結構都受影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「角度誤差與穿越長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A correctly located center with wrong attitude develops lateral error along the crossing length, affecting contact and clearance. Review position and axis together rather than accepting the whole geometry from one center point inside a tolerance circle. For assumed crossing length 10 m and angular error 0.2°, lateral deviation is 10tan0.2°=34.91 mm, not an allowable angle. A small angular error produces large rear-envelope displacement on a long machine, while wrong target lever arms make the displayed center appear correct. Unchecked full-envelope geometry threatens both sealing and structure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Angular error through the opening” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

For assumed crossing length 10 m and angular error 0.2°, lateral deviation is 10tan0.2°=34.91 mm, not an allowable angle. knowledge.text: 長機身的小角偏可在後方形成大碰撞風險，目標點桿臂設定錯誤又會讓畫面中心看似正確；若未核對整體輪廓，止水和結構都受影響。
knowledge.textEn: A small angular error produces large rear-envelope displacement on a long machine, while wrong target lever arms make the displayed center appear correct. Unchecked full-envelope geometry threatens both sealing and structure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「角度誤差與穿越長度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Angular error through the opening" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 長機身的小角偏可在後方形成大碰撞風險，目標點桿臂設定錯誤又會讓畫面中心看似正確；若未核對整體輪廓，止水和結構都受影響。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
總反力除支點數就是每個實際支點的真實受力。
optionsEn: A small angular error produces large rear-envelope displacement on a long machine, while wrong target lever arms make the displayed center appear correct.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Total reaction divided by support count equals the actual force at every support.
quiz.explanation: 長機身的小角偏可在後方形成大碰撞風險，目標點桿臂設定錯誤又會讓畫面中心看似正確；若未核對整體輪廓，止水和結構都受影響。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A small angular error produces large rear-envelope displacement on a long machine, while wrong target lever arms make the displayed center appear correct. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「反力架與暫態傳力」與「觀測鏈與過渡確認」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Reaction frame and temporary load paths" and "Observation chains and transition checks": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 反力架與暫態傳力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reaction frame and temporary load paths: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反力架與暫態傳力」如何影響潛盾發進與到達端止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reaction frame and temporary load paths” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water sealing at shield launch and reception”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 始發推進反力須經核准的支承系統傳到井體或基礎，受力位置與剛度會影響機器對準。到達時支承重新分配也可能形成局部荷載，永久井壁分析不能自動涵蓋這些集中暫態作用。 假設反力4 MN由4個理想等剛度支點均分，平均1 MN/點；偏心及不等剛度須另算。 單一支點間隙可使其他支點超載，反力架轉動又會把幾何誤差帶到止水介面；如果只看總反力，局部破壞和偏移都可能被掩蓋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反力架與暫態傳力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Launch reaction transfers through approved supports into shaft or foundation, with location and stiffness affecting alignment. Reception redistributes support and can create concentrated loads not automatically covered by permanent shaft-wall analysis. Assume 4 MN reaction shared by 4 ideally equal-stiffness supports; the mean is 1 MN each, with eccentricity and stiffness differences assessed separately. A gap at one support overloads others, and frame rotation transfers alignment error to the seal interface. Total reaction alone can conceal both localized structural distress and machine displacement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reaction frame and temporary load paths” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總反力除支點數就是每個實際支點的真實受力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total reaction divided by support count equals the actual force at every support." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「反力架與暫態傳力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Reaction frame and temporary load paths”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 反力架與暫態傳力
knowledge.titleEn: Reaction frame and temporary load paths
knowledge.text: 始發推進反力須經核准的支承系統傳到井體或基礎，受力位置與剛度會影響機器對準。到達時支承重新分配也可能形成局部荷載，永久井壁分析不能自動涵蓋這些集中暫態作用。
knowledge.textEn: Launch reaction transfers through approved supports into shaft or foundation, with location and stiffness affecting alignment. Reception redistributes support and can create concentrated loads not automatically covered by permanent shaft-wall analysis.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總反力除支點數就是每個實際支點的真實受力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total reaction divided by support count equals the actual force at every support. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「反力架與暫態傳力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Reaction frame and temporary load paths" is correct?
options: 總反力除支點數就是每個實際支點的真實受力。
始發推進反力須經核准的支承系統傳到井體或基礎，受力位置與剛度會影響機器對準。
井內沒有看見漏水就證明地層不可能向其他空間流失。
optionsEn: Total reaction divided by support count equals the actual force at every support.
Launch reaction transfers through approved supports into shaft or foundation, with location and stiffness affecting alignment.
No visible shaft leakage proves that ground cannot be flowing into other spaces.
quiz.explanation: 始發推進反力須經核准的支承系統傳到井體或基礎，受力位置與剛度會影響機器對準。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Launch reaction transfers through approved supports into shaft or foundation, with location and stiffness affecting alignment. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 反力架與暫態傳力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reaction frame and temporary load paths: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反力架與暫態傳力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reaction frame and temporary load paths” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設反力4 MN由4個理想等剛度支點均分，平均1 MN/點；偏心及不等剛度須另算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 4 MN reaction shared by 4 ideally equal-stiffness supports; the mean is 1 MN each, with eccentricity and stiffness differences assessed separately. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對實際反力點、連接及井體受力圖，利用合格分析或量測檢查分配與變形；臨時工程設計者簽認受力路徑和階段，不以總承載除支點數當完整結構驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check actual reaction points, connections and shaft load paths with qualified analysis or measurements of sharing and movement; temporary-works designers approve stages rather than treating total capacity divided by support count as full verification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設反力4 MN由4個理想等剛度支點均分，平均1 MN/點；偏心及不等剛度須另算。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 4 MN reaction shared by 4 ideally equal-stiffness supports; the mean is 1 MN each, with eccentricity and stiffness differences assessed separately.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「反力架與暫態傳力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Reaction frame and temporary load paths", which statement holds?
options: 始發到達成功就代表拆除臨時密封後永久止水也已合格。
井深就是所有含水層作用於井口的實際壓力水頭。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Successful launch or reception proves permanent sealing after temporary barriers are removed.
Shaft depth equals the actual pressure head from every aquifer at the opening.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 反力架與暫態傳力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reaction frame and temporary load paths: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反力架與暫態傳力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reaction frame and temporary load paths” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對實際反力點、連接及井體受力圖，利用合格分析或量測檢查分配與變形；臨時工程設計者簽認受力路徑和階段，不以總承載除支點數當完整結構驗證。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：單一支點間隙可使其他支點超載，反力架轉動又會把幾何誤差帶到止水介面；如果只看總反力，局部破壞和偏移都可能被掩蓋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check actual reaction points, connections and shaft load paths with qualified analysis or measurements of sharing and movement; temporary-works designers approve stages rather than treating total capacity divided by support count as full verification. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A gap at one support overloads others, and frame rotation transfers alignment error to the seal interface. Total reaction alone can conceal both localized structural distress and machine displacement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄反力架與暫態傳力的資料來源與適用條件。核對實際反力點、連接及井體受力圖，利用合格分析或量測檢查分配與變形；臨時工程設計者簽認受力路徑和階段，不以總承載除支點數當完整結構驗證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for reaction frame and temporary load paths. Check actual reaction points, connections and shaft load paths with qualified analysis or measurements of sharing and movement; temporary-works designers approve stages rather than treating total capacity divided by support count as full verification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：單一支點間隙可使其他支點超載，反力架轉動又會把幾何誤差帶到止水介面；如果只看總反力，局部破壞和偏移都可能被掩蓋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A gap at one support overloads others, and frame rotation transfers alignment error to the seal interface. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對實際反力點、連接及井體受力圖，利用合格分析或量測檢查分配與變形；臨時工程設計者簽認受力路徑和階段，不以總承載除支點數當完整結構驗證。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：單一支點間隙可使其他支點超載，反力架轉動又會把幾何誤差帶到止水介面；如果只看總反力，局部破壞和偏移都可能被掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Check actual reaction points, connections and shaft load paths with qualified analysis or measurements of sharing and movement; temporary-works designers approve stages rather than treating total capacity divided by support count as full verification. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A gap at one support overloads others, and frame rotation transfers alignment error to the seal interface. Total reaction alone can conceal both localized structural distress and machine displacement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄反力架與暫態傳力的資料來源與適用條件。核對實際反力點、連接及井體受力圖，利用合格分析或量測檢查分配與變形；臨時工程設計者簽認受力路徑和階段，不以總承載除支點數當完整結構驗證。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for reaction frame and temporary load paths. Check actual reaction points, connections and shaft load paths with qualified analysis or measurements of sharing and movement; temporary-works designers approve stages rather than treating total capacity divided by support count as full verification.

quiz.question: 要驗證「反力架與暫態傳力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Reaction frame and temporary load paths"?
options: 核對實際反力點、連接及井體受力圖，利用合格分析或量測檢查分配與變形；臨時工程設計者簽認受力路徑和階段，不以總承載除支點數當完整結構驗證。

處理體總厚度永遠就是地下水能走過的最短路徑。
optionsEn: Check actual reaction points, connections and shaft load paths with qualified analysis or measurements of sharing and movement.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

quiz.explanation: 核對實際反力點、連接及井體受力圖，利用合格分析或量測檢查分配與變形；臨時工程設計者簽認受力路徑和階段，不以總承載除支點數當完整結構驗證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check actual reaction points, connections and shaft load paths with qualified analysis or measurements of sharing and movement; temporary-works designers approve stages rather than treating total capacity divided by support count as full verification. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 反力架與暫態傳力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Reaction frame and temporary load paths: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反力架與暫態傳力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reaction frame and temporary load paths” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單一支點間隙可使其他支點超載，反力架轉動又會把幾何誤差帶到止水介面；如果只看總反力，局部破壞和偏移都可能被掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A gap at one support overloads others, and frame rotation transfers alignment error to the seal interface. Total reaction alone can conceal both localized structural distress and machine displacement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單一支點間隙可使其他支點超載，反力架轉動又會把幾何誤差帶到止水介面；如果只看總反力，局部破壞和偏移都可能被掩蓋。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總反力除支點數就是每個實際支點的真實受力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total reaction divided by support count equals the actual force at every support." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「反力架與暫態傳力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Reaction frame and temporary load paths" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

單一支點間隙可使其他支點超載，反力架轉動又會把幾何誤差帶到止水介面；如果只看總反力，局部破壞和偏移都可能被掩蓋。
井內沒有看見漏水就證明地層不可能向其他空間流失。

A gap at one support overloads others, and frame rotation transfers alignment error to the seal interface.
No visible shaft leakage proves that ground cannot be flowing into other spaces.
quiz.explanation: 單一支點間隙可使其他支點超載，反力架轉動又會把幾何誤差帶到止水介面；如果只看總反力，局部破壞和偏移都可能被掩蓋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A gap at one support overloads others, and frame rotation transfers alignment error to the seal interface. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 觀測鏈與過渡確認：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Observation chains and transition checks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「觀測鏈與過渡確認」如何影響潛盾發進與到達端止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Observation chains and transition checks” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water sealing at shield launch and reception”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 過渡區的量測須同時涵蓋水、土、機器和井體，單一無漏水觀察不能證明沒有地層流失。每項資料要對齊機器位置與階段，讓任何偏離可以回到具體屏障與責任人。 假設6項關鍵觀測中5項有效、1項失聯，有效率83.3%；失聯不能填成正常零值。 井內無明顯漏水可能因水土暫時流向其他空間，單靠肉眼會延遲辨識；資料不同步又會把先後關係倒置，使處置誤對錯誤階段。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「觀測鏈與過渡確認」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Transition monitoring covers water, ground, machine and shaft. No visible leakage alone does not prove absence of ground loss. Align all observations with machine position and stage so deviations map to a barrier and responsible owner. If 5 of an assumed 6 critical observations are valid and 1 is offline, validity is 83.3%; missing data must not be filled as a normal zero. Lack of visible shaft leakage may mean flow is temporarily directed elsewhere, delaying visual detection. Unsynchronized records can reverse event order and direct the response to the wrong transition stage. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Observation chains and transition checks” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「井內沒有看見漏水就證明地層不可能向其他空間流失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible shaft leakage proves that ground cannot be flowing into other spaces." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「觀測鏈與過渡確認」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Observation chains and transition checks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 觀測鏈與過渡確認
knowledge.text: 過渡區的量測須同時涵蓋水、土、機器和井體，單一無漏水觀察不能證明沒有地層流失。每項資料要對齊機器位置與階段，讓任何偏離可以回到具體屏障與責任人。
knowledge.textEn: Transition monitoring covers water, ground, machine and shaft. No visible leakage alone does not prove absence of ground loss.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：井內沒有看見漏水就證明地層不可能向其他空間流失。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible shaft leakage proves that ground cannot be flowing into other spaces. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「觀測鏈與過渡確認」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Observation chains and transition checks" is correct?
options: 井內沒有看見漏水就證明地層不可能向其他空間流失。
資料傳輸延遲就是地層可以安全等待處置的時間。
過渡區的量測須同時涵蓋水、土、機器和井體，單一無漏水觀察不能證明沒有地層流失。
optionsEn: No visible shaft leakage proves that ground cannot be flowing into other spaces.
Data transmission latency is the time the ground can safely wait for intervention.
Transition monitoring covers water, ground, machine and shaft.
quiz.explanation: 過渡區的量測須同時涵蓋水、土、機器和井體，單一無漏水觀察不能證明沒有地層流失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Transition monitoring covers water, ground, machine and shaft. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 觀測鏈與過渡確認：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Observation chains and transition checks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「觀測鏈與過渡確認」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Observation chains and transition checks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設6項關鍵觀測中5項有效、1項失聯，有效率83.3%；失聯不能填成正常零值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 5 of an assumed 6 critical observations are valid and 1 is offline, validity is 83.3%; missing data must not be filled as a normal zero. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以模擬事件演練壓力、流量、濁度、位移和姿態資料的同步比對，核對失聯警報與備援；主管工程師指定每階段必要證據，未取得時依既定計畫處理而非以多數正常通過。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Rehearse synchronized pressure, flow, turbidity, movement and pose using simulated events and verify dropout alarms and backups; engineers define stage-specific evidence, with missing data handled by the approved plan rather than majority-normal voting.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設6項關鍵觀測中5項有效、1項失聯，有效率83.3%；失聯不能填成正常零值。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 5 of an assumed 6 critical observations are valid and 1 is offline, validity is 83.3%; missing data must not be filled as a normal zero.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「觀測鏈與過渡確認」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Observation chains and transition checks", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
最終止水屏障完整就代表過渡階段絕不會出現空檔。
少數高強度處理體試件可以排除所有貫通薄弱通道。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Complete final sealing barriers guarantee no gap during intermediate transitions.
A few strong treated-ground specimens exclude every connected weak pathway.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 觀測鏈與過渡確認：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Observation chains and transition checks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「觀測鏈與過渡確認」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Observation chains and transition checks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以模擬事件演練壓力、流量、濁度、位移和姿態資料的同步比對，核對失聯警報與備援；主管工程師指定每階段必要證據，未取得時依既定計畫處理而非以多數正常通過。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：井內無明顯漏水可能因水土暫時流向其他空間，單靠肉眼會延遲辨識；資料不同步又會把先後關係倒置，使處置誤對錯誤階段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Rehearse synchronized pressure, flow, turbidity, movement and pose using simulated events and verify dropout alarms and backups; engineers define stage-specific evidence, with missing data handled by the approved plan rather than majority-normal voting. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Lack of visible shaft leakage may mean flow is temporarily directed elsewhere, delaying visual detection. Unsynchronized records can reverse event order and direct the response to the wrong transition stage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄觀測鏈與過渡確認的資料來源與適用條件。以模擬事件演練壓力、流量、濁度、位移和姿態資料的同步比對，核對失聯警報與備援；主管工程師指定每階段必要證據，未取得時依既定計畫處理而非以多數正常通過。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for observation chains and transition checks. Rehearse synchronized pressure, flow, turbidity, movement and pose using simulated events and verify dropout alarms and backups; engineers define stage-specific evidence, with missing data handled by the approved plan rather than majority-normal voting.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：井內無明顯漏水可能因水土暫時流向其他空間，單靠肉眼會延遲辨識；資料不同步又會把先後關係倒置，使處置誤對錯誤階段。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Lack of visible shaft leakage may mean flow is temporarily directed elsewhere, delaying visual detection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以模擬事件演練壓力、流量、濁度、位移和姿態資料的同步比對，核對失聯警報與備援；主管工程師指定每階段必要證據，未取得時依既定計畫處理而非以多數正常通過。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：井內無明顯漏水可能因水土暫時流向其他空間，單靠肉眼會延遲辨識；資料不同步又會把先後關係倒置，使處置誤對錯誤階段。
knowledge.textEn: Rehearse synchronized pressure, flow, turbidity, movement and pose using simulated events and verify dropout alarms and backups; engineers define stage-specific evidence, with missing data handled by the approved plan rather than majority-normal voting. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Lack of visible shaft leakage may mean flow is temporarily directed elsewhere, delaying visual detection. Unsynchronized records can reverse event order and direct the response to the wrong transition stage.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄觀測鏈與過渡確認的資料來源與適用條件。以模擬事件演練壓力、流量、濁度、位移和姿態資料的同步比對，核對失聯警報與備援；主管工程師指定每階段必要證據，未取得時依既定計畫處理而非以多數正常通過。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for observation chains and transition checks. Rehearse synchronized pressure, flow, turbidity, movement and pose using simulated events and verify dropout alarms and backups; engineers define stage-specific evidence, with missing data handled by the approved plan rather than majority-normal voting.

quiz.question: 要驗證「觀測鏈與過渡確認」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Observation chains and transition checks"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以模擬事件演練壓力、流量、濁度、位移和姿態資料的同步比對，核對失聯警報與備援；主管工程師指定每階段必要證據，未取得時依既定計畫處理而非以多數正常通過。
平均止水環壓縮正常就能排除偏心造成的局部失去接觸。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Rehearse synchronized pressure, flow, turbidity, movement and pose using simulated events and verify dropout alarms and backups.
Normal mean sealing-ring compression excludes local loss of contact from eccentricity.
quiz.explanation: 以模擬事件演練壓力、流量、濁度、位移和姿態資料的同步比對，核對失聯警報與備援；主管工程師指定每階段必要證據，未取得時依既定計畫處理而非以多數正常通過。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Rehearse synchronized pressure, flow, turbidity, movement and pose using simulated events and verify dropout alarms and backups; engineers define stage-specific evidence, with missing data handled by the approved plan rather than majority-normal voting. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 觀測鏈與過渡確認：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Observation chains and transition checks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「觀測鏈與過渡確認」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Observation chains and transition checks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 井內無明顯漏水可能因水土暫時流向其他空間，單靠肉眼會延遲辨識；資料不同步又會把先後關係倒置，使處置誤對錯誤階段。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Lack of visible shaft leakage may mean flow is temporarily directed elsewhere, delaying visual detection. Unsynchronized records can reverse event order and direct the response to the wrong transition stage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：井內無明顯漏水可能因水土暫時流向其他空間，單靠肉眼會延遲辨識；資料不同步又會把先後關係倒置，使處置誤對錯誤階段。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unsynchronized records can reverse event order and direct the response to the wrong transition stage.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「井內沒有看見漏水就證明地層不可能向其他空間流失。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible shaft leakage proves that ground cannot be flowing into other spaces." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 井內無明顯漏水可能因水土暫時流向其他空間，單靠肉眼會延遲辨識；資料不同步又會把先後關係倒置，使處置誤對錯誤階段。
knowledge.textEn: Lack of visible shaft leakage may mean flow is temporarily directed elsewhere, delaying visual detection. Unsynchronized records can reverse event order and direct the response to the wrong transition stage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「觀測鏈與過渡確認」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Observation chains and transition checks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
資料傳輸延遲就是地層可以安全等待處置的時間。
井內無明顯漏水可能因水土暫時流向其他空間，單靠肉眼會延遲辨識；資料不同步又會把先後關係倒置，使處置誤對錯誤階段。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Data transmission latency is the time the ground can safely wait for intervention.
Lack of visible shaft leakage may mean flow is temporarily directed elsewhere, delaying visual detection.
quiz.explanation: 井內無明顯漏水可能因水土暫時流向其他空間，單靠肉眼會延遲辨識；資料不同步又會把先後關係倒置，使處置誤對錯誤階段。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Lack of visible shaft leakage may mean flow is temporarily directed elsewhere, delaying visual detection. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「停留情境與既定回應」與「介面證據與接管」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hold scenarios and predetermined responses" and "Interface evidence and takeover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 停留情境與既定回應：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hold scenarios and predetermined responses: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停留情境與既定回應」如何影響潛盾發進與到達端止水的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hold scenarios and predetermined responses” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water sealing at shield launch and reception”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 過渡區若停留，材料時間效應、外水與支承狀態仍持續變化，所以停留情境需在事前設計。回應必須由核准專業團隊決定，學徒的角色是理解何種證據使原模型失效，並正確通報。 假設資料更新間隔2 min、傳輸3 min、確認5 min，單次資訊等待尺度10 min；不是允許停留時間。 把資料延遲當成工程可等待時間會混淆量測能力與地層容忍度，長停留下材料變化又可能使原驗證失效；未明示此界線會造成錯誤信心。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停留情境與既定回應」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: During a transition hold, material aging, water loading and support conditions continue changing. Plan such scenarios beforehand, with responses controlled by approved specialists; the learner identifies evidence invalidating the model and communicates it correctly. Assume update interval 2 min, transmission 3 min and confirmation 5 min; information delay totals 10 min, not an allowable hold duration. knowledge.textEn: During a transition hold, material aging, water loading and support conditions continue changing. Plan such scenarios beforehand, with responses controlled by approved specialists; the learner identifies evidence invalidating the model and communicates it correctly.

steps.title: 停留情境與既定回應：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設資料更新間隔2 min、傳輸3 min、確認5 min，單次資訊等待尺度10 min；不是允許停留時間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume update interval 2 min, transmission 3 min and confirmation 5 min; information delay totals 10 min, not an allowable hold duration. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 停留情境與既定回應：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 審查停留期間所需的連續觀測與備援通訊，演練責任人接收、核對和升級流程；正式停留、復工或維護仍依個案核准方案，不能由算例延遲自行制定時間限制。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把資料延遲當成工程可等待時間會混淆量測能力與地層容忍度，長停留下材料變化又可能使原驗證失效；未明示此界線會造成錯誤信心。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review continuous observations and backup communication during holds and rehearse acknowledgment and escalation; stopping, restarting and maintenance remain governed by the approved project plan, not a limit derived from illustrative data latency. steps.instruction: 始發到達完成後仍需查核井口、接縫和鄰近地層的延時反應，過渡成功不等於永久止水自動合格。交接要分開暫時與永久系統，保存屏障變更和量測歷程，讓營運方明白剩餘責任。 假設10項永久交接條件有9項完成，90%不能取代尚未驗證的1項止水介面；逐項審查優先於平均。 臨時密封拆除後若永久接縫尚未完整，原本未漏水的證據已不適用；竣工圖未記處理變更也會讓未來漏水診斷找不到真實介面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「介面證據與接管」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After launch or reception, delayed shaft, joint and ground response still needs review. Evidence of no leakage ceases to apply when temporary seals are removed before permanent joints are complete. Missing treatment changes on as-builts also prevent future diagnosis from locating the real interface. 始發到達完成後仍需查核井口、接縫和鄰近地層的延時反應，過渡成功不等於永久止水自動合格。
最終止水屏障完整就代表過渡階段絕不會出現空檔。
optionsEn: Successful launch or reception proves permanent sealing after temporary barriers are removed.
After launch or reception, delayed shaft, joint and ground response still needs review.
Complete final sealing barriers guarantee no gap during intermediate transitions.
quiz.explanation: 始發到達完成後仍需查核井口、接縫和鄰近地層的延時反應，過渡成功不等於永久止水自動合格。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After launch or reception, delayed shaft, joint and ground response still needs review. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 介面證據與接管：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Interface evidence and takeover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「介面證據與接管」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Interface evidence and takeover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10項永久交接條件有9項完成，90%不能取代尚未驗證的1項止水介面；逐項審查優先於平均。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 9 of an assumed 10 permanent handover conditions are complete, 90% cannot substitute for one unverified sealing interface; individual review takes precedence over the average. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照竣工幾何、永久止水試驗、地層監測和異常處置，將臨時設備移除後的邊界另行確認；土建、設備、地工及業主共同簽認接管條件，不把施工節點完成當全案性能證明。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile as-built geometry, permanent sealing tests, ground monitoring and responses and confirm boundaries after temporary equipment removal; civil, equipment, geotechnical and owner leads jointly approve takeover rather than equating a construction milestone with full performance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「介面證據與接管」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Interface evidence and takeover", which statement holds?
options: 少數高強度處理體試件可以排除所有貫通薄弱通道。
平均止水環壓縮正常就能排除偏心造成的局部失去接觸。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: A few strong treated-ground specimens exclude every connected weak pathway.
Normal mean sealing-ring compression excludes local loss of contact from eccentricity.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.

steps.title: 介面證據與接管：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Interface evidence and takeover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「介面證據與接管」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Interface evidence and takeover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照竣工幾何、永久止水試驗、地層監測和異常處置，將臨時設備移除後的邊界另行確認；土建、設備、地工及業主共同簽認接管條件，不把施工節點完成當全案性能證明。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：臨時密封拆除後若永久接縫尚未完整，原本未漏水的證據已不適用；竣工圖未記處理變更也會讓未來漏水診斷找不到真實介面。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile as-built geometry, permanent sealing tests, ground monitoring and responses and confirm boundaries after temporary equipment removal; civil, equipment, geotechnical and owner leads jointly approve takeover rather than equating a construction milestone with full performance. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Evidence of no leakage ceases to apply when temporary seals are removed before permanent joints are complete. Missing treatment changes on as-builts also prevent future diagnosis from locating the real interface. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄介面證據與接管的資料來源與適用條件。對照竣工幾何、永久止水試驗、地層監測和異常處置，將臨時設備移除後的邊界另行確認；土建、設備、地工及業主共同簽認接管條件，不把施工節點完成當全案性能證明。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for interface evidence and takeover. Reconcile as-built geometry, permanent sealing tests, ground monitoring and responses and confirm boundaries after temporary equipment removal; civil, equipment, geotechnical and owner leads jointly approve takeover rather than equating a construction milestone with full performance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：臨時密封拆除後若永久接縫尚未完整，原本未漏水的證據已不適用；竣工圖未記處理變更也會讓未來漏水診斷找不到真實介面。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Evidence of no leakage ceases to apply when temporary seals are removed before permanent joints are complete. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照竣工幾何、永久止水試驗、地層監測和異常處置，將臨時設備移除後的邊界另行確認；土建、設備、地工及業主共同簽認接管條件，不把施工節點完成當全案性能證明。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：臨時密封拆除後若永久接縫尚未完整，原本未漏水的證據已不適用；竣工圖未記處理變更也會讓未來漏水診斷找不到真實介面。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile as-built geometry, permanent sealing tests, ground monitoring and responses and confirm boundaries after temporary equipment removal; civil, equipment, geotechnical and owner leads jointly approve takeover rather than equating a construction milestone with full performance. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Evidence of no leakage ceases to apply when temporary seals are removed before permanent joints are complete. Missing treatment changes on as-builts also prevent future diagnosis from locating the real interface.

knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄介面證據與接管的資料來源與適用條件。對照竣工幾何、永久止水試驗、地層監測和異常處置，將臨時設備移除後的邊界另行確認；土建、設備、地工及業主共同簽認接管條件，不把施工節點完成當全案性能證明。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for interface evidence and takeover. Reconcile as-built geometry, permanent sealing tests, ground monitoring and responses and confirm boundaries after temporary equipment removal; civil, equipment, geotechnical and owner leads jointly approve takeover rather than equating a construction milestone with full performance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「介面證據與接管」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Interface evidence and takeover"?
options: 對照竣工幾何、永久止水試驗、地層監測和異常處置，將臨時設備移除後的邊界另行確認；土建、設備、地工及業主共同簽認接管條件，不把施工節點完成當全案性能證明。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
總反力除支點數就是每個實際支點的真實受力。
optionsEn: Reconcile as-built geometry, permanent sealing tests, ground monitoring and responses and confirm boundaries after temporary equipment removal.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Total reaction divided by support count equals the actual force at every support.
quiz.explanation: 對照竣工幾何、永久止水試驗、地層監測和異常處置，將臨時設備移除後的邊界另行確認；土建、設備、地工及業主共同簽認接管條件，不把施工節點完成當全案性能證明。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile as-built geometry, permanent sealing tests, ground monitoring and responses and confirm boundaries after temporary equipment removal; civil, equipment, geotechnical and owner leads jointly approve takeover rather than equating a construction milestone with full performance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 介面證據與接管：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Interface evidence and takeover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「介面證據與接管」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Interface evidence and takeover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 臨時密封拆除後若永久接縫尚未完整，原本未漏水的證據已不適用；竣工圖未記處理變更也會讓未來漏水診斷找不到真實介面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Evidence of no leakage ceases to apply when temporary seals are removed before permanent joints are complete. Missing treatment changes on as-builts also prevent future diagnosis from locating the real interface. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：臨時密封拆除後若永久接縫尚未完整，原本未漏水的證據已不適用；竣工圖未記處理變更也會讓未來漏水診斷找不到真實介面。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Missing treatment changes on as-builts also prevent future diagnosis from locating the real interface.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「始發到達成功就代表拆除臨時密封後永久止水也已合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Successful launch or reception proves permanent sealing after temporary barriers are removed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 臨時密封拆除後若永久接縫尚未完整，原本未漏水的證據已不適用；竣工圖未記處理變更也會讓未來漏水診斷找不到真實介面。
knowledge.textEn: Evidence of no leakage ceases to apply when temporary seals are removed before permanent joints are complete. Missing treatment changes on as-builts also prevent future diagnosis from locating the real interface.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「介面證據與接管」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Interface evidence and takeover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
臨時密封拆除後若永久接縫尚未完整，原本未漏水的證據已不適用；竣工圖未記處理變更也會讓未來漏水診斷找不到真實介面。
最終止水屏障完整就代表過渡階段絕不會出現空檔。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Evidence of no leakage ceases to apply when temporary seals are removed before permanent joints are complete.
Complete final sealing barriers guarantee no gap during intermediate transitions.
quiz.explanation: 臨時密封拆除後若永久接縫尚未完整，原本未漏水的證據已不適用；竣工圖未記處理變更也會讓未來漏水診斷找不到真實介面。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Evidence of no leakage ceases to apply when temporary seals are removed before permanent joints are complete. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 潛盾掘進導向控制
summary: 本課聚焦把坐標基準、機身姿態與環片幾何連成可獨立查核的導航鏈。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on link coordinate datum, machine attitude and ring geometry in an independently checkable navigation chain. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設本地點距轉換原點1000 m，尺度錯誤10 ppm產生10 mm位置差；非儀器隨機誤差。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設視距300 m、角度誤差1.5 arcsec，側向尺度300×1.5/206265=2.18 mm；未含設站誤差。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. At an assumed distance 1000 m from a transformation origin, a 10 ppm scale error creates 10 mm position error, not random instrument noise. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume sight distance 300 m and angular error 1.5 arcsec; lateral scale is 300×1.5/206265=2.18 mm, excluding station error. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「控制網與坐標基準」與「方位精度與遠距傳遞」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Control networks and coordinate datum" and "Azimuth precision over distance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 控制網與坐標基準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control networks and coordinate datum: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「控制網與坐標基準」如何影響潛盾掘進導向控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Control networks and coordinate datum” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM alignment guidance and control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 隧道導航從地表控制延伸到洞內測站再到機器目標，任何基準轉換錯誤都會沿鏈傳遞。坐標系、軸向、單位及高程需在同一版本，畫面上的小偏差只有在基準正確時才有意義。 假設本地點距轉換原點1000 m，尺度錯誤10 ppm產生10 mm位置差；非儀器隨機誤差。 原點吻合但尺度或旋轉錯誤可在長距離逐步放大，施工前段看似正常後段才偏離；若更換坐標版本未通知設備端，導航顯示會產生假跳動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「控制網與坐標基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Navigation transfers surface control through underground stations to machine targets, propagating datum errors along the chain. Coordinate frame, axes, units and elevation must share a version; small displayed offsets matter only within the correct datum. At an assumed distance 1000 m from a transformation origin, a 10 ppm scale error creates 10 mm position error, not random instrument noise. A matching origin with wrong scale or rotation diverges over distance, appearing normal early and failing later. An uncommunicated datum revision can also create a false jump on the navigation display. steps.title: 控制網與坐標基準：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設本地點距轉換原點1000 m，尺度錯誤10 ppm產生10 mm位置差；非儀器隨機誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Azimuth precision over distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM alignment guidance and control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長隧道方向誤差會隨距離放大，角度精度與位置精度必須分別規劃。多次測站轉接可能累積相關偏差，單次儀器精度不能直接當作全線貫通精度，需用網平差和獨立方向控制。 假設視距300 m、角度誤差1.5 arcsec，側向尺度300×1.5/206265=2.18 mm；未含設站誤差。 對中誤差或折射若總朝同一側會形成系統曲線偏差，增加相同幾何的測次未必改善；忽略共同偏差可能得到過度樂觀的貫通估計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方位精度與遠距傳遞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Angular error grows into lateral position error along a long tunnel. Assume sight distance 300 m and angular error 1.5 arcsec; lateral scale is 300×1.5/206265=2.18 mm, excluding station error. Consistently directed centering or refraction creates systematic alignment drift that repeating identical geometry may not reduce. Ignoring common bias produces an overly optimistic estimate of eventual breakthrough accuracy. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Azimuth precision over distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
