steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 沿節理剝落會縮小接觸區，顯示壓力可能仍正常但機體持續滑移；若把提高法向力當成通用解答，岩壁破壞可能擴大並干擾推進控制。
knowledge.textEn: Spalling along joints reduces the effective contact. Displayed pressure may look normal while the machine slips. Increasing normal force as a universal remedy may enlarge wall damage and further disturb thrust control.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「撐靴接觸與局部岩壁」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gripper contact and local rock wall" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
摩擦估計比需求大一點便證明反力完全安全。
沿節理剝落會縮小接觸區，顯示壓力可能仍正常但機體持續滑移；若把提高法向力當成通用解答，岩壁破壞可能擴大並干擾推進控制。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A friction estimate slightly above demand proves the reaction system is fully safe.
Spalling along joints reduces the effective contact.
quiz.explanation: 沿節理剝落會縮小接觸區，顯示壓力可能仍正常但機體持續滑移；若把提高法向力當成通用解答，岩壁破壞可能擴大並干擾推進控制。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Spalling along joints reduces the effective contact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「反力摩擦與需求分離」與「襯砌反力與局部承壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Reaction friction versus demand" and "Lining reaction and local bearing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 反力摩擦與需求分離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reaction friction versus demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反力摩擦與需求分離」如何影響雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reaction friction versus demand” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Double-shield hard-rock TBM operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 簡化摩擦模型以法向合力乘假設摩擦係數估算軸向抗滑能力；它只描述一個力學分量，未包含節理剪破、撐靴嵌入或機體扭矩。應先把需求與能力放在同一方向再比較。 假設N=8 MN、摩擦係數μ=0.4，軸向摩擦估計μN=3.2 MN；若假設軸向需求2.8 MN，比值3.2/2.8=1.14，非設計安全係數。 水膜或碎屑改變接觸條件，摩擦能力下降但推進需求未下降；反覆滑移會讓位移與行程計不一致，若只看平均推力就可能忽略失去穩定反力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反力摩擦與需求分離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A simplified friction model multiplies normal force by an assumed coefficient to estimate axial resistance. It represents only one component, excluding joint shear, shoe indentation and machine torque. Demand and resistance must first be resolved in the same direction. Assume N=8 MN and friction coefficient μ=0.4. Estimated axial friction is μN=3.2 MN. Against an assumed demand of 2.8 MN, the ratio is 3.2/2.8=1.14, not a design safety factor. Water films or debris can change contact while thrust demand remains unchanged. Repeated slip produces disagreement between actual motion and ram travel. Mean thrust alone can therefore miss the loss of a dependable reaction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reaction friction versus demand” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「摩擦估計比需求大一點便證明反力完全安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A friction estimate slightly above demand proves the reaction system is fully safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「反力摩擦與需求分離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Reaction friction versus demand”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 反力摩擦與需求分離
knowledge.text: 簡化摩擦模型以法向合力乘假設摩擦係數估算軸向抗滑能力；它只描述一個力學分量，未包含節理剪破、撐靴嵌入或機體扭矩。應先把需求與能力放在同一方向再比較。
knowledge.textEn: A simplified friction model multiplies normal force by an assumed coefficient to estimate axial resistance. It represents only one component, excluding joint shear, shoe indentation and machine torque.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：摩擦估計比需求大一點便證明反力完全安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A friction estimate slightly above demand proves the reaction system is fully safe. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「反力摩擦與需求分離」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Reaction friction versus demand" is correct?
options: 簡化摩擦模型以法向合力乘假設摩擦係數估算軸向抗滑能力；它只描述一個力學分量，未包含節理剪破、撐靴嵌入或機體扭矩。
摩擦估計比需求大一點便證明反力完全安全。
只要總推力相同，岩壁與管片反力模式等效。
optionsEn: A simplified friction model multiplies normal force by an assumed coefficient to estimate axial resistance.
A friction estimate slightly above demand proves the reaction system is fully safe.
Rock reaction and segment reaction are equivalent whenever total thrust is unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 簡化摩擦模型以法向合力乘假設摩擦係數估算軸向抗滑能力；它只描述一個力學分量，未包含節理剪破、撐靴嵌入或機體扭矩。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A simplified friction model multiplies normal force by an assumed coefficient to estimate axial resistance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 反力摩擦與需求分離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reaction friction versus demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反力摩擦與需求分離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reaction friction versus demand” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設N=8 MN、摩擦係數μ=0.4，軸向摩擦估計μN=3.2 MN；若假設軸向需求2.8 MN，比值3.2/2.8=1.14，非設計安全係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume N=8 MN and friction coefficient μ=0.4. Estimated axial friction is μN=3.2 MN. Against an assumed demand of 2.8 MN, the ratio is 3.2/2.8=1.14, not a design safety factor. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同步壓力、行程及機體位移資料確認力的方向和滑移起點，將扭矩改變、接觸狀態及岩壁紀錄一起標註；若計算比值對摩擦係數小幅變動敏感，應提出敏感度表供設計者審查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use synchronized pressure, travel and machine-displacement records to identify force direction and slip onset.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設N=8 MN、摩擦係數μ=0.4，軸向摩擦估計μN=3.2 MN；若假設軸向需求2.8 MN，比值3.2/2.8=1.14，非設計安全係數。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume N=8 MN and friction coefficient μ=0.4. Estimated axial friction is μN=3.2 MN. Against an assumed demand of 2.8 MN, the ratio is 3.2/2.8=1.14, not a design safety factor.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「反力摩擦與需求分離」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Reaction friction versus demand", which statement holds?
options: 停機沒有切削，岩體與盾殼接觸狀態便不變。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
單位體積能耗上升便能唯一反算岩石強度。
optionsEn: Without cutting during a shutdown, ground contact with the shield remains unchanged.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
An increase in energy per excavated volume uniquely determines higher rock strength.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 反力摩擦與需求分離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reaction friction versus demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反力摩擦與需求分離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reaction friction versus demand” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同步壓力、行程及機體位移資料確認力的方向和滑移起點，將扭矩改變、接觸狀態及岩壁紀錄一起標註；若計算比值對摩擦係數小幅變動敏感，應提出敏感度表供設計者審查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use synchronized pressure, travel and machine-displacement records to identify force direction and slip onset. Annotate torque changes, contact condition and wall observations. If the ratio changes materially with a small coefficient variation, provide a sensitivity table for designer review. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把μ的來源和替代範圍列為模型輸入，不允許用觀察到的最大值當永久保證；任何操作模式變更均須設備與地工主管共同審核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record the source and alternative range of μ as model inputs. An observed maximum is not a permanent guarantee. Equipment and geotechnical leads must jointly review any proposed operating-mode change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：水膜或碎屑改變接觸條件，摩擦能力下降但推進需求未下降；反覆滑移會讓位移與行程計不一致，若只看平均推力就可能忽略失去穩定反力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Water films or debris can change contact while thrust demand remains unchanged. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同步壓力、行程及機體位移資料確認力的方向和滑移起點，將扭矩改變、接觸狀態及岩壁紀錄一起標註；若計算比值對摩擦係數小幅變動敏感，應提出敏感度表供設計者審查。
knowledge.textEn: Use synchronized pressure, travel and machine-displacement records to identify force direction and slip onset. Annotate torque changes, contact condition and wall observations. If the ratio changes materially with a small coefficient variation, provide a sensitivity table for designer review.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把μ的來源和替代範圍列為模型輸入，不允許用觀察到的最大值當永久保證；任何操作模式變更均須設備與地工主管共同審核。
knowledge.textEn: Record the source and alternative range of μ as model inputs. An observed maximum is not a permanent guarantee. Equipment and geotechnical leads must jointly review any proposed operating-mode change.

quiz.question: 要驗證「反力摩擦與需求分離」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Reaction friction versus demand"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
資料完整率達九成以上就可忽略剩餘關鍵缺口。
以同步壓力、行程及機體位移資料確認力的方向和滑移起點，將扭矩改變、接觸狀態及岩壁紀錄一起標註；若計算比值對摩擦係數小幅變動敏感，應提出敏感度表供設計者審查。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A completeness rate above ninety percent permits the remaining critical gaps to be ignored.
Use synchronized pressure, travel and machine-displacement records to identify force direction and slip onset.
quiz.explanation: 以同步壓力、行程及機體位移資料確認力的方向和滑移起點，將扭矩改變、接觸狀態及岩壁紀錄一起標註；若計算比值對摩擦係數小幅變動敏感，應提出敏感度表供設計者審查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use synchronized pressure, travel and machine-displacement records to identify force direction and slip onset. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 反力摩擦與需求分離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Reaction friction versus demand: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反力摩擦與需求分離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reaction friction versus demand” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 水膜或碎屑改變接觸條件，摩擦能力下降但推進需求未下降；反覆滑移會讓位移與行程計不一致，若只看平均推力就可能忽略失去穩定反力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Water films or debris can change contact while thrust demand remains unchanged. Repeated slip produces disagreement between actual motion and ram travel. Mean thrust alone can therefore miss the loss of a dependable reaction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：水膜或碎屑改變接觸條件，摩擦能力下降但推進需求未下降；反覆滑移會讓位移與行程計不一致，若只看平均推力就可能忽略失去穩定反力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean thrust alone can therefore miss the loss of a dependable reaction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「摩擦估計比需求大一點便證明反力完全安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A friction estimate slightly above demand proves the reaction system is fully safe." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 水膜或碎屑改變接觸條件，摩擦能力下降但推進需求未下降；反覆滑移會讓位移與行程計不一致，若只看平均推力就可能忽略失去穩定反力。
knowledge.textEn: Water films or debris can change contact while thrust demand remains unchanged. Repeated slip produces disagreement between actual motion and ram travel. Mean thrust alone can therefore miss the loss of a dependable reaction.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「反力摩擦與需求分離」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Reaction friction versus demand" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 水膜或碎屑改變接觸條件，摩擦能力下降但推進需求未下降；反覆滑移會讓位移與行程計不一致，若只看平均推力就可能忽略失去穩定反力。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要總推力相同，岩壁與管片反力模式等效。
optionsEn: Water films or debris can change contact while thrust demand remains unchanged.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Rock reaction and segment reaction are equivalent whenever total thrust is unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 水膜或碎屑改變接觸條件，摩擦能力下降但推進需求未下降；反覆滑移會讓位移與行程計不一致，若只看平均推力就可能忽略失去穩定反力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Water films or debris can change contact while thrust demand remains unchanged. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 襯砌反力與局部承壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lining reaction and local bearing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「襯砌反力與局部承壓」如何影響雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lining reaction and local bearing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Double-shield hard-rock TBM operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 當岩壁反力不足而改由已完成管片承受推力時，力流轉向推靴接觸、管片接縫及環間傳遞。平均分配僅供列帳，實際偏心和缺口會造成個別推靴較大的局部承壓。 假設總推力12 MN由24個推靴平均承擔，各為0.5 MN；每個有效面積0.1 m²，名義承壓0.5/0.1=5 MPa，未檢查管片彎裂。 接縫不平或墊片缺損會使少數管片先受力，局部崩角與裂縫可能在總推力正常時出現；錯把環平均承壓當局部容許值會漏掉脆弱細部。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「襯砌反力與局部承壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When reaction shifts from rock walls to completed segments, the load path moves through thrust shoes, segment joints and ring interfaces. Equal allocation is only an accounting model; eccentricity and gaps can create much higher local bearing under individual shoes. Assume 12 MN shared equally by 24 shoes: each carries 0.5 MN. With effective area 0.1 m² per shoe, nominal bearing is 0.5/0.1=5 MPa. Segment bending and cracking are not checked. Uneven joints or damaged packing can engage only a few segments initially. Corner spalling or cracks may appear at a normal total thrust. Treating ring-average bearing as a local allowable stress misses vulnerable details. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lining reaction and local bearing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要總推力相同，岩壁與管片反力模式等效。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rock reaction and segment reaction are equivalent whenever total thrust is unchanged." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「襯砌反力與局部承壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lining reaction and local bearing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 襯砌反力與局部承壓
knowledge.text: 當岩壁反力不足而改由已完成管片承受推力時，力流轉向推靴接觸、管片接縫及環間傳遞。平均分配僅供列帳，實際偏心和缺口會造成個別推靴較大的局部承壓。
knowledge.textEn: When reaction shifts from rock walls to completed segments, the load path moves through thrust shoes, segment joints and ring interfaces. Equal allocation is only an accounting model; eccentricity and gaps can create much higher local bearing under individual shoes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要總推力相同，岩壁與管片反力模式等效。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rock reaction and segment reaction are equivalent whenever total thrust is unchanged. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「襯砌反力與局部承壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lining reaction and local bearing" is correct?
options: 只要總推力相同，岩壁與管片反力模式等效。
當岩壁反力不足而改由已完成管片承受推力時，力流轉向推靴接觸、管片接縫及環間傳遞。
兩項工序並行後，循環時間等於兩者時間平均。
optionsEn: Rock reaction and segment reaction are equivalent whenever total thrust is unchanged.
When reaction shifts from rock walls to completed segments, the load path moves through thrust shoes, segment joints and ring interfaces.
Once two tasks run concurrently, cycle time equals the average of their durations.
quiz.explanation: 當岩壁反力不足而改由已完成管片承受推力時，力流轉向推靴接觸、管片接縫及環間傳遞。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When reaction shifts from rock walls to completed segments, the load path moves through thrust shoes, segment joints and ring interfaces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 襯砌反力與局部承壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lining reaction and local bearing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「襯砌反力與局部承壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lining reaction and local bearing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總推力12 MN由24個推靴平均承擔，各為0.5 MN；每個有效面積0.1 m²，名義承壓0.5/0.1=5 MPa，未檢查管片彎裂。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 12 MN shared equally by 24 shoes: each carries 0.5 MN. With effective area 0.1 m² per shoe, nominal bearing is 0.5/0.1=5 MPa. Segment bending and cracking are not checked. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對各缸壓力、推靴面積、環號及接縫高差，將最大單靴力和平均力分別繪圖；以裂縫與接觸痕跡記錄驗證均分假設，任何局部損傷須與管片設計者核對而非以平均數消除。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check individual ram pressures, shoe areas, ring IDs and joint offsets.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總推力12 MN由24個推靴平均承擔，各為0.5 MN；每個有效面積0.1 m²，名義承壓0.5/0.1=5 MPa，未檢查管片彎裂。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 12 MN shared equally by 24 shoes: each carries 0.5 MN. With effective area 0.1 m² per shoe, nominal bearing is 0.5/0.1=5 MPa. Segment bending and cracking are not checked.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「襯砌反力與局部承壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lining reaction and local bearing", which statement holds?
options: 左右行程差除以基距所得角度就是核准導向量。
只要利用率相同，不同時間邊界的數據就可直接比較。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Differential travel divided by baseline directly gives the approved steering adjustment.
Equal utilization percentages are directly comparable even when their time boundaries differ.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 襯砌反力與局部承壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lining reaction and local bearing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「襯砌反力與局部承壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lining reaction and local bearing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對各缸壓力、推靴面積、環號及接縫高差，將最大單靴力和平均力分別繪圖；以裂縫與接觸痕跡記錄驗證均分假設，任何局部損傷須與管片設計者核對而非以平均數消除。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check individual ram pressures, shoe areas, ring IDs and joint offsets. Plot maximum shoe force separately from the mean. Crack and contact-mark records test the equal-share assumption; localized damage must be referred to the segment designer rather than averaged away. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：模式切換交接表需列出新的受力構件、有效接觸與核准檢查；管片工程師確認受力條件，設備主管再依正式程序決定可否切換。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A mode-change handover lists the newly loaded components, effective contacts and approved checks. The segment engineer confirms the structural conditions before the equipment lead determines whether a change is permissible under the formal procedure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接縫不平或墊片缺損會使少數管片先受力，局部崩角與裂縫可能在總推力正常時出現；錯把環平均承壓當局部容許值會漏掉脆弱細部。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uneven joints or damaged packing can engage only a few segments initially. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對各缸壓力、推靴面積、環號及接縫高差，將最大單靴力和平均力分別繪圖；以裂縫與接觸痕跡記錄驗證均分假設，任何局部損傷須與管片設計者核對而非以平均數消除。
knowledge.textEn: Check individual ram pressures, shoe areas, ring IDs and joint offsets. Plot maximum shoe force separately from the mean. Crack and contact-mark records test the equal-share assumption; localized damage must be referred to the segment designer rather than averaged away.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 模式切換交接表需列出新的受力構件、有效接觸與核准檢查；管片工程師確認受力條件，設備主管再依正式程序決定可否切換。
knowledge.textEn: A mode-change handover lists the newly loaded components, effective contacts and approved checks. The segment engineer confirms the structural conditions before the equipment lead determines whether a change is permissible under the formal procedure.

quiz.question: 要驗證「襯砌反力與局部承壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lining reaction and local bearing"?
options: 核對各缸壓力、推靴面積、環號及接縫高差，將最大單靴力和平均力分別繪圖；以裂縫與接觸痕跡記錄驗證均分假設，任何局部損傷須與管片設計者核對而非以平均數消除。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
伸縮行程夠長便能無限並行掘進與拼裝。
optionsEn: Check individual ram pressures, shoe areas, ring IDs and joint offsets.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Long telescopic travel allows excavation and assembly to continue concurrently without interruption.
quiz.explanation: 核對各缸壓力、推靴面積、環號及接縫高差，將最大單靴力和平均力分別繪圖；以裂縫與接觸痕跡記錄驗證均分假設，任何局部損傷須與管片設計者核對而非以平均數消除。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check individual ram pressures, shoe areas, ring IDs and joint offsets. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 襯砌反力與局部承壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lining reaction and local bearing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「襯砌反力與局部承壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lining reaction and local bearing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接縫不平或墊片缺損會使少數管片先受力，局部崩角與裂縫可能在總推力正常時出現；錯把環平均承壓當局部容許值會漏掉脆弱細部。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven joints or damaged packing can engage only a few segments initially. Corner spalling or cracks may appear at a normal total thrust. Treating ring-average bearing as a local allowable stress misses vulnerable details. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：接縫不平或墊片缺損會使少數管片先受力，局部崩角與裂縫可能在總推力正常時出現；錯把環平均承壓當局部容許值會漏掉脆弱細部。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating ring-average bearing as a local allowable stress misses vulnerable details.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要總推力相同，岩壁與管片反力模式等效。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rock reaction and segment reaction are equivalent whenever total thrust is unchanged." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接縫不平或墊片缺損會使少數管片先受力，局部崩角與裂縫可能在總推力正常時出現；錯把環平均承壓當局部容許值會漏掉脆弱細部。
knowledge.textEn: Uneven joints or damaged packing can engage only a few segments initially. Corner spalling or cracks may appear at a normal total thrust. Treating ring-average bearing as a local allowable stress misses vulnerable details.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「襯砌反力與局部承壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lining reaction and local bearing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
接縫不平或墊片缺損會使少數管片先受力，局部崩角與裂縫可能在總推力正常時出現；錯把環平均承壓當局部容許值會漏掉脆弱細部。
兩項工序並行後，循環時間等於兩者時間平均。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Uneven joints or damaged packing can engage only a few segments initially.
Once two tasks run concurrently, cycle time equals the average of their durations.
quiz.explanation: 接縫不平或墊片缺損會使少數管片先受力，局部崩角與裂縫可能在總推力正常時出現；錯把環平均承壓當局部容許值會漏掉脆弱細部。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uneven joints or damaged packing can engage only a few segments initially. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「並行工序與關鍵循環」與「盾殼接觸與擠壓阻力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Parallel tasks and critical cycle" and "Shield contact and squeezing resistance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 並行工序與關鍵循環：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Parallel tasks and critical cycle: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「並行工序與關鍵循環」如何影響雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Parallel tasks and critical cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Double-shield hard-rock TBM operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 能同時進行的切削與組環，循環時間受較慢工序控制，而非兩者相加；重新定位等不可重疊工作仍必須另計。後勤供應若不能配合，並行機構本身不會創造有效進尺。 假設切削30 min、組環25 min、定位5 min，每環並行循環max(30,25)+5=35 min；順序循環為60 min，理想時間節省25/60=41.7%。 若把定位時間藏在兩個工序內又相加，會高估等待；反之忽略等料會高估產能。兩種錯帳都使瓶頸判讀偏離實際，設備改善可能被投入錯誤環節。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「並行工序與關鍵循環」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For truly overlapping cutting and ring assembly, the slower activity governs elapsed time rather than their sum. Non-overlapping tasks such as regripping remain additional. Concurrent mechanics cannot produce useful advance when supply logistics fail to match the required rhythm. Assume cutting 30 min, assembly 25 min and regripping 5 min. A parallel cycle is max(30,25)+5=35 min versus 60 min sequentially; ideal time saving is 25/60=41.7%. Hiding regripping inside two activities and then adding both overstates delay, while omitting supply waits overstates output. Either bookkeeping error misidentifies the bottleneck and can direct improvements toward the wrong subsystem. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Parallel tasks and critical cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩項工序並行後，循環時間等於兩者時間平均。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once two tasks run concurrently, cycle time equals the average of their durations." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「並行工序與關鍵循環」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Parallel tasks and critical cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 並行工序與關鍵循環
knowledge.text: 能同時進行的切削與組環，循環時間受較慢工序控制，而非兩者相加；重新定位等不可重疊工作仍必須另計。後勤供應若不能配合，並行機構本身不會創造有效進尺。
knowledge.textEn: For truly overlapping cutting and ring assembly, the slower activity governs elapsed time rather than their sum. Non-overlapping tasks such as regripping remain additional.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩項工序並行後，循環時間等於兩者時間平均。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once two tasks run concurrently, cycle time equals the average of their durations. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「並行工序與關鍵循環」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Parallel tasks and critical cycle" is correct?
options: 兩項工序並行後，循環時間等於兩者時間平均。
停機沒有切削，岩體與盾殼接觸狀態便不變。
能同時進行的切削與組環，循環時間受較慢工序控制，而非兩者相加；重新定位等不可重疊工作仍必須另計。
optionsEn: Once two tasks run concurrently, cycle time equals the average of their durations.
Without cutting during a shutdown, ground contact with the shield remains unchanged.
For truly overlapping cutting and ring assembly, the slower activity governs elapsed time rather than their sum.
quiz.explanation: 能同時進行的切削與組環，循環時間受較慢工序控制，而非兩者相加；重新定位等不可重疊工作仍必須另計。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For truly overlapping cutting and ring assembly, the slower activity governs elapsed time rather than their sum. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 並行工序與關鍵循環：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Parallel tasks and critical cycle: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「並行工序與關鍵循環」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Parallel tasks and critical cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設切削30 min、組環25 min、定位5 min，每環並行循環max(30,25)+5=35 min；順序循環為60 min，理想時間節省25/60=41.7%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume cutting 30 min, assembly 25 min and regripping 5 min. A parallel cycle is max(30,25)+5=35 min versus 60 min sequentially; ideal time saving is 25/60=41.7%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用共同時鐘標註切削、組環、定位、等料和故障事件，抽查同時作業是否真的重疊；將理想循環與完整班次分開比較，統計缺漏不能自動歸入掘進時間，班次主管須簽認事件分類。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Time-stamp cutting, assembly, regripping, waiting and faults using one clock.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設切削30 min、組環25 min、定位5 min，每環並行循環max(30,25)+5=35 min；順序循環為60 min，理想時間節省25/60=41.7%。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume cutting 30 min, assembly 25 min and regripping 5 min. A parallel cycle is max(30,25)+5=35 min versus 60 min sequentially; ideal time saving is 25/60=41.7%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「並行工序與關鍵循環」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Parallel tasks and critical cycle", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
單位體積能耗上升便能唯一反算岩石強度。
資料完整率達九成以上就可忽略剩餘關鍵缺口。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
An increase in energy per excavated volume uniquely determines higher rock strength.
A completeness rate above ninety percent permits the remaining critical gaps to be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 並行工序與關鍵循環：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Parallel tasks and critical cycle: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「並行工序與關鍵循環」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Parallel tasks and critical cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用共同時鐘標註切削、組環、定位、等料和故障事件，抽查同時作業是否真的重疊；將理想循環與完整班次分開比較，統計缺漏不能自動歸入掘進時間，班次主管須簽認事件分類。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Time-stamp cutting, assembly, regripping, waiting and faults using one clock. Verify that claimed concurrent activities actually overlap. Compare the ideal cycle separately from the whole shift; missing records cannot automatically become cutting time, and the shift lead must approve event classifications. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保留原始事件和重疊判定規則，另做組環時間增加的情境分析；改善方案由施工與後勤主管共同核對，不能只報告刀盤切削速度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Preserve raw events and overlap rules, and analyze a longer assembly-duration scenario. Construction and logistics leads jointly review improvements; cutterhead cutting speed alone is not an adequate production report.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把定位時間藏在兩個工序內又相加，會高估等待；反之忽略等料會高估產能。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Hiding regripping inside two activities and then adding both overstates delay, while omitting supply waits overstates output. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Compare the ideal cycle separately from the whole shift; missing records cannot automatically become cutting time, and the shift lead must approve event classifications.

knowledge.textEn: Preserve raw events and overlap rules, and analyze a longer assembly-duration scenario. Construction and logistics leads jointly review improvements; cutterhead cutting speed alone is not an adequate production report.

quiz.question: 要驗證「並行工序與關鍵循環」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Parallel tasks and critical cycle"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
用共同時鐘標註切削、組環、定位、等料和故障事件，抽查同時作業是否真的重疊；將理想循環與完整班次分開比較，統計缺漏不能自動歸入掘進時間，班次主管須簽認事件分類。
完整岩芯強度很高便保證撐靴不會滑移。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Time-stamp cutting, assembly, regripping, waiting and faults using one clock.
High intact-core strength guarantees that grippers cannot slip against the tunnel wall.

quiz.explanationEn: Time-stamp cutting, assembly, regripping, waiting and faults using one clock. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 並行工序與關鍵循環：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Parallel tasks and critical cycle: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「並行工序與關鍵循環」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Parallel tasks and critical cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把定位時間藏在兩個工序內又相加，會高估等待；反之忽略等料會高估產能。兩種錯帳都使瓶頸判讀偏離實際，設備改善可能被投入錯誤環節。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Hiding regripping inside two activities and then adding both overstates delay, while omitting supply waits overstates output. Either bookkeeping error misidentifies the bottleneck and can direct improvements toward the wrong subsystem. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩種錯帳都使瓶頸判讀偏離實際，設備改善可能被投入錯誤環節。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩項工序並行後，循環時間等於兩者時間平均。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once two tasks run concurrently, cycle time equals the average of their durations." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把定位時間藏在兩個工序內又相加，會高估等待；反之忽略等料會高估產能。兩種錯帳都使瓶頸判讀偏離實際，設備改善可能被投入錯誤環節。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「並行工序與關鍵循環」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

停機沒有切削，岩體與盾殼接觸狀態便不變。
若把定位時間藏在兩個工序內又相加，會高估等待；反之忽略等料會高估產能。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Without cutting during a shutdown, ground contact with the shield remains unchanged.
Hiding regripping inside two activities and then adding both overstates delay, while omitting supply waits overstates output.

steps.objective: 說明「盾殼接觸與擠壓阻力」如何影響雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shield contact and squeezing resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Double-shield hard-rock TBM operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 擠壓岩體可能在盾殼周圍建立長距離接觸，摩擦阻力取決於壓力、接觸長度和摩擦係數。圓周均壓假設可示範尺度效應，但實際接觸斑塊及時間演化需要另行分析。 假設D=6 m、接觸L=4 m、p=0.2 MPa、μ=0.3，F=μpπDL=4.52 MN；L變為6 m時F=6.79 MN，均為理想均壓摩擦。 停機期間收斂持續發展，重新啟動需求可能提高而行程減少；把所有阻力增加視為刀具磨耗，會忽略盾殼接觸及夾盾風險的時間效應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「盾殼接觸與擠壓阻力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Squeezing ground can establish contact over a long shield length. Resistance depends on pressure, contact length and friction. Uniform circumferential pressure demonstrates scaling, but real contact patches and their evolution with time require separate analysis. Assume D=6 m, contact length L=4 m, p=0.2 MPa and μ=0.3. Uniform-contact friction is F=μpπDL=4.52 MN; at L=6 m it becomes 6.79 MN. Convergence may continue during downtime, increasing restart demand while travel decreases. Attributing all additional resistance to cutter wear can miss time-dependent shield contact and the associated risk of the shield becoming trapped. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Shield contact and squeezing resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設D=6 m、接觸L=4 m、p=0.2 MPa、μ=0.3，F=μpπDL=4.52 MN；L變為6 m時F=6.79 MN，均為理想均壓摩擦。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume D=6 m, contact length L=4 m, p=0.2 MPa and μ=0.3. Uniform-contact friction is F=μpπDL=4.52 MN; at L=6 m it becomes 6.79 MN. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較停機前後的推力、行程及可用收斂量測，將地層變化與接觸長度的不確定性分列；以多個壓力和摩擦假設計算範圍，不能藉單一推力反算唯一岩壓，需設計者核對可辨識性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare thrust, travel and available convergence observations before and after downtime.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設D=6 m、接觸L=4 m、p=0.2 MPa、μ=0.3，F=μpπDL=4.52 MN；L變為6 m時F=6.79 MN，均為理想均壓摩擦。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume D=6 m, contact length L=4 m, p=0.2 MPa and μ=0.3. Uniform-contact friction is F=μpπDL=4.52 MN; at L=6 m it becomes 6.79 MN.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「盾殼接觸與擠壓阻力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shield contact and squeezing resistance", which statement holds?
options: 只要利用率相同，不同時間邊界的數據就可直接比較。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
伸縮行程夠長便能無限並行掘進與拼裝。
optionsEn: Equal utilization percentages are directly comparable even when their time boundaries differ.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Long telescopic travel allows excavation and assembly to continue concurrently without interruption.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 盾殼接觸與擠壓阻力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shield contact and squeezing resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「盾殼接觸與擠壓阻力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shield contact and squeezing resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較停機前後的推力、行程及可用收斂量測，將地層變化與接觸長度的不確定性分列；以多個壓力和摩擦假設計算範圍，不能藉單一推力反算唯一岩壓，需設計者核對可辨識性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare thrust, travel and available convergence observations before and after downtime. Separate geological change from uncertain contact length. Calculate ranges using several pressure and friction assumptions; a single thrust observation cannot uniquely identify ground pressure, so the designer reviews identifiability. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：停機交接另列收斂趨勢、接觸不確定性與恢復前審查項；若觀測超出原假設，由地工設計者和設備主管檢討後續方案，課堂摩擦值不作啟動命令。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A shutdown handover lists convergence trends, uncertain contact and pre-restart reviews. If observations depart from assumptions, the geotechnical designer and equipment lead reconsider the plan. Classroom friction estimates never serve as restart commands.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：停機期間收斂持續發展，重新啟動需求可能提高而行程減少；把所有阻力增加視為刀具磨耗，會忽略盾殼接觸及夾盾風險的時間效應。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Convergence may continue during downtime, increasing restart demand while travel decreases. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較停機前後的推力、行程及可用收斂量測，將地層變化與接觸長度的不確定性分列；以多個壓力和摩擦假設計算範圍，不能藉單一推力反算唯一岩壓，需設計者核對可辨識性。
knowledge.textEn: Compare thrust, travel and available convergence observations before and after downtime. Separate geological change from uncertain contact length. Calculate ranges using several pressure and friction assumptions; a single thrust observation cannot uniquely identify ground pressure, so the designer reviews identifiability.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 停機交接另列收斂趨勢、接觸不確定性與恢復前審查項；若觀測超出原假設，由地工設計者和設備主管檢討後續方案，課堂摩擦值不作啟動命令。
knowledge.textEn: A shutdown handover lists convergence trends, uncertain contact and pre-restart reviews. If observations depart from assumptions, the geotechnical designer and equipment lead reconsider the plan. Classroom friction estimates never serve as restart commands.

quiz.question: 要驗證「盾殼接觸與擠壓阻力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shield contact and squeezing resistance"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
摩擦估計比需求大一點便證明反力完全安全。
比較停機前後的推力、行程及可用收斂量測，將地層變化與接觸長度的不確定性分列；以多個壓力和摩擦假設計算範圍，不能藉單一推力反算唯一岩壓，需設計者核對可辨識性。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A friction estimate slightly above demand proves the reaction system is fully safe.
Compare thrust, travel and available convergence observations before and after downtime.
quiz.explanation: 比較停機前後的推力、行程及可用收斂量測，將地層變化與接觸長度的不確定性分列；以多個壓力和摩擦假設計算範圍，不能藉單一推力反算唯一岩壓，需設計者核對可辨識性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare thrust, travel and available convergence observations before and after downtime. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 盾殼接觸與擠壓阻力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shield contact and squeezing resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「盾殼接觸與擠壓阻力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shield contact and squeezing resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 停機期間收斂持續發展，重新啟動需求可能提高而行程減少；把所有阻力增加視為刀具磨耗，會忽略盾殼接觸及夾盾風險的時間效應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Convergence may continue during downtime, increasing restart demand while travel decreases. Attributing all additional resistance to cutter wear can miss time-dependent shield contact and the associated risk of the shield becoming trapped. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：停機期間收斂持續發展，重新啟動需求可能提高而行程減少；把所有阻力增加視為刀具磨耗，會忽略盾殼接觸及夾盾風險的時間效應。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Attributing all additional resistance to cutter wear can miss time-dependent shield contact and the associated risk of the shield becoming trapped.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「停機沒有切削，岩體與盾殼接觸狀態便不變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Without cutting during a shutdown, ground contact with the shield remains unchanged." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 停機期間收斂持續發展，重新啟動需求可能提高而行程減少；把所有阻力增加視為刀具磨耗，會忽略盾殼接觸及夾盾風險的時間效應。
knowledge.textEn: Convergence may continue during downtime, increasing restart demand while travel decreases. Attributing all additional resistance to cutter wear can miss time-dependent shield contact and the associated risk of the shield becoming trapped.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「盾殼接觸與擠壓阻力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shield contact and squeezing resistance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 停機期間收斂持續發展，重新啟動需求可能提高而行程減少；把所有阻力增加視為刀具磨耗，會忽略盾殼接觸及夾盾風險的時間效應。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
左右行程差除以基距所得角度就是核准導向量。
optionsEn: Convergence may continue during downtime, increasing restart demand while travel decreases.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Differential travel divided by baseline directly gives the approved steering adjustment.
quiz.explanation: 停機期間收斂持續發展，重新啟動需求可能提高而行程減少；把所有阻力增加視為刀具磨耗，會忽略盾殼接觸及夾盾風險的時間效應。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Convergence may continue during downtime, increasing restart demand while travel decreases. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「姿態差與推力偏心」與「切削能量與岩況判讀」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Attitude difference and thrust eccentricity" and "Cutting energy and ground interpretation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 姿態差與推力偏心：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Attitude difference and thrust eccentricity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「姿態差與推力偏心」如何影響雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Attitude difference and thrust eccentricity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Double-shield hard-rock TBM operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 左右推進不均可形成轉動和偏心反力，但小角度幾何只能描述位移差，不證明周圍岩體允許該姿態。導向評估還要連接盾殼淨空、線形曲率以及後方環體位置。 假設左右量測基距B=5 m、行程差Δ=10 mm=0.010 m，小角θ≈Δ/B=0.002 rad=0.115°；並非允許導向角。 單側行程感測漂移可能被誤判為機體偏航，導致不必要的受力調整；相反，真實偏心若被當作校正問題，管片與盾殼局部接觸會持續累積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「姿態差與推力偏心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Unequal advance can cause rotation and eccentric reaction. Small-angle geometry describes differential movement but does not show that the ground permits the attitude. Steering interpretation must also consider shield clearance, alignment curvature and the positions of completed rings. Assume lateral baseline B=5 m and differential travel Δ=10 mm=0.010 m. The small angle is θ≈Δ/B=0.002 rad=0.115°, not an allowable steering angle. A drifting travel sensor may be mistaken for yaw and prompt unnecessary load changes. Conversely, treating genuine eccentricity as calibration error allows concentrated contact on the shield and segments to persist. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Attitude difference and thrust eccentricity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「左右行程差除以基距所得角度就是核准導向量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Differential travel divided by baseline directly gives the approved steering adjustment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「姿態差與推力偏心」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Attitude difference and thrust eccentricity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 姿態差與推力偏心
knowledge.text: 左右推進不均可形成轉動和偏心反力，但小角度幾何只能描述位移差，不證明周圍岩體允許該姿態。導向評估還要連接盾殼淨空、線形曲率以及後方環體位置。
knowledge.textEn: Unequal advance can cause rotation and eccentric reaction. Small-angle geometry describes differential movement but does not show that the ground permits the attitude.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：左右行程差除以基距所得角度就是核准導向量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Differential travel divided by baseline directly gives the approved steering adjustment. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「姿態差與推力偏心」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Attitude difference and thrust eccentricity" is correct?
options: 左右行程差除以基距所得角度就是核准導向量。
左右推進不均可形成轉動和偏心反力，但小角度幾何只能描述位移差，不證明周圍岩體允許該姿態。
單位體積能耗上升便能唯一反算岩石強度。
optionsEn: Differential travel divided by baseline directly gives the approved steering adjustment.
Unequal advance can cause rotation and eccentric reaction.
An increase in energy per excavated volume uniquely determines higher rock strength.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A drifting travel sensor may be mistaken for yaw and prompt unnecessary load changes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 切削能量與岩況判讀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cutting energy and ground interpretation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「切削能量與岩況判讀」如何影響雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cutting energy and ground interpretation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Double-shield hard-rock TBM operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 機械能與開挖體積的比值可用於比較同一設備在不同環段的表現，但它同時受刀具、岩性、轉速與停機分類影響。比能升高不是岩石強度增加的唯一證據，輸入功率也不等於純破岩功率。 假設平均機械功率800 kW、有效切削0.5 h、開挖40 m³，E/V=800×0.5/40=10 kWh/m³=36 MJ/m³，未扣除各項損失。 把整班用電除以少量進尺會製造虛高比能，掩蓋真正的後勤停頓；若據此推定岩體更硬，磨耗或待機問題便可能被錯誤歸因。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「切削能量與岩況判讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mechanical energy per excavated volume can compare sections on one machine, but cutters, geology, speed and downtime classification all influence it. Higher specific energy is not unique evidence of stronger rock, and input power is not identical to power used in fragmentation. Assume mean mechanical power 800 kW, cutting duration 0.5 h and excavation 40 m³. E/V=800×0.5/40=10 kWh/m³=36 MJ/m³, before separating individual losses. Dividing whole-shift electricity by limited advance creates an artificially high energy index and hides logistics delays. Inferring harder ground from that number can misclassify wear or standby losses as a geological change. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cutting energy and ground interpretation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。

steps.observation: 現場實務：報告明示功率邊界是電力、軸功或估算破岩能，保持跨環比較一致；地質與機械分析分別簽認，避免把統計相關當作獨立因果證明。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: State whether the power boundary is electrical input, shaft work or estimated fragmentation energy, keeping comparisons consistent. Geological and mechanical reviewers sign separately so that statistical association is not treated as independent causal proof.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把整班用電除以少量進尺會製造虛高比能，掩蓋真正的後勤停頓；若據此推定岩體更硬，磨耗或待機問題便可能被錯誤歸因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

quiz.question: 要驗證「切削能量與岩況判讀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 切削能量與岩況判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cutting energy and ground interpretation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「切削能量與岩況判讀」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cutting energy and ground interpretation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把整班用電除以少量進尺會製造虛高比能，掩蓋真正的後勤停頓；若據此推定岩體更硬，磨耗或待機問題便可能被錯誤歸因。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Dividing whole-shift electricity by limited advance creates an artificially high energy index and hides logistics delays. Inferring harder ground from that number can misclassify wear or standby losses as a geological change. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把整班用電除以少量進尺會製造虛高比能，掩蓋真正的後勤停頓；若據此推定岩體更硬，磨耗或待機問題便可能被錯誤歸因。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inferring harder ground from that number can misclassify wear or standby losses as a geological change.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單位體積能耗上升便能唯一反算岩石強度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An increase in energy per excavated volume uniquely determines higher rock strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把整班用電除以少量進尺會製造虛高比能，掩蓋真正的後勤停頓；若據此推定岩體更硬，磨耗或待機問題便可能被錯誤歸因。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「切削能量與岩況判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cutting energy and ground interpretation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要利用率相同，不同時間邊界的數據就可直接比較。
把整班用電除以少量進尺會製造虛高比能，掩蓋真正的後勤停頓；若據此推定岩體更硬，磨耗或待機問題便可能被錯誤歸因。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal utilization percentages are directly comparable even when their time boundaries differ.
Dividing whole-shift electricity by limited advance creates an artificially high energy index and hides logistics delays.
quiz.explanation: 把整班用電除以少量進尺會製造虛高比能，掩蓋真正的後勤停頓；若據此推定岩體更硬，磨耗或待機問題便可能被錯誤歸因。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Dividing whole-shift electricity by limited advance creates an artificially high energy index and hides logistics delays. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「停機利用率與敏感度」與「環號追溯與缺測處理」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Downtime utilization and sensitivity" and "Ring traceability and missing observations": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 停機利用率與敏感度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Downtime utilization and sensitivity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停機利用率與敏感度」如何影響雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Downtime utilization and sensitivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Double-shield hard-rock TBM operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 日進尺等於有效切削速度乘切削時間，不應在已扣停機的時間上再次乘利用率。分開排程時數與有效切削時數，才能比較維修和供料改善的實際作用，也避免重複扣除同一損失。 假設貫入5 mm/rev、2 rev/min、排程20 h/day、利用率0.5，進尺=5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day；利用率0.4時為4.8 m/day。 把有效切削十小時再乘一半利用率會低估進尺，反之將轉動但無進尺列為切削會高估效率；這些定義錯誤會誤導維修投資及工期溝通。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停機利用率與敏感度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Daily advance equals active cutting rate multiplied by actual cutting time. Utilization must not be applied again to hours already excluding downtime. Separating scheduled hours from active hours allows meaningful maintenance and supply comparisons without counting the same loss twice. Assume penetration 5 mm/rev, 2 rev/min, schedule 20 h/day and utilization 0.5. Advance is 5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day; utilization 0.4 gives 4.8 m/day. Multiplying ten already-active hours by one-half utilization understates advance. Counting rotation without progress as useful cutting overstates efficiency. These definition errors can misdirect maintenance investment and communication about schedule expectations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Downtime utilization and sensitivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要利用率相同，不同時間邊界的數據就可直接比較。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal utilization percentages are directly comparable even when their time boundaries differ." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「停機利用率與敏感度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Downtime utilization and sensitivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 停機利用率與敏感度
knowledge.text: 日進尺等於有效切削速度乘切削時間，不應在已扣停機的時間上再次乘利用率。分開排程時數與有效切削時數，才能比較維修和供料改善的實際作用，也避免重複扣除同一損失。
knowledge.textEn: Daily advance equals active cutting rate multiplied by actual cutting time. Utilization must not be applied again to hours already excluding downtime.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要利用率相同，不同時間邊界的數據就可直接比較。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal utilization percentages are directly comparable even when their time boundaries differ. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「停機利用率與敏感度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Downtime utilization and sensitivity" is correct?
options: 日進尺等於有效切削速度乘切削時間，不應在已扣停機的時間上再次乘利用率。
只要利用率相同，不同時間邊界的數據就可直接比較。
資料完整率達九成以上就可忽略剩餘關鍵缺口。
optionsEn: Daily advance equals active cutting rate multiplied by actual cutting time.
Equal utilization percentages are directly comparable even when their time boundaries differ.
A completeness rate above ninety percent permits the remaining critical gaps to be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 日進尺等於有效切削速度乘切削時間，不應在已扣停機的時間上再次乘利用率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Daily advance equals active cutting rate multiplied by actual cutting time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 停機利用率與敏感度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Downtime utilization and sensitivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停機利用率與敏感度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Downtime utilization and sensitivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設貫入5 mm/rev、2 rev/min、排程20 h/day、利用率0.5，進尺=5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day；利用率0.4時為4.8 m/day。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume penetration 5 mm/rev, 2 rev/min, schedule 20 h/day and utilization 0.5. Advance is 5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day; utilization 0.4 gives 4.8 m/day. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以刀盤實際運轉且有有效前進的事件定義切削時間，交叉核對班報與控制系統；分類停機原因並檢查總時數是否等於排程時數，任何重疊分類必須在比較利用率前先釐清。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define cutting time using actual cutterhead activity with useful advance, then reconcile shift reports and control records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設貫入5 mm/rev、2 rev/min、排程20 h/day、利用率0.5，進尺=5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day；利用率0.4時為4.8 m/day。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume penetration 5 mm/rev, 2 rev/min, schedule 20 h/day and utilization 0.5. Advance is 5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day; utilization 0.4 gives 4.8 m/day.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「停機利用率與敏感度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Downtime utilization and sensitivity", which statement holds?
options: 完整岩芯強度很高便保證撐靴不會滑移。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
只要總推力相同，岩壁與管片反力模式等效。
optionsEn: High intact-core strength guarantees that grippers cannot slip against the tunnel wall.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Downtime utilization and sensitivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以刀盤實際運轉且有有效前進的事件定義切削時間，交叉核對班報與控制系統；分類停機原因並檢查總時數是否等於排程時數，任何重疊分類必須在比較利用率前先釐清。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Define cutting time using actual cutterhead activity with useful advance, then reconcile shift reports and control records. Classify delays and check that accounted hours match scheduled hours. Resolve overlapping categories before comparing utilization or attributing improvement to maintenance. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep scheduled time, active time and delay categories as separate handover fields. Supply utilization sensitivity rather than one guaranteed rate. The planning lead evaluates schedule commitments against geological and supply constraints.
