steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying ten already-active hours by one-half utilization understates advance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以刀盤實際運轉且有有效前進的事件定義切削時間，交叉核對班報與控制系統；分類停機原因並檢查總時數是否等於排程時數，任何重疊分類必須在比較利用率前先釐清。
knowledge.textEn: Define cutting time using actual cutterhead activity with useful advance, then reconcile shift reports and control records. Classify delays and check that accounted hours match scheduled hours. Resolve overlapping categories before comparing utilization or attributing improvement to maintenance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件保留排程、有效時間和原因分類三欄，另附利用率敏感度而非單一保證進尺；工期承諾須由計畫主管結合地質與供應限制審定。
knowledge.textEn: Keep scheduled time, active time and delay categories as separate handover fields. Supply utilization sensitivity rather than one guaranteed rate. The planning lead evaluates schedule commitments against geological and supply constraints.

quiz.question: 要驗證「停機利用率與敏感度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Downtime utilization and sensitivity"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
停機沒有切削，岩體與盾殼接觸狀態便不變。
以刀盤實際運轉且有有效前進的事件定義切削時間，交叉核對班報與控制系統；分類停機原因並檢查總時數是否等於排程時數，任何重疊分類必須在比較利用率前先釐清。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Without cutting during a shutdown, ground contact with the shield remains unchanged.
Define cutting time using actual cutterhead activity with useful advance, then reconcile shift reports and control records.
quiz.explanation: 以刀盤實際運轉且有有效前進的事件定義切削時間，交叉核對班報與控制系統；分類停機原因並檢查總時數是否等於排程時數，任何重疊分類必須在比較利用率前先釐清。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Define cutting time using actual cutterhead activity with useful advance, then reconcile shift reports and control records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 停機利用率與敏感度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Downtime utilization and sensitivity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「停機利用率與敏感度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Downtime utilization and sensitivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把有效切削十小時再乘一半利用率會低估進尺，反之將轉動但無進尺列為切削會高估效率；這些定義錯誤會誤導維修投資及工期溝通。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying ten already-active hours by one-half utilization understates advance. Counting rotation without progress as useful cutting overstates efficiency. These definition errors can misdirect maintenance investment and communication about schedule expectations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把有效切削十小時再乘一半利用率會低估進尺，反之將轉動但無進尺列為切削會高估效率；這些定義錯誤會誤導維修投資及工期溝通。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: These definition errors can misdirect maintenance investment and communication about schedule expectations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要利用率相同，不同時間邊界的數據就可直接比較。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal utilization percentages are directly comparable even when their time boundaries differ." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把有效切削十小時再乘一半利用率會低估進尺，反之將轉動但無進尺列為切削會高估效率；這些定義錯誤會誤導維修投資及工期溝通。
knowledge.textEn: Multiplying ten already-active hours by one-half utilization understates advance. Counting rotation without progress as useful cutting overstates efficiency. These definition errors can misdirect maintenance investment and communication about schedule expectations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「停機利用率與敏感度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Downtime utilization and sensitivity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把有效切削十小時再乘一半利用率會低估進尺，反之將轉動但無進尺列為切削會高估效率；這些定義錯誤會誤導維修投資及工期溝通。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
資料完整率達九成以上就可忽略剩餘關鍵缺口。
optionsEn: Multiplying ten already-active hours by one-half utilization understates advance.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A completeness rate above ninety percent permits the remaining critical gaps to be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 把有效切削十小時再乘一半利用率會低估進尺，反之將轉動但無進尺列為切削會高估效率；這些定義錯誤會誤導維修投資及工期溝通。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiplying ten already-active hours by one-half utilization understates advance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 環號追溯與缺測處理：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ring traceability and missing observations: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「環號追溯與缺測處理」如何影響雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ring traceability and missing observations” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Double-shield hard-rock TBM operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 機械、地質與襯砌資料必須透過環號和共同時間串接，才能分辨同一事件前後的因果順序。資料完整率只衡量可追溯程度，不能取代內容正確性；缺測區間更不能默認機器狀態正常。 假設交接要求120個關鍵事件記錄，已驗證114個，完整率114/120=95%；仍有6個未閉合事件，不能以平均完整率取代逐項追查。 環號錯接會把前一環地質套用到後一環載重，產生看似合理但時間錯位的解釋；交接後若只保留彙總圖，原始異常便難以重新核查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環號追溯與缺測處理」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Machine, geological and lining records need ring IDs and a common clock to reconstruct event order. Completeness measures traceability rather than correctness. Missing intervals cannot be presumed normal, particularly when they coincide with mode changes or unusual loading. Assume handover requires 120 critical event records and 114 are verified. Completeness is 114/120=95%, leaving six unresolved events; the average percentage cannot replace investigation of each missing item. A misassigned ring ID links one ring's geology to another ring's loading, creating a plausible but temporally false explanation. Retaining only summary plots after handover makes later reconstruction of the anomaly difficult. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ring traceability and missing observations” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「資料完整率達九成以上就可忽略剩餘關鍵缺口。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A completeness rate above ninety percent permits the remaining critical gaps to be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「環號追溯與缺測處理」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ring traceability and missing observations”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環號追溯與缺測處理
knowledge.text: 機械、地質與襯砌資料必須透過環號和共同時間串接，才能分辨同一事件前後的因果順序。資料完整率只衡量可追溯程度，不能取代內容正確性；缺測區間更不能默認機器狀態正常。
knowledge.textEn: Machine, geological and lining records need ring IDs and a common clock to reconstruct event order. Completeness measures traceability rather than correctness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：資料完整率達九成以上就可忽略剩餘關鍵缺口。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A completeness rate above ninety percent permits the remaining critical gaps to be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環號追溯與缺測處理」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring traceability and missing observations" is correct?
options: 資料完整率達九成以上就可忽略剩餘關鍵缺口。
機械、地質與襯砌資料必須透過環號和共同時間串接，才能分辨同一事件前後的因果順序。

optionsEn: A completeness rate above ninety percent permits the remaining critical gaps to be ignored.
Machine, geological and lining records need ring IDs and a common clock to reconstruct event order.
Long telescopic travel allows excavation and assembly to continue concurrently without interruption.

quiz.explanationEn: Machine, geological and lining records need ring IDs and a common clock to reconstruct event order. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環號追溯與缺測處理：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring traceability and missing observations: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環號追溯與缺測處理」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ring traceability and missing observations” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設交接要求120個關鍵事件記錄，已驗證114個，完整率114/120=95%；仍有6個未閉合事件，不能以平均完整率取代逐項追查。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume handover requires 120 critical event records and 114 are verified. Completeness is 114/120=95%, leaving six unresolved events; the average percentage cannot replace investigation of each missing item. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽查環號、時鐘偏差、原始檔與簽認版本是否可互相回溯，優先檢視模式切換及推力異常附近的缺測；每個未閉合事件列出責任人、替代證據和下一次審查，不把補寫摘要當作原始量測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit ring identifiers, clock offsets, raw files and signed versions for traceability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設交接要求120個關鍵事件記錄，已驗證114個，完整率114/120=95%；仍有6個未閉合事件，不能以平均完整率取代逐項追查。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume handover requires 120 critical event records and 114 are verified. Completeness is 114/120=95%, leaving six unresolved events; the average percentage cannot replace investigation of each missing item.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環號追溯與缺測處理」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ring traceability and missing observations", which statement holds?
options: 摩擦估計比需求大一點便證明反力完全安全。
兩項工序並行後，循環時間等於兩者時間平均。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: A friction estimate slightly above demand proves the reaction system is fully safe.
Once two tasks run concurrently, cycle time equals the average of their durations.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 環號追溯與缺測處理：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ring traceability and missing observations: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環號追溯與缺測處理」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ring traceability and missing observations” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 抽查環號、時鐘偏差、原始檔與簽認版本是否可互相回溯，優先檢視模式切換及推力異常附近的缺測；每個未閉合事件列出責任人、替代證據和下一次審查，不把補寫摘要當作原始量測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit ring identifiers, clock offsets, raw files and signed versions for traceability. Prioritize missing records near mode changes or abnormal thrust. Assign each unresolved event an owner, alternative evidence and review date; a retrospective summary is not an original measurement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將未閉合事件獨立列為交接清單，保存不可覆寫的原始版本與修訂理由；設備、地質和品質負責人共同簽認資料限制後完成交接。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: List unresolved events separately at handover and retain immutable originals with reasons for revisions. Equipment, geological and quality leads jointly acknowledge data limitations before closing the handover record.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：環號錯接會把前一環地質套用到後一環載重，產生看似合理但時間錯位的解釋；交接後若只保留彙總圖，原始異常便難以重新核查。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A misassigned ring ID links one ring's geology to another ring's loading, creating a plausible but temporally false explanation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 抽查環號、時鐘偏差、原始檔與簽認版本是否可互相回溯，優先檢視模式切換及推力異常附近的缺測；每個未閉合事件列出責任人、替代證據和下一次審查，不把補寫摘要當作原始量測。
knowledge.textEn: Audit ring identifiers, clock offsets, raw files and signed versions for traceability. Prioritize missing records near mode changes or abnormal thrust. Assign each unresolved event an owner, alternative evidence and review date; a retrospective summary is not an original measurement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將未閉合事件獨立列為交接清單，保存不可覆寫的原始版本與修訂理由；設備、地質和品質負責人共同簽認資料限制後完成交接。
knowledge.textEn: List unresolved events separately at handover and retain immutable originals with reasons for revisions. Equipment, geological and quality leads jointly acknowledge data limitations before closing the handover record.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環號追溯與缺測處理」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

quiz.explanationEn: Audit ring identifiers, clock offsets, raw files and signed versions for traceability. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 環號錯接會把前一環地質套用到後一環載重，產生看似合理但時間錯位的解釋；交接後若只保留彙總圖，原始異常便難以重新核查。
knowledge.textEn: A misassigned ring ID links one ring's geology to another ring's loading, creating a plausible but temporally false explanation. Retaining only summary plots after handover makes later reconstruction of the anomaly difficult.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環號追溯與缺測處理」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ring traceability and missing observations" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
環號錯接會把前一環地質套用到後一環載重，產生看似合理但時間錯位的解釋；交接後若只保留彙總圖，原始異常便難以重新核查。
伸縮行程夠長便能無限並行掘進與拼裝。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A misassigned ring ID links one ring's geology to another ring's loading, creating a plausible but temporally false explanation.
Long telescopic travel allows excavation and assembly to continue concurrently without interruption.
quiz.explanation: 環號錯接會把前一環地質套用到後一環載重，產生看似合理但時間錯位的解釋；交接後若只保留彙總圖，原始異常便難以重新核查。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A misassigned ring ID links one ring's geology to another ring's loading, creating a plausible but temporally false explanation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐
titleEn: Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs
summary: 敞開式硬岩掘進機依靠撐靴傳遞反力，刀盤後方的岩面可被觀測，但暴露並不等於穩定。本課將岩塊幾何、未支護距離、噴層與錨栓的作用分開建模，再連接收斂、超挖、出碴與資料交接。課程中的梁、重量及時間公式是明示邊界的教學模型，不能據此決定現場進入條件或支護間距。
summaryEn: An open hard-rock TBM reacts through grippers and leaves rock behind the cutterhead available for observation, but exposure is not evidence of stability. This course separates block geometry, unsupported distance, sprayed lining and bolt action, then connects convergence, overbreak, muck handling and handover. Beam, weight and time relations have explicit teaching boundaries; they cannot determine field access conditions or support spacing.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下原創算例針對敞開硬岩掘進後方的暴露跨度、岩塊支護與證據閉合，每個輸入都是教學假設而非地標實測資料。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設塊體體積V=2.4 m³、岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³，重量W=γV=62.4 kN；這不是單一錨栓的需求，也未檢核滑動面。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設支護落後距離6 m、平均有效前進0.8 m/h，時間窗6/0.8=7.5 h；速度降為0.4 m/h時為15 h，非允許自立時間。兩式只回答各自所列的量與邊界，不應把單一平均結果當成整體穩定證明。請另以最不利的幾何、時間或接觸條件代入，分別標示量測誤差和模型偏差；交接記錄須保留原單位、資料日期以及未能確認的條件。
workedExample.textEn: This original worked example examines exposure, block support and evidence closure behind open hard-rock tbms. Every input is a teaching assumption, not a measured value from a landmark. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume block volume V=2.4 m³ and rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³. Weight is W=γV=62.4 kN; this is not an individual bolt demand and does not check a sliding surface. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume support lags 6 m and effective advance averages 0.8 m/h. Exposure time is 6/0.8=7.5 h; at 0.4 m/h it becomes 15 h. These are not allowable stand-up times. Each relation answers only its stated quantity under its stated boundary conditions. A favorable mean value is not proof of overall stability. Recalculate with an adverse geometry, timing or contact condition, distinguishing measurement uncertainty from model error. The handover record must retain original units, observation dates and conditions that remain unverified; the responsible designer decides whether additional evidence is needed.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」與「未支護距離與時間窗」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Crown blocks and self-weight path" and "Unsupported distance and exposure time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 頂拱岩塊與自重路徑：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Crown blocks and self-weight path: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」如何影響敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crown blocks and self-weight path” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩體節理可能切出可移動塊體，其重力由剩餘岩橋、節理摩擦或已核准支護傳遞。僅從岩塊體積可估重量，卻不能證明運動方向與抗力；幾何辨識必須先於支護力的列帳。 假設塊體體積V=2.4 m³、岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³，重量W=γV=62.4 kN；這不是單一錨栓的需求，也未檢核滑動面。 背部節理漏判會低估可移動體積，頂拱外觀完整仍可能有脫離面；若只用正面照片計重，支護討論會建立在錯誤幾何上並低估掉塊後果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Discontinuities can isolate movable blocks whose weight is carried by rock bridges, joint resistance or approved support. Volume estimates weight, but neither movement direction nor resistance. Geometric interpretation must therefore precede any accounting of support force. Assume block volume V=2.4 m³ and rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³. Weight is W=γV=62.4 kN; this is not an individual bolt demand and does not check a sliding surface. Missing a rear discontinuity understates movable volume even when the visible crown appears intact. Weight estimated only from a frontal image can therefore place support discussions on incorrect geometry and understate the consequences of block release. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crown blocks and self-weight path” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「表面沒有明顯裂縫便代表頂拱沒有可移動塊體。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A crown without obvious surface cracks contains no potentially movable rock blocks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Crown blocks and self-weight path”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 頂拱岩塊與自重路徑
knowledge.text: 岩體節理可能切出可移動塊體，其重力由剩餘岩橋、節理摩擦或已核准支護傳遞。僅從岩塊體積可估重量，卻不能證明運動方向與抗力；幾何辨識必須先於支護力的列帳。
knowledge.textEn: Discontinuities can isolate movable blocks whose weight is carried by rock bridges, joint resistance or approved support. Volume estimates weight, but neither movement direction nor resistance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：表面沒有明顯裂縫便代表頂拱沒有可移動塊體。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A crown without obvious surface cracks contains no potentially movable rock blocks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Crown blocks and self-weight path" is correct?
options: 表面沒有明顯裂縫便代表頂拱沒有可移動塊體。
岩體節理可能切出可移動塊體，其重力由剩餘岩橋、節理摩擦或已核准支護傳遞。
機器停止前進就不會增加未支護區的風險。
optionsEn: A crown without obvious surface cracks contains no potentially movable rock blocks.
Discontinuities can isolate movable blocks whose weight is carried by rock bridges, joint resistance or approved support.
Stopping machine advance cannot increase risk within the unsupported region behind it.
quiz.explanation: 岩體節理可能切出可移動塊體，其重力由剩餘岩橋、節理摩擦或已核准支護傳遞。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Discontinuities can isolate movable blocks whose weight is carried by rock bridges, joint resistance or approved support. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 頂拱岩塊與自重路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crown blocks and self-weight path: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crown blocks and self-weight path” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設塊體體積V=2.4 m³、岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³，重量W=γV=62.4 kN；這不是單一錨栓的需求，也未檢核滑動面。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume block volume V=2.4 m³ and rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³. Weight is W=γV=62.4 kN; this is not an individual bolt demand and does not check a sliding surface. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由獲准位置的影像、掃描和地質面誌交叉確認節理方位與塊體輪廓，記錄看不到的背面邊界；比較不同幾何假設對重量及運動可能性的影響，由地質工程師判定需要何種補充證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check images, scans and geological records acquired from approved locations for joint orientation and block outlines.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設塊體體積V=2.4 m³、岩石單位重γ=26 kN/m³，重量W=γV=62.4 kN；這不是單一錨栓的需求，也未檢核滑動面。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume block volume V=2.4 m³ and rock unit weight γ=26 kN/m³. Weight is W=γV=62.4 kN; this is not an individual bolt demand and does not check a sliding surface.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Crown blocks and self-weight path", which statement holds?
options: 噴凝土總量充足便保證每一處厚度與接觸良好。
兩次讀值的平均速率能完整表示區間內變形歷程。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: An adequate total sprayed-concrete quantity guarantees sufficient thickness and contact everywhere.
The average between two readings fully describes deformation throughout the entire interval.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 頂拱岩塊與自重路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crown blocks and self-weight path: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crown blocks and self-weight path” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由獲准位置的影像、掃描和地質面誌交叉確認節理方位與塊體輪廓，記錄看不到的背面邊界；比較不同幾何假設對重量及運動可能性的影響，由地質工程師判定需要何種補充證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check images, scans and geological records acquired from approved locations for joint orientation and block outlines. Record hidden rear boundaries. Compare alternative geometries for their effects on weight and possible motion; the engineering geologist determines what additional evidence is needed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：岩塊圖保留方位、比例尺與不可見區，不以課堂重量安排人員進入；支護與進入條件均由現場授權人員依核准風險程序決定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain orientation, scale and hidden regions on the block map. Do not use the classroom weight to authorize access. Authorized site personnel determine support and entry conditions through the approved risk procedure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：背部節理漏判會低估可移動體積，頂拱外觀完整仍可能有脫離面；若只用正面照片計重，支護討論會建立在錯誤幾何上並低估掉塊後果。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Missing a rear discontinuity understates movable volume even when the visible crown appears intact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 由獲准位置的影像、掃描和地質面誌交叉確認節理方位與塊體輪廓，記錄看不到的背面邊界；比較不同幾何假設對重量及運動可能性的影響，由地質工程師判定需要何種補充證據。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check images, scans and geological records acquired from approved locations for joint orientation and block outlines. Record hidden rear boundaries. Compare alternative geometries for their effects on weight and possible motion; the engineering geologist determines what additional evidence is needed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 岩塊圖保留方位、比例尺與不可見區，不以課堂重量安排人員進入；支護與進入條件均由現場授權人員依核准風險程序決定。
knowledge.textEn: Retain orientation, scale and hidden regions on the block map. Do not use the classroom weight to authorize access. Authorized site personnel determine support and entry conditions through the approved risk procedure.

quiz.question: 要驗證「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Crown blocks and self-weight path"?
options: 由獲准位置的影像、掃描和地質面誌交叉確認節理方位與塊體輪廓，記錄看不到的背面邊界；比較不同幾何假設對重量及運動可能性的影響，由地質工程師判定需要何種補充證據。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
皮帶瞬時額定能力高於切削需求便不可能積碴。
optionsEn: Cross-check images, scans and geological records acquired from approved locations for joint orientation and block outlines.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A belt rating above cutting demand makes muck accumulation impossible under all conditions.
quiz.explanation: 由獲准位置的影像、掃描和地質面誌交叉確認節理方位與塊體輪廓，記錄看不到的背面邊界；比較不同幾何假設對重量及運動可能性的影響，由地質工程師判定需要何種補充證據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check images, scans and geological records acquired from approved locations for joint orientation and block outlines. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 頂拱岩塊與自重路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Crown blocks and self-weight path: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Crown blocks and self-weight path” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 背部節理漏判會低估可移動體積，頂拱外觀完整仍可能有脫離面；若只用正面照片計重，支護討論會建立在錯誤幾何上並低估掉塊後果。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Missing a rear discontinuity understates movable volume even when the visible crown appears intact. Weight estimated only from a frontal image can therefore place support discussions on incorrect geometry and understate the consequences of block release. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：背部節理漏判會低估可移動體積，頂拱外觀完整仍可能有脫離面；若只用正面照片計重，支護討論會建立在錯誤幾何上並低估掉塊後果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Weight estimated only from a frontal image can therefore place support discussions on incorrect geometry and understate the consequences of block release.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「表面沒有明顯裂縫便代表頂拱沒有可移動塊體。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A crown without obvious surface cracks contains no potentially movable rock blocks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 背部節理漏判會低估可移動體積，頂拱外觀完整仍可能有脫離面；若只用正面照片計重，支護討論會建立在錯誤幾何上並低估掉塊後果。
knowledge.textEn: Missing a rear discontinuity understates movable volume even when the visible crown appears intact. Weight estimated only from a frontal image can therefore place support discussions on incorrect geometry and understate the consequences of block release.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Crown blocks and self-weight path" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
背部節理漏判會低估可移動體積，頂拱外觀完整仍可能有脫離面；若只用正面照片計重，支護討論會建立在錯誤幾何上並低估掉塊後果。
機器停止前進就不會增加未支護區的風險。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Missing a rear discontinuity understates movable volume even when the visible crown appears intact.
Stopping machine advance cannot increase risk within the unsupported region behind it.
quiz.explanation: 背部節理漏判會低估可移動體積，頂拱外觀完整仍可能有脫離面；若只用正面照片計重，支護討論會建立在錯誤幾何上並低估掉塊後果。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Missing a rear discontinuity understates movable volume even when the visible crown appears intact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 未支護距離與時間窗：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Unsupported distance and exposure time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「未支護距離與時間窗」如何影響敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unsupported distance and exposure time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 刀盤到首次形成有效支護的距離會產生暴露時間，隨實際前進速度改變。距離相同不代表風險相同，節理塊體、應力剝落與時間相依變形的機制不同，不能只用設備長度代表穩定性。 假設支護落後距離6 m、平均有效前進0.8 m/h，時間窗6/0.8=7.5 h；速度降為0.4 m/h時為15 h，非允許自立時間。 掘進停頓但支護仍落後時，暴露時間持續增加，設備里程卻沒有變化；若監測只依進尺觸發，時間相依變形的惡化便可能被漏掉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「未支護距離與時間窗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The distance from the cutterhead to effective support creates an exposure interval that depends on actual advance speed. Equal distance does not mean equal risk: joint blocks, stress spalling and time-dependent deformation behave differently. Machine geometry alone cannot establish stability. Assume support lags 6 m and effective advance averages 0.8 m/h. Exposure time is 6/0.8=7.5 h; at 0.4 m/h it becomes 15 h. These are not allowable stand-up times. When advance stops while support remains behind, exposure time continues to grow although machine chainage is unchanged. Monitoring triggered solely by distance can miss deterioration driven by time-dependent deformation during that stationary interval. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Unsupported distance and exposure time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「機器停止前進就不會增加未支護區的風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stopping machine advance cannot increase risk within the unsupported region behind it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「未支護距離與時間窗」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Unsupported distance and exposure time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 未支護距離與時間窗
knowledge.text: 刀盤到首次形成有效支護的距離會產生暴露時間，隨實際前進速度改變。距離相同不代表風險相同，節理塊體、應力剝落與時間相依變形的機制不同，不能只用設備長度代表穩定性。
knowledge.textEn: The distance from the cutterhead to effective support creates an exposure interval that depends on actual advance speed. Equal distance does not mean equal risk: joint blocks, stress spalling and time-dependent deformation behave differently.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：機器停止前進就不會增加未支護區的風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stopping machine advance cannot increase risk within the unsupported region behind it. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「未支護距離與時間窗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Unsupported distance and exposure time" is correct?
options: 機器停止前進就不會增加未支護區的風險。
把所有錨栓額定軸力相加就是任意方向的抗力。
刀盤到首次形成有效支護的距離會產生暴露時間，隨實際前進速度改變。
optionsEn: Stopping machine advance cannot increase risk within the unsupported region behind it.
Summing all nominal bolt axial capacities gives resistance in any required direction.
The distance from the cutterhead to effective support creates an exposure interval that depends on actual advance speed.
quiz.explanation: 刀盤到首次形成有效支護的距離會產生暴露時間，隨實際前進速度改變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The distance from the cutterhead to effective support creates an exposure interval that depends on actual advance speed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 未支護距離與時間窗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unsupported distance and exposure time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「未支護距離與時間窗」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Unsupported distance and exposure time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設支護落後距離6 m、平均有效前進0.8 m/h，時間窗6/0.8=7.5 h；速度降為0.4 m/h時為15 h，非允許自立時間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume support lags 6 m and effective advance averages 0.8 m/h. Exposure time is 6/0.8=7.5 h; at 0.4 m/h it becomes 15 h. These are not allowable stand-up times. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用時間標記的掘進里程與支護完成紀錄重建各位置的實際暴露，不以班平均速度代替長停機區間；將地質變化和觀測到的剝落分開標註，與設計假設比較後由支護負責人審查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconstruct actual exposure at each location using time-stamped chainage and support-completion records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設支護落後距離6 m、平均有效前進0.8 m/h，時間窗6/0.8=7.5 h；速度降為0.4 m/h時為15 h，非允許自立時間。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume support lags 6 m and effective advance averages 0.8 m/h. Exposure time is 6/0.8=7.5 h; at 0.4 m/h it becomes 15 h. These are not allowable stand-up times.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「未支護距離與時間窗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Unsupported distance and exposure time", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
梁模型算出的低撓度便證明岩體暴露跨度安全。
出碴車裝載體積減設計體積就是實際超挖量。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
A small calculated beam deflection proves that the exposed rock span is safe.
Loaded muck volume minus design excavation volume directly equals actual ground overbreak.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 未支護距離與時間窗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unsupported distance and exposure time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「未支護距離與時間窗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unsupported distance and exposure time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用時間標記的掘進里程與支護完成紀錄重建各位置的實際暴露，不以班平均速度代替長停機區間；將地質變化和觀測到的剝落分開標註，與設計假設比較後由支護負責人審查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct actual exposure at each location using time-stamped chainage and support-completion records. Do not substitute shift-average speed for long shutdowns. Annotate geological changes and observed spalling separately, then have the support lead compare the history with design assumptions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接同時列出距離與最長暴露時間，停機期間採核准的觀測與審查安排；不得把計算時間當成可容許等待時間或現場進入許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record both distance and maximum exposure time at handover. Use the approved observation and review arrangements during shutdown. Calculated exposure is neither an allowable waiting period nor permission to enter the unsupported region.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：掘進停頓但支護仍落後時，暴露時間持續增加，設備里程卻沒有變化；若監測只依進尺觸發，時間相依變形的惡化便可能被漏掉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: When advance stops while support remains behind, exposure time continues to grow although machine chainage is unchanged. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用時間標記的掘進里程與支護完成紀錄重建各位置的實際暴露，不以班平均速度代替長停機區間；將地質變化和觀測到的剝落分開標註，與設計假設比較後由支護負責人審查。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct actual exposure at each location using time-stamped chainage and support-completion records. Do not substitute shift-average speed for long shutdowns. Annotate geological changes and observed spalling separately, then have the support lead compare the history with design assumptions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接同時列出距離與最長暴露時間，停機期間採核准的觀測與審查安排；不得把計算時間當成可容許等待時間或現場進入許可。
knowledge.textEn: Record both distance and maximum exposure time at handover. Use the approved observation and review arrangements during shutdown. Calculated exposure is neither an allowable waiting period nor permission to enter the unsupported region.

quiz.question: 要驗證「未支護距離與時間窗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Unsupported distance and exposure time"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用時間標記的掘進里程與支護完成紀錄重建各位置的實際暴露，不以班平均速度代替長停機區間；將地質變化和觀測到的剝落分開標註，與設計假設比較後由支護負責人審查。
計算換氣完成時間一到，所有位置便必然安全。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Reconstruct actual exposure at each location using time-stamped chainage and support-completion records.
When the calculated exchange time elapses, every location is necessarily safe to enter.
quiz.explanation: 用時間標記的掘進里程與支護完成紀錄重建各位置的實際暴露，不以班平均速度代替長停機區間；將地質變化和觀測到的剝落分開標註，與設計假設比較後由支護負責人審查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct actual exposure at each location using time-stamped chainage and support-completion records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 掘進停頓但支護仍落後時，暴露時間持續增加，設備里程卻沒有變化；若監測只依進尺觸發，時間相依變形的惡化便可能被漏掉。
knowledge.textEn: When advance stops while support remains behind, exposure time continues to grow although machine chainage is unchanged. Monitoring triggered solely by distance can miss deterioration driven by time-dependent deformation during that stationary interval.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「未支護距離與時間窗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Unsupported distance and exposure time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
把所有錨栓額定軸力相加就是任意方向的抗力。
掘進停頓但支護仍落後時，暴露時間持續增加，設備里程卻沒有變化；若監測只依進尺觸發，時間相依變形的惡化便可能被漏掉。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Summing all nominal bolt axial capacities gives resistance in any required direction.
When advance stops while support remains behind, exposure time continues to grow although machine chainage is unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 掘進停頓但支護仍落後時，暴露時間持續增加，設備里程卻沒有變化；若監測只依進尺觸發，時間相依變形的惡化便可能被漏掉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: When advance stops while support remains behind, exposure time continues to grow although machine chainage is unchanged. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「錨栓方向與抗力分量」與「噴層厚度與局部彎曲」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bolt direction and force component" and "Sprayed-layer thickness and local bending": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 錨栓方向與抗力分量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bolt direction and force component: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「錨栓方向與抗力分量」如何影響敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bolt direction and force component” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 錨栓作用需投影到潛在塊體運動的反方向，幾何偏斜會減少該方向的有效分量。單純加總軸力忽略錨固長度、節理剪動與群體分配，不能取代實際支護系統的驗算。 假設四支錨栓各提供60 kN軸向力，與所需方向夾角30°，合分量4×60×cos30°=207.8 kN；不代表設計容許抗力。 錨栓方向避開預期抗力方向，或錨固終點仍在鬆動塊內，會讓名義軸力無法有效傳回穩定岩體；外觀完好的托板不能排除內部力流中斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「錨栓方向與抗力分量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bolt action must be projected opposite the potential block movement. Oblique geometry reduces the relevant component. Adding axial forces alone ignores anchorage length, joint displacement and group distribution, so it cannot replace checking the actual support system. Assume four bolts each develop 60 kN axially at 30° to the required direction. Their combined component is 4×60×cos30°=207.8 kN, not a design allowable resistance. A bolt may point away from the required resistance or terminate within the moving block. Nominal axial force then fails to reach stable rock effectively. An intact-looking plate does not rule out an interrupted internal load path. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bolt direction and force component” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把所有錨栓額定軸力相加就是任意方向的抗力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Summing all nominal bolt axial capacities gives resistance in any required direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「錨栓方向與抗力分量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bolt direction and force component”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 錨栓方向與抗力分量
knowledge.text: 錨栓作用需投影到潛在塊體運動的反方向，幾何偏斜會減少該方向的有效分量。單純加總軸力忽略錨固長度、節理剪動與群體分配，不能取代實際支護系統的驗算。
knowledge.textEn: Bolt action must be projected opposite the potential block movement. Oblique geometry reduces the relevant component.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：把所有錨栓額定軸力相加就是任意方向的抗力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Summing all nominal bolt axial capacities gives resistance in any required direction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「錨栓方向與抗力分量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bolt direction and force component" is correct?
options: 錨栓作用需投影到潛在塊體運動的反方向，幾何偏斜會減少該方向的有效分量。
把所有錨栓額定軸力相加就是任意方向的抗力。
噴凝土總量充足便保證每一處厚度與接觸良好。
optionsEn: Bolt action must be projected opposite the potential block movement.
Summing all nominal bolt axial capacities gives resistance in any required direction.
An adequate total sprayed-concrete quantity guarantees sufficient thickness and contact everywhere.
quiz.explanation: 錨栓作用需投影到潛在塊體運動的反方向，幾何偏斜會減少該方向的有效分量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Bolt action must be projected opposite the potential block movement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 錨栓方向與抗力分量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bolt direction and force component: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錨栓方向與抗力分量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bolt direction and force component” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設四支錨栓各提供60 kN軸向力，與所需方向夾角30°，合分量4×60×cos30°=207.8 kN；不代表設計容許抗力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume four bolts each develop 60 kN axially at 30° to the required direction. Their combined component is 4×60×cos30°=207.8 kN, not a design allowable resistance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對竣工鑽向、有效錨固區與試驗紀錄，把力方向畫在同一塊體圖上；拉拔試驗只支援其受測條件，不自動證明所有節理下的剪力和群體行為，差異須送支護設計者評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check as-built orientations, effective anchorage zones and test records, drawing force directions on the same block model.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設四支錨栓各提供60 kN軸向力，與所需方向夾角30°，合分量4×60×cos30°=207.8 kN；不代表設計容許抗力。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume four bolts each develop 60 kN axially at 30° to the required direction. Their combined component is 4×60×cos30°=207.8 kN, not a design allowable resistance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「錨栓方向與抗力分量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bolt direction and force component", which statement holds?
options: 兩次讀值的平均速率能完整表示區間內變形歷程。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
皮帶瞬時額定能力高於切削需求便不可能積碴。
optionsEn: The average between two readings fully describes deformation throughout the entire interval.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
A belt rating above cutting demand makes muck accumulation impossible under all conditions.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 錨栓方向與抗力分量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bolt direction and force component: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「錨栓方向與抗力分量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bolt direction and force component” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對竣工鑽向、有效錨固區與試驗紀錄，把力方向畫在同一塊體圖上；拉拔試驗只支援其受測條件，不自動證明所有節理下的剪力和群體行為，差異須送支護設計者評估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check as-built orientations, effective anchorage zones and test records, drawing force directions on the same block model. Pull tests support their tested conditions only; they do not establish shear and group behavior across every joint. The support designer assesses those differences. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：支護圖應標示目標塊體、錨固終點假設與力方向，保留不符合處置紀錄；任何支數或方向變更需設計者核准，課堂分量不作配置指令。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Support drawings identify the target block, assumed anchorage endpoint and force direction, retaining nonconformity records. The designer approves any change in count or orientation; classroom force components are not installation instructions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錨栓方向避開預期抗力方向，或錨固終點仍在鬆動塊內，會讓名義軸力無法有效傳回穩定岩體；外觀完好的托板不能排除內部力流中斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A bolt may point away from the required resistance or terminate within the moving block. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對竣工鑽向、有效錨固區與試驗紀錄，把力方向畫在同一塊體圖上；拉拔試驗只支援其受測條件，不自動證明所有節理下的剪力和群體行為，差異須送支護設計者評估。
knowledge.textEn: Check as-built orientations, effective anchorage zones and test records, drawing force directions on the same block model. Pull tests support their tested conditions only; they do not establish shear and group behavior across every joint. The support designer assesses those differences.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 支護圖應標示目標塊體、錨固終點假設與力方向，保留不符合處置紀錄；任何支數或方向變更需設計者核准，課堂分量不作配置指令。
knowledge.textEn: Support drawings identify the target block, assumed anchorage endpoint and force direction, retaining nonconformity records. The designer approves any change in count or orientation; classroom force components are not installation instructions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「錨栓方向與抗力分量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bolt direction and force component"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
抽驗比例夠高就無須檢查樣本的位置分布。
核對竣工鑽向、有效錨固區與試驗紀錄，把力方向畫在同一塊體圖上；拉拔試驗只支援其受測條件，不自動證明所有節理下的剪力和群體行為，差異須送支護設計者評估。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A sufficiently high sampling fraction removes the need to examine where samples were taken.
Check as-built orientations, effective anchorage zones and test records, drawing force directions on the same block model.
quiz.explanation: 核對竣工鑽向、有效錨固區與試驗紀錄，把力方向畫在同一塊體圖上；拉拔試驗只支援其受測條件，不自動證明所有節理下的剪力和群體行為，差異須送支護設計者評估。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check as-built orientations, effective anchorage zones and test records, drawing force directions on the same block model. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 錨栓方向與抗力分量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bolt direction and force component: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錨栓方向與抗力分量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bolt direction and force component” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錨栓方向避開預期抗力方向，或錨固終點仍在鬆動塊內，會讓名義軸力無法有效傳回穩定岩體；外觀完好的托板不能排除內部力流中斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A bolt may point away from the required resistance or terminate within the moving block. Nominal axial force then fails to reach stable rock effectively. An intact-looking plate does not rule out an interrupted internal load path. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：錨栓方向避開預期抗力方向，或錨固終點仍在鬆動塊內，會讓名義軸力無法有效傳回穩定岩體；外觀完好的托板不能排除內部力流中斷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An intact-looking plate does not rule out an interrupted internal load path.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「把所有錨栓額定軸力相加就是任意方向的抗力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Summing all nominal bolt axial capacities gives resistance in any required direction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 錨栓方向避開預期抗力方向，或錨固終點仍在鬆動塊內，會讓名義軸力無法有效傳回穩定岩體；外觀完好的托板不能排除內部力流中斷。
knowledge.textEn: A bolt may point away from the required resistance or terminate within the moving block. Nominal axial force then fails to reach stable rock effectively. An intact-looking plate does not rule out an interrupted internal load path.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「錨栓方向與抗力分量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bolt direction and force component" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 錨栓方向避開預期抗力方向，或錨固終點仍在鬆動塊內，會讓名義軸力無法有效傳回穩定岩體；外觀完好的托板不能排除內部力流中斷。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
噴凝土總量充足便保證每一處厚度與接觸良好。
optionsEn: A bolt may point away from the required resistance or terminate within the moving block.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
An adequate total sprayed-concrete quantity guarantees sufficient thickness and contact everywhere.
quiz.explanation: 錨栓方向避開預期抗力方向，或錨固終點仍在鬆動塊內，會讓名義軸力無法有效傳回穩定岩體；外觀完好的托板不能排除內部力流中斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A bolt may point away from the required resistance or terminate within the moving block. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 噴層厚度與局部彎曲：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sprayed-layer thickness and local bending: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「噴層厚度與局部彎曲」如何影響敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.title: 噴層厚度與局部彎曲：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sprayed-layer thickness and local bending: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「噴層厚度與局部彎曲」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sprayed-layer thickness and local bending” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設寬b=1 m、厚t=0.12 m、彎矩M=2 kN·m，彈性應力6M/(bt²)=833 kPa=0.833 MPa；t降至0.10 m時為1.2 MPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume width b=1 m, thickness t=0.12 m and moment M=2 kN·m. Elastic stress 6M/(bt²)=833 kPa=0.833 MPa; reducing t to 0.10 m gives 1.2 MPa. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以核准厚度檢測與表面掃描識別薄區，將基面起伏、回彈及黏結觀察一起記錄；用試驗支持材料早齡和殘餘性質，不能從外表平整推論厚度與背面接觸均勻，薄弱區交設計者評估。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Identify thin zones using approved thickness checks and surface scans, recording substrate relief, rebound and bond observations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 噴層厚度與局部彎曲：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「噴層厚度與局部彎曲」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sprayed-layer thickness and local bending” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以核准厚度檢測與表面掃描識別薄區，將基面起伏、回彈及黏結觀察一起記錄；用試驗支持材料早齡和殘餘性質，不能從外表平整推論厚度與背面接觸均勻，薄弱區交設計者評估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Identify thin zones using approved thickness checks and surface scans, recording substrate relief, rebound and bond observations. Tests must support early-age and residual material behavior. A smooth exposed surface cannot establish uniform thickness or rear contact; the designer assesses weak zones. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：厚度抽驗位置要連結基面異常圖，補強處置保存前後證據；未確認薄區與黏結問題前不得只以追加總噴量完成品質交接。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Tie thickness sampling locations to the substrate anomaly map and retain evidence before and after remediation. Do not close quality handover merely by increasing total sprayed quantity while thin-zone or bond concerns remain unresolved.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：背面空洞使噴層成為小跨梁，薄區應力增大且可能出現網狀裂紋；若只檢核平均噴量，局部厚度不足與失去接觸的影響會被掩蓋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A rear void makes the layer span locally, increasing stress at thin zones and potentially producing a crack network. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「支護滯後的梁式敏感度」與「收斂速率與時間解析」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Beam sensitivity to support lag" and "Convergence rate and time resolution": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支護滯後的梁式敏感度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Beam sensitivity to support lag: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支護滯後的梁式敏感度」如何影響敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Beam sensitivity to support lag” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 簡支梁可用來說明暴露跨度增加的非線性效應，但岩體頂拱不是自動成立的均質梁。保持荷載和剛度不變的比較，只能提示幾何敏感度，不能由撓度公式推定現場可自立距離。 假設均布q=20 kN/m、EI=50000 kN·m²，L=3 m時δ=5qL⁴/(384EI)=0.422 mm；L=4 m時為1.333 mm，為原值3.16倍。 裂隙一旦貫通，原有跨越機制可能轉為塊體運動，線彈性撓度不再是可靠預測；硬套梁模式會把突變誤判為平緩且可外推的趨勢。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護滯後的梁式敏感度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A simply supported beam illustrates nonlinear sensitivity to exposed span, but a rock crown is not automatically a homogeneous beam. Holding load and stiffness fixed isolates geometry. The resulting deflection comparison cannot establish a permissible unsupported length in the field. Assume uniform q=20 kN/m and EI=50000 kN·m². At L=3 m, δ=5qL⁴/(384EI)=0.422 mm; at L=4 m it is 1.333 mm, a factor of 3.16. Once a discontinuity becomes continuous, the mechanism may change from spanning to block movement. Linear-elastic deflection is then unreliable, and forcing the beam model can misrepresent an abrupt change as a smooth trend suitable for extrapolation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Beam sensitivity to support lag” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。

steps.title: 支護滯後的梁式敏感度：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Beam sensitivity to support lag” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設均布q=20 kN/m、EI=50000 kN·m²，L=3 m時δ=5qL⁴/(384EI)=0.422 mm；L=4 m時為1.333 mm，為原值3.16倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform q=20 kN/m and EI=50000 kN·m². At L=3 m, δ=5qL⁴/(384EI)=0.422 mm; at L=4 m it is 1.333 mm, a factor of 3.16. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將量測的暴露長度與頂拱變形時間序列配對，確認支點與連續性假設是否有地質證據；若節理使梁模式不成立，應換用塊體或其他核准模型，不能只調整剛度使曲線貼合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair measured exposure length with crown deformation histories and ask whether support and continuity assumptions have geological evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 將量測的暴露長度與頂拱變形時間序列配對，確認支點與連續性假設是否有地質證據；若節理使梁模式不成立，應換用塊體或其他核准模型，不能只調整剛度使曲線貼合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair measured exposure length with crown deformation histories and ask whether support and continuity assumptions have geological evidence. If joints invalidate beam action, use a block-based or other approved model. Altering stiffness merely to fit a curve is not adequate validation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：模型首頁明示梁式僅供敏感度教學，將不連續面與支承假設另表列出；現場支護間距與步距依設計審查，不以四次方算例直接決定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the beam relation as a sensitivity exercise and list discontinuities and support assumptions separately. Field support spacing and excavation increments follow design review, not a direct decision based on the fourth-power classroom example.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：裂隙一旦貫通，原有跨越機制可能轉為塊體運動，線彈性撓度不再是可靠預測；硬套梁模式會把突變誤判為平緩且可外推的趨勢。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Once a discontinuity becomes continuous, the mechanism may change from spanning to block movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 支護滯後的梁式敏感度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Beam sensitivity to support lag: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支護滯後的梁式敏感度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Beam sensitivity to support lag” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 裂隙一旦貫通，原有跨越機制可能轉為塊體運動，線彈性撓度不再是可靠預測；硬套梁模式會把突變誤判為平緩且可外推的趨勢。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Once a discontinuity becomes continuous, the mechanism may change from spanning to block movement. Linear-elastic deflection is then unreliable, and forcing the beam model can misrepresent an abrupt change as a smooth trend suitable for extrapolation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.objective: 說明「收斂速率與時間解析」如何影響敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Convergence rate and time resolution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相同總收斂若發生於不同時間內，對機制判讀有不同意義；平均速率只描述兩次讀值間的變化，無法揭露中途加速。基準點與量測方向必須穩定，才能把設備附近移動與岩體變形分開。 假設同一測線收斂由8 mm增至11 mm、間隔6 h，平均速率(11-8)/6=0.5 mm/h；若讀值獨立標準差各0.3 mm，差值標準差為0.424 mm。 基準點受到機械震動或自身移動，可能產生假收斂；反覆重設基準又會抹去累積變形，兩者都使趨勢失真並延誤辨識真正的加速。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「收斂速率與時間解析」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Equal total convergence over different intervals has different interpretive meaning. An average rate describes change between two readings but cannot reveal acceleration inside the interval. Stable references and measurement directions are needed to separate nearby equipment movement from ground deformation. Assume convergence rises from 8 to 11 mm over 6 h: mean rate is (11-8)/6=0.5 mm/h. With independent reading standard deviations of 0.3 mm, difference uncertainty is 0.424 mm. A reference affected by machine vibration or movement can produce apparent convergence. Repeatedly resetting it can erase cumulative movement. Both distort the trend and may delay recognition of actual acceleration in the surrounding ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Convergence rate and time resolution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
