steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設同一測線收斂由8 mm增至11 mm、間隔6 h，平均速率(11-8)/6=0.5 mm/h；若讀值獨立標準差各0.3 mm，差值標準差為0.424 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume convergence rises from 8 to 11 mm over 6 h: mean rate is (11-8)/6=0.5 mm/h. With independent reading standard deviations of 0.3 mm, difference uncertainty is 0.424 mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保留測線方向、基準穩定檢查和讀值時間，使用較短間隔資料檢查平均速率是否掩蓋加速；將儀器誤差與施工事件對齊，不以單一超差值診斷失穩，異常由監測與地工負責人共同審查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain line orientation, reference-stability checks and reading times.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設同一測線收斂由8 mm增至11 mm、間隔6 h，平均速率(11-8)/6=0.5 mm/h；若讀值獨立標準差各0.3 mm，差值標準差為0.424 mm。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume convergence rises from 8 to 11 mm over 6 h: mean rate is (11-8)/6=0.5 mm/h. With independent reading standard deviations of 0.3 mm, difference uncertainty is 0.424 mm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「收斂速率與時間解析」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Convergence rate and time resolution", which statement holds?
options: 計算換氣完成時間一到，所有位置便必然安全。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
表面沒有明顯裂縫便代表頂拱沒有可移動塊體。
optionsEn: When the calculated exchange time elapses, every location is necessarily safe to enter.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
A crown without obvious surface cracks contains no potentially movable rock blocks.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 收斂速率與時間解析：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Convergence rate and time resolution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「收斂速率與時間解析」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Convergence rate and time resolution” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留測線方向、基準穩定檢查和讀值時間，使用較短間隔資料檢查平均速率是否掩蓋加速；將儀器誤差與施工事件對齊，不以單一超差值診斷失穩，異常由監測與地工負責人共同審查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain line orientation, reference-stability checks and reading times. Use shorter-interval observations to test whether the mean hides acceleration. Align instrument uncertainty with construction events; a single anomalous value does not diagnose instability and requires monitoring and geotechnical review. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保留原始讀值及任何基準修正，修正前後曲線一起交接；監測門檻與升級回報由專案核准，課堂速率不得充作現場警戒值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain raw readings and every reference correction, handing over both original and corrected histories. The project approves monitoring triggers and escalation; classroom rates must not become field warning thresholds.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基準點受到機械震動或自身移動，可能產生假收斂；反覆重設基準又會抹去累積變形，兩者都使趨勢失真並延誤辨識真正的加速。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A reference affected by machine vibration or movement can produce apparent convergence. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Align instrument uncertainty with construction events; a single anomalous value does not diagnose instability and requires monitoring and geotechnical review.

quiz.question: 要驗證「收斂速率與時間解析」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Convergence rate and time resolution"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
把所有錨栓額定軸力相加就是任意方向的抗力。

Summing all nominal bolt axial capacities gives resistance in any required direction.

quiz.explanationEn: Retain line orientation, reference-stability checks and reading times. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 收斂速率與時間解析：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Convergence rate and time resolution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「收斂速率與時間解析」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Convergence rate and time resolution” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基準點受到機械震動或自身移動，可能產生假收斂；反覆重設基準又會抹去累積變形，兩者都使趨勢失真並延誤辨識真正的加速。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A reference affected by machine vibration or movement can produce apparent convergence. Repeatedly resetting it can erase cumulative movement. Both distort the trend and may delay recognition of actual acceleration in the surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：基準點受到機械震動或自身移動，可能產生假收斂；反覆重設基準又會抹去累積變形，兩者都使趨勢失真並延誤辨識真正的加速。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Both distort the trend and may delay recognition of actual acceleration in the surrounding ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩次讀值的平均速率能完整表示區間內變形歷程。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The average between two readings fully describes deformation throughout the entire interval." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基準點受到機械震動或自身移動，可能產生假收斂；反覆重設基準又會抹去累積變形，兩者都使趨勢失真並延誤辨識真正的加速。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「收斂速率與時間解析」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Convergence rate and time resolution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 基準點受到機械震動或自身移動，可能產生假收斂；反覆重設基準又會抹去累積變形，兩者都使趨勢失真並延誤辨識真正的加速。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
出碴車裝載體積減設計體積就是實際超挖量。
optionsEn: A reference affected by machine vibration or movement can produce apparent convergence.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Loaded muck volume minus design excavation volume directly equals actual ground overbreak.
quiz.explanation: 基準點受到機械震動或自身移動，可能產生假收斂；反覆重設基準又會抹去累積變形，兩者都使趨勢失真並延誤辨識真正的加速。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A reference affected by machine vibration or movement can produce apparent convergence. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「超挖體積與出碴核對」與「運碴能力與積存狀態」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Overbreak volume and muck reconciliation" and "Mucking capacity and accumulation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 超挖體積與出碴核對：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Overbreak volume and muck reconciliation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「超挖體積與出碴核對」如何影響敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Overbreak volume and muck reconciliation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 開挖輪廓超出名義圓形會增加原位體積，但鬆方出碴還受膨鬆和含水影響。先以相同里程的斷面積差計算原位超挖，再討論重量或鬆方資料，避免把不同體積定義直接相減。 假設名義D=6 m、實測等效D=6.1 m、段長L=2 m，超挖V=π(6.1²-6²)×2/4=1.901 m³；這是原位體積而非鬆方。 以膨鬆後體積和設計原位體積比較會製造大量假超挖，掩蓋真正的局部掉塊；相反若任意調整膨鬆係數配平，實際超挖也可能被隱藏。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「超挖體積與出碴核對」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Excavation beyond the nominal circle increases in-situ volume, while loose muck also depends on bulking and water. First calculate in-situ overbreak from cross-sectional differences over matching chainage, then compare mass or loose-volume evidence instead of subtracting unlike quantities. Assume nominal D=6 m, equivalent measured D=6.1 m and length L=2 m. Overbreak is V=π(6.1²-6²)×2/4=1.901 m³ of in-situ ground, not loose muck. Comparing loose volume with design in-situ volume creates false overbreak and can conceal localized block release. Conversely, adjusting the bulking factor solely to balance the accounts can hide genuine additional excavation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Overbreak volume and muck reconciliation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「出碴車裝載體積減設計體積就是實際超挖量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Loaded muck volume minus design excavation volume directly equals actual ground overbreak." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「超挖體積與出碴核對」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Overbreak volume and muck reconciliation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Excavation beyond the nominal circle increases in-situ volume, while loose muck also depends on bulking and water. First calculate in-situ overbreak from cross-sectional differences over matching chainage, then compare mass or loose-volume evidence instead of subtracting unlike quantities.

knowledge.text: 誤解：出碴車裝載體積減設計體積就是實際超挖量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Loaded muck volume minus design excavation volume directly equals actual ground overbreak. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「超挖體積與出碴核對」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 出碴車裝載體積減設計體積就是實際超挖量。
開挖輪廓超出名義圓形會增加原位體積，但鬆方出碴還受膨鬆和含水影響。
皮帶瞬時額定能力高於切削需求便不可能積碴。
optionsEn: Loaded muck volume minus design excavation volume directly equals actual ground overbreak.
Excavation beyond the nominal circle increases in-situ volume, while loose muck also depends on bulking and water.
A belt rating above cutting demand makes muck accumulation impossible under all conditions.
quiz.explanation: 開挖輪廓超出名義圓形會增加原位體積，但鬆方出碴還受膨鬆和含水影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Excavation beyond the nominal circle increases in-situ volume, while loose muck also depends on bulking and water. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.instruction: 將雷射斷面、實際進尺與出碴稱重對準同一段落，對異形輪廓直接積分而非強迫等效圓；含水與膨鬆係數另列來源及範圍，幾何與質量不一致時保留差額供地質和運輸人員核查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 運碴能力與積存狀態：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mucking capacity and accumulation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「運碴能力與積存狀態」如何影響敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mucking capacity and accumulation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 切削產生率高於搬運能力時，中間積存量必然增加，即使兩台設備各自運轉正常。控制體積的物料平衡需要同一乾濕與鬆方基準，暫存容量只能緩衝短期差額而非消除長期瓶頸。 假設同基準鬆方產生率80 m³/h、移除率65 m³/h，持續2 h增加(80-65)×2=30 m³；若可用暫存20 m³，理想填滿時間20/15=1.33 h。 暫存區逐漸接近容量時，回堵會干擾切削和支護動線；只報告瞬時最大皮帶能力會忽略停機與交接損失，使瓶頸在班平均數中被掩蓋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「運碴能力與積存狀態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When generation exceeds removal, intermediate stock grows even if both machines operate normally. A control-volume balance requires consistent moisture and loose-volume definitions. Buffer capacity absorbs temporary mismatch but cannot eliminate a persistent downstream bottleneck. Assume loose-volume generation 80 m³/h and removal 65 m³/h on the same basis. Two hours add 30 m³; a 20 m³ free buffer fills ideally in 20/15=1.33 h. As a buffer approaches capacity, backup can interfere with cutting and support logistics. Reporting only peak belt capability ignores stoppages and transfer losses, hiding the actual bottleneck within otherwise acceptable shift averages. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mucking capacity and accumulation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「皮帶瞬時額定能力高於切削需求便不可能積碴。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A belt rating above cutting demand makes muck accumulation impossible under all conditions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

quiz.question: 關於「運碴能力與積存狀態」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.instruction: 對齊皮帶稱重或流量估計、運輸事件與暫存位置觀察，檢查啟停期間的資料缺口；用累計入出量與實際積存變化核對平衡，若長期偏差存在，先查量測基準而不是假定岩體密度突然改變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize belt weighing or flow estimates, transport events and buffer observations. Check missing data during starts and stops. Compare cumulative inflow minus outflow with observed storage change; investigate measurement bases before attributing a persistent discrepancy to sudden density changes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：班報保存累計曲線及積存估計，運輸與掘進主管共同評估時段差額；任何清理與設備接近均依正式隔離及安全程序，物料平衡不授權作業。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep cumulative curves and storage estimates in shift reports so transport and excavation leads can review interval mismatches together. Clearing and equipment access follow formal isolation and safety procedures; a material balance does not authorize the work.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：暫存區逐漸接近容量時，回堵會干擾切削和支護動線；只報告瞬時最大皮帶能力會忽略停機與交接損失，使瓶頸在班平均數中被掩蓋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: As a buffer approaches capacity, backup can interfere with cutting and support logistics. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「運碴能力與積存狀態」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mucking capacity and accumulation"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
對齊皮帶稱重或流量估計、運輸事件與暫存位置觀察，檢查啟停期間的資料缺口。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Synchronize belt weighing or flow estimates, transport events and buffer observations.
A small calculated beam deflection proves that the exposed rock span is safe.
quiz.explanation: 對齊皮帶稱重或流量估計、運輸事件與暫存位置觀察，檢查啟停期間的資料缺口；用累計入出量與實際積存變化核對平衡，若長期偏差存在，先查量測基準而不是假定岩體密度突然改變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize belt weighing or flow estimates, transport events and buffer observations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 運碴能力與積存狀態：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mucking capacity and accumulation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「運碴能力與積存狀態」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mucking capacity and accumulation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 暫存區逐漸接近容量時，回堵會干擾切削和支護動線；只報告瞬時最大皮帶能力會忽略停機與交接損失，使瓶頸在班平均數中被掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: As a buffer approaches capacity, backup can interfere with cutting and support logistics. Reporting only peak belt capability ignores stoppages and transfer losses, hiding the actual bottleneck within otherwise acceptable shift averages. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：暫存區逐漸接近容量時，回堵會干擾切削和支護動線；只報告瞬時最大皮帶能力會忽略停機與交接損失，使瓶頸在班平均數中被掩蓋。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reporting only peak belt capability ignores stoppages and transfer losses, hiding the actual bottleneck within otherwise acceptable shift averages.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「皮帶瞬時額定能力高於切削需求便不可能積碴。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A belt rating above cutting demand makes muck accumulation impossible under all conditions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 暫存區逐漸接近容量時，回堵會干擾切削和支護動線；只報告瞬時最大皮帶能力會忽略停機與交接損失，使瓶頸在班平均數中被掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: As a buffer approaches capacity, backup can interfere with cutting and support logistics. Reporting only peak belt capability ignores stoppages and transfer losses, hiding the actual bottleneck within otherwise acceptable shift averages.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「運碴能力與積存狀態」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mucking capacity and accumulation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
計算換氣完成時間一到，所有位置便必然安全。
暫存區逐漸接近容量時，回堵會干擾切削和支護動線；只報告瞬時最大皮帶能力會忽略停機與交接損失，使瓶頸在班平均數中被掩蓋。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
When the calculated exchange time elapses, every location is necessarily safe to enter.
As a buffer approaches capacity, backup can interfere with cutting and support logistics.
quiz.explanation: 暫存區逐漸接近容量時，回堵會干擾切削和支護動線；只報告瞬時最大皮帶能力會忽略停機與交接損失，使瓶頸在班平均數中被掩蓋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: As a buffer approaches capacity, backup can interfere with cutting and support logistics. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「環境量測的換氣尺度」與「支護交接與抽驗代表性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation mixing-time scale" and "Support handover and sampling coverage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 環境量測的換氣尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation mixing-time scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「環境量測的換氣尺度」如何影響敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ventilation mixing-time scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想完全混合控制體積的換氣時間可比較風量與空間大小，但隧道實際流場含短路和死角。平均濃度模型不處理局部粉塵峰值、燃燒氣體或緊急情境，因此計算不能取代暴露評估。 假設有效體積V=600 m³、潔淨風量Q=20 m³/s，時間常數τ=V/Q=30 s；無持續污染源時90%衰減需ln(10)τ=69.1 s。 風流短路可能讓出口讀值良好而作業區仍累積污染，平均衰減公式會低估死角清除時間；若據此安排人員接近，模型簡化就被錯當暴露許可。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環境量測的換氣尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An ideal well-mixed volume gives a timescale for comparing airflow and space. Real tunnels contain short circuits and stagnant zones. A mean-concentration model excludes local dust peaks, combustion products and emergency conditions, so it cannot replace an exposure assessment. Assume effective volume V=600 m³ and clean airflow Q=20 m³/s. Time constant τ=V/Q=30 s; with no continuing source, 90% decay requires ln(10)τ=69.1 s. Air short-circuiting can produce a good outlet reading while contaminants persist elsewhere. The average decay model understates clearance in stagnant zones; using it to permit access wrongly turns a simplifying assumption into exposure authorization. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ventilation mixing-time scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「計算換氣完成時間一到，所有位置便必然安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "When the calculated exchange time elapses, every location is necessarily safe to enter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「環境量測的換氣尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ventilation mixing-time scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環境量測的換氣尺度
knowledge.text: 理想完全混合控制體積的換氣時間可比較風量與空間大小，但隧道實際流場含短路和死角。平均濃度模型不處理局部粉塵峰值、燃燒氣體或緊急情境，因此計算不能取代暴露評估。
knowledge.textEn: An ideal well-mixed volume gives a timescale for comparing airflow and space. Real tunnels contain short circuits and stagnant zones.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：計算換氣完成時間一到，所有位置便必然安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: When the calculated exchange time elapses, every location is necessarily safe to enter. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環境量測的換氣尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ventilation mixing-time scale" is correct?
options: 理想完全混合控制體積的換氣時間可比較風量與空間大小，但隧道實際流場含短路和死角。
計算換氣完成時間一到，所有位置便必然安全。
抽驗比例夠高就無須檢查樣本的位置分布。
optionsEn: An ideal well-mixed volume gives a timescale for comparing airflow and space.
When the calculated exchange time elapses, every location is necessarily safe to enter.
A sufficiently high sampling fraction removes the need to examine where samples were taken.
quiz.explanation: 理想完全混合控制體積的換氣時間可比較風量與空間大小，但隧道實際流場含短路和死角。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An ideal well-mixed volume gives a timescale for comparing airflow and space. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環境量測的換氣尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation mixing-time scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環境量測的換氣尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ventilation mixing-time scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設有效體積V=600 m³、潔淨風量Q=20 m³/s，時間常數τ=V/Q=30 s；無持續污染源時90%衰減需ln(10)τ=69.1 s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume effective volume V=600 m³ and clean airflow Q=20 m³/s. Time constant τ=V/Q=30 s; with no continuing source, 90% decay requires ln(10)τ=69.1 s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以核准儀器在多個位置量測風速與相關環境指標，保留位置、設備活動及採樣時間；比較空間差異以檢查完全混合假設，不能只在風管出口量一次就宣稱工作區達到要求。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use approved instruments at multiple locations for velocity and relevant environmental indicators, retaining position, machine activity and sampling time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設有效體積V=600 m³、潔淨風量Q=20 m³/s，時間常數τ=V/Q=30 s；無持續污染源時90%衰減需ln(10)τ=69.1 s。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume effective volume V=600 m³ and clean airflow Q=20 m³/s. Time constant τ=V/Q=30 s; with no continuing source, 90% decay requires ln(10)τ=69.1 s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環境量測的換氣尺度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ventilation mixing-time scale", which statement holds?
options: 機器停止前進就不會增加未支護區的風險。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
噴凝土總量充足便保證每一處厚度與接觸良好。
optionsEn: Stopping machine advance cannot increase risk within the unsupported region behind it.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
An adequate total sprayed-concrete quantity guarantees sufficient thickness and contact everywhere.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以核准儀器在多個位置量測風速與相關環境指標，保留位置、設備活動及採樣時間；比較空間差異以檢查完全混合假設，不能只在風管出口量一次就宣稱工作區達到要求。
knowledge.textEn: Use approved instruments at multiple locations for velocity and relevant environmental indicators, retaining position, machine activity and sampling time. Compare spatial differences to test mixing assumptions. A single reading at a duct outlet cannot demonstrate acceptable conditions across the work area.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把混合模型與實測暴露記錄分開，測點與允收由職業衛生及通風負責人核准；課堂時間僅用於理解尺度，不作人員進入判準。
knowledge.textEn: Separate the mixing model from measured exposure records. Occupational-hygiene and ventilation leads approve sampling locations and acceptance criteria; the classroom time illustrates scale and is not a criterion for personnel entry.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環境量測的換氣尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ventilation mixing-time scale"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩次讀值的平均速率能完整表示區間內變形歷程。
以核准儀器在多個位置量測風速與相關環境指標，保留位置、設備活動及採樣時間；比較空間差異以檢查完全混合假設，不能只在風管出口量一次就宣稱工作區達到要求。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
The average between two readings fully describes deformation throughout the entire interval.
Use approved instruments at multiple locations for velocity and relevant environmental indicators, retaining position, machine activity and sampling time.
quiz.explanation: 以核准儀器在多個位置量測風速與相關環境指標，保留位置、設備活動及採樣時間；比較空間差異以檢查完全混合假設，不能只在風管出口量一次就宣稱工作區達到要求。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use approved instruments at multiple locations for velocity and relevant environmental indicators, retaining position, machine activity and sampling time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 環境量測的換氣尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ventilation mixing-time scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環境量測的換氣尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ventilation mixing-time scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 風流短路可能讓出口讀值良好而作業區仍累積污染，平均衰減公式會低估死角清除時間；若據此安排人員接近，模型簡化就被錯當暴露許可。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Air short-circuiting can produce a good outlet reading while contaminants persist elsewhere. The average decay model understates clearance in stagnant zones; using it to permit access wrongly turns a simplifying assumption into exposure authorization. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：風流短路可能讓出口讀值良好而作業區仍累積污染，平均衰減公式會低估死角清除時間；若據此安排人員接近，模型簡化就被錯當暴露許可。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The average decay model understates clearance in stagnant zones; using it to permit access wrongly turns a simplifying assumption into exposure authorization.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「計算換氣完成時間一到，所有位置便必然安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "When the calculated exchange time elapses, every location is necessarily safe to enter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 風流短路可能讓出口讀值良好而作業區仍累積污染，平均衰減公式會低估死角清除時間；若據此安排人員接近，模型簡化就被錯當暴露許可。
knowledge.textEn: Air short-circuiting can produce a good outlet reading while contaminants persist elsewhere. The average decay model understates clearance in stagnant zones; using it to permit access wrongly turns a simplifying assumption into exposure authorization.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環境量測的換氣尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ventilation mixing-time scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 風流短路可能讓出口讀值良好而作業區仍累積污染，平均衰減公式會低估死角清除時間；若據此安排人員接近，模型簡化就被錯當暴露許可。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
抽驗比例夠高就無須檢查樣本的位置分布。
optionsEn: Air short-circuiting can produce a good outlet reading while contaminants persist elsewhere.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A sufficiently high sampling fraction removes the need to examine where samples were taken.
quiz.explanation: 風流短路可能讓出口讀值良好而作業區仍累積污染，平均衰減公式會低估死角清除時間；若據此安排人員接近，模型簡化就被錯當暴露許可。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Air short-circuiting can produce a good outlet reading while contaminants persist elsewhere. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 支護交接與抽驗代表性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support handover and sampling coverage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支護交接與抽驗代表性」如何影響敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support handover and sampling coverage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 支護品質資料須連回位置、批次和施工時段，抽樣比例本身不能保證代表性。異常地層或停機後的材料批次可能集中產生差異，均勻抽樣與風險導向抽查回答的是不同問題。 假設100個支護記錄中抽驗20個，覆蓋率20%；若10個異常區記錄僅抽1個，異常區覆蓋率為10%，不能由總體20%推定同等覆蓋。 抽驗都落在穩定區而異常區缺資料，整體合格率會給出錯誤信心；若交接又遺失批次與位置關係，後續維修將無法有效定位可能的弱點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護交接與抽驗代表性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Support quality records must link to location, batch and installation interval. Sampling fraction alone does not ensure representativeness. Changed ground or batches used after shutdown can concentrate variation, so uniform sampling and risk-directed inspection answer different questions. Assume 20 of 100 support records are checked: coverage is 20%. If only one of ten anomalous-zone records is checked, that zone has 10% coverage, not the overall 20%. Testing only stable sections while anomalous zones lack records creates misleading confidence in the overall pass rate. Losing batch-location links at handover then prevents maintenance teams from locating the potentially weak areas effectively. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support handover and sampling coverage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抽驗比例夠高就無須檢查樣本的位置分布。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently high sampling fraction removes the need to examine where samples were taken." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支護交接與抽驗代表性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support handover and sampling coverage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支護交接與抽驗代表性
knowledge.text: 支護品質資料須連回位置、批次和施工時段，抽樣比例本身不能保證代表性。異常地層或停機後的材料批次可能集中產生差異，均勻抽樣與風險導向抽查回答的是不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: Support quality records must link to location, batch and installation interval. Sampling fraction alone does not ensure representativeness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：抽驗比例夠高就無須檢查樣本的位置分布。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently high sampling fraction removes the need to examine where samples were taken. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支護交接與抽驗代表性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support handover and sampling coverage" is correct?
options: 抽驗比例夠高就無須檢查樣本的位置分布。
支護品質資料須連回位置、批次和施工時段，抽樣比例本身不能保證代表性。
表面沒有明顯裂縫便代表頂拱沒有可移動塊體。
optionsEn: A sufficiently high sampling fraction removes the need to examine where samples were taken.
Support quality records must link to location, batch and installation interval.
A crown without obvious surface cracks contains no potentially movable rock blocks.
quiz.explanation: 支護品質資料須連回位置、批次和施工時段，抽樣比例本身不能保證代表性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Support quality records must link to location, batch and installation interval. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支護交接與抽驗代表性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Support handover and sampling coverage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支護交接與抽驗代表性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support handover and sampling coverage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設100個支護記錄中抽驗20個，覆蓋率20%；若10個異常區記錄僅抽1個，異常區覆蓋率為10%，不能由總體20%推定同等覆蓋。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 20 of 100 support records are checked: coverage is 20%. If only one of ten anomalous-zone records is checked, that zone has 10% coverage, not the overall 20%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把抽驗位置覆在地質與施工事件圖上，確認資料是否集中於容易接近且條件較好的區段；核對未抽驗區的替代證據，將材料批次、修補和未閉合項目逐一列給品質與設計人員審查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Overlay sampling locations on geological and construction-event maps to detect concentration in accessible, favorable sections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設100個支護記錄中抽驗20個，覆蓋率20%；若10個異常區記錄僅抽1個，異常區覆蓋率為10%，不能由總體20%推定同等覆蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 20 of 100 support records are checked: coverage is 20%. If only one of ten anomalous-zone records is checked, that zone has 10% coverage, not the overall 20%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支護交接與抽驗代表性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Support handover and sampling coverage", which statement holds?
options: 把所有錨栓額定軸力相加就是任意方向的抗力。
梁模型算出的低撓度便證明岩體暴露跨度安全。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Summing all nominal bolt axial capacities gives resistance in any required direction.
A small calculated beam deflection proves that the exposed rock span is safe.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支護交接與抽驗代表性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support handover and sampling coverage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支護交接與抽驗代表性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Support handover and sampling coverage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把抽驗位置覆在地質與施工事件圖上，確認資料是否集中於容易接近且條件較好的區段；核對未抽驗區的替代證據，將材料批次、修補和未閉合項目逐一列給品質與設計人員審查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Overlay sampling locations on geological and construction-event maps to detect concentration in accessible, favorable sections. Review alternative evidence for unsampled zones and list material batches, repairs and unresolved items individually for quality and design assessment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接表同時列覆蓋率、位置偏差與未閉合項，保留原始試驗及修補版本；品質主管與支護設計者確認限制後簽認，百分比不能自行取代批准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The handover lists coverage, location bias and unresolved items together, retaining original tests and repair versions. Quality and support-design leads sign after acknowledging limitations; a percentage cannot substitute for their approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：抽驗都落在穩定區而異常區缺資料，整體合格率會給出錯誤信心；若交接又遺失批次與位置關係，後續維修將無法有效定位可能的弱點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only stable sections while anomalous zones lack records creates misleading confidence in the overall pass rate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Overlay sampling locations on geological and construction-event maps to detect concentration in accessible, favorable sections. Review alternative evidence for unsampled zones and list material batches, repairs and unresolved items individually for quality and design assessment.

knowledge.text: 交接表同時列覆蓋率、位置偏差與未閉合項，保留原始試驗及修補版本；品質主管與支護設計者確認限制後簽認，百分比不能自行取代批准。
knowledge.textEn: The handover lists coverage, location bias and unresolved items together, retaining original tests and repair versions. Quality and support-design leads sign after acknowledging limitations; a percentage cannot substitute for their approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支護交接與抽驗代表性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Support handover and sampling coverage"?
options: 把抽驗位置覆在地質與施工事件圖上，確認資料是否集中於容易接近且條件較好的區段；核對未抽驗區的替代證據，將材料批次、修補和未閉合項目逐一列給品質與設計人員審查。

quiz.explanationEn: Overlay sampling locations on geological and construction-event maps to detect concentration in accessible, favorable sections. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.titleEn: Support handover and sampling coverage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支護交接與抽驗代表性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support handover and sampling coverage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 抽驗都落在穩定區而異常區缺資料，整體合格率會給出錯誤信心；若交接又遺失批次與位置關係，後續維修將無法有效定位可能的弱點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only stable sections while anomalous zones lack records creates misleading confidence in the overall pass rate. Losing batch-location links at handover then prevents maintenance teams from locating the potentially weak areas effectively. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：抽驗都落在穩定區而異常區缺資料，整體合格率會給出錯誤信心；若交接又遺失批次與位置關係，後續維修將無法有效定位可能的弱點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Losing batch-location links at handover then prevents maintenance teams from locating the potentially weak areas effectively.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抽驗比例夠高就無須檢查樣本的位置分布。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sufficiently high sampling fraction removes the need to examine where samples were taken." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 抽驗都落在穩定區而異常區缺資料，整體合格率會給出錯誤信心；若交接又遺失批次與位置關係，後續維修將無法有效定位可能的弱點。
knowledge.textEn: Testing only stable sections while anomalous zones lack records creates misleading confidence in the overall pass rate. Losing batch-location links at handover then prevents maintenance teams from locating the potentially weak areas effectively.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支護交接與抽驗代表性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Support handover and sampling coverage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
抽驗都落在穩定區而異常區缺資料，整體合格率會給出錯誤信心；若交接又遺失批次與位置關係，後續維修將無法有效定位可能的弱點。
表面沒有明顯裂縫便代表頂拱沒有可移動塊體。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Testing only stable sections while anomalous zones lack records creates misleading confidence in the overall pass rate.
A crown without obvious surface cracks contains no potentially movable rock blocks.
quiz.explanation: 抽驗都落在穩定區而異常區缺資料，整體合格率會給出錯誤信心；若交接又遺失批次與位置關係，後續維修將無法有效定位可能的弱點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing only stable sections while anomalous zones lack records creates misleading confidence in the overall pass rate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 隧道分部開挖與支撐
summary: 分部開挖讓土岩的卸載、變形與支護成形交錯發生，最終斷面強度不能單獨說明施工期表現。本課以簡化反力曲線建立概念，再逐項檢視開挖面分割、早齡材料、仰拱閉合、收斂與防水介面。學員需用量測檢查每一個模型的邊界，將適配曲線、工程判斷及正式核准清楚區分。
summaryEn: Sequential excavation interleaves unloading, ground movement and support formation, so final-section strength alone cannot explain construction-stage behavior. The course begins with simplified reaction curves and then examines face subdivision, young materials, invert closure, convergence and waterproofing interfaces. Learners test each model boundary against observations and distinguish curve fitting, engineering judgment and formal authorization.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下原創算例針對分部開挖的地層支護互制、早齡襯砌與觀測回饋，每個輸入都是教學假設而非地標實測資料。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u以mm計，pg=0.6-0.02u MPa、ps=0.01(u-10) MPa且u≥10；相等得u=23.33 mm、p=0.133 MPa，僅為線性示例。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總斷面80 m²分為30、30、20 m²三部分，最大單部面積30/80=37.5%；每次假設進尺1 m時，最大單部原位開挖30 m³。兩式只回答各自所列的量與邊界，不應把單一平均結果當成整體穩定證明。請另以最不利的幾何、時間或接觸條件代入，分別標示量測誤差和模型偏差；交接記錄須保留原單位、資料日期以及未能確認的條件。
workedExample.textEn: This original worked example examines ground-support interaction, early-age lining and observational feedback in sequential excavation. Every input is a teaching assumption, not a measured value from a landmark. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume displacement u in mm, pg=0.6-0.02u MPa and ps=0.01(u-10) MPa for u≥10. Equating them gives u=23.33 mm and p=0.133 MPa, a linear illustration only. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume an 80 m² section divided into 30, 30 and 20 m² parts. The largest part is 30/80=37.5%; at an assumed 1 m increment its in-situ excavation is 30 m³. Each relation answers only its stated quantity under its stated boundary conditions. A favorable mean value is not proof of overall stability. Recalculate with an adverse geometry, timing or contact condition, distinguishing measurement uncertainty from model error. The handover record must retain original units, observation dates and conditions that remain unverified; the responsible designer decides whether additional evidence is needed.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地層支護曲線交點」與「分部面積與暴露尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ground-support curve intersection" and "Subdivided area and exposure scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地層支護曲線交點：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ground-support curve intersection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地層支護曲線交點」如何影響隧道分部開挖與支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ground-support curve intersection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sequential excavation and support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地層釋放變形時需求反力可能下降，已成形支護隨變形提供更多反力；交點代表特定簡化假設下的相容狀態。支護啟用前的位移會改變交點，兩條線並不是天然固定的材料常數。 假設u以mm計，pg=0.6-0.02u MPa、ps=0.01(u-10) MPa且u≥10；相等得u=23.33 mm、p=0.133 MPa，僅為線性示例。 把未觀測的先期變形設為零，會高估支護參與程度並錯估交點；即使後續曲線看似吻合，起始條件錯誤仍可能造成對施工變更的錯誤預測。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地層支護曲線交點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ground reaction demand may decrease as displacement develops, while installed support mobilizes increasing resistance. Their intersection is a compatible state under specified simplifying assumptions. Displacement before installation changes that state; neither line is a universal material constant. Assume displacement u in mm, pg=0.6-0.02u MPa and ps=0.01(u-10) MPa for u≥10. Equating them gives u=23.33 mm and p=0.133 MPa, a linear illustration only. Setting unobserved pre-installation movement to zero can overstate support participation and misplace the intersection. A visually good later fit does not remove that initial-condition error or make predictions of a changed sequence reliable. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ground-support curve intersection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地層與支護曲線一旦相交便證明所有失效均已排除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An intersection of ground and support curves proves every possible failure mode has been excluded." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地層支護曲線交點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ground-support curve intersection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地層支護曲線交點
knowledge.text: 地層釋放變形時需求反力可能下降，已成形支護隨變形提供更多反力；交點代表特定簡化假設下的相容狀態。支護啟用前的位移會改變交點，兩條線並不是天然固定的材料常數。
knowledge.textEn: Ground reaction demand may decrease as displacement develops, while installed support mobilizes increasing resistance. Their intersection is a compatible state under specified simplifying assumptions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：地層與支護曲線一旦相交便證明所有失效均已排除。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An intersection of ground and support curves proves every possible failure mode has been excluded. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地層支護曲線交點」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ground-support curve intersection" is correct?
options: 地層與支護曲線一旦相交便證明所有失效均已排除。
地層釋放變形時需求反力可能下降，已成形支護隨變形提供更多反力；交點代表特定簡化假設下的相容狀態。
把斷面分成三塊就能把所有荷載與風險降為三分之一。
optionsEn: An intersection of ground and support curves proves every possible failure mode has been excluded.
Ground reaction demand may decrease as displacement develops, while installed support mobilizes increasing resistance.
Dividing a section into three parts reduces every load and risk to one third.
quiz.explanation: 地層釋放變形時需求反力可能下降，已成形支護隨變形提供更多反力；交點代表特定簡化假設下的相容狀態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ground reaction demand may decrease as displacement develops, while installed support mobilizes increasing resistance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地層支護曲線交點：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ground-support curve intersection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地層支護曲線交點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ground-support curve intersection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u以mm計，pg=0.6-0.02u MPa、ps=0.01(u-10) MPa且u≥10；相等得u=23.33 mm、p=0.133 MPa，僅為線性示例。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume displacement u in mm, pg=0.6-0.02u MPa and ps=0.01(u-10) MPa for u≥10. Equating them gives u=23.33 mm and p=0.133 MPa, a linear illustration only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將收斂與支護應變資料配對，檢查啟用時間、初始位移和力換算的可辨識性；比較多個初始位移假設的交點，若量測不能區分它們，須保留解的範圍，不把一個最佳擬合當成唯一真實地層。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair convergence and support-strain histories, checking installation time, initial movement and force conversion.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u以mm計，pg=0.6-0.02u MPa、ps=0.01(u-10) MPa且u≥10；相等得u=23.33 mm、p=0.133 MPa，僅為線性示例。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume displacement u in mm, pg=0.6-0.02u MPa and ps=0.01(u-10) MPa for u≥10. Equating them gives u=23.33 mm and p=0.133 MPa, a linear illustration only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地層支護曲線交點」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ground-support curve intersection", which statement holds?
options: 平均應力是壓縮就表示襯砌每個位置都沒有拉裂。
量到的所有應變乘最終彈性模數就是當下內力。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Compressive average stress means that no part of the lining can develop tensile cracking.
All measured strain multiplied by the final elastic modulus gives the current internal force.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地層支護曲線交點：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ground-support curve intersection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地層支護曲線交點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ground-support curve intersection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將收斂與支護應變資料配對，檢查啟用時間、初始位移和力換算的可辨識性；比較多個初始位移假設的交點，若量測不能區分它們，須保留解的範圍，不把一個最佳擬合當成唯一真實地層。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair convergence and support-strain histories, checking installation time, initial movement and force conversion. Compare intersections for alternative initial displacements. If observations cannot distinguish them, retain a range of solutions rather than treating a best fit as the uniquely correct ground response. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每次比較先列出啟用位移、材料齡期與三維效應的處理方式，將模型結果交設計者連同失效模式審查，不能以曲線交點自行批准下一步開挖。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before each comparison, list installation displacement, material age and treatment of three-dimensional effects. The designer reviews the model together with failure modes; an intersection alone cannot authorize the next excavation stage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把未觀測的先期變形設為零，會高估支護參與程度並錯估交點；即使後續曲線看似吻合，起始條件錯誤仍可能造成對施工變更的錯誤預測。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Setting unobserved pre-installation movement to zero can overstate support participation and misplace the intersection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將收斂與支護應變資料配對，檢查啟用時間、初始位移和力換算的可辨識性；比較多個初始位移假設的交點，若量測不能區分它們，須保留解的範圍，不把一個最佳擬合當成唯一真實地層。
knowledge.textEn: Pair convergence and support-strain histories, checking installation time, initial movement and force conversion. Compare intersections for alternative initial displacements. If observations cannot distinguish them, retain a range of solutions rather than treating a best fit as the uniquely correct ground response.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每次比較先列出啟用位移、材料齡期與三維效應的處理方式，將模型結果交設計者連同失效模式審查，不能以曲線交點自行批准下一步開挖。
knowledge.textEn: Before each comparison, list installation displacement, material age and treatment of three-dimensional effects. The designer reviews the model together with failure modes; an intersection alone cannot authorize the next excavation stage.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地層支護曲線交點」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ground-support curve intersection"?
options: 將收斂與支護應變資料配對，檢查啟用時間、初始位移和力換算的可辨識性。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
內表面沒有滴水就表示外側水壓可以忽略。
optionsEn: Pair convergence and support-strain histories, checking installation time, initial movement and force conversion.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A dry inner surface means that external water pressure can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 將收斂與支護應變資料配對，檢查啟用時間、初始位移和力換算的可辨識性；比較多個初始位移假設的交點，若量測不能區分它們，須保留解的範圍，不把一個最佳擬合當成唯一真實地層。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair convergence and support-strain histories, checking installation time, initial movement and force conversion. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地層支護曲線交點：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ground-support curve intersection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地層支護曲線交點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ground-support curve intersection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把未觀測的先期變形設為零，會高估支護參與程度並錯估交點；即使後續曲線看似吻合，起始條件錯誤仍可能造成對施工變更的錯誤預測。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Setting unobserved pre-installation movement to zero can overstate support participation and misplace the intersection. A visually good later fit does not remove that initial-condition error or make predictions of a changed sequence reliable. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把未觀測的先期變形設為零，會高估支護參與程度並錯估交點；即使後續曲線看似吻合，起始條件錯誤仍可能造成對施工變更的錯誤預測。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A visually good later fit does not remove that initial-condition error or make predictions of a changed sequence reliable.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地層與支護曲線一旦相交便證明所有失效均已排除。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An intersection of ground and support curves proves every possible failure mode has been excluded." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把未觀測的先期變形設為零，會高估支護參與程度並錯估交點；即使後續曲線看似吻合，起始條件錯誤仍可能造成對施工變更的錯誤預測。
knowledge.textEn: Setting unobserved pre-installation movement to zero can overstate support participation and misplace the intersection. A visually good later fit does not remove that initial-condition error or make predictions of a changed sequence reliable.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地層支護曲線交點」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ground-support curve intersection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把未觀測的先期變形設為零，會高估支護參與程度並錯估交點；即使後續曲線看似吻合，起始條件錯誤仍可能造成對施工變更的錯誤預測。
把斷面分成三塊就能把所有荷載與風險降為三分之一。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Setting unobserved pre-installation movement to zero can overstate support participation and misplace the intersection.
Dividing a section into three parts reduces every load and risk to one third.
quiz.explanation: 把未觀測的先期變形設為零，會高估支護參與程度並錯估交點；即使後續曲線看似吻合，起始條件錯誤仍可能造成對施工變更的錯誤預測。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Setting unobserved pre-installation movement to zero can overstate support participation and misplace the intersection. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 分部面積與暴露尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Subdivided area and exposure scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分部面積與暴露尺度」如何影響隧道分部開挖與支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Subdivided area and exposure scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sequential excavation and support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分割斷面改變同時暴露的面積與形狀，卻也新增接縫和施工介面。面積減少可能有利於控制某些局部機制，但總斷面與暫時支護仍需共同受力，不能將面積比例直接當作穩定度比例。 假設總斷面80 m²分為30、30、20 m²三部分，最大單部面積30/80=37.5%；每次假設進尺1 m時，最大單部原位開挖30 m³。 相鄰開挖面時間重疊而未更新模型，會形成比圖面預想更大的開放區；局部掉塊或變形增加可能被錯認為偶發材料問題，實際原因卻是施工序列偏離。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分部面積與暴露尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Subdivision changes simultaneously exposed area and shape while creating joints and construction interfaces. A smaller face can help control some local mechanisms, but the complete section and temporary supports still interact. Area ratios cannot directly represent stability ratios. Assume an 80 m² section divided into 30, 30 and 20 m² parts. The largest part is 30/80=37.5%; at an assumed 1 m increment its in-situ excavation is 30 m³. Overlapping adjacent excavations without updating the model creates a larger open region than planned. Increased movement or local falls may then be misclassified as isolated material problems when the underlying issue is a departure from the intended sequence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Subdivided area and exposure scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把斷面分成三塊就能把所有荷載與風險降為三分之一。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dividing a section into three parts reduces every load and risk to one third." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分部面積與暴露尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Subdivided area and exposure scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分部面積與暴露尺度
knowledge.text: 分割斷面改變同時暴露的面積與形狀，卻也新增接縫和施工介面。面積減少可能有利於控制某些局部機制，但總斷面與暫時支護仍需共同受力，不能將面積比例直接當作穩定度比例。
knowledge.textEn: Subdivision changes simultaneously exposed area and shape while creating joints and construction interfaces. A smaller face can help control some local mechanisms, but the complete section and temporary supports still interact.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：把斷面分成三塊就能把所有荷載與風險降為三分之一。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Dividing a section into three parts reduces every load and risk to one third. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分部面積與暴露尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Subdivided area and exposure scale" is correct?
options: 把斷面分成三塊就能把所有荷載與風險降為三分之一。
材料最終強度合格便能證明所有早期受力都合格。
分割斷面改變同時暴露的面積與形狀，卻也新增接縫和施工介面。
optionsEn: Dividing a section into three parts reduces every load and risk to one third.
Acceptable final material strength proves that every earlier loading stage was acceptable.
Subdivision changes simultaneously exposed area and shape while creating joints and construction interfaces.
quiz.explanation: 分割斷面改變同時暴露的面積與形狀，卻也新增接縫和施工介面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Subdivision changes simultaneously exposed area and shape while creating joints and construction interfaces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分部面積與暴露尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Subdivided area and exposure scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分部面積與暴露尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Subdivided area and exposure scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總斷面80 m²分為30、30、20 m²三部分，最大單部面積30/80=37.5%；每次假設進尺1 m時，最大單部原位開挖30 m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume an 80 m² section divided into 30, 30 and 20 m² parts. The largest part is 30/80=37.5%; at an assumed 1 m increment its in-situ excavation is 30 m³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將實際輪廓和階段記錄重疊，核對有無相鄰部分提前開放而使合併暴露面積變大；地質面誌與暫時支護狀態需同時保存，面積計算只用於幾何核對，穩定判讀由設計者另行完成。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Overlay surveyed profiles and stage records to check whether adjacent parts opened early and enlarged the combined exposure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總斷面80 m²分為30、30、20 m²三部分，最大單部面積30/80=37.5%；每次假設進尺1 m時，最大單部原位開挖30 m³。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume an 80 m² section divided into 30, 30 and 20 m² parts. The largest part is 30/80=37.5%; at an assumed 1 m increment its in-situ excavation is 30 m³.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分部面積與暴露尺度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Subdivided area and exposure scale", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
仰拱外形接起來就代表完整承載能力立即形成。
曲線擬合出有限極限值就能證明隧道已穩定。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Connecting the visible invert geometry means that full structural capacity is immediately available.
A fitted finite asymptote proves that the tunnel has reached a stable condition.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分部面積與暴露尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Subdivided area and exposure scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分部面積與暴露尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Subdivided area and exposure scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將實際輪廓和階段記錄重疊，核對有無相鄰部分提前開放而使合併暴露面積變大；地質面誌與暫時支護狀態需同時保存，面積計算只用於幾何核對，穩定判讀由設計者另行完成。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Overlay surveyed profiles and stage records to check whether adjacent parts opened early and enlarged the combined exposure. Preserve geological logs and temporary-support status together. Use area calculations for geometric reconciliation; the designer separately evaluates stability and interaction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每日圖面同時標出已開挖、已支護和已閉合區，不只標累計進尺；任何部分重疊或順序調整，都須由現場技術負責人送設計審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Daily drawings distinguish excavated, supported and closed regions instead of showing accumulated advance alone. Any overlap or sequence change is referred by the site technical lead for design review.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：相鄰開挖面時間重疊而未更新模型，會形成比圖面預想更大的開放區；局部掉塊或變形增加可能被錯認為偶發材料問題，實際原因卻是施工序列偏離。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Overlapping adjacent excavations without updating the model creates a larger open region than planned. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將實際輪廓和階段記錄重疊，核對有無相鄰部分提前開放而使合併暴露面積變大；地質面誌與暫時支護狀態需同時保存，面積計算只用於幾何核對，穩定判讀由設計者另行完成。
knowledge.textEn: Overlay surveyed profiles and stage records to check whether adjacent parts opened early and enlarged the combined exposure. Preserve geological logs and temporary-support status together. Use area calculations for geometric reconciliation; the designer separately evaluates stability and interaction.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每日圖面同時標出已開挖、已支護和已閉合區，不只標累計進尺；任何部分重疊或順序調整，都須由現場技術負責人送設計審查。
knowledge.textEn: Daily drawings distinguish excavated, supported and closed regions instead of showing accumulated advance alone. Any overlap or sequence change is referred by the site technical lead for design review.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分部面積與暴露尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Subdivided area and exposure scale"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將實際輪廓和階段記錄重疊，核對有無相鄰部分提前開放而使合併暴露面積變大；地質面誌與暫時支護狀態需同時保存，面積計算只用於幾何核對，穩定判讀由設計者另行完成。
模型曲線完全吻合量測就代表所有參數都是真值。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Overlay surveyed profiles and stage records to check whether adjacent parts opened early and enlarged the combined exposure.
An exact fit to measured movement means that every fitted parameter is its true value.
quiz.explanation: 將實際輪廓和階段記錄重疊，核對有無相鄰部分提前開放而使合併暴露面積變大；地質面誌與暫時支護狀態需同時保存，面積計算只用於幾何核對，穩定判讀由設計者另行完成。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Overlay surveyed profiles and stage records to check whether adjacent parts opened early and enlarged the combined exposure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.
