Increased movement or local falls may then be misclassified as isolated material problems when the underlying issue is a departure from the intended sequence. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：相鄰開挖面時間重疊而未更新模型，會形成比圖面預想更大的開放區；局部掉塊或變形增加可能被錯認為偶發材料問題，實際原因卻是施工序列偏離。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Increased movement or local falls may then be misclassified as isolated material problems when the underlying issue is a departure from the intended sequence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「把斷面分成三塊就能把所有荷載與風險降為三分之一。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Dividing a section into three parts reduces every load and risk to one third." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 相鄰開挖面時間重疊而未更新模型，會形成比圖面預想更大的開放區；局部掉塊或變形增加可能被錯認為偶發材料問題，實際原因卻是施工序列偏離。
knowledge.textEn: Overlapping adjacent excavations without updating the model creates a larger open region than planned. Increased movement or local falls may then be misclassified as isolated material problems when the underlying issue is a departure from the intended sequence.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分部面積與暴露尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Subdivided area and exposure scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
材料最終強度合格便能證明所有早期受力都合格。
相鄰開挖面時間重疊而未更新模型，會形成比圖面預想更大的開放區；局部掉塊或變形增加可能被錯認為偶發材料問題，實際原因卻是施工序列偏離。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Acceptable final material strength proves that every earlier loading stage was acceptable.
Overlapping adjacent excavations without updating the model creates a larger open region than planned.
quiz.explanation: 相鄰開挖面時間重疊而未更新模型，會形成比圖面預想更大的開放區；局部掉塊或變形增加可能被錯認為偶發材料問題，實際原因卻是施工序列偏離。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Overlapping adjacent excavations without updating the model creates a larger open region than planned. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「早齡受壓與強度發展」與「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Early-age compression and strength development" and "Weak sections and eccentric bending": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 早齡受壓與強度發展：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Early-age compression and strength development: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「早齡受壓與強度發展」如何影響隧道分部開挖與支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Early-age compression and strength development” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sequential excavation and support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 新噴襯砌的強度與剛度隨齡期發展，受力開始時間可能早於材料達到長期性能。平均壓應力可檢查數量級，但彎曲、局部薄區與早齡徐變會使同一平均值對不同位置產生不同影響。 假設軸力N=300 kN/m、厚t=0.20 m，單位寬平均應力N/t=1500 kPa=1.5 MPa；若合成試驗強度2 MPa，比值為0.75，未含分項係數。 以二十八天強度取代初齡性能會掩蓋早期需求超過能力的時段，外表未裂也不能排除內部損傷；之後補足強度不會自動抹去既有裂縫和接縫缺陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「早齡受壓與強度發展」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fresh sprayed lining gains strength and stiffness with age and may carry load before reaching long-term properties. Mean compressive stress checks scale, but bending, thin zones and early creep can make an identical mean stress have different implications at different locations. Assume axial force N=300 kN/m and thickness t=0.20 m. Unit-width mean stress N/t=1500 kPa=1.5 MPa. Against synthetic test strength 2 MPa, the ratio is 0.75 before any partial factors. Using mature strength for young lining hides intervals when demand may exceed available resistance. A crack-free surface does not exclude internal damage, and later strength gain does not automatically remove cracks or joint defects formed earlier. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Early-age compression and strength development” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「材料最終強度合格便能證明所有早期受力都合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Acceptable final material strength proves that every earlier loading stage was acceptable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「早齡受壓與強度發展」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Early-age compression and strength development”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 早齡受壓與強度發展
knowledge.text: 新噴襯砌的強度與剛度隨齡期發展，受力開始時間可能早於材料達到長期性能。平均壓應力可檢查數量級，但彎曲、局部薄區與早齡徐變會使同一平均值對不同位置產生不同影響。
knowledge.textEn: Fresh sprayed lining gains strength and stiffness with age and may carry load before reaching long-term properties. Mean compressive stress checks scale, but bending, thin zones and early creep can make an identical mean stress have different implications at different locations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：材料最終強度合格便能證明所有早期受力都合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Acceptable final material strength proves that every earlier loading stage was acceptable. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「早齡受壓與強度發展」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Early-age compression and strength development" is correct?
options: 新噴襯砌的強度與剛度隨齡期發展，受力開始時間可能早於材料達到長期性能。
材料最終強度合格便能證明所有早期受力都合格。
平均應力是壓縮就表示襯砌每個位置都沒有拉裂。
optionsEn: Fresh sprayed lining gains strength and stiffness with age and may carry load before reaching long-term properties.
Acceptable final material strength proves that every earlier loading stage was acceptable.
Compressive average stress means that no part of the lining can develop tensile cracking.
quiz.explanation: 新噴襯砌的強度與剛度隨齡期發展，受力開始時間可能早於材料達到長期性能。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fresh sprayed lining gains strength and stiffness with age and may carry load before reaching long-term properties. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 早齡受壓與強度發展：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Early-age compression and strength development: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「早齡受壓與強度發展」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Early-age compression and strength development” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設軸力N=300 kN/m、厚t=0.20 m，單位寬平均應力N/t=1500 kPa=1.5 MPa；若合成試驗強度2 MPa，比值為0.75，未含分項係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume axial force N=300 kN/m and thickness t=0.20 m. Unit-width mean stress N/t=1500 kPa=1.5 MPa. Against synthetic test strength 2 MPa, the ratio is 0.75 before any partial factors. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把噴築時刻、溫度、核准早齡試驗與實際受力階段連起來，確認試體是否代表現場材料及養護；比較薄區和受彎位置，不能用較晚齡期強度回填較早的受力時段，差異需材料與結構人員審核。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Link spraying time, temperature, approved early-age tests and loading stages.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設軸力N=300 kN/m、厚t=0.20 m，單位寬平均應力N/t=1500 kPa=1.5 MPa；若合成試驗強度2 MPa，比值為0.75，未含分項係數。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume axial force N=300 kN/m and thickness t=0.20 m. Unit-width mean stress N/t=1500 kPa=1.5 MPa. Against synthetic test strength 2 MPa, the ratio is 0.75 before any partial factors.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「早齡受壓與強度發展」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Early-age compression and strength development", which statement holds?
options: 量到的所有應變乘最終彈性模數就是當下內力。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
內表面沒有滴水就表示外側水壓可以忽略。
optionsEn: All measured strain multiplied by the final elastic modulus gives the current internal force.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
A dry inner surface means that external water pressure can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 早齡受壓與強度發展：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Early-age compression and strength development: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「早齡受壓與強度發展」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Early-age compression and strength development” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把噴築時刻、溫度、核准早齡試驗與實際受力階段連起來，確認試體是否代表現場材料及養護；比較薄區和受彎位置，不能用較晚齡期強度回填較早的受力時段，差異需材料與結構人員審核。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Link spraying time, temperature, approved early-age tests and loading stages. Check whether specimens represent placed material and curing. Examine thin and bending zones; later-age strength cannot be substituted into an earlier loading interval without review by material and structural specialists. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接表以齡期而非僅以日期配對荷載和試驗，未知早齡性能要明列；下一施工階段是否可開始，由核准的材料與結構審查流程判定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Pair loading and tests by material age, not date alone, and explicitly list unknown early-age properties. Permission to begin the next stage follows the approved material and structural review process.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以二十八天強度取代初齡性能會掩蓋早期需求超過能力的時段，外表未裂也不能排除內部損傷；之後補足強度不會自動抹去既有裂縫和接縫缺陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using mature strength for young lining hides intervals when demand may exceed available resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把噴築時刻、溫度、核准早齡試驗與實際受力階段連起來，確認試體是否代表現場材料及養護；比較薄區和受彎位置，不能用較晚齡期強度回填較早的受力時段，差異需材料與結構人員審核。
knowledge.textEn: Link spraying time, temperature, approved early-age tests and loading stages. Check whether specimens represent placed material and curing. Examine thin and bending zones; later-age strength cannot be substituted into an earlier loading interval without review by material and structural specialists.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接表以齡期而非僅以日期配對荷載和試驗，未知早齡性能要明列；下一施工階段是否可開始，由核准的材料與結構審查流程判定。
knowledge.textEn: Pair loading and tests by material age, not date alone, and explicitly list unknown early-age properties. Permission to begin the next stage follows the approved material and structural review process.

quiz.question: 要驗證「早齡受壓與強度發展」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Early-age compression and strength development"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
缺陷總面積比例很小便不必逐項交接其位置。
把噴築時刻、溫度、核准早齡試驗與實際受力階段連起來，確認試體是否代表現場材料及養護。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A small overall defective-area fraction removes the need to hand over each defect location.
Link spraying time, temperature, approved early-age tests and loading stages.
quiz.explanation: 把噴築時刻、溫度、核准早齡試驗與實際受力階段連起來，確認試體是否代表現場材料及養護；比較薄區和受彎位置，不能用較晚齡期強度回填較早的受力時段，差異需材料與結構人員審核。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Link spraying time, temperature, approved early-age tests and loading stages. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 早齡受壓與強度發展：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Early-age compression and strength development: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「早齡受壓與強度發展」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Early-age compression and strength development” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以二十八天強度取代初齡性能會掩蓋早期需求超過能力的時段，外表未裂也不能排除內部損傷；之後補足強度不會自動抹去既有裂縫和接縫缺陷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using mature strength for young lining hides intervals when demand may exceed available resistance. A crack-free surface does not exclude internal damage, and later strength gain does not automatically remove cracks or joint defects formed earlier. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以二十八天強度取代初齡性能會掩蓋早期需求超過能力的時段，外表未裂也不能排除內部損傷；之後補足強度不會自動抹去既有裂縫和接縫缺陷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A crack-free surface does not exclude internal damage, and later strength gain does not automatically remove cracks or joint defects formed earlier.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「材料最終強度合格便能證明所有早期受力都合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Acceptable final material strength proves that every earlier loading stage was acceptable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以二十八天強度取代初齡性能會掩蓋早期需求超過能力的時段，外表未裂也不能排除內部損傷；之後補足強度不會自動抹去既有裂縫和接縫缺陷。
knowledge.textEn: Using mature strength for young lining hides intervals when demand may exceed available resistance. A crack-free surface does not exclude internal damage, and later strength gain does not automatically remove cracks or joint defects formed earlier.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「早齡受壓與強度發展」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Early-age compression and strength development" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 以二十八天強度取代初齡性能會掩蓋早期需求超過能力的時段，外表未裂也不能排除內部損傷；之後補足強度不會自動抹去既有裂縫和接縫缺陷。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
平均應力是壓縮就表示襯砌每個位置都沒有拉裂。
optionsEn: Using mature strength for young lining hides intervals when demand may exceed available resistance.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Compressive average stress means that no part of the lining can develop tensile cracking.
quiz.explanation: 以二十八天強度取代初齡性能會掩蓋早期需求超過能力的時段，外表未裂也不能排除內部損傷；之後補足強度不會自動抹去既有裂縫和接縫缺陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using mature strength for young lining hides intervals when demand may exceed available resistance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 薄弱截面與偏心彎曲：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Weak sections and eccentric bending: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」如何影響隧道分部開挖與支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Weak sections and eccentric bending” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sequential excavation and support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 非圓斷面或不均勻荷載會使襯砌同時受壓與彎曲，厚度局部減少對彎曲應力的影響大於對平均壓應力的影響。線彈性截面分析只在未裂與適用材料假設下成立，需與真實受力機制分開。 假設每米寬N=200 kN、M=10 kN·m、t=0.25 m，σ=N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa，兩緣為1.76與-0.16 MPa，負值表示拉應力。 局部薄區在彎矩作用下先裂，原有內力分配可能重新調整；只看截面平均壓縮會忽略拉側與接縫開口，進而低估滲水和後續耐久風險。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Noncircular geometry and uneven loads produce compression and bending together. Local thinning affects bending stress more strongly than mean compression. Linear-elastic section analysis applies only under its uncracked material assumptions and must be separated from the full ground-lining mechanism. For a 1 m strip assume N=200 kN, M=10 kN·m and t=0.25 m. Stress is N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa: edges are 1.76 and -0.16 MPa, with negative indicating tension. A thin zone may crack first under bending and redistribute internal forces. Looking only at mean compression overlooks the tensile edge and joint opening, potentially understating leakage and subsequent durability concerns. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Weak sections and eccentric bending” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均應力是壓縮就表示襯砌每個位置都沒有拉裂。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Compressive average stress means that no part of the lining can develop tensile cracking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Weak sections and eccentric bending”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 薄弱截面與偏心彎曲
knowledge.text: 非圓斷面或不均勻荷載會使襯砌同時受壓與彎曲，厚度局部減少對彎曲應力的影響大於對平均壓應力的影響。線彈性截面分析只在未裂與適用材料假設下成立，需與真實受力機制分開。
knowledge.textEn: Noncircular geometry and uneven loads produce compression and bending together. Local thinning affects bending stress more strongly than mean compression.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均應力是壓縮就表示襯砌每個位置都沒有拉裂。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Compressive average stress means that no part of the lining can develop tensile cracking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Weak sections and eccentric bending" is correct?
options: 平均應力是壓縮就表示襯砌每個位置都沒有拉裂。
非圓斷面或不均勻荷載會使襯砌同時受壓與彎曲，厚度局部減少對彎曲應力的影響大於對平均壓應力的影響。
仰拱外形接起來就代表完整承載能力立即形成。
optionsEn: Compressive average stress means that no part of the lining can develop tensile cracking.
Noncircular geometry and uneven loads produce compression and bending together.
Connecting the visible invert geometry means that full structural capacity is immediately available.
quiz.explanation: 非圓斷面或不均勻荷載會使襯砌同時受壓與彎曲，厚度局部減少對彎曲應力的影響大於對平均壓應力的影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Noncircular geometry and uneven loads produce compression and bending together. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 薄弱截面與偏心彎曲：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Weak sections and eccentric bending: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Weak sections and eccentric bending” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設每米寬N=200 kN、M=10 kN·m、t=0.25 m，σ=N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa，兩緣為1.76與-0.16 MPa，負值表示拉應力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. For a 1 m strip assume N=200 kN, M=10 kN·m and t=0.25 m. Stress is N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa: edges are 1.76 and -0.16 MPa, with negative indicating tension. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用厚度檢測與幾何掃描定位不利截面，應變計資料需校正溫度和齡期後才可換算內力；若彈性模型出現拉應力，應檢討裂縫與殘餘承載模型，不把負值直接截為零再宣稱通過。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use thickness measurements and geometry scans to locate adverse sections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設每米寬N=200 kN、M=10 kN·m、t=0.25 m，σ=N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa，兩緣為1.76與-0.16 MPa，負值表示拉應力。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. For a 1 m strip assume N=200 kN, M=10 kN·m and t=0.25 m. Stress is N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa: edges are 1.76 and -0.16 MPa, with negative indicating tension.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Weak sections and eccentric bending", which statement holds?
options: 曲線擬合出有限極限值就能證明隧道已穩定。
模型曲線完全吻合量測就代表所有參數都是真值。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: A fitted finite asymptote proves that the tunnel has reached a stable condition.
An exact fit to measured movement means that every fitted parameter is its true value.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 薄弱截面與偏心彎曲：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Weak sections and eccentric bending: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Weak sections and eccentric bending” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用厚度檢測與幾何掃描定位不利截面，應變計資料需校正溫度和齡期後才可換算內力；若彈性模型出現拉應力，應檢討裂縫與殘餘承載模型，不把負值直接截為零再宣稱通過。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use thickness measurements and geometry scans to locate adverse sections. Correct strain records for temperature and age before inferring forces. If elastic analysis predicts tension, review cracking and residual resistance rather than clipping negative stress to zero and declaring success. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：圖表分別列軸力、彎矩和兩緣應力，保留正負號定義；出現開裂可能性時交設計者決定後續驗證與模型，不能只用平均值完成驗收。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Report axial force, moment and both edge stresses separately, preserving the sign convention. When cracking is possible, the designer determines further verification and modeling; a mean value cannot close acceptance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部薄區在彎矩作用下先裂，原有內力分配可能重新調整；只看截面平均壓縮會忽略拉側與接縫開口，進而低估滲水和後續耐久風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A thin zone may crack first under bending and redistribute internal forces. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用厚度檢測與幾何掃描定位不利截面，應變計資料需校正溫度和齡期後才可換算內力；若彈性模型出現拉應力，應檢討裂縫與殘餘承載模型，不把負值直接截為零再宣稱通過。
knowledge.textEn: Use thickness measurements and geometry scans to locate adverse sections. Correct strain records for temperature and age before inferring forces. If elastic analysis predicts tension, review cracking and residual resistance rather than clipping negative stress to zero and declaring success.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 圖表分別列軸力、彎矩和兩緣應力，保留正負號定義；出現開裂可能性時交設計者決定後續驗證與模型，不能只用平均值完成驗收。
knowledge.textEn: Report axial force, moment and both edge stresses separately, preserving the sign convention. When cracking is possible, the designer determines further verification and modeling; a mean value cannot close acceptance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Weak sections and eccentric bending"?
options: 用厚度檢測與幾何掃描定位不利截面，應變計資料需校正溫度和齡期後才可換算內力；若彈性模型出現拉應力，應檢討裂縫與殘餘承載模型，不把負值直接截為零再宣稱通過。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
地層與支護曲線一旦相交便證明所有失效均已排除。
optionsEn: Use thickness measurements and geometry scans to locate adverse sections.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
An intersection of ground and support curves proves every possible failure mode has been excluded.
quiz.explanation: 用厚度檢測與幾何掃描定位不利截面，應變計資料需校正溫度和齡期後才可換算內力；若彈性模型出現拉應力，應檢討裂縫與殘餘承載模型，不把負值直接截為零再宣稱通過。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use thickness measurements and geometry scans to locate adverse sections. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 薄弱截面與偏心彎曲：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Weak sections and eccentric bending: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Weak sections and eccentric bending” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部薄區在彎矩作用下先裂，原有內力分配可能重新調整；只看截面平均壓縮會忽略拉側與接縫開口，進而低估滲水和後續耐久風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A thin zone may crack first under bending and redistribute internal forces. Looking only at mean compression overlooks the tensile edge and joint opening, potentially understating leakage and subsequent durability concerns. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：局部薄區在彎矩作用下先裂，原有內力分配可能重新調整；只看截面平均壓縮會忽略拉側與接縫開口，進而低估滲水和後續耐久風險。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Looking only at mean compression overlooks the tensile edge and joint opening, potentially understating leakage and subsequent durability concerns.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均應力是壓縮就表示襯砌每個位置都沒有拉裂。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Compressive average stress means that no part of the lining can develop tensile cracking." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部薄區在彎矩作用下先裂，原有內力分配可能重新調整；只看截面平均壓縮會忽略拉側與接縫開口，進而低估滲水和後續耐久風險。
knowledge.textEn: A thin zone may crack first under bending and redistribute internal forces. Looking only at mean compression overlooks the tensile edge and joint opening, potentially understating leakage and subsequent durability concerns.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「薄弱截面與偏心彎曲」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Weak sections and eccentric bending" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
局部薄區在彎矩作用下先裂，原有內力分配可能重新調整；只看截面平均壓縮會忽略拉側與接縫開口，進而低估滲水和後續耐久風險。
仰拱外形接起來就代表完整承載能力立即形成。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A thin zone may crack first under bending and redistribute internal forces.
Connecting the visible invert geometry means that full structural capacity is immediately available.
quiz.explanation: 局部薄區在彎矩作用下先裂，原有內力分配可能重新調整；只看截面平均壓縮會忽略拉側與接縫開口，進而低估滲水和後續耐久風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A thin zone may crack first under bending and redistribute internal forces. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「仰拱閉合與剛度改變」與「施工時間與剛度相容」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Invert closure and stiffness change" and "Construction timing and stiffness compatibility": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 仰拱閉合與剛度改變：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Invert closure and stiffness change: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「仰拱閉合與剛度改變」如何影響隧道分部開挖與支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Invert closure and stiffness change” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sequential excavation and support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 開口支護和閉合環的力流不同，仰拱接通後可增加環向約束，但接縫柔度與地層接觸仍影響實際剛度。用等效彈簧比較只展示閉合改變，不聲稱結構一定立即成為完整圓環。 假設同一增量荷載ΔF=600 kN，開口等效剛度20 kN/mm、閉合後60 kN/mm，位移增量分別30與10 mm；兩剛度均為教學假設。 圖面已閉合但接縫未充分傳力，會讓計算剛度高於實際；若據此移除臨時構件，變形可能重新加速，顯示幾何閉合與力學閉合並不相同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「仰拱閉合與剛度改變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Open support and a closed ring have different load paths. Invert connection can add circumferential restraint, but joint compliance and ground contact still govern effective stiffness. Equivalent springs illustrate the change without claiming that closure instantly creates a perfect circular ring. Assume the same incremental force ΔF=600 kN. With equivalent stiffness 20 kN/mm before closure and 60 kN/mm after, displacement increments are 30 and 10 mm; both stiffnesses are teaching assumptions. A geometrically closed section with ineffective joints can be less stiff than assumed. Removing temporary members on that assumption may restart movement, demonstrating that geometric closure and effective structural closure are different conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Invert closure and stiffness change” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「仰拱外形接起來就代表完整承載能力立即形成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Connecting the visible invert geometry means that full structural capacity is immediately available." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「仰拱閉合與剛度改變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Invert closure and stiffness change”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 仰拱閉合與剛度改變
knowledge.text: 開口支護和閉合環的力流不同，仰拱接通後可增加環向約束，但接縫柔度與地層接觸仍影響實際剛度。用等效彈簧比較只展示閉合改變，不聲稱結構一定立即成為完整圓環。
knowledge.textEn: Open support and a closed ring have different load paths. Invert connection can add circumferential restraint, but joint compliance and ground contact still govern effective stiffness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：仰拱外形接起來就代表完整承載能力立即形成。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Connecting the visible invert geometry means that full structural capacity is immediately available. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「仰拱閉合與剛度改變」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Invert closure and stiffness change" is correct?
options: 仰拱外形接起來就代表完整承載能力立即形成。
量到的所有應變乘最終彈性模數就是當下內力。
開口支護和閉合環的力流不同，仰拱接通後可增加環向約束，但接縫柔度與地層接觸仍影響實際剛度。
optionsEn: Connecting the visible invert geometry means that full structural capacity is immediately available.
All measured strain multiplied by the final elastic modulus gives the current internal force.
Open support and a closed ring have different load paths.
quiz.explanation: 開口支護和閉合環的力流不同，仰拱接通後可增加環向約束，但接縫柔度與地層接觸仍影響實際剛度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Open support and a closed ring have different load paths. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 仰拱閉合與剛度改變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Invert closure and stiffness change: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「仰拱閉合與剛度改變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Invert closure and stiffness change” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設同一增量荷載ΔF=600 kN，開口等效剛度20 kN/mm、閉合後60 kN/mm，位移增量分別30與10 mm；兩剛度均為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume the same incremental force ΔF=600 kN. With equivalent stiffness 20 kN/mm before closure and 60 kN/mm after, displacement increments are 30 and 10 mm; both stiffnesses are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對仰拱幾何、連接完成時間與材料齡期，將閉合前後收斂增量按相同施工事件比較；排除荷載變小或基準重設的影響，才討論剛度改變，任何等效值都須附上識別資料和不確定度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check invert geometry, connection completion and material age.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設同一增量荷載ΔF=600 kN，開口等效剛度20 kN/mm、閉合後60 kN/mm，位移增量分別30與10 mm；兩剛度均為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume the same incremental force ΔF=600 kN. With equivalent stiffness 20 kN/mm before closure and 60 kN/mm after, displacement increments are 30 and 10 mm; both stiffnesses are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「仰拱閉合與剛度改變」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Invert closure and stiffness change", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
內表面沒有滴水就表示外側水壓可以忽略。
缺陷總面積比例很小便不必逐項交接其位置。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
A dry inner surface means that external water pressure can be ignored.
A small overall defective-area fraction removes the need to hand over each defect location.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 仰拱閉合與剛度改變：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Invert closure and stiffness change: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「仰拱閉合與剛度改變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Invert closure and stiffness change” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對仰拱幾何、連接完成時間與材料齡期，將閉合前後收斂增量按相同施工事件比較；排除荷載變小或基準重設的影響，才討論剛度改變，任何等效值都須附上識別資料和不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check invert geometry, connection completion and material age. Compare convergence increments around matching construction events before and after closure. Exclude reduced loading or reset references before attributing changes to stiffness; every inferred equivalent value needs supporting data and uncertainty. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：閉合紀錄同時確認幾何、接縫、齡期和核准試驗，未完成項不以照片代替；臨時支護調整前由結構負責人確認實際傳力條件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Closure records verify geometry, joints, age and approved tests together. Photographs do not replace unresolved checks. Before altering temporary support, the structural lead confirms the actual load-transfer conditions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：圖面已閉合但接縫未充分傳力，會讓計算剛度高於實際；若據此移除臨時構件，變形可能重新加速，顯示幾何閉合與力學閉合並不相同。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A geometrically closed section with ineffective joints can be less stiff than assumed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對仰拱幾何、連接完成時間與材料齡期，將閉合前後收斂增量按相同施工事件比較；排除荷載變小或基準重設的影響，才討論剛度改變，任何等效值都須附上識別資料和不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Check invert geometry, connection completion and material age. Compare convergence increments around matching construction events before and after closure. Exclude reduced loading or reset references before attributing changes to stiffness; every inferred equivalent value needs supporting data and uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 閉合紀錄同時確認幾何、接縫、齡期和核准試驗，未完成項不以照片代替；臨時支護調整前由結構負責人確認實際傳力條件。
knowledge.textEn: Closure records verify geometry, joints, age and approved tests together. Photographs do not replace unresolved checks. Before altering temporary support, the structural lead confirms the actual load-transfer conditions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「仰拱閉合與剛度改變」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Invert closure and stiffness change"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
核對仰拱幾何、連接完成時間與材料齡期，將閉合前後收斂增量按相同施工事件比較；排除荷載變小或基準重設的影響，才討論剛度改變，任何等效值都須附上識別資料和不確定度。
把斷面分成三塊就能把所有荷載與風險降為三分之一。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Check invert geometry, connection completion and material age.
Dividing a section into three parts reduces every load and risk to one third.
quiz.explanation: 核對仰拱幾何、連接完成時間與材料齡期，將閉合前後收斂增量按相同施工事件比較；排除荷載變小或基準重設的影響，才討論剛度改變，任何等效值都須附上識別資料和不確定度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check invert geometry, connection completion and material age. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 仰拱閉合與剛度改變：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Invert closure and stiffness change: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「仰拱閉合與剛度改變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Invert closure and stiffness change” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 圖面已閉合但接縫未充分傳力，會讓計算剛度高於實際；若據此移除臨時構件，變形可能重新加速，顯示幾何閉合與力學閉合並不相同。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A geometrically closed section with ineffective joints can be less stiff than assumed. Removing temporary members on that assumption may restart movement, demonstrating that geometric closure and effective structural closure are different conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：圖面已閉合但接縫未充分傳力，會讓計算剛度高於實際；若據此移除臨時構件，變形可能重新加速，顯示幾何閉合與力學閉合並不相同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Removing temporary members on that assumption may restart movement, demonstrating that geometric closure and effective structural closure are different conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「仰拱外形接起來就代表完整承載能力立即形成。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Connecting the visible invert geometry means that full structural capacity is immediately available." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 圖面已閉合但接縫未充分傳力，會讓計算剛度高於實際；若據此移除臨時構件，變形可能重新加速，顯示幾何閉合與力學閉合並不相同。
knowledge.textEn: A geometrically closed section with ineffective joints can be less stiff than assumed. Removing temporary members on that assumption may restart movement, demonstrating that geometric closure and effective structural closure are different conditions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「仰拱閉合與剛度改變」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Invert closure and stiffness change" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
量到的所有應變乘最終彈性模數就是當下內力。
圖面已閉合但接縫未充分傳力，會讓計算剛度高於實際；若據此移除臨時構件，變形可能重新加速，顯示幾何閉合與力學閉合並不相同。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
All measured strain multiplied by the final elastic modulus gives the current internal force.
A geometrically closed section with ineffective joints can be less stiff than assumed.
quiz.explanation: 圖面已閉合但接縫未充分傳力，會讓計算剛度高於實際；若據此移除臨時構件，變形可能重新加速，顯示幾何閉合與力學閉合並不相同。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A geometrically closed section with ineffective joints can be less stiff than assumed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 施工時間與剛度相容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Construction timing and stiffness compatibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工時間與剛度相容」如何影響隧道分部開挖與支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Construction timing and stiffness compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sequential excavation and support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相同軸力作用於不同齡期材料會產生不同彈性應變，而早齡徐變使單純彈性關係更受限制。施工時間表不只是管理資料，它決定各部分材料在荷載轉移時的剛度以及可能的內力再分配。 假設單位寬A=0.25 m²、N=300 kN，E=6 GPa時ε=N/(EA)=200微應變；E=12 GPa時為100微應變，未包含徐變與收縮。 較晚啟用的儀器漏記先期應變，與年輕材料的低剛度疊加後可能誤判荷載很小；若再忽略徐變，內力估計的方向甚至可能和真實變化不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工時間與剛度相容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Equal axial force produces different elastic strain in materials of different age, while early creep further limits a purely elastic relation. The construction timetable is therefore a mechanical input: it determines stiffness during load transfer and potential redistribution among components. Assume unit-width area A=0.25 m² and N=300 kN. At E=6 GPa, ε=N/(EA)=200 microstrain; at E=12 GPa it is 100 microstrain, excluding creep and shrinkage. Late gauge activation misses earlier strain and, combined with low young-material stiffness, can suggest falsely small loading. Ignoring creep adds further bias and may make the inferred force trend differ from the actual load-transfer history. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Construction timing and stiffness compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量到的所有應變乘最終彈性模數就是當下內力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All measured strain multiplied by the final elastic modulus gives the current internal force." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「施工時間與剛度相容」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Construction timing and stiffness compatibility”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工時間與剛度相容
knowledge.text: 相同軸力作用於不同齡期材料會產生不同彈性應變，而早齡徐變使單純彈性關係更受限制。施工時間表不只是管理資料，它決定各部分材料在荷載轉移時的剛度以及可能的內力再分配。
knowledge.textEn: Equal axial force produces different elastic strain in materials of different age, while early creep further limits a purely elastic relation. The construction timetable is therefore a mechanical input: it determines stiffness during load transfer and potential redistribution among components.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：量到的所有應變乘最終彈性模數就是當下內力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All measured strain multiplied by the final elastic modulus gives the current internal force. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工時間與剛度相容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Construction timing and stiffness compatibility" is correct?
options: 相同軸力作用於不同齡期材料會產生不同彈性應變，而早齡徐變使單純彈性關係更受限制。
量到的所有應變乘最終彈性模數就是當下內力。
曲線擬合出有限極限值就能證明隧道已穩定。
optionsEn: Equal axial force produces different elastic strain in materials of different age, while early creep further limits a purely elastic relation.
All measured strain multiplied by the final elastic modulus gives the current internal force.
A fitted finite asymptote proves that the tunnel has reached a stable condition.
quiz.explanation: 相同軸力作用於不同齡期材料會產生不同彈性應變，而早齡徐變使單純彈性關係更受限制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal axial force produces different elastic strain in materials of different age, while early creep further limits a purely elastic relation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工時間與剛度相容：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Construction timing and stiffness compatibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工時間與剛度相容」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Construction timing and stiffness compatibility” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設單位寬A=0.25 m²、N=300 kN，E=6 GPa時ε=N/(EA)=200微應變；E=12 GPa時為100微應變，未包含徐變與收縮。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume unit-width area A=0.25 m² and N=300 kN. At E=6 GPa, ε=N/(EA)=200 microstrain; at E=12 GPa it is 100 microstrain, excluding creep and shrinkage. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄噴築時間、環境溫度、材料試驗與應變計啟用時刻，核對零點是否在已受力後才設定；將彈性、溫度和時間效應分別列出，無足夠證據時不能把全部應變都換算成結構軸力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize placement time, temperature, material tests and strain-gauge activation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設單位寬A=0.25 m²、N=300 kN，E=6 GPa時ε=N/(EA)=200微應變；E=12 GPa時為100微應變，未包含徐變與收縮。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume unit-width area A=0.25 m² and N=300 kN. At E=6 GPa, ε=N/(EA)=200 microstrain; at E=12 GPa it is 100 microstrain, excluding creep and shrinkage.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工時間與剛度相容」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Construction timing and stiffness compatibility", which statement holds?
options: 模型曲線完全吻合量測就代表所有參數都是真值。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
地層與支護曲線一旦相交便證明所有失效均已排除。
optionsEn: An exact fit to measured movement means that every fitted parameter is its true value.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
An intersection of ground and support curves proves every possible failure mode has been excluded.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工時間與剛度相容：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Construction timing and stiffness compatibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工時間與剛度相容」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Construction timing and stiffness compatibility” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄噴築時間、環境溫度、材料試驗與應變計啟用時刻，核對零點是否在已受力後才設定；將彈性、溫度和時間效應分別列出，無足夠證據時不能把全部應變都換算成結構軸力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize placement time, temperature, material tests and strain-gauge activation. Determine whether zero was established after loading had already begun. Separate elastic, thermal and time-dependent components; insufficient evidence precludes converting all measured strain directly into structural axial force. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：資料交接附上儀器零點時刻及材料齡期對照表，不能補填不存在的初始讀值；模型採用的剛度與時間效應由材料、監測和設計人員共同確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover includes gauge-zero times and material-age tables without inventing missing initial readings. Material, monitoring and design specialists jointly confirm the stiffness and time effects adopted in the model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：較晚啟用的儀器漏記先期應變，與年輕材料的低剛度疊加後可能誤判荷載很小；若再忽略徐變，內力估計的方向甚至可能和真實變化不同。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Late gauge activation misses earlier strain and, combined with low young-material stiffness, can suggest falsely small loading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步記錄噴築時間、環境溫度、材料試驗與應變計啟用時刻，核對零點是否在已受力後才設定；將彈性、溫度和時間效應分別列出，無足夠證據時不能把全部應變都換算成結構軸力。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize placement time, temperature, material tests and strain-gauge activation. Determine whether zero was established after loading had already begun. Separate elastic, thermal and time-dependent components; insufficient evidence precludes converting all measured strain directly into structural axial force.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 資料交接附上儀器零點時刻及材料齡期對照表，不能補填不存在的初始讀值；模型採用的剛度與時間效應由材料、監測和設計人員共同確認。
knowledge.textEn: Handover includes gauge-zero times and material-age tables without inventing missing initial readings. Material, monitoring and design specialists jointly confirm the stiffness and time effects adopted in the model.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工時間與剛度相容」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Construction timing and stiffness compatibility"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
材料最終強度合格便能證明所有早期受力都合格。
同步記錄噴築時間、環境溫度、材料試驗與應變計啟用時刻，核對零點是否在已受力後才設定；將彈性、溫度和時間效應分別列出，無足夠證據時不能把全部應變都換算成結構軸力。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Acceptable final material strength proves that every earlier loading stage was acceptable.
Synchronize placement time, temperature, material tests and strain-gauge activation.
quiz.explanation: 同步記錄噴築時間、環境溫度、材料試驗與應變計啟用時刻，核對零點是否在已受力後才設定；將彈性、溫度和時間效應分別列出，無足夠證據時不能把全部應變都換算成結構軸力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize placement time, temperature, material tests and strain-gauge activation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工時間與剛度相容：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Construction timing and stiffness compatibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工時間與剛度相容」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Construction timing and stiffness compatibility” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 較晚啟用的儀器漏記先期應變，與年輕材料的低剛度疊加後可能誤判荷載很小；若再忽略徐變，內力估計的方向甚至可能和真實變化不同。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Late gauge activation misses earlier strain and, combined with low young-material stiffness, can suggest falsely small loading. Ignoring creep adds further bias and may make the inferred force trend differ from the actual load-transfer history. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：較晚啟用的儀器漏記先期應變，與年輕材料的低剛度疊加後可能誤判荷載很小；若再忽略徐變，內力估計的方向甚至可能和真實變化不同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring creep adds further bias and may make the inferred force trend differ from the actual load-transfer history.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「量到的所有應變乘最終彈性模數就是當下內力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All measured strain multiplied by the final elastic modulus gives the current internal force." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 較晚啟用的儀器漏記先期應變，與年輕材料的低剛度疊加後可能誤判荷載很小；若再忽略徐變，內力估計的方向甚至可能和真實變化不同。
knowledge.textEn: Late gauge activation misses earlier strain and, combined with low young-material stiffness, can suggest falsely small loading. Ignoring creep adds further bias and may make the inferred force trend differ from the actual load-transfer history.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工時間與剛度相容」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Construction timing and stiffness compatibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 較晚啟用的儀器漏記先期應變，與年輕材料的低剛度疊加後可能誤判荷載很小；若再忽略徐變，內力估計的方向甚至可能和真實變化不同。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
曲線擬合出有限極限值就能證明隧道已穩定。
optionsEn: Late gauge activation misses earlier strain and, combined with low young-material stiffness, can suggest falsely small loading.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A fitted finite asymptote proves that the tunnel has reached a stable condition.
quiz.explanation: 較晚啟用的儀器漏記先期應變，與年輕材料的低剛度疊加後可能誤判荷載很小；若再忽略徐變，內力估計的方向甚至可能和真實變化不同。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Late gauge activation misses earlier strain and, combined with low young-material stiffness, can suggest falsely small loading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「收斂曲線與外推界線」與「防水介面與壓力分布」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Convergence curves and extrapolation limits" and "Waterproofing interfaces and pressure distribution": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 收斂曲線與外推界線：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Convergence curves and extrapolation limits: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「收斂曲線與外推界線」如何影響隧道分部開挖與支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Convergence curves and extrapolation limits” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sequential excavation and support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 指數曲線可以摘要逐漸變慢的合成收斂，但擬合形式不會自動證明地層穩定。開挖距離、地下水和後續拆除都可能改變邊界，造成原先衰減的曲線重新加速，預測必須附帶情境。 假設u(t)=20[1-exp(-t/5)] mm，t以day計，u(5)=12.64 mm、u(10)=17.29 mm；極限20 mm只是模型參數，非現場允收限值。 將加速讀值當作離群點刪除，會讓擬合曲線看似穩定卻失去預警能力；當邊界已改變，延用舊極限值可能錯估後續變形與需要的審查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「收斂曲線與外推界線」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An exponential curve can summarize synthetic convergence that slows with time, but its fitted form does not prove stability. Excavation distance, groundwater and later removals can change boundaries and restart acceleration. A forecast must therefore state the scenario under which it applies. Assume u(t)=20[1-exp(-t/5)] mm with t in days. Values are u(5)=12.64 mm and u(10)=17.29 mm; the 20 mm asymptote is a model parameter, not a field acceptance limit. Deleting accelerating readings as outliers can make a fitted curve look stable while removing its warning value. After boundaries change, retaining the old asymptote may misrepresent future movement and the need for engineering review. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Convergence curves and extrapolation limits” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「曲線擬合出有限極限值就能證明隧道已穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fitted finite asymptote proves that the tunnel has reached a stable condition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「收斂曲線與外推界線」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Convergence curves and extrapolation limits”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 收斂曲線與外推界線
knowledge.text: 指數曲線可以摘要逐漸變慢的合成收斂，但擬合形式不會自動證明地層穩定。開挖距離、地下水和後續拆除都可能改變邊界，造成原先衰減的曲線重新加速，預測必須附帶情境。
knowledge.textEn: An exponential curve can summarize synthetic convergence that slows with time, but its fitted form does not prove stability. Excavation distance, groundwater and later removals can change boundaries and restart acceleration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：曲線擬合出有限極限值就能證明隧道已穩定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A fitted finite asymptote proves that the tunnel has reached a stable condition. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「收斂曲線與外推界線」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Convergence curves and extrapolation limits" is correct?
options: 曲線擬合出有限極限值就能證明隧道已穩定。
指數曲線可以摘要逐漸變慢的合成收斂，但擬合形式不會自動證明地層穩定。
內表面沒有滴水就表示外側水壓可以忽略。
optionsEn: A fitted finite asymptote proves that the tunnel has reached a stable condition.
An exponential curve can summarize synthetic convergence that slows with time, but its fitted form does not prove stability.
A dry inner surface means that external water pressure can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 指數曲線可以摘要逐漸變慢的合成收斂，但擬合形式不會自動證明地層穩定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An exponential curve can summarize synthetic convergence that slows with time, but its fitted form does not prove stability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.titleEn: Convergence curves and extrapolation limits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「收斂曲線與外推界線」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.title: 防水介面與壓力分布：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「防水介面與壓力分布」如何影響隧道分部開挖與支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Waterproofing interfaces and pressure distribution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sequential excavation and support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地下水壓力作用於可受壓的面積，防水層負責阻隔水路而非憑空消除外部水壓。排水與封閉防水的設計邊界不同，若把排水假設移植到不排水區，襯砌受力可能被低估。 假設均勻表壓p=150 kPa作用於局部平面A=2 m²，合力F=pA=300 kN；這是假設局部均壓，非整個彎曲襯砌的總合力。 排水通道堵塞後外水壓上升，內表面卻可能暫時仍乾燥；若僅以滲漏量評估荷載，會錯把防水效果良好當成結構沒有水壓需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「防水介面與壓力分布」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Groundwater pressure acts over the pressurized area. Waterproofing blocks water paths rather than making external pressure disappear. Drained and sealed arrangements have different boundaries; applying a drainage assumption to a sealed region can understate lining demand. Assume uniform gauge pressure p=150 kPa on local plane area A=2 m². Resultant F=pA=300 kN applies to this idealized local patch, not the entire curved lining. After drainage blocks, external pressure may rise while the inner surface remains dry. Assessing loading from leakage alone can mistake effective waterproofing for the absence of a water-pressure demand on the structure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Waterproofing interfaces and pressure distribution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
