steps.title: 防水介面與壓力分布：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Waterproofing interfaces and pressure distribution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「防水介面與壓力分布」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Waterproofing interfaces and pressure distribution” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對設計排水路徑、孔壓量測及防水接縫驗證紀錄，將滲漏位置和水頭分開記錄；乾燥表面不能證明外壓為零，堵塞或排水條件改變時需由水文與結構負責人共同審查荷載假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check designed drainage paths, pore-pressure observations and waterproof-joint verification. Record leakage locations separately from head. A dry surface does not establish zero external pressure; blockage or changed drainage requires joint hydraulic and structural review of the load assumptions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接同時保存防水品質和排水功能證據，明示長期維護責任；壓力邊界改變先送設計審查，不以乾燥外觀代替結構荷載確認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain evidence of both waterproof quality and drainage function at handover, identifying long-term maintenance responsibility. A changed pressure boundary goes to design review; dry appearance does not replace confirmation of structural loading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：排水通道堵塞後外水壓上升，內表面卻可能暫時仍乾燥；若僅以滲漏量評估荷載，會錯把防水效果良好當成結構沒有水壓需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: After drainage blocks, external pressure may rise while the inner surface remains dry. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對設計排水路徑、孔壓量測及防水接縫驗證紀錄，將滲漏位置和水頭分開記錄；乾燥表面不能證明外壓為零，堵塞或排水條件改變時需由水文與結構負責人共同審查荷載假設。
knowledge.textEn: Check designed drainage paths, pore-pressure observations and waterproof-joint verification. Record leakage locations separately from head. A dry surface does not establish zero external pressure; blockage or changed drainage requires joint hydraulic and structural review of the load assumptions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接同時保存防水品質和排水功能證據，明示長期維護責任；壓力邊界改變先送設計審查，不以乾燥外觀代替結構荷載確認。
knowledge.textEn: Retain evidence of both waterproof quality and drainage function at handover, identifying long-term maintenance responsibility. A changed pressure boundary goes to design review; dry appearance does not replace confirmation of structural loading.

quiz.question: 要驗證「防水介面與壓力分布」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Waterproofing interfaces and pressure distribution"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對設計排水路徑、孔壓量測及防水接縫驗證紀錄，將滲漏位置和水頭分開記錄；乾燥表面不能證明外壓為零，堵塞或排水條件改變時需由水文與結構負責人共同審查荷載假設。
仰拱外形接起來就代表完整承載能力立即形成。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Check designed drainage paths, pore-pressure observations and waterproof-joint verification.
Connecting the visible invert geometry means that full structural capacity is immediately available.
quiz.explanation: 核對設計排水路徑、孔壓量測及防水接縫驗證紀錄，將滲漏位置和水頭分開記錄；乾燥表面不能證明外壓為零，堵塞或排水條件改變時需由水文與結構負責人共同審查荷載假設。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check designed drainage paths, pore-pressure observations and waterproof-joint verification. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 防水介面與壓力分布：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Waterproofing interfaces and pressure distribution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「防水介面與壓力分布」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Waterproofing interfaces and pressure distribution” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 排水通道堵塞後外水壓上升，內表面卻可能暫時仍乾燥；若僅以滲漏量評估荷載，會錯把防水效果良好當成結構沒有水壓需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: After drainage blocks, external pressure may rise while the inner surface remains dry. Assessing loading from leakage alone can mistake effective waterproofing for the absence of a water-pressure demand on the structure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水通道堵塞後外水壓上升，內表面卻可能暫時仍乾燥；若僅以滲漏量評估荷載，會錯把防水效果良好當成結構沒有水壓需求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assessing loading from leakage alone can mistake effective waterproofing for the absence of a water-pressure demand on the structure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「內表面沒有滴水就表示外側水壓可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A dry inner surface means that external water pressure can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 排水通道堵塞後外水壓上升，內表面卻可能暫時仍乾燥；若僅以滲漏量評估荷載，會錯把防水效果良好當成結構沒有水壓需求。
knowledge.textEn: After drainage blocks, external pressure may rise while the inner surface remains dry. Assessing loading from leakage alone can mistake effective waterproofing for the absence of a water-pressure demand on the structure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「防水介面與壓力分布」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Waterproofing interfaces and pressure distribution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
模型曲線完全吻合量測就代表所有參數都是真值。
排水通道堵塞後外水壓上升，內表面卻可能暫時仍乾燥；若僅以滲漏量評估荷載，會錯把防水效果良好當成結構沒有水壓需求。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
An exact fit to measured movement means that every fitted parameter is its true value.
After drainage blocks, external pressure may rise while the inner surface remains dry.
quiz.explanation: 排水通道堵塞後外水壓上升，內表面卻可能暫時仍乾燥；若僅以滲漏量評估荷載，會錯把防水效果良好當成結構沒有水壓需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: After drainage blocks, external pressure may rise while the inner surface remains dry. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「反分析的多解問題」與「分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Non-uniqueness in back-analysis" and "Layered-lining handover and defect map": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 反分析的多解問題：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Non-uniqueness in back-analysis: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反分析的多解問題」如何影響隧道分部開挖與支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Non-uniqueness in back-analysis” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sequential excavation and support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單一位移可能由較大荷載配較高剛度或較小荷載配較低剛度產生，因而不是所有參數都能由一條曲線辨識。反分析必須配合獨立地質、材料與內力量測，並報告可行參數的範圍。 假設u=F/k=10 mm，可由F=500 kN、k=50 kN/mm，也可由F=1000 kN、k=100 kN/mm得到；一個位移觀測無法區分兩組。 校準到單一斷面的模型可能只是參數互相補償，換到新地層或新序列便失準；若只公布最佳誤差不公布多解性，使用者會高估模型的預測能力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反分析的多解問題」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The same displacement can result from larger force with higher stiffness or smaller force with lower stiffness. A single curve therefore cannot identify every parameter. Back-analysis needs independent geological, material and force evidence and should report feasible parameter ranges. An observed u=F/k=10 mm can arise from F=500 kN with k=50 kN/mm or F=1000 kN with k=100 kN/mm. One displacement observation cannot distinguish the two pairs. A model calibrated to one section may rely on compensating parameters and fail under a new ground condition or sequence. Reporting only its best error while hiding non-uniqueness encourages overconfidence in predictive capability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Non-uniqueness in back-analysis” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模型曲線完全吻合量測就代表所有參數都是真值。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An exact fit to measured movement means that every fitted parameter is its true value." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「反分析的多解問題」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Non-uniqueness in back-analysis”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 反分析的多解問題
knowledge.text: 單一位移可能由較大荷載配較高剛度或較小荷載配較低剛度產生，因而不是所有參數都能由一條曲線辨識。反分析必須配合獨立地質、材料與內力量測，並報告可行參數的範圍。
knowledge.textEn: The same displacement can result from larger force with higher stiffness or smaller force with lower stiffness. A single curve therefore cannot identify every parameter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模型曲線完全吻合量測就代表所有參數都是真值。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An exact fit to measured movement means that every fitted parameter is its true value. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「反分析的多解問題」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Non-uniqueness in back-analysis" is correct?
options: 單一位移可能由較大荷載配較高剛度或較小荷載配較低剛度產生，因而不是所有參數都能由一條曲線辨識。
模型曲線完全吻合量測就代表所有參數都是真值。
缺陷總面積比例很小便不必逐項交接其位置。
optionsEn: The same displacement can result from larger force with higher stiffness or smaller force with lower stiffness.
An exact fit to measured movement means that every fitted parameter is its true value.
A small overall defective-area fraction removes the need to hand over each defect location.
quiz.explanation: 單一位移可能由較大荷載配較高剛度或較小荷載配較低剛度產生，因而不是所有參數都能由一條曲線辨識。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The same displacement can result from larger force with higher stiffness or smaller force with lower stiffness. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 反分析的多解問題：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Non-uniqueness in back-analysis: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反分析的多解問題」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Non-uniqueness in back-analysis” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u=F/k=10 mm，可由F=500 kN、k=50 kN/mm，也可由F=1000 kN、k=100 kN/mm得到；一個位移觀測無法區分兩組。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. An observed u=F/k=10 mm can arise from F=500 kN with k=50 kN/mm or F=1000 kN with k=100 kN/mm. One displacement observation cannot distinguish the two pairs. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先列出未知參數與獨立觀測數，再用不同參數組計算是否同樣符合位移；加入有物理意義的試驗約束而非任意縮小範圍，保留同樣可行的解，交設計者評估對後續序列的預測分歧。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List unknown parameters and independent observations, then test whether several parameter sets fit the displacement equally well.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u=F/k=10 mm，可由F=500 kN、k=50 kN/mm，也可由F=1000 kN、k=100 kN/mm得到；一個位移觀測無法區分兩組。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. An observed u=F/k=10 mm can arise from F=500 kN with k=50 kN/mm or F=1000 kN with k=100 kN/mm. One displacement observation cannot distinguish the two pairs.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「反分析的多解問題」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Non-uniqueness in back-analysis", which statement holds?
options: 把斷面分成三塊就能把所有荷載與風險降為三分之一。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
平均應力是壓縮就表示襯砌每個位置都沒有拉裂。
optionsEn: Dividing a section into three parts reduces every load and risk to one third.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Compressive average stress means that no part of the lining can develop tensile cracking.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 反分析的多解問題：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Non-uniqueness in back-analysis: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反分析的多解問題」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Non-uniqueness in back-analysis” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先列出未知參數與獨立觀測數，再用不同參數組計算是否同樣符合位移；加入有物理意義的試驗約束而非任意縮小範圍，保留同樣可行的解，交設計者評估對後續序列的預測分歧。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List unknown parameters and independent observations, then test whether several parameter sets fit the displacement equally well. Add physically supported test constraints rather than arbitrary narrow bounds. Retain viable alternatives and have the designer evaluate their differing predictions for later stages. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：反分析文件附參數範圍、相關性和獨立驗證資料，任何用於變更設計的結論須標明仍未辨識項；由模型與設計負責人共同簽認適用情境。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Back-analysis records include parameter ranges, correlations and independent validation. Conclusions used for design changes identify unresolved parameters, and modeling and design leads jointly approve the applicable scenarios.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：校準到單一斷面的模型可能只是參數互相補償，換到新地層或新序列便失準；若只公布最佳誤差不公布多解性，使用者會高估模型的預測能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A model calibrated to one section may rely on compensating parameters and fail under a new ground condition or sequence. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先列出未知參數與獨立觀測數，再用不同參數組計算是否同樣符合位移；加入有物理意義的試驗約束而非任意縮小範圍，保留同樣可行的解，交設計者評估對後續序列的預測分歧。
knowledge.textEn: List unknown parameters and independent observations, then test whether several parameter sets fit the displacement equally well. Add physically supported test constraints rather than arbitrary narrow bounds. Retain viable alternatives and have the designer evaluate their differing predictions for later stages.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 反分析文件附參數範圍、相關性和獨立驗證資料，任何用於變更設計的結論須標明仍未辨識項；由模型與設計負責人共同簽認適用情境。
knowledge.textEn: Back-analysis records include parameter ranges, correlations and independent validation. Conclusions used for design changes identify unresolved parameters, and modeling and design leads jointly approve the applicable scenarios.

quiz.question: 要驗證「反分析的多解問題」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Non-uniqueness in back-analysis"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
量到的所有應變乘最終彈性模數就是當下內力。
先列出未知參數與獨立觀測數，再用不同參數組計算是否同樣符合位移；加入有物理意義的試驗約束而非任意縮小範圍，保留同樣可行的解，交設計者評估對後續序列的預測分歧。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
All measured strain multiplied by the final elastic modulus gives the current internal force.
List unknown parameters and independent observations, then test whether several parameter sets fit the displacement equally well.
quiz.explanation: 先列出未知參數與獨立觀測數，再用不同參數組計算是否同樣符合位移；加入有物理意義的試驗約束而非任意縮小範圍，保留同樣可行的解，交設計者評估對後續序列的預測分歧。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: List unknown parameters and independent observations, then test whether several parameter sets fit the displacement equally well. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 反分析的多解問題：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Non-uniqueness in back-analysis: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反分析的多解問題」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Non-uniqueness in back-analysis” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 校準到單一斷面的模型可能只是參數互相補償，換到新地層或新序列便失準；若只公布最佳誤差不公布多解性，使用者會高估模型的預測能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A model calibrated to one section may rely on compensating parameters and fail under a new ground condition or sequence. Reporting only its best error while hiding non-uniqueness encourages overconfidence in predictive capability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：校準到單一斷面的模型可能只是參數互相補償，換到新地層或新序列便失準；若只公布最佳誤差不公布多解性，使用者會高估模型的預測能力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reporting only its best error while hiding non-uniqueness encourages overconfidence in predictive capability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模型曲線完全吻合量測就代表所有參數都是真值。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An exact fit to measured movement means that every fitted parameter is its true value." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 校準到單一斷面的模型可能只是參數互相補償，換到新地層或新序列便失準；若只公布最佳誤差不公布多解性，使用者會高估模型的預測能力。
knowledge.textEn: A model calibrated to one section may rely on compensating parameters and fail under a new ground condition or sequence. Reporting only its best error while hiding non-uniqueness encourages overconfidence in predictive capability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「反分析的多解問題」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Non-uniqueness in back-analysis" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 校準到單一斷面的模型可能只是參數互相補償，換到新地層或新序列便失準；若只公布最佳誤差不公布多解性，使用者會高估模型的預測能力。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
缺陷總面積比例很小便不必逐項交接其位置。
optionsEn: A model calibrated to one section may rely on compensating parameters and fail under a new ground condition or sequence.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A small overall defective-area fraction removes the need to hand over each defect location.
quiz.explanation: 校準到單一斷面的模型可能只是參數互相補償，換到新地層或新序列便失準；若只公布最佳誤差不公布多解性，使用者會高估模型的預測能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A model calibrated to one section may rely on compensating parameters and fail under a new ground condition or sequence. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Layered-lining handover and defect map: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖」如何影響隧道分部開挖與支撐的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Layered-lining handover and defect map” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sequential excavation and support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多層襯砌的品質需要逐層追溯，表層完成後會遮蔽接縫、修補與防水介面。缺陷面積比例只能摘要分布，缺陷是否位於力流轉折或滲水路徑比總百分比更影響後續檢查。 假設檢查面積200 m²、已確認需處置區8 m²，面積比8/200=4%；若其中2 m²位於關鍵接縫，不能被其餘192 m²良好區平均掉。 覆蓋後失去定位資訊會使後續滲漏無法連回原缺陷，維修只能猜測路徑；關鍵區域若被總體低缺陷率掩蓋，耐久與可維修性的問題便會延後暴露。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Layered lining needs traceability by layer because the final surface hides joints, repairs and waterproofing interfaces. Defect-area fraction summarizes distribution, but whether a defect lies at a load-path change or water route matters more than the overall percentage. Assume inspected area 200 m² and confirmed treatment area 8 m²: the fraction is 8/200=4%. If 2 m² lies at critical joints, the 192 m² of satisfactory area cannot average that issue away. Losing location information after covering a layer prevents later leaks from being linked to original defects. Repairs then rely on guesses, while a low overall defect rate can hide critical zones and postpone durability and maintainability problems. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Layered-lining handover and defect map” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「缺陷總面積比例很小便不必逐項交接其位置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small overall defective-area fraction removes the need to hand over each defect location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Layered-lining handover and defect map”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖
knowledge.text: 多層襯砌的品質需要逐層追溯，表層完成後會遮蔽接縫、修補與防水介面。缺陷面積比例只能摘要分布，缺陷是否位於力流轉折或滲水路徑比總百分比更影響後續檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Layered lining needs traceability by layer because the final surface hides joints, repairs and waterproofing interfaces. Defect-area fraction summarizes distribution, but whether a defect lies at a load-path change or water route matters more than the overall percentage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：缺陷總面積比例很小便不必逐項交接其位置。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small overall defective-area fraction removes the need to hand over each defect location. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Layered-lining handover and defect map" is correct?
options: 缺陷總面積比例很小便不必逐項交接其位置。
多層襯砌的品質需要逐層追溯，表層完成後會遮蔽接縫、修補與防水介面。
地層與支護曲線一旦相交便證明所有失效均已排除。
optionsEn: A small overall defective-area fraction removes the need to hand over each defect location.
Layered lining needs traceability by layer because the final surface hides joints, repairs and waterproofing interfaces.
An intersection of ground and support curves proves every possible failure mode has been excluded.
quiz.explanation: 多層襯砌的品質需要逐層追溯，表層完成後會遮蔽接縫、修補與防水介面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Layered lining needs traceability by layer because the final surface hides joints, repairs and waterproofing interfaces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Layered-lining handover and defect map: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Layered-lining handover and defect map” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設檢查面積200 m²、已確認需處置區8 m²，面積比8/200=4%；若其中2 m²位於關鍵接縫，不能被其餘192 m²良好區平均掉。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume inspected area 200 m² and confirmed treatment area 8 m²: the fraction is 8/200=4%. If 2 m² lies at critical joints, the 192 m² of satisfactory area cannot average that issue away. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以坐標化照片、厚度點和修補批次建立逐層缺陷圖，抽查下一層施工前的停點簽認；每項處置需有原因、方法核准和完成證據，不能只交總合格面積而省略關鍵接縫的未閉合狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build layer-by-layer defect maps from located photographs, thickness points and repair batches.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設檢查面積200 m²、已確認需處置區8 m²，面積比8/200=4%；若其中2 m²位於關鍵接縫，不能被其餘192 m²良好區平均掉。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume inspected area 200 m² and confirmed treatment area 8 m²: the fraction is 8/200=4%. If 2 m² lies at critical joints, the 192 m² of satisfactory area cannot average that issue away.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Layered-lining handover and defect map", which statement holds?
options: 材料最終強度合格便能證明所有早期受力都合格。
仰拱外形接起來就代表完整承載能力立即形成。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Acceptable final material strength proves that every earlier loading stage was acceptable.
Connecting the visible invert geometry means that full structural capacity is immediately available.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Layered-lining handover and defect map: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Layered-lining handover and defect map” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以坐標化照片、厚度點和修補批次建立逐層缺陷圖，抽查下一層施工前的停點簽認；每項處置需有原因、方法核准和完成證據，不能只交總合格面積而省略關鍵接縫的未閉合狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build layer-by-layer defect maps from located photographs, thickness points and repair batches. Audit hold-point approval before the next layer. Each treatment needs a cause, approved method and completion evidence; total accepted area cannot conceal unresolved conditions at critical joints. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：未閉合缺陷與已完成修補分開列帳，保留覆蓋前影像和批准版本；品質、結構與維護代表共同確認可追溯資料後，才完成襯砌交接。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Separate unresolved defects from completed repairs and retain pre-covering images and approval versions. Quality, structural and maintenance representatives confirm the traceable evidence before the lining handover is closed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：覆蓋後失去定位資訊會使後續滲漏無法連回原缺陷，維修只能猜測路徑；關鍵區域若被總體低缺陷率掩蓋，耐久與可維修性的問題便會延後暴露。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Losing location information after covering a layer prevents later leaks from being linked to original defects. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以坐標化照片、厚度點和修補批次建立逐層缺陷圖，抽查下一層施工前的停點簽認；每項處置需有原因、方法核准和完成證據，不能只交總合格面積而省略關鍵接縫的未閉合狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Build layer-by-layer defect maps from located photographs, thickness points and repair batches. Audit hold-point approval before the next layer. Each treatment needs a cause, approved method and completion evidence; total accepted area cannot conceal unresolved conditions at critical joints.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 未閉合缺陷與已完成修補分開列帳，保留覆蓋前影像和批准版本；品質、結構與維護代表共同確認可追溯資料後，才完成襯砌交接。
knowledge.textEn: Separate unresolved defects from completed repairs and retain pre-covering images and approval versions. Quality, structural and maintenance representatives confirm the traceable evidence before the lining handover is closed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Layered-lining handover and defect map"?
options: 以坐標化照片、厚度點和修補批次建立逐層缺陷圖，抽查下一層施工前的停點簽認；每項處置需有原因、方法核准和完成證據，不能只交總合格面積而省略關鍵接縫的未閉合狀態。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
曲線擬合出有限極限值就能證明隧道已穩定。
optionsEn: Build layer-by-layer defect maps from located photographs, thickness points and repair batches.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A fitted finite asymptote proves that the tunnel has reached a stable condition.
quiz.explanation: 以坐標化照片、厚度點和修補批次建立逐層缺陷圖，抽查下一層施工前的停點簽認；每項處置需有原因、方法核准和完成證據，不能只交總合格面積而省略關鍵接縫的未閉合狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build layer-by-layer defect maps from located photographs, thickness points and repair batches. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Layered-lining handover and defect map: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Layered-lining handover and defect map” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 覆蓋後失去定位資訊會使後續滲漏無法連回原缺陷，維修只能猜測路徑；關鍵區域若被總體低缺陷率掩蓋，耐久與可維修性的問題便會延後暴露。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Losing location information after covering a layer prevents later leaks from being linked to original defects. Repairs then rely on guesses, while a low overall defect rate can hide critical zones and postpone durability and maintainability problems. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：覆蓋後失去定位資訊會使後續滲漏無法連回原缺陷，維修只能猜測路徑；關鍵區域若被總體低缺陷率掩蓋，耐久與可維修性的問題便會延後暴露。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Repairs then rely on guesses, while a low overall defect rate can hide critical zones and postpone durability and maintainability problems.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「缺陷總面積比例很小便不必逐項交接其位置。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small overall defective-area fraction removes the need to hand over each defect location." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 覆蓋後失去定位資訊會使後續滲漏無法連回原缺陷，維修只能猜測路徑；關鍵區域若被總體低缺陷率掩蓋，耐久與可維修性的問題便會延後暴露。
knowledge.textEn: Losing location information after covering a layer prevents later leaks from being linked to original defects. Repairs then rely on guesses, while a low overall defect rate can hide critical zones and postpone durability and maintainability problems.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分層襯砌交接與缺陷圖」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Layered-lining handover and defect map" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
覆蓋後失去定位資訊會使後續滲漏無法連回原缺陷，維修只能猜測路徑；關鍵區域若被總體低缺陷率掩蓋，耐久與可維修性的問題便會延後暴露。
地層與支護曲線一旦相交便證明所有失效均已排除。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Losing location information after covering a layer prevents later leaks from being linked to original defects.
An intersection of ground and support curves proves every possible failure mode has been excluded.
quiz.explanation: 覆蓋後失去定位資訊會使後續滲漏無法連回原缺陷，維修只能猜測路徑；關鍵區域若被總體低缺陷率掩蓋，耐久與可維修性的問題便會延後暴露。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Losing location information after covering a layer prevents later leaks from being linked to original defects. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 隧道台階法施工
summary: 台階法把上半斷面、下半斷面與仰拱分階段形成，各階段的支承位置和自由邊界都會改變。本課追蹤拱腳承載、保留核心、左右開挖與閉合距離的互相影響，再以幾何、物料、收斂及排水資料進行核對。所有算例服務於辨識荷載轉移與資料限制，不指定實際台階長度、開挖步距或拆除程序。
summaryEn: Bench excavation forms the upper section, lower section and invert in stages, changing support locations and free boundaries along the way. The course follows arch-foot bearing, retained core, left-right excavation and closure distance, checking their interaction through geometry, quantities, convergence and drainage evidence. Calculations identify load transfer and data limitations; they do not prescribe actual bench lengths, excavation increments or removal procedures.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下原創算例針對台階開挖的拱腳承載、核心保留與仰拱閉合時序，每個輸入都是教學假設而非地標實測資料。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設垂直合力W=900 kN且對稱，左右反力各450 kN；若假設分配為60%與40%，則為540及360 kN，總和仍為900 kN。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設兩作業點穩定相距12 m、同步平均推進2 m/day，一斷面等待時間12/2=6 days；加入3天停頓則為9 days，非允許等待期。兩式只回答各自所列的量與邊界，不應把單一平均結果當成整體穩定證明。請另以最不利的幾何、時間或接觸條件代入，分別標示量測誤差和模型偏差；交接記錄須保留原單位、資料日期以及未能確認的條件。
workedExample.textEn: This original worked example examines bench excavation, arch-foot bearing, retained core and invert-closure timing. Every input is a teaching assumption, not a measured value from a landmark. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume vertical resultant W=900 kN. Symmetry gives 450 kN at each side. A hypothetical 60/40 split instead gives 540 and 360 kN, still summing to 900 kN. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume two work points remain 12 m apart while advancing at 2 m/day. A section waits 12/2=6 days; a three-day shutdown makes nine days. Neither is an allowable waiting period. Each relation answers only its stated quantity under its stated boundary conditions. A favorable mean value is not proof of overall stability. Recalculate with an adverse geometry, timing or contact condition, distinguishing measurement uncertainty from model error. The handover record must retain original units, observation dates and conditions that remain unverified; the responsible designer decides whether additional evidence is needed.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「上半斷面與反力位置」與「台階長度與暴露歷程」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Upper section and reaction locations" and "Bench length and exposure history": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 上半斷面與反力位置：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Upper section and reaction locations: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「上半斷面與反力位置」如何影響隧道台階法施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Upper section and reaction locations” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Bench excavation for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 上半支護形成後，拱部需求先傳到當時可用的拱腳與地層；下半部未開挖並不表示它沒有受力。簡化對稱反力只適合展示力平衡，傾斜地層和幾何不對稱都會改變左右分配。 假設垂直合力W=900 kN且對稱，左右反力各450 kN；若假設分配為60%與40%，則為540及360 kN，總和仍為900 kN。 一側拱腳較軟會使支護旋轉或重新分配反力，總位移平均值可能不大但局部彎矩上升；只核對總荷載會忽略支承差異所引起的細部需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「上半斷面與反力位置」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After upper support forms, crown demand reaches the available arch feet and surrounding ground. An unexcavated lower section is still mechanically involved. Symmetric reactions illustrate equilibrium only; inclined strata and asymmetric geometry can alter left-right load sharing. Assume vertical resultant W=900 kN. Symmetry gives 450 kN at each side. A hypothetical 60/40 split instead gives 540 and 360 kN, still summing to 900 kN. A softer arch foot may rotate the lining or redistribute reactions. Average movement can remain modest while local bending increases. Checking total load alone therefore misses demands caused by unequal support conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Upper section and reaction locations” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總荷載不變就表示左右拱腳需求一定不變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An unchanged total load means that demand at each arch foot must also remain unchanged." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「上半斷面與反力位置」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Upper section and reaction locations”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 上半斷面與反力位置
knowledge.text: 上半支護形成後，拱部需求先傳到當時可用的拱腳與地層；下半部未開挖並不表示它沒有受力。簡化對稱反力只適合展示力平衡，傾斜地層和幾何不對稱都會改變左右分配。
knowledge.textEn: After upper support forms, crown demand reaches the available arch feet and surrounding ground. An unexcavated lower section is still mechanically involved.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總荷載不變就表示左右拱腳需求一定不變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An unchanged total load means that demand at each arch foot must also remain unchanged. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「上半斷面與反力位置」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Upper section and reaction locations" is correct?
options: 總荷載不變就表示左右拱腳需求一定不變。
上半支護形成後，拱部需求先傳到當時可用的拱腳與地層；下半部未開挖並不表示它沒有受力。
台階長度維持固定就代表每個斷面的受力歷程相同。
optionsEn: An unchanged total load means that demand at each arch foot must also remain unchanged.
After upper support forms, crown demand reaches the available arch feet and surrounding ground.
A fixed bench length means that every section experiences an identical loading history.
quiz.explanation: 上半支護形成後，拱部需求先傳到當時可用的拱腳與地層；下半部未開挖並不表示它沒有受力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After upper support forms, crown demand reaches the available arch feet and surrounding ground. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 上半斷面與反力位置：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Upper section and reaction locations: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「上半斷面與反力位置」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Upper section and reaction locations” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設垂直合力W=900 kN且對稱，左右反力各450 kN；若假設分配為60%與40%，則為540及360 kN，總和仍為900 kN。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume vertical resultant W=900 kN. Symmetry gives 450 kN at each side. A hypothetical 60/40 split instead gives 540 and 360 kN, still summing to 900 kN. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將拱腳位置、支護形狀與量測變形對到同一斷面，核對左右地層是否支持對稱假設；比較拱腳沉陷與上部收斂的關聯，若反應不對稱，保留偏載情境送設計者審查而非直接取平均。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map arch-foot locations, support shape and measured movement onto one section.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設垂直合力W=900 kN且對稱，左右反力各450 kN；若假設分配為60%與40%，則為540及360 kN，總和仍為900 kN。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume vertical resultant W=900 kN. Symmetry gives 450 kN at each side. A hypothetical 60/40 split instead gives 540 and 360 kN, still summing to 900 kN.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「上半斷面與反力位置」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Upper section and reaction locations", which statement holds?
options: 核心保留體積比例就是它提供的抗力比例。
出碴重量和幾何量不符時，只要修改密度就能解決。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: The retained core volume percentage equals the percentage of resistance it provides.
Whenever muck mass and geometry disagree, changing the assumed density resolves the problem.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 上半斷面與反力位置：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Upper section and reaction locations: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「上半斷面與反力位置」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Upper section and reaction locations” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將拱腳位置、支護形狀與量測變形對到同一斷面，核對左右地層是否支持對稱假設；比較拱腳沉陷與上部收斂的關聯，若反應不對稱，保留偏載情境送設計者審查而非直接取平均。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map arch-foot locations, support shape and measured movement onto one section. Check whether the ground supports symmetry. Compare foot settlement with upper convergence; if behavior is asymmetric, retain eccentric-load scenarios for designer review rather than replacing them with a mean. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每階段圖面標出當時有效支承而非最終支承，偏載假設與量測差異另列；下半開挖前由設計和現場技術負責人確認荷載路徑。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Stage drawings show currently effective supports rather than final ones. List eccentric-load assumptions and observational differences separately; design and site technical leads confirm the load path before lower excavation proceeds.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一側拱腳較軟會使支護旋轉或重新分配反力，總位移平均值可能不大但局部彎矩上升；只核對總荷載會忽略支承差異所引起的細部需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A softer arch foot may rotate the lining or redistribute reactions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將拱腳位置、支護形狀與量測變形對到同一斷面，核對左右地層是否支持對稱假設；比較拱腳沉陷與上部收斂的關聯，若反應不對稱，保留偏載情境送設計者審查而非直接取平均。
knowledge.textEn: Map arch-foot locations, support shape and measured movement onto one section. Check whether the ground supports symmetry. Compare foot settlement with upper convergence; if behavior is asymmetric, retain eccentric-load scenarios for designer review rather than replacing them with a mean.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每階段圖面標出當時有效支承而非最終支承，偏載假設與量測差異另列；下半開挖前由設計和現場技術負責人確認荷載路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Stage drawings show currently effective supports rather than final ones. List eccentric-load assumptions and observational differences separately; design and site technical leads confirm the load path before lower excavation proceeds.

quiz.question: 要驗證「上半斷面與反力位置」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Upper section and reaction locations"?
options: 將拱腳位置、支護形狀與量測變形對到同一斷面，核對左右地層是否支持對稱假設；比較拱腳沉陷與上部收斂的關聯，若反應不對稱，保留偏載情境送設計者審查而非直接取平均。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
多量幾次取平均就能消除任何種類的測量誤差。
optionsEn: Map arch-foot locations, support shape and measured movement onto one section.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Repeating measurements and averaging removes every type of measurement error, including systematic bias.
quiz.explanation: 將拱腳位置、支護形狀與量測變形對到同一斷面，核對左右地層是否支持對稱假設；比較拱腳沉陷與上部收斂的關聯，若反應不對稱，保留偏載情境送設計者審查而非直接取平均。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map arch-foot locations, support shape and measured movement onto one section. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 上半斷面與反力位置：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Upper section and reaction locations: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「上半斷面與反力位置」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Upper section and reaction locations” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一側拱腳較軟會使支護旋轉或重新分配反力，總位移平均值可能不大但局部彎矩上升；只核對總荷載會忽略支承差異所引起的細部需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A softer arch foot may rotate the lining or redistribute reactions. Average movement can remain modest while local bending increases. Checking total load alone therefore misses demands caused by unequal support conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：一側拱腳較軟會使支護旋轉或重新分配反力，總位移平均值可能不大但局部彎矩上升；只核對總荷載會忽略支承差異所引起的細部需求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Checking total load alone therefore misses demands caused by unequal support conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總荷載不變就表示左右拱腳需求一定不變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An unchanged total load means that demand at each arch foot must also remain unchanged." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一側拱腳較軟會使支護旋轉或重新分配反力，總位移平均值可能不大但局部彎矩上升；只核對總荷載會忽略支承差異所引起的細部需求。
knowledge.textEn: A softer arch foot may rotate the lining or redistribute reactions. Average movement can remain modest while local bending increases. Checking total load alone therefore misses demands caused by unequal support conditions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「上半斷面與反力位置」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Upper section and reaction locations" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
一側拱腳較軟會使支護旋轉或重新分配反力，總位移平均值可能不大但局部彎矩上升；只核對總荷載會忽略支承差異所引起的細部需求。
台階長度維持固定就代表每個斷面的受力歷程相同。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A softer arch foot may rotate the lining or redistribute reactions.
A fixed bench length means that every section experiences an identical loading history.
quiz.explanation: 一側拱腳較軟會使支護旋轉或重新分配反力，總位移平均值可能不大但局部彎矩上升；只核對總荷載會忽略支承差異所引起的細部需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A softer arch foot may rotate the lining or redistribute reactions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 台階長度與暴露歷程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bench length and exposure history: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「台階長度與暴露歷程」如何影響隧道台階法施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bench length and exposure history” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Bench excavation for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 上半掌子面到下半支護完成點的距離，代表不同斷面停留於開口狀態的時間歷程。進尺相同但中途停機不同，會形成不同暴露時間，因此台階長度不能單獨替代施工序列和地層時間效應。 假設兩作業點穩定相距12 m、同步平均推進2 m/day，一斷面等待時間12/2=6 days；加入3天停頓則為9 days，非允許等待期。 只追蹤掌子面距離會忽略停機期間的變形累積，長台階與時間相依地層疊加時尤其明顯；資料缺少時間戳便無法回溯何時偏離原假設。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「台階長度與暴露歷程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The distance from the upper face to completed lower support represents a history of open-section exposure. Equal advance with different shutdown periods produces different exposure times. Bench length alone cannot replace a construction sequence or account for time-dependent ground behavior. Assume two work points remain 12 m apart while advancing at 2 m/day. A section waits 12/2=6 days; a three-day shutdown makes nine days. Neither is an allowable waiting period. Tracking face distance alone misses movement accumulating during shutdown, particularly when a long bench coincides with time-dependent ground. Without timestamps, investigators cannot reconstruct when conditions departed from the original assumptions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bench length and exposure history” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「台階長度維持固定就代表每個斷面的受力歷程相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fixed bench length means that every section experiences an identical loading history." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「台階長度與暴露歷程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bench length and exposure history”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 台階長度與暴露歷程
knowledge.text: 上半掌子面到下半支護完成點的距離，代表不同斷面停留於開口狀態的時間歷程。進尺相同但中途停機不同，會形成不同暴露時間，因此台階長度不能單獨替代施工序列和地層時間效應。
knowledge.textEn: The distance from the upper face to completed lower support represents a history of open-section exposure. Equal advance with different shutdown periods produces different exposure times.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：台階長度維持固定就代表每個斷面的受力歷程相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A fixed bench length means that every section experiences an identical loading history. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「台階長度與暴露歷程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bench length and exposure history" is correct?
options: 台階長度維持固定就代表每個斷面的受力歷程相同。
名義拱腳寬度乘長度永遠等於有效接觸面積。
上半掌子面到下半支護完成點的距離，代表不同斷面停留於開口狀態的時間歷程。
optionsEn: A fixed bench length means that every section experiences an identical loading history.
Nominal arch-foot width multiplied by length always equals the effective loaded contact area.
The distance from the upper face to completed lower support represents a history of open-section exposure.
quiz.explanation: 上半掌子面到下半支護完成點的距離，代表不同斷面停留於開口狀態的時間歷程。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The distance from the upper face to completed lower support represents a history of open-section exposure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 台階長度與暴露歷程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bench length and exposure history: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「台階長度與暴露歷程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bench length and exposure history” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設兩作業點穩定相距12 m、同步平均推進2 m/day，一斷面等待時間12/2=6 days；加入3天停頓則為9 days，非允許等待期。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume two work points remain 12 m apart while advancing at 2 m/day. A section waits 12/2=6 days; a three-day shutdown makes nine days. Neither is an allowable waiting period. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從各斷面的時間戳重建上半、下半與仰拱完成日期，特別保留停機而無進尺的區間；將這份歷程與收斂曲線比較，確認時間與距離效應是否混淆，不能用班平均進尺補掉長時間缺測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconstruct upper, lower and invert completion dates for each section using timestamps, preserving stationary shutdown intervals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設兩作業點穩定相距12 m、同步平均推進2 m/day，一斷面等待時間12/2=6 days；加入3天停頓則為9 days，非允許等待期。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume two work points remain 12 m apart while advancing at 2 m/day. A section waits 12/2=6 days; a three-day shutdown makes nine days. Neither is an allowable waiting period.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「台階長度與暴露歷程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bench length and exposure history", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
左右沉陷平均不大就能排除偏轉與接縫問題。
只要每天施工仰拱，最終一定會追上仍前進的掌子面。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
A small average of left and right settlements rules out rotation and joint problems.
Daily invert construction necessarily catches a face that continues advancing at any speed.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 台階長度與暴露歷程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bench length and exposure history: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「台階長度與暴露歷程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bench length and exposure history” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從各斷面的時間戳重建上半、下半與仰拱完成日期，特別保留停機而無進尺的區間；將這份歷程與收斂曲線比較，確認時間與距離效應是否混淆，不能用班平均進尺補掉長時間缺測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct upper, lower and invert completion dates for each section using timestamps, preserving stationary shutdown intervals. Compare this history with convergence and distinguish time from distance effects. Shift-average advance must not be used to fill long gaps in observations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：施工日誌以斷面編號連結日期和地層，不只保存累計公尺數；延長等待或調整台階時序須由核准審查程序評估，不以算例天數作排程許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Link dates and ground conditions to section identifiers, not just accumulated meters. Extended waiting or altered bench timing follows the approved review process; classroom durations are not scheduling authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只追蹤掌子面距離會忽略停機期間的變形累積，長台階與時間相依地層疊加時尤其明顯；資料缺少時間戳便無法回溯何時偏離原假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Tracking face distance alone misses movement accumulating during shutdown, particularly when a long bench coincides with time-dependent ground. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從各斷面的時間戳重建上半、下半與仰拱完成日期，特別保留停機而無進尺的區間；將這份歷程與收斂曲線比較，確認時間與距離效應是否混淆，不能用班平均進尺補掉長時間缺測。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct upper, lower and invert completion dates for each section using timestamps, preserving stationary shutdown intervals. Compare this history with convergence and distinguish time from distance effects. Shift-average advance must not be used to fill long gaps in observations.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 施工日誌以斷面編號連結日期和地層，不只保存累計公尺數；延長等待或調整台階時序須由核准審查程序評估，不以算例天數作排程許可。
knowledge.textEn: Link dates and ground conditions to section identifiers, not just accumulated meters. Extended waiting or altered bench timing follows the approved review process; classroom durations are not scheduling authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「台階長度與暴露歷程」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bench length and exposure history"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
從各斷面的時間戳重建上半、下半與仰拱完成日期，特別保留停機而無進尺的區間；將這份歷程與收斂曲線比較，確認時間與距離效應是否混淆，不能用班平均進尺補掉長時間缺測。
只要排水設備足夠大，增加湧水就不需要地工判讀。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Reconstruct upper, lower and invert completion dates for each section using timestamps, preserving stationary shutdown intervals.
Sufficient pumping capacity makes additional inflow irrelevant to geotechnical interpretation and support review.
quiz.explanation: 從各斷面的時間戳重建上半、下半與仰拱完成日期，特別保留停機而無進尺的區間；將這份歷程與收斂曲線比較，確認時間與距離效應是否混淆，不能用班平均進尺補掉長時間缺測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct upper, lower and invert completion dates for each section using timestamps, preserving stationary shutdown intervals. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

Without timestamps, investigators cannot reconstruct when conditions departed from the original assumptions. steps.observation: 連結機制：只追蹤掌子面距離會忽略停機期間的變形累積，長台階與時間相依地層疊加時尤其明顯；資料缺少時間戳便無法回溯何時偏離原假設。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without timestamps, investigators cannot reconstruct when conditions departed from the original assumptions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「台階長度維持固定就代表每個斷面的受力歷程相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fixed bench length means that every section experiences an identical loading history." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只追蹤掌子面距離會忽略停機期間的變形累積，長台階與時間相依地層疊加時尤其明顯；資料缺少時間戳便無法回溯何時偏離原假設。
knowledge.textEn: Tracking face distance alone misses movement accumulating during shutdown, particularly when a long bench coincides with time-dependent ground. Without timestamps, investigators cannot reconstruct when conditions departed from the original assumptions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「台階長度與暴露歷程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bench length and exposure history" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
名義拱腳寬度乘長度永遠等於有效接觸面積。
只追蹤掌子面距離會忽略停機期間的變形累積，長台階與時間相依地層疊加時尤其明顯；資料缺少時間戳便無法回溯何時偏離原假設。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Nominal arch-foot width multiplied by length always equals the effective loaded contact area.
Tracking face distance alone misses movement accumulating during shutdown, particularly when a long bench coincides with time-dependent ground.
quiz.explanation: 只追蹤掌子面距離會忽略停機期間的變形累積，長台階與時間相依地層疊加時尤其明顯；資料缺少時間戳便無法回溯何時偏離原假設。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Tracking face distance alone misses movement accumulating during shutdown, particularly when a long bench coincides with time-dependent ground. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「拱腳面積與接觸承壓」與「保留核心與幾何邊界」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Arch-foot area and contact bearing" and "Retained core and geometric boundaries": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 拱腳面積與接觸承壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Arch-foot area and contact bearing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拱腳面積與接觸承壓」如何影響隧道台階法施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arch-foot area and contact bearing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Bench excavation for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱腳把集中反力傳到地層或暫時基座，名義寬度不一定等於有效接觸寬度。接觸不平、偏心與局部軟弱層會改變壓力分布，平均承壓只能作為追問接觸機制的起點。 假設反力R=600 kN、有效接觸A=1.2 m²，平均q=500 kPa；若接觸降為0.8 m²，q=750 kPa，未檢查地層承載或沉陷。 基座局部沖刷或軟化使有效面積縮小，支護可能在總反力不變時產生額外沉陷；若外觀遮蔽接觸面，僅看上部襯砌會延後發現承載路徑的變化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拱腳面積與接觸承壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An arch foot transfers concentrated reaction to ground or a temporary base, and nominal width may differ from effective contact. Uneven seating, eccentricity and weak seams alter pressure distribution. Mean bearing is only the starting point for examining that mechanism. Assume reaction R=600 kN and effective contact A=1.2 m². Mean bearing q=500 kPa; with A=0.8 m² it becomes 750 kPa, without checking ground capacity or settlement. Local erosion or softening can reduce effective footing contact and cause settlement at unchanged total reaction. When the contact is hidden, inspecting only the upper lining delays recognition of the changed bearing path below it. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Arch-foot area and contact bearing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「名義拱腳寬度乘長度永遠等於有效接觸面積。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Nominal arch-foot width multiplied by length always equals the effective loaded contact area." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拱腳面積與接觸承壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Arch-foot area and contact bearing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拱腳面積與接觸承壓
knowledge.text: 拱腳把集中反力傳到地層或暫時基座，名義寬度不一定等於有效接觸寬度。接觸不平、偏心與局部軟弱層會改變壓力分布，平均承壓只能作為追問接觸機制的起點。
knowledge.textEn: An arch foot transfers concentrated reaction to ground or a temporary base, and nominal width may differ from effective contact. Uneven seating, eccentricity and weak seams alter pressure distribution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：名義拱腳寬度乘長度永遠等於有效接觸面積。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Nominal arch-foot width multiplied by length always equals the effective loaded contact area. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「拱腳面積與接觸承壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Arch-foot area and contact bearing" is correct?
options: 拱腳把集中反力傳到地層或暫時基座，名義寬度不一定等於有效接觸寬度。
名義拱腳寬度乘長度永遠等於有效接觸面積。
核心保留體積比例就是它提供的抗力比例。
optionsEn: An arch foot transfers concentrated reaction to ground or a temporary base, and nominal width may differ from effective contact.
Nominal arch-foot width multiplied by length always equals the effective loaded contact area.
The retained core volume percentage equals the percentage of resistance it provides.
quiz.explanation: 拱腳把集中反力傳到地層或暫時基座，名義寬度不一定等於有效接觸寬度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An arch foot transfers concentrated reaction to ground or a temporary base, and nominal width may differ from effective contact. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 拱腳面積與接觸承壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Arch-foot area and contact bearing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拱腳面積與接觸承壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Arch-foot area and contact bearing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設反力R=600 kN、有效接觸A=1.2 m²，平均q=500 kPa；若接觸降為0.8 m²，q=750 kPa，未檢查地層承載或沉陷。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume reaction R=600 kN and effective contact A=1.2 m². Mean bearing q=500 kPa; with A=0.8 m² it becomes 750 kPa, without checking ground capacity or settlement. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對竣工接觸尺寸、地層描述及拱腳沉陷，將偏心與接觸缺口畫在同一圖上；必要試驗須代表實際材料和受力方向，不能把其他位置的承載數字直接移用，異常由基礎與支護設計者審查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check as-built contact dimensions, ground descriptions and arch-foot settlement, mapping eccentricity and gaps together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設反力R=600 kN、有效接觸A=1.2 m²，平均q=500 kPa；若接觸降為0.8 m²，q=750 kPa，未檢查地層承載或沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume reaction R=600 kN and effective contact A=1.2 m². Mean bearing q=500 kPa; with A=0.8 m² it becomes 750 kPa, without checking ground capacity or settlement.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「拱腳面積與接觸承壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Arch-foot area and contact bearing", which statement holds?
options: 出碴重量和幾何量不符時，只要修改密度就能解決。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
多量幾次取平均就能消除任何種類的測量誤差。
optionsEn: Whenever muck mass and geometry disagree, changing the assumed density resolves the problem.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Repeating measurements and averaging removes every type of measurement error, including systematic bias.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 拱腳面積與接觸承壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Arch-foot area and contact bearing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拱腳面積與接觸承壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Arch-foot area and contact bearing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對竣工接觸尺寸、地層描述及拱腳沉陷，將偏心與接觸缺口畫在同一圖上；必要試驗須代表實際材料和受力方向，不能把其他位置的承載數字直接移用，異常由基礎與支護設計者審查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check as-built contact dimensions, ground descriptions and arch-foot settlement, mapping eccentricity and gaps together. Supporting tests must represent the actual material and loading direction. Do not transplant a capacity value from another location; foundation and support designers review anomalies. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：拱腳交接記錄包含接觸條件和地下水變化，未知面積以範圍呈現；支承處置由設計者核准，平均承壓計算不作現場加載依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Arch-foot handover records include contact conditions and groundwater changes, expressing uncertain area as a range. The designer approves support treatment; average-pressure calculations do not authorize field loading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基座局部沖刷或軟化使有效面積縮小，支護可能在總反力不變時產生額外沉陷；若外觀遮蔽接觸面，僅看上部襯砌會延後發現承載路徑的變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local erosion or softening can reduce effective footing contact and cause settlement at unchanged total reaction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

Supporting tests must represent the actual material and loading direction. Do not transplant a capacity value from another location; foundation and support designers review anomalies.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 拱腳交接記錄包含接觸條件和地下水變化，未知面積以範圍呈現；支承處置由設計者核准，平均承壓計算不作現場加載依據。
knowledge.textEn: Arch-foot handover records include contact conditions and groundwater changes, expressing uncertain area as a range. The designer approves support treatment; average-pressure calculations do not authorize field loading.

quiz.question: 要驗證「拱腳面積與接觸承壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Arch-foot area and contact bearing"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
平均斷面尺寸合格就表示所有淨空介面都合格。

quiz.explanationEn: Check as-built contact dimensions, ground descriptions and arch-foot settlement, mapping eccentricity and gaps together. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

quiz.question: 在「拱腳面積與接觸承壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Arch-foot area and contact bearing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
