With one absent, 600 kN remains against assumed demand 700 kN, leaving a 100 kN gap before factors or group effects.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「暫時構件減少與需求缺口」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Temporary-member reduction and demand gap", which statement holds?
options: 暫時牆拆掉後，其原接縫就不再影響永久襯砌。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
跨度減半就代表整個地下工程的風險必然減為四分之一。
optionsEn: Once a temporary wall is removed, its former joints no longer affect the permanent lining.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Halving a span necessarily reduces the risk of the whole underground work to one quarter.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 暫時構件減少與需求缺口：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Temporary-member reduction and demand gap: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「暫時構件減少與需求缺口」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Temporary-member reduction and demand gap” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立每階段支承清單與方向圖，核對能力是否有可追溯設計依據以及構件是否實際有效；先查總量平衡，再查個別分配和連接，任何需求缺口須由設計者明確處理，不能靠修改報表平均值消失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build stage-specific support inventories and force-direction diagrams, checking traceable resistance assumptions and actual availability. Review total equilibrium before individual distribution and connections. The designer must explicitly address any demand gap; changing an average in a report cannot remove it. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：構件清單分開列已完成、已驗證與待核准狀態，禁止把計畫構件當成現有支承；暫時工程主管和結構設計者共同簽認每階段力流。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Distinguish completed, verified and pending members in the inventory. Planned members cannot count as existing support. The temporary-works lead and structural designer jointly approve the load path at each stage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若構件尚未達齡期或接點未完成卻被算入可用數量，能力表會高估實際系統；逐項少算需求又可能讓總表看似平衡，掩蓋某一關鍵施工階段的缺口。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting members before adequate age or connection completion overstates the available system. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「暫時構件減少與需求缺口」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Temporary-member reduction and demand gap"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
暫時牆壓應力低於材料強度就不會發生失穩。
建立每階段支承清單與方向圖，核對能力是否有可追溯設計依據以及構件是否實際有效。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A temporary wall cannot become unstable while compressive stress remains below material strength.
Build stage-specific support inventories and force-direction diagrams, checking traceable resistance assumptions and actual availability.

quiz.explanationEn: Build stage-specific support inventories and force-direction diagrams, checking traceable resistance assumptions and actual availability. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 暫時構件減少與需求缺口：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Temporary-member reduction and demand gap: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「暫時構件減少與需求缺口」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Temporary-member reduction and demand gap” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若構件尚未達齡期或接點未完成卻被算入可用數量，能力表會高估實際系統；逐項少算需求又可能讓總表看似平衡，掩蓋某一關鍵施工階段的缺口。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting members before adequate age or connection completion overstates the available system. Understating separate demands can then make the totals appear balanced while concealing a gap at a critical construction stage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若構件尚未達齡期或接點未完成卻被算入可用數量，能力表會高估實際系統；逐項少算需求又可能讓總表看似平衡，掩蓋某一關鍵施工階段的缺口。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Understating separate demands can then make the totals appear balanced while concealing a gap at a critical construction stage.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要平均分到各支承的力不大，缺少構件就沒有影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Missing members have no effect as long as the average force per support looks modest." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若構件尚未達齡期或接點未完成卻被算入可用數量，能力表會高估實際系統；逐項少算需求又可能讓總表看似平衡，掩蓋某一關鍵施工階段的缺口。
knowledge.textEn: Counting members before adequate age or connection completion overstates the available system. Understating separate demands can then make the totals appear balanced while concealing a gap at a critical construction stage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「暫時構件減少與需求缺口」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Temporary-member reduction and demand gap" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若構件尚未達齡期或接點未完成卻被算入可用數量，能力表會高估實際系統；逐項少算需求又可能讓總表看似平衡，掩蓋某一關鍵施工階段的缺口。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
任何兩項量測不確定度都可直接平方和開根號。
optionsEn: Counting members before adequate age or connection completion overstates the available system.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Any two measurement uncertainties can always be combined by root-sum-square without further checks.
quiz.explanation: 若構件尚未達齡期或接點未完成卻被算入可用數量，能力表會高估實際系統；逐項少算需求又可能讓總表看似平衡，掩蓋某一關鍵施工階段的缺口。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting members before adequate age or connection completion overstates the available system. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「共同基準與相關誤差」與「階段模型與保留驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shared reference and correlated uncertainty" and "Staged model and withheld validation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 共同基準與相關誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared reference and correlated uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「共同基準與相關誤差」如何影響大斷面隧道雙側壁導坑法的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shared reference and correlated uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-drift excavation for large tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 左右導坑量測常共用基準，因此誤差可能相關；平方和只適用獨立分量。若要比較組合量，必須依加減方向包含共變異數，不然資料看似精密也可能低估或高估實際不確定度。 假設相加量兩項標準差2與3 mm、相關係數ρ=0.5，σ=√(2²+3²+2×0.5×2×3)=4.36 mm；若獨立則3.61 mm。 把共用基準的資料當完全獨立會錯估合成不確定度，導致異常判定過度敏感或不夠敏感；若正負號也混淆，左右差異甚至可能被錯誤放大。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「共同基準與相關誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measurements in both drifts may share a reference, creating correlated errors. Root-sum-square applies only to independent components. For a combined quantity, covariance must follow the chosen addition or subtraction; otherwise apparent precision can understate or overstate uncertainty. For a sum, assume standard deviations 2 and 3 mm and correlation ρ=0.5. σ=√(2²+3²+2×0.5×2×3)=4.36 mm; independence would give 3.61 mm. Treating shared-reference data as independent misstates combined uncertainty and can make anomaly detection too sensitive or too insensitive. Confusing signs adds another error and may exaggerate a left-right difference that the observations do not support. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Shared reference and correlated uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何兩項量測不確定度都可直接平方和開根號。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any two measurement uncertainties can always be combined by root-sum-square without further checks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「共同基準與相關誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Shared reference and correlated uncertainty”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 共同基準與相關誤差
knowledge.text: 左右導坑量測常共用基準，因此誤差可能相關；平方和只適用獨立分量。若要比較組合量，必須依加減方向包含共變異數，不然資料看似精密也可能低估或高估實際不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Measurements in both drifts may share a reference, creating correlated errors. Root-sum-square applies only to independent components.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何兩項量測不確定度都可直接平方和開根號。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any two measurement uncertainties can always be combined by root-sum-square without further checks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共同基準與相關誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shared reference and correlated uncertainty" is correct?
options: 任何兩項量測不確定度都可直接平方和開根號。
左右導坑量測常共用基準，因此誤差可能相關；平方和只適用獨立分量。
模型全期平均誤差很小便表示每一次構件變更都可靠。
optionsEn: Any two measurement uncertainties can always be combined by root-sum-square without further checks.
Measurements in both drifts may share a reference, creating correlated errors.
A small whole-history average error makes every modeled member change reliable and validated.
quiz.explanation: 左右導坑量測常共用基準，因此誤差可能相關；平方和只適用獨立分量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Measurements in both drifts may share a reference, creating correlated errors. The other options are common misconceptions.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

steps.title: 共同基準與相關誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shared reference and correlated uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「共同基準與相關誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shared reference and correlated uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對兩組量測是否共用設站、控制點或氣象修正，先定義比較量是和還是差；從重複觀測估計相關性時保留樣本限制，基準偏差另行調查，不以套入相關係數掩蓋未查明的系統誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check shared setup, control and atmospheric correction, first defining whether the comparison is a sum or difference. Retain sample limitations when estimating correlation from repetitions. Investigate reference bias separately rather than inserting a coefficient to conceal an unexplained systematic error. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：量測報告保留坐標、組合公式與共用誤差來源，相關性不明時提供情境範圍；監測主管與設計者確認後，才用於施工階段比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reports retain coordinates, combination formulas and shared-error sources. Where correlation is unknown, provide scenario bounds. Monitoring and design leads confirm the treatment before using it to compare construction stages.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把共用基準的資料當完全獨立會錯估合成不確定度，導致異常判定過度敏感或不夠敏感；若正負號也混淆，左右差異甚至可能被錯誤放大。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating shared-reference data as independent misstates combined uncertainty and can make anomaly detection too sensitive or too insensitive. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain sample limitations when estimating correlation from repetitions. Investigate reference bias separately rather than inserting a coefficient to conceal an unexplained systematic error.

steps.title: 共同基準與相關誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shared reference and correlated uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「共同基準與相關誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shared reference and correlated uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把共用基準的資料當完全獨立會錯估合成不確定度，導致異常判定過度敏感或不夠敏感；若正負號也混淆，左右差異甚至可能被錯誤放大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating shared-reference data as independent misstates combined uncertainty and can make anomaly detection too sensitive or too insensitive. Confusing signs adds another error and may exaggerate a left-right difference that the observations do not support. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把共用基準的資料當完全獨立會錯估合成不確定度，導致異常判定過度敏感或不夠敏感；若正負號也混淆，左右差異甚至可能被錯誤放大。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Confusing signs adds another error and may exaggerate a left-right difference that the observations do not support.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任何兩項量測不確定度都可直接平方和開根號。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any two measurement uncertainties can always be combined by root-sum-square without further checks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

模型全期平均誤差很小便表示每一次構件變更都可靠。

steps.title: 階段模型與保留驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Staged model and withheld validation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「階段模型與保留驗證」如何影響大斷面隧道雙側壁導坑法的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Staged model and withheld validation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-drift excavation for large tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 階段模型必須依實際完成狀態啟用構件，才有可能對照量測；總誤差很小不代表每個階段都合理。保留未用於校準的觀測能檢查外推能力，殘差的時間方向比單一誤差數字更有資訊。 假設三個保留觀測為4、7、10 mm，預測為5、7、8 mm，誤差為1、0、-2 mm，RMSE=√[(1²+0²+2²)/3]=1.29 mm。 把驗證資料回填校準後再稱為獨立驗證，會製造過度樂觀的準確度；模型在拆除後系統性低估時，平均誤差可能仍被前期良好吻合稀釋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「階段模型與保留驗證」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A staged model activates members according to actual completion before it can be compared with observations. Small total error does not make every stage credible. Withheld observations test predictive performance, and the temporal pattern of residuals often matters more than one summary metric. Assume withheld observations 4, 7 and 10 mm with predictions 5, 7 and 8 mm. Errors are 1, 0 and -2 mm; RMSE=√[(1²+0²+2²)/3]=1.29 mm. Reusing validation observations for calibration and still calling them independent creates optimistic accuracy. Systematic underprediction after removal can also be diluted by good early fits when only a whole-history average is reported. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Staged model and withheld validation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模型全期平均誤差很小便表示每一次構件變更都可靠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small whole-history average error makes every modeled member change reliable and validated." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「階段模型與保留驗證」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: A staged model activates members according to actual completion before it can be compared with observations. Small total error does not make every stage credible.

knowledge.text: 誤解：模型全期平均誤差很小便表示每一次構件變更都可靠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「階段模型與保留驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「階段模型與保留驗證」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Staged model and withheld validation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查校準與驗證資料是否真正分離，將殘差對照中隔牆狀態與開挖時序；若後期持續低估，須檢討構件啟用、剛度及荷載邊界，不能只用全期RMSE較小便宣稱下一階段已驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify that calibration and validation data are separate, comparing residuals with wall status and excavation chronology. Persistent late underprediction requires reviewing member activation, stiffness and load boundaries. A small whole-history RMSE does not validate the next stage automatically. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：模型版本記錄每個構件的啟用日期與校準資料集，保留後期驗證不回填；拆除相關預測與實際差異由模型和暫時工程負責人共同審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Model versions record activation dates and calibration datasets, keeping later validation genuinely separate. Modeling and temporary-works leads jointly review differences between removal-related predictions and observations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把驗證資料回填校準後再稱為獨立驗證，會製造過度樂觀的準確度；模型在拆除後系統性低估時，平均誤差可能仍被前期良好吻合稀釋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reusing validation observations for calibration and still calling them independent creates optimistic accuracy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Verify that calibration and validation data are separate, comparing residuals with wall status and excavation chronology. Persistent late underprediction requires reviewing member activation, stiffness and load boundaries. A small whole-history RMSE does not validate the next stage automatically.

knowledge.textEn: Model versions record activation dates and calibration datasets, keeping later validation genuinely separate. Modeling and temporary-works leads jointly review differences between removal-related predictions and observations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「階段模型與保留驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Staged model and withheld validation"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
檢查校準與驗證資料是否真正分離，將殘差對照中隔牆狀態與開挖時序；若後期持續低估，須檢討構件啟用、剛度及荷載邊界，不能只用全期RMSE較小便宣稱下一階段已驗證。
外荷載不變就表示拆除一個支承後其他構件內力不變。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Verify that calibration and validation data are separate, comparing residuals with wall status and excavation chronology.
Unchanged external loading means that removing one support cannot change forces in the others.
quiz.explanation: 檢查校準與驗證資料是否真正分離，將殘差對照中隔牆狀態與開挖時序；若後期持續低估，須檢討構件啟用、剛度及荷載邊界，不能只用全期RMSE較小便宣稱下一階段已驗證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify that calibration and validation data are separate, comparing residuals with wall status and excavation chronology. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 階段模型與保留驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Staged model and withheld validation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「階段模型與保留驗證」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Staged model and withheld validation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把驗證資料回填校準後再稱為獨立驗證，會製造過度樂觀的準確度；模型在拆除後系統性低估時，平均誤差可能仍被前期良好吻合稀釋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reusing validation observations for calibration and still calling them independent creates optimistic accuracy. Systematic underprediction after removal can also be diluted by good early fits when only a whole-history average is reported. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把驗證資料回填校準後再稱為獨立驗證，會製造過度樂觀的準確度；模型在拆除後系統性低估時，平均誤差可能仍被前期良好吻合稀釋。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Systematic underprediction after removal can also be diluted by good early fits when only a whole-history average is reported.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模型全期平均誤差很小便表示每一次構件變更都可靠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small whole-history average error makes every modeled member change reliable and validated." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把驗證資料回填校準後再稱為獨立驗證，會製造過度樂觀的準確度；模型在拆除後系統性低估時，平均誤差可能仍被前期良好吻合稀釋。
knowledge.textEn: Reusing validation observations for calibration and still calling them independent creates optimistic accuracy. Systematic underprediction after removal can also be diluted by good early fits when only a whole-history average is reported.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「階段模型與保留驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Staged model and withheld validation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
暫時牆拆掉後，其原接縫就不再影響永久襯砌。
把驗證資料回填校準後再稱為獨立驗證，會製造過度樂觀的準確度；模型在拆除後系統性低估時，平均誤差可能仍被前期良好吻合稀釋。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Once a temporary wall is removed, its former joints no longer affect the permanent lining.
Reusing validation observations for calibration and still calling them independent creates optimistic accuracy.
quiz.explanation: 把驗證資料回填校準後再稱為獨立驗證，會製造過度樂觀的準確度；模型在拆除後系統性低估時，平均誤差可能仍被前期良好吻合稀釋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reusing validation observations for calibration and still calling them independent creates optimistic accuracy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」與「施工狀態清單與交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths" and "Construction-state register and handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 拆牆介面與水壓路徑：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」如何影響大斷面隧道雙側壁導坑法的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-drift excavation for large tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中隔牆移除後，原接觸和施工縫會成為必須確認的防水介面；外部水頭不會因牆被拆除而消失。局部平面水壓合力可顯示需求尺度，但接縫滲漏與結構傳力要分別驗證。 假設淡水水頭18 m，p=9.81×18=176.58 kPa；在假設平面面積1.5 m²上F=264.87 kN，未代表整個曲面襯砌的合力。 拆除留下的凹槽或施工縫若未完成相容處置，可能形成沿界面的滲流路徑；早期沒有漏水不代表耐久可靠，後續水頭改變才可能暴露缺陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After a dividing wall is removed, former contacts and construction joints become interfaces requiring waterproofing verification. External head does not disappear with wall removal. A local planar pressure resultant illustrates scale, while leakage paths and structural transfer need separate checks. Assume freshwater head 18 m: p=9.81×18=176.58 kPa. On an ideal plane area 1.5 m², F=264.87 kN; this is not the resultant over the whole curved lining. A recess or construction joint left without compatible treatment can form an interface seepage path. Lack of early leakage does not establish durability, because a later head change may be what exposes the defect. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「暫時牆拆掉後，其原接縫就不再影響永久襯砌。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a temporary wall is removed, its former joints no longer affect the permanent lining." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拆牆介面與水壓路徑
knowledge.text: 中隔牆移除後，原接觸和施工縫會成為必須確認的防水介面；外部水頭不會因牆被拆除而消失。局部平面水壓合力可顯示需求尺度，但接縫滲漏與結構傳力要分別驗證。
knowledge.textEn: After a dividing wall is removed, former contacts and construction joints become interfaces requiring waterproofing verification. External head does not disappear with wall removal.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：暫時牆拆掉後，其原接縫就不再影響永久襯砌。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a temporary wall is removed, its former joints no longer affect the permanent lining. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths" is correct?
options: 中隔牆移除後，原接觸和施工縫會成為必須確認的防水介面；外部水頭不會因牆被拆除而消失。
暫時牆拆掉後，其原接縫就不再影響永久襯砌。
交接完成率夠高就能把所有剩餘項目視為行政細節。
optionsEn: After a dividing wall is removed, former contacts and construction joints become interfaces requiring waterproofing verification.
Once a temporary wall is removed, its former joints no longer affect the permanent lining.
A high completion percentage makes every remaining handover item merely an administrative detail.
quiz.explanation: 中隔牆移除後，原接觸和施工縫會成為必須確認的防水介面；外部水頭不會因牆被拆除而消失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After a dividing wall is removed, former contacts and construction joints become interfaces requiring waterproofing verification. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 拆牆介面與水壓路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設淡水水頭18 m，p=9.81×18=176.58 kPa；在假設平面面積1.5 m²上F=264.87 kN，未代表整個曲面襯砌的合力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume freshwater head 18 m: p=9.81×18=176.58 kPa. On an ideal plane area 1.5 m², F=264.87 kN; this is not the resultant over the whole curved lining. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將拆牆後暴露的接縫、修補與防水連續性定位記錄，核對外水頭與排水設計是否一致；以核准品質試驗確認介面，乾燥表面不能排除未來水頭增加，需由防水及結構負責人共同核查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Locate exposed joints, repairs and waterproof continuity after removal, checking consistency between external head and drainage design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設淡水水頭18 m，p=9.81×18=176.58 kPa；在假設平面面積1.5 m²上F=264.87 kN，未代表整個曲面襯砌的合力。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume freshwater head 18 m: p=9.81×18=176.58 kPa. On an ideal plane area 1.5 m², F=264.87 kN; this is not the resultant over the whole curved lining.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths", which statement holds?
options: 左右總荷載加總正確就不必檢查合力的位置。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
中隔牆只承擔軸向壓力，所以不需要考慮偏心彎矩。
optionsEn: Correctly adding the left and right forces removes the need to check resultant location.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
A temporary dividing wall carries axial compression only, so eccentric bending need not be considered.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 拆牆介面與水壓路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將拆牆後暴露的接縫、修補與防水連續性定位記錄，核對外水頭與排水設計是否一致；以核准品質試驗確認介面，乾燥表面不能排除未來水頭增加，需由防水及結構負責人共同核查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Locate exposed joints, repairs and waterproof continuity after removal, checking consistency between external head and drainage design. Approved quality tests verify interfaces. A dry surface does not exclude future head increase, so waterproofing and structural leads review the conditions together. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：防水交接另列原中隔牆介面及修補版本，保留覆蓋前證據與維護定位；未閉合項須由相應設計責任人處理，不以無漏水照片取代核准。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Waterproofing handover identifies former wall interfaces and repair versions, retaining pre-covering evidence and maintenance locations. Responsible designers resolve open items; a photograph without leakage is not a substitute for approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：拆除留下的凹槽或施工縫若未完成相容處置，可能形成沿界面的滲流路徑；早期沒有漏水不代表耐久可靠，後續水頭改變才可能暴露缺陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A recess or construction joint left without compatible treatment can form an interface seepage path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將拆牆後暴露的接縫、修補與防水連續性定位記錄，核對外水頭與排水設計是否一致；以核准品質試驗確認介面，乾燥表面不能排除未來水頭增加，需由防水及結構負責人共同核查。
knowledge.textEn: Locate exposed joints, repairs and waterproof continuity after removal, checking consistency between external head and drainage design. Approved quality tests verify interfaces. A dry surface does not exclude future head increase, so waterproofing and structural leads review the conditions together.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 防水交接另列原中隔牆介面及修補版本，保留覆蓋前證據與維護定位；未閉合項須由相應設計責任人處理，不以無漏水照片取代核准。
knowledge.textEn: Waterproofing handover identifies former wall interfaces and repair versions, retaining pre-covering evidence and maintenance locations. Responsible designers resolve open items; a photograph without leakage is not a substitute for approval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要平均分到各支承的力不大，缺少構件就沒有影響。
將拆牆後暴露的接縫、修補與防水連續性定位記錄，核對外水頭與排水設計是否一致；以核准品質試驗確認介面，乾燥表面不能排除未來水頭增加，需由防水及結構負責人共同核查。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Missing members have no effect as long as the average force per support looks modest.
Locate exposed joints, repairs and waterproof continuity after removal, checking consistency between external head and drainage design.
quiz.explanation: 將拆牆後暴露的接縫、修補與防水連續性定位記錄，核對外水頭與排水設計是否一致；以核准品質試驗確認介面，乾燥表面不能排除未來水頭增加，需由防水及結構負責人共同核查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Locate exposed joints, repairs and waterproof continuity after removal, checking consistency between external head and drainage design. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 拆牆介面與水壓路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 拆除留下的凹槽或施工縫若未完成相容處置，可能形成沿界面的滲流路徑；早期沒有漏水不代表耐久可靠，後續水頭改變才可能暴露缺陷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A recess or construction joint left without compatible treatment can form an interface seepage path. Lack of early leakage does not establish durability, because a later head change may be what exposes the defect. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：拆除留下的凹槽或施工縫若未完成相容處置，可能形成沿界面的滲流路徑；早期沒有漏水不代表耐久可靠，後續水頭改變才可能暴露缺陷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Lack of early leakage does not establish durability, because a later head change may be what exposes the defect.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「暫時牆拆掉後，其原接縫就不再影響永久襯砌。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a temporary wall is removed, its former joints no longer affect the permanent lining." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 拆除留下的凹槽或施工縫若未完成相容處置，可能形成沿界面的滲流路徑；早期沒有漏水不代表耐久可靠，後續水頭改變才可能暴露缺陷。
knowledge.textEn: A recess or construction joint left without compatible treatment can form an interface seepage path. Lack of early leakage does not establish durability, because a later head change may be what exposes the defect.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「拆牆介面與水壓路徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wall-removal interfaces and water-pressure paths" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 拆除留下的凹槽或施工縫若未完成相容處置，可能形成沿界面的滲流路徑；早期沒有漏水不代表耐久可靠，後續水頭改變才可能暴露缺陷。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
交接完成率夠高就能把所有剩餘項目視為行政細節。
optionsEn: A recess or construction joint left without compatible treatment can form an interface seepage path.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A high completion percentage makes every remaining handover item merely an administrative detail.
quiz.explanation: 拆除留下的凹槽或施工縫若未完成相容處置，可能形成沿界面的滲流路徑；早期沒有漏水不代表耐久可靠，後續水頭改變才可能暴露缺陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A recess or construction joint left without compatible treatment can form an interface seepage path. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 施工狀態清單與交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Construction-state register and handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工狀態清單與交接」如何影響大斷面隧道雙側壁導坑法的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Construction-state register and handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-drift excavation for large tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型洞室交接需要知道哪些暫時構件已移除、哪些永久介面已驗證，僅有完工外觀圖會遺失施工歷程。清單完成率是資料管理指標，關鍵未閉合項的風險仍需個別決策。 假設交接列80項界面，已核准76項，完成率76/80=95%；剩餘4項若含荷載轉移驗證，即使比例只有5%也不能自動結案。 暫時狀態未更新會讓後續人員以為仍有某個支承，或誤認已完成防水修補；這類文件錯誤可能使維護決策建立在不存在的構件或未驗證的介面上。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工狀態清單與交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cavern handover needs the status of removed temporary members and verified permanent interfaces. An as-finished view alone loses construction history. Register completion is a data-management measure; critical unresolved items still require individual engineering decisions. Assume 80 interface items with 76 approved: completion is 76/80=95%. If the remaining four include load-transfer verification, their 5% share does not justify automatic closure. An outdated temporary-state record can make later staff assume a support remains or a waterproof repair is complete. Maintenance decisions may then rely on a nonexistent member or an interface whose condition has never been verified. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Construction-state register and handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「交接完成率夠高就能把所有剩餘項目視為行政細節。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A high completion percentage makes every remaining handover item merely an administrative detail." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「施工狀態清單與交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Construction-state register and handover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工狀態清單與交接
knowledge.text: 大型洞室交接需要知道哪些暫時構件已移除、哪些永久介面已驗證，僅有完工外觀圖會遺失施工歷程。清單完成率是資料管理指標，關鍵未閉合項的風險仍需個別決策。
knowledge.textEn: Cavern handover needs the status of removed temporary members and verified permanent interfaces. An as-finished view alone loses construction history.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：交接完成率夠高就能把所有剩餘項目視為行政細節。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A high completion percentage makes every remaining handover item merely an administrative detail. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工狀態清單與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Construction-state register and handover" is correct?
options: 交接完成率夠高就能把所有剩餘項目視為行政細節。
大型洞室交接需要知道哪些暫時構件已移除、哪些永久介面已驗證，僅有完工外觀圖會遺失施工歷程。
跨度減半就代表整個地下工程的風險必然減為四分之一。
optionsEn: A high completion percentage makes every remaining handover item merely an administrative detail.
Cavern handover needs the status of removed temporary members and verified permanent interfaces.
Halving a span necessarily reduces the risk of the whole underground work to one quarter.
quiz.explanation: 大型洞室交接需要知道哪些暫時構件已移除、哪些永久介面已驗證，僅有完工外觀圖會遺失施工歷程。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cavern handover needs the status of removed temporary members and verified permanent interfaces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工狀態清單與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Construction-state register and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工狀態清單與交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Construction-state register and handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設交接列80項界面，已核准76項，完成率76/80=95%；剩餘4項若含荷載轉移驗證，即使比例只有5%也不能自動結案。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 80 interface items with 76 approved: completion is 76/80=95%. If the remaining four include load-transfer verification, their 5% share does not justify automatic closure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐項抽查清單能否連到圖面版本、原始量測與核准記錄，特別檢查拆除前後狀態是否一致；將待辦項依機制和責任分列，不能只交一個總完成百分比，維護單位也須能定位永久介面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit whether each register item links to drawing versions, original observations and approvals, especially consistency before and after removal.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設交接列80項界面，已核准76項，完成率76/80=95%；剩餘4項若含荷載轉移驗證，即使比例只有5%也不能自動結案。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 80 interface items with 76 approved: completion is 76/80=95%. If the remaining four include load-transfer verification, their 5% share does not justify automatic closure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工狀態清單與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Construction-state register and handover", which statement holds?
options: 暫時牆壓應力低於材料強度就不會發生失穩。
外荷載不變就表示拆除一個支承後其他構件內力不變。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: A temporary wall cannot become unstable while compressive stress remains below material strength.
Unchanged external loading means that removing one support cannot change forces in the others.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工狀態清單與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Construction-state register and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工狀態清單與交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Construction-state register and handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐項抽查清單能否連到圖面版本、原始量測與核准記錄，特別檢查拆除前後狀態是否一致；將待辦項依機制和責任分列，不能只交一個總完成百分比，維護單位也須能定位永久介面。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit whether each register item links to drawing versions, original observations and approvals, especially consistency before and after removal. Classify open items by mechanism and responsibility rather than handing over one percentage. Maintenance staff must also be able to locate permanent interfaces. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Preserve the link between construction-state history and the permanent asset register, assigning owners and approval conditions to unresolved items. Design, construction, quality and maintenance representatives jointly confirm the record before handover closes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：暫時狀態未更新會讓後續人員以為仍有某個支承，或誤認已完成防水修補；這類文件錯誤可能使維護決策建立在不存在的構件或未驗證的介面上。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An outdated temporary-state record can make later staff assume a support remains or a waterproof repair is complete. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Audit whether each register item links to drawing versions, original observations and approvals, especially consistency before and after removal. Classify open items by mechanism and responsibility rather than handing over one percentage. Maintenance staff must also be able to locate permanent interfaces.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保留施工狀態歷程與永久資產清單的對應，未閉合項指定責任人及核准條件；設計、施工、品質和維護代表共同確認後完成交接。
knowledge.textEn: Preserve the link between construction-state history and the permanent asset register, assigning owners and approval conditions to unresolved items. Design, construction, quality and maintenance representatives jointly confirm the record before handover closes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工狀態清單與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Construction-state register and handover"?
options: 逐項抽查清單能否連到圖面版本、原始量測與核准記錄，特別檢查拆除前後狀態是否一致；將待辦項依機制和責任分列，不能只交一個總完成百分比，維護單位也須能定位永久介面。

quiz.explanationEn: Audit whether each register item links to drawing versions, original observations and approvals, especially consistency before and after removal. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工狀態清單與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Construction-state register and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工狀態清單與交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Construction-state register and handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 暫時狀態未更新會讓後續人員以為仍有某個支承，或誤認已完成防水修補；這類文件錯誤可能使維護決策建立在不存在的構件或未驗證的介面上。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An outdated temporary-state record can make later staff assume a support remains or a waterproof repair is complete. Maintenance decisions may then rely on a nonexistent member or an interface whose condition has never been verified. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：暫時狀態未更新會讓後續人員以為仍有某個支承，或誤認已完成防水修補；這類文件錯誤可能使維護決策建立在不存在的構件或未驗證的介面上。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Maintenance decisions may then rely on a nonexistent member or an interface whose condition has never been verified.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「交接完成率夠高就能把所有剩餘項目視為行政細節。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A high completion percentage makes every remaining handover item merely an administrative detail." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 暫時狀態未更新會讓後續人員以為仍有某個支承，或誤認已完成防水修補；這類文件錯誤可能使維護決策建立在不存在的構件或未驗證的介面上。
knowledge.textEn: An outdated temporary-state record can make later staff assume a support remains or a waterproof repair is complete. Maintenance decisions may then rely on a nonexistent member or an interface whose condition has never been verified.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工狀態清單與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Construction-state register and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
暫時狀態未更新會讓後續人員以為仍有某個支承，或誤認已完成防水修補；這類文件錯誤可能使維護決策建立在不存在的構件或未驗證的介面上。
跨度減半就代表整個地下工程的風險必然減為四分之一。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An outdated temporary-state record can make later staff assume a support remains or a waterproof repair is complete.
Halving a span necessarily reduces the risk of the whole underground work to one quarter.
quiz.explanation: 暫時狀態未更新會讓後續人員以為仍有某個支承，或誤認已完成防水修補；這類文件錯誤可能使維護決策建立在不存在的構件或未驗證的介面上。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An outdated temporary-state record can make later staff assume a support remains or a waterproof repair is complete. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 隧道噴射混凝土支護
summary: 本課以以早齡承載、基面黏結與厚度控制噴凝土支護為主線，從薄殼受力與岩面接觸與早齡強度與卸載時序建立系統邊界，再把鋼筋網背後的陰影區、芯樣方向與強度換算連到分區品質與交接證據。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on control shotcrete support through early strength, substrate bond and installed thickness. It begins with Shell action and rock contact and Early strength and unloading sequence, links Shadows behind reinforcement mesh and Core orientation and strength interpretation, and ends with Zoned quality and handover evidence. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查薄殼受力與岩面接觸：N=pR=0.10 MPa*4 m=0.40 MN/m; sigma=N/t=0.40/0.15=2.67 MPa；再獨立檢查早齡強度與卸載時序：Inputs stress=0.60 MPa, earlyStrength=1.20 MPa; utilization=stress/earlyStrength=0.60/1.20=0.50; at earlyStrength=0.80 MPa it becomes 0.75。壓力由 0.10 增為 0.11 MPa，半徑和厚度不變，環力由 0.40 增為 0.44 MN/m，應力由 2.67 增為 2.93 MPa；這只適用完整環。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 將把應變、溫度、收斂及儀器歸零時刻共同對時作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Shell action and rock contact: N=pR=0.10 MPa*4 m=0.40 MN/m; sigma=N/t=0.40/0.15=2.67 MPa. Independently check Early strength and unloading sequence: Inputs stress=0.60 MPa, earlyStrength=1.20 MPa; utilization=stress/earlyStrength=0.60/1.20=0.50; at earlyStrength=0.80 MPa it becomes 0.75. Increasing pressure from 0.10 to 0.11 MPa at fixed radius and thickness raises ring force from 0.40 to 0.44 MN/m and stress from 2.67 to 2.93 MPa, for an intact ring only. The two results are not a complete design because the layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. Use synchronize strain, temperature, convergence and gauge-zero timestamps as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」與「早齡強度與卸載時序」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shell action and rock contact" and "Early strength and unloading sequence": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 薄殼受力與岩面接觸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shell action and rock contact: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」如何影響隧道噴射混凝土支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shell action and rock contact” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shotcrete tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 黏結完整的噴層限制岩塊轉動，把局部作用傳給周圍岩體及岩栓。若岩面存在空腔，膜力路徑會局部轉成彎曲，平均壓應力合格仍可能有背面拉裂；完整圓環模型只用來辨認量級，不能代替節理岩塊的穩定分析。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將雷射斷面、敲擊空鼓圖與岩塊節理位置對齊比較；若出現未接觸區的集中彎曲造成裂紋，表面厚度正常仍可能剝落，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A bonded layer restrains block rotation and transfers local actions to surrounding rock and bolts. Cavities convert membrane transfer into bending, allowing back-face tension despite acceptable mean compression. An intact-ring model establishes scale only and does not replace joint-block stability analysis. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare laser sections and sounding maps registered to rock-block joints. If concentrated bending over noncontact zones cracks a layer of apparently normal thickness, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Shell action and rock contact” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：N=pR=0.10 MPa*4 m=0.40 MN/m; sigma=N/t=0.40/0.15=2.67 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: N=pR=0.10 MPa*4 m=0.40 MN/m; sigma=N/t=0.40/0.15=2.67 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均厚度足夠便不必查岩面接觸」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate mean thickness removes the need to check rock contact" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Shell action and rock contact”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 薄殼受力與岩面接觸
knowledge.text: 黏結完整的噴層限制岩塊轉動，把局部作用傳給周圍岩體及岩栓。若岩面存在空腔，膜力路徑會局部轉成彎曲，平均壓應力合格仍可能有背面拉裂；完整圓環模型只用來辨認量級，不能代替節理岩塊的穩定分析。
knowledge.textEn: A bonded layer restrains block rotation and transfers local actions to surrounding rock and bolts. Cavities convert membrane transfer into bending, allowing back-face tension despite acceptable mean compression.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均厚度足夠便不必查岩面接觸 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate mean thickness removes the need to check rock contact Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shell action and rock contact" is correct?
options: 平均厚度足夠便不必查岩面接觸
黏結完整的噴層限制岩塊轉動，把局部作用傳給周圍岩體及岩栓。
材料已經凝結就能承受全部設計荷載
optionsEn: Adequate mean thickness removes the need to check rock contact
A bonded layer restrains block rotation and transfers local actions to surrounding rock and bolts.
A set material can already carry the full design load
quiz.explanation: 黏結完整的噴層限制岩塊轉動，把局部作用傳給周圍岩體及岩栓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A bonded layer restrains block rotation and transfers local actions to surrounding rock and bolts. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 薄殼受力與岩面接觸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shell action and rock contact: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shell action and rock contact” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：N=pR=0.10 MPa*4 m=0.40 MN/m; sigma=N/t=0.40/0.15=2.67 MPa。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: N=pR=0.10 MPa*4 m=0.40 MN/m; sigma=N/t=0.40/0.15=2.67 MPa. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將雷射斷面、敲擊空鼓圖與岩塊節理位置對齊比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare laser sections and sounding maps registered to rock-block joints.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：N=pR=0.10 MPa*4 m=0.40 MN/m; sigma=N/t=0.40/0.15=2.67 MPa。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: N=pR=0.10 MPa*4 m=0.40 MN/m; sigma=N/t=0.40/0.15=2.67 MPa. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shell action and rock contact", which statement holds?
options: 拉拔數字相同就代表破壞原因完全相同
平均厚度合格便能忽略所有局部薄處
原創教學假設：N=pR=0.10 MPa*4 m=0.40 MN/m; sigma=N/t=0.40/0.15=2.67 MPa。
optionsEn: Equal pull-test values prove identical failure causes
Passing mean thickness permits every local thin area to be ignored
Original teaching assumptions: N=pR=0.10 MPa*4 m=0.40 MN/m; sigma=N/t=0.40/0.15=2.67 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：N=pR=0.10 MPa*4 m=0.40 MN/m; sigma=N/t=0.40/0.15=2.67 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: N=pR=0.10 MPa*4 m=0.40 MN/m; sigma=N/t=0.40/0.15=2.67 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 薄殼受力與岩面接觸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shell action and rock contact: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shell action and rock contact” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將雷射斷面、敲擊空鼓圖與岩塊節理位置對齊比較。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「未接觸區的集中彎曲造成裂紋，表面厚度正常仍可能剝落」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare laser sections and sounding maps registered to rock-block joints. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Concentrated bending over noncontact zones cracks a layer of apparently normal thickness. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將雷射斷面、敲擊空鼓圖與岩塊節理位置對齊比較列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現未接觸區的集中彎曲造成裂紋，表面厚度正常仍可能剝落，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare laser sections and sounding maps registered to rock-block joints. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If concentrated bending over noncontact zones cracks a layer of apparently normal thickness, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未接觸區的集中彎曲造成裂紋，表面厚度正常仍可能剝落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Concentrated bending over noncontact zones cracks a layer of apparently normal thickness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將雷射斷面、敲擊空鼓圖與岩塊節理位置對齊比較。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「未接觸區的集中彎曲造成裂紋，表面厚度正常仍可能剝落」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare laser sections and sounding maps registered to rock-block joints. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Concentrated bending over noncontact zones cracks a layer of apparently normal thickness. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將雷射斷面、敲擊空鼓圖與岩塊節理位置對齊比較列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現未接觸區的集中彎曲造成裂紋，表面厚度正常仍可能剝落，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare laser sections and sounding maps registered to rock-block joints. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If concentrated bending over noncontact zones cracks a layer of apparently normal thickness, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shell action and rock contact"?
options: 將雷射斷面、敲擊空鼓圖與岩塊節理位置對齊比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
量測儀器歸零就表示結構回到無應力
optionsEn: Compare laser sections and sounding maps registered to rock-block joints.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Zeroing a sensor returns the structure to a stress-free state
quiz.explanation: 將雷射斷面、敲擊空鼓圖與岩塊節理位置對齊比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare laser sections and sounding maps registered to rock-block joints. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 薄殼受力與岩面接觸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shell action and rock contact: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shell action and rock contact” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未接觸區的集中彎曲造成裂紋，表面厚度正常仍可能剝落。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將雷射斷面、敲擊空鼓圖與岩塊節理位置對齊比較，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Concentrated bending over noncontact zones cracks a layer of apparently normal thickness. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare laser sections and sounding maps registered to rock-block joints to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將雷射斷面、敲擊空鼓圖與岩塊節理位置對齊比較；若出現未接觸區的集中彎曲造成裂紋，表面厚度正常仍可能剝落，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If concentrated bending over noncontact zones cracks a layer of apparently normal thickness, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均厚度足夠便不必查岩面接觸」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate mean thickness removes the need to check rock contact" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 未接觸區的集中彎曲造成裂紋，表面厚度正常仍可能剝落。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將雷射斷面、敲擊空鼓圖與岩塊節理位置對齊比較，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare laser sections and sounding maps registered to rock-block joints to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shell action and rock contact" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
未接觸區的集中彎曲造成裂紋，表面厚度正常仍可能剝落。
材料已經凝結就能承受全部設計荷載
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Concentrated bending over noncontact zones cracks a layer of apparently normal thickness.
A set material can already carry the full design load
quiz.explanation: 未接觸區的集中彎曲造成裂紋，表面厚度正常仍可能剝落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Concentrated bending over noncontact zones cracks a layer of apparently normal thickness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 早齡強度與卸載時序：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Early strength and unloading sequence: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「早齡強度與卸載時序」如何影響隧道噴射混凝土支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Early strength and unloading sequence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shotcrete tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 凝結只是材料開始形成骨架，不代表已達長期承載。開挖卸載與噴層硬化同時發生，下一循環擾動可能作用在仍弱的拱頂；室溫試件與潮濕寒冷岩面的成熟度不同，須用齡期和溫度描述同一強度狀態。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將早齡貫入或拔釘結果與原位溫度及噴射時間配對；若出現溫暖試件高估拱頂強度，使後續擾動造成不可逆微裂縫，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「早齡強度與卸載時序」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Setting starts formation of a material skeleton rather than providing long-term capacity. Excavation unloading competes with hardening, and the next disturbance can reach a weak crown. Laboratory and cold wet rock-face maturity differ, so age and temperature must describe a common strength state. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Match early penetration or stud results to in-place temperature and spraying time. If warm specimens overstate crown strength and subsequent disturbance creates irreversible microcracks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Early strength and unloading sequence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Inputs stress=0.60 MPa, earlyStrength=1.20 MPa; utilization=stress/earlyStrength=0.60/1.20=0.50; at earlyStrength=0.80 MPa it becomes 0.75。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs stress=0.60 MPa, earlyStrength=1.20 MPa; utilization=stress/earlyStrength=0.60/1.20=0.50; at earlyStrength=0.80 MPa it becomes 0.75.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「材料已經凝結就能承受全部設計荷載」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A set material can already carry the full design load" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「早齡強度與卸載時序」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Early strength and unloading sequence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 早齡強度與卸載時序
knowledge.text: 凝結只是材料開始形成骨架，不代表已達長期承載。開挖卸載與噴層硬化同時發生，下一循環擾動可能作用在仍弱的拱頂；室溫試件與潮濕寒冷岩面的成熟度不同，須用齡期和溫度描述同一強度狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Setting starts formation of a material skeleton rather than providing long-term capacity. Excavation unloading competes with hardening, and the next disturbance can reach a weak crown.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：材料已經凝結就能承受全部設計荷載 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A set material can already carry the full design load Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「早齡強度與卸載時序」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Early strength and unloading sequence" is correct?
options: 材料已經凝結就能承受全部設計荷載
泵送纖維含量就是岩面留存的纖維含量
凝結只是材料開始形成骨架，不代表已達長期承載。
optionsEn: A set material can already carry the full design load
Pump-feed fibre content equals fibre content retained on the rock
Setting starts formation of a material skeleton rather than providing long-term capacity.
quiz.explanation: 凝結只是材料開始形成骨架，不代表已達長期承載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Setting starts formation of a material skeleton rather than providing long-term capacity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 早齡強度與卸載時序：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Early strength and unloading sequence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「早齡強度與卸載時序」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Early strength and unloading sequence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Inputs stress=0.60 MPa, earlyStrength=1.20 MPa; utilization=stress/earlyStrength=0.60/1.20=0.50; at earlyStrength=0.80 MPa it becomes 0.75。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs stress=0.60 MPa, earlyStrength=1.20 MPa; utilization=stress/earlyStrength=0.60/1.20=0.50; at earlyStrength=0.80 MPa it becomes 0.75. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將早齡貫入或拔釘結果與原位溫度及噴射時間配對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Match early penetration or stud results to in-place temperature and spraying time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
