knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將早齡貫入或拔釘結果與原位溫度及噴射時間配對列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現溫暖試件高估拱頂強度，使後續擾動造成不可逆微裂縫，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Match early penetration or stud results to in-place temperature and spraying time. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If warm specimens overstate crown strength and subsequent disturbance creates irreversible microcracks, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「早齡強度與卸載時序」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Early strength and unloading sequence"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將早齡貫入或拔釘結果與原位溫度及噴射時間配對。
沒有漏水的裂縫一定不影響支護性能
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Match early penetration or stud results to in-place temperature and spraying time.
A dry crack cannot affect the performance of tunnel support
quiz.explanation: 將早齡貫入或拔釘結果與原位溫度及噴射時間配對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Match early penetration or stud results to in-place temperature and spraying time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 早齡強度與卸載時序：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Early strength and unloading sequence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「早齡強度與卸載時序」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Early strength and unloading sequence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 溫暖試件高估拱頂強度，使後續擾動造成不可逆微裂縫。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將早齡貫入或拔釘結果與原位溫度及噴射時間配對，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Warm specimens overstate crown strength and subsequent disturbance creates irreversible microcracks. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to match early penetration or stud results to in-place temperature and spraying time to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將早齡貫入或拔釘結果與原位溫度及噴射時間配對；若出現溫暖試件高估拱頂強度，使後續擾動造成不可逆微裂縫，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If warm specimens overstate crown strength and subsequent disturbance creates irreversible microcracks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「材料已經凝結就能承受全部設計荷載」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A set material can already carry the full design load" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Warm specimens overstate crown strength and subsequent disturbance creates irreversible microcracks. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to match early penetration or stud results to in-place temperature and spraying time to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「早齡強度與卸載時序」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Early strength and unloading sequence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
泵送纖維含量就是岩面留存的纖維含量
溫暖試件高估拱頂強度，使後續擾動造成不可逆微裂縫。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Pump-feed fibre content equals fibre content retained on the rock
Warm specimens overstate crown strength and subsequent disturbance creates irreversible microcracks.
quiz.explanation: 溫暖試件高估拱頂強度，使後續擾動造成不可逆微裂縫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Warm specimens overstate crown strength and subsequent disturbance creates irreversible microcracks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「回彈量與材料收支」與「基面黏結與破壞界面」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rebound and material balance" and "Bond and failure interfaces": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 回彈量與材料收支：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rebound and material balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「回彈量與材料收支」如何影響隧道噴射混凝土支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rebound and material balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shotcrete tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 回彈物不是原配比的等比例縮小，骨材與纖維可能選擇性流失。泵送量只能描述供料，不能證明留在岩面的密度或纖維含量；材料帳應區分落地回彈、管路殘留與有效噴層，才可把厚度不足與輸送損失分開。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以分區回彈收集重量及原位密度反算留存體積；若出現回彈重新混入會引入污染並掩蓋纖維與骨材比例改變，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「回彈量與材料收支」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rebound is not a scaled copy of the original mix because aggregate and fibres can be preferentially lost. Pumped volume does not prove installed density or fibre content. Separate rebound, line residue and retained layer so insufficient thickness can be distinguished from delivery losses. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Use zoned rebound mass and in-place density to reconstruct retained volume. If reintroduced rebound brings contamination and conceals changed fibre and aggregate proportions, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rebound and material balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Vretained=Vsupplied*(1-r)=12 m3*(1-0.18)=9.84 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Vretained=Vsupplied*(1-r)=12 m3*(1-0.18)=9.84 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵送纖維含量就是岩面留存的纖維含量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pump-feed fibre content equals fibre content retained on the rock" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「回彈量與材料收支」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rebound and material balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 回彈量與材料收支
knowledge.text: 回彈物不是原配比的等比例縮小，骨材與纖維可能選擇性流失。泵送量只能描述供料，不能證明留在岩面的密度或纖維含量；材料帳應區分落地回彈、管路殘留與有效噴層，才可把厚度不足與輸送損失分開。
knowledge.textEn: Rebound is not a scaled copy of the original mix because aggregate and fibres can be preferentially lost. Pumped volume does not prove installed density or fibre content.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：泵送纖維含量就是岩面留存的纖維含量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pump-feed fibre content equals fibre content retained on the rock Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「回彈量與材料收支」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rebound and material balance" is correct?
options: 回彈物不是原配比的等比例縮小，骨材與纖維可能選擇性流失。
泵送纖維含量就是岩面留存的纖維含量
拉拔數字相同就代表破壞原因完全相同
optionsEn: Rebound is not a scaled copy of the original mix because aggregate and fibres can be preferentially lost.
Pump-feed fibre content equals fibre content retained on the rock
Equal pull-test values prove identical failure causes
quiz.explanation: 回彈物不是原配比的等比例縮小，骨材與纖維可能選擇性流失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rebound is not a scaled copy of the original mix because aggregate and fibres can be preferentially lost. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 回彈量與材料收支：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rebound and material balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「回彈量與材料收支」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rebound and material balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Vretained=Vsupplied*(1-r)=12 m3*(1-0.18)=9.84 m3。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Vretained=Vsupplied*(1-r)=12 m3*(1-0.18)=9.84 m3. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分區回彈收集重量及原位密度反算留存體積。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use zoned rebound mass and in-place density to reconstruct retained volume.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Vretained=Vsupplied*(1-r)=12 m3*(1-0.18)=9.84 m3。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：回彈重新混入會引入污染並掩蓋纖維與骨材比例改變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「回彈量與材料收支」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rebound and material balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 回彈重新混入會引入污染並掩蓋纖維與骨材比例改變。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以分區回彈收集重量及原位密度反算留存體積，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reintroduced rebound brings contamination and conceals changed fibre and aggregate proportions. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to use zoned rebound mass and in-place density to reconstruct retained volume to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以分區回彈收集重量及原位密度反算留存體積；若出現回彈重新混入會引入污染並掩蓋纖維與骨材比例改變，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If reintroduced rebound brings contamination and conceals changed fibre and aggregate proportions, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵送纖維含量就是岩面留存的纖維含量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pump-feed fibre content equals fibre content retained on the rock" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 回彈重新混入會引入污染並掩蓋纖維與骨材比例改變。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以分區回彈收集重量及原位密度反算留存體積，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Reintroduced rebound brings contamination and conceals changed fibre and aggregate proportions. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to use zoned rebound mass and in-place density to reconstruct retained volume to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「回彈量與材料收支」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rebound and material balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 回彈重新混入會引入污染並掩蓋纖維與骨材比例改變。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
拉拔數字相同就代表破壞原因完全相同
optionsEn: Reintroduced rebound brings contamination and conceals changed fibre and aggregate proportions.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Equal pull-test values prove identical failure causes
quiz.explanation: 回彈重新混入會引入污染並掩蓋纖維與骨材比例改變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reintroduced rebound brings contamination and conceals changed fibre and aggregate proportions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 基面黏結與破壞界面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bond and failure interfaces: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「基面黏結與破壞界面」如何影響隧道噴射混凝土支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bond and failure interfaces” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shotcrete tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 粉塵、水膜與鬆動薄片會切斷噴層和基岩之間的剪力傳遞。拉拔量到的是試體中最弱路徑，可能位於膠層、噴凝土或岩石；相同峰值不代表相同修復方法，必須保留破壞面照片和各層位置才能判讀。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐件記錄拉拔破壞面、濕度及切割邊界位置；若出現膠層剝離被錯當噴凝土失效，會導致錯誤的材料更換，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「基面黏結與破壞界面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dust, water films and loose flakes interrupt shear transfer to the substrate. A pull test samples the weakest path, which may lie in adhesive, shotcrete or rock. Equal peaks need not imply equal repairs; retain failure-face photographs and layer positions for interpretation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record the failure plane, moisture and isolation-cut boundary for every pull test. If adhesive debonding misclassified as shotcrete failure leads to the wrong material replacement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bond and failure interfaces” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：bondStress=F/A=25 kN/0.025 m2=1.0 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: bondStress=F/A=25 kN/0.025 m2=1.0 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「拉拔數字相同就代表破壞原因完全相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal pull-test values prove identical failure causes" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「基面黏結與破壞界面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bond and failure interfaces”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Dust, water films and loose flakes interrupt shear transfer to the substrate. A pull test samples the weakest path, which may lie in adhesive, shotcrete or rock.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：拉拔數字相同就代表破壞原因完全相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「基面黏結與破壞界面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bond and failure interfaces" is correct?

粉塵、水膜與鬆動薄片會切斷噴層和基岩之間的剪力傳遞。

optionsEn: Equal pull-test values prove identical failure causes
Dust, water films and loose flakes interrupt shear transfer to the substrate.
A smooth face proves complete encapsulation of reinforcement mesh

quiz.explanationEn: Dust, water films and loose flakes interrupt shear transfer to the substrate. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基面黏結與破壞界面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bond and failure interfaces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「基面黏結與破壞界面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bond and failure interfaces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：bondStress=F/A=25 kN/0.025 m2=1.0 MPa。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: bondStress=F/A=25 kN/0.025 m2=1.0 MPa. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐件記錄拉拔破壞面、濕度及切割邊界位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record the failure plane, moisture and isolation-cut boundary for every pull test.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：bondStress=F/A=25 kN/0.025 m2=1.0 MPa。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: bondStress=F/A=25 kN/0.025 m2=1.0 MPa. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基面黏結與破壞界面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bond and failure interfaces", which statement holds?
options: 不同尺寸與方向的試體強度都可以直接互換
沒有漏水的裂縫一定不影響支護性能
原創教學假設：bondStress=F/A=25 kN/0.025 m2=1.0 MPa。
optionsEn: Strengths from different specimen sizes and orientations are directly interchangeable
A dry crack cannot affect the performance of tunnel support
Original teaching assumptions: bondStress=F/A=25 kN/0.025 m2=1.0 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：bondStress=F/A=25 kN/0.025 m2=1.0 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: bondStress=F/A=25 kN/0.025 m2=1.0 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基面黏結與破壞界面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bond and failure interfaces: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「基面黏結與破壞界面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bond and failure interfaces” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐件記錄拉拔破壞面、濕度及切割邊界位置。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「膠層剝離被錯當噴凝土失效，會導致錯誤的材料更換」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record the failure plane, moisture and isolation-cut boundary for every pull test. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Adhesive debonding misclassified as shotcrete failure leads to the wrong material replacement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將逐件記錄拉拔破壞面、濕度及切割邊界位置列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現膠層剝離被錯當噴凝土失效，會導致錯誤的材料更換，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Record the failure plane, moisture and isolation-cut boundary for every pull test. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If adhesive debonding misclassified as shotcrete failure leads to the wrong material replacement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：膠層剝離被錯當噴凝土失效，會導致錯誤的材料更換。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adhesive debonding misclassified as shotcrete failure leads to the wrong material replacement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐件記錄拉拔破壞面、濕度及切割邊界位置。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「膠層剝離被錯當噴凝土失效，會導致錯誤的材料更換」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Record the failure plane, moisture and isolation-cut boundary for every pull test. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Adhesive debonding misclassified as shotcrete failure leads to the wrong material replacement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將逐件記錄拉拔破壞面、濕度及切割邊界位置列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現膠層剝離被錯當噴凝土失效，會導致錯誤的材料更換，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Record the failure plane, moisture and isolation-cut boundary for every pull test. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If adhesive debonding misclassified as shotcrete failure leads to the wrong material replacement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

steps.title: 局部厚度與斷面配準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Local thickness and section registration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「局部厚度與斷面配準」如何影響隧道噴射混凝土支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local thickness and section registration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shotcrete tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩面起伏使同一材料體積產生不同的最薄厚度，局部彎曲與耐久往往由薄區主導。施工前後點雲必須共用控制基準，否則岩面突起會被誤讀為新增厚度；平均料量只能作總體收支，不能取代最薄處驗證。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將厚度釘、鑽芯與雙期點雲在共同基準下互比；若出現點雲錯位遮蔽薄區，造成局部剛度與保護層被高估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「局部厚度與斷面配準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rock roughness gives different minimum thicknesses at equal material volume, while local bending and durability often depend on thin areas. Before-and-after clouds require common control; otherwise protrusions appear as added thickness. Delivered volume is a global balance rather than verification of local minima. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare thickness pins, cores and two-epoch clouds on a common datum. If cloud misregistration conceals thin zones and overstates local stiffness and cover, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local thickness and section registration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：tavg=V/A=15 m3/100 m2=0.15 m; assumed local minimum=0.09 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: tavg=V/A=15 m3/100 m2=0.15 m; assumed local minimum=0.09 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均厚度合格便能忽略所有局部薄處」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing mean thickness permits every local thin area to be ignored" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「局部厚度與斷面配準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Local thickness and section registration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 局部厚度與斷面配準
knowledge.text: 岩面起伏使同一材料體積產生不同的最薄厚度，局部彎曲與耐久往往由薄區主導。施工前後點雲必須共用控制基準，否則岩面突起會被誤讀為新增厚度；平均料量只能作總體收支，不能取代最薄處驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Rock roughness gives different minimum thicknesses at equal material volume, while local bending and durability often depend on thin areas. Before-and-after clouds require common control; otherwise protrusions appear as added thickness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均厚度合格便能忽略所有局部薄處 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing mean thickness permits every local thin area to be ignored Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「局部厚度與斷面配準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Local thickness and section registration" is correct?
options: 岩面起伏使同一材料體積產生不同的最薄厚度，局部彎曲與耐久往往由薄區主導。
平均厚度合格便能忽略所有局部薄處
不同尺寸與方向的試體強度都可以直接互換
optionsEn: Rock roughness gives different minimum thicknesses at equal material volume, while local bending and durability often depend on thin areas.
Passing mean thickness permits every local thin area to be ignored
Strengths from different specimen sizes and orientations are directly interchangeable
quiz.explanation: 岩面起伏使同一材料體積產生不同的最薄厚度，局部彎曲與耐久往往由薄區主導。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rock roughness gives different minimum thicknesses at equal material volume, while local bending and durability often depend on thin areas. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 局部厚度與斷面配準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Local thickness and section registration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「局部厚度與斷面配準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Local thickness and section registration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：tavg=V/A=15 m3/100 m2=0.15 m; assumed local minimum=0.09 m。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: tavg=V/A=15 m3/100 m2=0.15 m; assumed local minimum=0.09 m. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將厚度釘、鑽芯與雙期點雲在共同基準下互比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare thickness pins, cores and two-epoch clouds on a common datum.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：tavg=V/A=15 m3/100 m2=0.15 m; assumed local minimum=0.09 m。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: tavg=V/A=15 m3/100 m2=0.15 m; assumed local minimum=0.09 m. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「局部厚度與斷面配準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Local thickness and section registration", which statement holds?
options: 沒有漏水的裂縫一定不影響支護性能
原創教學假設：tavg=V/A=15 m3/100 m2=0.15 m; assumed local minimum=0.09 m。
平均厚度足夠便不必查岩面接觸
optionsEn: A dry crack cannot affect the performance of tunnel support
Original teaching assumptions: tavg=V/A=15 m3/100 m2=0.15 m; assumed local minimum=0.09 m.
Adequate mean thickness removes the need to check rock contact
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：tavg=V/A=15 m3/100 m2=0.15 m; assumed local minimum=0.09 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: tavg=V/A=15 m3/100 m2=0.15 m; assumed local minimum=0.09 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 局部厚度與斷面配準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Local thickness and section registration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「局部厚度與斷面配準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Local thickness and section registration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將厚度釘、鑽芯與雙期點雲在共同基準下互比。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「點雲錯位遮蔽薄區，造成局部剛度與保護層被高估」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare thickness pins, cores and two-epoch clouds on a common datum. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Cloud misregistration conceals thin zones and overstates local stiffness and cover. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將厚度釘、鑽芯與雙期點雲在共同基準下互比列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現點雲錯位遮蔽薄區，造成局部剛度與保護層被高估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare thickness pins, cores and two-epoch clouds on a common datum. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If cloud misregistration conceals thin zones and overstates local stiffness and cover, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：點雲錯位遮蔽薄區，造成局部剛度與保護層被高估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cloud misregistration conceals thin zones and overstates local stiffness and cover. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將厚度釘、鑽芯與雙期點雲在共同基準下互比。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「點雲錯位遮蔽薄區，造成局部剛度與保護層被高估」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare thickness pins, cores and two-epoch clouds on a common datum. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Cloud misregistration conceals thin zones and overstates local stiffness and cover. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將厚度釘、鑽芯與雙期點雲在共同基準下互比列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現點雲錯位遮蔽薄區，造成局部剛度與保護層被高估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare thickness pins, cores and two-epoch clouds on a common datum. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If cloud misregistration conceals thin zones and overstates local stiffness and cover, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「局部厚度與斷面配準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Local thickness and section registration"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
泵送纖維含量就是岩面留存的纖維含量
將厚度釘、鑽芯與雙期點雲在共同基準下互比。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Pump-feed fibre content equals fibre content retained on the rock
Compare thickness pins, cores and two-epoch clouds on a common datum.
quiz.explanation: 將厚度釘、鑽芯與雙期點雲在共同基準下互比。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare thickness pins, cores and two-epoch clouds on a common datum. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 局部厚度與斷面配準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Local thickness and section registration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「局部厚度與斷面配準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Local thickness and section registration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 點雲錯位遮蔽薄區，造成局部剛度與保護層被高估。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將厚度釘、鑽芯與雙期點雲在共同基準下互比，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cloud misregistration conceals thin zones and overstates local stiffness and cover. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare thickness pins, cores and two-epoch clouds on a common datum to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將厚度釘、鑽芯與雙期點雲在共同基準下互比；若出現點雲錯位遮蔽薄區，造成局部剛度與保護層被高估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If cloud misregistration conceals thin zones and overstates local stiffness and cover, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均厚度合格便能忽略所有局部薄處」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing mean thickness permits every local thin area to be ignored" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 點雲錯位遮蔽薄區，造成局部剛度與保護層被高估。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將厚度釘、鑽芯與雙期點雲在共同基準下互比，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Cloud misregistration conceals thin zones and overstates local stiffness and cover. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare thickness pins, cores and two-epoch clouds on a common datum to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「局部厚度與斷面配準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Local thickness and section registration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 點雲錯位遮蔽薄區，造成局部剛度與保護層被高估。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
不同尺寸與方向的試體強度都可以直接互換
optionsEn: Cloud misregistration conceals thin zones and overstates local stiffness and cover.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Strengths from different specimen sizes and orientations are directly interchangeable
quiz.explanation: 點雲錯位遮蔽薄區，造成局部剛度與保護層被高估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Cloud misregistration conceals thin zones and overstates local stiffness and cover. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「芯樣方向與強度換算」與「收斂與噴層應變零點」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Core orientation and strength interpretation" and "Convergence and strain-gauge zero": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 芯樣方向與強度換算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Core orientation and strength interpretation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「芯樣方向與強度換算」如何影響隧道噴射混凝土支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Core orientation and strength interpretation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shotcrete tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 噴凝土有層間界面，取芯方向會改變荷載穿越界面的方式。端面不平又會引入偏心壓縮，兩種效應都能降低峰值但原因不同；試體形狀、齡期與飽水狀態必須一起記錄，不能把任意立方體結果直接套到拱頂。 判別這個機制時，應觀察成組比較相同齡期但不同取芯方向的破壞形態；若出現端面偏心造成假低強度，掩蓋真正的層間黏結問題，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「芯樣方向與強度換算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sprayed layers contain interfaces whose loading depends on coring direction. Uneven ends introduce eccentric compression; both effects reduce peaks for different reasons. Record geometry, age and saturation together rather than transferring an arbitrary cube result directly to the crown. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare failure shapes of same-age cores taken in different orientations. If eccentric end loading produces false low strength and obscures actual interlayer bond problems, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. quiz.question: 關於「芯樣方向與強度換算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 芯樣方向與強度換算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Core orientation and strength interpretation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「芯樣方向與強度換算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Core orientation and strength interpretation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：fc=F/A=200 kN/(pi*0.05^2 m2)=25.46 MPa。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: fc=F/A=200 kN/(pi*0.05^2 m2)=25.46 MPa. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：成組比較相同齡期但不同取芯方向的破壞形態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare failure shapes of same-age cores taken in different orientations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 芯樣方向與強度換算：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Core orientation and strength interpretation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「芯樣方向與強度換算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Core orientation and strength interpretation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 成組比較相同齡期但不同取芯方向的破壞形態。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「端面偏心造成假低強度，掩蓋真正的層間黏結問題」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare failure shapes of same-age cores taken in different orientations. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Eccentric end loading produces false low strength and obscures actual interlayer bond problems. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將成組比較相同齡期但不同取芯方向的破壞形態列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現端面偏心造成假低強度，掩蓋真正的層間黏結問題，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare failure shapes of same-age cores taken in different orientations. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If eccentric end loading produces false low strength and obscures actual interlayer bond problems, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：端面偏心造成假低強度，掩蓋真正的層間黏結問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Eccentric end loading produces false low strength and obscures actual interlayer bond problems. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 成組比較相同齡期但不同取芯方向的破壞形態。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「端面偏心造成假低強度，掩蓋真正的層間黏結問題」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare failure shapes of same-age cores taken in different orientations. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Eccentric end loading produces false low strength and obscures actual interlayer bond problems. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將成組比較相同齡期但不同取芯方向的破壞形態列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現端面偏心造成假低強度，掩蓋真正的層間黏結問題，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare failure shapes of same-age cores taken in different orientations. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If eccentric end loading produces false low strength and obscures actual interlayer bond problems, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「芯樣方向與強度換算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 成組比較相同齡期但不同取芯方向的破壞形態。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
拉拔數字相同就代表破壞原因完全相同
optionsEn: Compare failure shapes of same-age cores taken in different orientations.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Equal pull-test values prove identical failure causes

steps.title: 芯樣方向與強度換算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Core orientation and strength interpretation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「芯樣方向與強度換算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Core orientation and strength interpretation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 端面偏心造成假低強度，掩蓋真正的層間黏結問題。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到成組比較相同齡期但不同取芯方向的破壞形態，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Eccentric end loading produces false low strength and obscures actual interlayer bond problems. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare failure shapes of same-age cores taken in different orientations to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察成組比較相同齡期但不同取芯方向的破壞形態；若出現端面偏心造成假低強度，掩蓋真正的層間黏結問題，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If eccentric end loading produces false low strength and obscures actual interlayer bond problems, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不同尺寸與方向的試體強度都可以直接互換」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Strengths from different specimen sizes and orientations are directly interchangeable" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 端面偏心造成假低強度，掩蓋真正的層間黏結問題。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到成組比較相同齡期但不同取芯方向的破壞形態，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Eccentric end loading produces false low strength and obscures actual interlayer bond problems. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare failure shapes of same-age cores taken in different orientations to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「芯樣方向與強度換算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Core orientation and strength interpretation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

steps.title: 收斂與噴層應變零點：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Convergence and strain-gauge zero: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「收斂與噴層應變零點」如何影響隧道噴射混凝土支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Convergence and strain-gauge zero” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shotcrete tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地層在噴層安裝前已變形，總收斂並不全部進入噴凝土。應變計晚歸零會刪除早期荷載，溫度又能造成非機械應變；需把噴射、安裝、歸零與後續開挖放在同一時間軸，才可比較環向收縮和材料應力。 判別這個機制時，應觀察把應變、溫度、收斂及儀器歸零時刻共同對時；若出現歸零後曲線平穩卻漏掉累積應力，錯判支護已卸載，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「收斂與噴層應變零點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ground deforms before support installation, so total convergence does not all enter the lining. Late zeroing removes early load history, and temperature adds nonmechanical strain. Align spraying, installation, zeroing and excavation before comparing circumferential shortening with material stress. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize strain, temperature, convergence and gauge-zero timestamps. If a calm post-zero curve hides accumulated stress and falsely suggests unloading, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Convergence and strain-gauge zero” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：epsilon=0.8 mm/4000 mm=0.0002; sigma=10 GPa*0.0002=2 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: epsilon=0.8 mm/4000 mm=0.0002; sigma=10 GPa*0.0002=2 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量測儀器歸零就表示結構回到無應力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Zeroing a sensor returns the structure to a stress-free state" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「收斂與噴層應變零點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Convergence and strain-gauge zero”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 收斂與噴層應變零點
knowledge.text: 地層在噴層安裝前已變形，總收斂並不全部進入噴凝土。應變計晚歸零會刪除早期荷載，溫度又能造成非機械應變；需把噴射、安裝、歸零與後續開挖放在同一時間軸，才可比較環向收縮和材料應力。
knowledge.textEn: Ground deforms before support installation, so total convergence does not all enter the lining. Late zeroing removes early load history, and temperature adds nonmechanical strain.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：量測儀器歸零就表示結構回到無應力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Zeroing a sensor returns the structure to a stress-free state Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「收斂與噴層應變零點」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Convergence and strain-gauge zero" is correct?
options: 量測儀器歸零就表示結構回到無應力
沒有漏水的裂縫一定不影響支護性能
地層在噴層安裝前已變形，總收斂並不全部進入噴凝土。
optionsEn: Zeroing a sensor returns the structure to a stress-free state
A dry crack cannot affect the performance of tunnel support
Ground deforms before support installation, so total convergence does not all enter the lining.
quiz.explanation: 地層在噴層安裝前已變形，總收斂並不全部進入噴凝土。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ground deforms before support installation, so total convergence does not all enter the lining. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 收斂與噴層應變零點：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Convergence and strain-gauge zero: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「收斂與噴層應變零點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Convergence and strain-gauge zero” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：epsilon=0.8 mm/4000 mm=0.0002; sigma=10 GPa*0.0002=2 MPa。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: epsilon=0.8 mm/4000 mm=0.0002; sigma=10 GPa*0.0002=2 MPa. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把應變、溫度、收斂及儀器歸零時刻共同對時。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize strain, temperature, convergence and gauge-zero timestamps.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：epsilon=0.8 mm/4000 mm=0.0002; sigma=10 GPa*0.0002=2 MPa。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: epsilon=0.8 mm/4000 mm=0.0002; sigma=10 GPa*0.0002=2 MPa. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「收斂與噴層應變零點」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Convergence and strain-gauge zero", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：epsilon=0.8 mm/4000 mm=0.0002; sigma=10 GPa*0.0002=2 MPa。
平均厚度足夠便不必查岩面接觸
泵送纖維含量就是岩面留存的纖維含量
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: epsilon=0.8 mm/4000 mm=0.0002; sigma=10 GPa*0.0002=2 MPa.
Adequate mean thickness removes the need to check rock contact
Pump-feed fibre content equals fibre content retained on the rock
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：epsilon=0.8 mm/4000 mm=0.0002; sigma=10 GPa*0.0002=2 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: epsilon=0.8 mm/4000 mm=0.0002; sigma=10 GPa*0.0002=2 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 收斂與噴層應變零點：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Convergence and strain-gauge zero: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「收斂與噴層應變零點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Convergence and strain-gauge zero” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把應變、溫度、收斂及儀器歸零時刻共同對時。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「歸零後曲線平穩卻漏掉累積應力，錯判支護已卸載」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize strain, temperature, convergence and gauge-zero timestamps. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A calm post-zero curve hides accumulated stress and falsely suggests unloading. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將把應變、溫度、收斂及儀器歸零時刻共同對時列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現歸零後曲線平穩卻漏掉累積應力，錯判支護已卸載，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Synchronize strain, temperature, convergence and gauge-zero timestamps. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a calm post-zero curve hides accumulated stress and falsely suggests unloading, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：歸零後曲線平穩卻漏掉累積應力，錯判支護已卸載。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A calm post-zero curve hides accumulated stress and falsely suggests unloading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把應變、溫度、收斂及儀器歸零時刻共同對時。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「歸零後曲線平穩卻漏掉累積應力，錯判支護已卸載」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize strain, temperature, convergence and gauge-zero timestamps. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A calm post-zero curve hides accumulated stress and falsely suggests unloading. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將把應變、溫度、收斂及儀器歸零時刻共同對時列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現歸零後曲線平穩卻漏掉累積應力，錯判支護已卸載，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Synchronize strain, temperature, convergence and gauge-zero timestamps. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a calm post-zero curve hides accumulated stress and falsely suggests unloading, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「收斂與噴層應變零點」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Convergence and strain-gauge zero"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
把應變、溫度、收斂及儀器歸零時刻共同對時。
表面平順便足以證明鋼筋網完全包覆
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Synchronize strain, temperature, convergence and gauge-zero timestamps.
A smooth face proves complete encapsulation of reinforcement mesh
quiz.explanation: 把應變、溫度、收斂及儀器歸零時刻共同對時。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize strain, temperature, convergence and gauge-zero timestamps. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 收斂與噴層應變零點：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Convergence and strain-gauge zero: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「收斂與噴層應變零點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Convergence and strain-gauge zero” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 歸零後曲線平穩卻漏掉累積應力，錯判支護已卸載。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把應變、溫度、收斂及儀器歸零時刻共同對時，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A calm post-zero curve hides accumulated stress and falsely suggests unloading. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize strain, temperature, convergence and gauge-zero timestamps to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察把應變、溫度、收斂及儀器歸零時刻共同對時；若出現歸零後曲線平穩卻漏掉累積應力，錯判支護已卸載，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a calm post-zero curve hides accumulated stress and falsely suggests unloading, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「量測儀器歸零就表示結構回到無應力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Zeroing a sensor returns the structure to a stress-free state" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 歸零後曲線平穩卻漏掉累積應力，錯判支護已卸載。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把應變、溫度、收斂及儀器歸零時刻共同對時，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A calm post-zero curve hides accumulated stress and falsely suggests unloading. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize strain, temperature, convergence and gauge-zero timestamps to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「收斂與噴層應變零點」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Convergence and strain-gauge zero" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
沒有漏水的裂縫一定不影響支護性能
歸零後曲線平穩卻漏掉累積應力，錯判支護已卸載。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A dry crack cannot affect the performance of tunnel support
A calm post-zero curve hides accumulated stress and falsely suggests unloading.
quiz.explanation: 歸零後曲線平穩卻漏掉累積應力，錯判支護已卸載。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A calm post-zero curve hides accumulated stress and falsely suggests unloading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「活動裂縫與耐久通路」與「分區品質與交接證據」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Active cracks and durability paths" and "Zoned quality and handover evidence": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 活動裂縫與耐久通路：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Active cracks and durability paths: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「活動裂縫與耐久通路」如何影響隧道噴射混凝土支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Active cracks and durability paths” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shotcrete tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 裂縫寬度描述某一時刻，無法單獨區分乾縮、溫度循環與岩體持續運動。水和侵蝕離子可沿裂縫優先進入，封閉表面可能把出水轉移到別處；維修判斷需追蹤同一裂縫的開合、水量及附近收斂歷史。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以裂縫計、水量、溫度和固定視角照片追蹤同一位置；若出現活動裂縫被當成乾縮封補後重新開裂並改變漏水位置，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「活動裂縫與耐久通路」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Width describes an instant rather than distinguishing shrinkage, thermal cycling and continued rock movement. Water and aggressive ions follow cracks, while sealing a face can redirect discharge. Repair decisions need the same crack's opening, flow and neighbouring convergence history. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Track one location with crack gauges, flow, temperature and fixed-view photographs. If an active crack treated as shrinkage reopens and shifts the leakage location, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Active cracks and durability paths” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：openingRate=(0.30-0.18) mm/30 day=0.004 mm/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: openingRate=(0.30-0.18) mm/30 day=0.004 mm/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沒有漏水的裂縫一定不影響支護性能」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A dry crack cannot affect the performance of tunnel support" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「活動裂縫與耐久通路」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Active cracks and durability paths”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 活動裂縫與耐久通路
knowledge.text: 裂縫寬度描述某一時刻，無法單獨區分乾縮、溫度循環與岩體持續運動。水和侵蝕離子可沿裂縫優先進入，封閉表面可能把出水轉移到別處；維修判斷需追蹤同一裂縫的開合、水量及附近收斂歷史。
knowledge.textEn: Width describes an instant rather than distinguishing shrinkage, thermal cycling and continued rock movement. Water and aggressive ions follow cracks, while sealing a face can redirect discharge.

knowledge.text: 誤解：沒有漏水的裂縫一定不影響支護性能 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A dry crack cannot affect the performance of tunnel support Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「活動裂縫與耐久通路」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Active cracks and durability paths" is correct?
options: 裂縫寬度描述某一時刻，無法單獨區分乾縮、溫度循環與岩體持續運動。

quiz.explanation: 裂縫寬度描述某一時刻，無法單獨區分乾縮、溫度循環與岩體持續運動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Width describes an instant rather than distinguishing shrinkage, thermal cycling and continued rock movement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 活動裂縫與耐久通路：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Active cracks and durability paths: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「活動裂縫與耐久通路」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Active cracks and durability paths” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：openingRate=(0.30-0.18) mm/30 day=0.004 mm/day。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: openingRate=(0.30-0.18) mm/30 day=0.004 mm/day. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以裂縫計、水量、溫度和固定視角照片追蹤同一位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track one location with crack gauges, flow, temperature and fixed-view photographs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「活動裂縫與耐久通路」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Active cracks and durability paths", which statement holds?
options: 材料已經凝結就能承受全部設計荷載
原創教學假設：openingRate=(0.30-0.18) mm/30 day=0.004 mm/day。
拉拔數字相同就代表破壞原因完全相同
optionsEn: A set material can already carry the full design load
Original teaching assumptions: openingRate=(0.30-0.18) mm/30 day=0.004 mm/day.
Equal pull-test values prove identical failure causes
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：openingRate=(0.30-0.18) mm/30 day=0.004 mm/day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: openingRate=(0.30-0.18) mm/30 day=0.004 mm/day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 活動裂縫與耐久通路：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Active cracks and durability paths: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「活動裂縫與耐久通路」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Active cracks and durability paths” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以裂縫計、水量、溫度和固定視角照片追蹤同一位置。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「活動裂縫被當成乾縮封補後重新開裂並改變漏水位置」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track one location with crack gauges, flow, temperature and fixed-view photographs. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An active crack treated as shrinkage reopens and shifts the leakage location. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以裂縫計、水量、溫度和固定視角照片追蹤同一位置列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現活動裂縫被當成乾縮封補後重新開裂並改變漏水位置，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Track one location with crack gauges, flow, temperature and fixed-view photographs. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an active crack treated as shrinkage reopens and shifts the leakage location, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：活動裂縫被當成乾縮封補後重新開裂並改變漏水位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An active crack treated as shrinkage reopens and shifts the leakage location. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「活動裂縫與耐久通路」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Active cracks and durability paths"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
平均厚度合格便能忽略所有局部薄處
以裂縫計、水量、溫度和固定視角照片追蹤同一位置。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Passing mean thickness permits every local thin area to be ignored
Track one location with crack gauges, flow, temperature and fixed-view photographs.
quiz.explanation: 以裂縫計、水量、溫度和固定視角照片追蹤同一位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Track one location with crack gauges, flow, temperature and fixed-view photographs. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 活動裂縫與耐久通路：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Active cracks and durability paths: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「活動裂縫與耐久通路」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Active cracks and durability paths” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 活動裂縫被當成乾縮封補後重新開裂並改變漏水位置。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以裂縫計、水量、溫度和固定視角照片追蹤同一位置，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An active crack treated as shrinkage reopens and shifts the leakage location. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to track one location with crack gauges, flow, temperature and fixed-view photographs to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以裂縫計、水量、溫度和固定視角照片追蹤同一位置；若出現活動裂縫被當成乾縮封補後重新開裂並改變漏水位置，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If an active crack treated as shrinkage reopens and shifts the leakage location, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「沒有漏水的裂縫一定不影響支護性能」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A dry crack cannot affect the performance of tunnel support" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 活動裂縫被當成乾縮封補後重新開裂並改變漏水位置。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以裂縫計、水量、溫度和固定視角照片追蹤同一位置，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: An active crack treated as shrinkage reopens and shifts the leakage location. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to track one location with crack gauges, flow, temperature and fixed-view photographs to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「活動裂縫與耐久通路」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Active cracks and durability paths" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 活動裂縫被當成乾縮封補後重新開裂並改變漏水位置。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要有一份合格報告就能代表整條隧道
optionsEn: An active crack treated as shrinkage reopens and shifts the leakage location.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
One passing report represents the entire tunnel lining
quiz.explanation: 活動裂縫被當成乾縮封補後重新開裂並改變漏水位置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An active crack treated as shrinkage reopens and shifts the leakage location. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 分區品質與交接證據：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Zoned quality and handover evidence: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分區品質與交接證據」如何影響隧道噴射混凝土支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
