steps.instructionEn: Quality varies along chainage and around the perimeter; pooling specimens conceals thin or wet zones. Link geology, batches, spraying times and defect disposition so later cracks can be traced to their initial condition rather than a single average-strength certificate. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit thickness, bond, early strength and defect closure by zone. If unlocated passing reports cannot establish that a damaged zone was inspected, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Zoned quality and handover evidence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：coverage=verifiedZones/requiredZones=18/20=0.90=90 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: coverage=verifiedZones/requiredZones=18/20=0.90=90 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要有一份合格報告就能代表整條隧道」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One passing report represents the entire tunnel lining" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分區品質與交接證據」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Zoned quality and handover evidence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分區品質與交接證據
knowledge.text: 支護品質沿里程與環向都可能不同，將所有試件合併平均會失去對薄區和濕區的辨識。交接資料應連結地質、批次、噴射時刻和缺陷處置，讓後續裂紋能追溯到初期狀態，而不是只留下單一平均強度證明。
knowledge.textEn: Quality varies along chainage and around the perimeter; pooling specimens conceals thin or wet zones. Link geology, batches, spraying times and defect disposition so later cracks can be traced to their initial condition rather than a single average-strength certificate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要有一份合格報告就能代表整條隧道 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One passing report represents the entire tunnel lining Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分區品質與交接證據」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Zoned quality and handover evidence" is correct?
options: 只要有一份合格報告就能代表整條隧道
支護品質沿里程與環向都可能不同，將所有試件合併平均會失去對薄區和濕區的辨識。
平均厚度足夠便不必查岩面接觸
optionsEn: One passing report represents the entire tunnel lining
Quality varies along chainage and around the perimeter; pooling specimens conceals thin or wet zones.
Adequate mean thickness removes the need to check rock contact
quiz.explanation: 支護品質沿里程與環向都可能不同，將所有試件合併平均會失去對薄區和濕區的辨識。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：coverage=verifiedZones/requiredZones=18/20=0.90=90 percent。噴層與岩塊、岩栓共同工作，空腔會改變受力路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: coverage=verifiedZones/requiredZones=18/20=0.90=90 percent. The layer interacts with rock blocks and bolts; cavities change its load path. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分區品質與交接證據」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Zoned quality and handover evidence", which statement holds?

表面平順便足以證明鋼筋網完全包覆

A smooth face proves complete encapsulation of reinforcement mesh
Original teaching assumptions: coverage=verifiedZones/requiredZones=18/20=0.90=90 percent.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: coverage=verifiedZones/requiredZones=18/20=0.90=90 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分區品質與交接證據：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Zoned quality and handover evidence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分區品質與交接證據」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Zoned quality and handover evidence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐區核對厚度、黏結、早齡強度及缺陷關閉紀錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「缺少里程對應的合格報告無法證明受損區曾受檢查」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit thickness, bond, early strength and defect closure by zone. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Unlocated passing reports cannot establish that a damaged zone was inspected. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將逐區核對厚度、黏結、早齡強度及缺陷關閉紀錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現缺少里程對應的合格報告無法證明受損區曾受檢查，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Audit thickness, bond, early strength and defect closure by zone. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If unlocated passing reports cannot establish that a damaged zone was inspected, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：缺少里程對應的合格報告無法證明受損區曾受檢查。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unlocated passing reports cannot establish that a damaged zone was inspected. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐區核對厚度、黏結、早齡強度及缺陷關閉紀錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「缺少里程對應的合格報告無法證明受損區曾受檢查」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Audit thickness, bond, early strength and defect closure by zone. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Unlocated passing reports cannot establish that a damaged zone was inspected. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將逐區核對厚度、黏結、早齡強度及缺陷關閉紀錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現缺少里程對應的合格報告無法證明受損區曾受檢查，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Audit thickness, bond, early strength and defect closure by zone. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If unlocated passing reports cannot establish that a damaged zone was inspected, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分區品質與交接證據」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Zoned quality and handover evidence"?
options: 逐區核對厚度、黏結、早齡強度及缺陷關閉紀錄。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
不同尺寸與方向的試體強度都可以直接互換
optionsEn: Audit thickness, bond, early strength and defect closure by zone.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Strengths from different specimen sizes and orientations are directly interchangeable
quiz.explanation: 逐區核對厚度、黏結、早齡強度及缺陷關閉紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit thickness, bond, early strength and defect closure by zone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分區品質與交接證據：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Zoned quality and handover evidence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分區品質與交接證據」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Zoned quality and handover evidence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 缺少里程對應的合格報告無法證明受損區曾受檢查。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐區核對厚度、黏結、早齡強度及缺陷關閉紀錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unlocated passing reports cannot establish that a damaged zone was inspected. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit thickness, bond, early strength and defect closure by zone to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察逐區核對厚度、黏結、早齡強度及缺陷關閉紀錄；若出現缺少里程對應的合格報告無法證明受損區曾受檢查，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If unlocated passing reports cannot establish that a damaged zone was inspected, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要有一份合格報告就能代表整條隧道」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One passing report represents the entire tunnel lining" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 缺少里程對應的合格報告無法證明受損區曾受檢查。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐區核對厚度、黏結、早齡強度及缺陷關閉紀錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Unlocated passing reports cannot establish that a damaged zone was inspected. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit thickness, bond, early strength and defect closure by zone to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分區品質與交接證據」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Zoned quality and handover evidence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
缺少里程對應的合格報告無法證明受損區曾受檢查。
平均厚度足夠便不必查岩面接觸
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Unlocated passing reports cannot establish that a damaged zone was inspected.
Adequate mean thickness removes the need to check rock contact
quiz.explanation: 缺少里程對應的合格報告無法證明受損區曾受檢查。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unlocated passing reports cannot establish that a damaged zone was inspected. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗
summary: 本課以以裂後荷載、能量積分與取樣方向驗證纖維噴凝土為主線，從裂後承載與纖維橋接與力位移曲線的能量積分建立系統邊界，再把拔出功與界面滑移、荷重位移同步與零點連到性能規格與試法交接。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on verify fibre shotcrete through postcrack load, energy integration and sampling direction. It begins with Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging and Energy integration of force-displacement curves, links Pullout work and interface slip and Force-displacement synchronization and zero, and ends with Performance specifications and method handover. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查裂後承載與纖維橋接：retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60；再獨立檢查力位移曲線的能量積分：E=Fmean*delta=20 kN*25 mm=500 J。平均力由 20 增為 22 kN、位移仍為 25 mm，能量由 500 增為 550 J；試板尺寸或支承變更時不能沿用這個比例。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 將比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging: retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60. Independently check Energy integration of force-displacement curves: E=Fmean*delta=20 kN*25 mm=500 J. At a fixed 25 mm travel, mean force rising from 20 to 22 kN increases energy from 500 to 550 J; changed panel geometry or support prevents direct transfer. The two results are not a complete design because panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. Use compare individual curves, mean and dispersion from nine independent panels as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「裂後承載與纖維橋接」與「力位移曲線的能量積分」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging" and "Energy integration of force-displacement curves": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 裂後承載與纖維橋接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「裂後承載與纖維橋接」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 首裂以前主要由水泥基材承受拉應力，裂後則由跨縫纖維傳力。纖維可能拔出、拉斷或與基材局部剝離，因此高抗壓不保證高殘餘荷載；應沿整條荷載位移曲線辨識峰值後的衰減，而非只比較最大力。 判別這個機制時，應觀察在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點；若出現高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「裂後承載與纖維橋接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The matrix carries most tensile action before cracking; bridging fibres transfer force afterward. Pullout, rupture and local debonding create different responses, so high compression strength does not guarantee residual resistance. Inspect the complete postpeak curve rather than comparing maximum loads alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking. If rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抗壓強度高就代表纖維噴層韌性必然高」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High compression strength guarantees high fibre-shotcrete toughness" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「裂後承載與纖維橋接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 裂後承載與纖維橋接
knowledge.text: 首裂以前主要由水泥基材承受拉應力，裂後則由跨縫纖維傳力。纖維可能拔出、拉斷或與基材局部剝離，因此高抗壓不保證高殘餘荷載；應沿整條荷載位移曲線辨識峰值後的衰減，而非只比較最大力。
knowledge.textEn: The matrix carries most tensile action before cracking; bridging fibres transfer force afterward. Pullout, rupture and local debonding create different responses, so high compression strength does not guarantee residual resistance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：抗壓強度高就代表纖維噴層韌性必然高 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High compression strength guarantees high fibre-shotcrete toughness Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「裂後承載與纖維橋接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging" is correct?
options: 抗壓強度高就代表纖維噴層韌性必然高
首裂以前主要由水泥基材承受拉應力，裂後則由跨縫纖維傳力。
荷載曲線下面積可以不管位移量測位置
optionsEn: High compression strength guarantees high fibre-shotcrete toughness
The matrix carries most tensile action before cracking; bridging fibres transfer force afterward.
Curve area is valid regardless of where displacement is measured
quiz.explanation: 首裂以前主要由水泥基材承受拉應力，裂後則由跨縫纖維傳力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The matrix carries most tensile action before cracking; bridging fibres transfer force afterward. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 裂後承載與纖維橋接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裂後承載與纖維橋接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「裂後承載與纖維橋接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging", which statement holds?
options: 把纖維總根數乘餘弦就能得到跨縫根數

steps.title: 裂後承載與纖維橋接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裂後承載與纖維橋接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「裂後承載與纖維橋接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging"?
options: 在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
重複次數多就能自動消除所有系統誤差
optionsEn: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Many repetitions automatically eliminate every systematic error
quiz.explanation: 在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 裂後承載與纖維橋接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裂後承載與纖維橋接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點；若出現高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抗壓強度高就代表纖維噴層韌性必然高」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High compression strength guarantees high fibre-shotcrete toughness" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「裂後承載與纖維橋接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋。
荷載曲線下面積可以不管位移量測位置
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force.
Curve area is valid regardless of where displacement is measured
quiz.explanation: 高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 力位移曲線的能量積分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Energy integration of force-displacement curves: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「力位移曲線的能量積分」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Energy integration of force-displacement curves” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 試板吸收能量是荷載對測定位移的積分，單位為力乘距離。使用橫樑行程會混入機架與接觸變形，積分面積因而可能偏大；位移量測應明確指向試板中央或規定位置，並保存積分區間與離散方法。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以校正荷重及獨立中央位移重算梯形積分面積；若出現機架柔度被算成試板變形而高估材料吸能，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「力位移曲線的能量積分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Absorbed panel energy integrates force over the prescribed displacement. Crosshead travel includes machine and contact compliance and can inflate the area. Define displacement at the panel centre or specified location, and preserve the integration interval and discretization method. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Recompute trapezoidal area using calibrated force and independent central displacement. If frame compliance counted as panel deformation overstates material energy absorption, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Energy integration of force-displacement curves” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：E=Fmean*delta=20 kN*25 mm=500 J。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: E=Fmean*delta=20 kN*25 mm=500 J.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「荷載曲線下面積可以不管位移量測位置」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Curve area is valid regardless of where displacement is measured" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「力位移曲線的能量積分」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Energy integration of force-displacement curves”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 力位移曲線的能量積分
knowledge.text: 試板吸收能量是荷載對測定位移的積分，單位為力乘距離。使用橫樑行程會混入機架與接觸變形，積分面積因而可能偏大；位移量測應明確指向試板中央或規定位置，並保存積分區間與離散方法。
knowledge.textEn: Absorbed panel energy integrates force over the prescribed displacement. Crosshead travel includes machine and contact compliance and can inflate the area.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：荷載曲線下面積可以不管位移量測位置 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Curve area is valid regardless of where displacement is measured Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「力位移曲線的能量積分」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Energy integration of force-displacement curves" is correct?
options: 荷載曲線下面積可以不管位移量測位置
不同厚度的試板能量可以直接比較優劣
試板吸收能量是荷載對測定位移的積分，單位為力乘距離。
optionsEn: Curve area is valid regardless of where displacement is measured
Energy from panels of different thickness directly ranks material quality
Absorbed panel energy integrates force over the prescribed displacement.
quiz.explanation: 試板吸收能量是荷載對測定位移的積分，單位為力乘距離。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Absorbed panel energy integrates force over the prescribed displacement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.instruction: 以校正荷重及獨立中央位移重算梯形積分面積。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「機架柔度被算成試板變形而高估材料吸能」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 力位移曲線的能量積分：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 機架柔度被算成試板變形而高估材料吸能。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以校正荷重及獨立中央位移重算梯形積分面積，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Frame compliance counted as panel deformation overstates material energy absorption. steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「荷載曲線下面積可以不管位移量測位置」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Curve area is valid regardless of where displacement is measured" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「面板厚度與彎曲尺度」與「纖維方向與法向力分量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Panel thickness and bending scale" and "Fibre orientation and normal force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 面板厚度與彎曲尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Panel thickness and bending scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「面板厚度與彎曲尺度」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Panel thickness and bending scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相同材料配比的面板，厚度改變會改變彎曲剛度、裂縫分布與纖維總數。梁條彎矩尺度對厚度平方敏感，但完整面板仍有雙向裂縫及膜效應；試驗比較必須先鎖定幾何，不可把厚板能量直接當成薄噴層的材料指標。 判別這個機制時，應觀察量測試板各區厚度及支承位置，按相同幾何組別比較；若出現厚試板掩蓋低纖維效果，現地薄區卻先裂損，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「面板厚度與彎曲尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thickness changes bending stiffness, crack distribution and the number of engaged fibres even at equal mix. A strip moment scale varies with thickness squared, while full panels add two-way cracking and membrane action. Fix geometry before treating energy as a material comparison. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure local panel thickness and support positions and compare matched geometries. If a thick panel conceals weak fibre performance while thin installed zones crack first, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Panel thickness and bending scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：M=f*b*h^2/6=3 MPa*0.10 m*(0.10 m)^2/6=0.50 kNm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: M=f*b*h^2/6=3 MPa*0.10 m*(0.10 m)^2/6=0.50 kNm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「不同厚度的試板能量可以直接比較優劣」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Energy from panels of different thickness directly ranks material quality" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「面板厚度與彎曲尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Panel thickness and bending scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 面板厚度與彎曲尺度
knowledge.text: 相同材料配比的面板，厚度改變會改變彎曲剛度、裂縫分布與纖維總數。梁條彎矩尺度對厚度平方敏感，但完整面板仍有雙向裂縫及膜效應；試驗比較必須先鎖定幾何，不可把厚板能量直接當成薄噴層的材料指標。
knowledge.textEn: Thickness changes bending stiffness, crack distribution and the number of engaged fibres even at equal mix. A strip moment scale varies with thickness squared, while full panels add two-way cracking and membrane action.

knowledge.text: 誤解：不同厚度的試板能量可以直接比較優劣 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Energy from panels of different thickness directly ranks material quality Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：M=f*b*h^2/6=3 MPa*0.10 m*(0.10 m)^2/6=0.50 kNm。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: M=f*b*h^2/6=3 MPa*0.10 m*(0.10 m)^2/6=0.50 kNm. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測試板各區厚度及支承位置，按相同幾何組別比較。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 量測試板各區厚度及支承位置，按相同幾何組別比較。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「厚試板掩蓋低纖維效果，現地薄區卻先裂損」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure local panel thickness and support positions and compare matched geometries. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A thick panel conceals weak fibre performance while thin installed zones crack first. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 面板厚度與彎曲尺度：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「面板厚度與彎曲尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Panel thickness and bending scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 厚試板掩蓋低纖維效果，現地薄區卻先裂損。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到量測試板各區厚度及支承位置，按相同幾何組別比較，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A thick panel conceals weak fibre performance while thin installed zones crack first. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure local panel thickness and support positions and compare matched geometries to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察量測試板各區厚度及支承位置，按相同幾何組別比較；若出現厚試板掩蓋低纖維效果，現地薄區卻先裂損，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a thick panel conceals weak fibre performance while thin installed zones crack first, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不同厚度的試板能量可以直接比較優劣」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Energy from panels of different thickness directly ranks material quality" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 纖維方向與法向力分量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fibre orientation and normal force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「纖維方向與法向力分量」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fibre orientation and normal force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 纖維沿噴射方向及流動方向重新排列，跨越裂縫的角度影響法向傳力。餘弦可用來投影單根已知纖維的力，卻不能直接計算跨縫根數；根數還受位置、長度及三維取向分布控制，必須透過切面或影像取樣描述。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以切面纖維取向統計配對裂縫兩側的殘餘荷載；若出現有利方向的試體高估另一方向現地裂縫的橋接力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「纖維方向與法向力分量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Spraying and flow orient fibres, and crossing angles affect normal transfer. A cosine projects a known fibre force but does not directly count crossings. Counts also depend on position, length and three-dimensional orientation, requiring section or image sampling rather than a force-projection shortcut. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Pair sectional orientation statistics with residual loads across the crack. If favourably oriented specimens overstate bridging across differently oriented field cracks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fibre orientation and normal force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Fnormal=100 N*cos(60 deg)=50 N; angle measured from crack normal。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Fnormal=100 N*cos(60 deg)=50 N; angle measured from crack normal.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把纖維總根數乘餘弦就能得到跨縫根數」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Multiplying total fibre count by a cosine gives the number crossing cracks" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「纖維方向與法向力分量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fibre orientation and normal force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 纖維方向與法向力分量
knowledge.text: 纖維沿噴射方向及流動方向重新排列，跨越裂縫的角度影響法向傳力。餘弦可用來投影單根已知纖維的力，卻不能直接計算跨縫根數；根數還受位置、長度及三維取向分布控制，必須透過切面或影像取樣描述。
knowledge.textEn: Spraying and flow orient fibres, and crossing angles affect normal transfer. A cosine projects a known fibre force but does not directly count crossings.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：把纖維總根數乘餘弦就能得到跨縫根數 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Multiplying total fibre count by a cosine gives the number crossing cracks Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

optionsEn: Multiplying total fibre count by a cosine gives the number crossing cracks
Spraying and flow orient fibres, and crossing angles affect normal transfer.
Equal wire tensile strength guarantees identical pullout energy

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fibre orientation and normal force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Fnormal=100 N*cos(60 deg)=50 N; angle measured from crack normal。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Fnormal=100 N*cos(60 deg)=50 N; angle measured from crack normal. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair sectional orientation statistics with residual loads across the crack.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以切面纖維取向統計配對裂縫兩側的殘餘荷載。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「有利方向的試體高估另一方向現地裂縫的橋接力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Pair sectional orientation statistics with residual loads across the crack. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Favourably oriented specimens overstate bridging across differently oriented field cracks. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將以切面纖維取向統計配對裂縫兩側的殘餘荷載列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現有利方向的試體高估另一方向現地裂縫的橋接力，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Pair sectional orientation statistics with residual loads across the crack. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If favourably oriented specimens overstate bridging across differently oriented field cracks, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「纖維方向與法向力分量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
High compression strength guarantees high fibre-shotcrete toughness
quiz.explanation: 以切面纖維取向統計配對裂縫兩側的殘餘荷載。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair sectional orientation statistics with residual loads across the crack. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 纖維方向與法向力分量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fibre orientation and normal force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「纖維方向與法向力分量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fibre orientation and normal force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 有利方向的試體高估另一方向現地裂縫的橋接力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以切面纖維取向統計配對裂縫兩側的殘餘荷載，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Favourably oriented specimens overstate bridging across differently oriented field cracks. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to pair sectional orientation statistics with residual loads across the crack to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以切面纖維取向統計配對裂縫兩側的殘餘荷載；若出現有利方向的試體高估另一方向現地裂縫的橋接力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If favourably oriented specimens overstate bridging across differently oriented field cracks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「把纖維總根數乘餘弦就能得到跨縫根數」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Multiplying total fibre count by a cosine gives the number crossing cracks" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 有利方向的試體高估另一方向現地裂縫的橋接力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以切面纖維取向統計配對裂縫兩側的殘餘荷載，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「纖維方向與法向力分量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fibre orientation and normal force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

有利方向的試體高估另一方向現地裂縫的橋接力。

Favourably oriented specimens overstate bridging across differently oriented field cracks.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「拔出功與界面滑移」與「取樣批次與纖維分散」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pullout work and interface slip" and "Sampling batches and fibre dispersion": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 拔出功與界面滑移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pullout work and interface slip: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拔出功與界面滑移」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pullout work and interface slip” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 纖維拔出過程的摩擦與機械錨固能持續耗能，過強界面反而可能導致脆性拉斷。拔出功屬單根纖維與試件的組合，不能不考慮互相干擾便乘上所有纖維數；嵌入長度及端部形狀要隨試驗一起報告。 判別這個機制時，應觀察記錄拔出曲線、嵌入長度及斷纖或滑移的比例；若出現表面鍍層變化使滑移功降低，即使鋼絲強度不變，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拔出功與界面滑移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Friction and mechanical anchorage dissipate energy during pullout, whereas an overly strong interface can promote rupture. Single-fibre work belongs to that specimen system and cannot be multiplied by every fibre without interaction assumptions. Report embedment length and end shape with the result. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record pullout curves, embedment lengths and proportions of rupture versus sliding. If a changed surface coating reduces sliding work despite unchanged wire strength, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pullout work and interface slip” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Wpull=Fmean*slip=80 N*0.010 m=0.80 J per assumed fibre。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Wpull=Fmean*slip=80 N*0.010 m=0.80 J per assumed fibre.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼絲抗拉強度相同就保證拔出能量相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal wire tensile strength guarantees identical pullout energy" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拔出功與界面滑移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pullout work and interface slip”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拔出功與界面滑移
knowledge.text: 纖維拔出過程的摩擦與機械錨固能持續耗能，過強界面反而可能導致脆性拉斷。拔出功屬單根纖維與試件的組合，不能不考慮互相干擾便乘上所有纖維數；嵌入長度及端部形狀要隨試驗一起報告。
knowledge.textEn: Friction and mechanical anchorage dissipate energy during pullout, whereas an overly strong interface can promote rupture. Single-fibre work belongs to that specimen system and cannot be multiplied by every fibre without interaction assumptions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼絲抗拉強度相同就保證拔出能量相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal wire tensile strength guarantees identical pullout energy Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「拔出功與界面滑移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pullout work and interface slip" is correct?
options: 鋼絲抗拉強度相同就保證拔出能量相同
平均纖維用量符合就不需要檢查分散均勻度
纖維拔出過程的摩擦與機械錨固能持續耗能，過強界面反而可能導致脆性拉斷。
optionsEn: Equal wire tensile strength guarantees identical pullout energy
Passing mean fibre dosage removes the need to assess dispersion
Friction and mechanical anchorage dissipate energy during pullout, whereas an overly strong interface can promote rupture.
quiz.explanation: 纖維拔出過程的摩擦與機械錨固能持續耗能，過強界面反而可能導致脆性拉斷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Friction and mechanical anchorage dissipate energy during pullout, whereas an overly strong interface can promote rupture. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 拔出功與界面滑移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pullout work and interface slip: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拔出功與界面滑移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pullout work and interface slip” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Wpull=Fmean*slip=80 N*0.010 m=0.80 J per assumed fibre。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Wpull=Fmean*slip=80 N*0.010 m=0.80 J per assumed fibre. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄拔出曲線、嵌入長度及斷纖或滑移的比例。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record pullout curves, embedment lengths and proportions of rupture versus sliding.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Wpull=Fmean*slip=80 N*0.010 m=0.80 J per assumed fibre。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「拔出功與界面滑移」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pullout work and interface slip", which statement holds?

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

quiz.question: 要驗證「拔出功與界面滑移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pullout work and interface slip"?

Record pullout curves, embedment lengths and proportions of rupture versus sliding.
Curve area is valid regardless of where displacement is measured

quiz.explanationEn: Record pullout curves, embedment lengths and proportions of rupture versus sliding. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 拔出功與界面滑移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pullout work and interface slip: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拔出功與界面滑移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pullout work and interface slip” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 表面鍍層變化使滑移功降低，即使鋼絲強度不變。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到記錄拔出曲線、嵌入長度及斷纖或滑移的比例，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A changed surface coating reduces sliding work despite unchanged wire strength. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record pullout curves, embedment lengths and proportions of rupture versus sliding to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察記錄拔出曲線、嵌入長度及斷纖或滑移的比例；若出現表面鍍層變化使滑移功降低，即使鋼絲強度不變，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a changed surface coating reduces sliding work despite unchanged wire strength, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼絲抗拉強度相同就保證拔出能量相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal wire tensile strength guarantees identical pullout energy" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

quiz.question: 在「拔出功與界面滑移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

Passing mean fibre dosage removes the need to assess dispersion
A changed surface coating reduces sliding work despite unchanged wire strength.

steps.title: 取樣批次與纖維分散：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sampling batches and fibre dispersion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「取樣批次與纖維分散」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sampling batches and fibre dispersion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 材料平均纖維質量相同，局部團聚仍會造成弱區。小試樣若只來自易取位置，容易漏掉噴射陰影或回彈較大的區段；抽樣應保留空間位置，將分散度和平均值分開呈現，才能辨識材料混合與施工方向的影響。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以分區洗出或適當材料辨識法比較纖維量離散；若出現團聚區與缺纖區互相平均，留下低韌性的薄弱帶，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「取樣批次與纖維分散」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Equal mean fibre mass can coexist with local clusters and weak zones. Convenient small samples can miss spray shadows or high-rebound areas. Retain spatial locations and report dispersion separately from the mean to distinguish mixing effects from placement orientation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare spatial fibre-content dispersion using washout or suitable material identification. If clusters average with fibre-poor zones and leave a low-toughness band, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sampling batches and fibre dispersion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：CV=standardDeviation/mean=5 kg/m3/35 kg/m3=0.143=14.3 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: CV=standardDeviation/mean=5 kg/m3/35 kg/m3=0.143=14.3 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均纖維用量符合就不需要檢查分散均勻度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 取樣批次與纖維分散：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「取樣批次與纖維分散」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sampling batches and fibre dispersion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：CV=standardDeviation/mean=5 kg/m3/35 kg/m3=0.143=14.3 percent。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: CV=standardDeviation/mean=5 kg/m3/35 kg/m3=0.143=14.3 percent. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分區洗出或適當材料辨識法比較纖維量離散。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare spatial fibre-content dispersion using washout or suitable material identification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以分區洗出或適當材料辨識法比較纖維量離散；若出現團聚區與缺纖區互相平均，留下低韌性的薄弱帶，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.textEn: Clusters average with fibre-poor zones and leave a low-toughness band. stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「荷重位移同步與零點」與「重複試驗與不確定度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Force-displacement synchronization and zero" and "Repeated tests and uncertainty": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 荷重位移同步與零點：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Force-displacement synchronization and zero: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「荷重位移同步與零點」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Force-displacement synchronization and zero” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 能量積分需要同一時刻的荷重與位移，資料流延遲會把峰值配到錯誤開口。試件接觸前的行程不應列入試板變形，接觸壓密又須與真正裂後位移區分；儀器零點、取樣率及濾波設定都會影響曲線形狀。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用共同事件校核兩通道時間差及接觸零點；若出現時間錯位扭曲裂後面積，造成虛假的韌性增益，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「荷重位移同步與零點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Energy integration requires synchronized force and displacement; stream delay pairs a peak with the wrong opening. Precontact motion is not panel deflection, and seating differs from postcrack displacement. Zero, sampling rate and filters therefore influence the interpreted curve. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check channel lag and contact zero with a shared identifiable event. If timing mismatch distorts postcrack area and creates false toughness improvement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Force-displacement synchronization and zero” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：phaseTravel=loadingSpeed*timeLag=0.5 mm/min*0.2 min=0.10 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: phaseTravel=loadingSpeed*timeLag=0.5 mm/min*0.2 min=0.10 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「荷重與位移各自準確就不需要同步取樣」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「荷重位移同步與零點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 荷重位移同步與零點

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

steps.title: 荷重位移同步與零點：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Force-displacement synchronization and zero: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「荷重位移同步與零點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Force-displacement synchronization and zero” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：phaseTravel=loadingSpeed*timeLag=0.5 mm/min*0.2 min=0.10 mm。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: phaseTravel=loadingSpeed*timeLag=0.5 mm/min*0.2 min=0.10 mm. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用共同事件校核兩通道時間差及接觸零點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check channel lag and contact zero with a shared identifiable event.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：phaseTravel=loadingSpeed*timeLag=0.5 mm/min*0.2 min=0.10 mm。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Force-displacement synchronization and zero” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用共同事件校核兩通道時間差及接觸零點。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「時間錯位扭曲裂後面積，造成虛假的韌性增益」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check channel lag and contact zero with a shared identifiable event. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If timing mismatch distorts postcrack area and creates false toughness improvement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
