knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「荷重位移同步與零點」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Force-displacement synchronization and zero" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
時間錯位扭曲裂後面積，造成虛假的韌性增益。
重複次數多就能自動消除所有系統誤差
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Timing mismatch distorts postcrack area and creates false toughness improvement.
Many repetitions automatically eliminate every systematic error
quiz.explanation: 時間錯位扭曲裂後面積，造成虛假的韌性增益。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Timing mismatch distorts postcrack area and creates false toughness improvement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 重複試驗與不確定度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Repeated tests and uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重複試驗與不確定度」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Repeated tests and uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 纖維跨縫數具隨機性，單一試板不能代表整批材料。增加重複數能改善平均值估計，但不能補救有偏的取樣位置；報告應區分樣本標準差與平均值標準誤，並展示個別曲線以辨認異常破壞型態。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散；若出現只報平均值掩蓋少數極低能量試件及取樣偏差，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重複試驗與不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Random fibre crossings make one panel insufficient for a batch. Replication improves estimation of the mean but cannot correct biased sampling positions. Separate sample standard deviation from standard error and show individual curves so unusual failure patterns remain visible. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare individual curves, mean and dispersion from nine independent panels. If a mean-only report hides very low-energy specimens and sampling bias, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Repeated tests and uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：standardError=s/sqrt(n)=60 J/sqrt(9)=20 J。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: standardError=s/sqrt(n)=60 J/sqrt(9)=20 J.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「重複次數多就能自動消除所有系統誤差」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Many repetitions automatically eliminate every systematic error" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重複試驗與不確定度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Repeated tests and uncertainty”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 重複試驗與不確定度
knowledge.text: 纖維跨縫數具隨機性，單一試板不能代表整批材料。增加重複數能改善平均值估計，但不能補救有偏的取樣位置；報告應區分樣本標準差與平均值標準誤，並展示個別曲線以辨認異常破壞型態。
knowledge.textEn: Random fibre crossings make one panel insufficient for a batch. Replication improves estimation of the mean but cannot correct biased sampling positions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：重複次數多就能自動消除所有系統誤差 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Many repetitions automatically eliminate every systematic error Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「重複試驗與不確定度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Repeated tests and uncertainty" is correct?
options: 重複次數多就能自動消除所有系統誤差
初期韌性合格就保證整個設計年限不衰退
纖維跨縫數具隨機性，單一試板不能代表整批材料。
optionsEn: Many repetitions automatically eliminate every systematic error
Passing initial toughness guarantees no deterioration throughout the design life
Random fibre crossings make one panel insufficient for a batch.
quiz.explanation: 纖維跨縫數具隨機性，單一試板不能代表整批材料。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Random fibre crossings make one panel insufficient for a batch. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 重複試驗與不確定度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Repeated tests and uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重複試驗與不確定度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Repeated tests and uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：standardError=s/sqrt(n)=60 J/sqrt(9)=20 J。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: standardError=s/sqrt(n)=60 J/sqrt(9)=20 J. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare individual curves, mean and dispersion from nine independent panels.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：standardError=s/sqrt(n)=60 J/sqrt(9)=20 J。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: standardError=s/sqrt(n)=60 J/sqrt(9)=20 J. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「重複試驗與不確定度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Repeated tests and uncertainty", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：standardError=s/sqrt(n)=60 J/sqrt(9)=20 J。
抗壓強度高就代表纖維噴層韌性必然高
不同厚度的試板能量可以直接比較優劣
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: standardError=s/sqrt(n)=60 J/sqrt(9)=20 J.
High compression strength guarantees high fibre-shotcrete toughness
Energy from panels of different thickness directly ranks material quality
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：standardError=s/sqrt(n)=60 J/sqrt(9)=20 J。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: standardError=s/sqrt(n)=60 J/sqrt(9)=20 J. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 重複試驗與不確定度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Repeated tests and uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「重複試驗與不確定度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Repeated tests and uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只報平均值掩蓋少數極低能量試件及取樣偏差」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare individual curves, mean and dispersion from nine independent panels. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A mean-only report hides very low-energy specimens and sampling bias. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只報平均值掩蓋少數極低能量試件及取樣偏差，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare individual curves, mean and dispersion from nine independent panels. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a mean-only report hides very low-energy specimens and sampling bias, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只報平均值掩蓋少數極低能量試件及取樣偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A mean-only report hides very low-energy specimens and sampling bias. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只報平均值掩蓋少數極低能量試件及取樣偏差」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare individual curves, mean and dispersion from nine independent panels. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A mean-only report hides very low-energy specimens and sampling bias. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只報平均值掩蓋少數極低能量試件及取樣偏差，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare individual curves, mean and dispersion from nine independent panels. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a mean-only report hides very low-energy specimens and sampling bias, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「重複試驗與不確定度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Repeated tests and uncertainty"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散。
鋼絲抗拉強度相同就保證拔出能量相同
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare individual curves, mean and dispersion from nine independent panels.
Equal wire tensile strength guarantees identical pullout energy
quiz.explanation: 比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare individual curves, mean and dispersion from nine independent panels. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 重複試驗與不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Repeated tests and uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重複試驗與不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Repeated tests and uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只報平均值掩蓋少數極低能量試件及取樣偏差。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A mean-only report hides very low-energy specimens and sampling bias. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare individual curves, mean and dispersion from nine independent panels to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散；若出現只報平均值掩蓋少數極低能量試件及取樣偏差，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a mean-only report hides very low-energy specimens and sampling bias, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「重複次數多就能自動消除所有系統誤差」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Many repetitions automatically eliminate every systematic error" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只報平均值掩蓋少數極低能量試件及取樣偏差。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A mean-only report hides very low-energy specimens and sampling bias. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare individual curves, mean and dispersion from nine independent panels to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「重複試驗與不確定度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Repeated tests and uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
初期韌性合格就保證整個設計年限不衰退
只報平均值掩蓋少數極低能量試件及取樣偏差。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Passing initial toughness guarantees no deterioration throughout the design life
A mean-only report hides very low-energy specimens and sampling bias.
quiz.explanation: 只報平均值掩蓋少數極低能量試件及取樣偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A mean-only report hides very low-energy specimens and sampling bias. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「環境老化與殘餘能力」與「性能規格與試法交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Environmental ageing and residual resistance" and "Performance specifications and method handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 環境老化與殘餘能力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Environmental ageing and residual resistance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「環境老化與殘餘能力」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Environmental ageing and residual resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 裂縫開放後纖維及界面暴露於水與化學環境，長期表現不能只由初期能量推定。加速試驗的溫度或溶液可能改變失效機制，因此老化前後必須採同幾何及同位移定義，並檢查裂縫處的實際腐蝕或脆化證據。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀；若出現不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環境老化與殘餘能力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Open cracks expose fibres and interfaces to water and chemistry, so initial energy cannot establish long-term resistance. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces. quiz.question: 關於「環境老化與殘餘能力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Environmental ageing and residual resistance" is correct?

steps.title: 環境老化與殘餘能力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Environmental ageing and residual resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環境老化與殘餘能力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Environmental ageing and residual resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：retainedEnergy=420 J/500 J=0.84=84 percent。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: retainedEnergy=420 J/500 J=0.84=84 percent. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：retainedEnergy=420 J/500 J=0.84=84 percent。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 環境老化與殘餘能力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Environmental ageing and residual resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環境老化與殘餘能力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Environmental ageing and residual resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An unrepresentative accelerated exposure mispredicts field interface degradation. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an unrepresentative accelerated exposure mispredicts field interface degradation, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An unrepresentative accelerated exposure mispredicts field interface degradation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An unrepresentative accelerated exposure mispredicts field interface degradation. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an unrepresentative accelerated exposure mispredicts field interface degradation, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環境老化與殘餘能力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Environmental ageing and residual resistance"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
平均纖維用量符合就不需要檢查分散均勻度
對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Passing mean fibre dosage removes the need to assess dispersion
Compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces.
quiz.explanation: 對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 環境老化與殘餘能力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Environmental ageing and residual resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環境老化與殘餘能力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Environmental ageing and residual resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An unrepresentative accelerated exposure mispredicts field interface degradation. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀；若出現不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If an unrepresentative accelerated exposure mispredicts field interface degradation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「初期韌性合格就保證整個設計年限不衰退」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing initial toughness guarantees no deterioration throughout the design life" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: An unrepresentative accelerated exposure mispredicts field interface degradation. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環境老化與殘餘能力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Environmental ageing and residual resistance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Results expressed in joules can always be compared across test methods

steps.title: 性能規格與試法交接：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「性能規格與試法交接」如何影響纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Performance specifications and method handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 規格若只寫一個焦耳數卻沒有試板尺寸、支承及截止位移，數字缺乏可比較的物理意義。梁試驗和板試驗有不同裂縫路徑，不能直接換算；交接應保留版本、曲線和取樣方向，讓維修材料採用同一性能語言。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移；若出現不同試法結果被拼成一張合格表而無法重算，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「性能規格與試法交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A joule requirement without panel size, supports and terminal displacement lacks a comparable physical meaning. Beams and panels form different crack paths and are not directly interchangeable. Preserve method editions, curves and sampling directions so repair materials use the same performance definition. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit method edition, support, thickness, orientation and terminal displacement. If different test methods are pooled into a passing table that cannot be reproduced, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Performance specifications and method handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：methodCompleteness=recordedRequiredFields/requiredFields=7/8=87.5 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: methodCompleteness=recordedRequiredFields/requiredFields=7/8=87.5 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要報告單位都是焦耳就能跨試法直接比較」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Results expressed in joules can always be compared across test methods" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「性能規格與試法交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Performance specifications and method handover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 性能規格與試法交接
knowledge.text: 規格若只寫一個焦耳數卻沒有試板尺寸、支承及截止位移，數字缺乏可比較的物理意義。梁試驗和板試驗有不同裂縫路徑，不能直接換算；交接應保留版本、曲線和取樣方向，讓維修材料採用同一性能語言。
knowledge.textEn: A joule requirement without panel size, supports and terminal displacement lacks a comparable physical meaning. Beams and panels form different crack paths and are not directly interchangeable.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要報告單位都是焦耳就能跨試法直接比較 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Results expressed in joules can always be compared across test methods Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「性能規格與試法交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Performance specifications and method handover" is correct?
options: 只要報告單位都是焦耳就能跨試法直接比較
規格若只寫一個焦耳數卻沒有試板尺寸、支承及截止位移，數字缺乏可比較的物理意義。
抗壓強度高就代表纖維噴層韌性必然高
optionsEn: Results expressed in joules can always be compared across test methods
A joule requirement without panel size, supports and terminal displacement lacks a comparable physical meaning.
High compression strength guarantees high fibre-shotcrete toughness
quiz.explanation: 規格若只寫一個焦耳數卻沒有試板尺寸、支承及截止位移，數字缺乏可比較的物理意義。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A joule requirement without panel size, supports and terminal displacement lacks a comparable physical meaning. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 性能規格與試法交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Performance specifications and method handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「性能規格與試法交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Performance specifications and method handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：methodCompleteness=recordedRequiredFields/requiredFields=7/8=87.5 percent。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: methodCompleteness=recordedRequiredFields/requiredFields=7/8=87.5 percent. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit method edition, support, thickness, orientation and terminal displacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：methodCompleteness=recordedRequiredFields/requiredFields=7/8=87.5 percent。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: methodCompleteness=recordedRequiredFields/requiredFields=7/8=87.5 percent. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「性能規格與試法交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Performance specifications and method handover", which statement holds?
options: 不同厚度的試板能量可以直接比較優劣
鋼絲抗拉強度相同就保證拔出能量相同
原創教學假設：methodCompleteness=recordedRequiredFields/requiredFields=7/8=87.5 percent。
optionsEn: Energy from panels of different thickness directly ranks material quality
Equal wire tensile strength guarantees identical pullout energy
Original teaching assumptions: methodCompleteness=recordedRequiredFields/requiredFields=7/8=87.5 percent.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：methodCompleteness=recordedRequiredFields/requiredFields=7/8=87.5 percent。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: methodCompleteness=recordedRequiredFields/requiredFields=7/8=87.5 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 性能規格與試法交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Performance specifications and method handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「性能規格與試法交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Performance specifications and method handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「不同試法結果被拼成一張合格表而無法重算」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit method edition, support, thickness, orientation and terminal displacement. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Different test methods are pooled into a passing table that cannot be reproduced. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現不同試法結果被拼成一張合格表而無法重算，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Audit method edition, support, thickness, orientation and terminal displacement. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If different test methods are pooled into a passing table that cannot be reproduced, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同試法結果被拼成一張合格表而無法重算。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different test methods are pooled into a passing table that cannot be reproduced. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「不同試法結果被拼成一張合格表而無法重算」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Audit method edition, support, thickness, orientation and terminal displacement. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Different test methods are pooled into a passing table that cannot be reproduced. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現不同試法結果被拼成一張合格表而無法重算，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Audit method edition, support, thickness, orientation and terminal displacement. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If different test methods are pooled into a passing table that cannot be reproduced, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「性能規格與試法交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Performance specifications and method handover"?
options: 逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
荷重與位移各自準確就不需要同步取樣
optionsEn: Audit method edition, support, thickness, orientation and terminal displacement.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Accurate force and displacement channels do not need synchronized sampling
quiz.explanation: 逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit method edition, support, thickness, orientation and terminal displacement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 性能規格與試法交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Performance specifications and method handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「性能規格與試法交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Performance specifications and method handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不同試法結果被拼成一張合格表而無法重算。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different test methods are pooled into a passing table that cannot be reproduced. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit method edition, support, thickness, orientation and terminal displacement to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移；若出現不同試法結果被拼成一張合格表而無法重算，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If different test methods are pooled into a passing table that cannot be reproduced, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要報告單位都是焦耳就能跨試法直接比較」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Results expressed in joules can always be compared across test methods" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 不同試法結果被拼成一張合格表而無法重算。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Different test methods are pooled into a passing table that cannot be reproduced. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit method edition, support, thickness, orientation and terminal displacement to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「性能規格與試法交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Performance specifications and method handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
不同試法結果被拼成一張合格表而無法重算。
抗壓強度高就代表纖維噴層韌性必然高
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Different test methods are pooled into a passing table that cannot be reproduced.
High compression strength guarantees high fibre-shotcrete toughness
quiz.explanation: 不同試法結果被拼成一張合格表而無法重算。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Different test methods are pooled into a passing table that cannot be reproduced. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 隧道岩栓拉拔驗證
summary: 本課以辨識岩栓鋼材、漿體與岩體界面的拉拔傳力為主線，從岩楔荷重與岩栓方向與鋼材屈服與有效面積建立系統邊界，再把自由段伸長與系統柔度、持載位移與時間效應連到試驗代表性與補強決策。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on distinguish bolt steel, grout and rock interfaces in pullout load transfer. It begins with Wedge weight and bolt direction and Steel yielding and effective area, links Free-length extension and system compliance and Hold movement and time effects, and ends with Representativeness and reinforcement decisions. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查岩楔荷重與岩栓方向：W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each；再獨立檢查鋼材屈服與有效面積：Ny=A*fy=314 mm2*500 N/mm2=157000 N=157 kN。假想岩楔由 4 增為 5 m3，單位重 26 kN/m3 不變，重量由 104 增為 130 kN；兩支垂直岩栓只有在理想對稱下才各分擔 65 kN。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 將用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Wedge weight and bolt direction: W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each. Independently check Steel yielding and effective area: Ny=A*fy=314 mm2*500 N/mm2=157000 N=157 kN. Increasing assumed wedge volume from 4 to 5 m3 at 26 kN/m3 raises weight from 104 to 130 kN; two vertical bolts share 65 kN each only under ideal symmetry. The two results are not a complete design because a single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. Use compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」與「鋼材屈服與有效面積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wedge weight and bolt direction" and "Steel yielding and effective area": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 岩楔荷重與岩栓方向：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wedge weight and bolt direction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wedge weight and bolt direction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.

steps.title: 岩楔荷重與岩栓方向：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wedge weight and bolt direction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: W=gamma*V=26 kN/m3*4 m3=104 kN; two symmetric vertical bolts carry 52 kN each. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將節理交線、岩楔體積與岩栓方向畫在同一量測圖。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 岩楔荷重與岩栓方向：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wedge weight and bolt direction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將節理交線、岩楔體積與岩栓方向畫在同一量測圖。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「岩栓未穿越滑動面，試驗合格仍可能隨岩楔一起掉落」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot joint intersections, wedge volume and bolt directions in the same surveyed geometry. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A bolt not crossing the sliding surface can pass a pull test yet fall with the wedge. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將節理交線、岩楔體積與岩栓方向畫在同一量測圖列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現岩栓未穿越滑動面，試驗合格仍可能隨岩楔一起掉落，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：岩栓未穿越滑動面，試驗合格仍可能隨岩楔一起掉落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.instruction: 岩栓未穿越滑動面，試驗合格仍可能隨岩楔一起掉落。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將節理交線、岩楔體積與岩栓方向畫在同一量測圖，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 鋼材屈服與有效面積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Steel yielding and effective area: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋼材屈服與有效面積」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steel yielding and effective area” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼材承載面積可能由螺紋根部或腐蝕局部截面控制，不一定等於公稱直徑。拉拔系統也包含接頭和夾具，若先發生局部滑移，量得曲線便不是純鋼材拉伸；應把鋼材屈服與界面拔出分開設定模型。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對螺紋有效面積、材證與載入後的永久伸長；若出現以光桿面積計算高估螺紋承載，破壞集中在接頭，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼材屈服與有效面積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The thread root or a locally corroded section may control steel area rather than nominal diameter. Connections and grips also belong to the pull system; early slip produces a response unlike pure steel tension. Model steel yielding separately from interface pullout and identify which limit is being tested. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check thread area, material certificates and permanent elongation after loading. If using shank area overstates thread capacity and concentrates failure at the connection, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Steel yielding and effective area” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 鋼材屈服與有效面積
knowledge.text: 鋼材承載面積可能由螺紋根部或腐蝕局部截面控制，不一定等於公稱直徑。拉拔系統也包含接頭和夾具，若先發生局部滑移，量得曲線便不是純鋼材拉伸；應把鋼材屈服與界面拔出分開設定模型。
knowledge.textEn: The thread root or a locally corroded section may control steel area rather than nominal diameter. Connections and grips also belong to the pull system; early slip produces a response unlike pure steel tension.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

steps.title: 鋼材屈服與有效面積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Steel yielding and effective area: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼材屈服與有效面積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steel yielding and effective area” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Ny=A*fy=314 mm2*500 N/mm2=157000 N=157 kN。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Ny=A*fy=314 mm2*500 N/mm2=157000 N=157 kN. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對螺紋有效面積、材證與載入後的永久伸長。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check thread area, material certificates and permanent elongation after loading.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 鋼材屈服與有效面積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Steel yielding and effective area: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼材屈服與有效面積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Steel yielding and effective area” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對螺紋有效面積、材證與載入後的永久伸長。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「以光桿面積計算高估螺紋承載，破壞集中在接頭」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check thread area, material certificates and permanent elongation after loading. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Using shank area overstates thread capacity and concentrates failure at the connection. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對螺紋有效面積、材證與載入後的永久伸長列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現以光桿面積計算高估螺紋承載，破壞集中在接頭，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If using shank area overstates thread capacity and concentrates failure at the connection, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以光桿面積計算高估螺紋承載，破壞集中在接頭。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對螺紋有效面積、材證與載入後的永久伸長。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「以光桿面積計算高估螺紋承載，破壞集中在接頭」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Using shank area overstates thread capacity and concentrates failure at the connection. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.text: 將核對螺紋有效面積、材證與載入後的永久伸長列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現以光桿面積計算高估螺紋承載，破壞集中在接頭，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼材屈服與有效面積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Check thread area, material certificates and permanent elongation after loading.
Small average corrosion guarantees adequate resistance at every section

steps.title: 鋼材屈服與有效面積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Steel yielding and effective area: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼材屈服與有效面積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Steel yielding and effective area” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以光桿面積計算高估螺紋承載，破壞集中在接頭。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對螺紋有效面積、材證與載入後的永久伸長，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using shank area overstates thread capacity and concentrates failure at the connection. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check thread area, material certificates and permanent elongation after loading to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對螺紋有效面積、材證與載入後的永久伸長；若出現以光桿面積計算高估螺紋承載，破壞集中在接頭，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岩栓公稱直徑足以代表所有承載截面」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Nominal bolt diameter represents every load-carrying section" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以光桿面積計算高估螺紋承載，破壞集中在接頭。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對螺紋有效面積、材證與載入後的永久伸長，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「鋼材屈服與有效面積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Steel yielding and effective area" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「漿體黏結與有效長度」與「托盤承壓與岩面凹凸」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Grout bond and effective length" and "Plate bearing and rock roughness": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 漿體黏結與有效長度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Grout bond and effective length: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漿體黏結與有效長度」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grout bond and effective length” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沿錨固段的剪應力通常不均勻，受拉端先動員而遠端可能尚未充分參與。均勻黏結公式只能作平均量級，裂隙、灌漿空洞與孔壁擾動會減少有效長度；提高漿體抗壓也不一定改善岩漿界面的剪力傳遞。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像；若出現漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漿體黏結與有效長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bond shear is nonuniform: the loaded end mobilizes before distant sections. A uniform-bond formula provides an average scale only. Fractures, grout voids and disturbed bore walls reduce effective length, while greater grout compression strength need not improve rock-grout shear transfer. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Pair pull curves with grout volume, bore diameter and available borehole images. If grout voids shorten effective length and bring local shear to its peak early, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Grout bond and effective length” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「灌漿總量足夠就證明整段錨固完全密實」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate total grout volume proves complete consolidation along the anchorage" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漿體黏結與有效長度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Grout bond and effective length”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 沿錨固段的剪應力通常不均勻，受拉端先動員而遠端可能尚未充分參與。均勻黏結公式只能作平均量級，裂隙、灌漿空洞與孔壁擾動會減少有效長度；提高漿體抗壓也不一定改善岩漿界面的剪力傳遞。
knowledge.textEn: Bond shear is nonuniform: the loaded end mobilizes before distant sections. A uniform-bond formula provides an average scale only.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：灌漿總量足夠就證明整段錨固完全密實 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate total grout volume proves complete consolidation along the anchorage Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「漿體黏結與有效長度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Grout bond and effective length" is correct?
options: 沿錨固段的剪應力通常不均勻，受拉端先動員而遠端可能尚未充分參與。
灌漿總量足夠就證明整段錨固完全密實
鋼托盤沒有變形就代表岩面承壓正常
optionsEn: Bond shear is nonuniform: the loaded end mobilizes before distant sections.
Adequate total grout volume proves complete consolidation along the anchorage
An undeformed steel plate proves acceptable rock bearing
quiz.explanation: 沿錨固段的剪應力通常不均勻，受拉端先動員而遠端可能尚未充分參與。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Bond shear is nonuniform: the loaded end mobilizes before distant sections. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 漿體黏結與有效長度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Grout bond and effective length: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「漿體黏結與有效長度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grout bond and effective length” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair pull curves with grout volume, bore diameter and available borehole images.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「漿體黏結與有效長度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Grout bond and effective length", which statement holds?
options: 反力架只影響設備而不會改變岩體行為

Original teaching assumptions: N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN.

quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.05 m*2 m*0.30 MPa=94.25 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 漿體黏結與有效長度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Grout bond and effective length: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「漿體黏結與有效長度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grout bond and effective length” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair pull curves with grout volume, bore diameter and available borehole images. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Grout voids shorten effective length and bring local shear to its peak early. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Pair pull curves with grout volume, bore diameter and available borehole images. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If grout voids shorten effective length and bring local shear to its peak early, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Grout voids shorten effective length and bring local shear to its peak early. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Grout voids shorten effective length and bring local shear to its peak early. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Pair pull curves with grout volume, bore diameter and available borehole images. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If grout voids shorten effective length and bring local shear to its peak early, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「漿體黏結與有效長度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Grout bond and effective length"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
抽測平均合格就可以證明所有地區的岩栓安全
以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A passing sample mean proves bolt safety in every geological zone
Pair pull curves with grout volume, bore diameter and available borehole images.
quiz.explanation: 以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair pull curves with grout volume, bore diameter and available borehole images. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 漿體黏結與有效長度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Grout bond and effective length: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「漿體黏結與有效長度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Grout bond and effective length” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Grout voids shorten effective length and bring local shear to its peak early. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to pair pull curves with grout volume, bore diameter and available borehole images to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像；若出現漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If grout voids shorten effective length and bring local shear to its peak early, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「灌漿總量足夠就證明整段錨固完全密實」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate total grout volume proves complete consolidation along the anchorage" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以拉拔曲線配對灌漿量、孔徑和可用孔內影像，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Grout voids shorten effective length and bring local shear to its peak early. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to pair pull curves with grout volume, bore diameter and available borehole images to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「漿體黏結與有效長度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Grout bond and effective length" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
鋼托盤沒有變形就代表岩面承壓正常
optionsEn: Grout voids shorten effective length and bring local shear to its peak early.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
An undeformed steel plate proves acceptable rock bearing
quiz.explanation: 漿體空洞縮短有效長度，使局部剪應力提早達峰。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Grout voids shorten effective length and bring local shear to its peak early. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 托盤承壓與岩面凹凸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Plate bearing and rock roughness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「托盤承壓與岩面凹凸」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Plate bearing and rock roughness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 托盤把軸力傳給局部岩面，實際接觸面積受凹凸、薄片和墊層影響。整片鋼板面積不等於受壓面積，局部壓碎可使預力流失而鋼栓仍完好；托盤轉角與岩面裂紋因此是傳力判讀的重要證據。 判別這個機制時，應觀察觀察托盤接觸印跡、轉角及周圍岩面裂紋；若出現托盤下薄片壓碎造成滑移，誤被判成鋼栓延伸，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「托盤承壓與岩面凹凸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A plate transfers axial force to local rock contact controlled by roughness, flakes and bedding. Gross plate area is not necessarily bearing area. Local crushing can lose preload while the bolt remains intact, making plate rotation and surrounding cracks important transfer evidence. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Inspect plate contact marks, rotation and cracks in the surrounding rock. If crushed flakes beneath the plate cause slip mistaken for bolt elongation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Plate bearing and rock roughness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：bearingStress=80 kN/0.020 m2=4 MPa; half the contact area gives 8 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: bearingStress=80 kN/0.020 m2=4 MPa; half the contact area gives 8 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼托盤沒有變形就代表岩面承壓正常」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An undeformed steel plate proves acceptable rock bearing" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「托盤承壓與岩面凹凸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Plate bearing and rock roughness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 托盤把軸力傳給局部岩面，實際接觸面積受凹凸、薄片和墊層影響。整片鋼板面積不等於受壓面積，局部壓碎可使預力流失而鋼栓仍完好；托盤轉角與岩面裂紋因此是傳力判讀的重要證據。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：bearingStress=80 kN/0.020 m2=4 MPa; half the contact area gives 8 MPa。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: bearingStress=80 kN/0.020 m2=4 MPa; half the contact area gives 8 MPa. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：觀察托盤接觸印跡、轉角及周圍岩面裂紋。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect plate contact marks, rotation and cracks in the surrounding rock.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：bearingStress=80 kN/0.020 m2=4 MPa; half the contact area gives 8 MPa。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: bearingStress=80 kN/0.020 m2=4 MPa; half the contact area gives 8 MPa. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「托盤承壓與岩面凹凸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Plate bearing and rock roughness", which statement holds?
options: 持載位移增加一定只代表岩漿界面蠕變
平均腐蝕量很小就保證每一截面承載正常
原創教學假設：bearingStress=80 kN/0.020 m2=4 MPa; half the contact area gives 8 MPa。
optionsEn: Increasing hold displacement always means rock-grout interface creep alone
Small average corrosion guarantees adequate resistance at every section
Original teaching assumptions: bearingStress=80 kN/0.020 m2=4 MPa; half the contact area gives 8 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：bearingStress=80 kN/0.020 m2=4 MPa; half the contact area gives 8 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
