steps.title: 托盤承壓與岩面凹凸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Plate bearing and rock roughness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「托盤承壓與岩面凹凸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Plate bearing and rock roughness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 觀察托盤接觸印跡、轉角及周圍岩面裂紋。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「托盤下薄片壓碎造成滑移，誤被判成鋼栓延伸」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect plate contact marks, rotation and cracks in the surrounding rock. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Crushed flakes beneath the plate cause slip mistaken for bolt elongation. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將觀察托盤接觸印跡、轉角及周圍岩面裂紋列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現托盤下薄片壓碎造成滑移，誤被判成鋼栓延伸，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Inspect plate contact marks, rotation and cracks in the surrounding rock. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If crushed flakes beneath the plate cause slip mistaken for bolt elongation, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：托盤下薄片壓碎造成滑移，誤被判成鋼栓延伸。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Crushed flakes beneath the plate cause slip mistaken for bolt elongation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 觀察托盤接觸印跡、轉角及周圍岩面裂紋。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「托盤下薄片壓碎造成滑移，誤被判成鋼栓延伸」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect plate contact marks, rotation and cracks in the surrounding rock. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Crushed flakes beneath the plate cause slip mistaken for bolt elongation. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將觀察托盤接觸印跡、轉角及周圍岩面裂紋列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現托盤下薄片壓碎造成滑移，誤被判成鋼栓延伸，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

quiz.question: 要驗證「托盤承壓與岩面凹凸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Plate bearing and rock roughness"?
options: 觀察托盤接觸印跡、轉角及周圍岩面裂紋。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
岩栓數量足夠便不必考慮節理方向
optionsEn: Inspect plate contact marks, rotation and cracks in the surrounding rock.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Enough bolts remove the need to consider joint orientation
quiz.explanation: 觀察托盤接觸印跡、轉角及周圍岩面裂紋。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspect plate contact marks, rotation and cracks in the surrounding rock. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 托盤承壓與岩面凹凸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Plate bearing and rock roughness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「托盤承壓與岩面凹凸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Plate bearing and rock roughness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 托盤下薄片壓碎造成滑移，誤被判成鋼栓延伸。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到觀察托盤接觸印跡、轉角及周圍岩面裂紋，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Crushed flakes beneath the plate cause slip mistaken for bolt elongation. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to inspect plate contact marks, rotation and cracks in the surrounding rock to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察觀察托盤接觸印跡、轉角及周圍岩面裂紋；若出現托盤下薄片壓碎造成滑移，誤被判成鋼栓延伸，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If crushed flakes beneath the plate cause slip mistaken for bolt elongation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼托盤沒有變形就代表岩面承壓正常」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An undeformed steel plate proves acceptable rock bearing" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 托盤下薄片壓碎造成滑移，誤被判成鋼栓延伸。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到觀察托盤接觸印跡、轉角及周圍岩面裂紋，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Crushed flakes beneath the plate cause slip mistaken for bolt elongation. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to inspect plate contact marks, rotation and cracks in the surrounding rock to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「托盤承壓與岩面凹凸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Plate bearing and rock roughness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
托盤下薄片壓碎造成滑移，誤被判成鋼栓延伸。
千斤頂行程就等於岩栓本身的伸長
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Crushed flakes beneath the plate cause slip mistaken for bolt elongation.
Jack travel always equals elongation of the bolt itself
quiz.explanation: 托盤下薄片壓碎造成滑移，誤被判成鋼栓延伸。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Crushed flakes beneath the plate cause slip mistaken for bolt elongation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「自由段伸長與系統柔度」與「反力位置與局部約束」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Free-length extension and system compliance" and "Reaction location and local restraint": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 自由段伸長與系統柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Free-length extension and system compliance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自由段伸長與系統柔度」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free-length extension and system compliance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量到的位移包含自由鋼材伸長、錨固滑移、夾具變形與反力架沉陷。用全長代入純鋼伸長公式會錯把黏結段當成自由段；比較載卸曲線可辨認可回復彈性與不可回復滑移，但仍需要獨立基準才能分離支承移動。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動；若出現反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自由段伸長與系統柔度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Measured movement combines free steel extension, bond slip, grip deformation and reaction-frame settlement. Full-length elastic calculation wrongly treats bonded length as free. Loading-unloading response distinguishes recoverable extension from slip, but independent references are still needed to separate support movement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure relative motion of bolt head, grip and reaction frame with independent gauges. If reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Free-length extension and system compliance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：delta=N*L/(E*A)=100000 N*2000 mm/(200000 N/mm2*314 mm2)=3.18 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: delta=N*L/(E*A)=100000 N*2000 mm/(200000 N/mm2*314 mm2)=3.18 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「千斤頂行程就等於岩栓本身的伸長」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Jack travel always equals elongation of the bolt itself" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「自由段伸長與系統柔度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Free-length extension and system compliance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 自由段伸長與系統柔度
knowledge.text: 量到的位移包含自由鋼材伸長、錨固滑移、夾具變形與反力架沉陷。用全長代入純鋼伸長公式會錯把黏結段當成自由段；比較載卸曲線可辨認可回復彈性與不可回復滑移，但仍需要獨立基準才能分離支承移動。
knowledge.textEn: Measured movement combines free steel extension, bond slip, grip deformation and reaction-frame settlement. Full-length elastic calculation wrongly treats bonded length as free.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：千斤頂行程就等於岩栓本身的伸長 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Jack travel always equals elongation of the bolt itself Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自由段伸長與系統柔度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Free-length extension and system compliance" is correct?
options: 千斤頂行程就等於岩栓本身的伸長
反力架只影響設備而不會改變岩體行為
量到的位移包含自由鋼材伸長、錨固滑移、夾具變形與反力架沉陷。
optionsEn: Jack travel always equals elongation of the bolt itself
The reaction frame affects equipment but never the surrounding rock
Measured movement combines free steel extension, bond slip, grip deformation and reaction-frame settlement.
quiz.explanation: 量到的位移包含自由鋼材伸長、錨固滑移、夾具變形與反力架沉陷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Measured movement combines free steel extension, bond slip, grip deformation and reaction-frame settlement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: delta=N*L/(E*A)=100000 N*2000 mm/(200000 N/mm2*314 mm2)=3.18 mm. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

steps.title: 自由段伸長與系統柔度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Free-length extension and system compliance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「自由段伸長與系統柔度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Free-length extension and system compliance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure relative motion of bolt head, grip and reaction frame with independent gauges. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Measure relative motion of bolt head, grip and reaction frame with independent gauges. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「自由段伸長與系統柔度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Measure relative motion of bolt head, grip and reaction frame with independent gauges.
Nominal bolt diameter represents every load-carrying section

steps.title: 自由段伸長與系統柔度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Free-length extension and system compliance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「自由段伸長與系統柔度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Free-length extension and system compliance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure relative motion of bolt head, grip and reaction frame with independent gauges to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動；若出現反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「千斤頂行程就等於岩栓本身的伸長」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Jack travel always equals elongation of the bolt itself" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用獨立位移計量測栓頭、夾具及反力架的相對移動，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure relative motion of bolt head, grip and reaction frame with independent gauges to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「自由段伸長與系統柔度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Free-length extension and system compliance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

反力架只影響設備而不會改變岩體行為
反力架沉陷被計入岩栓位移，造成假性低剛度。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
The reaction frame affects equipment but never the surrounding rock
Reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness.

quiz.explanationEn: Reaction-frame settlement counted as bolt movement produces false low stiffness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 反力位置與局部約束：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reaction location and local restraint: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反力位置與局部約束」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 拉拔反力若直接壓在受測錨固區附近，會提高局部圍壓並改變岩體破壞路徑。測試看似只是向外拉，實際同時向內壓縮周邊岩面；反力支點尺寸與間距必須記錄，才可知道結果代表何種約束條件。 判別這個機制時，應觀察記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區；若出現過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反力位置與局部約束」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reaction close to the anchorage increases confinement and alters rock failure paths. Pulling outward simultaneously compresses nearby ground inward. Record reaction footprint and spacing so the result can be interpreted under its actual restraint rather than as an unconstrained rock capacity. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone. If nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reaction location and local restraint” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：reactionPressure=100 kN/0.10 m2=1000 kPa=1 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: reactionPressure=100 kN/0.10 m2=1000 kPa=1 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「反力架只影響設備而不會改變岩體行為」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「反力位置與局部約束」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 反力位置與局部約束：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reaction location and local restraint: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反力位置與局部約束」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reaction location and local restraint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「反力位置與局部約束」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Reaction location and local restraint"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
灌漿總量足夠就證明整段錨固完全密實
記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Adequate total grout volume proves complete consolidation along the anchorage
Record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone.
quiz.explanation: 記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 反力位置與局部約束：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Reaction location and local restraint: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反力位置與局部約束」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reaction location and local restraint” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區；若出現過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「反力架只影響設備而不會改變岩體行為」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The reaction frame affects equipment but never the surrounding rock" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到記錄反力腳位置及岩面變形，對照預期破壞區，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record reaction feet and rock-surface movement relative to the predicted failure zone to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「反力位置與局部約束」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Reaction location and local restraint" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
持載位移增加一定只代表岩漿界面蠕變
optionsEn: Nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Increasing hold displacement always means rock-grout interface creep alone
quiz.explanation: 過近反力壓住潛在破壞錐，使拉拔能力被高估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Nearby reaction suppresses a potential breakout cone and overstates pull resistance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「持載位移與時間效應」與「荷重校正與不確定度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hold movement and time effects" and "Load calibration and uncertainty": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 持載位移與時間效應：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hold movement and time effects: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「持載位移與時間效應」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hold movement and time effects” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 恆定荷重下位移增加可能來自黏結蠕變，也可能是油壓漂移或支承沉陷。必須同時記錄實際荷重，才能區分持載滑移與荷重仍在增加；單一時間點的位移不能代表速率，更不能直接外推長期壽命。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步保存持載期間荷重、位移、溫度及支承基準；若出現油壓緩升被錯判為黏結蠕變，引出不必要的補強，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「持載位移與時間效應」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Movement under constant load can reflect bond creep, pressure drift or support settlement. Record actual force simultaneously to distinguish hold slip from continued loading. One displacement point establishes neither a rate nor a reliable extrapolation of long-term service behaviour. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize force, displacement, temperature and support references during the hold. If a slow pressure increase mistaken for bond creep prompts unnecessary reinforcement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hold movement and time effects” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：movementRate=(2.4-1.8) mm/10 min=0.06 mm/min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: movementRate=(2.4-1.8) mm/10 min=0.06 mm/min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「持載位移增加一定只代表岩漿界面蠕變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing hold displacement always means rock-grout interface creep alone" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「持載位移與時間效應」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hold movement and time effects”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 持載位移與時間效應
knowledge.text: 恆定荷重下位移增加可能來自黏結蠕變，也可能是油壓漂移或支承沉陷。必須同時記錄實際荷重，才能區分持載滑移與荷重仍在增加；單一時間點的位移不能代表速率，更不能直接外推長期壽命。
knowledge.textEn: Movement under constant load can reflect bond creep, pressure drift or support settlement. Record actual force simultaneously to distinguish hold slip from continued loading.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：持載位移增加一定只代表岩漿界面蠕變 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing hold displacement always means rock-grout interface creep alone Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「持載位移與時間效應」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hold movement and time effects" is correct?
options: 持載位移增加一定只代表岩漿界面蠕變
恆定荷重下位移增加可能來自黏結蠕變，也可能是油壓漂移或支承沉陷。
油壓表精確就能保證實際拉力完全精確
optionsEn: Increasing hold displacement always means rock-grout interface creep alone
Movement under constant load can reflect bond creep, pressure drift or support settlement.
An accurate pressure gauge guarantees completely accurate applied tensile force
quiz.explanation: 恆定荷重下位移增加可能來自黏結蠕變，也可能是油壓漂移或支承沉陷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Movement under constant load can reflect bond creep, pressure drift or support settlement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 持載位移與時間效應：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hold movement and time effects: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「持載位移與時間效應」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hold movement and time effects” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：movementRate=(2.4-1.8) mm/10 min=0.06 mm/min。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: movementRate=(2.4-1.8) mm/10 min=0.06 mm/min. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步保存持載期間荷重、位移、溫度及支承基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize force, displacement, temperature and support references during the hold.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：movementRate=(2.4-1.8) mm/10 min=0.06 mm/min。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: movementRate=(2.4-1.8) mm/10 min=0.06 mm/min. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「持載位移與時間效應」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hold movement and time effects", which statement holds?
options: 抽測平均合格就可以證明所有地區的岩栓安全
岩栓公稱直徑足以代表所有承載截面
原創教學假設：movementRate=(2.4-1.8) mm/10 min=0.06 mm/min。
optionsEn: A passing sample mean proves bolt safety in every geological zone
Nominal bolt diameter represents every load-carrying section
Original teaching assumptions: movementRate=(2.4-1.8) mm/10 min=0.06 mm/min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：movementRate=(2.4-1.8) mm/10 min=0.06 mm/min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: movementRate=(2.4-1.8) mm/10 min=0.06 mm/min. Keep units when recalculating.

An undeformed steel plate proves acceptable rock bearing

steps.title: 持載位移與時間效應：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hold movement and time effects: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「持載位移與時間效應」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hold movement and time effects” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 油壓緩升被錯判為黏結蠕變，引出不必要的補強。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步保存持載期間荷重、位移、溫度及支承基準，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A slow pressure increase mistaken for bond creep prompts unnecessary reinforcement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize force, displacement, temperature and support references during the hold to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察同步保存持載期間荷重、位移、溫度及支承基準；若出現油壓緩升被錯判為黏結蠕變，引出不必要的補強，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a slow pressure increase mistaken for bond creep prompts unnecessary reinforcement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「持載位移增加一定只代表岩漿界面蠕變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing hold displacement always means rock-grout interface creep alone" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「持載位移與時間效應」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。

A slow pressure increase mistaken for bond creep prompts unnecessary reinforcement.
An accurate pressure gauge guarantees completely accurate applied tensile force

steps.title: 荷重校正與不確定度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Load calibration and uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「荷重校正與不確定度」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Load calibration and uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壓力乘活塞面積只是理想液壓力，密封摩擦、有效面積與回程方向會造成偏差。荷重元可提供獨立比較，但也需校正與對中；不確定度應和試體離散分開報告，避免把設備偏差歸因於地質變化。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向；若出現忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「荷重校正與不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure times piston area gives ideal hydraulic force; seal friction, effective area and direction introduce bias. A load cell offers independent comparison but also needs calibration and alignment. Separate instrumental uncertainty from specimen variability instead of attributing equipment bias to geology. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions. If ignored seal friction biases low-load readings and distorts initial stiffness, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Load calibration and uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Fideal=20 MPa*0.005 m2=100 kN; measured=96 kN; difference=4 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Fideal=20 MPa*0.005 m2=100 kN; measured=96 kN; difference=4 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「油壓表精確就能保證實際拉力完全精確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An accurate pressure gauge guarantees completely accurate applied tensile force" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「荷重校正與不確定度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Load calibration and uncertainty”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 壓力乘活塞面積只是理想液壓力，密封摩擦、有效面積與回程方向會造成偏差。荷重元可提供獨立比較，但也需校正與對中；不確定度應和試體離散分開報告，避免把設備偏差歸因於地質變化。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure times piston area gives ideal hydraulic force; seal friction, effective area and direction introduce bias. A load cell offers independent comparison but also needs calibration and alignment.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：油壓表精確就能保證實際拉力完全精確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An accurate pressure gauge guarantees completely accurate applied tensile force Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「荷重校正與不確定度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load calibration and uncertainty" is correct?
options: 油壓表精確就能保證實際拉力完全精確
平均腐蝕量很小就保證每一截面承載正常
壓力乘活塞面積只是理想液壓力，密封摩擦、有效面積與回程方向會造成偏差。
optionsEn: An accurate pressure gauge guarantees completely accurate applied tensile force
Small average corrosion guarantees adequate resistance at every section
Pressure times piston area gives ideal hydraulic force; seal friction, effective area and direction introduce bias.
quiz.explanation: 壓力乘活塞面積只是理想液壓力，密封摩擦、有效面積與回程方向會造成偏差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure times piston area gives ideal hydraulic force; seal friction, effective area and direction introduce bias. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Fideal=20 MPa*0.005 m2=100 kN; measured=96 kN; difference=4 percent。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Fideal=20 MPa*0.005 m2=100 kN; measured=96 kN; difference=4 percent. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If ignored seal friction biases low-load readings and distorts initial stiffness, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「荷重校正與不確定度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load calibration and uncertainty"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向。
千斤頂行程就等於岩栓本身的伸長
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions.
Jack travel always equals elongation of the bolt itself
quiz.explanation: 用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 荷重校正與不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load calibration and uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「荷重校正與不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Load calibration and uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignored seal friction biases low-load readings and distorts initial stiffness. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向；若出現忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If ignored seal friction biases low-load readings and distorts initial stiffness, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「油壓表精確就能保證實際拉力完全精確」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An accurate pressure gauge guarantees completely accurate applied tensile force" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用可追溯荷重元比較不同荷重階段及載卸方向，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Ignored seal friction biases low-load readings and distorts initial stiffness. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare traceable load-cell readings across force levels and loading directions to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「荷重校正與不確定度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load calibration and uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
平均腐蝕量很小就保證每一截面承載正常
忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Small average corrosion guarantees adequate resistance at every section
Ignored seal friction biases low-load readings and distorts initial stiffness.
quiz.explanation: 忽略密封摩擦使低荷重讀值偏差，扭曲初始剛度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignored seal friction biases low-load readings and distorts initial stiffness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「腐蝕損失與局部弱截面」與「試驗代表性與補強決策」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Corrosion loss and local weak sections" and "Representativeness and reinforcement decisions": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 腐蝕損失與局部弱截面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Corrosion loss and local weak sections: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「腐蝕損失與局部弱截面」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Corrosion loss and local weak sections” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 腐蝕不一定沿全長均勻，孔口水氣和裂縫可能造成局部截面損失。直徑減少對面積有平方影響，局部坑蝕又會加劇應力集中；用平均重量損失推估剩餘承載，需要確認最小截面及腐蝕分布是否已被量到。 判別這個機制時，應觀察檢查孔口防護、水質及可見最小直徑並追蹤時間變化；若出現局部坑蝕被平均失重掩蓋，岩栓在弱截面突然斷裂，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「腐蝕損失與局部弱截面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Corrosion can concentrate near wet collars and fractures rather than being uniform. Diameter loss changes area quadratically, and pits add stress concentration. Inferring capacity from mean mass loss requires evidence that the minimum section and corrosion distribution have actually been characterized. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Inspect collar protection, water chemistry and visible minimum diameter over time. If local pitting hidden by mean mass loss causes rupture at the weakest section, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Corrosion loss and local weak sections” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：remainingAreaRatio=(18 mm/20 mm)^2=0.81=81 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: remainingAreaRatio=(18 mm/20 mm)^2=0.81=81 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均腐蝕量很小就保證每一截面承載正常」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Small average corrosion guarantees adequate resistance at every section" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「腐蝕損失與局部弱截面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Corrosion loss and local weak sections”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 腐蝕損失與局部弱截面
knowledge.titleEn: Corrosion loss and local weak sections
knowledge.text: 腐蝕不一定沿全長均勻，孔口水氣和裂縫可能造成局部截面損失。直徑減少對面積有平方影響，局部坑蝕又會加劇應力集中；用平均重量損失推估剩餘承載，需要確認最小截面及腐蝕分布是否已被量到。
knowledge.textEn: Corrosion can concentrate near wet collars and fractures rather than being uniform. Diameter loss changes area quadratically, and pits add stress concentration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均腐蝕量很小就保證每一截面承載正常 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Small average corrosion guarantees adequate resistance at every section Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「腐蝕損失與局部弱截面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Corrosion loss and local weak sections" is correct?
options: 腐蝕不一定沿全長均勻，孔口水氣和裂縫可能造成局部截面損失。
平均腐蝕量很小就保證每一截面承載正常
抽測平均合格就可以證明所有地區的岩栓安全
optionsEn: Corrosion can concentrate near wet collars and fractures rather than being uniform.
Small average corrosion guarantees adequate resistance at every section
A passing sample mean proves bolt safety in every geological zone
quiz.explanation: 腐蝕不一定沿全長均勻，孔口水氣和裂縫可能造成局部截面損失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Corrosion can concentrate near wet collars and fractures rather than being uniform. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 腐蝕損失與局部弱截面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Corrosion loss and local weak sections: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「腐蝕損失與局部弱截面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Corrosion loss and local weak sections” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：remainingAreaRatio=(18 mm/20 mm)^2=0.81=81 percent。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: remainingAreaRatio=(18 mm/20 mm)^2=0.81=81 percent. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查孔口防護、水質及可見最小直徑並追蹤時間變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect collar protection, water chemistry and visible minimum diameter over time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：remainingAreaRatio=(18 mm/20 mm)^2=0.81=81 percent。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: remainingAreaRatio=(18 mm/20 mm)^2=0.81=81 percent. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「腐蝕損失與局部弱截面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Corrosion loss and local weak sections", which statement holds?
options: 岩栓公稱直徑足以代表所有承載截面
原創教學假設：remainingAreaRatio=(18 mm/20 mm)^2=0.81=81 percent。
鋼托盤沒有變形就代表岩面承壓正常
optionsEn: Nominal bolt diameter represents every load-carrying section
Original teaching assumptions: remainingAreaRatio=(18 mm/20 mm)^2=0.81=81 percent.
An undeformed steel plate proves acceptable rock bearing
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：remainingAreaRatio=(18 mm/20 mm)^2=0.81=81 percent。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: remainingAreaRatio=(18 mm/20 mm)^2=0.81=81 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 腐蝕損失與局部弱截面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Corrosion loss and local weak sections: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「腐蝕損失與局部弱截面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Corrosion loss and local weak sections” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查孔口防護、水質及可見最小直徑並追蹤時間變化。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部坑蝕被平均失重掩蓋，岩栓在弱截面突然斷裂」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect collar protection, water chemistry and visible minimum diameter over time. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Local pitting hidden by mean mass loss causes rupture at the weakest section. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Inspect collar protection, water chemistry and visible minimum diameter over time. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If local pitting hidden by mean mass loss causes rupture at the weakest section, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部坑蝕被平均失重掩蓋，岩栓在弱截面突然斷裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local pitting hidden by mean mass loss causes rupture at the weakest section. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 檢查孔口防護、水質及可見最小直徑並追蹤時間變化。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部坑蝕被平均失重掩蓋，岩栓在弱截面突然斷裂」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Local pitting hidden by mean mass loss causes rupture at the weakest section. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

If local pitting hidden by mean mass loss causes rupture at the weakest section, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「腐蝕損失與局部弱截面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Corrosion loss and local weak sections"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
反力架只影響設備而不會改變岩體行為

The reaction frame affects equipment but never the surrounding rock
Inspect collar protection, water chemistry and visible minimum diameter over time.

steps.title: 腐蝕損失與局部弱截面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Corrosion loss and local weak sections: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「腐蝕損失與局部弱截面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Corrosion loss and local weak sections” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部坑蝕被平均失重掩蓋，岩栓在弱截面突然斷裂。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到檢查孔口防護、水質及可見最小直徑並追蹤時間變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local pitting hidden by mean mass loss causes rupture at the weakest section. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to inspect collar protection, water chemistry and visible minimum diameter over time to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察檢查孔口防護、水質及可見最小直徑並追蹤時間變化；若出現局部坑蝕被平均失重掩蓋，岩栓在弱截面突然斷裂，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If local pitting hidden by mean mass loss causes rupture at the weakest section, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均腐蝕量很小就保證每一截面承載正常」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small average corrosion guarantees adequate resistance at every section" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部坑蝕被平均失重掩蓋，岩栓在弱截面突然斷裂。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到檢查孔口防護、水質及可見最小直徑並追蹤時間變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Local pitting hidden by mean mass loss causes rupture at the weakest section. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to inspect collar protection, water chemistry and visible minimum diameter over time to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「腐蝕損失與局部弱截面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Corrosion loss and local weak sections" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 局部坑蝕被平均失重掩蓋，岩栓在弱截面突然斷裂。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
抽測平均合格就可以證明所有地區的岩栓安全
optionsEn: Local pitting hidden by mean mass loss causes rupture at the weakest section.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A passing sample mean proves bolt safety in every geological zone
quiz.explanation: 局部坑蝕被平均失重掩蓋，岩栓在弱截面突然斷裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Local pitting hidden by mean mass loss causes rupture at the weakest section. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 試驗代表性與補強決策：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Representativeness and reinforcement decisions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「試驗代表性與補強決策」如何影響隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Representativeness and reinforcement decisions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拉拔試點通常只覆蓋少量岩栓，結果的適用範圍由地質、施工批次及錨固型式決定。可接近位置可能比濕區或破碎區容易施工，取樣偏差會留下未驗證族群；交接須讓每個結果能追溯到同類岩栓，而不是以全區平均替代分區判讀。 判別這個機制時，應觀察依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表；若出現僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「試驗代表性與補強決策」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pull tests sample few bolts, with applicability governed by geology, batches and anchorage type. Accessible positions may be easier to install than wet or fractured areas, leaving unverified populations. Trace each result to comparable bolts instead of substituting a global mean for zoned interpretation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type. If testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Representativeness and reinforcement decisions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：samplingCoverage=testedZones/definedZones=8/10=80 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: samplingCoverage=testedZones/definedZones=8/10=80 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抽測平均合格就可以證明所有地區的岩栓安全」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A passing sample mean proves bolt safety in every geological zone" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「試驗代表性與補強決策」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Representativeness and reinforcement decisions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 試驗代表性與補強決策
knowledge.text: 拉拔試點通常只覆蓋少量岩栓，結果的適用範圍由地質、施工批次及錨固型式決定。可接近位置可能比濕區或破碎區容易施工，取樣偏差會留下未驗證族群；交接須讓每個結果能追溯到同類岩栓，而不是以全區平均替代分區判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Pull tests sample few bolts, with applicability governed by geology, batches and anchorage type. Accessible positions may be easier to install than wet or fractured areas, leaving unverified populations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：抽測平均合格就可以證明所有地區的岩栓安全 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A passing sample mean proves bolt safety in every geological zone Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「試驗代表性與補強決策」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Representativeness and reinforcement decisions" is correct?
options: 抽測平均合格就可以證明所有地區的岩栓安全
拉拔試點通常只覆蓋少量岩栓，結果的適用範圍由地質、施工批次及錨固型式決定。
岩栓數量足夠便不必考慮節理方向
optionsEn: A passing sample mean proves bolt safety in every geological zone
Pull tests sample few bolts, with applicability governed by geology, batches and anchorage type.
Enough bolts remove the need to consider joint orientation
quiz.explanation: 拉拔試點通常只覆蓋少量岩栓，結果的適用範圍由地質、施工批次及錨固型式決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pull tests sample few bolts, with applicability governed by geology, batches and anchorage type. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 試驗代表性與補強決策：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Representativeness and reinforcement decisions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「試驗代表性與補強決策」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Representativeness and reinforcement decisions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：samplingCoverage=testedZones/definedZones=8/10=80 percent。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: samplingCoverage=testedZones/definedZones=8/10=80 percent. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：samplingCoverage=testedZones/definedZones=8/10=80 percent。單支拉拔只檢驗局部系統，不能直接證明整個岩楔穩定。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: samplingCoverage=testedZones/definedZones=8/10=80 percent. A single pull test examines a local system and does not establish whole-wedge stability. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「試驗代表性與補強決策」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Representativeness and reinforcement decisions", which statement holds?
options: 灌漿總量足夠就證明整段錨固完全密實
千斤頂行程就等於岩栓本身的伸長
原創教學假設：samplingCoverage=testedZones/definedZones=8/10=80 percent。
optionsEn: Adequate total grout volume proves complete consolidation along the anchorage
Jack travel always equals elongation of the bolt itself
Original teaching assumptions: samplingCoverage=testedZones/definedZones=8/10=80 percent.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：samplingCoverage=testedZones/definedZones=8/10=80 percent。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: samplingCoverage=testedZones/definedZones=8/10=80 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 試驗代表性與補強決策：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Representativeness and reinforcement decisions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「試驗代表性與補強決策」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Representativeness and reinforcement decisions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「試驗代表性與補強決策」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Representativeness and reinforcement decisions"?
options: 依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表。

Increasing hold displacement always means rock-grout interface creep alone
quiz.explanation: 依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.
