steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抽測平均合格就可以證明所有地區的岩栓安全」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A passing sample mean proves bolt safety in every geological zone" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到依地質、批次及錨固型式建立試驗分層對照表，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to stratify test records by geology, batch and anchorage type to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「試驗代表性與補強決策」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Representativeness and reinforcement decisions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料。
岩栓數量足夠便不必考慮節理方向
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented.
Enough bolts remove the need to consider joint orientation
quiz.explanation: 僅測易施工區造成選樣偏差，危險區卻沒有代表資料。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing only easy zones biases the sample and leaves critical zones unrepresented. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架
summary: 本課以把鋼拱、格柵、噴凝土與基腳組成可驗證支護系統為主線，從榀距與分擔寬度與軸力偏心與彎矩建立系統邊界，再把接頭滑移與力線連續、複合噴層與變形相容連到隱蔽工程與交接追溯。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on combine steel ribs, lattices, shotcrete and feet into a verifiable support system. It begins with Rib spacing and tributary width and Axial eccentricity and bending, links Joint slip and force continuity and Composite shotcrete and compatibility, and ends with Concealed works and handover traceability. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查榀距與分擔寬度：N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN；再獨立檢查軸力偏心與彎矩：M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm。間距由 0.75 增為 1.0 m，在壓力 0.08 MPa、半徑 4 m 的理想環模型下，單榀環力由 240 增為 320 kN；噴層跨距效應另算。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 將用安裝後基準斷面比較各時期冠頂與側壁偏移作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Rib spacing and tributary width: N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN. Independently check Axial eccentricity and bending: M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm. Increasing spacing from 0.75 to 1.0 m at pressure 0.08 MPa and radius 4 m raises ideal rib thrust from 240 to 320 kN; shotcrete span effects require separate assessment. The two results are not a complete design because a rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. Use compare crown and wall offsets against the as-installed reference section as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「榀距與分擔寬度」與「軸力偏心與彎矩」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rib spacing and tributary width" and "Axial eccentricity and bending": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 榀距與分擔寬度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rib spacing and tributary width: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「榀距與分擔寬度」如何影響鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rib spacing and tributary width” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Steel-rib and lattice-girder tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰鋼拱間距決定單榀承受的地層分擔寬度，間距增加同時拉大噴層縱向跨距。完整圓環均壓可估環向軸力，但局部鬆動塊會引入彎矩；應分開平均地層壓力與集中作用，不能只以環力判斷全部構件。 判別這個機制時，應觀察沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度；若出現局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「榀距與分擔寬度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Spacing determines each rib's tributary ground width and the longitudinal span of shotcrete. Uniform pressure on an intact ring estimates hoop thrust, but loose blocks introduce bending. Separate average ground pressure from concentrated actions rather than treating ring thrust as the complete member demand. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness. If a locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rib spacing and tributary width” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要平均榀距符合就不必檢查局部跨距」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing average rib spacing removes the need to check local spans" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「榀距與分擔寬度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rib spacing and tributary width”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 榀距與分擔寬度
knowledge.text: 相鄰鋼拱間距決定單榀承受的地層分擔寬度，間距增加同時拉大噴層縱向跨距。完整圓環均壓可估環向軸力，但局部鬆動塊會引入彎矩；應分開平均地層壓力與集中作用，不能只以環力判斷全部構件。
knowledge.textEn: Spacing determines each rib's tributary ground width and the longitudinal span of shotcrete. Uniform pressure on an intact ring estimates hoop thrust, but loose blocks introduce bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要平均榀距符合就不必檢查局部跨距 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing average rib spacing removes the need to check local spans Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「榀距與分擔寬度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rib spacing and tributary width" is correct?
options: 只要平均榀距符合就不必檢查局部跨距
相鄰鋼拱間距決定單榀承受的地層分擔寬度，間距增加同時拉大噴層縱向跨距。
拱架承受壓力就不會同時產生彎矩
optionsEn: Passing average rib spacing removes the need to check local spans
Spacing determines each rib's tributary ground width and the longitudinal span of shotcrete.
A rib carrying compression cannot simultaneously develop bending moments
quiz.explanation: 相鄰鋼拱間距決定單榀承受的地層分擔寬度，間距增加同時拉大噴層縱向跨距。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Spacing determines each rib's tributary ground width and the longitudinal span of shotcrete. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 榀距與分擔寬度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rib spacing and tributary width: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「榀距與分擔寬度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rib spacing and tributary width” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「榀距與分擔寬度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rib spacing and tributary width", which statement holds?
options: 主筋總面積相同就代表所有格柵剛度相同
鋼材強度合格就不需要驗算拱架基腳
原創教學假設：N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN。
optionsEn: Equal total chord area means identical stiffness for every lattice geometry
Adequate steel strength removes the need to assess rib feet
Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R*s=0.08 MPa*4 m*0.75 m=240 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 榀距與分擔寬度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rib spacing and tributary width: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「榀距與分擔寬度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rib spacing and tributary width” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「榀距與分擔寬度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rib spacing and tributary width"?
options: 沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
位移只有幾毫米就可以永遠忽略二階效應
optionsEn: Compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A few millimetres of movement always makes second-order effects negligible
quiz.explanation: 沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 榀距與分擔寬度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rib spacing and tributary width: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「榀距與分擔寬度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rib spacing and tributary width” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察沿里程量測實際榀距並對照地質鬆動區與噴層厚度；若出現局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要平均榀距符合就不必檢查局部跨距」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing average rib spacing removes the need to check local spans" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare measured rib spacing with loosened ground zones and shotcrete thickness to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「榀距與分擔寬度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rib spacing and tributary width" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
局部超間距加大構件力與噴層彎曲，平均間距卻正常。

A locally wide bay increases rib force and shotcrete bending despite a normal mean spacing.
A rib carrying compression cannot simultaneously develop bending moments

steps.title: 軸力偏心與彎矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Axial eccentricity and bending: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「軸力偏心與彎矩」如何影響鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Axial eccentricity and bending” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Steel-rib and lattice-girder tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼拱與岩面接觸不均會使壓力偏離截面中心，名義壓縮構件因而同時彎曲。接頭與基腳的旋轉也會移動作用線，不能用截面積增加掩蓋偏心；應先辨識接觸點及變形後幾何，再決定是否需二階分析。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照鋼拱斷面掃描、接觸點及內外緣應變差；若出現只看平均壓應變漏掉單側拉應力與局部屈曲，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「軸力偏心與彎矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven ground contact moves force away from the section centre and bends a nominal compression member. Joint and foot rotation also move the load line. Increasing area does not resolve eccentricity; identify contact locations and deformed geometry before deciding on second-order analysis. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare rib geometry, contact points and differences between inner and outer strains. If mean compression alone conceals one-sided tension and local buckling, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Axial eccentricity and bending” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「拱架承受壓力就不會同時產生彎矩」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A rib carrying compression cannot simultaneously develop bending moments" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「軸力偏心與彎矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Axial eccentricity and bending”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 軸力偏心與彎矩
knowledge.text: 鋼拱與岩面接觸不均會使壓力偏離截面中心，名義壓縮構件因而同時彎曲。接頭與基腳的旋轉也會移動作用線，不能用截面積增加掩蓋偏心；應先辨識接觸點及變形後幾何，再決定是否需二階分析。
knowledge.textEn: Uneven ground contact moves force away from the section centre and bends a nominal compression member. Joint and foot rotation also move the load line.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：拱架承受壓力就不會同時產生彎矩 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A rib carrying compression cannot simultaneously develop bending moments Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「軸力偏心與彎矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Shotcrete cover permits complete lateral restraint to be assumed in every direction

steps.title: 軸力偏心與彎矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Axial eccentricity and bending: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「軸力偏心與彎矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Axial eccentricity and bending” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照鋼拱斷面掃描、接觸點及內外緣應變差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare rib geometry, contact points and differences between inner and outer strains.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「軸力偏心與彎矩」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

螺栓已鎖緊就能把接頭視為完全剛接

optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm.
Tightened bolts make every rib joint perfectly rigid
Steel stress automatically disappears when the surrounding shotcrete hardens

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: M=N*e=240 kN*0.05 m=12 kNm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 軸力偏心與彎矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Axial eccentricity and bending: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「軸力偏心與彎矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Axial eccentricity and bending” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照鋼拱斷面掃描、接觸點及內外緣應變差。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只看平均壓應變漏掉單側拉應力與局部屈曲」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare rib geometry, contact points and differences between inner and outer strains. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Mean compression alone conceals one-sided tension and local buckling. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare rib geometry, contact points and differences between inner and outer strains. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If mean compression alone conceals one-sided tension and local buckling, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看平均壓應變漏掉單側拉應力與局部屈曲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Mean compression alone conceals one-sided tension and local buckling. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A rib carrying compression cannot simultaneously develop bending moments" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看平均壓應變漏掉單側拉應力與局部屈曲。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照鋼拱斷面掃描、接觸點及內外緣應變差，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Mean compression alone conceals one-sided tension and local buckling. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare rib geometry, contact points and differences between inner and outer strains to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「軸力偏心與彎矩」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

Shotcrete cover permits complete lateral restraint to be assumed in every direction
Mean compression alone conceals one-sided tension and local buckling.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼拱弱軸與有效長度」與「格柵桁架與節點」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Weak-axis buckling and effective length" and "Lattice trusses and nodes": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼拱弱軸與有效長度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Weak-axis buckling and effective length: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋼拱弱軸與有效長度」如何影響鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Weak-axis buckling and effective length” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Steel-rib and lattice-girder tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱面內有支承不代表拱面外也被約束，縱向連繫的位置決定弱軸有效長度。Euler 公式只適用理想彈性直柱，彎曲拱架還有初始缺陷和非均勻受力；它適合揭示連繫缺失的敏感度，不應當成實際承載保證。 判別這個機制時，應觀察查核連繫間距、接頭固定度及拱面外偏移量；若出現缺少一段連繫讓有效長度倍增，理想屈曲力降至四分之一，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼拱弱軸與有效長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In-plane restraint does not establish out-of-plane restraint; longitudinal ties control weak-axis effective length. Euler's ideal straight-column model omits curved geometry, imperfections and nonuniform force. It reveals sensitivity to missing ties rather than guaranteeing actual rib resistance. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check tie spacing, connection restraint and out-of-plane offsets. If one missing tie bay doubles effective length and quarters ideal buckling force, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Weak-axis buckling and effective length” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Pcr=pi^2*E*I/L^2=pi^2*200 GPa*2e-6 m4/(2 m)^2=987 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Pcr=pi^2*E*I/L^2=pi^2*200 GPa*2e-6 m4/(2 m)^2=987 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「有噴凝土包覆就能假定所有方向完全側撐」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shotcrete cover permits complete lateral restraint to be assumed in every direction" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鋼拱弱軸與有效長度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Weak-axis buckling and effective length”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼拱弱軸與有效長度

quiz.question: 關於「鋼拱弱軸與有效長度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Shotcrete cover permits complete lateral restraint to be assumed in every direction
Equal total chord area means identical stiffness for every lattice geometry

steps.title: 鋼拱弱軸與有效長度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Weak-axis buckling and effective length: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼拱弱軸與有效長度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Weak-axis buckling and effective length” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Pcr=pi^2*E*I/L^2=pi^2*200 GPa*2e-6 m4/(2 m)^2=987 kN。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Pcr=pi^2*E*I/L^2=pi^2*200 GPa*2e-6 m4/(2 m)^2=987 kN. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：查核連繫間距、接頭固定度及拱面外偏移量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check tie spacing, connection restraint and out-of-plane offsets.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「鋼拱弱軸與有效長度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.instruction: 查核連繫間距、接頭固定度及拱面外偏移量。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「缺少一段連繫讓有效長度倍增，理想屈曲力降至四分之一」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If one missing tie bay doubles effective length and quarters ideal buckling force, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：缺少一段連繫讓有效長度倍增，理想屈曲力降至四分之一。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼拱弱軸與有效長度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Weak-axis buckling and effective length" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 缺少一段連繫讓有效長度倍增，理想屈曲力降至四分之一。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
主筋總面積相同就代表所有格柵剛度相同
optionsEn: One missing tie bay doubles effective length and quarters ideal buckling force.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Equal total chord area means identical stiffness for every lattice geometry
quiz.explanation: 缺少一段連繫讓有效長度倍增，理想屈曲力降至四分之一。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One missing tie bay doubles effective length and quarters ideal buckling force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 格柵桁架與節點：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lattice trusses and nodes: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「格柵桁架與節點」如何影響鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lattice trusses and nodes” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Steel-rib and lattice-girder tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 格柵以主筋和腹桿形成小型桁架，節點把剪力傳到弦材。若腹桿焊接缺陷或幾何偏差存在，名義鋼量相同仍有不同剛度；噴凝土填滿格柵後才可能建立預期複合作用，不能忽略空隙與施工前裸架狀態。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性；若出現節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「格柵桁架與節點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A lattice transfers shear through webs into chord bars. Weld defects or geometric deviations change stiffness despite equal steel mass. Intended composite action requires shotcrete to fill the lattice, while voids and the exposed pre-encapsulation stage remain distinct structural states. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation. If a detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lattice trusses and nodes” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：chordForce=M/h=9 kNm/0.30 m=30 kN in an ideal chord pair。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: chordForce=M/h=9 kNm/0.30 m=30 kN in an ideal chord pair.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主筋總面積相同就代表所有格柵剛度相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal total chord area means identical stiffness for every lattice geometry" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「格柵桁架與節點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lattice trusses and nodes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 格柵桁架與節點
knowledge.text: 格柵以主筋和腹桿形成小型桁架，節點把剪力傳到弦材。若腹桿焊接缺陷或幾何偏差存在，名義鋼量相同仍有不同剛度；噴凝土填滿格柵後才可能建立預期複合作用，不能忽略空隙與施工前裸架狀態。
knowledge.textEn: A lattice transfers shear through webs into chord bars. Weld defects or geometric deviations change stiffness despite equal steel mass.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主筋總面積相同就代表所有格柵剛度相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal total chord area means identical stiffness for every lattice geometry Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「格柵桁架與節點」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lattice trusses and nodes" is correct?
options: 主筋總面積相同就代表所有格柵剛度相同
格柵以主筋和腹桿形成小型桁架，節點把剪力傳到弦材。
螺栓已鎖緊就能把接頭視為完全剛接
optionsEn: Equal total chord area means identical stiffness for every lattice geometry
A lattice transfers shear through webs into chord bars.
Tightened bolts make every rib joint perfectly rigid
quiz.explanation: 格柵以主筋和腹桿形成小型桁架，節點把剪力傳到弦材。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A lattice transfers shear through webs into chord bars. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 格柵桁架與節點：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lattice trusses and nodes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「格柵桁架與節點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lattice trusses and nodes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：chordForce=M/h=9 kNm/0.30 m=30 kN in an ideal chord pair。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: chordForce=M/h=9 kNm/0.30 m=30 kN in an ideal chord pair. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：chordForce=M/h=9 kNm/0.30 m=30 kN in an ideal chord pair。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: chordForce=M/h=9 kNm/0.30 m=30 kN in an ideal chord pair. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「格柵桁架與節點」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lattice trusses and nodes", which statement holds?
options: 噴層硬化後鋼拱原本的應力會自動消失
外露鋼材看起來良好就能代表包覆區無腐蝕
原創教學假設：chordForce=M/h=9 kNm/0.30 m=30 kN in an ideal chord pair。
optionsEn: Steel stress automatically disappears when the surrounding shotcrete hardens
Sound exposed steel proves corrosion is absent in covered areas
Original teaching assumptions: chordForce=M/h=9 kNm/0.30 m=30 kN in an ideal chord pair.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：chordForce=M/h=9 kNm/0.30 m=30 kN in an ideal chord pair。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: chordForce=M/h=9 kNm/0.30 m=30 kN in an ideal chord pair. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 格柵桁架與節點：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lattice trusses and nodes: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「格柵桁架與節點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lattice trusses and nodes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「格柵桁架與節點」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lattice trusses and nodes"?
options: 核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

optionsEn: Check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Passing average rib spacing removes the need to check local spans
quiz.explanation: 核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 格柵桁架與節點：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lattice trusses and nodes: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「格柵桁架與節點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lattice trusses and nodes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性；若出現節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主筋總面積相同就代表所有格柵剛度相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal total chord area means identical stiffness for every lattice geometry" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 節點脫開使局部主筋單獨彎曲，桁架假設失效。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對格柵高度、腹桿節點及包覆後的填充完整性，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check lattice depth, web nodes and filling completeness after encapsulation to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「格柵桁架與節點」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lattice trusses and nodes" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
