quiz.explanationEn: A detached node leaves a chord bending locally and invalidates the truss assumption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接頭滑移與力線連續」與「基腳承載與沉陷」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint slip and force continuity" and "Foot bearing and settlement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接頭滑移與力線連續：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint slip and force continuity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接頭滑移與力線連續」如何影響鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint slip and force continuity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Steel-rib and lattice-girder tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分段鋼拱的接頭必須傳遞設計所需軸力與彎矩，接觸間隙可能讓兩側先後受力。螺栓鎖緊不是連續剛接的證明，滑移後作用線還會偏移；應把接頭剛度與允許變形列入整榀模型，而非把接頭當成無長度連線。 判別這個機制時，應觀察量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變；若出現接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接頭滑移與力線連續」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Segment joints must transfer the required thrust and moment, but gaps engage the two sides at different times. Tight bolts do not prove rigid continuity, and slip moves the load line. Include joint stiffness and deformation in the rib model rather than an ideal zero-length connection. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure joint opening and slip alongside strains on both sides. If joint slip concentrates deformation and opens cracks and leakage paths behind the rib, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint slip and force continuity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「螺栓已鎖緊就能把接頭視為完全剛接」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tightened bolts make every rib joint perfectly rigid" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接頭滑移與力線連續」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint slip and force continuity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接頭滑移與力線連續
knowledge.text: 分段鋼拱的接頭必須傳遞設計所需軸力與彎矩，接觸間隙可能讓兩側先後受力。螺栓鎖緊不是連續剛接的證明，滑移後作用線還會偏移；應把接頭剛度與允許變形列入整榀模型，而非把接頭當成無長度連線。
knowledge.textEn: Segment joints must transfer the required thrust and moment, but gaps engage the two sides at different times. Tight bolts do not prove rigid continuity, and slip moves the load line.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：螺栓已鎖緊就能把接頭視為完全剛接 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Tightened bolts make every rib joint perfectly rigid Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接頭滑移與力線連續」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint slip and force continuity" is correct?
options: 螺栓已鎖緊就能把接頭視為完全剛接
鋼材強度合格就不需要驗算拱架基腳
分段鋼拱的接頭必須傳遞設計所需軸力與彎矩，接觸間隙可能讓兩側先後受力。
optionsEn: Tightened bolts make every rib joint perfectly rigid
Adequate steel strength removes the need to assess rib feet
Segment joints must transfer the required thrust and moment, but gaps engage the two sides at different times.
quiz.explanation: 分段鋼拱的接頭必須傳遞設計所需軸力與彎矩，接觸間隙可能讓兩側先後受力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Segment joints must transfer the required thrust and moment, but gaps engage the two sides at different times. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接頭滑移與力線連續：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint slip and force continuity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接頭滑移與力線連續」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint slip and force continuity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure joint opening and slip alongside strains on both sides.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接頭滑移與力線連續」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint slip and force continuity", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm。
位移只有幾毫米就可以永遠忽略二階效應
材料證書齊全就等於現地鋼拱系統已驗證
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm.
A few millimetres of movement always makes second-order effects negligible
Complete material certificates prove the installed rib system has been verified
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: jointStiffness=deltaF/deltaSlip=100 kN/2 mm=50 kN/mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 接頭滑移與力線連續：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint slip and force continuity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接頭滑移與力線連續」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint slip and force continuity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure joint opening and slip alongside strains on both sides. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Joint slip concentrates deformation and opens cracks and leakage paths behind the rib. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Measure joint opening and slip alongside strains on both sides. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If joint slip concentrates deformation and opens cracks and leakage paths behind the rib, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Joint slip concentrates deformation and opens cracks and leakage paths behind the rib. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Measure joint opening and slip alongside strains on both sides. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Joint slip concentrates deformation and opens cracks and leakage paths behind the rib. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Measure joint opening and slip alongside strains on both sides. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If joint slip concentrates deformation and opens cracks and leakage paths behind the rib, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接頭滑移與力線連續」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint slip and force continuity"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變。
拱架承受壓力就不會同時產生彎矩
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure joint opening and slip alongside strains on both sides.
A rib carrying compression cannot simultaneously develop bending moments
quiz.explanation: 量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure joint opening and slip alongside strains on both sides. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 接頭滑移與力線連續：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint slip and force continuity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接頭滑移與力線連續」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint slip and force continuity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Joint slip concentrates deformation and opens cracks and leakage paths behind the rib. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure joint opening and slip alongside strains on both sides to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變；若出現接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If joint slip concentrates deformation and opens cracks and leakage paths behind the rib, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「螺栓已鎖緊就能把接頭視為完全剛接」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tightened bolts make every rib joint perfectly rigid" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到量測接縫開口與滑移，對照載入時兩側應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Joint slip concentrates deformation and opens cracks and leakage paths behind the rib. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure joint opening and slip alongside strains on both sides to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接頭滑移與力線連續」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint slip and force continuity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
鋼材強度合格就不需要驗算拱架基腳
接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Adequate steel strength removes the need to assess rib feet
Joint slip concentrates deformation and opens cracks and leakage paths behind the rib.
quiz.explanation: 接縫滑移集中變形，造成背後噴層開裂與漏水通路。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint slip concentrates deformation and opens cracks and leakage paths behind the rib. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 基腳承載與沉陷：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Foot bearing and settlement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「基腳承載與沉陷」如何影響鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Foot bearing and settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Steel-rib and lattice-girder tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼拱荷載最後由基腳傳入地層，鬆軟或受水擾動的基底可能先於鋼材屈服。基腳沉陷會使拱形變扁並增加彎曲，單側沉陷尤其不利；擴大底板也需確認真正接觸面積，不能把懸空板面列入承壓。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以基腳水準、接觸印跡及地層含水狀態同步追蹤；若出現單側基腳下陷使拱頂偏移，構件強度合格仍失穩，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「基腳承載與沉陷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Footings transfer rib actions into ground that may soften or erode before steel yields. Settlement flattens the arch and increases bending, especially if asymmetric. Larger plates help only where contact exists; unsupported plate area cannot be counted as bearing area. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Track foot levels, contact marks and ground moisture together. If one sinking foot displaces the crown and destabilizes otherwise adequate members, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Foot bearing and settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：q=N/A=240 kN/0.40 m2=600 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: q=N/A=240 kN/0.40 m2=600 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼材強度合格就不需要驗算拱架基腳」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate steel strength removes the need to assess rib feet" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「基腳承載與沉陷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Foot bearing and settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基腳承載與沉陷
knowledge.text: 鋼拱荷載最後由基腳傳入地層，鬆軟或受水擾動的基底可能先於鋼材屈服。基腳沉陷會使拱形變扁並增加彎曲，單側沉陷尤其不利；擴大底板也需確認真正接觸面積，不能把懸空板面列入承壓。
knowledge.textEn: Footings transfer rib actions into ground that may soften or erode before steel yields. Settlement flattens the arch and increases bending, especially if asymmetric.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼材強度合格就不需要驗算拱架基腳 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate steel strength removes the need to assess rib feet Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基腳承載與沉陷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Foot bearing and settlement" is correct?
options: 鋼拱荷載最後由基腳傳入地層，鬆軟或受水擾動的基底可能先於鋼材屈服。
鋼材強度合格就不需要驗算拱架基腳
噴層硬化後鋼拱原本的應力會自動消失
optionsEn: Footings transfer rib actions into ground that may soften or erode before steel yields.
Adequate steel strength removes the need to assess rib feet
Steel stress automatically disappears when the surrounding shotcrete hardens
quiz.explanation: 鋼拱荷載最後由基腳傳入地層，鬆軟或受水擾動的基底可能先於鋼材屈服。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Footings transfer rib actions into ground that may soften or erode before steel yields. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基腳承載與沉陷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Foot bearing and settlement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「基腳承載與沉陷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Foot bearing and settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：q=N/A=240 kN/0.40 m2=600 kPa。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: q=N/A=240 kN/0.40 m2=600 kPa. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以基腳水準、接觸印跡及地層含水狀態同步追蹤。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track foot levels, contact marks and ground moisture together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：q=N/A=240 kN/0.40 m2=600 kPa。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: q=N/A=240 kN/0.40 m2=600 kPa. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基腳承載與沉陷」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Foot bearing and settlement", which statement holds?
options: 外露鋼材看起來良好就能代表包覆區無腐蝕
原創教學假設：q=N/A=240 kN/0.40 m2=600 kPa。
只要平均榀距符合就不必檢查局部跨距
optionsEn: Sound exposed steel proves corrosion is absent in covered areas
Original teaching assumptions: q=N/A=240 kN/0.40 m2=600 kPa.
Passing average rib spacing removes the need to check local spans
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：q=N/A=240 kN/0.40 m2=600 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: q=N/A=240 kN/0.40 m2=600 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基腳承載與沉陷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Foot bearing and settlement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「基腳承載與沉陷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Foot bearing and settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以基腳水準、接觸印跡及地層含水狀態同步追蹤。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「單側基腳下陷使拱頂偏移，構件強度合格仍失穩」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track foot levels, contact marks and ground moisture together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: One sinking foot displaces the crown and destabilizes otherwise adequate members. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以基腳水準、接觸印跡及地層含水狀態同步追蹤列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現單側基腳下陷使拱頂偏移，構件強度合格仍失穩，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Track foot levels, contact marks and ground moisture together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If one sinking foot displaces the crown and destabilizes otherwise adequate members, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：單側基腳下陷使拱頂偏移，構件強度合格仍失穩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One sinking foot displaces the crown and destabilizes otherwise adequate members. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以基腳水準、接觸印跡及地層含水狀態同步追蹤。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「單側基腳下陷使拱頂偏移，構件強度合格仍失穩」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Track foot levels, contact marks and ground moisture together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: One sinking foot displaces the crown and destabilizes otherwise adequate members. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將以基腳水準、接觸印跡及地層含水狀態同步追蹤列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現單側基腳下陷使拱頂偏移，構件強度合格仍失穩，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Track foot levels, contact marks and ground moisture together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If one sinking foot displaces the crown and destabilizes otherwise adequate members, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基腳承載與沉陷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Foot bearing and settlement"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
有噴凝土包覆就能假定所有方向完全側撐
以基腳水準、接觸印跡及地層含水狀態同步追蹤。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Shotcrete cover permits complete lateral restraint to be assumed in every direction
Track foot levels, contact marks and ground moisture together.
quiz.explanation: 以基腳水準、接觸印跡及地層含水狀態同步追蹤。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Track foot levels, contact marks and ground moisture together. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 基腳承載與沉陷：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Foot bearing and settlement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「基腳承載與沉陷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Foot bearing and settlement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單側基腳下陷使拱頂偏移，構件強度合格仍失穩。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以基腳水準、接觸印跡及地層含水狀態同步追蹤，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One sinking foot displaces the crown and destabilizes otherwise adequate members. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to track foot levels, contact marks and ground moisture together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以基腳水準、接觸印跡及地層含水狀態同步追蹤；若出現單側基腳下陷使拱頂偏移，構件強度合格仍失穩，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If one sinking foot displaces the crown and destabilizes otherwise adequate members, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鋼材強度合格就不需要驗算拱架基腳」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate steel strength removes the need to assess rib feet" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 單側基腳下陷使拱頂偏移，構件強度合格仍失穩。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以基腳水準、接觸印跡及地層含水狀態同步追蹤，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: One sinking foot displaces the crown and destabilizes otherwise adequate members. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to track foot levels, contact marks and ground moisture together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基腳承載與沉陷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Foot bearing and settlement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 單側基腳下陷使拱頂偏移，構件強度合格仍失穩。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
噴層硬化後鋼拱原本的應力會自動消失
optionsEn: One sinking foot displaces the crown and destabilizes otherwise adequate members.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Steel stress automatically disappears when the surrounding shotcrete hardens
quiz.explanation: 單側基腳下陷使拱頂偏移，構件強度合格仍失穩。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One sinking foot displaces the crown and destabilizes otherwise adequate members. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「複合噴層與變形相容」與「輪廓測量與二階效應」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Composite shotcrete and compatibility" and "Profile survey and second-order response": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 複合噴層與變形相容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Composite shotcrete and compatibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「複合噴層與變形相容」如何影響鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Composite shotcrete and compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Steel-rib and lattice-girder tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼拱與噴凝土只有在接觸及剪力傳遞足夠時才能共同分擔荷載。材料模數與齡期不同，先受力的鋼拱不會因後續噴層硬化而自動卸載；組合剛度只是同時變形下的理想上限，須保留實際施工載入歷史。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對時比較鋼材和噴層應變及各自開始受力時刻；若出現把全部荷載按完工剛度重分配會低估鋼拱既有應力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「複合噴層與變形相容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steel and shotcrete share loads only with sufficient contact and shear transfer. Their moduli and ages differ, and steel loaded earlier does not automatically unload as shotcrete hardens. Combined stiffness is an ideal compatibility model requiring the actual staged loading history. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare steel and shotcrete strains with their respective loading-start times. If redistributing all load by final stiffness understates stress already carried by steel, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Composite shotcrete and compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：EAsteel=200 GPa*0.003 m2=600 MN; EAshotcrete=10 GPa*0.10 m2=1000 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: EAsteel=200 GPa*0.003 m2=600 MN; EAshotcrete=10 GPa*0.10 m2=1000 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「噴層硬化後鋼拱原本的應力會自動消失」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Steel stress automatically disappears when the surrounding shotcrete hardens" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「複合噴層與變形相容」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Composite shotcrete and compatibility”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 複合噴層與變形相容
knowledge.text: 鋼拱與噴凝土只有在接觸及剪力傳遞足夠時才能共同分擔荷載。材料模數與齡期不同，先受力的鋼拱不會因後續噴層硬化而自動卸載；組合剛度只是同時變形下的理想上限，須保留實際施工載入歷史。
knowledge.textEn: Steel and shotcrete share loads only with sufficient contact and shear transfer. Their moduli and ages differ, and steel loaded earlier does not automatically unload as shotcrete hardens.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：噴層硬化後鋼拱原本的應力會自動消失 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Steel stress automatically disappears when the surrounding shotcrete hardens Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「複合噴層與變形相容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Composite shotcrete and compatibility" is correct?
options: 噴層硬化後鋼拱原本的應力會自動消失
鋼拱與噴凝土只有在接觸及剪力傳遞足夠時才能共同分擔荷載。
位移只有幾毫米就可以永遠忽略二階效應
optionsEn: Steel stress automatically disappears when the surrounding shotcrete hardens
Steel and shotcrete share loads only with sufficient contact and shear transfer.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：EAsteel=200 GPa*0.003 m2=600 MN; EAshotcrete=10 GPa*0.10 m2=1000 MN。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: EAsteel=200 GPa*0.003 m2=600 MN; EAshotcrete=10 GPa*0.10 m2=1000 MN. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對時比較鋼材和噴層應變及各自開始受力時刻。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 複合噴層與變形相容：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「複合噴層與變形相容」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 對時比較鋼材和噴層應變及各自開始受力時刻。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把全部荷載按完工剛度重分配會低估鋼拱既有應力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare steel and shotcrete strains with their respective loading-start times. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Redistributing all load by final stiffness understates stress already carried by steel. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare steel and shotcrete strains with their respective loading-start times. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If redistributing all load by final stiffness understates stress already carried by steel, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把全部荷載按完工剛度重分配會低估鋼拱既有應力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「複合噴層與變形相容」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 把全部荷載按完工剛度重分配會低估鋼拱既有應力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對時比較鋼材和噴層應變及各自開始受力時刻，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Redistributing all load by final stiffness understates stress already carried by steel. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare steel and shotcrete strains with their respective loading-start times to discriminate the cause. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對時比較鋼材和噴層應變及各自開始受力時刻；若出現把全部荷載按完工剛度重分配會低估鋼拱既有應力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If redistributing all load by final stiffness understates stress already carried by steel, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「噴層硬化後鋼拱原本的應力會自動消失」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Steel stress automatically disappears when the surrounding shotcrete hardens" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Msecond=P*delta=300 kN*0.020 m=6 kNm。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Msecond=P*delta=300 kN*0.020 m=6 kNm. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「輪廓測量與二階效應」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 原創教學假設：Msecond=P*delta=300 kN*0.020 m=6 kNm。
只要平均榀距符合就不必檢查局部跨距
有噴凝土包覆就能假定所有方向完全側撐
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: Msecond=P*delta=300 kN*0.020 m=6 kNm.
Passing average rib spacing removes the need to check local spans
Shotcrete cover permits complete lateral restraint to be assumed in every direction
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Msecond=P*delta=300 kN*0.020 m=6 kNm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Msecond=P*delta=300 kN*0.020 m=6 kNm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輪廓測量與二階效應：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Profile survey and second-order response: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「輪廓測量與二階效應」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Profile survey and second-order response” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用安裝後基準斷面比較各時期冠頂與側壁偏移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「重設量測零點掩蓋累積偏位，低估二階彎矩」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare crown and wall offsets against the as-installed reference section. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Resetting the survey zero hides accumulated offset and understates second-order moment. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將用安裝後基準斷面比較各時期冠頂與側壁偏移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現重設量測零點掩蓋累積偏位，低估二階彎矩，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare crown and wall offsets against the as-installed reference section. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If resetting the survey zero hides accumulated offset and understates second-order moment, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重設量測零點掩蓋累積偏位，低估二階彎矩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Resetting the survey zero hides accumulated offset and understates second-order moment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 用安裝後基準斷面比較各時期冠頂與側壁偏移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「重設量測零點掩蓋累積偏位，低估二階彎矩」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare crown and wall offsets against the as-installed reference section. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Resetting the survey zero hides accumulated offset and understates second-order moment. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將用安裝後基準斷面比較各時期冠頂與側壁偏移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現重設量測零點掩蓋累積偏位，低估二階彎矩，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

quiz.question: 要驗證「輪廓測量與二階效應」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Profile survey and second-order response"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用安裝後基準斷面比較各時期冠頂與側壁偏移。
螺栓已鎖緊就能把接頭視為完全剛接
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare crown and wall offsets against the as-installed reference section.
Tightened bolts make every rib joint perfectly rigid
quiz.explanation: 用安裝後基準斷面比較各時期冠頂與側壁偏移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare crown and wall offsets against the as-installed reference section. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 輪廓測量與二階效應：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Profile survey and second-order response: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輪廓測量與二階效應」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Profile survey and second-order response” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重設量測零點掩蓋累積偏位，低估二階彎矩。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用安裝後基準斷面比較各時期冠頂與側壁偏移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Resetting the survey zero hides accumulated offset and understates second-order moment. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare crown and wall offsets against the as-installed reference section to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察用安裝後基準斷面比較各時期冠頂與側壁偏移；若出現重設量測零點掩蓋累積偏位，低估二階彎矩，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If resetting the survey zero hides accumulated offset and understates second-order moment, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「位移只有幾毫米就可以永遠忽略二階效應」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A few millimetres of movement always makes second-order effects negligible" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重設量測零點掩蓋累積偏位，低估二階彎矩。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用安裝後基準斷面比較各時期冠頂與側壁偏移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Resetting the survey zero hides accumulated offset and understates second-order moment. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare crown and wall offsets against the as-installed reference section to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輪廓測量與二階效應」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Profile survey and second-order response" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
外露鋼材看起來良好就能代表包覆區無腐蝕
重設量測零點掩蓋累積偏位，低估二階彎矩。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Sound exposed steel proves corrosion is absent in covered areas
Resetting the survey zero hides accumulated offset and understates second-order moment.
quiz.explanation: 重設量測零點掩蓋累積偏位，低估二階彎矩。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Resetting the survey zero hides accumulated offset and understates second-order moment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「腐蝕與未包覆區」與「隱蔽工程與交接追溯」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Corrosion and uncovered zones" and "Concealed works and handover traceability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 腐蝕與未包覆區：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Corrosion and uncovered zones: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「腐蝕與未包覆區」如何影響鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Corrosion and uncovered zones” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Steel-rib and lattice-girder tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱架接頭、基腳及噴層空洞是容易接觸水氣的位置，腐蝕往往不是沿整榀均勻分布。厚度減少會同時影響面積與局部板件穩定，不能只用外表鏽色分級；檢查位置應與漏水和原施工空鼓紀錄互相連結。 判別這個機制時，應觀察在接頭及濕區量測剩餘厚度，配對空鼓與漏水圖；若出現隱藏空洞持續進水造成局部減薄，外露乾區卻正常，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「腐蝕與未包覆區」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joints, feet and shotcrete voids expose ribs to moisture, producing localized rather than uniform corrosion. Thickness loss affects both area and local plate stability; rust colour alone is insufficient. Relate inspection positions to leakage and original void records. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure remaining thickness at joints and wet zones against void and leakage maps. If wet hidden cavities thin local steel while exposed dry areas appear sound, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Corrosion and uncovered zones” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：thicknessLoss=(8-6) mm/8 mm=25 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: thicknessLoss=(8-6) mm/8 mm=25 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外露鋼材看起來良好就能代表包覆區無腐蝕」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Sound exposed steel proves corrosion is absent in covered areas" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「腐蝕與未包覆區」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Corrosion and uncovered zones”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 腐蝕與未包覆區
knowledge.text: 拱架接頭、基腳及噴層空洞是容易接觸水氣的位置，腐蝕往往不是沿整榀均勻分布。厚度減少會同時影響面積與局部板件穩定，不能只用外表鏽色分級；檢查位置應與漏水和原施工空鼓紀錄互相連結。
knowledge.textEn: Joints, feet and shotcrete voids expose ribs to moisture, producing localized rather than uniform corrosion. Thickness loss affects both area and local plate stability; rust colour alone is insufficient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外露鋼材看起來良好就能代表包覆區無腐蝕 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Sound exposed steel proves corrosion is absent in covered areas Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「腐蝕與未包覆區」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Corrosion and uncovered zones" is correct?
options: 拱架接頭、基腳及噴層空洞是容易接觸水氣的位置，腐蝕往往不是沿整榀均勻分布。
外露鋼材看起來良好就能代表包覆區無腐蝕
材料證書齊全就等於現地鋼拱系統已驗證

Complete material certificates prove the installed rib system has been verified

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Corrosion and uncovered zones” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：thicknessLoss=(8-6) mm/8 mm=25 percent。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 腐蝕與未包覆區：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Corrosion and uncovered zones” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在接頭及濕區量測剩餘厚度，配對空鼓與漏水圖。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「隱藏空洞持續進水造成局部減薄，外露乾區卻正常」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure remaining thickness at joints and wet zones against void and leakage maps. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Wet hidden cavities thin local steel while exposed dry areas appear sound. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將在接頭及濕區量測剩餘厚度，配對空鼓與漏水圖列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現隱藏空洞持續進水造成局部減薄，外露乾區卻正常，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Measure remaining thickness at joints and wet zones against void and leakage maps. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If wet hidden cavities thin local steel while exposed dry areas appear sound, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：隱藏空洞持續進水造成局部減薄，外露乾區卻正常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 腐蝕與未包覆區：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「腐蝕與未包覆區」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Corrosion and uncovered zones” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 隱藏空洞持續進水造成局部減薄，外露乾區卻正常。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到在接頭及濕區量測剩餘厚度，配對空鼓與漏水圖，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Wet hidden cavities thin local steel while exposed dry areas appear sound. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure remaining thickness at joints and wet zones against void and leakage maps to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 隱蔽工程與交接追溯：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「隱蔽工程與交接追溯」如何影響鋼拱支撐與格柵拱架的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concealed works and handover traceability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Steel-rib and lattice-girder tunnel support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 噴層完成後接頭、連繫及基腳難以直接觀察，施工前照片和幾何紀錄具有不可替代性。單一材料證書只能說明鋼材供應，不能證明現地連接；交接須把每榀編號連到檢查結果和修補版本，讓後續異常能定位到特定構造。 判別這個機制時，應觀察按榀號核對接頭、連繫、基腳與包覆前照片；若出現無法定位的施工照片使缺失區域無從追查與維修，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「隱蔽工程與交接追溯」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Encapsulation hides joints, ties and feet, making pre-cover photographs and geometry irreplaceable. A mill certificate describes supplied steel rather than installed connections. Link every rib identifier to inspections and repair revisions so later anomalies can be traced to the actual detail. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit joints, ties, feet and pre-cover photographs by rib identifier. If unlocated construction photographs prevent tracing and repairing a defective zone, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Concealed works and handover traceability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：traceability=fullyLinkedRibs/installedRibs=46/50=92 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: traceability=fullyLinkedRibs/installedRibs=46/50=92 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「材料證書齊全就等於現地鋼拱系統已驗證」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Complete material certificates prove the installed rib system has been verified" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「隱蔽工程與交接追溯」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Concealed works and handover traceability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：traceability=fullyLinkedRibs/installedRibs=46/50=92 percent。單榀承載取決於接頭、側向連繫及地層接觸，不只鋼材強度。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: traceability=fullyLinkedRibs/installedRibs=46/50=92 percent. A rib depends on joints, lateral bracing and ground contact as well as steel strength. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instructionEn: Audit joints, ties, feet and pre-cover photographs by rib identifier. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Unlocated construction photographs prevent tracing and repairing a defective zone. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將按榀號核對接頭、連繫、基腳與包覆前照片列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現無法定位的施工照片使缺失區域無從追查與維修，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Audit joints, ties, feet and pre-cover photographs by rib identifier. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If unlocated construction photographs prevent tracing and repairing a defective zone, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：無法定位的施工照片使缺失區域無從追查與維修。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unlocated construction photographs prevent tracing and repairing a defective zone. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「隱蔽工程與交接追溯」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Concealed works and handover traceability"?
options: 按榀號核對接頭、連繫、基腳與包覆前照片。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

optionsEn: Audit joints, ties, feet and pre-cover photographs by rib identifier.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Steel stress automatically disappears when the surrounding shotcrete hardens

quiz.explanationEn: Audit joints, ties, feet and pre-cover photographs by rib identifier. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 隱蔽工程與交接追溯：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Concealed works and handover traceability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隱蔽工程與交接追溯」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Concealed works and handover traceability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 無法定位的施工照片使缺失區域無從追查與維修。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到按榀號核對接頭、連繫、基腳與包覆前照片，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unlocated construction photographs prevent tracing and repairing a defective zone. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit joints, ties, feet and pre-cover photographs by rib identifier to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察按榀號核對接頭、連繫、基腳與包覆前照片；若出現無法定位的施工照片使缺失區域無從追查與維修，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If unlocated construction photographs prevent tracing and repairing a defective zone, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「材料證書齊全就等於現地鋼拱系統已驗證」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Complete material certificates prove the installed rib system has been verified" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 無法定位的施工照片使缺失區域無從追查與維修。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到按榀號核對接頭、連繫、基腳與包覆前照片，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Unlocated construction photographs prevent tracing and repairing a defective zone. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit joints, ties, feet and pre-cover photographs by rib identifier to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「隱蔽工程與交接追溯」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Concealed works and handover traceability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
無法定位的施工照片使缺失區域無從追查與維修。
只要平均榀距符合就不必檢查局部跨距
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Unlocated construction photographs prevent tracing and repairing a defective zone.
Passing average rib spacing removes the need to check local spans
quiz.explanation: 無法定位的施工照片使缺失區域無從追查與維修。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unlocated construction photographs prevent tracing and repairing a defective zone. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 隧道管棚超前支護
summary: 本課以用縱向跨距、搭接與鑽孔幾何檢核管棚超前支護為主線，從縱向橋接與反力路徑與鋼管截面與抗彎剛度建立系統邊界，再把鑽孔傾角與端部偏位、地層彈簧與支承剛度連到支護界面與撤除判斷。管棚依賴前方地層及後方初支共同反力，並非獨立懸空屋頂。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on check pipe umbrellas through longitudinal spans, overlap and bore geometry. It begins with Longitudinal bridging and reactions and Pipe section and flexural stiffness, links Bore inclination and end offset and Ground springs and restraint stiffness, and ends with Support interfaces and transfer decisions. The umbrella relies on reactions from ground ahead and support behind; it is not a free-standing roof. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
architectureNodes: 開孔間距與拱頂連續性

labels: 開孔間距與拱頂連續性

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查縱向橋接與反力路徑：M=q*L^2/8=30 kN/m*(3 m)^2/8=33.75 kNm；再獨立檢查鋼管截面與抗彎剛度：Inputs D,d in m; I=pi*(D^4-d^4)/64=pi*(0.114^4-0.102^4)/64=2.98e-6 m4。理想簡支跨度由 3.0 增為 3.3 m，均布線荷載 30 kN/m 不變，彎矩由 33.75 增為 40.84 kNm，增加 21%；連續地層支承仍須另建模。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為管棚依賴前方地層及後方初支共同反力，並非獨立懸空屋頂。 將以獨立控制點修正支承沉陷，再比較管件多點曲線作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Longitudinal bridging and reactions: M=q*L^2/8=30 kN/m*(3 m)^2/8=33.75 kNm. Independently check Pipe section and flexural stiffness: Inputs D,d in m; I=pi*(D^4-d^4)/64=pi*(0.114^4-0.102^4)/64=2.98e-6 m4. At fixed 30 kN/m, increasing an ideal simple span from 3.0 to 3.3 m raises moment from 33.75 to 40.84 kNm, by 21%; continuous ground restraint requires a separate model. The two results are not a complete design because the umbrella relies on reactions from ground ahead and support behind; it is not a free-standing roof. Use correct support settlement using independent control and compare multipoint pipe profiles as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「縱向橋接與反力路徑」與「鋼管截面與抗彎剛度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Longitudinal bridging and reactions" and "Pipe section and flexural stiffness": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 縱向橋接與反力路徑：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Longitudinal bridging and reactions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「縱向橋接與反力路徑」如何影響隧道管棚超前支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Longitudinal bridging and reactions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pipe-umbrella presupport for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管棚把開挖前方部分荷載跨越未支護區傳給後方初支和前方地層。反力不是固定鉸支點，會隨地層鬆動及支護沉陷移動；簡支梁可用來理解跨距平方的敏感度，但不能隱去土管接觸和開挖循環的影響。 判別這個機制時，應觀察把管棚撓度、初支沉陷及掌子面距離共同對時；若出現後方初支下沉擴大有效跨距，管材強度未變卻彎曲增加，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「縱向橋接與反力路徑」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An umbrella bridges an unsupported zone and transfers load to previous support and ground ahead. Reactions move as ground loosens and support settles rather than acting as fixed hinges. A simple beam reveals squared-span sensitivity but does not capture contact changes and excavation cycles. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize umbrella deflection, initial-support settlement and face distance. If rear support settlement lengthens the effective span and increases bending without changing pipe strength, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Longitudinal bridging and reactions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：M=q*L^2/8=30 kN/m*(3 m)^2/8=33.75 kNm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: M=q*L^2/8=30 kN/m*(3 m)^2/8=33.75 kNm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管棚只要夠長就不需要後方支護反力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently long umbrella does not require reactions from rear support" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「縱向橋接與反力路徑」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Longitudinal bridging and reactions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 縱向橋接與反力路徑
knowledge.text: 管棚把開挖前方部分荷載跨越未支護區傳給後方初支和前方地層。反力不是固定鉸支點，會隨地層鬆動及支護沉陷移動；簡支梁可用來理解跨距平方的敏感度，但不能隱去土管接觸和開挖循環的影響。
knowledge.textEn: An umbrella bridges an unsupported zone and transfers load to previous support and ground ahead. Reactions move as ground loosens and support settles rather than acting as fixed hinges.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：管棚只要夠長就不需要後方支護反力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently long umbrella does not require reactions from rear support Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「縱向橋接與反力路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Longitudinal bridging and reactions" is correct?
options: 管棚只要夠長就不需要後方支護反力
管棚把開挖前方部分荷載跨越未支護區傳給後方初支和前方地層。
鋼管每米重量相同就代表抗彎剛度相同
optionsEn: A sufficiently long umbrella does not require reactions from rear support
An umbrella bridges an unsupported zone and transfers load to previous support and ground ahead.
Equal steel-pipe mass per metre guarantees equal bending stiffness
quiz.explanation: 管棚把開挖前方部分荷載跨越未支護區傳給後方初支和前方地層。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An umbrella bridges an unsupported zone and transfers load to previous support and ground ahead. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 縱向橋接與反力路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Longitudinal bridging and reactions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「縱向橋接與反力路徑」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Longitudinal bridging and reactions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：M=q*L^2/8=30 kN/m*(3 m)^2/8=33.75 kNm。管棚依賴前方地層及後方初支共同反力，並非獨立懸空屋頂。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: M=q*L^2/8=30 kN/m*(3 m)^2/8=33.75 kNm. The umbrella relies on reactions from ground ahead and support behind; it is not a free-standing roof. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把管棚撓度、初支沉陷及掌子面距離共同對時。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize umbrella deflection, initial-support settlement and face distance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

steps.title: 縱向橋接與反力路徑：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 把管棚撓度、初支沉陷及掌子面距離共同對時。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「後方初支下沉擴大有效跨距，管材強度未變卻彎曲增加」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize umbrella deflection, initial-support settlement and face distance. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Rear support settlement lengthens the effective span and increases bending without changing pipe strength. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If rear support settlement lengthens the effective span and increases bending without changing pipe strength, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：後方初支下沉擴大有效跨距，管材強度未變卻彎曲增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Longitudinal bridging and reactions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 後方初支下沉擴大有效跨距，管材強度未變卻彎曲增加。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把管棚撓度、初支沉陷及掌子面距離共同對時，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rear support settlement lengthens the effective span and increases bending without changing pipe strength. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize umbrella deflection, initial-support settlement and face distance to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察把管棚撓度、初支沉陷及掌子面距離共同對時；若出現後方初支下沉擴大有效跨距，管材強度未變卻彎曲增加，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If rear support settlement lengthens the effective span and increases bending without changing pipe strength, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管棚只要夠長就不需要後方支護反力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sufficiently long umbrella does not require reactions from rear support" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 鋼管截面與抗彎剛度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pipe section and flexural stiffness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋼管截面與抗彎剛度」如何影響隧道管棚超前支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pipe section and flexural stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pipe-umbrella presupport for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼管抗彎剛度對直徑分布敏感，增加鋼材重量不一定等比例增加截面慣性矩。接頭處有效截面與母材不同，腐蝕或磨耗也可能降低壁厚；計算必須明確區分外徑、內徑及接頭剛度，不能只填一個公稱口徑。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對管材外內徑及接頭位置，抽測實際壁厚；若出現將公稱直徑當外徑會錯算慣性矩和彎曲應力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼管截面與抗彎剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pipe stiffness depends on how material is distributed about the axis, not weight alone. Connections differ from the parent section, while corrosion and wear can reduce wall thickness. Distinguish outside diameter, inside diameter and joint stiffness instead of using a single nominal size. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check outside and inside diameters, connection locations and measured wall thickness. If treating nominal size as outside diameter miscalculates inertia and bending stress, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pipe section and flexural stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs D,d in m; I=pi*(D^4-d^4)/64=pi*(0.114^4-0.102^4)/64=2.98e-6 m4.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼管每米重量相同就代表抗彎剛度相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal steel-pipe mass per metre guarantees equal bending stiffness" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鋼管截面與抗彎剛度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
