workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查掌子面擠出與地層核心：meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent；再獨立檢查補強密度與非均勻分擔：tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar。同一 6000 mm 參考長度內，假想擠出由 12 增為 18 mm，平均變形比由 0.2% 增為 0.3%；不是每支筋的相同應變。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 將比較深淺錨點相對位移及通道完整性診斷作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Face extrusion and ground core: meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent. Independently check Reinforcement density and unequal sharing: tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar. Over a 6000 mm reference length, extrusion rising from 12 to 18 mm changes the mean deformation ratio from 0.2% to 0.3%; this is not identical strain in every bar. The two results are not a complete design because fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. Use compare relative shallow-deep movement and channel-integrity diagnostics as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「掌子面擠出與地層核心」與「補強密度與非均勻分擔」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Face extrusion and ground core" and "Reinforcement density and unequal sharing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 掌子面擠出與地層核心：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Face extrusion and ground core: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「掌子面擠出與地層核心」如何影響隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Face extrusion and ground core” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiberglass face reinforcement for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 面前地層向開挖空間擠出會削弱拱效應，補強筋透過黏結抑制核心變形。量到的面位移包含開挖卸載與地層時效，不能直接當作每根筋伸長；應先定義量測參考長度及未擾動基準，再比較不同進尺的擠出增量。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時；若出現基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「掌子面擠出與地層核心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ground extruding toward the opening weakens arching, while bonded bars restrain the core. Face movement includes unloading and time effects rather than each bar's extension. Define reference length and an undisturbed datum before comparing extrusion increments at different excavation advances. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones. If a datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Face extrusion and ground core” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「面位移除以長度就是每支玻纖筋的真實應變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Face movement divided by length equals the actual strain of every bar" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「掌子面擠出與地層核心」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Face extrusion and ground core”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 掌子面擠出與地層核心
knowledge.text: 面前地層向開挖空間擠出會削弱拱效應，補強筋透過黏結抑制核心變形。量到的面位移包含開挖卸載與地層時效，不能直接當作每根筋伸長；應先定義量測參考長度及未擾動基準，再比較不同進尺的擠出增量。
knowledge.textEn: Ground extruding toward the opening weakens arching, while bonded bars restrain the core. Face movement includes unloading and time effects rather than each bar's extension.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：面位移除以長度就是每支玻纖筋的真實應變 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Face movement divided by length equals the actual strain of every bar Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「掌子面擠出與地層核心」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Face extrusion and ground core" is correct?
options: 面位移除以長度就是每支玻纖筋的真實應變
面前地層向開挖空間擠出會削弱拱效應，補強筋透過黏結抑制核心變形。
面積除以筋數就能決定每支筋一定承受的荷載
optionsEn: Face movement divided by length equals the actual strain of every bar
Ground extruding toward the opening weakens arching, while bonded bars restrain the core.
Area divided by bar count determines the exact force in each bar
quiz.explanation: 面前地層向開挖空間擠出會削弱拱效應，補強筋透過黏結抑制核心變形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ground extruding toward the opening weakens arching, while bonded bars restrain the core. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 掌子面擠出與地層核心：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Face extrusion and ground core: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「掌子面擠出與地層核心」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Face extrusion and ground core” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「掌子面擠出與地層核心」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Face extrusion and ground core", which statement holds?
options: 只要玻纖筋本身夠強就不會發生拔出
孔口位置正確就代表深部補強位置一定正確
原創教學假設：meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent。
optionsEn: A sufficiently strong fibre bar cannot pull out of the ground
Correct collar positions guarantee correct deep reinforcement positions
Original teaching assumptions: meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: meanDeformationRatio=12 mm/6000 mm=0.002=0.2 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 掌子面擠出與地層核心：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Face extrusion and ground core: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「掌子面擠出與地層核心」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Face extrusion and ground core” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「掌子面擠出與地層核心」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Face extrusion and ground core"?
options: 將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
掌子面中心位移小就代表整個核心沒有剪切
optionsEn: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Small central face movement proves the entire core is free of shear
quiz.explanation: 將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 掌子面擠出與地層核心：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Face extrusion and ground core: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「掌子面擠出與地層核心」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Face extrusion and ground core” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時；若出現基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「面位移除以長度就是每支玻纖筋的真實應變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Face movement divided by length equals the actual strain of every bar" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將多點面位移與開挖時間、距離及地層分區對時，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to synchronize multipoint face movement with excavation time, distance and ground zones to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「掌子面擠出與地層核心」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Face extrusion and ground core" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效。
面積除以筋數就能決定每支筋一定承受的荷載
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement.
Area divided by bar count determines the exact force in each bar
quiz.explanation: 基準也隨核心移動會低估擠出，錯判補強已奏效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A datum moving with the core understates extrusion and falsely indicates effective reinforcement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 補強密度與非均勻分擔：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reinforcement density and unequal sharing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「補強密度與非均勻分擔」如何影響隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reinforcement density and unequal sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiberglass face reinforcement for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每支筋對應的面積可描述幾何密度，卻不是固定承載分區。面中心、周邊及薄弱夾層的變形不同，黏結尚未動員的筋可能幾乎不受力；密度比較應同時看長度與岩土變形，避免只用根數評估面穩定。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布；若出現均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「補強密度與非均勻分擔」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Area per bar describes geometric density rather than a fixed load tributary. Centre, edge and weak-layer movements differ, and bars with unmobilized bond may carry little load. Compare density together with length and ground deformation instead of judging face stability from count alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers. If uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reinforcement density and unequal sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「面積除以筋數就能決定每支筋一定承受的荷載」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Area divided by bar count determines the exact force in each bar" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「補強密度與非均勻分擔」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Reinforcement density and unequal sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 補強密度與非均勻分擔
knowledge.text: 每支筋對應的面積可描述幾何密度，卻不是固定承載分區。面中心、周邊及薄弱夾層的變形不同，黏結尚未動員的筋可能幾乎不受力；密度比較應同時看長度與岩土變形，避免只用根數評估面穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Area per bar describes geometric density rather than a fixed load tributary. Centre, edge and weak-layer movements differ, and bars with unmobilized bond may carry little load.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：面積除以筋數就能決定每支筋一定承受的荷載 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Area divided by bar count determines the exact force in each bar Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「補強密度與非均勻分擔」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Reinforcement density and unequal sharing" is correct?
options: 面積除以筋數就能決定每支筋一定承受的荷載
玻纖筋能像鋼筋一樣先大幅屈服才破壞
每支筋對應的面積可描述幾何密度，卻不是固定承載分區。
optionsEn: Area divided by bar count determines the exact force in each bar
A fibre bar yields extensively like steel before it fails
Area per bar describes geometric density rather than a fixed load tributary.
quiz.explanation: 每支筋對應的面積可描述幾何密度，卻不是固定承載分區。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Area per bar describes geometric density rather than a fixed load tributary. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 補強密度與非均勻分擔：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reinforcement density and unequal sharing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「補強密度與非均勻分擔」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reinforcement density and unequal sharing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「補強密度與非均勻分擔」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Reinforcement density and unequal sharing", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar。
一次安裝長筋就能不受限制地連續開挖
孔口漿體變硬就代表整支錨固已達最終強度
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar.
Installing long bars once permits unlimited continuous excavation
Hard grout at the collar proves final strength along the entire anchorage
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: tributaryArea=faceArea/barCount=80 m2/40=2 m2 per bar. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 補強密度與非均勻分擔：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reinforcement density and unequal sharing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「補強密度與非均勻分擔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reinforcement density and unequal sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「補強密度與非均勻分擔」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Reinforcement density and unequal sharing"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布。
可切削材料被挖掉後仍可算入原先支護容量
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers.
Excavated cuttable material can still be counted in original support capacity
quiz.explanation: 比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 補強密度與非均勻分擔：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Reinforcement density and unequal sharing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「補強密度與非均勻分擔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reinforcement density and unequal sharing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布；若出現均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「面積除以筋數就能決定每支筋一定承受的荷載」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Area divided by bar count determines the exact force in each bar" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比對筋位圖與面中心、邊緣及弱層的位移分布，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare bar locations with displacement at the centre, edge and weak layers to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「補強密度與非均勻分擔」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Reinforcement density and unequal sharing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
玻纖筋能像鋼筋一樣先大幅屈服才破壞
均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A fibre bar yields extensively like steel before it fails
Uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion.
quiz.explanation: 均勻根數掩蓋弱層沒有有效補強，面局部仍持續擠出。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uniform counts conceal ineffective reinforcement of a weak layer with continuing local extrusion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「玻纖材料與脆性拉伸」與「孔壁黏結與有效錨固」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fibre material and brittle tension" and "Bore-wall bond and effective anchorage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 玻纖材料與脆性拉伸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fibre material and brittle tension: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「玻纖材料與脆性拉伸」如何影響隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fibre material and brittle tension” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiberglass face reinforcement for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 玻纖複材沿纖維方向強度高，但橫向、彎曲及剪切性能不同，不能套用鋼材的屈服延性。接頭及表面肋形也影響有效承載，名義拉力應以材證與試驗方向配對；沒有明顯塑性警訊時，損傷辨識尤其依賴品質證據。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對縱向拉伸試驗、接頭型式與安裝後表面損傷；若出現運送折傷造成局部纖維斷裂，外徑正常仍突然拉斷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「玻纖材料與脆性拉伸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fibre composites are strong along fibres but differ in transverse, bending and shear behaviour, so steel yielding assumptions do not apply. Connections and surface ribs affect effective resistance. Match certificates to test direction; limited plastic warning makes quality evidence particularly important. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check longitudinal tension tests, connection type and installed surface damage. If handling bends break local fibres and cause sudden rupture despite a normal diameter, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fibre material and brittle tension” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Nt=A*ft=500 mm2*600 N/mm2=300000 N=300 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Nt=A*ft=500 mm2*600 N/mm2=300000 N=300 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「玻纖筋能像鋼筋一樣先大幅屈服才破壞」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fibre bar yields extensively like steel before it fails" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「玻纖材料與脆性拉伸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fibre material and brittle tension”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 玻纖材料與脆性拉伸
knowledge.text: 玻纖複材沿纖維方向強度高，但橫向、彎曲及剪切性能不同，不能套用鋼材的屈服延性。接頭及表面肋形也影響有效承載，名義拉力應以材證與試驗方向配對；沒有明顯塑性警訊時，損傷辨識尤其依賴品質證據。
knowledge.textEn: Fibre composites are strong along fibres but differ in transverse, bending and shear behaviour, so steel yielding assumptions do not apply. Connections and surface ribs affect effective resistance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

quiz.question: 關於「玻纖材料與脆性拉伸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

玻纖筋能像鋼筋一樣先大幅屈服才破壞
只要玻纖筋本身夠強就不會發生拔出
optionsEn: Fibre composites are strong along fibres but differ in transverse, bending and shear behaviour, so steel yielding assumptions do not apply.
A fibre bar yields extensively like steel before it fails
A sufficiently strong fibre bar cannot pull out of the ground

quiz.explanationEn: Fibre composites are strong along fibres but differ in transverse, bending and shear behaviour, so steel yielding assumptions do not apply. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 玻纖材料與脆性拉伸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fibre material and brittle tension: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「玻纖材料與脆性拉伸」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fibre material and brittle tension” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Nt=A*ft=500 mm2*600 N/mm2=300000 N=300 kN。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Nt=A*ft=500 mm2*600 N/mm2=300000 N=300 kN. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對縱向拉伸試驗、接頭型式與安裝後表面損傷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check longitudinal tension tests, connection type and installed surface damage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 玻纖材料與脆性拉伸：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「玻纖材料與脆性拉伸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fibre material and brittle tension” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對縱向拉伸試驗、接頭型式與安裝後表面損傷。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「運送折傷造成局部纖維斷裂，外徑正常仍突然拉斷」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check longitudinal tension tests, connection type and installed surface damage. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Handling bends break local fibres and cause sudden rupture despite a normal diameter. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對縱向拉伸試驗、接頭型式與安裝後表面損傷列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現運送折傷造成局部纖維斷裂，外徑正常仍突然拉斷，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check longitudinal tension tests, connection type and installed surface damage. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If handling bends break local fibres and cause sudden rupture despite a normal diameter, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：運送折傷造成局部纖維斷裂，外徑正常仍突然拉斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 玻纖材料與脆性拉伸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fibre material and brittle tension: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「玻纖材料與脆性拉伸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fibre material and brittle tension” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 運送折傷造成局部纖維斷裂，外徑正常仍突然拉斷。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對縱向拉伸試驗、接頭型式與安裝後表面損傷，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Handling bends break local fibres and cause sudden rupture despite a normal diameter. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check longitudinal tension tests, connection type and installed surface damage to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對縱向拉伸試驗、接頭型式與安裝後表面損傷；若出現運送折傷造成局部纖維斷裂，外徑正常仍突然拉斷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If handling bends break local fibres and cause sudden rupture despite a normal diameter, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「玻纖筋能像鋼筋一樣先大幅屈服才破壞」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fibre bar yields extensively like steel before it fails" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.objective: 說明「孔壁黏結與有效錨固」如何影響隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bore-wall bond and effective anchorage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiberglass face reinforcement for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 玻纖筋透過漿體將拉力分散到孔壁，實際界面受孔壁擾動及注漿連續性控制。長度增加不保證線性增加容量，受拉端先動員且可能先軟化；平均黏結公式只能用作初步量級，必須配合拉拔曲線辨認滑移位置。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以拉拔位移、灌漿量和孔壁條件共同判斷有效黏結；若出現軟弱孔壁剪壞使筋連漿拔出，提高筋強度無法解決，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔壁黏結與有效錨固」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grout distributes bar force to the bore wall, controlled by disturbance and continuity. Longer embedment does not guarantee proportional capacity because the loaded end mobilizes and may soften first. An average-bond estimate provides scale and needs pull curves to identify the slipping interface. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Assess effective bond using pull movement, grout volume and bore-wall condition. If a weak bore wall shears and releases bar with grout despite stronger reinforcement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bore-wall bond and effective anchorage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.04 m*4 m*0.20 MPa=100.5 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.04 m*4 m*0.20 MPa=100.5 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要玻纖筋本身夠強就不會發生拔出」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.04 m*4 m*0.20 MPa=100.5 kN。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.04 m*4 m*0.20 MPa=100.5 kN. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以拉拔位移、灌漿量和孔壁條件共同判斷有效黏結。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Assess effective bond using pull movement, grout volume and bore-wall condition.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.04 m*4 m*0.20 MPa=100.5 kN。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.04 m*4 m*0.20 MPa=100.5 kN. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「孔壁黏結與有效錨固」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bore-wall bond and effective anchorage", which statement holds?
options: 孔口漿體變硬就代表整支錨固已達最終強度
可切削材料被挖掉後仍可算入原先支護容量
原創教學假設：N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.04 m*4 m*0.20 MPa=100.5 kN。
optionsEn: Hard grout at the collar proves final strength along the entire anchorage
Excavated cuttable material can still be counted in original support capacity
Original teaching assumptions: N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.04 m*4 m*0.20 MPa=100.5 kN.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.04 m*4 m*0.20 MPa=100.5 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: N=pi*d*L*tau=pi*0.04 m*4 m*0.20 MPa=100.5 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 孔壁黏結與有效錨固：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bore-wall bond and effective anchorage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔壁黏結與有效錨固」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bore-wall bond and effective anchorage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以拉拔位移、灌漿量和孔壁條件共同判斷有效黏結。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「軟弱孔壁剪壞使筋連漿拔出，提高筋強度無法解決」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Assess effective bond using pull movement, grout volume and bore-wall condition. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A weak bore wall shears and releases bar with grout despite stronger reinforcement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以拉拔位移、灌漿量和孔壁條件共同判斷有效黏結列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現軟弱孔壁剪壞使筋連漿拔出，提高筋強度無法解決，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Assess effective bond using pull movement, grout volume and bore-wall condition. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a weak bore wall shears and releases bar with grout despite stronger reinforcement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：軟弱孔壁剪壞使筋連漿拔出，提高筋強度無法解決。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A weak bore wall shears and releases bar with grout despite stronger reinforcement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以拉拔位移、灌漿量和孔壁條件共同判斷有效黏結。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「軟弱孔壁剪壞使筋連漿拔出，提高筋強度無法解決」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Assess effective bond using pull movement, grout volume and bore-wall condition. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A weak bore wall shears and releases bar with grout despite stronger reinforcement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將以拉拔位移、灌漿量和孔壁條件共同判斷有效黏結列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現軟弱孔壁剪壞使筋連漿拔出，提高筋強度無法解決，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Assess effective bond using pull movement, grout volume and bore-wall condition. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a weak bore wall shears and releases bar with grout despite stronger reinforcement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「孔壁黏結與有效錨固」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bore-wall bond and effective anchorage"?
options: 以拉拔位移、灌漿量和孔壁條件共同判斷有效黏結。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
面位移除以長度就是每支玻纖筋的真實應變
optionsEn: Assess effective bond using pull movement, grout volume and bore-wall condition.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Face movement divided by length equals the actual strain of every bar
quiz.explanation: 以拉拔位移、灌漿量和孔壁條件共同判斷有效黏結。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Assess effective bond using pull movement, grout volume and bore-wall condition. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 孔壁黏結與有效錨固：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bore-wall bond and effective anchorage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔壁黏結與有效錨固」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bore-wall bond and effective anchorage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 軟弱孔壁剪壞使筋連漿拔出，提高筋強度無法解決。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以拉拔位移、灌漿量和孔壁條件共同判斷有效黏結，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A weak bore wall shears and releases bar with grout despite stronger reinforcement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to assess effective bond using pull movement, grout volume and bore-wall condition to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以拉拔位移、灌漿量和孔壁條件共同判斷有效黏結；若出現軟弱孔壁剪壞使筋連漿拔出，提高筋強度無法解決，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a weak bore wall shears and releases bar with grout despite stronger reinforcement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要玻纖筋本身夠強就不會發生拔出」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sufficiently strong fibre bar cannot pull out of the ground" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 軟弱孔壁剪壞使筋連漿拔出，提高筋強度無法解決。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以拉拔位移、灌漿量和孔壁條件共同判斷有效黏結，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A weak bore wall shears and releases bar with grout despite stronger reinforcement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to assess effective bond using pull movement, grout volume and bore-wall condition to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「孔壁黏結與有效錨固」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bore-wall bond and effective anchorage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
軟弱孔壁剪壞使筋連漿拔出，提高筋強度無法解決。
一次安裝長筋就能不受限制地連續開挖
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A weak bore wall shears and releases bar with grout despite stronger reinforcement.
Installing long bars once permits unlimited continuous excavation
quiz.explanation: 軟弱孔壁剪壞使筋連漿拔出，提高筋強度無法解決。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A weak bore wall shears and releases bar with grout despite stronger reinforcement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「開挖進尺與保留長度」與「鑽孔偏差與地層覆蓋」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Advance and retained reinforcement" and "Bore deviation and ground coverage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 開挖進尺與保留長度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Advance and retained reinforcement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「開挖進尺與保留長度」如何影響隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Advance and retained reinforcement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiberglass face reinforcement for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每次開挖會切去靠近面的一段筋，剩餘錨固長度隨進尺降低。原始孔長合格不代表下一循環仍有足夠保留量，偏斜和孔底未填也會減少有效段；應建立每一輪補強與實際進尺的幾何帳，而非只記採購長度。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐輪比較實測孔長、累積進尺及下一輪補強位置；若出現超進尺把有效黏結段切短，局部擠出突然加快，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「開挖進尺與保留長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each advance removes the near-face section, reducing retained anchorage. Correct original length does not guarantee the next cycle's effective embedment; deviation and unfilled ends reduce it further. Maintain a geometric record of each reinforcement round and actual advance rather than purchase length alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare measured bore length, accumulated advance and the next reinforcement round. If excess advance shortens effective bond and abruptly accelerates local extrusion, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Advance and retained reinforcement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：retainedLength=installedLength-advance=12 m-7 m=5 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: retainedLength=installedLength-advance=12 m-7 m=5 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一次安裝長筋就能不受限制地連續開挖」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Installing long bars once permits unlimited continuous excavation" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「開挖進尺與保留長度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Advance and retained reinforcement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 開挖進尺與保留長度
knowledge.text: 每次開挖會切去靠近面的一段筋，剩餘錨固長度隨進尺降低。原始孔長合格不代表下一循環仍有足夠保留量，偏斜和孔底未填也會減少有效段；應建立每一輪補強與實際進尺的幾何帳，而非只記採購長度。
knowledge.textEn: Each advance removes the near-face section, reducing retained anchorage. Correct original length does not guarantee the next cycle's effective embedment; deviation and unfilled ends reduce it further.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一次安裝長筋就能不受限制地連續開挖 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Installing long bars once permits unlimited continuous excavation Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「開挖進尺與保留長度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Advance and retained reinforcement" is correct?
options: 一次安裝長筋就能不受限制地連續開挖
孔口位置正確就代表深部補強位置一定正確
每次開挖會切去靠近面的一段筋，剩餘錨固長度隨進尺降低。
optionsEn: Installing long bars once permits unlimited continuous excavation
Correct collar positions guarantee correct deep reinforcement positions
Each advance removes the near-face section, reducing retained anchorage.
quiz.explanation: 每次開挖會切去靠近面的一段筋，剩餘錨固長度隨進尺降低。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each advance removes the near-face section, reducing retained anchorage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 開挖進尺與保留長度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Advance and retained reinforcement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「開挖進尺與保留長度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.title: 開挖進尺與保留長度：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「開挖進尺與保留長度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Advance and retained reinforcement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐輪比較實測孔長、累積進尺及下一輪補強位置。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「超進尺把有效黏結段切短，局部擠出突然加快」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare measured bore length, accumulated advance and the next reinforcement round. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Excess advance shortens effective bond and abruptly accelerates local extrusion. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If excess advance shortens effective bond and abruptly accelerates local extrusion, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：超進尺把有效黏結段切短，局部擠出突然加快。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 開挖進尺與保留長度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Advance and retained reinforcement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「開挖進尺與保留長度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Advance and retained reinforcement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 超進尺把有效黏結段切短，局部擠出突然加快。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐輪比較實測孔長、累積進尺及下一輪補強位置，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excess advance shortens effective bond and abruptly accelerates local extrusion. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare measured bore length, accumulated advance and the next reinforcement round to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察逐輪比較實測孔長、累積進尺及下一輪補強位置；若出現超進尺把有效黏結段切短，局部擠出突然加快，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If excess advance shortens effective bond and abruptly accelerates local extrusion, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一次安裝長筋就能不受限制地連續開挖」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Installing long bars once permits unlimited continuous excavation" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.instruction: 孔口布點均勻不能保證深部補強均勻，傾角誤差會讓孔群逐漸聚集或發散。弱層若位於原預期孔軸之外，筋數再多也不能提供所需拘束；需把三維孔軸與地質模型重疊，辨識未覆蓋體積而非只看正面照片。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以導向或孔內量測重建孔軸並疊合弱層位置；若出現同向偏孔留下連續缺筋帶，正面布點卻完全合格，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鑽孔偏差與地層覆蓋」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Uniform collars do not ensure deep coverage because angular errors concentrate or separate bores. A weak layer outside the actual axes remains unrestrained despite a high bar count. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Reconstruct bore axes from guidance or downhole measurement and overlay weak layers. If consistently deviated bores leave a continuous unreinforced band despite correct collars, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bore deviation and ground coverage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 鑽孔偏差與地層覆蓋：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bore deviation and ground coverage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鑽孔偏差與地層覆蓋」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bore deviation and ground coverage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以導向或孔內量測重建孔軸並疊合弱層位置。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「同向偏孔留下連續缺筋帶，正面布點卻完全合格」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct bore axes from guidance or downhole measurement and overlay weak layers. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Consistently deviated bores leave a continuous unreinforced band despite correct collars. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以導向或孔內量測重建孔軸並疊合弱層位置列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現同向偏孔留下連續缺筋帶，正面布點卻完全合格，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Reconstruct bore axes from guidance or downhole measurement and overlay weak layers. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If consistently deviated bores leave a continuous unreinforced band despite correct collars, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同向偏孔留下連續缺筋帶，正面布點卻完全合格。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Consistently deviated bores leave a continuous unreinforced band despite correct collars. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以導向或孔內量測重建孔軸並疊合弱層位置。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「同向偏孔留下連續缺筋帶，正面布點卻完全合格」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct bore axes from guidance or downhole measurement and overlay weak layers. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Consistently deviated bores leave a continuous unreinforced band despite correct collars. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將以導向或孔內量測重建孔軸並疊合弱層位置列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現同向偏孔留下連續缺筋帶，正面布點卻完全合格，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If consistently deviated bores leave a continuous unreinforced band despite correct collars, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鑽孔偏差與地層覆蓋」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bore deviation and ground coverage"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
玻纖筋能像鋼筋一樣先大幅屈服才破壞
以導向或孔內量測重建孔軸並疊合弱層位置。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A fibre bar yields extensively like steel before it fails
Reconstruct bore axes from guidance or downhole measurement and overlay weak layers.
quiz.explanation: 以導向或孔內量測重建孔軸並疊合弱層位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct bore axes from guidance or downhole measurement and overlay weak layers. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鑽孔偏差與地層覆蓋：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bore deviation and ground coverage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鑽孔偏差與地層覆蓋」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bore deviation and ground coverage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同向偏孔留下連續缺筋帶，正面布點卻完全合格。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以導向或孔內量測重建孔軸並疊合弱層位置，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Consistently deviated bores leave a continuous unreinforced band despite correct collars. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconstruct bore axes from guidance or downhole measurement and overlay weak layers to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以導向或孔內量測重建孔軸並疊合弱層位置；若出現同向偏孔留下連續缺筋帶，正面布點卻完全合格，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If consistently deviated bores leave a continuous unreinforced band despite correct collars, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔口位置正確就代表深部補強位置一定正確」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Correct collar positions guarantee correct deep reinforcement positions" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同向偏孔留下連續缺筋帶，正面布點卻完全合格。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以導向或孔內量測重建孔軸並疊合弱層位置，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Consistently deviated bores leave a continuous unreinforced band despite correct collars. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reconstruct bore axes from guidance or downhole measurement and overlay weak layers to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鑽孔偏差與地層覆蓋」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bore deviation and ground coverage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 同向偏孔留下連續缺筋帶，正面布點卻完全合格。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
孔口漿體變硬就代表整支錨固已達最終強度
optionsEn: Consistently deviated bores leave a continuous unreinforced band despite correct collars.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Hard grout at the collar proves final strength along the entire anchorage
quiz.explanation: 同向偏孔留下連續缺筋帶，正面布點卻完全合格。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Consistently deviated bores leave a continuous unreinforced band despite correct collars. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「施工時間與黏結成熟」與「多點擠出與變形梯度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Construction time and bond maturity" and "Multipoint extrusion and gradients": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 施工時間與黏結成熟：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Construction time and bond maturity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工時間與黏結成熟」如何影響隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Construction time and bond maturity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiberglass face reinforcement for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 漿體材料需要時間形成可用黏結，低溫或大量水流可能改變成熟速度。表面硬化不能證明深部界面已發展，下一次開挖若過早卸載會在尚弱的錨固中造成滑移；評估要使用與原位環境可比的試體或核准方法。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將原位溫度、材料齡期及可比黏結試驗共同對照；若出現室內成熟資料高估低溫孔內黏結，導致早期滑移，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工時間與黏結成熟」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grout needs time to develop useful bond, with cold or flowing water changing maturity. Surface hardening does not prove deep-interface development. Early unloading in the next advance can slip a weak anchorage, requiring specimens or approved evidence comparable to the installed environment. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare in-place temperature, age and representative bond tests. If indoor maturity data overstate cold-bore bond and allow early slip, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Construction time and bond maturity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：strengthRatio=earlyBond/matureBond=0.08 MPa/0.20 MPa=0.40。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: strengthRatio=earlyBond/matureBond=0.08 MPa/0.20 MPa=0.40.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔口漿體變硬就代表整支錨固已達最終強度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hard grout at the collar proves final strength along the entire anchorage" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「施工時間與黏結成熟」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Construction time and bond maturity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工時間與黏結成熟
knowledge.text: 漿體材料需要時間形成可用黏結，低溫或大量水流可能改變成熟速度。表面硬化不能證明深部界面已發展，下一次開挖若過早卸載會在尚弱的錨固中造成滑移；評估要使用與原位環境可比的試體或核准方法。
knowledge.textEn: Grout needs time to develop useful bond, with cold or flowing water changing maturity. Surface hardening does not prove deep-interface development.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔口漿體變硬就代表整支錨固已達最終強度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hard grout at the collar proves final strength along the entire anchorage Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工時間與黏結成熟」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Construction time and bond maturity" is correct?
options: 孔口漿體變硬就代表整支錨固已達最終強度
漿體材料需要時間形成可用黏結，低溫或大量水流可能改變成熟速度。
掌子面中心位移小就代表整個核心沒有剪切
optionsEn: Hard grout at the collar proves final strength along the entire anchorage
Grout needs time to develop useful bond, with cold or flowing water changing maturity.
Small central face movement proves the entire core is free of shear
quiz.explanation: 漿體材料需要時間形成可用黏結，低溫或大量水流可能改變成熟速度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Grout needs time to develop useful bond, with cold or flowing water changing maturity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工時間與黏結成熟：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Construction time and bond maturity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工時間與黏結成熟」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Construction time and bond maturity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：strengthRatio=earlyBond/matureBond=0.08 MPa/0.20 MPa=0.40。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: strengthRatio=earlyBond/matureBond=0.08 MPa/0.20 MPa=0.40. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將原位溫度、材料齡期及可比黏結試驗共同對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare in-place temperature, age and representative bond tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：strengthRatio=earlyBond/matureBond=0.08 MPa/0.20 MPa=0.40。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: strengthRatio=earlyBond/matureBond=0.08 MPa/0.20 MPa=0.40. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工時間與黏結成熟」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Construction time and bond maturity", which statement holds?
options: 掌子面位移受控就能證明所有周邊支護都安全
面積除以筋數就能決定每支筋一定承受的荷載
原創教學假設：strengthRatio=earlyBond/matureBond=0.08 MPa/0.20 MPa=0.40。
optionsEn: Controlled face movement proves every peripheral support element is safe
Area divided by bar count determines the exact force in each bar
Original teaching assumptions: strengthRatio=earlyBond/matureBond=0.08 MPa/0.20 MPa=0.40.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：strengthRatio=earlyBond/matureBond=0.08 MPa/0.20 MPa=0.40。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: strengthRatio=earlyBond/matureBond=0.08 MPa/0.20 MPa=0.40. Keep units when recalculating.
