steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Multipoint extrusion and gradients” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiberglass face reinforcement for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 掌子面單一中心位移只能描述一點，無法辨認深部剪切帶與整體剛體移動。沿深度的多點位移差可建立變形梯度，但標距跨越不同地層時必須分段；量測斷線也可能被誤讀成穩定，因此缺值要保留而非補成零。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較深淺錨點相對位移及通道完整性診斷；若出現深部滑移集中在短區段，平均面位移卻顯得溫和，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「多點擠出與變形梯度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: One central displacement cannot distinguish a deep shear band from rigid movement. Differences along depth give deformation gradients but should be segmented across strata. A broken channel may also appear stable, so retain missing values rather than replacing them with zeros. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare relative shallow-deep movement and channel-integrity diagnostics. If deep slip localizes within a short zone despite modest mean face movement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: gradient=(18-6) mm/3000 mm=0.004=0.4 percent.

steps.title: 多點擠出與變形梯度：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Multipoint extrusion and gradients” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 深部滑移集中在短區段，平均面位移卻顯得溫和。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較深淺錨點相對位移及通道完整性診斷，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Deep slip localizes within a short zone despite modest mean face movement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare relative shallow-deep movement and channel-integrity diagnostics to discriminate the cause. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「掌子面中心位移小就代表整個核心沒有剪切」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「切除材料與施工介面」與「面補強與周邊支護協調」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cuttable material and excavation interfaces" and "Face reinforcement and peripheral support": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 切除材料與施工介面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cuttable material and excavation interfaces: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「切除材料與施工介面」如何影響隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cuttable material and excavation interfaces” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiberglass face reinforcement for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 玻纖筋可被開挖設備切除的特性，不表示其碎片或殘端對後續流程沒有影響。材料碎屑可能混入土石與排水系統，殘留筋端也會改變局部接觸；交接須把設計保留段和施工切除段分開，避免把已移除材料仍算入支護。 判別這個機制時，應觀察按循環核對切除長度、殘端位置及排水清理紀錄；若出現資料庫未扣除切去段而高估面前剩餘補強能力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「切除材料與施工介面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cuttable reinforcement still affects downstream work through fragments and residual ends. Debris can enter spoil or drainage systems, while remnants alter contact. Distinguish retained design lengths from removed sections so excavation records do not continue crediting reinforcement that no longer exists. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit removed length, remnant positions and drainage-cleaning records by cycle. If a database retaining removed lengths overstates remaining reinforcement ahead of the face, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cuttable material and excavation interfaces” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：removedBarLength=barCount*advance=40*1.5 m=60 m per assumed cycle。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: removedBarLength=barCount*advance=40*1.5 m=60 m per assumed cycle.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「可切削材料被挖掉後仍可算入原先支護容量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Excavated cuttable material can still be counted in original support capacity" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「切除材料與施工介面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cuttable material and excavation interfaces”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 玻纖筋可被開挖設備切除的特性，不表示其碎片或殘端對後續流程沒有影響。材料碎屑可能混入土石與排水系統，殘留筋端也會改變局部接觸；交接須把設計保留段和施工切除段分開，避免把已移除材料仍算入支護。
knowledge.textEn: Cuttable reinforcement still affects downstream work through fragments and residual ends. Debris can enter spoil or drainage systems, while remnants alter contact.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：可切削材料被挖掉後仍可算入原先支護容量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Excavated cuttable material can still be counted in original support capacity Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 切除材料與施工介面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cuttable material and excavation interfaces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「切除材料與施工介面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cuttable material and excavation interfaces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：removedBarLength=barCount*advance=40*1.5 m=60 m per assumed cycle。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: removedBarLength=barCount*advance=40*1.5 m=60 m per assumed cycle. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按循環核對切除長度、殘端位置及排水清理紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit removed length, remnant positions and drainage-cleaning records by cycle.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 資料庫未扣除切去段而高估面前剩餘補強能力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到按循環核對切除長度、殘端位置及排水清理紀錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A database retaining removed lengths overstates remaining reinforcement ahead of the face. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit removed length, remnant positions and drainage-cleaning records by cycle to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察按循環核對切除長度、殘端位置及排水清理紀錄；若出現資料庫未扣除切去段而高估面前剩餘補強能力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a database retaining removed lengths overstates remaining reinforcement ahead of the face, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「可切削材料被挖掉後仍可算入原先支護容量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Excavated cuttable material can still be counted in original support capacity" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 面補強與周邊支護協調：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Face reinforcement and peripheral support: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「面補強與周邊支護協調」如何影響隧道掌子面玻纖錨桿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Face reinforcement and peripheral support” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Fiberglass face reinforcement for tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 面補強抑制核心擠出，周邊初支則限制徑向收斂，兩者作用不同又相互影響。只增加面筋不能補償基腳沉陷或未閉合環，監測應同時追蹤面前與面後；施工判讀須避免把周邊支護問題錯歸因於筋材品質。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步比較面擠出、拱頂沉陷及初支閉合位置；若出現面位移改善卻周邊持續收斂，單一指標掩蓋另一失效，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「面補強與周邊支護協調」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Face bars restrain extrusion while peripheral support limits radial convergence; the mechanisms differ but interact. More face bars cannot compensate for sinking feet or an unclosed ring. Monitor ahead and behind the face to avoid attributing peripheral-support problems solely to bar quality. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare extrusion, crown settlement and initial-support closure position simultaneously. If improved face movement conceals continuing perimeter convergence when only one indicator is used, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Face reinforcement and peripheral support” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：movementRatio=faceExtrusion/crownSettlement=15 mm/5 mm=3, a diagnostic ratio only。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: movementRatio=faceExtrusion/crownSettlement=15 mm/5 mm=3, a diagnostic ratio only.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「掌子面位移受控就能證明所有周邊支護都安全」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Controlled face movement proves every peripheral support element is safe" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「面補強與周邊支護協調」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Face reinforcement and peripheral support”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 面補強與周邊支護協調：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「面補強與周邊支護協調」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Face reinforcement and peripheral support” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：movementRatio=faceExtrusion/crownSettlement=15 mm/5 mm=3, a diagnostic ratio only。玻纖筋是地層補強，不能把全部面壓簡單平均分配到每支筋。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: movementRatio=faceExtrusion/crownSettlement=15 mm/5 mm=3, a diagnostic ratio only. Fibre bars reinforce ground; total face pressure cannot simply be divided among all bars. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步比較面擠出、拱頂沉陷及初支閉合位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare extrusion, crown settlement and initial-support closure position simultaneously.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Face reinforcement and peripheral support” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步比較面擠出、拱頂沉陷及初支閉合位置。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「面位移改善卻周邊持續收斂，單一指標掩蓋另一失效」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare extrusion, crown settlement and initial-support closure position simultaneously. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Improved face movement conceals continuing perimeter convergence when only one indicator is used. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同步比較面擠出、拱頂沉陷及初支閉合位置列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現面位移改善卻周邊持續收斂，單一指標掩蓋另一失效，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare extrusion, crown settlement and initial-support closure position simultaneously. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If improved face movement conceals continuing perimeter convergence when only one indicator is used, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：面位移改善卻周邊持續收斂，單一指標掩蓋另一失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Improved face movement conceals continuing perimeter convergence when only one indicator is used. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 面位移改善卻周邊持續收斂，單一指標掩蓋另一失效。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步比較面擠出、拱頂沉陷及初支閉合位置，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Improved face movement conceals continuing perimeter convergence when only one indicator is used. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare extrusion, crown settlement and initial-support closure position simultaneously to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「面補強與周邊支護協調」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Face reinforcement and peripheral support" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
面位移改善卻周邊持續收斂，單一指標掩蓋另一失效。
面位移除以長度就是每支玻纖筋的真實應變
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Improved face movement conceals continuing perimeter convergence when only one indicator is used.
Face movement divided by length equals the actual strain of every bar
quiz.explanation: 面位移改善卻周邊持續收斂，單一指標掩蓋另一失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Improved face movement conceals continuing perimeter convergence when only one indicator is used. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 隧道防水膜鋪設
summary: 本課以以水壓邊界、焊縫與分區連續性驗證隧道防水膜為主線，從水頭與結構承壓邊界與基面平整與膜材跨空建立系統邊界，再把雙焊道試驗與溫度修正、穿透構件與接縫變形連到耐久相容與維護交接。防水膜阻隔滲水，承壓與排水責任仍須由整體襯砌系統承擔。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on verify tunnel membranes through pressure boundaries, seams and compartment continuity. It begins with Head and structural pressure boundary and Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging, links Dual-seam tests and temperature effects and Penetrations and joint movement, and ends with Durability compatibility and handover. The membrane blocks seepage, while the lining system must carry pressure or provide drainage. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查水頭與結構承壓邊界：p=rho*g*h=1000 kg/m3*9.81 m/s2*20 m=196200 Pa=196.2 kPa；再獨立檢查基面平整與膜材跨空：localExtension=(105-100) mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent。水頭由 20 增為 30 m 時，淡水壓力由 196.2 增為 294.3 kPa；膜後排水堵塞的水頭須與結構模型一致。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為防水膜阻隔滲水，承壓與排水責任仍須由整體襯砌系統承擔。 將將膜材照片、修補編號與最後一道交叉工序完成時間連結作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Head and structural pressure boundary: p=rho*g*h=1000 kg/m3*9.81 m/s2*20 m=196200 Pa=196.2 kPa. Independently check Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging: localExtension=(105-100) mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent. Raising freshwater head from 20 to 30 m increases pressure from 196.2 to 294.3 kPa; a blocked-drain head must agree with the structural model. The two results are not a complete design because the membrane blocks seepage, while the lining system must carry pressure or provide drainage. Use link membrane photographs and patch ids to completion of the final crossing trade as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水頭與結構承壓邊界」與「基面平整與膜材跨空」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Head and structural pressure boundary" and "Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水頭與結構承壓邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Head and structural pressure boundary: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水頭與結構承壓邊界」如何影響隧道防水膜鋪設的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Head and structural pressure boundary” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel waterproofing-membrane installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 防水膜本身不會讓地下水壓消失，封閉系統需要襯砌承受相應壓力，排水系統則依可靠排導降低水頭。將排水型和承壓型細部混用會留下不明荷載；必須明確寫出正常、堵塞和維修狀態的水壓邊界。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照地下水位、膜後水壓及排水通路的實際連接；若出現排水堵塞卻仍沿用低水頭設計，使襯砌承受未檢核壓力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水頭與結構承壓邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A membrane does not eliminate groundwater pressure: a closed system transfers pressure to lining, while a drained system relies on discharge to reduce head. Mixing the two concepts leaves undefined loads. Define pressure boundaries for normal operation, blockage and maintenance states. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare groundwater level, behind-membrane pressure and actual drain connections. If blocked drains leave lining exposed to pressure omitted by a low-head assumption, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Head and structural pressure boundary” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：p=rho*g*h=1000 kg/m3*9.81 m/s2*20 m=196200 Pa=196.2 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: p=rho*g*h=1000 kg/m3*9.81 m/s2*20 m=196200 Pa=196.2 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要有防水膜地下水壓就不會作用在襯砌」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A waterproof membrane prevents groundwater pressure from acting on the lining" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水頭與結構承壓邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Head and structural pressure boundary”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水頭與結構承壓邊界
knowledge.text: 防水膜本身不會讓地下水壓消失，封閉系統需要襯砌承受相應壓力，排水系統則依可靠排導降低水頭。將排水型和承壓型細部混用會留下不明荷載；必須明確寫出正常、堵塞和維修狀態的水壓邊界。
knowledge.textEn: A membrane does not eliminate groundwater pressure: a closed system transfers pressure to lining, while a drained system relies on discharge to reduce head. Mixing the two concepts leaves undefined loads.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要有防水膜地下水壓就不會作用在襯砌 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A waterproof membrane prevents groundwater pressure from acting on the lining Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水頭與結構承壓邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Head and structural pressure boundary" is correct?
options: 只要有防水膜地下水壓就不會作用在襯砌
防水膜本身不會讓地下水壓消失，封閉系統需要襯砌承受相應壓力，排水系統則依可靠排導降低水頭。
膜材延伸率高就能容許任意尖突基面
optionsEn: A waterproof membrane prevents groundwater pressure from acting on the lining
A membrane does not eliminate groundwater pressure: a closed system transfers pressure to lining, while a drained system relies on discharge to reduce head.
High membrane elongation permits a substrate with any sharp projections
quiz.explanation: 防水膜本身不會讓地下水壓消失，封閉系統需要襯砌承受相應壓力，排水系統則依可靠排導降低水頭。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A membrane does not eliminate groundwater pressure: a closed system transfers pressure to lining, while a drained system relies on discharge to reduce head. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水頭與結構承壓邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Head and structural pressure boundary: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水頭與結構承壓邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Head and structural pressure boundary” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：p=rho*g*h=1000 kg/m3*9.81 m/s2*20 m=196200 Pa=196.2 kPa。防水膜阻隔滲水，承壓與排水責任仍須由整體襯砌系統承擔。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: p=rho*g*h=1000 kg/m3*9.81 m/s2*20 m=196200 Pa=196.2 kPa. The membrane blocks seepage, while the lining system must carry pressure or provide drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照地下水位、膜後水壓及排水通路的實際連接。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare groundwater level, behind-membrane pressure and actual drain connections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：p=rho*g*h=1000 kg/m3*9.81 m/s2*20 m=196200 Pa=196.2 kPa。防水膜阻隔滲水，承壓與排水責任仍須由整體襯砌系統承擔。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: p=rho*g*h=1000 kg/m3*9.81 m/s2*20 m=196200 Pa=196.2 kPa. The membrane blocks seepage, while the lining system must carry pressure or provide drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水頭與結構承壓邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Multiple compartments drawn on a plan guarantee hydraulic isolation in place

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: p=rho*g*h=1000 kg/m3*9.81 m/s2*20 m=196200 Pa=196.2 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水頭與結構承壓邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Head and structural pressure boundary: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水頭與結構承壓邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Head and structural pressure boundary” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照地下水位、膜後水壓及排水通路的實際連接。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「排水堵塞卻仍沿用低水頭設計，使襯砌承受未檢核壓力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare groundwater level, behind-membrane pressure and actual drain connections. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Blocked drains leave lining exposed to pressure omitted by a low-head assumption. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照地下水位、膜後水壓及排水通路的實際連接列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現排水堵塞卻仍沿用低水頭設計，使襯砌承受未檢核壓力，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare groundwater level, behind-membrane pressure and actual drain connections. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If blocked drains leave lining exposed to pressure omitted by a low-head assumption, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：排水堵塞卻仍沿用低水頭設計，使襯砌承受未檢核壓力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Blocked drains leave lining exposed to pressure omitted by a low-head assumption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照地下水位、膜後水壓及排水通路的實際連接。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「排水堵塞卻仍沿用低水頭設計，使襯砌承受未檢核壓力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare groundwater level, behind-membrane pressure and actual drain connections. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Blocked drains leave lining exposed to pressure omitted by a low-head assumption. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將對照地下水位、膜後水壓及排水通路的實際連接列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現排水堵塞卻仍沿用低水頭設計，使襯砌承受未檢核壓力，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare groundwater level, behind-membrane pressure and actual drain connections. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If blocked drains leave lining exposed to pressure omitted by a low-head assumption, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水頭與結構承壓邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Head and structural pressure boundary"?
options: 對照地下水位、膜後水壓及排水通路的實際連接。

Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

steps.title: 水頭與結構承壓邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Head and structural pressure boundary: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水頭與結構承壓邊界」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Head and structural pressure boundary” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 排水堵塞卻仍沿用低水頭設計，使襯砌承受未檢核壓力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照地下水位、膜後水壓及排水通路的實際連接，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Blocked drains leave lining exposed to pressure omitted by a low-head assumption. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare groundwater level, behind-membrane pressure and actual drain connections to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照地下水位、膜後水壓及排水通路的實際連接；若出現排水堵塞卻仍沿用低水頭設計，使襯砌承受未檢核壓力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If blocked drains leave lining exposed to pressure omitted by a low-head assumption, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要有防水膜地下水壓就不會作用在襯砌」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A waterproof membrane prevents groundwater pressure from acting on the lining" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 排水堵塞卻仍沿用低水頭設計，使襯砌承受未檢核壓力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照地下水位、膜後水壓及排水通路的實際連接，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Blocked drains leave lining exposed to pressure omitted by a low-head assumption. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare groundwater level, behind-membrane pressure and actual drain connections to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水頭與結構承壓邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Head and structural pressure boundary" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
排水堵塞卻仍沿用低水頭設計，使襯砌承受未檢核壓力。
膜材延伸率高就能容許任意尖突基面
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Blocked drains leave lining exposed to pressure omitted by a low-head assumption.
High membrane elongation permits a substrate with any sharp projections
quiz.explanation: 排水堵塞卻仍沿用低水頭設計，使襯砌承受未檢核壓力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Blocked drains leave lining exposed to pressure omitted by a low-head assumption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 基面平整與膜材跨空：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「基面平整與膜材跨空」如何影響隧道防水膜鋪設的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel waterproofing-membrane installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 尖突和凹穴使膜材在混凝土擠壓下局部拉伸或刺穿，名義厚度不能補救不相容基面。柔軟墊層分散接觸但也可能壓縮，膜跨越空洞時的拉伸與支承條件不同；基面幾何應在被覆前留下可追溯紀錄。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以輪廓量測與接觸樣板標示尖突、凹穴及墊層位置；若出現膜材被混凝土壓入凹穴而局部拉裂，表面原本看似平順，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「基面平整與膜材跨空」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Projections and hollows stretch or puncture membrane under concrete pressure; nominal thickness cannot cure an incompatible substrate. Cushioning spreads contact but can compress, while bridging a cavity changes restraint. Record substrate geometry before it is concealed by the membrane. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Map projections, hollows and cushioning using profile measurements and contact templates. If concrete pushes membrane into a hollow and tears it despite a previously smooth appearance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：localExtension=(105-100) mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: localExtension=(105-100) mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「膜材延伸率高就能容許任意尖突基面」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High membrane elongation permits a substrate with any sharp projections" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「基面平整與膜材跨空」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基面平整與膜材跨空
knowledge.text: 尖突和凹穴使膜材在混凝土擠壓下局部拉伸或刺穿，名義厚度不能補救不相容基面。柔軟墊層分散接觸但也可能壓縮，膜跨越空洞時的拉伸與支承條件不同；基面幾何應在被覆前留下可追溯紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Projections and hollows stretch or puncture membrane under concrete pressure; nominal thickness cannot cure an incompatible substrate. Cushioning spreads contact but can compress, while bridging a cavity changes restraint.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：膜材延伸率高就能容許任意尖突基面 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High membrane elongation permits a substrate with any sharp projections Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基面平整與膜材跨空」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging" is correct?
options: 膜材延伸率高就能容許任意尖突基面
捲材平均厚度合格就能忽略局部薄點
尖突和凹穴使膜材在混凝土擠壓下局部拉伸或刺穿，名義厚度不能補救不相容基面。
optionsEn: High membrane elongation permits a substrate with any sharp projections
Passing mean roll thickness permits local thin points to be ignored
Projections and hollows stretch or puncture membrane under concrete pressure; nominal thickness cannot cure an incompatible substrate.
quiz.explanation: 尖突和凹穴使膜材在混凝土擠壓下局部拉伸或刺穿，名義厚度不能補救不相容基面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Projections and hollows stretch or puncture membrane under concrete pressure; nominal thickness cannot cure an incompatible substrate. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基面平整與膜材跨空：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「基面平整與膜材跨空」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：localExtension=(105-100) mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent。防水膜阻隔滲水，承壓與排水責任仍須由整體襯砌系統承擔。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: localExtension=(105-100) mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent. The membrane blocks seepage, while the lining system must carry pressure or provide drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以輪廓量測與接觸樣板標示尖突、凹穴及墊層位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map projections, hollows and cushioning using profile measurements and contact templates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：localExtension=(105-100) mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent。防水膜阻隔滲水，承壓與排水責任仍須由整體襯砌系統承擔。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: localExtension=(105-100) mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent. The membrane blocks seepage, while the lining system must carry pressure or provide drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基面平整與膜材跨空」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：localExtension=(105-100) mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent。
任何試壓壓降都能直接證明膜材有破洞
材料斷裂延伸率就是所有穿透細部的允許位移
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: localExtension=(105-100) mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent.
Every pressure-test drop directly proves a hole in the membrane
Material break elongation is the allowable movement of every penetration detail
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：localExtension=(105-100) mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: localExtension=(105-100) mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基面平整與膜材跨空：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「基面平整與膜材跨空」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以輪廓量測與接觸樣板標示尖突、凹穴及墊層位置。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「膜材被混凝土壓入凹穴而局部拉裂，表面原本看似平順」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map projections, hollows and cushioning using profile measurements and contact templates. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Concrete pushes membrane into a hollow and tears it despite a previously smooth appearance. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以輪廓量測與接觸樣板標示尖突、凹穴及墊層位置列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現膜材被混凝土壓入凹穴而局部拉裂，表面原本看似平順，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Map projections, hollows and cushioning using profile measurements and contact templates. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If concrete pushes membrane into a hollow and tears it despite a previously smooth appearance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：膜材被混凝土壓入凹穴而局部拉裂，表面原本看似平順。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Concrete pushes membrane into a hollow and tears it despite a previously smooth appearance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以輪廓量測與接觸樣板標示尖突、凹穴及墊層位置。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「膜材被混凝土壓入凹穴而局部拉裂，表面原本看似平順」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Map projections, hollows and cushioning using profile measurements and contact templates. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Concrete pushes membrane into a hollow and tears it despite a previously smooth appearance. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將以輪廓量測與接觸樣板標示尖突、凹穴及墊層位置列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現膜材被混凝土壓入凹穴而局部拉裂，表面原本看似平順，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Map projections, hollows and cushioning using profile measurements and contact templates. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If concrete pushes membrane into a hollow and tears it despite a previously smooth appearance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基面平整與膜材跨空」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Substrate smoothness and membrane bridging"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以輪廓量測與接觸樣板標示尖突、凹穴及墊層位置。
內表面漏水位置一定就是膜材破損的位置
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Map projections, hollows and cushioning using profile measurements and contact templates.
An interior leak always marks the exact location of membrane damage
quiz.explanation: 以輪廓量測與接觸樣板標示尖突、凹穴及墊層位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map projections, hollows and cushioning using profile measurements and contact templates. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

焊縫外觀平滑就能證明全寬熔合
optionsEn: A locally thin point tears under later construction pressure despite a passing average report.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A smooth seam appearance proves fusion across its entire width
quiz.explanation: 局部薄點在後續施工受壓破裂，平均報告未能預警。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A locally thin point tears under later construction pressure despite a passing average report. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 焊縫有效寬度與剝離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective seam width and peeling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「焊縫有效寬度與剝離」如何影響隧道防水膜鋪設的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective seam width and peeling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel waterproofing-membrane installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 焊縫需要連續熔合，外觀寬度不等於有效黏合寬度，污染或皺摺可能形成未熔合通道。剝離與剪切試驗檢查不同受力方式，單一峰值需搭配破壞位置；以完整材料撕裂還是界面分離，會導出不同品質判讀。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將剝離與剪切結果配對焊縫破壞面及有效寬度；若出現表面封口掩蓋內部未熔合通道，水沿接縫串流，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「焊縫有效寬度與剝離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A seam needs continuous fusion; visible width differs from effective bonded width when contamination or folds create channels. Peel and shear test different loading modes. Interpret peak force together with whether failure tears parent material or separates the interface. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Pair peel and shear results with failure faces and effective seam width. If surface closure conceals an unfused internal channel that carries water along the seam, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective seam width and peeling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：lineResistance=F/width=300 N/50 mm=6 N/mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: lineResistance=F/width=300 N/50 mm=6 N/mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「焊縫外觀平滑就能證明全寬熔合」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A smooth seam appearance proves fusion across its entire width" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「焊縫有效寬度與剝離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective seam width and peeling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 焊縫有效寬度與剝離
knowledge.text: 焊縫需要連續熔合，外觀寬度不等於有效黏合寬度，污染或皺摺可能形成未熔合通道。剝離與剪切試驗檢查不同受力方式，單一峰值需搭配破壞位置；以完整材料撕裂還是界面分離，會導出不同品質判讀。
knowledge.textEn: A seam needs continuous fusion; visible width differs from effective bonded width when contamination or folds create channels. Peel and shear test different loading modes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：焊縫外觀平滑就能證明全寬熔合 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A smooth seam appearance proves fusion across its entire width Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「焊縫有效寬度與剝離」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective seam width and peeling" is correct?
options: 焊縫外觀平滑就能證明全寬熔合
焊縫需要連續熔合，外觀寬度不等於有效黏合寬度，污染或皺摺可能形成未熔合通道。
任何試壓壓降都能直接證明膜材有破洞
optionsEn: A smooth seam appearance proves fusion across its entire width
A seam needs continuous fusion; visible width differs from effective bonded width when contamination or folds create channels.
Every pressure-test drop directly proves a hole in the membrane
quiz.explanation: 焊縫需要連續熔合，外觀寬度不等於有效黏合寬度，污染或皺摺可能形成未熔合通道。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A seam needs continuous fusion; visible width differs from effective bonded width when contamination or folds create channels. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 焊縫有效寬度與剝離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective seam width and peeling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「焊縫有效寬度與剝離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective seam width and peeling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：lineResistance=F/width=300 N/50 mm=6 N/mm。防水膜阻隔滲水，承壓與排水責任仍須由整體襯砌系統承擔。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: lineResistance=F/width=300 N/50 mm=6 N/mm. The membrane blocks seepage, while the lining system must carry pressure or provide drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將剝離與剪切結果配對焊縫破壞面及有效寬度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair peel and shear results with failure faces and effective seam width.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：lineResistance=F/width=300 N/50 mm=6 N/mm。防水膜阻隔滲水，承壓與排水責任仍須由整體襯砌系統承擔。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: lineResistance=F/width=300 N/50 mm=6 N/mm. The membrane blocks seepage, while the lining system must carry pressure or provide drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「焊縫有效寬度與剝離」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective seam width and peeling", which statement holds?
options: 材料斷裂延伸率就是所有穿透細部的允許位移
內表面漏水位置一定就是膜材破損的位置
原創教學假設：lineResistance=F/width=300 N/50 mm=6 N/mm。
optionsEn: Material break elongation is the allowable movement of every penetration detail
An interior leak always marks the exact location of membrane damage
Original teaching assumptions: lineResistance=F/width=300 N/50 mm=6 N/mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：lineResistance=F/width=300 N/50 mm=6 N/mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: lineResistance=F/width=300 N/50 mm=6 N/mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 焊縫有效寬度與剝離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective seam width and peeling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「焊縫有效寬度與剝離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective seam width and peeling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將剝離與剪切結果配對焊縫破壞面及有效寬度。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「表面封口掩蓋內部未熔合通道，水沿接縫串流」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair peel and shear results with failure faces and effective seam width. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Surface closure conceals an unfused internal channel that carries water along the seam. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將剝離與剪切結果配對焊縫破壞面及有效寬度列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現表面封口掩蓋內部未熔合通道，水沿接縫串流，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Pair peel and shear results with failure faces and effective seam width. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If surface closure conceals an unfused internal channel that carries water along the seam, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：表面封口掩蓋內部未熔合通道，水沿接縫串流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Surface closure conceals an unfused internal channel that carries water along the seam. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將剝離與剪切結果配對焊縫破壞面及有效寬度。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「表面封口掩蓋內部未熔合通道，水沿接縫串流」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Pair peel and shear results with failure faces and effective seam width. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Surface closure conceals an unfused internal channel that carries water along the seam. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將剝離與剪切結果配對焊縫破壞面及有效寬度列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現表面封口掩蓋內部未熔合通道，水沿接縫串流，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Pair peel and shear results with failure faces and effective seam width. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If surface closure conceals an unfused internal channel that carries water along the seam, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「焊縫有效寬度與剝離」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective seam width and peeling"?
options: 將剝離與剪切結果配對焊縫破壞面及有效寬度。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要有防水膜地下水壓就不會作用在襯砌
optionsEn: Pair peel and shear results with failure faces and effective seam width.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A waterproof membrane prevents groundwater pressure from acting on the lining
quiz.explanation: 將剝離與剪切結果配對焊縫破壞面及有效寬度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair peel and shear results with failure faces and effective seam width. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 焊縫有效寬度與剝離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective seam width and peeling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「焊縫有效寬度與剝離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective seam width and peeling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 表面封口掩蓋內部未熔合通道，水沿接縫串流。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將剝離與剪切結果配對焊縫破壞面及有效寬度，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Surface closure conceals an unfused internal channel that carries water along the seam. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to pair peel and shear results with failure faces and effective seam width to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將剝離與剪切結果配對焊縫破壞面及有效寬度；若出現表面封口掩蓋內部未熔合通道，水沿接縫串流，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If surface closure conceals an unfused internal channel that carries water along the seam, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「焊縫外觀平滑就能證明全寬熔合」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A smooth seam appearance proves fusion across its entire width" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 表面封口掩蓋內部未熔合通道，水沿接縫串流。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將剝離與剪切結果配對焊縫破壞面及有效寬度，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Surface closure conceals an unfused internal channel that carries water along the seam. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to pair peel and shear results with failure faces and effective seam width to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「焊縫有效寬度與剝離」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Effective seam width and peeling" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
表面封口掩蓋內部未熔合通道，水沿接縫串流。
任何試壓壓降都能直接證明膜材有破洞
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Surface closure conceals an unfused internal channel that carries water along the seam.
Every pressure-test drop directly proves a hole in the membrane
quiz.explanation: 表面封口掩蓋內部未熔合通道，水沿接縫串流。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface closure conceals an unfused internal channel that carries water along the seam. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雙焊道試驗與溫度修正」與「分區止水與水路隔離」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dual-seam tests and temperature effects" and "Compartments and hydraulic isolation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雙焊道試驗與溫度修正：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dual-seam tests and temperature effects: mechanism and system paths

steps.instruction: 同步記錄通道絕對壓力、溫度及端封接頭檢漏結果。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「冷卻造成壓降被誤判為焊縫漏氣，引出無效重焊」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 分區止水與水路隔離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Compartments and hydraulic isolation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分區止水與水路隔離」如何影響隧道防水膜鋪設的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compartments and hydraulic isolation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel waterproofing-membrane installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分區系統限制漏水在膜後蔓延，水擋、接頭與後續修復管路必須構成連續邊界。圖上分區不等於實體隔離，跨區穿孔或未連接止水帶可讓一處破損影響很大範圍；驗證要追蹤水路而不只是統計隔板數。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐一核對分區水擋交會、穿透細部及可追溯測試端口；若出現一處跨區缺口讓多區連通，局部維修失去定位能力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分區止水與水路隔離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compartments limit migration behind the membrane through continuous waterstops, joints and repair interfaces. Drawn zones are not physical isolation: penetrations or disconnected stops can spread one defect widely. Verification therefore traces hydraulic paths rather than counting compartment boundaries. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit waterstop intersections, penetrations and traceable test ports by compartment. If one cross-zone gap connects compartments and defeats localization of repair, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Compartments and hydraulic isolation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: affectedAreaRatio=oneZone/wholeArea=100 m2/1000 m2=0.10, assuming intact isolation.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「圖紙畫成多個分區就能保證實際水路隔離」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Multiple compartments drawn on a plan guarantee hydraulic isolation in place" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分區止水與水路隔離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Compartments and hydraulic isolation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分區止水與水路隔離
knowledge.text: 分區系統限制漏水在膜後蔓延，水擋、接頭與後續修復管路必須構成連續邊界。圖上分區不等於實體隔離，跨區穿孔或未連接止水帶可讓一處破損影響很大範圍；驗證要追蹤水路而不只是統計隔板數。
knowledge.textEn: Compartments limit migration behind the membrane through continuous waterstops, joints and repair interfaces. Drawn zones are not physical isolation: penetrations or disconnected stops can spread one defect widely.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：圖紙畫成多個分區就能保證實際水路隔離 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Multiple compartments drawn on a plan guarantee hydraulic isolation in place Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分區止水與水路隔離」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Compartments and hydraulic isolation" is correct?
options: 分區系統限制漏水在膜後蔓延，水擋、接頭與後續修復管路必須構成連續邊界。
圖紙畫成多個分區就能保證實際水路隔離
材料斷裂延伸率就是所有穿透細部的允許位移
optionsEn: Compartments limit migration behind the membrane through continuous waterstops, joints and repair interfaces.
Multiple compartments drawn on a plan guarantee hydraulic isolation in place
Material break elongation is the allowable movement of every penetration detail
quiz.explanation: 分區系統限制漏水在膜後蔓延，水擋、接頭與後續修復管路必須構成連續邊界。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compartments limit migration behind the membrane through continuous waterstops, joints and repair interfaces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分區止水與水路隔離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Compartments and hydraulic isolation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分區止水與水路隔離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Compartments and hydraulic isolation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：affectedAreaRatio=oneZone/wholeArea=100 m2/1000 m2=0.10, assuming intact isolation。防水膜阻隔滲水，承壓與排水責任仍須由整體襯砌系統承擔。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: affectedAreaRatio=oneZone/wholeArea=100 m2/1000 m2=0.10, assuming intact isolation. The membrane blocks seepage, while the lining system must carry pressure or provide drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐一核對分區水擋交會、穿透細部及可追溯測試端口。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit waterstop intersections, penetrations and traceable test ports by compartment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分區止水與水路隔離」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Original teaching assumptions: affectedAreaRatio=oneZone/wholeArea=100 m2/1000 m2=0.10, assuming intact isolation.
A waterproof membrane prevents groundwater pressure from acting on the lining

steps.title: 分區止水與水路隔離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Compartments and hydraulic isolation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分區止水與水路隔離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Compartments and hydraulic isolation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐一核對分區水擋交會、穿透細部及可追溯測試端口。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「一處跨區缺口讓多區連通，局部維修失去定位能力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit waterstop intersections, penetrations and traceable test ports by compartment. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: One cross-zone gap connects compartments and defeats localization of repair. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將逐一核對分區水擋交會、穿透細部及可追溯測試端口列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現一處跨區缺口讓多區連通，局部維修失去定位能力，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Audit waterstop intersections, penetrations and traceable test ports by compartment. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If one cross-zone gap connects compartments and defeats localization of repair, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一處跨區缺口讓多區連通，局部維修失去定位能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One cross-zone gap connects compartments and defeats localization of repair. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐一核對分區水擋交會、穿透細部及可追溯測試端口。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「一處跨區缺口讓多區連通，局部維修失去定位能力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Audit waterstop intersections, penetrations and traceable test ports by compartment. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: One cross-zone gap connects compartments and defeats localization of repair. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將逐一核對分區水擋交會、穿透細部及可追溯測試端口列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現一處跨區缺口讓多區連通，局部維修失去定位能力，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Audit waterstop intersections, penetrations and traceable test ports by compartment. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. quiz.question: 要驗證「分區止水與水路隔離」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Compartments and hydraulic isolation"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
捲材平均厚度合格就能忽略局部薄點

optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Passing mean roll thickness permits local thin points to be ignored
Audit waterstop intersections, penetrations and traceable test ports by compartment.
quiz.explanation: 逐一核對分區水擋交會、穿透細部及可追溯測試端口。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit waterstop intersections, penetrations and traceable test ports by compartment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分區止水與水路隔離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compartments and hydraulic isolation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分區止水與水路隔離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compartments and hydraulic isolation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一處跨區缺口讓多區連通，局部維修失去定位能力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐一核對分區水擋交會、穿透細部及可追溯測試端口，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One cross-zone gap connects compartments and defeats localization of repair. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit waterstop intersections, penetrations and traceable test ports by compartment to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察逐一核對分區水擋交會、穿透細部及可追溯測試端口；若出現一處跨區缺口讓多區連通，局部維修失去定位能力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If one cross-zone gap connects compartments and defeats localization of repair, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「圖紙畫成多個分區就能保證實際水路隔離」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Multiple compartments drawn on a plan guarantee hydraulic isolation in place" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一處跨區缺口讓多區連通，局部維修失去定位能力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐一核對分區水擋交會、穿透細部及可追溯測試端口，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: One cross-zone gap connects compartments and defeats localization of repair. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit waterstop intersections, penetrations and traceable test ports by compartment to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分區止水與水路隔離」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Compartments and hydraulic isolation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 一處跨區缺口讓多區連通，局部維修失去定位能力。

optionsEn: One cross-zone gap connects compartments and defeats localization of repair.
