stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「穿透構件與接縫變形」與「隱蔽前損傷與後續工序」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Penetrations and joint movement" and "Pre-concealment damage and subsequent work": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 穿透構件與接縫變形：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Penetrations and joint movement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「穿透構件與接縫變形」如何影響隧道防水膜鋪設的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Penetrations and joint movement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel waterproofing-membrane installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 支架、預埋件和施工接縫會中斷連續膜面，局部位移常集中在固定點附近。密封細部需要同時容許預期移動並保持水路連續，不能把材料拉伸率直接當作接頭允許位移；自由長度、固定方式及多方向變形都要確認。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較接頭位移方向、膜材自由長度及穿透處試件變形；若出現固定點太靠近接縫使小位移集中成撕裂，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「穿透構件與接縫變形」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Brackets, embedded items and joints interrupt membrane continuity and concentrate movement near fixings. Details must accommodate movement while preserving water isolation. Material elongation is not the joint movement allowance: free length, restraint and multidirectional deformation require separate verification. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare joint movement directions, membrane free length and penetration-specimen response. If fixings too close to a joint concentrate small movement into tearing, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Penetrations and joint movement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：nominalStrain=movement/freeLength=5 mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: nominalStrain=movement/freeLength=5 mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「材料斷裂延伸率就是所有穿透細部的允許位移」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Material break elongation is the allowable movement of every penetration detail" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「穿透構件與接縫變形」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Penetrations and joint movement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 穿透構件與接縫變形
knowledge.text: 支架、預埋件和施工接縫會中斷連續膜面，局部位移常集中在固定點附近。密封細部需要同時容許預期移動並保持水路連續，不能把材料拉伸率直接當作接頭允許位移；自由長度、固定方式及多方向變形都要確認。
knowledge.textEn: Brackets, embedded items and joints interrupt membrane continuity and concentrate movement near fixings. Details must accommodate movement while preserving water isolation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：材料斷裂延伸率就是所有穿透細部的允許位移 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Material break elongation is the allowable movement of every penetration detail Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「穿透構件與接縫變形」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Penetrations and joint movement" is correct?
options: 材料斷裂延伸率就是所有穿透細部的允許位移
支架、預埋件和施工接縫會中斷連續膜面，局部位移常集中在固定點附近。
焊接檢驗完成後就永遠不需再次查看膜面
optionsEn: Material break elongation is the allowable movement of every penetration detail
Brackets, embedded items and joints interrupt membrane continuity and concentrate movement near fixings.
After seam inspection the membrane surface never needs another check
quiz.explanation: 支架、預埋件和施工接縫會中斷連續膜面，局部位移常集中在固定點附近。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Brackets, embedded items and joints interrupt membrane continuity and concentrate movement near fixings. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 穿透構件與接縫變形：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Penetrations and joint movement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「穿透構件與接縫變形」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Penetrations and joint movement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：nominalStrain=movement/freeLength=5 mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent。防水膜阻隔滲水，承壓與排水責任仍須由整體襯砌系統承擔。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: nominalStrain=movement/freeLength=5 mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent. The membrane blocks seepage, while the lining system must carry pressure or provide drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較接頭位移方向、膜材自由長度及穿透處試件變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare joint movement directions, membrane free length and penetration-specimen response.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「穿透構件與接縫變形」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Penetrations and joint movement", which statement holds?
options: 短期貼得牢就代表修補材料能長期相容
膜材延伸率高就能容許任意尖突基面
原創教學假設：nominalStrain=movement/freeLength=5 mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent。
optionsEn: Strong initial adhesion proves long-term compatibility of repair materials
High membrane elongation permits a substrate with any sharp projections
Original teaching assumptions: nominalStrain=movement/freeLength=5 mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: nominalStrain=movement/freeLength=5 mm/100 mm=0.05=5 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 穿透構件與接縫變形：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Penetrations and joint movement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「穿透構件與接縫變形」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Penetrations and joint movement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較接頭位移方向、膜材自由長度及穿透處試件變形。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「固定點太靠近接縫使小位移集中成撕裂」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare joint movement directions, membrane free length and penetration-specimen response. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Fixings too close to a joint concentrate small movement into tearing. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較接頭位移方向、膜材自由長度及穿透處試件變形列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現固定點太靠近接縫使小位移集中成撕裂，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare joint movement directions, membrane free length and penetration-specimen response. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If fixings too close to a joint concentrate small movement into tearing, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：固定點太靠近接縫使小位移集中成撕裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fixings too close to a joint concentrate small movement into tearing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較接頭位移方向、膜材自由長度及穿透處試件變形。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「固定點太靠近接縫使小位移集中成撕裂」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare joint movement directions, membrane free length and penetration-specimen response. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Fixings too close to a joint concentrate small movement into tearing. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較接頭位移方向、膜材自由長度及穿透處試件變形列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現固定點太靠近接縫使小位移集中成撕裂，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare joint movement directions, membrane free length and penetration-specimen response. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If fixings too close to a joint concentrate small movement into tearing, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「穿透構件與接縫變形」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Penetrations and joint movement"?
options: 比較接頭位移方向、膜材自由長度及穿透處試件變形。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
焊縫外觀平滑就能證明全寬熔合
optionsEn: Compare joint movement directions, membrane free length and penetration-specimen response.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A smooth seam appearance proves fusion across its entire width
quiz.explanation: 比較接頭位移方向、膜材自由長度及穿透處試件變形。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare joint movement directions, membrane free length and penetration-specimen response. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 穿透構件與接縫變形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Penetrations and joint movement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「穿透構件與接縫變形」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Penetrations and joint movement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 固定點太靠近接縫使小位移集中成撕裂。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較接頭位移方向、膜材自由長度及穿透處試件變形，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Fixings too close to a joint concentrate small movement into tearing. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare joint movement directions, membrane free length and penetration-specimen response to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較接頭位移方向、膜材自由長度及穿透處試件變形；若出現固定點太靠近接縫使小位移集中成撕裂，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If fixings too close to a joint concentrate small movement into tearing, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「材料斷裂延伸率就是所有穿透細部的允許位移」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Material break elongation is the allowable movement of every penetration detail" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 固定點太靠近接縫使小位移集中成撕裂。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較接頭位移方向、膜材自由長度及穿透處試件變形，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Fixings too close to a joint concentrate small movement into tearing. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare joint movement directions, membrane free length and penetration-specimen response to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「穿透構件與接縫變形」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Penetrations and joint movement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
固定點太靠近接縫使小位移集中成撕裂。
焊接檢驗完成後就永遠不需再次查看膜面
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Fixings too close to a joint concentrate small movement into tearing.
After seam inspection the membrane surface never needs another check
quiz.explanation: 固定點太靠近接縫使小位移集中成撕裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fixings too close to a joint concentrate small movement into tearing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 隱蔽前損傷與後續工序：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pre-concealment damage and subsequent work: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「隱蔽前損傷與後續工序」如何影響隧道防水膜鋪設的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pre-concealment damage and subsequent work” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel waterproofing-membrane installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 焊縫檢驗後的膜材仍可能被鋼筋、墊塊或台車碰傷，檢查時間因而決定證據有效範圍。修補片會新增邊界與搭接，必須索引到原缺陷位置；最後隱蔽前檢查應覆蓋後續施工造成的損傷，而非重複舊報告。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將膜材照片、修補編號與最後一道交叉工序完成時間連結；若出現檢驗後被鋼筋刺穿，舊合格紀錄無法代表隱蔽時狀態，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「隱蔽前損傷與後續工序」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Membranes can be damaged by reinforcement, spacers or carriages after seam testing, so inspection timing defines evidence validity. Patches add new boundaries and overlaps and must trace back to defects. Final pre-cover inspection must address damage from subsequent work rather than merely repeat an earlier report. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Link membrane photographs and patch IDs to completion of the final crossing trade. If reinforcement punctures a previously tested membrane and invalidates its earlier passing record, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pre-concealment damage and subsequent work” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：recheckCoverage=areasAfterLastTrade/totalAreas=18/20=90 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: recheckCoverage=areasAfterLastTrade/totalAreas=18/20=90 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「焊接檢驗完成後就永遠不需再次查看膜面」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "After seam inspection the membrane surface never needs another check" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「隱蔽前損傷與後續工序」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pre-concealment damage and subsequent work”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 隱蔽前損傷與後續工序
knowledge.text: 焊縫檢驗後的膜材仍可能被鋼筋、墊塊或台車碰傷，檢查時間因而決定證據有效範圍。修補片會新增邊界與搭接，必須索引到原缺陷位置；最後隱蔽前檢查應覆蓋後續施工造成的損傷，而非重複舊報告。
knowledge.textEn: Membranes can be damaged by reinforcement, spacers or carriages after seam testing, so inspection timing defines evidence validity. Patches add new boundaries and overlaps and must trace back to defects.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: After seam inspection the membrane surface never needs another check Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「隱蔽前損傷與後續工序」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pre-concealment damage and subsequent work" is correct?
options: 焊接檢驗完成後就永遠不需再次查看膜面
內表面漏水位置一定就是膜材破損的位置
焊縫檢驗後的膜材仍可能被鋼筋、墊塊或台車碰傷，檢查時間因而決定證據有效範圍。
optionsEn: After seam inspection the membrane surface never needs another check
An interior leak always marks the exact location of membrane damage
Membranes can be damaged by reinforcement, spacers or carriages after seam testing, so inspection timing defines evidence validity.
quiz.explanation: 焊縫檢驗後的膜材仍可能被鋼筋、墊塊或台車碰傷，檢查時間因而決定證據有效範圍。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 隱蔽前損傷與後續工序：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pre-concealment damage and subsequent work: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隱蔽前損傷與後續工序」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pre-concealment damage and subsequent work” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將膜材照片、修補編號與最後一道交叉工序完成時間連結。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「檢驗後被鋼筋刺穿，舊合格紀錄無法代表隱蔽時狀態」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Link membrane photographs and patch IDs to completion of the final crossing trade. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將膜材照片、修補編號與最後一道交叉工序完成時間連結列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現檢驗後被鋼筋刺穿，舊合格紀錄無法代表隱蔽時狀態，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Link membrane photographs and patch IDs to completion of the final crossing trade. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If reinforcement punctures a previously tested membrane and invalidates its earlier passing record, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：檢驗後被鋼筋刺穿，舊合格紀錄無法代表隱蔽時狀態。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reinforcement punctures a previously tested membrane and invalidates its earlier passing record. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「隱蔽前損傷與後續工序」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.

quiz.explanationEn: Link membrane photographs and patch IDs to completion of the final crossing trade. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 隱蔽前損傷與後續工序：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pre-concealment damage and subsequent work: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隱蔽前損傷與後續工序」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pre-concealment damage and subsequent work” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 檢驗後被鋼筋刺穿，舊合格紀錄無法代表隱蔽時狀態。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將膜材照片、修補編號與最後一道交叉工序完成時間連結，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reinforcement punctures a previously tested membrane and invalidates its earlier passing record. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to link membrane photographs and patch IDs to completion of the final crossing trade to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將膜材照片、修補編號與最後一道交叉工序完成時間連結；若出現檢驗後被鋼筋刺穿，舊合格紀錄無法代表隱蔽時狀態，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If reinforcement punctures a previously tested membrane and invalidates its earlier passing record, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「焊接檢驗完成後就永遠不需再次查看膜面」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "After seam inspection the membrane surface never needs another check" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 檢驗後被鋼筋刺穿，舊合格紀錄無法代表隱蔽時狀態。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將膜材照片、修補編號與最後一道交叉工序完成時間連結，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「隱蔽前損傷與後續工序」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pre-concealment damage and subsequent work" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

內表面漏水位置一定就是膜材破損的位置
檢驗後被鋼筋刺穿，舊合格紀錄無法代表隱蔽時狀態。

An interior leak always marks the exact location of membrane damage
Reinforcement punctures a previously tested membrane and invalidates its earlier passing record.

quiz.explanationEn: Reinforcement punctures a previously tested membrane and invalidates its earlier passing record. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.instructionEn: The interior discharge location need not coincide with membrane damage because water migrates behind layers and through joints or cavities. Sealing an outlet redirects paths and may raise local pressure. Combine compartment maps, flow and timing to distinguish new damage, connectivity and blocked drains. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Map discharge, compartment-port responses and groundwater changes together. If a sealed outlet moves to a neighbouring area while the original membrane defect remains, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Leak localization and surface symptoms” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 漏水定位與表面假象：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 出口被封後轉移到鄰區，原來的膜破損仍未修復。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將出水位置、分區端口反應與水位變化共同繪圖，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A sealed outlet moves to a neighbouring area while the original membrane defect remains. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to map discharge, compartment-port responses and groundwater changes together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將出水位置、分區端口反應與水位變化共同繪圖；若出現出口被封後轉移到鄰區，原來的膜破損仍未修復，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「內表面漏水位置一定就是膜材破損的位置」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An interior leak always marks the exact location of membrane damage" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：recordCompleteness=linkedRolls/installedRolls=48/50=96 percent。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: recordCompleteness=linkedRolls/installedRolls=48/50=96 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 耐久相容與維護交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Durability compatibility and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「耐久相容與維護交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Durability compatibility and handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對材料批次、相容性證據、分區圖與修補履歷。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「失去材料身分後採不相容修補，造成界面劣化和再漏」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit batches, compatibility evidence, compartment maps and patch histories. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Lost material identity leads to incompatible repair, interface degradation and renewed leakage. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對材料批次、相容性證據、分區圖與修補履歷列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現失去材料身分後採不相容修補，造成界面劣化和再漏，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Audit batches, compatibility evidence, compartment maps and patch histories. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If lost material identity leads to incompatible repair, interface degradation and renewed leakage, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：失去材料身分後採不相容修補，造成界面劣化和再漏。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Lost material identity leads to incompatible repair, interface degradation and renewed leakage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對材料批次、相容性證據、分區圖與修補履歷。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「失去材料身分後採不相容修補，造成界面劣化和再漏」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Audit batches, compatibility evidence, compartment maps and patch histories. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Lost material identity leads to incompatible repair, interface degradation and renewed leakage. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將核對材料批次、相容性證據、分區圖與修補履歷列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現失去材料身分後採不相容修補，造成界面劣化和再漏，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Audit batches, compatibility evidence, compartment maps and patch histories. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If lost material identity leads to incompatible repair, interface degradation and renewed leakage, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「耐久相容與維護交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Durability compatibility and handover"?
options: 核對材料批次、相容性證據、分區圖與修補履歷。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
材料斷裂延伸率就是所有穿透細部的允許位移
optionsEn: Audit batches, compatibility evidence, compartment maps and patch histories.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Material break elongation is the allowable movement of every penetration detail
quiz.explanation: 核對材料批次、相容性證據、分區圖與修補履歷。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit batches, compatibility evidence, compartment maps and patch histories. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 耐久相容與維護交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Durability compatibility and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「耐久相容與維護交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Durability compatibility and handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 失去材料身分後採不相容修補，造成界面劣化和再漏。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對材料批次、相容性證據、分區圖與修補履歷，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Lost material identity leads to incompatible repair, interface degradation and renewed leakage. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit batches, compatibility evidence, compartment maps and patch histories to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對材料批次、相容性證據、分區圖與修補履歷；若出現失去材料身分後採不相容修補，造成界面劣化和再漏，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If lost material identity leads to incompatible repair, interface degradation and renewed leakage, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「短期貼得牢就代表修補材料能長期相容」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Strong initial adhesion proves long-term compatibility of repair materials" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 失去材料身分後採不相容修補，造成界面劣化和再漏。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對材料批次、相容性證據、分區圖與修補履歷，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Lost material identity leads to incompatible repair, interface degradation and renewed leakage. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit batches, compatibility evidence, compartment maps and patch histories to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「耐久相容與維護交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Durability compatibility and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
失去材料身分後採不相容修補，造成界面劣化和再漏。
只要有防水膜地下水壓就不會作用在襯砌
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Lost material identity leads to incompatible repair, interface degradation and renewed leakage.
A waterproof membrane prevents groundwater pressure from acting on the lining
quiz.explanation: 失去材料身分後採不相容修補，造成界面劣化和再漏。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Lost material identity leads to incompatible repair, interface degradation and renewed leakage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 隧道二次襯砌台車施工
titleEn: Tunnel secondary lining with formwork carriages
summary: 本課以協調台車定位、新拌混凝土壓力與襯砌成形證據為主線，從淨空與襯砌厚度與新拌混凝土側壓建立系統邊界，再把不對稱壓力與上浮、早齡拆模與支承轉換連到台車循環與品質追溯。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on coordinate carriage position, fresh-concrete pressure and lining geometry evidence. It begins with Clearance and lining thickness and Fresh-concrete lateral pressure, links Asymmetric pressure and uplift and Early stripping and support transfer, and ends with Carriage cycles and quality traceability. The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查淨空與襯砌厚度：thickness=outerRadius-innerRadius=5.30 m-5.00 m=0.30 m；再獨立檢查新拌混凝土側壓：p=gamma*h=24 kN/m3*3 m=72 kPa。外半徑 5.30 m 固定，台車內半徑由 5.00 增為 5.05 m，襯砌厚度由 0.30 降為 0.25 m，減少 16.7%；淨空增加會消耗結構厚度。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 將同步量測核心與表面溫度、應變及裂縫出現時刻作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Clearance and lining thickness: thickness=outerRadius-innerRadius=5.30 m-5.00 m=0.30 m. Independently check Fresh-concrete lateral pressure: p=gamma*h=24 kN/m3*3 m=72 kPa. At a fixed outer radius of 5.30 m, increasing form radius from 5.00 to 5.05 m reduces thickness from 0.30 to 0.25 m, by 16.7%; increased clearance consumes structural thickness. The two results are not a complete design because the carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. Use synchronize core and surface temperatures, strain and crack-onset times as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「淨空與襯砌厚度」與「新拌混凝土側壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Clearance and lining thickness" and "Fresh-concrete lateral pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 淨空與襯砌厚度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Clearance and lining thickness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「淨空與襯砌厚度」如何影響隧道二次襯砌台車施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Clearance and lining thickness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel secondary lining with formwork carriages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 台車定位同時決定內表面淨空與可用混凝土厚度，向外調整並非只有好處。初支輪廓不規則時，平均半徑合格仍可能局部不足；定位需把軌道基準、台車形狀與初支點雲配準，辨認真正最薄區而非只測拱頂高度。 判別這個機制時，應觀察把初支與模板點雲對齊到同一控制網並搜尋最小間距；若出現台車偏心增加一側淨空卻壓縮另一側結構厚度，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「淨空與襯砌厚度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Carriage positioning sets both clearance and available concrete thickness, so moving outward is not purely beneficial. An irregular initial lining can leave thin zones despite a correct mean radius. Register track control, form geometry and initial-lining clouds to identify local minima rather than crown height alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Register support and form clouds to one network and locate minimum separation. If carriage eccentricity increases clearance on one side while consuming thickness on the other, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Clearance and lining thickness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：thickness=outerRadius-innerRadius=5.30 m-5.00 m=0.30 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: thickness=outerRadius-innerRadius=5.30 m-5.00 m=0.30 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「內部淨空越大就表示襯砌品質越好」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Greater interior clearance always means better lining quality" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「淨空與襯砌厚度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Clearance and lining thickness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 淨空與襯砌厚度
knowledge.text: 台車定位同時決定內表面淨空與可用混凝土厚度，向外調整並非只有好處。初支輪廓不規則時，平均半徑合格仍可能局部不足；定位需把軌道基準、台車形狀與初支點雲配準，辨認真正最薄區而非只測拱頂高度。
knowledge.textEn: Carriage positioning sets both clearance and available concrete thickness, so moving outward is not purely beneficial. An irregular initial lining can leave thin zones despite a correct mean radius.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：內部淨空越大就表示襯砌品質越好 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Greater interior clearance always means better lining quality Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「淨空與襯砌厚度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Clearance and lining thickness" is correct?
options: 內部淨空越大就表示襯砌品質越好
台車定位同時決定內表面淨空與可用混凝土厚度，向外調整並非只有好處。
混凝土強度高就代表施工側壓一定比較小
optionsEn: Greater interior clearance always means better lining quality
Carriage positioning sets both clearance and available concrete thickness, so moving outward is not purely beneficial.
High concrete strength guarantees lower pressure during placement
quiz.explanation: 台車定位同時決定內表面淨空與可用混凝土厚度，向外調整並非只有好處。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Carriage positioning sets both clearance and available concrete thickness, so moving outward is not purely beneficial. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 淨空與襯砌厚度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Clearance and lining thickness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「淨空與襯砌厚度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Clearance and lining thickness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：thickness=outerRadius-innerRadius=5.30 m-5.00 m=0.30 m。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: thickness=outerRadius-innerRadius=5.30 m-5.00 m=0.30 m. The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把初支與模板點雲對齊到同一控制網並搜尋最小間距。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Register support and form clouds to one network and locate minimum separation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

steps.instruction: 量測模板壓力並對照混凝土溫度、齡期及填充高度。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「誤用已凝結假設低估側壓，模板鼓脹造成輪廓失真」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare form pressures with concrete temperature, age and fill height. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An assumed set state understates pressure and allows forms to bulge out of profile. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將量測模板壓力並對照混凝土溫度、齡期及填充高度列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現誤用已凝結假設低估側壓，模板鼓脹造成輪廓失真，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare form pressures with concrete temperature, age and fill height. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an assumed set state understates pressure and allows forms to bulge out of profile, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：誤用已凝結假設低估側壓，模板鼓脹造成輪廓失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An assumed set state understates pressure and allows forms to bulge out of profile. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「新拌混凝土側壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fresh-concrete lateral pressure"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare form pressures with concrete temperature, age and fill height.
A flush surface joint guarantees the internal waterstop is correctly located
quiz.explanation: 量測模板壓力並對照混凝土溫度、齡期及填充高度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare form pressures with concrete temperature, age and fill height. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 新拌混凝土側壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fresh-concrete lateral pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「新拌混凝土側壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fresh-concrete lateral pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 誤用已凝結假設低估側壓，模板鼓脹造成輪廓失真。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到量測模板壓力並對照混凝土溫度、齡期及填充高度，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An assumed set state understates pressure and allows forms to bulge out of profile. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare form pressures with concrete temperature, age and fill height to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察量測模板壓力並對照混凝土溫度、齡期及填充高度；若出現誤用已凝結假設低估側壓，模板鼓脹造成輪廓失真，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If an assumed set state understates pressure and allows forms to bulge out of profile, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土強度高就代表施工側壓一定比較小」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High concrete strength guarantees lower pressure during placement" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 誤用已凝結假設低估側壓，模板鼓脹造成輪廓失真。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到量測模板壓力並對照混凝土溫度、齡期及填充高度，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: An assumed set state understates pressure and allows forms to bulge out of profile. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare form pressures with concrete temperature, age and fill height to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「新拌混凝土側壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fresh-concrete lateral pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
模板厚度一致就能保證每一位置撓度一致
誤用已凝結假設低估側壓，模板鼓脹造成輪廓失真。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Uniform form thickness guarantees uniform deflection at every position
An assumed set state understates pressure and allows forms to bulge out of profile.
quiz.explanation: 誤用已凝結假設低估側壓，模板鼓脹造成輪廓失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An assumed set state understates pressure and allows forms to bulge out of profile. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「面板跨距與撓度」與「支架反力與地基承壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Panel span and deflection" and "Frame reactions and foundation bearing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 面板跨距與撓度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Panel span and deflection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「面板跨距與撓度」如何影響隧道二次襯砌台車施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Panel span and deflection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel secondary lining with formwork carriages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 面板在肋材間彎曲，支承間距對變形極敏感；相同均布線荷載作用於較大未支承跨距，會增加局部鼓出。簡支條帶的跨度四次方關係須保持線荷載 q、EI 與支承條件不變；固定總力不是同一假設。實際板還有雙向剛度與接頭，不能只靠平均模板厚度判斷。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較肋距、面板中心位移與接縫兩側的高差；若出現局部缺肋讓面板撓度增加，形成難以修正的襯砌凹凸，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「面板跨距與撓度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Panels bend between ribs and are highly sensitive to support spacing. The same uniform line load over a longer unsupported span increases bulging. Fourth-power span scaling requires unchanged line load q, EI and support conditions; fixed total force is a different assumption. Actual panels add two-way action and joints beyond mean plate thickness. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare rib spacing, panel-centre displacement and steps across seams. If a missing rib increases local deflection and creates permanent lining irregularity, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Panel span and deflection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：deflectionRatio=(newSpan/oldSpan)^4=(1.1/1.0)^4=1.4641 for unchanged uniform line load q, EI and simple-support conditions。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: deflectionRatio=(newSpan/oldSpan)^4=(1.1/1.0)^4=1.4641 for unchanged uniform line load q, EI and simple-support conditions.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模板厚度一致就能保證每一位置撓度一致」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uniform form thickness guarantees uniform deflection at every position" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「面板跨距與撓度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Panel span and deflection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 面板跨距與撓度
knowledge.text: 面板在肋材間彎曲，支承間距對變形極敏感；相同均布線荷載作用於較大未支承跨距，會增加局部鼓出。簡支條帶的跨度四次方關係須保持線荷載 q、EI 與支承條件不變；固定總力不是同一假設。
knowledge.textEn: Panels bend between ribs and are highly sensitive to support spacing. The same uniform line load over a longer unsupported span increases bulging.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模板厚度一致就能保證每一位置撓度一致 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Uniform form thickness guarantees uniform deflection at every position Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「面板跨距與撓度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Panel span and deflection" is correct?
options: 面板在肋材間彎曲，支承間距對變形極敏感；相同均布線荷載作用於較大未支承跨距，會增加局部鼓出。
模板厚度一致就能保證每一位置撓度一致
總重量除以支腳數就能得到每腳實際反力
optionsEn: Panels bend between ribs and are highly sensitive to support spacing.
Uniform form thickness guarantees uniform deflection at every position
Total weight divided by foot count gives each actual reaction
quiz.explanation: 面板在肋材間彎曲，支承間距對變形極敏感；相同均布線荷載作用於較大未支承跨距，會增加局部鼓出。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Panels bend between ribs and are highly sensitive to support spacing. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 面板跨距與撓度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Panel span and deflection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「面板跨距與撓度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Panel span and deflection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：deflectionRatio=(newSpan/oldSpan)^4=(1.1/1.0)^4=1.4641 for unchanged uniform line load q, EI and simple-support conditions。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: deflectionRatio=(newSpan/oldSpan)^4=(1.1/1.0)^4=1.4641 for unchanged uniform line load q, EI and simple-support conditions. The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較肋距、面板中心位移與接縫兩側的高差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare rib spacing, panel-centre displacement and steps across seams.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：deflectionRatio=(newSpan/oldSpan)^4=(1.1/1.0)^4=1.4641 for unchanged uniform line load q, EI and simple-support conditions。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.instructionEn: A missing rib increases local deflection and creates permanent lining irregularity. steps.instruction: 模板荷載經支架傳到支腳或軌道，偏心填充可能讓某些支腳先受力或局部抬起。總重量平均分配只適用理想對稱，基底柔度會重新分配反力；檢查應同時包含支架力、接觸狀態及基準沉陷。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將支腳荷重、底板接觸與軌道水準同步比較；若出現一支腳沉陷讓相鄰支架超載，台車整體產生扭曲，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支架反力與地基承壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Form loads reach feet or rails through the frame, while asymmetric filling can load some feet first or lift others. Equal distribution assumes symmetry; foundation compliance redistributes reactions. Verify frame forces, contact status and datum settlement together rather than total weight alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare foot loads, bearing contact and rail levels on a common time base. If one settling foot overloads neighbouring supports and twists the carriage, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Frame reactions and foundation bearing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：bearingPressure=footReaction/area=360 kN/0.60 m2=600 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: bearingPressure=footReaction/area=360 kN/0.60 m2=600 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總重量除以支腳數就能得到每腳實際反力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total weight divided by foot count gives each actual reaction" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支架反力與地基承壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.text: 將將支腳荷重、底板接觸與軌道水準同步比較列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現一支腳沉陷讓相鄰支架超載，台車整體產生扭曲，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare foot loads, bearing contact and rail levels on a common time base. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If one settling foot overloads neighbouring supports and twists the carriage, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支架反力與地基承壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Frame reactions and foundation bearing"?
options: 將支腳荷重、底板接觸與軌道水準同步比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
內部淨空越大就表示襯砌品質越好
optionsEn: Compare foot loads, bearing contact and rail levels on a common time base.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Greater interior clearance always means better lining quality
quiz.explanation: 將支腳荷重、底板接觸與軌道水準同步比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare foot loads, bearing contact and rail levels on a common time base. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支架反力與地基承壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Frame reactions and foundation bearing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支架反力與地基承壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Frame reactions and foundation bearing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一支腳沉陷讓相鄰支架超載，台車整體產生扭曲。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將支腳荷重、底板接觸與軌道水準同步比較，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One settling foot overloads neighbouring supports and twists the carriage. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare foot loads, bearing contact and rail levels on a common time base to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將支腳荷重、底板接觸與軌道水準同步比較；若出現一支腳沉陷讓相鄰支架超載，台車整體產生扭曲，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If one settling foot overloads neighbouring supports and twists the carriage, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總重量除以支腳數就能得到每腳實際反力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total weight divided by foot count gives each actual reaction" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一支腳沉陷讓相鄰支架超載，台車整體產生扭曲。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將支腳荷重、底板接觸與軌道水準同步比較，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: One settling foot overloads neighbouring supports and twists the carriage. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare foot loads, bearing contact and rail levels on a common time base to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支架反力與地基承壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Frame reactions and foundation bearing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
一支腳沉陷讓相鄰支架超載，台車整體產生扭曲。
台車很重就不可能受到混凝土壓力抬升
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
One settling foot overloads neighbouring supports and twists the carriage.
A heavy carriage cannot be lifted by concrete pressure
quiz.explanation: 一支腳沉陷讓相鄰支架超載，台車整體產生扭曲。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One settling foot overloads neighbouring supports and twists the carriage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「不對稱壓力與上浮」與「拱頂填充與空洞」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Asymmetric pressure and uplift" and "Crown filling and voids": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 不對稱壓力與上浮：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Asymmetric pressure and uplift: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「不對稱壓力與上浮」如何影響隧道二次襯砌台車施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asymmetric pressure and uplift” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel secondary lining with formwork carriages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 混凝土壓力作用在模板不同方向，垂直分量可能產生上浮，水平不平衡則推動台車。只核對自重不能證明穩定，約束位置與反力容量必須配合實際載入階段；局部脫離支腳後，原先線性分配也會改變。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較台車垂直位移、支腳接觸和約束荷重歷程；若出現壓力不平衡抬起一側，使模板接縫張開與漏漿，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「不對稱壓力與上浮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure acts in different directions, generating uplift or lateral imbalance. Self-weight alone does not establish stability; restraint positions and reactions must match the stage. Once a foot separates, the assumed linear distribution changes and requires a revised contact model. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare vertical carriage motion, foot contact and restraint-force histories. If unbalanced pressure lifts one side, opening form joints and releasing grout, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asymmetric pressure and uplift” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：uplift=p*A=80 kPa*8 m2=640 kN for an assumed projected area。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: uplift=p*A=80 kPa*8 m2=640 kN for an assumed projected area.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「台車很重就不可能受到混凝土壓力抬升」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A heavy carriage cannot be lifted by concrete pressure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「不對稱壓力與上浮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asymmetric pressure and uplift”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 不對稱壓力與上浮
knowledge.text: 混凝土壓力作用在模板不同方向，垂直分量可能產生上浮，水平不平衡則推動台車。只核對自重不能證明穩定，約束位置與反力容量必須配合實際載入階段；局部脫離支腳後，原先線性分配也會改變。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure acts in different directions, generating uplift or lateral imbalance. Self-weight alone does not establish stability; restraint positions and reactions must match the stage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：台車很重就不可能受到混凝土壓力抬升 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A heavy carriage cannot be lifted by concrete pressure Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「不對稱壓力與上浮」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Asymmetric pressure and uplift" is correct?
options: 台車很重就不可能受到混凝土壓力抬升
混凝土總用量達到理論值就證明沒有空洞
混凝土壓力作用在模板不同方向，垂直分量可能產生上浮，水平不平衡則推動台車。
optionsEn: A heavy carriage cannot be lifted by concrete pressure
Delivered concrete equal to theoretical volume proves there are no voids
Pressure acts in different directions, generating uplift or lateral imbalance.
quiz.explanation: 混凝土壓力作用在模板不同方向，垂直分量可能產生上浮，水平不平衡則推動台車。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure acts in different directions, generating uplift or lateral imbalance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 不對稱壓力與上浮：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asymmetric pressure and uplift: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「不對稱壓力與上浮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asymmetric pressure and uplift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：uplift=p*A=80 kPa*8 m2=640 kN for an assumed projected area。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: uplift=p*A=80 kPa*8 m2=640 kN for an assumed projected area. The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較台車垂直位移、支腳接觸和約束荷重歷程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare vertical carriage motion, foot contact and restraint-force histories.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：uplift=p*A=80 kPa*8 m2=640 kN for an assumed projected area。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「不對稱壓力與上浮」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Asymmetric pressure and uplift", which statement holds?

Thermal cracking cannot occur once concrete stops heating
Factory-approved carriages never need positioning checks during later cycles

steps.title: 不對稱壓力與上浮：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「不對稱壓力與上浮」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asymmetric pressure and uplift” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較台車垂直位移、支腳接觸和約束荷重歷程。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「壓力不平衡抬起一側，使模板接縫張開與漏漿」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare vertical carriage motion, foot contact and restraint-force histories. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare vertical carriage motion, foot contact and restraint-force histories. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If unbalanced pressure lifts one side, opening form joints and releasing grout, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：壓力不平衡抬起一側，使模板接縫張開與漏漿。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unbalanced pressure lifts one side, opening form joints and releasing grout. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Unbalanced pressure lifts one side, opening form joints and releasing grout. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「不對稱壓力與上浮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asymmetric pressure and uplift” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 壓力不平衡抬起一側，使模板接縫張開與漏漿。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較台車垂直位移、支腳接觸和約束荷重歷程，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unbalanced pressure lifts one side, opening form joints and releasing grout. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare vertical carriage motion, foot contact and restraint-force histories to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較台車垂直位移、支腳接觸和約束荷重歷程；若出現壓力不平衡抬起一側，使模板接縫張開與漏漿，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If unbalanced pressure lifts one side, opening form joints and releasing grout, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「台車很重就不可能受到混凝土壓力抬升」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A heavy carriage cannot be lifted by concrete pressure" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 壓力不平衡抬起一側，使模板接縫張開與漏漿。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較台車垂直位移、支腳接觸和約束荷重歷程，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Unbalanced pressure lifts one side, opening form joints and releasing grout. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare vertical carriage motion, foot contact and restraint-force histories to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「不對稱壓力與上浮」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asymmetric pressure and uplift" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
混凝土總用量達到理論值就證明沒有空洞
壓力不平衡抬起一側，使模板接縫張開與漏漿。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Delivered concrete equal to theoretical volume proves there are no voids
Unbalanced pressure lifts one side, opening form joints and releasing grout.
quiz.explanation: 壓力不平衡抬起一側，使模板接縫張開與漏漿。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unbalanced pressure lifts one side, opening form joints and releasing grout. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 拱頂填充與空洞：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Crown filling and voids: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拱頂填充與空洞」如何影響隧道二次襯砌台車施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crown filling and voids” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel secondary lining with formwork carriages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱頂是氣體與未填滿空間容易聚集的位置，出料量足夠不代表所有高點密實。理論體積與送入量的差也包含管路殘留、超挖和漏漿，不能直接等同空洞；應以多種證據區分幾何偏差與真正未填區。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照材料收支、拱頂檢測與可取得的孔內或雷達證據；若出現拱頂空洞削弱接觸並集中彎曲，外表平順仍可能漏判，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拱頂填充與空洞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Air and unfilled space collect at high points; adequate delivery does not prove a dense crown. Theoretical-versus-delivered volume also includes line residue, overbreak and leakage. Combine evidence to distinguish geometric differences from actual voids instead of treating the balance residual as a direct void measurement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare material balance with crown checks and available borehole or radar evidence. If a crown void weakens contact and concentrates bending despite a smooth interior, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crown filling and voids” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Inputs outerRadius=5.30 m, innerRadius=5.00 m, length=10 m; fullRingVolume=pi*(5.30^2-5.00^2)*10=97.08 m3, idealized full circular ring。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs outerRadius=5.30 m, innerRadius=5.00 m, length=10 m; fullRingVolume=pi*(5.30^2-5.00^2)*10=97.08 m3, idealized full circular ring.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土總用量達到理論值就證明沒有空洞」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Delivered concrete equal to theoretical volume proves there are no voids" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拱頂填充與空洞」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Crown filling and voids”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拱頂填充與空洞
knowledge.text: 拱頂是氣體與未填滿空間容易聚集的位置，出料量足夠不代表所有高點密實。理論體積與送入量的差也包含管路殘留、超挖和漏漿，不能直接等同空洞；應以多種證據區分幾何偏差與真正未填區。
knowledge.textEn: Air and unfilled space collect at high points; adequate delivery does not prove a dense crown. Theoretical-versus-delivered volume also includes line residue, overbreak and leakage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土總用量達到理論值就證明沒有空洞 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Delivered concrete equal to theoretical volume proves there are no voids Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「拱頂填充與空洞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

早齡抗壓比值低就能取代所有拆模階段檢核

Delivered concrete equal to theoretical volume proves there are no voids
A low early compression ratio replaces every stripping-stage check

steps.title: 拱頂填充與空洞：定量估算
