steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crown filling and voids” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Inputs outerRadius=5.30 m, innerRadius=5.00 m, length=10 m; fullRingVolume=pi*(5.30^2-5.00^2)*10=97.08 m3, idealized full circular ring。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs outerRadius=5.30 m, innerRadius=5.00 m, length=10 m; fullRingVolume=pi*(5.30^2-5.00^2)*10=97.08 m3, idealized full circular ring. The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照材料收支、拱頂檢測與可取得的孔內或雷達證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare material balance with crown checks and available borehole or radar evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Inputs outerRadius=5.30 m, innerRadius=5.00 m, length=10 m; fullRingVolume=pi*(5.30^2-5.00^2)*10=97.08 m3, idealized full circular ring。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs outerRadius=5.30 m, innerRadius=5.00 m, length=10 m; fullRingVolume=pi*(5.30^2-5.00^2)*10=97.08 m3, idealized full circular ring. The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

內部淨空越大就表示襯砌品質越好

steps.title: 拱頂填充與空洞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crown filling and voids: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拱頂填充與空洞」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crown filling and voids” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照材料收支、拱頂檢測與可取得的孔內或雷達證據。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「拱頂空洞削弱接觸並集中彎曲，外表平順仍可能漏判」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare material balance with crown checks and available borehole or radar evidence. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A crown void weakens contact and concentrates bending despite a smooth interior. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare material balance with crown checks and available borehole or radar evidence. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a crown void weakens contact and concentrates bending despite a smooth interior, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：拱頂空洞削弱接觸並集中彎曲，外表平順仍可能漏判。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a crown void weakens contact and concentrates bending despite a smooth interior, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土總用量達到理論值就證明沒有空洞」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Delivered concrete equal to theoretical volume proves there are no voids" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 拱頂空洞削弱接觸並集中彎曲，外表平順仍可能漏判。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照材料收支、拱頂檢測與可取得的孔內或雷達證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A crown void weakens contact and concentrates bending despite a smooth interior. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare material balance with crown checks and available borehole or radar evidence to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「拱頂填充與空洞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Crown filling and voids" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 拱頂空洞削弱接觸並集中彎曲，外表平順仍可能漏判。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
早齡抗壓比值低就能取代所有拆模階段檢核
optionsEn: A crown void weakens contact and concentrates bending despite a smooth interior.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A low early compression ratio replaces every stripping-stage check
quiz.explanation: 拱頂空洞削弱接觸並集中彎曲，外表平順仍可能漏判。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A crown void weakens contact and concentrates bending despite a smooth interior. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「早齡拆模與支承轉換」與「溫度收縮與約束裂縫」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Early stripping and support transfer" and "Thermal contraction and restrained cracking": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 早齡拆模與支承轉換：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Early stripping and support transfer: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「早齡拆模與支承轉換」如何影響隧道二次襯砌台車施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Early stripping and support transfer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel secondary lining with formwork carriages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拆模把混凝土自重及外力轉交給尚在硬化的襯砌，試件強度要能代表現地齡期與溫度。強度之外還有模數、裂縫及接觸條件，單一抗壓值不能證明整環穩定；支承轉換應明確納入施工階段模型。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將原位成熟度、可比試件及拆模後裂縫觀察配對；若出現暖室試件高估現地強度，支承撤除後形成早齡裂紋，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「早齡拆模與支承轉換」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stripping transfers self-weight and external actions to hardening lining, so specimens must represent in-place age and temperature. Modulus, cracks and contact matter as well as compression strength. One strength value cannot establish ring stability; model the support transition explicitly. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Pair in-place maturity and representative specimens with post-stripping crack observations. If warm specimens overstate field strength and early cracks form after support removal, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Early stripping and support transfer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：stressRatio=assumedDemand/earlyStrength=1.5 MPa/6 MPa=0.25。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: stressRatio=assumedDemand/earlyStrength=1.5 MPa/6 MPa=0.25.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「早齡抗壓比值低就能取代所有拆模階段檢核」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A low early compression ratio replaces every stripping-stage check" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「早齡拆模與支承轉換」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Early stripping and support transfer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 早齡拆模與支承轉換
knowledge.text: 拆模把混凝土自重及外力轉交給尚在硬化的襯砌，試件強度要能代表現地齡期與溫度。強度之外還有模數、裂縫及接觸條件，單一抗壓值不能證明整環穩定；支承轉換應明確納入施工階段模型。
knowledge.textEn: Stripping transfers self-weight and external actions to hardening lining, so specimens must represent in-place age and temperature. Modulus, cracks and contact matter as well as compression strength.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：早齡抗壓比值低就能取代所有拆模階段檢核 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A low early compression ratio replaces every stripping-stage check Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「早齡拆模與支承轉換」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Early stripping and support transfer" is correct?
options: 早齡抗壓比值低就能取代所有拆模階段檢核
拆模把混凝土自重及外力轉交給尚在硬化的襯砌，試件強度要能代表現地齡期與溫度。
混凝土不再升溫後就不會發生溫度裂縫
optionsEn: A low early compression ratio replaces every stripping-stage check
Stripping transfers self-weight and external actions to hardening lining, so specimens must represent in-place age and temperature.
Thermal cracking cannot occur once concrete stops heating
quiz.explanation: 拆模把混凝土自重及外力轉交給尚在硬化的襯砌，試件強度要能代表現地齡期與溫度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stripping transfers self-weight and external actions to hardening lining, so specimens must represent in-place age and temperature. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 早齡拆模與支承轉換：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Early stripping and support transfer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「早齡拆模與支承轉換」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Early stripping and support transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：stressRatio=assumedDemand/earlyStrength=1.5 MPa/6 MPa=0.25。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: stressRatio=assumedDemand/earlyStrength=1.5 MPa/6 MPa=0.25. The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將原位成熟度、可比試件及拆模後裂縫觀察配對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair in-place maturity and representative specimens with post-stripping crack observations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：stressRatio=assumedDemand/earlyStrength=1.5 MPa/6 MPa=0.25。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: stressRatio=assumedDemand/earlyStrength=1.5 MPa/6 MPa=0.25. The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「早齡拆模與支承轉換」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Early stripping and support transfer", which statement holds?
options: 台車出廠合格就不需要每循環重新定位檢查
混凝土強度高就代表施工側壓一定比較小
原創教學假設：stressRatio=assumedDemand/earlyStrength=1.5 MPa/6 MPa=0.25。
optionsEn: Factory-approved carriages never need positioning checks during later cycles
High concrete strength guarantees lower pressure during placement

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: stressRatio=assumedDemand/earlyStrength=1.5 MPa/6 MPa=0.25. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 早齡拆模與支承轉換：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Early stripping and support transfer: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「早齡拆模與支承轉換」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Early stripping and support transfer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將原位成熟度、可比試件及拆模後裂縫觀察配對。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「暖室試件高估現地強度，支承撤除後形成早齡裂紋」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair in-place maturity and representative specimens with post-stripping crack observations. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Warm specimens overstate field strength and early cracks form after support removal. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將原位成熟度、可比試件及拆模後裂縫觀察配對列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現暖室試件高估現地強度，支承撤除後形成早齡裂紋，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Pair in-place maturity and representative specimens with post-stripping crack observations. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If warm specimens overstate field strength and early cracks form after support removal, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：暖室試件高估現地強度，支承撤除後形成早齡裂紋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Warm specimens overstate field strength and early cracks form after support removal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to pair in-place maturity and representative specimens with post-stripping crack observations to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「早齡拆模與支承轉換」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Warm specimens overstate field strength and early cracks form after support removal.
Thermal cracking cannot occur once concrete stops heating
quiz.explanation: 暖室試件高估現地強度，支承撤除後形成早齡裂紋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Warm specimens overstate field strength and early cracks form after support removal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 溫度收縮與約束裂縫：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal contraction and restrained cracking: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「溫度收縮與約束裂縫」如何影響隧道二次襯砌台車施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal contraction and restrained cracking” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel secondary lining with formwork carriages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水化升溫後的降溫使襯砌收縮，初支、底部或相鄰段可能限制其自由變形。完全約束公式只是一個上限模型，徐變與接觸滑移會降低應力；監測需把溫度梯度與整體降溫分開，避免將所有裂縫都歸因於強度不足。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步量測核心與表面溫度、應變及裂縫出現時刻；若出現只看最高溫度漏掉降溫約束，延後才發現貫通裂縫，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溫度收縮與約束裂縫」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cooling after hydration contracts lining against restraint from initial support, the base or adjacent pours. Full restraint is an upper-bound model reduced by creep and slip. Separate thermal gradients from bulk cooling instead of attributing every crack to low strength. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Synchronize core and surface temperatures, strain and crack-onset times. If peak-temperature checks miss cooling restraint and through-cracks are discovered late, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal contraction and restrained cracking” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：freeStrain=alpha*dT=1e-5/K*20 K=0.0002; fullRestraintStress=20 GPa*0.0002=4 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: freeStrain=alpha*dT=1e-5/K*20 K=0.0002; fullRestraintStress=20 GPa*0.0002=4 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土不再升溫後就不會發生溫度裂縫」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thermal cracking cannot occur once concrete stops heating" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「溫度收縮與約束裂縫」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 溫度收縮與約束裂縫：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal contraction and restrained cracking” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：freeStrain=alpha*dT=1e-5/K*20 K=0.0002; fullRestraintStress=20 GPa*0.0002=4 MPa。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: freeStrain=alpha*dT=1e-5/K*20 K=0.0002; fullRestraintStress=20 GPa*0.0002=4 MPa. The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測核心與表面溫度、應變及裂縫出現時刻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize core and surface temperatures, strain and crack-onset times.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 溫度收縮與約束裂縫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal contraction and restrained cracking: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「溫度收縮與約束裂縫」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal contraction and restrained cracking” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測核心與表面溫度、應變及裂縫出現時刻。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只看最高溫度漏掉降溫約束，延後才發現貫通裂縫」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize core and surface temperatures, strain and crack-onset times. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Peak-temperature checks miss cooling restraint and through-cracks are discovered late. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同步量測核心與表面溫度、應變及裂縫出現時刻列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只看最高溫度漏掉降溫約束，延後才發現貫通裂縫，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Synchronize core and surface temperatures, strain and crack-onset times. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If peak-temperature checks miss cooling restraint and through-cracks are discovered late, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看最高溫度漏掉降溫約束，延後才發現貫通裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Peak-temperature checks miss cooling restraint and through-cracks are discovered late. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

steps.title: 溫度收縮與約束裂縫：失效診斷

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.explanationEn: Peak-temperature checks miss cooling restraint and through-cracks are discovered late. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「施工縫對接與止水連續」與「台車循環與品質追溯」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Construction joints and waterstop continuity" and "Carriage cycles and quality traceability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 施工縫對接與止水連續：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Construction joints and waterstop continuity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工縫對接與止水連續」如何影響隧道二次襯砌台車施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Construction joints and waterstop continuity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel secondary lining with formwork carriages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 台車循環形成分段施工縫，接縫需要在幾何、剪力與止水三方面連續。止水帶偏位可能在澆置後被完全遮蔽，外表縫線整齊也無法證明埋入長度；前後兩段資料應共同索引到同一接縫編號。 判別這個機制時，應觀察檢查止水帶位置、固定狀態及兩段施工前後影像；若出現止水帶偏折形成漏水捷徑，表面接縫看不出缺陷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工縫對接與止水連續」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Carriage cycles create joints requiring geometric, shear and hydraulic continuity. A displaced waterstop becomes concealed after casting, and a neat visible line does not establish embedment. Index records from both adjacent pours to the same joint identifier. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check waterstop position, restraint and images before and after both pours. If a folded waterstop creates a leakage shortcut invisible at the surface joint, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Construction joints and waterstop continuity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：embedmentImbalance=left-right=110 mm-70 mm=40 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: embedmentImbalance=left-right=110 mm-70 mm=40 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接縫外表平整就能保證內部止水帶位置正確」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A flush surface joint guarantees the internal waterstop is correctly located" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「施工縫對接與止水連續」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Construction joints and waterstop continuity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工縫對接與止水連續
knowledge.text: 台車循環形成分段施工縫，接縫需要在幾何、剪力與止水三方面連續。止水帶偏位可能在澆置後被完全遮蔽，外表縫線整齊也無法證明埋入長度；前後兩段資料應共同索引到同一接縫編號。
knowledge.textEn: Carriage cycles create joints requiring geometric, shear and hydraulic continuity. A displaced waterstop becomes concealed after casting, and a neat visible line does not establish embedment.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接縫外表平整就能保證內部止水帶位置正確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A flush surface joint guarantees the internal waterstop is correctly located Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工縫對接與止水連續」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Construction joints and waterstop continuity" is correct?
options: 台車循環形成分段施工縫，接縫需要在幾何、剪力與止水三方面連續。
接縫外表平整就能保證內部止水帶位置正確
台車出廠合格就不需要每循環重新定位檢查
optionsEn: Carriage cycles create joints requiring geometric, shear and hydraulic continuity.
A flush surface joint guarantees the internal waterstop is correctly located
Factory-approved carriages never need positioning checks during later cycles
quiz.explanation: 台車循環形成分段施工縫，接縫需要在幾何、剪力與止水三方面連續。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Carriage cycles create joints requiring geometric, shear and hydraulic continuity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工縫對接與止水連續：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Construction joints and waterstop continuity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工縫對接與止水連續」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Construction joints and waterstop continuity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：embedmentImbalance=left-right=110 mm-70 mm=40 mm。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: embedmentImbalance=left-right=110 mm-70 mm=40 mm. The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查止水帶位置、固定狀態及兩段施工前後影像。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check waterstop position, restraint and images before and after both pours.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：embedmentImbalance=left-right=110 mm-70 mm=40 mm。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: embedmentImbalance=left-right=110 mm-70 mm=40 mm. The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工縫對接與止水連續」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Construction joints and waterstop continuity", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土強度高就代表施工側壓一定比較小
原創教學假設：embedmentImbalance=left-right=110 mm-70 mm=40 mm。
總重量除以支腳數就能得到每腳實際反力
optionsEn: High concrete strength guarantees lower pressure during placement
Original teaching assumptions: embedmentImbalance=left-right=110 mm-70 mm=40 mm.
Total weight divided by foot count gives each actual reaction
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：embedmentImbalance=left-right=110 mm-70 mm=40 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: embedmentImbalance=left-right=110 mm-70 mm=40 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工縫對接與止水連續：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Construction joints and waterstop continuity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工縫對接與止水連續」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Construction joints and waterstop continuity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查止水帶位置、固定狀態及兩段施工前後影像。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「止水帶偏折形成漏水捷徑，表面接縫看不出缺陷」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check waterstop position, restraint and images before and after both pours. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A folded waterstop creates a leakage shortcut invisible at the surface joint. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將檢查止水帶位置、固定狀態及兩段施工前後影像列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現止水帶偏折形成漏水捷徑，表面接縫看不出缺陷，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check waterstop position, restraint and images before and after both pours. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a folded waterstop creates a leakage shortcut invisible at the surface joint, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：止水帶偏折形成漏水捷徑，表面接縫看不出缺陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A folded waterstop creates a leakage shortcut invisible at the surface joint. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 檢查止水帶位置、固定狀態及兩段施工前後影像。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「止水帶偏折形成漏水捷徑，表面接縫看不出缺陷」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check waterstop position, restraint and images before and after both pours. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A folded waterstop creates a leakage shortcut invisible at the surface joint. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將檢查止水帶位置、固定狀態及兩段施工前後影像列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現止水帶偏折形成漏水捷徑，表面接縫看不出缺陷，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Check waterstop position, restraint and images before and after both pours. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a folded waterstop creates a leakage shortcut invisible at the surface joint, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工縫對接與止水連續」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Construction joints and waterstop continuity"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
混凝土總用量達到理論值就證明沒有空洞
檢查止水帶位置、固定狀態及兩段施工前後影像。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Delivered concrete equal to theoretical volume proves there are no voids
Check waterstop position, restraint and images before and after both pours.
quiz.explanation: 檢查止水帶位置、固定狀態及兩段施工前後影像。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check waterstop position, restraint and images before and after both pours. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工縫對接與止水連續：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Construction joints and waterstop continuity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工縫對接與止水連續」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Construction joints and waterstop continuity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 止水帶偏折形成漏水捷徑，表面接縫看不出缺陷。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到檢查止水帶位置、固定狀態及兩段施工前後影像，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A folded waterstop creates a leakage shortcut invisible at the surface joint. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check waterstop position, restraint and images before and after both pours to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察檢查止水帶位置、固定狀態及兩段施工前後影像；若出現止水帶偏折形成漏水捷徑，表面接縫看不出缺陷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a folded waterstop creates a leakage shortcut invisible at the surface joint, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接縫外表平整就能保證內部止水帶位置正確」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A flush surface joint guarantees the internal waterstop is correctly located" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 止水帶偏折形成漏水捷徑，表面接縫看不出缺陷。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到檢查止水帶位置、固定狀態及兩段施工前後影像，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A folded waterstop creates a leakage shortcut invisible at the surface joint. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check waterstop position, restraint and images before and after both pours to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工縫對接與止水連續」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Construction joints and waterstop continuity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 止水帶偏折形成漏水捷徑，表面接縫看不出缺陷。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
台車出廠合格就不需要每循環重新定位檢查
optionsEn: A folded waterstop creates a leakage shortcut invisible at the surface joint.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Factory-approved carriages never need positioning checks during later cycles
quiz.explanation: 止水帶偏折形成漏水捷徑，表面接縫看不出缺陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A folded waterstop creates a leakage shortcut invisible at the surface joint. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 台車循環與品質追溯：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Carriage cycles and quality traceability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「台車循環與品質追溯」如何影響隧道二次襯砌台車施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Carriage cycles and quality traceability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel secondary lining with formwork carriages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同一台車會重複移動、調整和受載，螺接鬆動或幾何漂移可能逐循環累積。出廠合格只描述初始設備，不代表每次定位正確；交接須把台車版本、定位檢查與各襯砌段的材料和缺陷關聯，讓系統性偏差可被辨認。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用每循環定位殘差與設備檢查紀錄分析累積偏差；若出現持續小偏位在多循環後侵入淨空，單次目視卻未察覺，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「台車循環與品質追溯」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated moves, adjustments and loads accumulate loosened connections and geometric drift. Factory acceptance describes initial equipment rather than each setup. Link carriage revisions and positioning checks to lining batches and defects so systematic errors can be recognized across cycles. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Analyze accumulated setup residuals alongside equipment inspection records. If small repeated offsets eventually encroach on clearance while individual visual checks miss them, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Carriage cycles and quality traceability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 台車循環與品質追溯：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Carriage cycles and quality traceability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「台車循環與品質追溯」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Carriage cycles and quality traceability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：driftPerCycle=totalDrift/cycles=12 mm/6=2 mm per cycle。台車是施工階段構造，完成面淨空與結構厚度必須同時檢核。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: driftPerCycle=totalDrift/cycles=12 mm/6=2 mm per cycle. The carriage is a temporary structure; final clearance and structural thickness need simultaneous checks. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用每循環定位殘差與設備檢查紀錄分析累積偏差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Analyze accumulated setup residuals alongside equipment inspection records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 台車循環與品質追溯：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Carriage cycles and quality traceability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「台車循環與品質追溯」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Carriage cycles and quality traceability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用每循環定位殘差與設備檢查紀錄分析累積偏差。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「持續小偏位在多循環後侵入淨空，單次目視卻未察覺」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Analyze accumulated setup residuals alongside equipment inspection records. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Small repeated offsets eventually encroach on clearance while individual visual checks miss them. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將用每循環定位殘差與設備檢查紀錄分析累積偏差列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現持續小偏位在多循環後侵入淨空，單次目視卻未察覺，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Analyze accumulated setup residuals alongside equipment inspection records. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If small repeated offsets eventually encroach on clearance while individual visual checks miss them, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：持續小偏位在多循環後侵入淨空，單次目視卻未察覺。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Small repeated offsets eventually encroach on clearance while individual visual checks miss them. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

quiz.question: 要驗證「台車循環與品質追溯」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Carriage cycles and quality traceability"?

A low early compression ratio replaces every stripping-stage check

steps.title: 台車循環與品質追溯：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Carriage cycles and quality traceability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「台車循環與品質追溯」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Carriage cycles and quality traceability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 持續小偏位在多循環後侵入淨空，單次目視卻未察覺。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用每循環定位殘差與設備檢查紀錄分析累積偏差，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Small repeated offsets eventually encroach on clearance while individual visual checks miss them. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to analyze accumulated setup residuals alongside equipment inspection records to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察用每循環定位殘差與設備檢查紀錄分析累積偏差；若出現持續小偏位在多循環後侵入淨空，單次目視卻未察覺，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If small repeated offsets eventually encroach on clearance while individual visual checks miss them, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「台車出廠合格就不需要每循環重新定位檢查」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Factory-approved carriages never need positioning checks during later cycles" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 持續小偏位在多循環後侵入淨空，單次目視卻未察覺。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用每循環定位殘差與設備檢查紀錄分析累積偏差，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「台車循環與品質追溯」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Carriage cycles and quality traceability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

title: 隧道仰拱閉合施工
summary: 本課以以閉合環、接頭相容與基底反力解析隧道仰拱為主線，從閉合環與環向力與仰拱曲率與力線建立系統邊界，再把閉合距離與時間效應、地下水浮力與排水狀態連到永久環與維護交接。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on analyze tunnel inverts through ring closure, joint compatibility and base reactions. It begins with Ring closure and hoop force and Invert curvature and force trajectory, links Closure distance and time effects and Groundwater uplift and drainage state, and ends with Permanent ring and maintenance handover. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查閉合環與環向力：N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m；再獨立檢查仰拱曲率與力線：eccentricMoment=N*e=600 kN/m*0.03 m=18 kNm/m。半徑 4 m 固定，壓力由 0.15 增為 0.18 MPa，理想環力由 0.60 增為 0.72 MN/m；這不含接頭彎矩和基底不均勻反力。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 將把水平與斜向收斂、底部高程及閉合時刻共同配準作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Ring closure and hoop force: N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m. Independently check Invert curvature and force trajectory: eccentricMoment=N*e=600 kN/m*0.03 m=18 kNm/m. At a fixed 4 m radius, raising pressure from 0.15 to 0.18 MPa increases ideal-ring thrust from 0.60 to 0.72 MN/m, excluding joint moments and uneven base reactions. The two results are not a complete design because an intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. Use register horizontal and diagonal convergence, base elevation and closure time as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「閉合環與環向力」與「仰拱曲率與力線」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ring closure and hoop force" and "Invert curvature and force trajectory": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 閉合環與環向力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ring closure and hoop force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「閉合環與環向力」如何影響隧道仰拱閉合施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ring closure and hoop force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel invert closure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱部與仰拱接成閉合環後，部分地層作用可由環向壓力傳遞，開口環則更依賴拱腳反力與彎曲。閉合不是外觀接觸而已，接頭必須能傳遞所需作用；模型應保留閉合前已發生的變形，不能把全部荷載重新從零分配。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態；若出現接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「閉合環與環向力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Closure allows ground actions to transfer partly through hoop compression, whereas an open arch relies more on foot reaction and bending. Visible contact is not sufficient joint transfer. Retain preclosure deformation rather than reallocating the complete load from an artificial zero state. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure. If an intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ring closure and hoop force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土外觀連成一圈就等於受力環已完全閉合」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Concrete appearing as a circle proves complete structural ring closure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「閉合環與環向力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ring closure and hoop force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 閉合環與環向力
knowledge.text: 拱部與仰拱接成閉合環後，部分地層作用可由環向壓力傳遞，開口環則更依賴拱腳反力與彎曲。閉合不是外觀接觸而已，接頭必須能傳遞所需作用；模型應保留閉合前已發生的變形，不能把全部荷載重新從零分配。
knowledge.textEn: Closure allows ground actions to transfer partly through hoop compression, whereas an open arch relies more on foot reaction and bending. Visible contact is not sufficient joint transfer.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土外觀連成一圈就等於受力環已完全閉合 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Concrete appearing as a circle proves complete structural ring closure Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「閉合環與環向力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring closure and hoop force" is correct?
options: 混凝土外觀連成一圈就等於受力環已完全閉合
拱部與仰拱接成閉合環後，部分地層作用可由環向壓力傳遞，開口環則更依賴拱腳反力與彎曲。
仰拱最低點高程正確就代表整條曲線都正確
optionsEn: Concrete appearing as a circle proves complete structural ring closure
Closure allows ground actions to transfer partly through hoop compression, whereas an open arch relies more on foot reaction and bending.
Correct lowest invert elevation proves the entire profile is correct
quiz.explanation: 拱部與仰拱接成閉合環後，部分地層作用可由環向壓力傳遞，開口環則更依賴拱腳反力與彎曲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Closure allows ground actions to transfer partly through hoop compression, whereas an open arch relies more on foot reaction and bending. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 閉合環與環向力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring closure and hoop force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「閉合環與環向力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ring closure and hoop force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「閉合環與環向力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ring closure and hoop force", which statement holds?
options: 基底被稱為岩盤就不可能發生可觀沉陷
仰拱外觀已硬化就能承受任何施工車輛
原創教學假設：N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m。
optionsEn: A base classified as rock cannot undergo significant settlement
An apparently hard invert can carry any construction vehicle
Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: N=p*R=0.15 MPa*4 m=0.60 MN/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 閉合環與環向力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ring closure and hoop force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「閉合環與環向力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ring closure and hoop force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「閉合環與環向力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ring closure and hoop force"?
options: 比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
閉合後監測曲線變平就一定是結構已穩定
optionsEn: Compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A flatter curve after closure necessarily proves structural stability
quiz.explanation: 比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 閉合環與環向力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ring closure and hoop force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「閉合環與環向力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ring closure and hoop force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態；若出現接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If an intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土外觀連成一圈就等於受力環已完全閉合」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Concrete appearing as a circle proves complete structural ring closure" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較閉合前後拱腳位移、仰拱應變及接頭狀態，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: An intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare foot movement, invert strain and joint condition before and after closure to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「閉合環與環向力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ring closure and hoop force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲。
仰拱最低點高程正確就代表整條曲線都正確
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
An intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending.
Correct lowest invert elevation proves the entire profile is correct
quiz.explanation: 接頭未傳力卻採完整環模型，低估拱腳張開與彎曲。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An intact-ring model with inactive joints understates foot spreading and bending. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 仰拱曲率與力線：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Invert curvature and force trajectory: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「仰拱曲率與力線」如何影響隧道仰拱閉合施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Invert curvature and force trajectory” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel invert closure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 仰拱曲率影響軸力作用線與基底接觸，過度平坦可能增加彎曲需求。局部厚度和曲率誤差互相影響，不能只量最低點高程；應將設計曲線與完成面配準，辨認轉折、接頭及基底鬆動造成的非均勻受力。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以斷面掃描檢核曲率、厚度與接頭附近的幾何轉折；若出現局部平坦區使力線偏心，形成表面與背面的交替裂紋，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「仰拱曲率與力線」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Invert curvature governs the thrust trajectory and base contact, and flattening can increase bending demand. Thickness and curvature errors interact, so the lowest elevation alone is insufficient. Register the completed profile to identify kinks, joints and uneven loading from disturbed ground. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Use section scans to check curvature, thickness and geometric kinks near joints. If a locally flat zone shifts the thrust line and causes alternating-face cracks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Invert curvature and force trajectory” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
