optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Register horizontal and diagonal convergence, base elevation and closure time.
Equal closure distances imply identical construction-time effects
quiz.explanation: 把水平與斜向收斂、底部高程及閉合時刻共同配準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Register horizontal and diagonal convergence, base elevation and closure time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 收斂閉合與儀器對時：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Convergence closure and synchronization: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「收斂閉合與儀器對時」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Convergence closure and synchronization” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 更換基準造成曲線跳動，被誤認為閉合後突然穩定。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把水平與斜向收斂、底部高程及閉合時刻共同配準，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A reference change creates a curve jump mistaken for sudden postclosure stability. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to register horizontal and diagonal convergence, base elevation and closure time to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察把水平與斜向收斂、底部高程及閉合時刻共同配準；若出現更換基準造成曲線跳動，被誤認為閉合後突然穩定，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a reference change creates a curve jump mistaken for sudden postclosure stability, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「閉合後監測曲線變平就一定是結構已穩定」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A flatter curve after closure necessarily proves structural stability" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 更換基準造成曲線跳動，被誤認為閉合後突然穩定。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把水平與斜向收斂、底部高程及閉合時刻共同配準，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A reference change creates a curve jump mistaken for sudden postclosure stability. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to register horizontal and diagonal convergence, base elevation and closure time to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「收斂閉合與儀器對時」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Convergence closure and synchronization" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
接縫漏水增加一定代表結構裂縫變大
更換基準造成曲線跳動，被誤認為閉合後突然穩定。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Increasing joint leakage always means a structural crack has widened
A reference change creates a curve jump mistaken for sudden postclosure stability.
quiz.explanation: 更換基準造成曲線跳動，被誤認為閉合後突然穩定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A reference change creates a curve jump mistaken for sudden postclosure stability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接縫漏水與耐久」與「永久環與維護交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint leakage and durability" and "Permanent ring and maintenance handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接縫漏水與耐久：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint leakage and durability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接縫漏水與耐久」如何影響隧道仰拱閉合施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint leakage and durability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel invert closure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 仰拱接縫接近積水和沉積物，漏水可能沿施工界面連通到兩側。水量增加不一定表示裂縫擴大，也可能是水頭上升或排水改道；維修前應把接縫開口、化學環境與排水歷史配對，避免堵住唯一的洩壓通路。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照接縫開口、水頭及同區排水量的同步紀錄；若出現只封出水口使底壓升高，漏水轉移到鄰近接縫，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接縫漏水與耐久」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Invert joints encounter water and sediment, and leakage can spread along construction interfaces. Increasing flow may reflect head rise or rerouting rather than wider cracks. Pair opening, chemistry and drainage history before repair to avoid sealing the only pressure-relief path. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare synchronized joint opening, head and local drainage flow. If sealing an outlet raises base pressure and moves leakage to another joint, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint leakage and durability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接縫漏水增加一定代表結構裂縫變大」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing joint leakage always means a structural crack has widened" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接縫漏水與耐久」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint leakage and durability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接縫漏水與耐久
knowledge.text: 仰拱接縫接近積水和沉積物，漏水可能沿施工界面連通到兩側。水量增加不一定表示裂縫擴大，也可能是水頭上升或排水改道；維修前應把接縫開口、化學環境與排水歷史配對，避免堵住唯一的洩壓通路。
knowledge.textEn: Invert joints encounter water and sediment, and leakage can spread along construction interfaces. Increasing flow may reflect head rise or rerouting rather than wider cracks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接縫漏水增加一定代表結構裂縫變大 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing joint leakage always means a structural crack has widened Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接縫漏水與耐久」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint leakage and durability" is correct?
options: 仰拱接縫接近積水和沉積物，漏水可能沿施工界面連通到兩側。
接縫漏水增加一定代表結構裂縫變大
隧道路面以下的混凝土都可以視為非結構填充
optionsEn: Invert joints encounter water and sediment, and leakage can spread along construction interfaces.
Increasing joint leakage always means a structural crack has widened
All concrete beneath a tunnel pavement can be treated as nonstructural fill
quiz.explanation: 仰拱接縫接近積水和沉積物，漏水可能沿施工界面連通到兩側。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Invert joints encounter water and sediment, and leakage can spread along construction interfaces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接縫漏水與耐久：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint leakage and durability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接縫漏水與耐久」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint leakage and durability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照接縫開口、水頭及同區排水量的同步紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare synchronized joint opening, head and local drainage flow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis。完整環公式不能直接套用在未閉合、接頭鬆動或基底懸空狀態。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接縫漏水與耐久」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint leakage and durability", which statement holds?
options: 仰拱最低點高程正確就代表整條曲線都正確
原創教學假設：leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis。
基底被稱為岩盤就不可能發生可觀沉陷
optionsEn: Correct lowest invert elevation proves the entire profile is correct
Original teaching assumptions: leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis.
A base classified as rock cannot undergo significant settlement
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: leakChange=(0.6-0.2) L/min=0.4 L/min, at unspecified head requires further diagnosis. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 接縫漏水與耐久：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint leakage and durability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接縫漏水與耐久」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint leakage and durability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照接縫開口、水頭及同區排水量的同步紀錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只封出水口使底壓升高，漏水轉移到鄰近接縫」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare synchronized joint opening, head and local drainage flow. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Sealing an outlet raises base pressure and moves leakage to another joint. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照接縫開口、水頭及同區排水量的同步紀錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只封出水口使底壓升高，漏水轉移到鄰近接縫，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare synchronized joint opening, head and local drainage flow. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If sealing an outlet raises base pressure and moves leakage to another joint, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只封出水口使底壓升高，漏水轉移到鄰近接縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sealing an outlet raises base pressure and moves leakage to another joint. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照接縫開口、水頭及同區排水量的同步紀錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只封出水口使底壓升高，漏水轉移到鄰近接縫」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare synchronized joint opening, head and local drainage flow. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Sealing an outlet raises base pressure and moves leakage to another joint. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將對照接縫開口、水頭及同區排水量的同步紀錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只封出水口使底壓升高，漏水轉移到鄰近接縫，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare synchronized joint opening, head and local drainage flow. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If sealing an outlet raises base pressure and moves leakage to another joint, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接縫漏水與耐久」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint leakage and durability"?

steps.titleEn: Joint leakage and durability: failure diagnosis

steps.title: 永久環與維護交接：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 施工仰拱、填充層和永久路面可能同時存在，卻有不同承載與排水角色。維修開槽若誤切結構仰拱，會破壞環向傳力，原圖未標高程時尤其難辨認；交接應提供可追溯的分層幾何及禁止任意切割的結構界面。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將竣工分層高程、排水位置與結構接頭編入維護圖；若出現把結構仰拱當填充層開槽，切斷原本閉合的受力環，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「永久環與維護交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Structural invert, fill and pavement have different loading and drainage roles despite sharing the same section. Maintenance cuts into the structural invert interrupt ring transfer, particularly where layer levels are unclear. Handover must preserve layered geometry and identify structural interfaces requiring engineering review. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record as-built layer levels, drain locations and structural joints in maintenance drawings. If treating structural invert as fill and cutting it interrupts the closed load path, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Permanent ring and maintenance handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: availableNonstructuralDepth=coverDepth-uncertainty=0.40 m-0.05 m=0.35 m, not excavation permission. An intact-ring formula does not describe unclosed rings, loose joints or unsupported bases. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將竣工分層高程、排水位置與結構接頭編入維護圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record as-built layer levels, drain locations and structural joints in maintenance drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 永久環與維護交接：試驗與驗證

quiz.question: 在「永久環與維護交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Permanent ring and maintenance handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把結構仰拱當填充層開槽，切斷原本閉合的受力環。
混凝土外觀連成一圈就等於受力環已完全閉合
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating structural invert as fill and cutting it interrupts the closed load path.
Concrete appearing as a circle proves complete structural ring closure
quiz.explanation: 把結構仰拱當填充層開槽，切斷原本閉合的受力環。 需以量測區分可能原因。

title: 岩爆監測與卸壓支護
summary: 本課以用能量、變形與監測不確定度辨識岩爆支護需求為主線，從彈性能與釋放比例與拋出物動能與速度建立系統邊界，再把動態載入速率與試驗邊界、串聯力鏈與容量區分連到事件後剩餘行程與復核。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on assess rockburst support using energy, deformation and monitoring uncertainty. It begins with Elastic energy and releasable fraction and Ejected-rock energy and velocity, links Dynamic rate and test boundaries and Serial force paths and capacity distinctions, and ends with Post-event remaining stroke and requalification. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查彈性能與釋放比例：u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3；再獨立檢查拋出物動能與速度：Ek=0.5*m*v^2=0.5*100 kg*(5 m/s)^2=1250 J=1.25 kJ。線彈性應力由 100 增為 110 MPa、模數仍為 50 GPa，能量密度由 100 增為 121 kJ/m3；可釋放比例未知，不能全部當成拋石動能。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 將對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Elastic energy and releasable fraction: u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3. Independently check Ejected-rock energy and velocity: Ek=0.5*m*v^2=0.5*100 kg*(5 m/s)^2=1250 J=1.25 kJ. At a fixed 50 GPa modulus, stress rising from 100 to 110 MPa increases elastic energy density from 100 to 121 kJ/m3; an unknown releasable fraction prevents treating all of it as ejection energy. The two results are not a complete design because static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. Use compare sensor availability, noise and events within a consistent detectable range as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「彈性能與釋放比例」與「拋出物動能與速度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Elastic energy and releasable fraction" and "Ejected-rock energy and velocity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 彈性能與釋放比例：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Elastic energy and releasable fraction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「彈性能與釋放比例」如何影響岩爆監測與卸壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elastic energy and releasable fraction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高應力岩體儲存彈性能，開挖造成應力重分配後可能釋放其中一部分。線彈性能密度只是儲存量的理想估計，還需區分裂縫生成、摩擦、波動和拋出物能量；把全部體積乘能量密度直接當支護需求會忽略真正耦合路徑。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照應力估計、岩體剛度及事件後破裂與拋出證據；若出現把儲存能全部或完全不計入支護需求，都可能誤判作用，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「彈性能與釋放比例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stressed rock stores elastic energy, part of which may be released after excavation redistributes stress. Elastic density estimates storage rather than its partition into fracture, friction, waves and ejection. Multiplying volume by density does not establish support demand without the coupling pathway and releasable fraction. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare stress estimates and rock stiffness with post-event fracture and ejection evidence. If equating stored energy to demand, or ignoring it entirely, misrepresents the action, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Elastic energy and releasable fraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有岩體彈性能最後都會成為拋石動能」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All elastic energy in the rock ultimately becomes ejected-rock kinetic energy" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「彈性能與釋放比例」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Elastic energy and releasable fraction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 彈性能與釋放比例
knowledge.text: 高應力岩體儲存彈性能，開挖造成應力重分配後可能釋放其中一部分。線彈性能密度只是儲存量的理想估計，還需區分裂縫生成、摩擦、波動和拋出物能量；把全部體積乘能量密度直接當支護需求會忽略真正耦合路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Stressed rock stores elastic energy, part of which may be released after excavation redistributes stress. Elastic density estimates storage rather than its partition into fracture, friction, waves and ejection.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有岩體彈性能最後都會成為拋石動能 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All elastic energy in the rock ultimately becomes ejected-rock kinetic energy Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「彈性能與釋放比例」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Elastic energy and releasable fraction" is correct?
options: 所有岩體彈性能最後都會成為拋石動能
高應力岩體儲存彈性能，開挖造成應力重分配後可能釋放其中一部分。
拋出塊體質量相同就代表衝擊能量相同
optionsEn: All elastic energy in the rock ultimately becomes ejected-rock kinetic energy
Stressed rock stores elastic energy, part of which may be released after excavation redistributes stress.
Equal ejected-block mass means equal impact energy in every event
quiz.explanation: 高應力岩體儲存彈性能，開挖造成應力重分配後可能釋放其中一部分。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stressed rock stores elastic energy, part of which may be released after excavation redistributes stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 彈性能與釋放比例：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Elastic energy and releasable fraction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「彈性能與釋放比例」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Elastic energy and releasable fraction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照應力估計、岩體剛度及事件後破裂與拋出證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare stress estimates and rock stiffness with post-event fracture and ejection evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「彈性能與釋放比例」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Elastic energy and releasable fraction", which statement holds?
options: 把各元件額定能量加總就能得到整套支護容量

One sensor receiving a signal uniquely locates a rockburst
Original teaching assumptions: u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: u=sigma^2/(2E)=(100 MPa)^2/(2*50000 MPa)=0.10 MPa=100 kJ/m3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 彈性能與釋放比例：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Elastic energy and releasable fraction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「彈性能與釋放比例」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Elastic energy and releasable fraction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照應力估計、岩體剛度及事件後破裂與拋出證據。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把儲存能全部或完全不計入支護需求，都可能誤判作用」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare stress estimates and rock stiffness with post-event fracture and ejection evidence. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Equating stored energy to demand, or ignoring it entirely, misrepresents the action. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照應力估計、岩體剛度及事件後破裂與拋出證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把儲存能全部或完全不計入支護需求，都可能誤判作用，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare stress estimates and rock stiffness with post-event fracture and ejection evidence. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If equating stored energy to demand, or ignoring it entirely, misrepresents the action, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把儲存能全部或完全不計入支護需求，都可能誤判作用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Equating stored energy to demand, or ignoring it entirely, misrepresents the action. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照應力估計、岩體剛度及事件後破裂與拋出證據。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把儲存能全部或完全不計入支護需求，都可能誤判作用」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare stress estimates and rock stiffness with post-event fracture and ejection evidence. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Equating stored energy to demand, or ignoring it entirely, misrepresents the action. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將對照應力估計、岩體剛度及事件後破裂與拋出證據列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把儲存能全部或完全不計入支護需求，都可能誤判作用，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare stress estimates and rock stiffness with post-event fracture and ejection evidence. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If equating stored energy to demand, or ignoring it entirely, misrepresents the action, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「彈性能與釋放比例」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Elastic energy and releasable fraction"?
options: 對照應力估計、岩體剛度及事件後破裂與拋出證據。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
微震事件減少就必定代表施工區更加安全
optionsEn: Compare stress estimates and rock stiffness with post-event fracture and ejection evidence.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Fewer microseismic events necessarily mean the work area is safer
quiz.explanation: 對照應力估計、岩體剛度及事件後破裂與拋出證據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare stress estimates and rock stiffness with post-event fracture and ejection evidence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 彈性能與釋放比例：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Elastic energy and releasable fraction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「彈性能與釋放比例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Elastic energy and releasable fraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把儲存能全部或完全不計入支護需求，都可能誤判作用。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照應力估計、岩體剛度及事件後破裂與拋出證據，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equating stored energy to demand, or ignoring it entirely, misrepresents the action. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare stress estimates and rock stiffness with post-event fracture and ejection evidence to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照應力估計、岩體剛度及事件後破裂與拋出證據；若出現把儲存能全部或完全不計入支護需求，都可能誤判作用，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If equating stored energy to demand, or ignoring it entirely, misrepresents the action, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有岩體彈性能最後都會成為拋石動能」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All elastic energy in the rock ultimately becomes ejected-rock kinetic energy" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

steps.title: 拋出物動能與速度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ejected-rock energy and velocity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拋出物動能與速度」如何影響岩爆監測與卸壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ejected-rock energy and velocity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拋出物的動能與速度平方成正比，重量估計和速度估計的誤差有不同影響。表面落塊不一定由同一動態機制造成，需區分重力落下與應力驅動拋出；單塊估算也不能代表整個事件作用在支護的時間和空間分布。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用可取得的影像、塊體質量及落點證據約束速度範圍；若出現僅憑落塊尺寸推估動態需求而漏掉速度平方效應，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拋出物動能與速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ejection energy varies with velocity squared, making mass and velocity uncertainty affect it differently. Surface falls need not share the same dynamic mechanism; distinguish gravity fall from stress-driven ejection. A single-block estimate does not establish the event's spatial or temporal loading of support. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Constrain velocity using available images, block mass and landing evidence. If demand inferred only from block size misses the squared effect of velocity, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ejected-rock energy and velocity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Ek=0.5*m*v^2=0.5*100 kg*(5 m/s)^2=1250 J=1.25 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「拋出塊體質量相同就代表衝擊能量相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal ejected-block mass means equal impact energy in every event" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拋出物動能與速度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ejected-rock energy and velocity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拋出物動能與速度
knowledge.text: 拋出物的動能與速度平方成正比，重量估計和速度估計的誤差有不同影響。表面落塊不一定由同一動態機制造成，需區分重力落下與應力驅動拋出；單塊估算也不能代表整個事件作用在支護的時間和空間分布。
knowledge.textEn: Ejection energy varies with velocity squared, making mass and velocity uncertainty affect it differently. Surface falls need not share the same dynamic mechanism; distinguish gravity fall from stress-driven ejection.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：拋出塊體質量相同就代表衝擊能量相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal ejected-block mass means equal impact energy in every event Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「拋出物動能與速度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 拋出塊體質量相同就代表衝擊能量相同
元件峰值拉力大就保證它吸收的能量也大
拋出物的動能與速度平方成正比，重量估計和速度估計的誤差有不同影響。
optionsEn: Equal ejected-block mass means equal impact energy in every event
A large peak tensile force guarantees large absorbed energy
Ejection energy varies with velocity squared, making mass and velocity uncertainty affect it differently.
quiz.explanation: 拋出物的動能與速度平方成正比，重量估計和速度估計的誤差有不同影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ejection energy varies with velocity squared, making mass and velocity uncertainty affect it differently. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 拋出物動能與速度：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Ek=0.5*m*v^2=0.5*100 kg*(5 m/s)^2=1250 J=1.25 kJ。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Ek=0.5*m*v^2=0.5*100 kg*(5 m/s)^2=1250 J=1.25 kJ. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用可取得的影像、塊體質量及落點證據約束速度範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Constrain velocity using available images, block mass and landing evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Ek=0.5*m*v^2=0.5*100 kg*(5 m/s)^2=1250 J=1.25 kJ。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Ek=0.5*m*v^2=0.5*100 kg*(5 m/s)^2=1250 J=1.25 kJ. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「拋出物動能與速度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ejected-rock energy and velocity", which statement holds?

Drop-weight potential energy equals energy absorbed solely by the tested bolt
Serial support energy capacity always equals the smallest component energy rating

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Ek=0.5*m*v^2=0.5*100 kg*(5 m/s)^2=1250 J=1.25 kJ. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.titleEn: Ejected-rock energy and velocity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拋出物動能與速度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ejected-rock energy and velocity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用可取得的影像、塊體質量及落點證據約束速度範圍。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「僅憑落塊尺寸推估動態需求而漏掉速度平方效應」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Constrain velocity using available images, block mass and landing evidence. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Demand inferred only from block size misses the squared effect of velocity. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If demand inferred only from block size misses the squared effect of velocity, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：僅憑落塊尺寸推估動態需求而漏掉速度平方效應。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Demand inferred only from block size misses the squared effect of velocity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 僅憑落塊尺寸推估動態需求而漏掉速度平方效應。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用可取得的影像、塊體質量及落點證據約束速度範圍，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Demand inferred only from block size misses the squared effect of velocity. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to constrain velocity using available images, block mass and landing evidence to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「拋出物動能與速度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ejected-rock energy and velocity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
元件峰值拉力大就保證它吸收的能量也大
僅憑落塊尺寸推估動態需求而漏掉速度平方效應。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A large peak tensile force guarantees large absorbed energy
Demand inferred only from block size misses the squared effect of velocity.
quiz.explanation: 僅憑落塊尺寸推估動態需求而漏掉速度平方效應。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Demand inferred only from block size misses the squared effect of velocity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「讓壓行程與吸能積分」與「岩栓板網與共同變形」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Yielding stroke and energy integration" and "Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 讓壓行程與吸能積分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Yielding stroke and energy integration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「讓壓行程與吸能積分」如何影響岩爆監測與卸壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Yielding stroke and energy integration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 讓壓構件透過受控變形吸收功，能量是力對實際行程的積分。高峰值力不一定有足夠行程，低剛度也不等於穩定吸能；必須看完整載入曲線及卸載後損傷，並區分元件試驗邊界與安裝系統邊界。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以校正荷重與相對位移積分，檢查行程末端反力變化；若出現構件行程用盡後突然變硬，將高反力傳到連接與岩體，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「讓壓行程與吸能積分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Yielding components absorb work through controlled displacement, integrating force over actual stroke. A high peak may lack travel, and low stiffness does not establish stable absorption. Review the full loading curve and damage while distinguishing component-test restraint from the installed support system. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Integrate calibrated force against relative displacement and inspect end-of-stroke response. If a component hardens abruptly when stroke is exhausted and overloads connections and rock, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Yielding stroke and energy integration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「元件峰值拉力大就保證它吸收的能量也大」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A large peak tensile force guarantees large absorbed energy" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「讓壓行程與吸能積分」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Yielding stroke and energy integration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 讓壓行程與吸能積分
knowledge.text: 讓壓構件透過受控變形吸收功，能量是力對實際行程的積分。高峰值力不一定有足夠行程，低剛度也不等於穩定吸能；必須看完整載入曲線及卸載後損傷，並區分元件試驗邊界與安裝系統邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Yielding components absorb work through controlled displacement, integrating force over actual stroke. A high peak may lack travel, and low stiffness does not establish stable absorption.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：元件峰值拉力大就保證它吸收的能量也大 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A large peak tensile force guarantees large absorbed energy Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「讓壓行程與吸能積分」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Yielding stroke and energy integration" is correct?
options: 讓壓構件透過受控變形吸收功，能量是力對實際行程的積分。
元件峰值拉力大就保證它吸收的能量也大
把各元件額定能量加總就能得到整套支護容量
optionsEn: Yielding components absorb work through controlled displacement, integrating force over actual stroke.
A large peak tensile force guarantees large absorbed energy
Adding every component energy rating gives the installed system capacity
quiz.explanation: 讓壓構件透過受控變形吸收功，能量是力對實際行程的積分。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Yielding components absorb work through controlled displacement, integrating force over actual stroke. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 讓壓行程與吸能積分：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Yielding stroke and energy integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「讓壓行程與吸能積分」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Yielding stroke and energy integration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以校正荷重與相對位移積分，檢查行程末端反力變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate calibrated force against relative displacement and inspect end-of-stroke response.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「讓壓行程與吸能積分」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Yielding stroke and energy integration", which statement holds?
options: 單支感測器收到訊號就能唯一定位岩爆位置
原創教學假設：W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ。
微震事件減少就必定代表施工區更加安全
optionsEn: One sensor receiving a signal uniquely locates a rockburst
Original teaching assumptions: W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ.
Fewer microseismic events necessarily mean the work area is safer
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: W=Fmean*stroke=150 kN*0.20 m=30 kJ. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 讓壓行程與吸能積分：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Yielding stroke and energy integration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「讓壓行程與吸能積分」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Yielding stroke and energy integration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以校正荷重與相對位移積分，檢查行程末端反力變化。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「構件行程用盡後突然變硬，將高反力傳到連接與岩體」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate calibrated force against relative displacement and inspect end-of-stroke response. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A component hardens abruptly when stroke is exhausted and overloads connections and rock. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以校正荷重與相對位移積分，檢查行程末端反力變化列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現構件行程用盡後突然變硬，將高反力傳到連接與岩體，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Integrate calibrated force against relative displacement and inspect end-of-stroke response. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a component hardens abruptly when stroke is exhausted and overloads connections and rock, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：構件行程用盡後突然變硬，將高反力傳到連接與岩體。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A component hardens abruptly when stroke is exhausted and overloads connections and rock. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以校正荷重與相對位移積分，檢查行程末端反力變化。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「構件行程用盡後突然變硬，將高反力傳到連接與岩體」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Integrate calibrated force against relative displacement and inspect end-of-stroke response. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A component hardens abruptly when stroke is exhausted and overloads connections and rock. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將以校正荷重與相對位移積分，檢查行程末端反力變化列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現構件行程用盡後突然變硬，將高反力傳到連接與岩體，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Integrate calibrated force against relative displacement and inspect end-of-stroke response. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a component hardens abruptly when stroke is exhausted and overloads connections and rock, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「讓壓行程與吸能積分」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Yielding stroke and energy integration"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
原額定能量減事件能量就能保證剩餘支護能力
以校正荷重與相對位移積分，檢查行程末端反力變化。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Original rated energy minus event energy guarantees remaining support capacity
Integrate calibrated force against relative displacement and inspect end-of-stroke response.
quiz.explanation: 以校正荷重與相對位移積分，檢查行程末端反力變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

steps.title: 讓壓行程與吸能積分：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Yielding stroke and energy integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「讓壓行程與吸能積分」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Yielding stroke and energy integration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 構件行程用盡後突然變硬，將高反力傳到連接與岩體。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以校正荷重與相對位移積分，檢查行程末端反力變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A component hardens abruptly when stroke is exhausted and overloads connections and rock. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to integrate calibrated force against relative displacement and inspect end-of-stroke response to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以校正荷重與相對位移積分，檢查行程末端反力變化；若出現構件行程用盡後突然變硬，將高反力傳到連接與岩體，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a component hardens abruptly when stroke is exhausted and overloads connections and rock, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「元件峰值拉力大就保證它吸收的能量也大」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A large peak tensile force guarantees large absorbed energy" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「讓壓行程與吸能積分」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Yielding stroke and energy integration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

steps.title: 岩栓板網與共同變形：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岩栓板網與共同變形」如何影響岩爆監測與卸壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 吸能岩栓需要托盤與表面網把岩塊作用傳給它，任一連接先失效都會中斷路徑。各元件可能有不同位移和載入速率，不能只把產品額定能量相加；系統驗證必須確認網的變形、板的穿破和岩栓行程能相容。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步量測網、托盤及岩栓相對位移和破壞順序；若出現托盤先穿破網面使岩栓未動員，名義吸能能力無法使用，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩栓板網與共同變形」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An energy-absorbing bolt needs plates and mesh to deliver rock actions; premature connection failure interrupts that path. Components undergo different displacements and rates, preventing simple addition of product energy ratings. Verify compatible mesh deformation, plate punching and bolt travel as a system. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure mesh, plate and bolt relative movements and failure order simultaneously. If a plate punches through mesh before the bolt engages and its nominal energy capacity is unavailable, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：displacementMismatch=meshDeflection-boltTravel=0.18 m-0.10 m=0.08 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: displacementMismatch=meshDeflection-boltTravel=0.18 m-0.10 m=0.08 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把各元件額定能量加總就能得到整套支護容量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding every component energy rating gives the installed system capacity" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「岩栓板網與共同變形」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 岩栓板網與共同變形
knowledge.text: 吸能岩栓需要托盤與表面網把岩塊作用傳給它，任一連接先失效都會中斷路徑。各元件可能有不同位移和載入速率，不能只把產品額定能量相加；系統驗證必須確認網的變形、板的穿破和岩栓行程能相容。
knowledge.textEn: An energy-absorbing bolt needs plates and mesh to deliver rock actions; premature connection failure interrupts that path. Components undergo different displacements and rates, preventing simple addition of product energy ratings.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：把各元件額定能量加總就能得到整套支護容量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding every component energy rating gives the installed system capacity Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「岩栓板網與共同變形」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility" is correct?
options: 把各元件額定能量加總就能得到整套支護容量
吸能岩栓需要托盤與表面網把岩塊作用傳給它，任一連接先失效都會中斷路徑。
落錘位能完全等於被測岩栓吸收的能量
optionsEn: Adding every component energy rating gives the installed system capacity
An energy-absorbing bolt needs plates and mesh to deliver rock actions; premature connection failure interrupts that path.
Drop-weight potential energy equals energy absorbed solely by the tested bolt
quiz.explanation: 吸能岩栓需要托盤與表面網把岩塊作用傳給它，任一連接先失效都會中斷路徑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An energy-absorbing bolt needs plates and mesh to deliver rock actions; premature connection failure interrupts that path. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 岩栓板網與共同變形：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「岩栓板網與共同變形」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：displacementMismatch=meshDeflection-boltTravel=0.18 m-0.10 m=0.08 m。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: displacementMismatch=meshDeflection-boltTravel=0.18 m-0.10 m=0.08 m. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測網、托盤及岩栓相對位移和破壞順序。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure mesh, plate and bolt relative movements and failure order simultaneously.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：displacementMismatch=meshDeflection-boltTravel=0.18 m-0.10 m=0.08 m。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: displacementMismatch=meshDeflection-boltTravel=0.18 m-0.10 m=0.08 m. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「岩栓板網與共同變形」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility", which statement holds?
options: 串聯支護的吸能能力一定等於最小元件額定能量
預警準確率很高就可取代現場工程判斷
原創教學假設：displacementMismatch=meshDeflection-boltTravel=0.18 m-0.10 m=0.08 m。
optionsEn: Serial support energy capacity always equals the smallest component energy rating
High warning accuracy can replace engineering judgement in the field
Original teaching assumptions: displacementMismatch=meshDeflection-boltTravel=0.18 m-0.10 m=0.08 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：displacementMismatch=meshDeflection-boltTravel=0.18 m-0.10 m=0.08 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: displacementMismatch=meshDeflection-boltTravel=0.18 m-0.10 m=0.08 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 岩栓板網與共同變形：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「岩栓板網與共同變形」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測網、托盤及岩栓相對位移和破壞順序。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「托盤先穿破網面使岩栓未動員，名義吸能能力無法使用」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure mesh, plate and bolt relative movements and failure order simultaneously. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A plate punches through mesh before the bolt engages and its nominal energy capacity is unavailable. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同步量測網、托盤及岩栓相對位移和破壞順序列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現托盤先穿破網面使岩栓未動員，名義吸能能力無法使用，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Measure mesh, plate and bolt relative movements and failure order simultaneously. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a plate punches through mesh before the bolt engages and its nominal energy capacity is unavailable, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：托盤先穿破網面使岩栓未動員，名義吸能能力無法使用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A plate punches through mesh before the bolt engages and its nominal energy capacity is unavailable. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量測網、托盤及岩栓相對位移和破壞順序。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「托盤先穿破網面使岩栓未動員，名義吸能能力無法使用」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Measure mesh, plate and bolt relative movements and failure order simultaneously. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A plate punches through mesh before the bolt engages and its nominal energy capacity is unavailable. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將同步量測網、托盤及岩栓相對位移和破壞順序列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現托盤先穿破網面使岩栓未動員，名義吸能能力無法使用，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Measure mesh, plate and bolt relative movements and failure order simultaneously. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a plate punches through mesh before the bolt engages and its nominal energy capacity is unavailable, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「岩栓板網與共同變形」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility"?
options: 同步量測網、托盤及岩栓相對位移和破壞順序。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
所有岩體彈性能最後都會成為拋石動能
optionsEn: Measure mesh, plate and bolt relative movements and failure order simultaneously.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
All elastic energy in the rock ultimately becomes ejected-rock kinetic energy
quiz.explanation: 同步量測網、托盤及岩栓相對位移和破壞順序。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure mesh, plate and bolt relative movements and failure order simultaneously. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 岩栓板網與共同變形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「岩栓板網與共同變形」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 托盤先穿破網面使岩栓未動員，名義吸能能力無法使用。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步量測網、托盤及岩栓相對位移和破壞順序，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A plate punches through mesh before the bolt engages and its nominal energy capacity is unavailable. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure mesh, plate and bolt relative movements and failure order simultaneously to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察同步量測網、托盤及岩栓相對位移和破壞順序；若出現托盤先穿破網面使岩栓未動員，名義吸能能力無法使用，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a plate punches through mesh before the bolt engages and its nominal energy capacity is unavailable, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「把各元件額定能量加總就能得到整套支護容量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding every component energy rating gives the installed system capacity" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 托盤先穿破網面使岩栓未動員，名義吸能能力無法使用。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步量測網、托盤及岩栓相對位移和破壞順序，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A plate punches through mesh before the bolt engages and its nominal energy capacity is unavailable. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure mesh, plate and bolt relative movements and failure order simultaneously to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「岩栓板網與共同變形」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bolt-plate-mesh deformation compatibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
托盤先穿破網面使岩栓未動員，名義吸能能力無法使用。
落錘位能完全等於被測岩栓吸收的能量
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A plate punches through mesh before the bolt engages and its nominal energy capacity is unavailable.
Drop-weight potential energy equals energy absorbed solely by the tested bolt
quiz.explanation: 托盤先穿破網面使岩栓未動員，名義吸能能力無法使用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A plate punches through mesh before the bolt engages and its nominal energy capacity is unavailable. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「動態載入速率與試驗邊界」與「微震到時與位置不確定度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dynamic rate and test boundaries" and "Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 動態載入速率與試驗邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dynamic rate and test boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「動態載入速率與試驗邊界」如何影響岩爆監測與卸壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dynamic rate and test boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 動態事件的慣性和載入速率與慢速拉拔不同，錨固界面及金屬變形也可能隨速率改變。落錘試驗能量包含設備和試件的共同反應，不能只依落高推定材料實際吸收量；應量測反彈、裝置變形與力位移歷程。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將輸入能量與反彈、裝置變形及試件積分功作收支；若出現把設備吸收的能量算給岩栓，會高估元件動態表現，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「動態載入速率與試驗邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Inertia and loading rate differ from slow pull tests and may change anchorage and metal response. steps.title: 動態載入速率與試驗邊界：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「動態載入速率與試驗邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dynamic rate and test boundaries” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Einput=m*g*h=1000 kg*9.81 m/s2*1 m=9.81 kJ。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Einput=m*g*h=1000 kg*9.81 m/s2*1 m=9.81 kJ. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將輸入能量與反彈、裝置變形及試件積分功作收支。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Balance input energy against rebound, fixture deformation and integrated specimen work.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
