steps.title: 動態載入速率與試驗邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dynamic rate and test boundaries: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「動態載入速率與試驗邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dynamic rate and test boundaries” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將輸入能量與反彈、裝置變形及試件積分功作收支。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把設備吸收的能量算給岩栓，會高估元件動態表現」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Balance input energy against rebound, fixture deformation and integrated specimen work. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Energy absorbed by the fixture is credited to the bolt and overstates dynamic performance. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將輸入能量與反彈、裝置變形及試件積分功作收支列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把設備吸收的能量算給岩栓，會高估元件動態表現，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Balance input energy against rebound, fixture deformation and integrated specimen work. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If energy absorbed by the fixture is credited to the bolt and overstates dynamic performance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把設備吸收的能量算給岩栓，會高估元件動態表現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Energy absorbed by the fixture is credited to the bolt and overstates dynamic performance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 動態載入速率與試驗邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dynamic rate and test boundaries: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「動態載入速率與試驗邊界」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dynamic rate and test boundaries” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把設備吸收的能量算給岩栓，會高估元件動態表現。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將輸入能量與反彈、裝置變形及試件積分功作收支，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Energy absorbed by the fixture is credited to the bolt and overstates dynamic performance. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to balance input energy against rebound, fixture deformation and integrated specimen work to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將輸入能量與反彈、裝置變形及試件積分功作收支；若出現把設備吸收的能量算給岩栓，會高估元件動態表現，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If energy absorbed by the fixture is credited to the bolt and overstates dynamic performance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「落錘位能完全等於被測岩栓吸收的能量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Drop-weight potential energy equals energy absorbed solely by the tested bolt" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認

steps.title: 微震到時與位置不確定度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「微震到時與位置不確定度」如何影響岩爆監測與卸壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 微震定位使用多站到時差與波速模型，單站訊號不能唯一決定位置。岩層非均質、耦合品質和時鐘偏差會移動估計震源；到時殘差小也可能只是錯誤波速模型被擬合，必須用可驗證參考事件檢查定位誤差。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差；若出現時間偏差被當成震源移動，使風險區域被錯誤定位，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「微震到時與位置不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Location uses multistation arrival differences and a velocity model; one station cannot uniquely locate a source. Heterogeneity, coupling and clocks shift estimates. Small residuals may merely fit an incorrect velocity model, requiring reference events with independently constrained positions to assess error. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check station clocks, coupling and location residuals against independently known reference events. If timing bias appears as source migration and mislocates the area of concern, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：pathDifference=v*dt=5000 m/s*0.002 s=10 m, not a unique source position。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: pathDifference=v*dt=5000 m/s*0.002 s=10 m, not a unique source position.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單支感測器收到訊號就能唯一定位岩爆位置」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One sensor receiving a signal uniquely locates a rockburst" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 微震到時與位置不確定度
knowledge.text: 微震定位使用多站到時差與波速模型，單站訊號不能唯一決定位置。岩層非均質、耦合品質和時鐘偏差會移動估計震源；到時殘差小也可能只是錯誤波速模型被擬合，必須用可驗證參考事件檢查定位誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Location uses multistation arrival differences and a velocity model; one station cannot uniquely locate a source. Heterogeneity, coupling and clocks shift estimates.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：單支感測器收到訊號就能唯一定位岩爆位置 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One sensor receiving a signal uniquely locates a rockburst Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「微震到時與位置不確定度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty" is correct?
options: 微震定位使用多站到時差與波速模型，單站訊號不能唯一決定位置。

串聯支護的吸能能力一定等於最小元件額定能量
optionsEn: Location uses multistation arrival differences and a velocity model; one station cannot uniquely locate a source.
One sensor receiving a signal uniquely locates a rockburst
Serial support energy capacity always equals the smallest component energy rating
quiz.explanation: 微震定位使用多站到時差與波速模型，單站訊號不能唯一決定位置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Location uses multistation arrival differences and a velocity model; one station cannot uniquely locate a source. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 微震到時與位置不確定度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「微震到時與位置不確定度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：pathDifference=v*dt=5000 m/s*0.002 s=10 m, not a unique source position。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: pathDifference=v*dt=5000 m/s*0.002 s=10 m, not a unique source position. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check station clocks, coupling and location residuals against independently known reference events.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「微震到時與位置不確定度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 預警準確率很高就可取代現場工程判斷

所有岩體彈性能最後都會成為拋石動能
optionsEn: High warning accuracy can replace engineering judgement in the field
Original teaching assumptions: pathDifference=v*dt=5000 m/s*0.002 s=10 m, not a unique source position.
All elastic energy in the rock ultimately becomes ejected-rock kinetic energy

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: pathDifference=v*dt=5000 m/s*0.002 s=10 m, not a unique source position. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 微震到時與位置不確定度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「微震到時與位置不確定度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「時間偏差被當成震源移動，使風險區域被錯誤定位」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check station clocks, coupling and location residuals against independently known reference events. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Timing bias appears as source migration and mislocates the area of concern. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現時間偏差被當成震源移動，使風險區域被錯誤定位，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check station clocks, coupling and location residuals against independently known reference events. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If timing bias appears as source migration and mislocates the area of concern, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時間偏差被當成震源移動，使風險區域被錯誤定位。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Timing bias appears as source migration and mislocates the area of concern. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「時間偏差被當成震源移動，使風險區域被錯誤定位」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check station clocks, coupling and location residuals against independently known reference events. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Timing bias appears as source migration and mislocates the area of concern. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現時間偏差被當成震源移動，使風險區域被錯誤定位，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Check station clocks, coupling and location residuals against independently known reference events. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If timing bias appears as source migration and mislocates the area of concern, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「微震到時與位置不確定度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
元件峰值拉力大就保證它吸收的能量也大
以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A large peak tensile force guarantees large absorbed energy
Check station clocks, coupling and location residuals against independently known reference events.
quiz.explanation: 以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check station clocks, coupling and location residuals against independently known reference events. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 微震到時與位置不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「微震到時與位置不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時間偏差被當成震源移動，使風險區域被錯誤定位。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Timing bias appears as source migration and mislocates the area of concern. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check station clocks, coupling and location residuals against independently known reference events to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差；若出現時間偏差被當成震源移動，使風險區域被錯誤定位，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If timing bias appears as source migration and mislocates the area of concern, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單支感測器收到訊號就能唯一定位岩爆位置」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One sensor receiving a signal uniquely locates a rockburst" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 時間偏差被當成震源移動，使風險區域被錯誤定位。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以已知參考位置事件檢查各站時鐘、耦合及定位殘差，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Timing bias appears as source migration and mislocates the area of concern. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check station clocks, coupling and location residuals against independently known reference events to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「微震到時與位置不確定度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Microseismic arrivals and location uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 時間偏差被當成震源移動，使風險區域被錯誤定位。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
串聯支護的吸能能力一定等於最小元件額定能量

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Serial support energy capacity always equals the smallest component energy rating

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「串聯力鏈與容量區分」與「事件計數與偵測完整度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Serial force paths and capacity distinctions" and "Event counts and detection completeness": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 串聯力鏈與容量區分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Serial force paths and capacity distinctions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「串聯力鏈與容量區分」如何影響岩爆監測與卸壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Serial force paths and capacity distinctions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想同軸串聯元件承受相同靜態拉力，因此最小力容量限制該理想力鏈。動態吸能卻是每一元件力位移積分，不存在一般性的最小能量法則；同一系統可能因連接位移限制而無法動員某元件的試驗吸能。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐段核對傳力方向、靜態容量及各元件可用位移；若出現以最小額定能量代替系統動態分析，忽略不同元件行程，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「串聯力鏈與容量區分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ideal collinear serial components carry the same static force, making the smallest force capacity a limit for that ideal chain. Dynamic energy depends on each force-displacement integral, without a general minimum-energy rule. Connection travel may prevent engagement of a component's tested absorption capacity. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit force directions, static limits and available displacement for each component. If using minimum rated energy as system capacity ignores differing component travel, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Serial force paths and capacity distinctions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：staticForceCeiling=min(300,180,250) kN=180 kN; not a dynamic-energy prediction。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: staticForceCeiling=min(300,180,250) kN=180 kN; not a dynamic-energy prediction.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「串聯支護的吸能能力一定等於最小元件額定能量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Serial support energy capacity always equals the smallest component energy rating" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「串聯力鏈與容量區分」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Ideal collinear serial components carry the same static force, making the smallest force capacity a limit for that ideal chain. Dynamic energy depends on each force-displacement integral, without a general minimum-energy rule.

knowledge.text: 誤解：串聯支護的吸能能力一定等於最小元件額定能量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.instructionEn: Using minimum rated energy as system capacity ignores differing component travel. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 事件計數與偵測完整度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Event counts and detection completeness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「事件計數與偵測完整度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Event counts and detection completeness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「感測器離線造成事件變少，被誤認為岩體活動降低」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare sensor availability, noise and events within a consistent detectable range. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Offline sensors reduce event counts and falsely suggest quieter rock behaviour. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現感測器離線造成事件變少，被誤認為岩體活動降低，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If offline sensors reduce event counts and falsely suggest quieter rock behaviour, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：感測器離線造成事件變少，被誤認為岩體活動降低。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Offline sensors reduce event counts and falsely suggest quieter rock behaviour. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 事件計數與偵測完整度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Event counts and detection completeness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「事件計數與偵測完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Event counts and detection completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 感測器離線造成事件變少，被誤認為岩體活動降低。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Offline sensors reduce event counts and falsely suggest quieter rock behaviour. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare sensor availability, noise and events within a consistent detectable range to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照感測器在線率、噪音水準及同尺度事件分布；若出現感測器離線造成事件變少，被誤認為岩體活動降低，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If offline sensors reduce event counts and falsely suggest quieter rock behaviour, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「微震事件減少就必定代表施工區更加安全」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fewer microseismic events necessarily mean the work area is safer" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「事件計數與偵測完整度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
High warning accuracy can replace engineering judgement in the field
Offline sensors reduce event counts and falsely suggest quieter rock behaviour.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「監測融合與決策證據」與「事件後剩餘行程與復核」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Monitoring integration and decision evidence" and "Post-event remaining stroke and requalification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 監測融合與決策證據：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Monitoring integration and decision evidence: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「監測融合與決策證據」如何影響岩爆監測與卸壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Monitoring integration and decision evidence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聲學訊號、收斂、岩片剝落及應力估計各觀察不同物理量，彼此不一致時需要診斷而非多數決。預警模型的誤報和漏報都與資料族群有關，不能用訓練準確率代替現地驗證；責任人必須知道哪些通道失效或尚未校核。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將警報逐件與觀察結果及資料缺口對照並保留未確認事件；若出現只統計已確認警報而忽略漏報，使預警可靠性被高估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「監測融合與決策證據」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acoustic signals, convergence, spalling and stress estimates measure different phenomena; disagreement needs diagnosis rather than majority voting. False alarms and misses depend on the data population, so training accuracy is not field validation. Decision owners need visibility of failed or unverified channels. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare each alert with observations and data gaps while retaining unconfirmed events. If counting confirmed alerts but ignoring misses overstates warning reliability, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Monitoring integration and decision evidence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 監測融合與決策證據：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Monitoring integration and decision evidence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「監測融合與決策證據」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Monitoring integration and decision evidence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將警報逐件與觀察結果及資料缺口對照並保留未確認事件。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只統計已確認警報而忽略漏報，使預警可靠性被高估」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare each alert with observations and data gaps while retaining unconfirmed events. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Counting confirmed alerts but ignoring misses overstates warning reliability. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將警報逐件與觀察結果及資料缺口對照並保留未確認事件列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只統計已確認警報而忽略漏報，使預警可靠性被高估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare each alert with observations and data gaps while retaining unconfirmed events. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If counting confirmed alerts but ignoring misses overstates warning reliability, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只統計已確認警報而忽略漏報，使預警可靠性被高估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting confirmed alerts but ignoring misses overstates warning reliability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「監測融合與決策證據」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Monitoring integration and decision evidence"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
單支感測器收到訊號就能唯一定位岩爆位置
將警報逐件與觀察結果及資料缺口對照並保留未確認事件。

One sensor receiving a signal uniquely locates a rockburst
Compare each alert with observations and data gaps while retaining unconfirmed events.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare each alert with observations and data gaps while retaining unconfirmed events. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 監測融合與決策證據：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Monitoring integration and decision evidence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「監測融合與決策證據」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Monitoring integration and decision evidence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只統計已確認警報而忽略漏報，使預警可靠性被高估。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將警報逐件與觀察結果及資料缺口對照並保留未確認事件，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting confirmed alerts but ignoring misses overstates warning reliability. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare each alert with observations and data gaps while retaining unconfirmed events to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將警報逐件與觀察結果及資料缺口對照並保留未確認事件；若出現只統計已確認警報而忽略漏報，使預警可靠性被高估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If counting confirmed alerts but ignoring misses overstates warning reliability, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預警準確率很高就可取代現場工程判斷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High warning accuracy can replace engineering judgement in the field" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Counting confirmed alerts but ignoring misses overstates warning reliability. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare each alert with observations and data gaps while retaining unconfirmed events to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「監測融合與決策證據」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Monitoring integration and decision evidence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只統計已確認警報而忽略漏報，使預警可靠性被高估。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
原額定能量減事件能量就能保證剩餘支護能力
optionsEn: Counting confirmed alerts but ignoring misses overstates warning reliability.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Original rated energy minus event energy guarantees remaining support capacity
quiz.explanation: 只統計已確認警報而忽略漏報，使預警可靠性被高估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting confirmed alerts but ignoring misses overstates warning reliability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 事件後剩餘行程與復核：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-event remaining stroke and requalification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「事件後剩餘行程與復核」如何影響岩爆監測與卸壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-event remaining stroke and requalification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rockburst monitoring and pressure-relief support”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 事件後外觀完整不代表元件仍保有原容量，讓壓行程、錨固損傷和接頭變形都可能已消耗。只有經校準且仍符合假設的恆力元件，才能用剩餘行程乘力估剩餘功；不能直接從原額定能量扣掉估計事件能量來宣稱剩餘安全。 判別這個機制時，應觀察檢查讓壓剩餘行程、錨固及接頭損傷並由負責技師重核；若出現元件已耗盡行程卻沿用原額定容量，後續事件突然脆斷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「事件後剩餘行程與復核」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An intact appearance does not preserve original capacity after stroke consumption, anchor damage or connection deformation. Remaining force times travel applies only to a calibrated constant-force element still meeting its assumptions. Subtracting estimated event energy from an original rating does not establish residual safety. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Inspect remaining stroke, anchorage and connection damage for engineer-led requalification. If an exhausted component retains its original rating on paper and fails abruptly in the next event, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Post-event remaining stroke and requalification” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：remainingWork=calibratedForce*remainingStroke=150 kN*0.08 m=12 kJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: remainingWork=calibratedForce*remainingStroke=150 kN*0.08 m=12 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「原額定能量減事件能量就能保證剩餘支護能力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Original rated energy minus event energy guarantees remaining support capacity" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「事件後剩餘行程與復核」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Post-event remaining stroke and requalification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 事件後剩餘行程與復核
knowledge.text: 事件後外觀完整不代表元件仍保有原容量，讓壓行程、錨固損傷和接頭變形都可能已消耗。只有經校準且仍符合假設的恆力元件，才能用剩餘行程乘力估剩餘功；不能直接從原額定能量扣掉估計事件能量來宣稱剩餘安全。
knowledge.textEn: An intact appearance does not preserve original capacity after stroke consumption, anchor damage or connection deformation. Remaining force times travel applies only to a calibrated constant-force element still meeting its assumptions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：原額定能量減事件能量就能保證剩餘支護能力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Original rated energy minus event energy guarantees remaining support capacity Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「事件後剩餘行程與復核」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-event remaining stroke and requalification" is correct?
options: 原額定能量減事件能量就能保證剩餘支護能力
事件後外觀完整不代表元件仍保有原容量，讓壓行程、錨固損傷和接頭變形都可能已消耗。
所有岩體彈性能最後都會成為拋石動能
optionsEn: Original rated energy minus event energy guarantees remaining support capacity
An intact appearance does not preserve original capacity after stroke consumption, anchor damage or connection deformation.
All elastic energy in the rock ultimately becomes ejected-rock kinetic energy
quiz.explanation: 事件後外觀完整不代表元件仍保有原容量，讓壓行程、錨固損傷和接頭變形都可能已消耗。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An intact appearance does not preserve original capacity after stroke consumption, anchor damage or connection deformation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 事件後剩餘行程與復核：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-event remaining stroke and requalification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「事件後剩餘行程與復核」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-event remaining stroke and requalification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：remainingWork=calibratedForce*remainingStroke=150 kN*0.08 m=12 kJ。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: remainingWork=calibratedForce*remainingStroke=150 kN*0.08 m=12 kJ. Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查讓壓剩餘行程、錨固及接頭損傷並由負責技師重核。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect remaining stroke, anchorage and connection damage for engineer-led requalification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：remainingWork=calibratedForce*remainingStroke=150 kN*0.08 m=12 kJ。靜態強度、動態吸能及事件預警是不同證據，不可互相替代。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

Static strength, dynamic energy absorption and event warning are distinct evidence and are not interchangeable. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

Drop-weight potential energy equals energy absorbed solely by the tested bolt

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將檢查讓壓剩餘行程、錨固及接頭損傷並由負責技師重核列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現元件已耗盡行程卻沿用原額定容量，後續事件突然脆斷，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Inspect remaining stroke, anchorage and connection damage for engineer-led requalification. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an exhausted component retains its original rating on paper and fails abruptly in the next event, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：元件已耗盡行程卻沿用原額定容量，後續事件突然脆斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An exhausted component retains its original rating on paper and fails abruptly in the next event. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 檢查讓壓剩餘行程、錨固及接頭損傷並由負責技師重核。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「元件已耗盡行程卻沿用原額定容量，後續事件突然脆斷」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect remaining stroke, anchorage and connection damage for engineer-led requalification. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An exhausted component retains its original rating on paper and fails abruptly in the next event. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將檢查讓壓剩餘行程、錨固及接頭損傷並由負責技師重核列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現元件已耗盡行程卻沿用原額定容量，後續事件突然脆斷，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Inspect remaining stroke, anchorage and connection damage for engineer-led requalification. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an exhausted component retains its original rating on paper and fails abruptly in the next event, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「事件後剩餘行程與復核」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-event remaining stroke and requalification"?
options: 檢查讓壓剩餘行程、錨固及接頭損傷並由負責技師重核。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
串聯支護的吸能能力一定等於最小元件額定能量
optionsEn: Inspect remaining stroke, anchorage and connection damage for engineer-led requalification.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Serial support energy capacity always equals the smallest component energy rating
quiz.explanation: 檢查讓壓剩餘行程、錨固及接頭損傷並由負責技師重核。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inspect remaining stroke, anchorage and connection damage for engineer-led requalification. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 事件後剩餘行程與復核：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-event remaining stroke and requalification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「事件後剩餘行程與復核」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post-event remaining stroke and requalification” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 元件已耗盡行程卻沿用原額定容量，後續事件突然脆斷。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到檢查讓壓剩餘行程、錨固及接頭損傷並由負責技師重核，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An exhausted component retains its original rating on paper and fails abruptly in the next event. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to inspect remaining stroke, anchorage and connection damage for engineer-led requalification to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察檢查讓壓剩餘行程、錨固及接頭損傷並由負責技師重核；若出現元件已耗盡行程卻沿用原額定容量，後續事件突然脆斷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If an exhausted component retains its original rating on paper and fails abruptly in the next event, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「原額定能量減事件能量就能保證剩餘支護能力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Original rated energy minus event energy guarantees remaining support capacity" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 元件已耗盡行程卻沿用原額定容量，後續事件突然脆斷。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到檢查讓壓剩餘行程、錨固及接頭損傷並由負責技師重核，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: An exhausted component retains its original rating on paper and fails abruptly in the next event. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to inspect remaining stroke, anchorage and connection damage for engineer-led requalification to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「事件後剩餘行程與復核」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-event remaining stroke and requalification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
元件已耗盡行程卻沿用原額定容量，後續事件突然脆斷。
所有岩體彈性能最後都會成為拋石動能
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An exhausted component retains its original rating on paper and fails abruptly in the next event.
All elastic energy in the rock ultimately becomes ejected-rock kinetic energy
quiz.explanation: 元件已耗盡行程卻沿用原額定容量，後續事件突然脆斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An exhausted component retains its original rating on paper and fails abruptly in the next event. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 擠壓性地層讓壓支護
summary: 本課以把擠壓地層收斂、讓壓行程與支護時序連成設計模型為主線，從應力強度比與初篩與收斂拘束與交會點建立系統邊界，再把收斂速率與時效、噴層間隙與局部壓碎連到觀察法與調整證據。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on link squeezing-ground convergence, yielding travel and support timing. It begins with Stress-strength ratio and screening and Convergence-confinement intersection, links Convergence rate and time dependence and Shotcrete slots and local crushing, and ends with Observational design and adjustment evidence. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查應力強度比與初篩：sigmaV=gamma*H=26 kN/m3*500 m=13 MPa; ratio=13/3=4.33；再獨立檢查收斂拘束與交會點：supportPressure=k*(u-u0)=20 MPa/m*(0.08-0.03) m=1.0 MPa。覆土由 500 增為 600 m、單位重 26 kN/m3，垂直應力由 13 增為 15.6 MPa；對 3 MPa 岩體強度的比由 4.33 變為 5.2，只作初篩。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 將用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Stress-strength ratio and screening: sigmaV=gamma*H=26 kN/m3*500 m=13 MPa; ratio=13/3=4.33. Independently check Convergence-confinement intersection: supportPressure=k*(u-u0)=20 MPa/m*(0.08-0.03) m=1.0 MPa. At 26 kN/m3, cover rising from 500 to 600 m raises vertical stress from 13 to 15.6 MPa and its ratio to 3 MPa rock-mass strength from 4.33 to 5.2, for screening only. The two results are not a complete design because squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. Use test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「應力強度比與初篩」與「收斂拘束與交會點」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stress-strength ratio and screening" and "Convergence-confinement intersection": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 應力強度比與初篩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stress-strength ratio and screening: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「應力強度比與初篩」如何影響擠壓性地層讓壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stress-strength ratio and screening” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Yielding support in squeezing ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高覆土應力與低岩體強度的組合可能造成大變形，但垂直應力不代表完整三維應力場。完整岩樣強度也不同於節理岩體強度，將兩者混用會高估地層能力；比值只協助比較調查情境，不能單獨決定讓壓構件和開挖尺寸。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將原位應力方向、岩體分級與試樣強度分別列示；若出現把完整岩樣強度當岩體強度，低估節理控制的大變形，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「應力強度比與初篩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: High cover stress combined with weak rock mass can produce large deformation, but vertical stress is not the full three-dimensional field. Intact-sample strength differs from jointed-rock strength. The ratio helps compare investigation scenarios but cannot alone determine yielding components or excavation geometry. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Report in-situ stress direction, rock-mass characterization and specimen strength separately. If using intact strength for the rock mass understates joint-controlled deformation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stress-strength ratio and screening” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：sigmaV=gamma*H=26 kN/m3*500 m=13 MPa; ratio=13/3=4.33。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: sigmaV=gamma*H=26 kN/m3*500 m=13 MPa; ratio=13/3=4.33.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「應力強度比一個數字就能完全預測擠壓量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One stress-strength ratio completely predicts squeezing deformation" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「應力強度比與初篩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Stress-strength ratio and screening”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 應力強度比與初篩
knowledge.text: 高覆土應力與低岩體強度的組合可能造成大變形，但垂直應力不代表完整三維應力場。完整岩樣強度也不同於節理岩體強度，將兩者混用會高估地層能力；比值只協助比較調查情境，不能單獨決定讓壓構件和開挖尺寸。
knowledge.textEn: High cover stress combined with weak rock mass can produce large deformation, but vertical stress is not the full three-dimensional field. Intact-sample strength differs from jointed-rock strength.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：應力強度比一個數字就能完全預測擠壓量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One stress-strength ratio completely predicts squeezing deformation Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「應力強度比與初篩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stress-strength ratio and screening" is correct?
options: 應力強度比一個數字就能完全預測擠壓量
高覆土應力與低岩體強度的組合可能造成大變形，但垂直應力不代表完整三維應力場。
把支護做得最硬就一定能使總變形最小
optionsEn: One stress-strength ratio completely predicts squeezing deformation
High cover stress combined with weak rock mass can produce large deformation, but vertical stress is not the full three-dimensional field.
The stiffest possible support always minimizes total deformation
quiz.explanation: 高覆土應力與低岩體強度的組合可能造成大變形，但垂直應力不代表完整三維應力場。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: High cover stress combined with weak rock mass can produce large deformation, but vertical stress is not the full three-dimensional field. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 應力強度比與初篩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stress-strength ratio and screening: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「應力強度比與初篩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stress-strength ratio and screening” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：sigmaV=gamma*H=26 kN/m3*500 m=13 MPa; ratio=13/3=4.33。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: sigmaV=gamma*H=26 kN/m3*500 m=13 MPa; ratio=13/3=4.33. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將原位應力方向、岩體分級與試樣強度分別列示。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Report in-situ stress direction, rock-mass characterization and specimen strength separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：sigmaV=gamma*H=26 kN/m3*500 m=13 MPa; ratio=13/3=4.33。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: sigmaV=gamma*H=26 kN/m3*500 m=13 MPa; ratio=13/3=4.33. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 應力強度比與初篩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stress-strength ratio and screening: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「應力強度比與初篩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stress-strength ratio and screening” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將原位應力方向、岩體分級與試樣強度分別列示。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把完整岩樣強度當岩體強度，低估節理控制的大變形」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Report in-situ stress direction, rock-mass characterization and specimen strength separately. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Using intact strength for the rock mass understates joint-controlled deformation. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將原位應力方向、岩體分級與試樣強度分別列示列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把完整岩樣強度當岩體強度，低估節理控制的大變形，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Report in-situ stress direction, rock-mass characterization and specimen strength separately. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If using intact strength for the rock mass understates joint-controlled deformation, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把完整岩樣強度當岩體強度，低估節理控制的大變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using intact strength for the rock mass understates joint-controlled deformation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 應力強度比與初篩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stress-strength ratio and screening: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「應力強度比與初篩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stress-strength ratio and screening” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把完整岩樣強度當岩體強度，低估節理控制的大變形。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將原位應力方向、岩體分級與試樣強度分別列示，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using intact strength for the rock mass understates joint-controlled deformation. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to report in-situ stress direction, rock-mass characterization and specimen strength separately to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將原位應力方向、岩體分級與試樣強度分別列示；若出現把完整岩樣強度當岩體強度，低估節理控制的大變形，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If using intact strength for the rock mass understates joint-controlled deformation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「應力強度比一個數字就能完全預測擠壓量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One stress-strength ratio completely predicts squeezing deformation" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把完整岩樣強度當岩體強度，低估節理控制的大變形。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將原位應力方向、岩體分級與試樣強度分別列示，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to report in-situ stress direction, rock-mass characterization and specimen strength separately to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「應力強度比與初篩」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stress-strength ratio and screening" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把完整岩樣強度當岩體強度，低估節理控制的大變形。
把支護做得最硬就一定能使總變形最小
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using intact strength for the rock mass understates joint-controlled deformation.
The stiffest possible support always minimizes total deformation
quiz.explanation: 把完整岩樣強度當岩體強度，低估節理控制的大變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using intact strength for the rock mass understates joint-controlled deformation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 收斂拘束與交會點：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Convergence-confinement intersection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「收斂拘束與交會點」如何影響擠壓性地層讓壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Convergence-confinement intersection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Yielding support in squeezing ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地層反應曲線和支護曲線的交會描述特定假設下的平衡，安裝前收斂決定支護曲線起點。兩條曲線不是材料常數，開挖三維效應和時效會改變位置；比較方案必須固定地層模型，並保留支護介入時已發生的變形。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較安裝時位移零點、後續收斂及支護反力曲線；若出現忽略安裝前變形讓支護反力起算過早，誤判剛度效果，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「收斂拘束與交會點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The ground-support curve intersection describes equilibrium under specified assumptions, with preinstallation convergence setting the support origin. Neither curve is a universal material constant. Three-dimensional excavation and time shift them, so compare schemes under consistent ground assumptions and retain deformation before support engagement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare installation displacement zero, subsequent convergence and support reaction curves. If ignoring preinstallation motion starts support loading too early and misjudges stiffness effects, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Convergence-confinement intersection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：supportPressure=k*(u-u0)=20 MPa/m*(0.08-0.03) m=1.0 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: supportPressure=k*(u-u0)=20 MPa/m*(0.08-0.03) m=1.0 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把支護做得最硬就一定能使總變形最小」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The stiffest possible support always minimizes total deformation" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「收斂拘束與交會點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Convergence-confinement intersection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 收斂拘束與交會點
knowledge.text: 地層反應曲線和支護曲線的交會描述特定假設下的平衡，安裝前收斂決定支護曲線起點。兩條曲線不是材料常數，開挖三維效應和時效會改變位置；比較方案必須固定地層模型，並保留支護介入時已發生的變形。
knowledge.textEn: The ground-support curve intersection describes equilibrium under specified assumptions, with preinstallation convergence setting the support origin. Neither curve is a universal material constant.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：把支護做得最硬就一定能使總變形最小 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The stiffest possible support always minimizes total deformation Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「收斂拘束與交會點」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Convergence-confinement intersection" is correct?
options: 把支護做得最硬就一定能使總變形最小
元件可以讓壓就代表它的變形行程沒有上限
地層反應曲線和支護曲線的交會描述特定假設下的平衡，安裝前收斂決定支護曲線起點。
optionsEn: The stiffest possible support always minimizes total deformation
A yielding component has unlimited available deformation travel
The ground-support curve intersection describes equilibrium under specified assumptions, with preinstallation convergence setting the support origin.
quiz.explanation: 地層反應曲線和支護曲線的交會描述特定假設下的平衡，安裝前收斂決定支護曲線起點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 收斂拘束與交會點：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Convergence-confinement intersection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「收斂拘束與交會點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Convergence-confinement intersection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：supportPressure=k*(u-u0)=20 MPa/m*(0.08-0.03) m=1.0 MPa。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: supportPressure=k*(u-u0)=20 MPa/m*(0.08-0.03) m=1.0 MPa. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較安裝時位移零點、後續收斂及支護反力曲線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare installation displacement zero, subsequent convergence and support reaction curves.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

steps.title: 收斂拘束與交會點：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「收斂拘束與交會點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Convergence-confinement intersection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較安裝時位移零點、後續收斂及支護反力曲線。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「忽略安裝前變形讓支護反力起算過早，誤判剛度效果」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare installation displacement zero, subsequent convergence and support reaction curves. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Ignoring preinstallation motion starts support loading too early and misjudges stiffness effects. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較安裝時位移零點、後續收斂及支護反力曲線列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現忽略安裝前變形讓支護反力起算過早，誤判剛度效果，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare installation displacement zero, subsequent convergence and support reaction curves. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If ignoring preinstallation motion starts support loading too early and misjudges stiffness effects, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略安裝前變形讓支護反力起算過早，誤判剛度效果。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring preinstallation motion starts support loading too early and misjudges stiffness effects. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
