quiz.question: 要驗證「收斂拘束與交會點」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Convergence-confinement intersection"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較安裝時位移零點、後續收斂及支護反力曲線。
短期收斂速率低就能證明永久襯砌永不增載
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare installation displacement zero, subsequent convergence and support reaction curves.
A low short-term rate proves permanent lining loads will never increase
quiz.explanation: 比較安裝時位移零點、後續收斂及支護反力曲線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare installation displacement zero, subsequent convergence and support reaction curves. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 收斂拘束與交會點：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Convergence-confinement intersection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「收斂拘束與交會點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Convergence-confinement intersection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略安裝前變形讓支護反力起算過早，誤判剛度效果。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較安裝時位移零點、後續收斂及支護反力曲線，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring preinstallation motion starts support loading too early and misjudges stiffness effects. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare installation displacement zero, subsequent convergence and support reaction curves to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較安裝時位移零點、後續收斂及支護反力曲線；若出現忽略安裝前變形讓支護反力起算過早，誤判剛度效果，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If ignoring preinstallation motion starts support loading too early and misjudges stiffness effects, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「把支護做得最硬就一定能使總變形最小」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The stiffest possible support always minimizes total deformation" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略安裝前變形讓支護反力起算過早，誤判剛度效果。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較安裝時位移零點、後續收斂及支護反力曲線，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring preinstallation motion starts support loading too early and misjudges stiffness effects. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare installation displacement zero, subsequent convergence and support reaction curves to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「收斂拘束與交會點」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Convergence-confinement intersection" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
元件可以讓壓就代表它的變形行程沒有上限
忽略安裝前變形讓支護反力起算過早，誤判剛度效果。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A yielding component has unlimited available deformation travel
Ignoring preinstallation motion starts support loading too early and misjudges stiffness effects.
quiz.explanation: 忽略安裝前變形讓支護反力起算過早，誤判剛度效果。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring preinstallation motion starts support loading too early and misjudges stiffness effects. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「讓壓平台與行程需求」與「預留變形與淨空消耗」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Yielding plateau and travel demand" and "Deformation allowance and clearance consumption": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 讓壓平台與行程需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Yielding plateau and travel demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「讓壓平台與行程需求」如何影響擠壓性地層讓壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Yielding plateau and travel demand” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Yielding support in squeezing ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 讓壓元件在變形中維持反力，目的是避免剛性支護過早超載，同時保留必要拘束。平台力太低可能無法穩住地層，行程太短則很快轉為高剛度；需把力、行程與地層預期收斂一起比較，不能只選最大吸能值。 判別這個機制時，應觀察記錄平台力、實際行程及行程末端的剛度改變；若出現讓壓行程耗盡後反力陡增，導致相鄰噴層壓碎，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「讓壓平台與行程需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A yielding element maintains restraint while deforming to avoid premature overload of rigid support. Too little force may not stabilize ground; too little travel quickly returns to high stiffness. Compare force and stroke against expected convergence rather than selecting the largest energy rating alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record plateau force, actual travel and stiffness change near the stroke end. If exhausted yielding travel sharply raises reaction and crushes adjacent shotcrete, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Yielding plateau and travel demand” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：yieldWork=Fy*stroke=200 kN*0.15 m=30 kJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: yieldWork=Fy*stroke=200 kN*0.15 m=30 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「元件可以讓壓就代表它的變形行程沒有上限」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A yielding component has unlimited available deformation travel" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「讓壓平台與行程需求」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Yielding plateau and travel demand”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 讓壓平台與行程需求
knowledge.text: 讓壓元件在變形中維持反力，目的是避免剛性支護過早超載，同時保留必要拘束。平台力太低可能無法穩住地層，行程太短則很快轉為高剛度；需把力、行程與地層預期收斂一起比較，不能只選最大吸能值。
knowledge.textEn: A yielding element maintains restraint while deforming to avoid premature overload of rigid support. Too little force may not stabilize ground; too little travel quickly returns to high stiffness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：元件可以讓壓就代表它的變形行程沒有上限 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A yielding component has unlimited available deformation travel Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「讓壓平台與行程需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Yielding plateau and travel demand" is correct?
options: 讓壓元件在變形中維持反力，目的是避免剛性支護過早超載，同時保留必要拘束。
元件可以讓壓就代表它的變形行程沒有上限
平均收斂未超預留值就代表所有位置都不侵限
optionsEn: A yielding element maintains restraint while deforming to avoid premature overload of rigid support.
A yielding component has unlimited available deformation travel
Mean convergence within allowance proves no local clearance intrusion
quiz.explanation: 讓壓元件在變形中維持反力，目的是避免剛性支護過早超載，同時保留必要拘束。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A yielding element maintains restraint while deforming to avoid premature overload of rigid support. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 讓壓平台與行程需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Yielding plateau and travel demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「讓壓平台與行程需求」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Yielding plateau and travel demand” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：yieldWork=Fy*stroke=200 kN*0.15 m=30 kJ。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: yieldWork=Fy*stroke=200 kN*0.15 m=30 kJ. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄平台力、實際行程及行程末端的剛度改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record plateau force, actual travel and stiffness change near the stroke end.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：yieldWork=Fy*stroke=200 kN*0.15 m=30 kJ。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「讓壓平台與行程需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Yielding plateau and travel demand", which statement holds?
options: 每個接頭名義行程相加就是任何方向可用收斂
原創教學假設：yieldWork=Fy*stroke=200 kN*0.15 m=30 kJ。
反算曲線吻合就代表地層參數已唯一確定
optionsEn: Adding nominal joint strokes gives available convergence in every direction
Original teaching assumptions: yieldWork=Fy*stroke=200 kN*0.15 m=30 kJ.
A matching back-analysis curve uniquely determines the ground parameters
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：yieldWork=Fy*stroke=200 kN*0.15 m=30 kJ。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: yieldWork=Fy*stroke=200 kN*0.15 m=30 kJ. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Yielding plateau and travel demand” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 讓壓行程耗盡後反力陡增，導致相鄰噴層壓碎。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到記錄平台力、實際行程及行程末端的剛度改變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Exhausted yielding travel sharply raises reaction and crushes adjacent shotcrete. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record plateau force, actual travel and stiffness change near the stroke end to discriminate the cause. steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If exhausted yielding travel sharply raises reaction and crushes adjacent shotcrete, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「元件可以讓壓就代表它的變形行程沒有上限」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 預留變形與淨空消耗：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「預留變形與淨空消耗」如何影響擠壓性地層讓壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deformation allowance and clearance consumption” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Yielding support in squeezing ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 預留變形需要在開挖尺寸、支護厚度和永久淨空之間分配，不是任意放大洞徑。實際收斂可能不對稱，圓形平均半徑只會顯示總量而漏掉局部侵限；應用全斷面幾何檢核剩餘空間與後續襯砌需求。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以各時期全斷面掃描比較預留量及永久襯砌輪廓；若出現局部收斂侵入襯砌空間，平均變形量卻仍在範圍內，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「預留變形與淨空消耗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Deformation allowance must be allocated among excavation, support and permanent clearance rather than simply enlarging the opening. Convergence can be asymmetric, so a mean radius hides local intrusion. Use complete profiles to assess remaining space and future lining requirements. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare full-section scans with allowances and permanent-lining geometry. If local convergence consumes lining space while mean movement still appears acceptable, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Deformation allowance and clearance consumption” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：remainingAllowance=reserved-convergence=0.20 m-0.14 m=0.06 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: remainingAllowance=reserved-convergence=0.20 m-0.14 m=0.06 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均收斂未超預留值就代表所有位置都不侵限」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mean convergence within allowance proves no local clearance intrusion" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「預留變形與淨空消耗」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Deformation allowance and clearance consumption”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Deformation allowance must be allocated among excavation, support and permanent clearance rather than simply enlarging the opening. Convergence can be asymmetric, so a mean radius hides local intrusion.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Mean convergence within allowance proves no local clearance intrusion Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

Convergence necessarily stops as soon as the face leaves a monitored zone

quiz.question: 要驗證「預留變形與淨空消耗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Deformation allowance and clearance consumption"?
options: 以各時期全斷面掃描比較預留量及永久襯砌輪廓。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
應力強度比一個數字就能完全預測擠壓量
optionsEn: Compare full-section scans with allowances and permanent-lining geometry.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
One stress-strength ratio completely predicts squeezing deformation
quiz.explanation: 以各時期全斷面掃描比較預留量及永久襯砌輪廓。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare full-section scans with allowances and permanent-lining geometry. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預留變形與淨空消耗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Deformation allowance and clearance consumption: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預留變形與淨空消耗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deformation allowance and clearance consumption” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部收斂侵入襯砌空間，平均變形量卻仍在範圍內。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以各時期全斷面掃描比較預留量及永久襯砌輪廓，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local convergence consumes lining space while mean movement still appears acceptable. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare full-section scans with allowances and permanent-lining geometry to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以各時期全斷面掃描比較預留量及永久襯砌輪廓；若出現局部收斂侵入襯砌空間，平均變形量卻仍在範圍內，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If local convergence consumes lining space while mean movement still appears acceptable, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均收斂未超預留值就代表所有位置都不侵限」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mean convergence within allowance proves no local clearance intrusion" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部收斂侵入襯砌空間，平均變形量卻仍在範圍內。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以各時期全斷面掃描比較預留量及永久襯砌輪廓，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare full-section scans with allowances and permanent-lining geometry to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預留變形與淨空消耗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Deformation allowance and clearance consumption" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
局部收斂侵入襯砌空間，平均變形量卻仍在範圍內。
掌子面離開量測區後收斂就一定立即停止
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Local convergence consumes lining space while mean movement still appears acceptable.
Convergence necessarily stops as soon as the face leaves a monitored zone
quiz.explanation: 局部收斂侵入襯砌空間，平均變形量卻仍在範圍內。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Local convergence consumes lining space while mean movement still appears acceptable. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「收斂速率與時效」與「拱架滑移接頭」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Convergence rate and time dependence" and "Sliding joints in steel ribs": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 收斂速率與時效：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Convergence rate and time dependence: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「收斂速率與時效」如何影響擠壓性地層讓壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Convergence rate and time dependence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Yielding support in squeezing ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 擠壓地層可能在掌子面遠離後繼續變形，速率曲線有助區分短期卸載和持續蠕變。不同量測間隔會把尖峰平均掉，施工停頓也改變時間基準；比較需同時保留距面距離和真實經過時間，不應只按進尺排序。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用固定時間尺度與距面位置共同比較收斂速率；若出現長停機期間的變形被漏記，使後續支護需求低估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「收斂速率與時效」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Squeezing can continue after the face has moved away, and rates help distinguish immediate unloading from continuing creep. Sampling intervals average peaks, while stoppages change elapsed time. Preserve both distance from the face and real time rather than ordering observations solely by advance. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare convergence rates on consistent time intervals and face-relative positions. If unrecorded deformation during a long stoppage understates later support demand, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Convergence rate and time dependence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：rate=(45-30) mm/(6-3) day=5 mm/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rate=(45-30) mm/(6-3) day=5 mm/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「掌子面離開量測區後收斂就一定立即停止」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Convergence necessarily stops as soon as the face leaves a monitored zone" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「收斂速率與時效」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Convergence rate and time dependence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 收斂速率與時效
knowledge.text: 擠壓地層可能在掌子面遠離後繼續變形，速率曲線有助區分短期卸載和持續蠕變。不同量測間隔會把尖峰平均掉，施工停頓也改變時間基準；比較需同時保留距面距離和真實經過時間，不應只按進尺排序。
knowledge.textEn: Squeezing can continue after the face has moved away, and rates help distinguish immediate unloading from continuing creep. Sampling intervals average peaks, while stoppages change elapsed time.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：掌子面離開量測區後收斂就一定立即停止 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Convergence necessarily stops as soon as the face leaves a monitored zone Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「收斂速率與時效」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Convergence rate and time dependence" is correct?
options: 掌子面離開量測區後收斂就一定立即停止
每個接頭名義行程相加就是任何方向可用收斂
擠壓地層可能在掌子面遠離後繼續變形，速率曲線有助區分短期卸載和持續蠕變。
optionsEn: Convergence necessarily stops as soon as the face leaves a monitored zone
Adding nominal joint strokes gives available convergence in every direction
Squeezing can continue after the face has moved away, and rates help distinguish immediate unloading from continuing creep.
quiz.explanation: 擠壓地層可能在掌子面遠離後繼續變形，速率曲線有助區分短期卸載和持續蠕變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Squeezing can continue after the face has moved away, and rates help distinguish immediate unloading from continuing creep. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 收斂速率與時效：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Convergence rate and time dependence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「收斂速率與時效」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Convergence rate and time dependence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：rate=(45-30) mm/(6-3) day=5 mm/day。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: rate=(45-30) mm/(6-3) day=5 mm/day. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用固定時間尺度與距面位置共同比較收斂速率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare convergence rates on consistent time intervals and face-relative positions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：rate=(45-30) mm/(6-3) day=5 mm/day。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: rate=(45-30) mm/(6-3) day=5 mm/day. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「收斂速率與時效」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Convergence rate and time dependence", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：rate=(45-30) mm/(6-3) day=5 mm/day。
反算曲線吻合就代表地層參數已唯一確定
觀察法就是可以依現場感覺隨時更改設計
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: rate=(45-30) mm/(6-3) day=5 mm/day.
A matching back-analysis curve uniquely determines the ground parameters
Observational design means changing the design whenever field intuition suggests it
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：rate=(45-30) mm/(6-3) day=5 mm/day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: rate=(45-30) mm/(6-3) day=5 mm/day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 收斂速率與時效：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Convergence rate and time dependence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「收斂速率與時效」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Convergence rate and time dependence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用固定時間尺度與距面位置共同比較收斂速率。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「長停機期間的變形被漏記，使後續支護需求低估」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare convergence rates on consistent time intervals and face-relative positions. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Unrecorded deformation during a long stoppage understates later support demand. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將用固定時間尺度與距面位置共同比較收斂速率列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現長停機期間的變形被漏記，使後續支護需求低估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare convergence rates on consistent time intervals and face-relative positions. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If unrecorded deformation during a long stoppage understates later support demand, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：長停機期間的變形被漏記，使後續支護需求低估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unrecorded deformation during a long stoppage understates later support demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Unrecorded deformation during a long stoppage understates later support demand. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將用固定時間尺度與距面位置共同比較收斂速率列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現長停機期間的變形被漏記，使後續支護需求低估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If unrecorded deformation during a long stoppage understates later support demand, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
讓壓間隙填得越密實越能提高支護性能
optionsEn: One jammed joint forces excessive slip elsewhere and shifts crown loading.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Filling a yielding slot more densely always improves support performance
quiz.explanation: 單側接頭卡住使其餘位置超滑，拱頂偏心受力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One jammed joint forces excessive slip elsewhere and shifts crown loading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」與「反算參數與可辨識性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shotcrete slots and local crushing" and "Back-analysis and identifiability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 噴層間隙與局部壓碎：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shotcrete slots and local crushing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」如何影響擠壓性地層讓壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shotcrete slots and local crushing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Yielding support in squeezing ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 讓壓間隙允許環向縮短，但間隙端部會產生應力集中，填入不相容材料可能提早鎖死。開縫長度也不能簡單視為均勻應變，因為周圍噴層仍有彎曲與接觸；應把間隙閉合過程和鋼拱滑移一同追蹤。 判別這個機制時，應觀察量測各間隙剩餘寬度、端部裂紋及鄰近鋼拱滑移；若出現砂漿誤填讓壓間隙使反力突然增加並壓碎端部，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Yield slots allow circumferential shortening but concentrate stress at their ends. Incompatible infill can lock them early. Slot closure is not uniform lining strain because adjacent shotcrete still bends and contacts ground; track it alongside steel-rib sliding rather than as an isolated gap. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure remaining slots, end cracks and nearby steel-rib slip. If accidental mortar filling locks a yielding slot and crushes its ends, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Shotcrete slots and local crushing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「讓壓間隙填得越密實越能提高支護性能」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Filling a yielding slot more densely always improves support performance" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Shotcrete slots and local crushing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 噴層間隙與局部壓碎
knowledge.text: 讓壓間隙允許環向縮短，但間隙端部會產生應力集中，填入不相容材料可能提早鎖死。開縫長度也不能簡單視為均勻應變，因為周圍噴層仍有彎曲與接觸；應把間隙閉合過程和鋼拱滑移一同追蹤。
knowledge.textEn: Yield slots allow circumferential shortening but concentrate stress at their ends. Incompatible infill can lock them early.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：讓壓間隙填得越密實越能提高支護性能 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Filling a yielding slot more densely always improves support performance Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shotcrete slots and local crushing" is correct?
options: 讓壓間隙填得越密實越能提高支護性能
讓壓間隙允許環向縮短，但間隙端部會產生應力集中，填入不相容材料可能提早鎖死。
反算曲線吻合就代表地層參數已唯一確定
optionsEn: Filling a yielding slot more densely always improves support performance
Yield slots allow circumferential shortening but concentrate stress at their ends.
A matching back-analysis curve uniquely determines the ground parameters
quiz.explanation: 讓壓間隙允許環向縮短，但間隙端部會產生應力集中，填入不相容材料可能提早鎖死。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Yield slots allow circumferential shortening but concentrate stress at their ends. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 噴層間隙與局部壓碎：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shotcrete slots and local crushing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shotcrete slots and local crushing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測各間隙剩餘寬度、端部裂紋及鄰近鋼拱滑移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure remaining slots, end cracks and nearby steel-rib slip.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shotcrete slots and local crushing", which statement holds?
options: 觀察法就是可以依現場感覺隨時更改設計
把支護做得最硬就一定能使總變形最小
原創教學假設：gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent。
optionsEn: Observational design means changing the design whenever field intuition suggests it
The stiffest possible support always minimizes total deformation
Original teaching assumptions: gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: gapConsumption=closed/initial=35 mm/50 mm=70 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 噴層間隙與局部壓碎：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shotcrete slots and local crushing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shotcrete slots and local crushing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測各間隙剩餘寬度、端部裂紋及鄰近鋼拱滑移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「砂漿誤填讓壓間隙使反力突然增加並壓碎端部」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure remaining slots, end cracks and nearby steel-rib slip. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Accidental mortar filling locks a yielding slot and crushes its ends. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將量測各間隙剩餘寬度、端部裂紋及鄰近鋼拱滑移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現砂漿誤填讓壓間隙使反力突然增加並壓碎端部，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Measure remaining slots, end cracks and nearby steel-rib slip. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If accidental mortar filling locks a yielding slot and crushes its ends, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：砂漿誤填讓壓間隙使反力突然增加並壓碎端部。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Accidental mortar filling locks a yielding slot and crushes its ends. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測各間隙剩餘寬度、端部裂紋及鄰近鋼拱滑移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「砂漿誤填讓壓間隙使反力突然增加並壓碎端部」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Measure remaining slots, end cracks and nearby steel-rib slip. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Accidental mortar filling locks a yielding slot and crushes its ends. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將量測各間隙剩餘寬度、端部裂紋及鄰近鋼拱滑移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現砂漿誤填讓壓間隙使反力突然增加並壓碎端部，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Measure remaining slots, end cracks and nearby steel-rib slip. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If accidental mortar filling locks a yielding slot and crushes its ends, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shotcrete slots and local crushing"?
options: 量測各間隙剩餘寬度、端部裂紋及鄰近鋼拱滑移。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
平均收斂未超預留值就代表所有位置都不侵限
optionsEn: Measure remaining slots, end cracks and nearby steel-rib slip.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Mean convergence within allowance proves no local clearance intrusion
quiz.explanation: 量測各間隙剩餘寬度、端部裂紋及鄰近鋼拱滑移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure remaining slots, end cracks and nearby steel-rib slip. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 噴層間隙與局部壓碎：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shotcrete slots and local crushing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shotcrete slots and local crushing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 砂漿誤填讓壓間隙使反力突然增加並壓碎端部。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到量測各間隙剩餘寬度、端部裂紋及鄰近鋼拱滑移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Accidental mortar filling locks a yielding slot and crushes its ends. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure remaining slots, end cracks and nearby steel-rib slip to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察量測各間隙剩餘寬度、端部裂紋及鄰近鋼拱滑移；若出現砂漿誤填讓壓間隙使反力突然增加並壓碎端部，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If accidental mortar filling locks a yielding slot and crushes its ends, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「讓壓間隙填得越密實越能提高支護性能」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Filling a yielding slot more densely always improves support performance" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 砂漿誤填讓壓間隙使反力突然增加並壓碎端部。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到量測各間隙剩餘寬度、端部裂紋及鄰近鋼拱滑移，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Accidental mortar filling locks a yielding slot and crushes its ends. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure remaining slots, end cracks and nearby steel-rib slip to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「噴層間隙與局部壓碎」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shotcrete slots and local crushing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
砂漿誤填讓壓間隙使反力突然增加並壓碎端部。
反算曲線吻合就代表地層參數已唯一確定
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Accidental mortar filling locks a yielding slot and crushes its ends.
A matching back-analysis curve uniquely determines the ground parameters
quiz.explanation: 砂漿誤填讓壓間隙使反力突然增加並壓碎端部。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Accidental mortar filling locks a yielding slot and crushes its ends. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 反算參數與可辨識性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Back-analysis and identifiability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反算參數與可辨識性」如何影響擠壓性地層讓壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Back-analysis and identifiability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Yielding support in squeezing ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 一條收斂曲線可能由不同地層強度、模數或支護安裝時間組合產生，擬合良好不代表參數唯一。增加支護反力、孔內位移或獨立地質證據才能限制解的範圍；反算應呈現多組可能情境，而非只交一條最漂亮曲線。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力；若出現多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反算參數與可辨識性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different ground strengths, moduli and installation times can reproduce one convergence curve, so fit quality does not imply uniqueness. quiz.question: 關於「反算參數與可辨識性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 反算參數與可辨識性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Back-analysis and identifiability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反算參數與可辨識性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Back-analysis and identifiability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：normalizedResidual=abs(predicted-observed)/observed=abs(48-50)/50=4 percent。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: normalizedResidual=abs(predicted-observed)/observed=abs(48-50)/50=4 percent. Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：normalizedResidual=abs(predicted-observed)/observed=abs(48-50)/50=4 percent。擠壓是高應力下的時間相依變形，不能直接等同材料遇水膨脹。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

Squeezing is stress-driven time-dependent deformation and is not identical to water-induced swelling. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「反算參數與可辨識性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Back-analysis and identifiability", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：normalizedResidual=abs(predicted-observed)/observed=abs(48-50)/50=4 percent。
應力強度比一個數字就能完全預測擠壓量
元件可以讓壓就代表它的變形行程沒有上限
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: normalizedResidual=abs(predicted-observed)/observed=abs(48-50)/50=4 percent.
One stress-strength ratio completely predicts squeezing deformation
A yielding component has unlimited available deformation travel

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: normalizedResidual=abs(predicted-observed)/observed=abs(48-50)/50=4 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 反算參數與可辨識性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Back-analysis and identifiability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反算參數與可辨識性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Back-analysis and identifiability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「反算參數與可辨識性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Back-analysis and identifiability"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力。
掌子面離開量測區後收斂就一定立即停止
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections.
Convergence necessarily stops as soon as the face leaves a monitored zone
quiz.explanation: 用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 反算參數與可辨識性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Back-analysis and identifiability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反算參數與可辨識性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Back-analysis and identifiability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力；若出現多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「反算曲線吻合就代表地層參數已唯一確定」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A matching back-analysis curve uniquely determines the ground parameters" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用保留的獨立量測區段檢驗反算參數的外推能力，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to test back-calculated parameters against withheld independent monitoring sections to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「反算參數與可辨識性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Back-analysis and identifiability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
短期收斂速率低就能證明永久襯砌永不增載
多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A low short-term rate proves permanent lining loads will never increase
Compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground.
quiz.explanation: 多參數互相補償得到良好擬合，遇新地層立即失準。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Compensating parameters produce a good fit but fail immediately in different ground. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「長期荷載與二次襯砌」與「觀察法與調整證據」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Long-term load and secondary lining" and "Observational design and adjustment evidence": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 長期荷載與二次襯砌：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-term load and secondary lining: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「長期荷載與二次襯砌」如何影響擠壓性地層讓壓支護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-term load and secondary lining” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Yielding support in squeezing ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 二次襯砌完成後地層仍可能蠕變，初支和永久結構的分擔取決於接觸、剛度與施工時間。不能因外觀停止變形就假定永久荷載不再增加，儀器解析度也可能掩蓋慢速變化；設計應保留長期監測和可解釋的力學模型。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較長期收斂、接觸水壓及二次襯砌應變的趨勢；若出現短期穩定被當成永久穩定，慢速蠕變逐年消耗淨空，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「長期荷載與二次襯砌」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ground may creep after secondary lining, with load sharing governed by contact, stiffness and timing. Apparently stopped movement does not prove constant permanent demand, and resolution can hide slow trends. Preserve long-term monitoring and an interpretable mechanical model for later comparisons. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare long-term convergence, contact water pressure and secondary-lining strain trends. If short-term stability is treated as permanent while slow creep consumes clearance over years, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Long-term load and secondary lining” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 長期荷載與二次襯砌：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長期荷載與二次襯砌」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.observation: 如何核對：比較長期收斂、接觸水壓及二次襯砌應變的趨勢。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 長期荷載與二次襯砌：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-term load and secondary lining” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較長期收斂、接觸水壓及二次襯砌應變的趨勢。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「短期穩定被當成永久穩定，慢速蠕變逐年消耗淨空」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare long-term convergence, contact water pressure and secondary-lining strain trends. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Short-term stability is treated as permanent while slow creep consumes clearance over years. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：短期穩定被當成永久穩定，慢速蠕變逐年消耗淨空。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 長期荷載與二次襯砌：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-term load and secondary lining” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 短期穩定被當成永久穩定，慢速蠕變逐年消耗淨空。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較長期收斂、接觸水壓及二次襯砌應變的趨勢，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Short-term stability is treated as permanent while slow creep consumes clearance over years. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare long-term convergence, contact water pressure and secondary-lining strain trends to discriminate the cause. steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If short-term stability is treated as permanent while slow creep consumes clearance over years, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「短期收斂速率低就能證明永久襯砌永不增載」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 觀察法與調整證據：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Observational design and adjustment evidence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Yielding support in squeezing ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 觀察法需要事前定義可觀察量、可接受範圍及對應備案，並非看到問題後任意修改。讓壓行程、收斂速率和支護損傷反映不同邊界，調整前必須確認量測有效；版本追蹤可避免不同班組使用互相矛盾的支護假設。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項核對觸發依據、儀器有效性、設計版本及核定責任；若出現失效感測器觸發錯誤支護調整，卻沒有留下決策依據，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「觀察法與調整證據」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Observational design requires predefined observables, acceptable ranges and contingency actions rather than arbitrary changes after trouble. Stroke, convergence rate and damage reveal different boundaries; confirm measurement validity before adjustment. Revision control prevents crews from using contradictory support assumptions. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit trigger evidence, instrument validity, design revision and approval responsibility. If a failed sensor prompts an incorrect support change without a recorded rationale, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Observational design and adjustment evidence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：verifiedTriggerCoverage=verifiedChannels/requiredChannels=5/6=83.3 percent。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Observational design means changing the design whenever field intuition suggests it" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「觀察法與調整證據」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Observational design and adjustment evidence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 觀察法與調整證據
