quiz.explanationEn: Locate active swelling layers using multidepth anchors and geological samples. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 膨脹層厚度與隆起：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Swelling-layer thickness and heave: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「膨脹層厚度與隆起」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Swelling-layer thickness and heave” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把整個覆土當活躍層高估隆起，或漏掉局部薄層差異變形。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用多深度錨點與地層取樣定位膨脹活躍層，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating all cover as active overstates heave while missed thin layers hide differential motion. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to locate active swelling layers using multidepth anchors and geological samples to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察用多深度錨點與地層取樣定位膨脹活躍層；若出現把整個覆土當活躍層高估隆起，或漏掉局部薄層差異變形，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If treating all cover as active overstates heave while missed thin layers hide differential motion, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地表隆起除以總覆土就能得到唯一膨脹率」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Surface heave divided by total cover gives the unique swelling strain" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把整個覆土當活躍層高估隆起，或漏掉局部薄層差異變形。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用多深度錨點與地層取樣定位膨脹活躍層，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Treating all cover as active overstates heave while missed thin layers hide differential motion. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to locate active swelling layers using multidepth anchors and geological samples to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「膨脹層厚度與隆起」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Swelling-layer thickness and heave" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把整個覆土當活躍層高估隆起，或漏掉局部薄層差異變形。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
設置柔軟墊層就能永久消除所有膨脹作用
optionsEn: Treating all cover as active overstates heave while missed thin layers hide differential motion.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A soft layer permanently eliminates every swelling action
quiz.explanation: 把整個覆土當活躍層高估隆起，或漏掉局部薄層差異變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating all cover as active overstates heave while missed thin layers hide differential motion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「仰拱拘束與接觸壓力」與「反應速率與外推」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Invert restraint and contact pressure" and "Reaction rate and extrapolation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 仰拱拘束與接觸壓力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Invert restraint and contact pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「仰拱拘束與接觸壓力」如何影響膨脹性地層隧道設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Invert restraint and contact pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel design in swelling ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 剛性仰拱限制隆起卻可能增加反力，可壓縮層則用變形空間減少部分壓力。兩者是力與位移的取捨，不能假設兼得零隆起與零壓力；設計需檢查可壓縮層耗盡後的行為以及長期水化反應。 判別這個機制時，應觀察量測仰拱隆起、界面壓力與可壓縮層剩餘厚度；若出現可壓縮層耗盡後壓力急增，原先緩慢隆起轉為結構裂損，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「仰拱拘束與接觸壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A stiff invert limits heave but can increase reaction, while a compressible layer trades space for reduced pressure. Zero movement and zero pressure cannot both be assumed. Check behaviour after compressible travel is exhausted and account for continuing long-term hydration. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure invert heave, interface pressure and remaining compressible-layer thickness. If exhausted compression space sharply raises pressure and turns slow heave into cracking, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Invert restraint and contact pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：compressionReserve=layerTravel-usedTravel=100 mm-65 mm=35 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: compressionReserve=layerTravel-usedTravel=100 mm-65 mm=35 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設置柔軟墊層就能永久消除所有膨脹作用」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A soft layer permanently eliminates every swelling action" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「仰拱拘束與接觸壓力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Invert restraint and contact pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 仰拱拘束與接觸壓力
knowledge.text: 剛性仰拱限制隆起卻可能增加反力，可壓縮層則用變形空間減少部分壓力。兩者是力與位移的取捨，不能假設兼得零隆起與零壓力；設計需檢查可壓縮層耗盡後的行為以及長期水化反應。
knowledge.textEn: A stiff invert limits heave but can increase reaction, while a compressible layer trades space for reduced pressure. Zero movement and zero pressure cannot both be assumed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設置柔軟墊層就能永久消除所有膨脹作用 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A soft layer permanently eliminates every swelling action Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「仰拱拘束與接觸壓力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Invert restraint and contact pressure" is correct?
options: 設置柔軟墊層就能永久消除所有膨脹作用
剛性仰拱限制隆起卻可能增加反力，可壓縮層則用變形空間減少部分壓力。
觀察到短期不變就證明膨脹反應已永久結束
optionsEn: A soft layer permanently eliminates every swelling action
A stiff invert limits heave but can increase reaction, while a compressible layer trades space for reduced pressure.
A short period without change proves swelling has permanently ended
quiz.explanation: 剛性仰拱限制隆起卻可能增加反力，可壓縮層則用變形空間減少部分壓力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A stiff invert limits heave but can increase reaction, while a compressible layer trades space for reduced pressure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 仰拱拘束與接觸壓力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Invert restraint and contact pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「仰拱拘束與接觸壓力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Invert restraint and contact pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：compressionReserve=layerTravel-usedTravel=100 mm-65 mm=35 mm。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: compressionReserve=layerTravel-usedTravel=100 mm-65 mm=35 mm. Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測仰拱隆起、界面壓力與可壓縮層剩餘厚度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure invert heave, interface pressure and remaining compressible-layer thickness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：compressionReserve=layerTravel-usedTravel=100 mm-65 mm=35 mm。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「仰拱拘束與接觸壓力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Invert restraint and contact pressure", which statement holds?
options: 裂縫修補完成就代表膨脹地層已經永久穩定
自由膨脹率可以直接換成受限膨脹壓力
原創教學假設：compressionReserve=layerTravel-usedTravel=100 mm-65 mm=35 mm。
optionsEn: Completing crack repairs proves the swelling ground is permanently stable
Free-swell percentage directly converts to restrained swelling pressure
Original teaching assumptions: compressionReserve=layerTravel-usedTravel=100 mm-65 mm=35 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：compressionReserve=layerTravel-usedTravel=100 mm-65 mm=35 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: compressionReserve=layerTravel-usedTravel=100 mm-65 mm=35 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Measure invert heave, interface pressure and remaining compressible-layer thickness. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If exhausted compression space sharply raises pressure and turns slow heave into cracking, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：可壓縮層耗盡後壓力急增，原先緩慢隆起轉為結構裂損。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Exhausted compression space sharply raises pressure and turns slow heave into cracking. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測仰拱隆起、界面壓力與可壓縮層剩餘厚度。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「可壓縮層耗盡後壓力急增，原先緩慢隆起轉為結構裂損」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Measure invert heave, interface pressure and remaining compressible-layer thickness. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Exhausted compression space sharply raises pressure and turns slow heave into cracking. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將量測仰拱隆起、界面壓力與可壓縮層剩餘厚度列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現可壓縮層耗盡後壓力急增，原先緩慢隆起轉為結構裂損，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Measure invert heave, interface pressure and remaining compressible-layer thickness. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If exhausted compression space sharply raises pressure and turns slow heave into cracking, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「仰拱拘束與接觸壓力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Invert restraint and contact pressure"?

量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

optionsEn: Measure invert heave, interface pressure and remaining compressible-layer thickness.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Every deformation after wetting must be caused solely by swelling

quiz.explanationEn: Measure invert heave, interface pressure and remaining compressible-layer thickness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 仰拱拘束與接觸壓力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Invert restraint and contact pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「仰拱拘束與接觸壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Invert restraint and contact pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 可壓縮層耗盡後壓力急增，原先緩慢隆起轉為結構裂損。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到量測仰拱隆起、界面壓力與可壓縮層剩餘厚度，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Exhausted compression space sharply raises pressure and turns slow heave into cracking. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure invert heave, interface pressure and remaining compressible-layer thickness to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If exhausted compression space sharply raises pressure and turns slow heave into cracking, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設置柔軟墊層就能永久消除所有膨脹作用」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A soft layer permanently eliminates every swelling action" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure invert heave, interface pressure and remaining compressible-layer thickness to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「仰拱拘束與接觸壓力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Invert restraint and contact pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
可壓縮層耗盡後壓力急增，原先緩慢隆起轉為結構裂損。

Exhausted compression space sharply raises pressure and turns slow heave into cracking.
A short period without change proves swelling has permanently ended

steps.title: 反應速率與外推：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reaction rate and extrapolation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反應速率與外推」如何影響膨脹性地層隧道設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reaction rate and extrapolation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel design in swelling ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 短期浸水試驗可能只涵蓋快速階段，慢速礦物轉化則持續更久。固定速率外推只能作敏感度練習，反應可能隨水源、溫度或可反應材料耗減而改變；監測應保留完整曲線和停滯區間，避免只取最近兩點。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較長期曲線分段速率與溫度、水位及取樣礦物變化；若出現短期平台被當成反應結束，後續供水恢復後再次隆起，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反應速率與外推」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Short wetting tests can capture a rapid stage while slower transformation continues. Constant-rate extrapolation is only a sensitivity exercise because water, temperature and reactant depletion change rates. Preserve complete curves and pauses rather than interpreting the latest two points alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare long-term segment rates with temperature, head and mineral changes. If a short plateau is treated as reaction completion before heave resumes with renewed water, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reaction rate and extrapolation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：illustrativeHeave=constantRate*time=0.5 mm/month*24 month=12 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: illustrativeHeave=constantRate*time=0.5 mm/month*24 month=12 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「觀察到短期不變就證明膨脹反應已永久結束」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A short period without change proves swelling has permanently ended" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「反應速率與外推」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Reaction rate and extrapolation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 反應速率與外推
knowledge.text: 短期浸水試驗可能只涵蓋快速階段，慢速礦物轉化則持續更久。固定速率外推只能作敏感度練習，反應可能隨水源、溫度或可反應材料耗減而改變；監測應保留完整曲線和停滯區間，避免只取最近兩點。
knowledge.textEn: Short wetting tests can capture a rapid stage while slower transformation continues. Constant-rate extrapolation is only a sensitivity exercise because water, temperature and reactant depletion change rates.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：觀察到短期不變就證明膨脹反應已永久結束 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A short period without change proves swelling has permanently ended Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「反應速率與外推」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Reaction rate and extrapolation" is correct?
options: 觀察到短期不變就證明膨脹反應已永久結束

短期浸水試驗可能只涵蓋快速階段，慢速礦物轉化則持續更久。
optionsEn: A short period without change proves swelling has permanently ended
Lowering groundwater has only beneficial effects for every underground structure
Short wetting tests can capture a rapid stage while slower transformation continues.
quiz.explanation: 短期浸水試驗可能只涵蓋快速階段，慢速礦物轉化則持續更久。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Short wetting tests can capture a rapid stage while slower transformation continues. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 反應速率與外推：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reaction rate and extrapolation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反應速率與外推」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reaction rate and extrapolation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：illustrativeHeave=constantRate*time=0.5 mm/month*24 month=12 mm。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: illustrativeHeave=constantRate*time=0.5 mm/month*24 month=12 mm. Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

Compare long-term segment rates with temperature, head and mineral changes.
Lower measured drainage proves minerals have completely stopped taking up water
quiz.explanation: 比較長期曲線分段速率與溫度、水位及取樣礦物變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare long-term segment rates with temperature, head and mineral changes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 反應速率與外推：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Reaction rate and extrapolation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反應速率與外推」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reaction rate and extrapolation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 短期平台被當成反應結束，後續供水恢復後再次隆起。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較長期曲線分段速率與溫度、水位及取樣礦物變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A short plateau is treated as reaction completion before heave resumes with renewed water. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare long-term segment rates with temperature, head and mineral changes to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較長期曲線分段速率與溫度、水位及取樣礦物變化；若出現短期平台被當成反應結束，後續供水恢復後再次隆起，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a short plateau is treated as reaction completion before heave resumes with renewed water, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「觀察到短期不變就證明膨脹反應已永久結束」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A short period without change proves swelling has permanently ended" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 短期平台被當成反應結束，後續供水恢復後再次隆起。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比較長期曲線分段速率與溫度、水位及取樣礦物變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A short plateau is treated as reaction completion before heave resumes with renewed water. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare long-term segment rates with temperature, head and mineral changes to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「反應速率與外推」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Reaction rate and extrapolation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
降低地下水位對所有地下工程都只有正面效果
短期平台被當成反應結束，後續供水恢復後再次隆起。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Lowering groundwater has only beneficial effects for every underground structure
A short plateau is treated as reaction completion before heave resumes with renewed water.
quiz.explanation: 短期平台被當成反應結束，後續供水恢復後再次隆起。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A short plateau is treated as reaction completion before heave resumes with renewed water. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「排水相容與環境影響」與「長期維護與反應地圖」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drainage compatibility and environmental effects" and "Long-term maintenance and reaction maps": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 排水相容與環境影響：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drainage compatibility and environmental effects: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排水相容與環境影響」如何影響膨脹性地層隧道設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drainage compatibility and environmental effects” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel design in swelling ground”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 抽排水可能減少局部水接觸，但也會改變有效應力、地表沉陷及水化學，不能把降低水位當成無代價方案。膜、排水和結構設計必須使用一致邊界，並考慮長期堵塞；評估應分開水量效果與材料反應效果。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同時監測水位、地表沉陷及仰拱反應而非只看出水量；若出現降水減少膨脹供水卻引起鄰地壓密，單一指標誤判成功，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水相容與環境影響」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drainage can reduce contact but also alters effective stress, settlement and chemistry, so lower head is not consequence-free. Membranes, drains and structural models need compatible boundaries including blockage. Separate hydraulic effects from mineral reaction effects when assessing performance. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Monitor head, surface settlement and invert response rather than discharge alone. If dewatering reduces swelling supply but consolidates nearby ground, misleading a single-metric assessment, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drainage compatibility and environmental effects” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：effectiveStressChange=gammaWater*headDrop=9.81 kN/m3*3 m=29.43 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: effectiveStressChange=gammaWater*headDrop=9.81 kN/m3*3 m=29.43 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「降低地下水位對所有地下工程都只有正面效果」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lowering groundwater has only beneficial effects for every underground structure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排水相容與環境影響」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drainage compatibility and environmental effects”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 排水相容與環境影響
knowledge.text: 抽排水可能減少局部水接觸，但也會改變有效應力、地表沉陷及水化學，不能把降低水位當成無代價方案。膜、排水和結構設計必須使用一致邊界，並考慮長期堵塞；評估應分開水量效果與材料反應效果。
knowledge.textEn: Drainage can reduce contact but also alters effective stress, settlement and chemistry, so lower head is not consequence-free. Membranes, drains and structural models need compatible boundaries including blockage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：降低地下水位對所有地下工程都只有正面效果 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lowering groundwater has only beneficial effects for every underground structure Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「排水相容與環境影響」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drainage compatibility and environmental effects" is correct?
options: 抽排水可能減少局部水接觸，但也會改變有效應力、地表沉陷及水化學，不能把降低水位當成無代價方案。
降低地下水位對所有地下工程都只有正面效果
裂縫修補完成就代表膨脹地層已經永久穩定
optionsEn: Drainage can reduce contact but also alters effective stress, settlement and chemistry, so lower head is not consequence-free.
Lowering groundwater has only beneficial effects for every underground structure
Completing crack repairs proves the swelling ground is permanently stable
quiz.explanation: 抽排水可能減少局部水接觸，但也會改變有效應力、地表沉陷及水化學，不能把降低水位當成無代價方案。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Drainage can reduce contact but also alters effective stress, settlement and chemistry, so lower head is not consequence-free. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 排水相容與環境影響：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drainage compatibility and environmental effects: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排水相容與環境影響」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drainage compatibility and environmental effects” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：effectiveStressChange=gammaWater*headDrop=9.81 kN/m3*3 m=29.43 kPa。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: effectiveStressChange=gammaWater*headDrop=9.81 kN/m3*3 m=29.43 kPa. Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時監測水位、地表沉陷及仰拱反應而非只看出水量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Monitor head, surface settlement and invert response rather than discharge alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：effectiveStressChange=gammaWater*headDrop=9.81 kN/m3*3 m=29.43 kPa。自由膨脹率與受限膨脹壓力屬不同邊界，不能比例互換。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: effectiveStressChange=gammaWater*headDrop=9.81 kN/m3*3 m=29.43 kPa. Free swelling and restrained swelling pressure belong to different boundaries and cannot be converted proportionally. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「排水相容與環境影響」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drainage compatibility and environmental effects", which statement holds?
options: 自由膨脹率可以直接換成受限膨脹壓力
原創教學假設：effectiveStressChange=gammaWater*headDrop=9.81 kN/m3*3 m=29.43 kPa。
遇水後產生的任何變形都只能叫做膨脹
optionsEn: Free-swell percentage directly converts to restrained swelling pressure
Original teaching assumptions: effectiveStressChange=gammaWater*headDrop=9.81 kN/m3*3 m=29.43 kPa.
Every deformation after wetting must be caused solely by swelling
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：effectiveStressChange=gammaWater*headDrop=9.81 kN/m3*3 m=29.43 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: effectiveStressChange=gammaWater*headDrop=9.81 kN/m3*3 m=29.43 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 排水相容與環境影響：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drainage compatibility and environmental effects: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排水相容與環境影響」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drainage compatibility and environmental effects” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時監測水位、地表沉陷及仰拱反應而非只看出水量。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「降水減少膨脹供水卻引起鄰地壓密，單一指標誤判成功」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor head, surface settlement and invert response rather than discharge alone. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Dewatering reduces swelling supply but consolidates nearby ground, misleading a single-metric assessment. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同時監測水位、地表沉陷及仰拱反應而非只看出水量列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現降水減少膨脹供水卻引起鄰地壓密，單一指標誤判成功，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Monitor head, surface settlement and invert response rather than discharge alone. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If dewatering reduces swelling supply but consolidates nearby ground, misleading a single-metric assessment, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：降水減少膨脹供水卻引起鄰地壓密，單一指標誤判成功。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Dewatering reduces swelling supply but consolidates nearby ground, misleading a single-metric assessment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時監測水位、地表沉陷及仰拱反應而非只看出水量。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「降水減少膨脹供水卻引起鄰地壓密，單一指標誤判成功」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Monitor head, surface settlement and invert response rather than discharge alone. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Dewatering reduces swelling supply but consolidates nearby ground, misleading a single-metric assessment. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將同時監測水位、地表沉陷及仰拱反應而非只看出水量列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現降水減少膨脹供水卻引起鄰地壓密，單一指標誤判成功，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Monitor head, surface settlement and invert response rather than discharge alone. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If dewatering reduces swelling supply but consolidates nearby ground, misleading a single-metric assessment, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「排水相容與環境影響」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drainage compatibility and environmental effects"?

地表隆起除以總覆土就能得到唯一膨脹率

Surface heave divided by total cover gives the unique swelling strain
Monitor head, surface settlement and invert response rather than discharge alone.

quiz.explanationEn: Monitor head, surface settlement and invert response rather than discharge alone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to review mineral zones, seepage paths, heave and repair records as a combined map to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

title: 高水壓隧道止水灌漿
summary: 本課以用水頭、壓力損失與滲流證據評估高水壓止水灌漿為主線，從水頭基準與孔隙水壓與泵表讀值與孔段壓力建立系統邊界，再把幾何體積與實際注入量、前後透水比較與水頭連到驗收範圍與長期水路。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on assess high-head water-control grouting using head, pressure loss and seepage evidence. It begins with Head datum and pore pressure and Pump gauge and interval pressure, links Geometric volume and delivered volume and Before-after permeability and head, and ends with Acceptance coverage and long-term pathways. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查水頭基準與孔隙水壓：Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, h=80 m; p=rho*g*h=1000*9.81*80=784800 Pa=0.7848 MPa；再獨立檢查泵表讀值與孔段壓力：Inputs conveyed-fluid density=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, downward elevation change=10 m; pInterval=0.90 MPa+0.0981 MPa-0.15 MPa=0.8481 MPa; another grout density requires recalculating the hydrostatic term。水頭由 80 增為 100 m，淡水靜壓由 0.7848 增為 0.981 MPa；泵壓仍須修正高程及沿程損失，不能把差值當成允許提高注壓的指令。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 將將地表水準、結構位移和相鄰孔壓放在共同時間軸作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Head datum and pore pressure: Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, h=80 m; p=rho*g*h=1000*9.81*80=784800 Pa=0.7848 MPa. Independently check Pump gauge and interval pressure: Inputs conveyed-fluid density=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, downward elevation change=10 m; pInterval=0.90 MPa+0.0981 MPa-0.15 MPa=0.8481 MPa; another grout density requires recalculating the hydrostatic term. Increasing freshwater head from 80 to 100 m raises static pressure from 0.7848 to 0.981 MPa; pump readings still require elevation and loss corrections, not an instruction to increase field pressure. The two results are not a complete design because examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. Use align surface levels, structural movement and neighbouring pore pressures as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水頭基準與孔隙水壓」與「泵表讀值與孔段壓力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Head datum and pore pressure" and "Pump gauge and interval pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水頭基準與孔隙水壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Head datum and pore pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水頭基準與孔隙水壓」如何影響高水壓隧道止水灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Head datum and pore pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-control grouting in high-pressure tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高水壓首先是水位與量測點高程的關係，埋深不一定等於水頭。承壓含水層可在地表以上形成測壓水位，不同孔段也可能不連通；應把量測位置和基準高程清楚標出，再比較外部水壓與隧道內部條件。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將分段測壓水位、孔口高程及量測深度換到共同基準；若出現混用地表深度與水頭使設計水壓估錯，錯判止水需求，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水頭基準與孔隙水壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: High pressure depends on piezometric level relative to the measurement point, not burial depth alone. Confined levels may exceed ground surface and different intervals may be disconnected. Identify measurement elevations and datums before comparing external water pressure with tunnel conditions. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Reduce interval heads, collar elevations and measurement depths to a common datum. If confusing depth with head misestimates water pressure and water-control demand, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Head datum and pore pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, h=80 m; p=rho*g*h=1000*9.81*80=784800 Pa=0.7848 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, h=80 m; p=rho*g*h=1000*9.81*80=784800 Pa=0.7848 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隧道埋得多深就一定有完全相同的地下水頭」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tunnel burial depth always equals the groundwater head" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水頭基準與孔隙水壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Head datum and pore pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水頭基準與孔隙水壓
knowledge.text: 高水壓首先是水位與量測點高程的關係，埋深不一定等於水頭。承壓含水層可在地表以上形成測壓水位，不同孔段也可能不連通；應把量測位置和基準高程清楚標出，再比較外部水壓與隧道內部條件。
knowledge.textEn: High pressure depends on piezometric level relative to the measurement point, not burial depth alone. Confined levels may exceed ground surface and different intervals may be disconnected.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隧道埋得多深就一定有完全相同的地下水頭 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Tunnel burial depth always equals the groundwater head Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水頭基準與孔隙水壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Head datum and pore pressure" is correct?
options: 隧道埋得多深就一定有完全相同的地下水頭
高水壓首先是水位與量測點高程的關係，埋深不一定等於水頭。
泵表壓力永遠等於灌漿孔段實際壓力
optionsEn: Tunnel burial depth always equals the groundwater head
High pressure depends on piezometric level relative to the measurement point, not burial depth alone.
Pump-gauge pressure always equals actual pressure in the treated interval
quiz.explanation: 高水壓首先是水位與量測點高程的關係，埋深不一定等於水頭。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: High pressure depends on piezometric level relative to the measurement point, not burial depth alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水頭基準與孔隙水壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Head datum and pore pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水頭基準與孔隙水壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Head datum and pore pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, h=80 m; p=rho*g*h=1000*9.81*80=784800 Pa=0.7848 MPa。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, h=80 m; p=rho*g*h=1000*9.81*80=784800 Pa=0.7848 MPa. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將分段測壓水位、孔口高程及量測深度換到共同基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reduce interval heads, collar elevations and measurement depths to a common datum.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, h=80 m; p=rho*g*h=1000*9.81*80=784800 Pa=0.7848 MPa。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, h=80 m; p=rho*g*h=1000*9.81*80=784800 Pa=0.7848 MPa. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水頭基準與孔隙水壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Head datum and pore pressure", which statement holds?
options: 所有裂隙對總漏水的貢獻都大致相同
入口壓力升高就能證明整個處理區都已封閉
optionsEn: Every fracture contributes approximately equally to total leakage
Rising entrance pressure proves the entire treated zone is sealed
Original teaching assumptions: Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, h=80 m; p=rho*g*h=1000*9.81*80=784800 Pa=0.7848 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, h=80 m; p=rho*g*h=1000*9.81*80=784800 Pa=0.7848 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, h=80 m; p=rho*g*h=1000*9.81*80=784800 Pa=0.7848 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水頭基準與孔隙水壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Head datum and pore pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水頭基準與孔隙水壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Head datum and pore pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將分段測壓水位、孔口高程及量測深度換到共同基準。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「混用地表深度與水頭使設計水壓估錯，錯判止水需求」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reduce interval heads, collar elevations and measurement depths to a common datum. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Confusing depth with head misestimates water pressure and water-control demand. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將分段測壓水位、孔口高程及量測深度換到共同基準列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現混用地表深度與水頭使設計水壓估錯，錯判止水需求，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Reduce interval heads, collar elevations and measurement depths to a common datum. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If confusing depth with head misestimates water pressure and water-control demand, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：混用地表深度與水頭使設計水壓估錯，錯判止水需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing depth with head misestimates water pressure and water-control demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將分段測壓水位、孔口高程及量測深度換到共同基準。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「混用地表深度與水頭使設計水壓估錯，錯判止水需求」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Reduce interval heads, collar elevations and measurement depths to a common datum. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Confusing depth with head misestimates water pressure and water-control demand. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將分段測壓水位、孔口高程及量測深度換到共同基準列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現混用地表深度與水頭使設計水壓估錯，錯判止水需求，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Reduce interval heads, collar elevations and measurement depths to a common datum. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If confusing depth with head misestimates water pressure and water-control demand, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水頭基準與孔隙水壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Head datum and pore pressure"?
options: 將分段測壓水位、孔口高程及量測深度換到共同基準。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
孔口周圍沒變形就能證明所有遠端地層都沒反應
optionsEn: Reduce interval heads, collar elevations and measurement depths to a common datum.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
No movement near the collar proves all distant ground remains unaffected

steps.title: 水頭基準與孔隙水壓：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水頭基準與孔隙水壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Head datum and pore pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 混用地表深度與水頭使設計水壓估錯，錯判止水需求。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將分段測壓水位、孔口高程及量測深度換到共同基準，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing depth with head misestimates water pressure and water-control demand. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to reduce interval heads, collar elevations and measurement depths to a common datum to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將分段測壓水位、孔口高程及量測深度換到共同基準；若出現混用地表深度與水頭使設計水壓估錯，錯判止水需求，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If confusing depth with head misestimates water pressure and water-control demand, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隧道埋得多深就一定有完全相同的地下水頭」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tunnel burial depth always equals the groundwater head" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 泵表讀值與孔段壓力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pump gauge and interval pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「泵表讀值與孔段壓力」如何影響高水壓隧道止水灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pump gauge and interval pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-control grouting in high-pressure tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泵表位置和目標孔段高程不同，管線摩擦及局部損失也使讀值不能直接當孔內壓力。壓差隨流量、材料和管路狀態改變，靜止時與流動時的校核意義不同；必須定義正負高程和壓力類型，避免重複扣除水頭。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以可用孔段壓力、流量及管路校核共同檢查泵表換算；若出現只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「泵表讀值與孔段壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gauge elevation differs from the target interval, while line and local losses prevent direct transfer of readings. Loss changes with flow, material and pipe condition, so static and flowing checks differ. Define elevation signs and pressure type to avoid counting head corrections twice. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check gauge conversion using available interval pressure, flow and line calibration. If ignoring line blockage losses falsely assigns gauge pressure to the target ground, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pump gauge and interval pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Inputs conveyed-fluid density=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, downward elevation change=10 m; pInterval=0.90 MPa+0.0981 MPa-0.15 MPa=0.8481 MPa; another grout density requires recalculating the hydrostatic term。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs conveyed-fluid density=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, downward elevation change=10 m; pInterval=0.90 MPa+0.0981 MPa-0.15 MPa=0.8481 MPa; another grout density requires recalculating the hydrostatic term.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵表壓力永遠等於灌漿孔段實際壓力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pump-gauge pressure always equals actual pressure in the treated interval" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「泵表讀值與孔段壓力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pump gauge and interval pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 泵表讀值與孔段壓力：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泵表讀值與孔段壓力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pump gauge and interval pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Inputs conveyed-fluid density=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, downward elevation change=10 m; pInterval=0.90 MPa+0.0981 MPa-0.15 MPa=0.8481 MPa; another grout density requires recalculating the hydrostatic term。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs conveyed-fluid density=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, downward elevation change=10 m; pInterval=0.90 MPa+0.0981 MPa-0.15 MPa=0.8481 MPa; another grout density requires recalculating the hydrostatic term. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以可用孔段壓力、流量及管路校核共同檢查泵表換算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check gauge conversion using available interval pressure, flow and line calibration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 以可用孔段壓力、流量及管路校核共同檢查泵表換算。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check gauge conversion using available interval pressure, flow and line calibration. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check gauge conversion using available interval pressure, flow and line calibration. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If ignoring line blockage losses falsely assigns gauge pressure to the target ground, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泵表讀值與孔段壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pump gauge and interval pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以可用孔段壓力、流量及管路校核共同檢查泵表換算，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring line blockage losses falsely assigns gauge pressure to the target ground. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check gauge conversion using available interval pressure, flow and line calibration to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以可用孔段壓力、流量及管路校核共同檢查泵表換算；若出現只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If ignoring line blockage losses falsely assigns gauge pressure to the target ground, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵表壓力永遠等於灌漿孔段實際壓力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pump-gauge pressure always equals actual pressure in the treated interval" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以可用孔段壓力、流量及管路校核共同檢查泵表換算，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring line blockage losses falsely assigns gauge pressure to the target ground. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check gauge conversion using available interval pressure, flow and line calibration to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「泵表讀值與孔段壓力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pump gauge and interval pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
淨注入壓差低就能保證任何地層都不會開裂
只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A low net injection difference guarantees no ground can fracture
Ignoring line blockage losses falsely assigns gauge pressure to the target ground.
quiz.explanation: 只讀泵表而忽略堵管損失，誤以為目標地層已受相同壓力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring line blockage losses falsely assigns gauge pressure to the target ground. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「孔隙壓與有效作用差」與「裂隙開度與流量敏感度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pore pressure and net pressure difference" and "Fracture aperture and flow sensitivity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 孔隙壓與有效作用差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and net pressure difference: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔隙壓與有效作用差」如何影響高水壓隧道止水灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pore pressure and net pressure difference” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-control grouting in high-pressure tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 注入端壓力與原地下水壓之差影響流動，但不能單獨決定地層是否會開裂或抬升。最小主應力、既有裂隙與連通路徑同樣重要，局部壓力還可能傳到遠處薄弱面；模型應區分水力驅動差與允許作用上限。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照孔段壓差、周邊位移及相鄰測壓反應；若出現把淨壓差小誤當無風險，忽略遠處低拘束裂隙開啟，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔隙壓與有效作用差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The difference between injection and groundwater pressure drives flow but does not alone establish fracture or uplift risk. Minimum stress, existing joints and connectivity also matter, with pressure reaching remote weak planes. Distinguish a hydraulic driving difference from an allowable action limit. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare interval pressure difference with surrounding movement and neighbouring head responses. If a small net difference is treated as risk-free despite remote low-restraint joints opening, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pore pressure and net pressure difference” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：netDifference=0.8481 MPa-0.7848 MPa=0.0633 MPa=63.3 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: netDifference=0.8481 MPa-0.7848 MPa=0.0633 MPa=63.3 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「淨注入壓差低就能保證任何地層都不會開裂」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A low net injection difference guarantees no ground can fracture" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「孔隙壓與有效作用差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pore pressure and net pressure difference”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 孔隙壓與有效作用差
knowledge.titleEn: Pore pressure and net pressure difference
knowledge.text: 注入端壓力與原地下水壓之差影響流動，但不能單獨決定地層是否會開裂或抬升。最小主應力、既有裂隙與連通路徑同樣重要，局部壓力還可能傳到遠處薄弱面；模型應區分水力驅動差與允許作用上限。
knowledge.textEn: The difference between injection and groundwater pressure drives flow but does not alone establish fracture or uplift risk. Minimum stress, existing joints and connectivity also matter, with pressure reaching remote weak planes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：淨注入壓差低就能保證任何地層都不會開裂 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A low net injection difference guarantees no ground can fracture Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔隙壓與有效作用差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pore pressure and net pressure difference" is correct?
options: 注入端壓力與原地下水壓之差影響流動，但不能單獨決定地層是否會開裂或抬升。
淨注入壓差低就能保證任何地層都不會開裂
所有裂隙對總漏水的貢獻都大致相同
optionsEn: The difference between injection and groundwater pressure drives flow but does not alone establish fracture or uplift risk.
A low net injection difference guarantees no ground can fracture
Every fracture contributes approximately equally to total leakage
quiz.explanation: 注入端壓力與原地下水壓之差影響流動，但不能單獨決定地層是否會開裂或抬升。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The difference between injection and groundwater pressure drives flow but does not alone establish fracture or uplift risk. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 孔隙壓與有效作用差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and net pressure difference: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔隙壓與有效作用差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pore pressure and net pressure difference” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：netDifference=0.8481 MPa-0.7848 MPa=0.0633 MPa=63.3 kPa。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: netDifference=0.8481 MPa-0.7848 MPa=0.0633 MPa=63.3 kPa. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照孔段壓差、周邊位移及相鄰測壓反應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare interval pressure difference with surrounding movement and neighbouring head responses.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：netDifference=0.8481 MPa-0.7848 MPa=0.0633 MPa=63.3 kPa。算例只描述水力關係，不提供現地配方、注入壓力或施作授權。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: netDifference=0.8481 MPa-0.7848 MPa=0.0633 MPa=63.3 kPa. Examples describe hydraulic relationships, not field recipes, injection pressures or operating authorization. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「孔隙壓與有效作用差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pore pressure and net pressure difference", which statement holds?
options: 入口壓力升高就能證明整個處理區都已封閉
原創教學假設：netDifference=0.8481 MPa-0.7848 MPa=0.0633 MPa=63.3 kPa。
孔口周圍沒變形就能證明所有遠端地層都沒反應
optionsEn: Rising entrance pressure proves the entire treated zone is sealed
Original teaching assumptions: netDifference=0.8481 MPa-0.7848 MPa=0.0633 MPa=63.3 kPa.
No movement near the collar proves all distant ground remains unaffected
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：netDifference=0.8481 MPa-0.7848 MPa=0.0633 MPa=63.3 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: netDifference=0.8481 MPa-0.7848 MPa=0.0633 MPa=63.3 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 孔隙壓與有效作用差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and net pressure difference: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔隙壓與有效作用差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pore pressure and net pressure difference” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照孔段壓差、周邊位移及相鄰測壓反應。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把淨壓差小誤當無風險，忽略遠處低拘束裂隙開啟」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare interval pressure difference with surrounding movement and neighbouring head responses. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A small net difference is treated as risk-free despite remote low-restraint joints opening. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照孔段壓差、周邊位移及相鄰測壓反應列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把淨壓差小誤當無風險，忽略遠處低拘束裂隙開啟，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare interval pressure difference with surrounding movement and neighbouring head responses. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a small net difference is treated as risk-free despite remote low-restraint joints opening, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把淨壓差小誤當無風險，忽略遠處低拘束裂隙開啟。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A small net difference is treated as risk-free despite remote low-restraint joints opening. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照孔段壓差、周邊位移及相鄰測壓反應。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把淨壓差小誤當無風險，忽略遠處低拘束裂隙開啟」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare interval pressure difference with surrounding movement and neighbouring head responses. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A small net difference is treated as risk-free despite remote low-restraint joints opening. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將對照孔段壓差、周邊位移及相鄰測壓反應列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把淨壓差小誤當無風險，忽略遠處低拘束裂隙開啟，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare interval pressure difference with surrounding movement and neighbouring head responses. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a small net difference is treated as risk-free despite remote low-restraint joints opening, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「孔隙壓與有效作用差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pore pressure and net pressure difference"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
中心驗證孔合格就能代表整個止水範圍連續
對照孔段壓差、周邊位移及相鄰測壓反應。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A passing central verification hole proves the entire water barrier is continuous
Compare interval pressure difference with surrounding movement and neighbouring head responses.
quiz.explanation: 對照孔段壓差、周邊位移及相鄰測壓反應。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare interval pressure difference with surrounding movement and neighbouring head responses. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 孔隙壓與有效作用差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and net pressure difference: failure diagnosis

steps.instructionEn: A small net difference is treated as risk-free despite remote low-restraint joints opening. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare interval pressure difference with surrounding movement and neighbouring head responses to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
