The entire gross sump volume is available as pump-failure storage
Original teaching assumptions: headTrend=(18-21) m/6 month=-0.5 m/month, not proof of causation.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：headTrend=(18-21) m/6 month=-0.5 m/month, not proof of causation。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: headTrend=(18-21) m/6 month=-0.5 m/month, not proof of causation. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長期水文與維護交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-term hydrology and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長期水文與維護交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-term hydrology and handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將降雨、地下水位、分區排水與清理事件共同分析。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把季節乾旱全歸因隧道排水，或忽略持續抽排的影響」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Analyze rainfall, groundwater levels, zoned discharge and cleaning events together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Seasonal drought is entirely blamed on drainage, or persistent drainage effects are ignored. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將降雨、地下水位、分區排水與清理事件共同分析列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把季節乾旱全歸因隧道排水，或忽略持續抽排的影響，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Analyze rainfall, groundwater levels, zoned discharge and cleaning events together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If seasonal drought is entirely blamed on drainage, or persistent drainage effects are ignored, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把季節乾旱全歸因隧道排水，或忽略持續抽排的影響。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Seasonal drought is entirely blamed on drainage, or persistent drainage effects are ignored. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將降雨、地下水位、分區排水與清理事件共同分析。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把季節乾旱全歸因隧道排水，或忽略持續抽排的影響」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Analyze rainfall, groundwater levels, zoned discharge and cleaning events together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Seasonal drought is entirely blamed on drainage, or persistent drainage effects are ignored. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將降雨、地下水位、分區排水與清理事件共同分析列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把季節乾旱全歸因隧道排水，或忽略持續抽排的影響，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Analyze rainfall, groundwater levels, zoned discharge and cleaning events together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If seasonal drought is entirely blamed on drainage, or persistent drainage effects are ignored, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長期水文與維護交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-term hydrology and handover"?
options: 將降雨、地下水位、分區排水與清理事件共同分析。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
管徑減少百分之二十就只會少百分之二十排水能力
optionsEn: Analyze rainfall, groundwater levels, zoned discharge and cleaning events together.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A twenty-percent diameter loss reduces drainage capacity by only twenty percent
quiz.explanation: 將降雨、地下水位、分區排水與清理事件共同分析。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Analyze rainfall, groundwater levels, zoned discharge and cleaning events together. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長期水文與維護交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-term hydrology and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長期水文與維護交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-term hydrology and handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把季節乾旱全歸因隧道排水，或忽略持續抽排的影響。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將降雨、地下水位、分區排水與清理事件共同分析，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Seasonal drought is entirely blamed on drainage, or persistent drainage effects are ignored. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to analyze rainfall, groundwater levels, zoned discharge and cleaning events together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將降雨、地下水位、分區排水與清理事件共同分析；若出現把季節乾旱全歸因隧道排水，或忽略持續抽排的影響，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If seasonal drought is entirely blamed on drainage, or persistent drainage effects are ignored, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隧道排水變化可以完全不參考周邊水文資料」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tunnel discharge changes can be interpreted without surrounding hydrological data" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把季節乾旱全歸因隧道排水，或忽略持續抽排的影響。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將降雨、地下水位、分區排水與清理事件共同分析，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Seasonal drought is entirely blamed on drainage, or persistent drainage effects are ignored. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to analyze rainfall, groundwater levels, zoned discharge and cleaning events together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長期水文與維護交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-term hydrology and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把季節乾旱全歸因隧道排水，或忽略持續抽排的影響。
泵站量到的全部出水都是地層自然湧水
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Seasonal drought is entirely blamed on drainage, or persistent drainage effects are ignored.
All water measured at the pump outlet is natural groundwater inflow
quiz.explanation: 把季節乾旱全歸因隧道排水，或忽略持續抽排的影響。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Seasonal drought is entirely blamed on drainage, or persistent drainage effects are ignored. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 既有隧道漏水修繕
summary: 本課以以水源診斷、活動裂縫與修補相容性處理既有隧道漏水為主線，從凝結與地下水來源與漏水量級與時間窗建立系統邊界，再把水頭正規化與成效、排水保留與壓力轉移連到修繕履歷與重複缺陷。可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on repair existing-tunnel leakage through source diagnosis, active-crack assessment and material compatibility. It begins with Condensation and groundwater sources and Leakage scale and time windows, links Head normalization and repair effect and Drainage preservation and pressure transfer, and ends with Repair history and recurrent defects. The visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查凝結與地下水來源：temperatureMargin=surface-dewPoint=12 C-14 C=-2 C；再獨立檢查漏水量級與時間窗：dailyVolume=0.5 L/min*1440 min/day=720 L/day=0.72 m3/day。露點保持 14°C，表面溫度由 12 升為 15°C，溫度餘裕由 -2 變為 +1°C；這只改變凝結可能性，不能排除同時存在的裂縫滲漏。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 將以代表性水樣、接觸時間及鋼材厚度量測追蹤暴露作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Condensation and groundwater sources: temperatureMargin=surface-dewPoint=12 C-14 C=-2 C. Independently check Leakage scale and time windows: dailyVolume=0.5 L/min*1440 min/day=720 L/day=0.72 m3/day. At a fixed 14 C dew point, surface temperature rising from 12 to 15 C changes the margin from -2 to +1 C; this changes condensation potential but does not exclude simultaneous crack leakage. The two results are not a complete design because the visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. Use track exposure using representative water samples, contact duration and steel thickness as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「凝結與地下水來源」與「漏水量級與時間窗」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Condensation and groundwater sources" and "Leakage scale and time windows": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 凝結與地下水來源：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Condensation and groundwater sources: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「凝結與地下水來源」如何影響既有隧道漏水修繕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Condensation and groundwater sources” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Leakage repair in existing tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 潮濕表面可能來自冷凝、地層滲水或管線漏水，三者有不同控制方法。表面溫度低於露點支持凝結可能性，但不是唯一來源證明；空間分布、水質與時間變化應共同檢查，避免把整面冷凝誤當防水膜大面積破損。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步量測表面溫度、露點、水質與濕區分布；若出現凝結被當成裂縫漏水灌補，濕氣問題仍然存在，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「凝結與地下水來源」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wet surfaces can arise from condensation, groundwater or utilities, requiring different remedies. A surface below dew point supports condensation but does not exclude other sources. Combine spatial distribution, chemistry and timing rather than treating widespread condensation as widespread membrane failure. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure surface temperature, dew point, chemistry and wet-area distribution together. If condensation is treated as crack leakage and persists after sealing, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Condensation and groundwater sources” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：temperatureMargin=surface-dewPoint=12 C-14 C=-2 C。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: temperatureMargin=surface-dewPoint=12 C-14 C=-2 C.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要隧道表面有水就一定是地下水穿過裂縫」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any water on a tunnel surface must be groundwater passing through a crack" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「凝結與地下水來源」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Condensation and groundwater sources”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 凝結與地下水來源
knowledge.text: 潮濕表面可能來自冷凝、地層滲水或管線漏水，三者有不同控制方法。表面溫度低於露點支持凝結可能性，但不是唯一來源證明；空間分布、水質與時間變化應共同檢查，避免把整面冷凝誤當防水膜大面積破損。
knowledge.textEn: Wet surfaces can arise from condensation, groundwater or utilities, requiring different remedies. A surface below dew point supports condensation but does not exclude other sources.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要隧道表面有水就一定是地下水穿過裂縫 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any water on a tunnel surface must be groundwater passing through a crack Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「凝結與地下水來源」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Condensation and groundwater sources" is correct?
options: 只要隧道表面有水就一定是地下水穿過裂縫
潮濕表面可能來自冷凝、地層滲水或管線漏水，三者有不同控制方法。
漏水量很小就不會累積成任何耐久問題
optionsEn: Any water on a tunnel surface must be groundwater passing through a crack
Wet surfaces can arise from condensation, groundwater or utilities, requiring different remedies.
A small leak can never accumulate into a durability problem
quiz.explanation: 潮濕表面可能來自冷凝、地層滲水或管線漏水，三者有不同控制方法。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wet surfaces can arise from condensation, groundwater or utilities, requiring different remedies. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 凝結與地下水來源：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Condensation and groundwater sources: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「凝結與地下水來源」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Condensation and groundwater sources” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：temperatureMargin=surface-dewPoint=12 C-14 C=-2 C。可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: temperatureMargin=surface-dewPoint=12 C-14 C=-2 C. The visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測表面溫度、露點、水質與濕區分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure surface temperature, dew point, chemistry and wet-area distribution together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：temperatureMargin=surface-dewPoint=12 C-14 C=-2 C。可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: temperatureMargin=surface-dewPoint=12 C-14 C=-2 C. The visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「凝結與地下水來源」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Condensation and groundwater sources", which statement holds?
options: 某個漏點不再出水就能證明水源已被完全封住
乾燥試驗黏得牢就能保證潮濕裂縫修補有效
原創教學假設：temperatureMargin=surface-dewPoint=12 C-14 C=-2 C。
optionsEn: One dry outlet proves the complete water source has been sealed
Strong dry adhesion guarantees effective repair of a wet crack
Original teaching assumptions: temperatureMargin=surface-dewPoint=12 C-14 C=-2 C.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：temperatureMargin=surface-dewPoint=12 C-14 C=-2 C。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: temperatureMargin=surface-dewPoint=12 C-14 C=-2 C. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 凝結與地下水來源：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Condensation and groundwater sources: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「凝結與地下水來源」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Condensation and groundwater sources” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測表面溫度、露點、水質與濕區分布。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「凝結被當成裂縫漏水灌補，濕氣問題仍然存在」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure surface temperature, dew point, chemistry and wet-area distribution together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Condensation is treated as crack leakage and persists after sealing. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同步量測表面溫度、露點、水質與濕區分布列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現凝結被當成裂縫漏水灌補，濕氣問題仍然存在，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Measure surface temperature, dew point, chemistry and wet-area distribution together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If condensation is treated as crack leakage and persists after sealing, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：凝結被當成裂縫漏水灌補，濕氣問題仍然存在。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Condensation is treated as crack leakage and persists after sealing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量測表面溫度、露點、水質與濕區分布。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「凝結被當成裂縫漏水灌補，濕氣問題仍然存在」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Measure surface temperature, dew point, chemistry and wet-area distribution together. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Condensation is treated as crack leakage and persists after sealing. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將同步量測表面溫度、露點、水質與濕區分布列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現凝結被當成裂縫漏水灌補，濕氣問題仍然存在，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Measure surface temperature, dew point, chemistry and wet-area distribution together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If condensation is treated as crack leakage and persists after sealing, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「凝結與地下水來源」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Condensation and groundwater sources"?
options: 同步量測表面溫度、露點、水質與濕區分布。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
把表面鏽斑清乾淨就表示腐蝕問題已解決
optionsEn: Measure surface temperature, dew point, chemistry and wet-area distribution together.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Cleaning visible rust stains proves the corrosion problem is resolved
quiz.explanation: 同步量測表面溫度、露點、水質與濕區分布。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure surface temperature, dew point, chemistry and wet-area distribution together. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 凝結與地下水來源：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Condensation and groundwater sources: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「凝結與地下水來源」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Condensation and groundwater sources” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 凝結被當成裂縫漏水灌補，濕氣問題仍然存在。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步量測表面溫度、露點、水質與濕區分布，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Condensation is treated as crack leakage and persists after sealing. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure surface temperature, dew point, chemistry and wet-area distribution together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察同步量測表面溫度、露點、水質與濕區分布；若出現凝結被當成裂縫漏水灌補，濕氣問題仍然存在，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If condensation is treated as crack leakage and persists after sealing, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要隧道表面有水就一定是地下水穿過裂縫」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any water on a tunnel surface must be groundwater passing through a crack" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 凝結被當成裂縫漏水灌補，濕氣問題仍然存在。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到同步量測表面溫度、露點、水質與濕區分布，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Condensation is treated as crack leakage and persists after sealing. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure surface temperature, dew point, chemistry and wet-area distribution together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「凝結與地下水來源」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Condensation and groundwater sources" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
凝結被當成裂縫漏水灌補，濕氣問題仍然存在。
漏水量很小就不會累積成任何耐久問題
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Condensation is treated as crack leakage and persists after sealing.
A small leak can never accumulate into a durability problem
quiz.explanation: 凝結被當成裂縫漏水灌補，濕氣問題仍然存在。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Condensation is treated as crack leakage and persists after sealing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 漏水量級與時間窗：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Leakage scale and time windows: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漏水量級與時間窗」如何影響既有隧道漏水修繕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Leakage scale and time windows” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Leakage repair in existing tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水滴頻率受滴頭形狀影響，不能不經校正就換成流量。集水時間窗需要涵蓋變化，維修前後也應使用相似水頭與環境；小流量持續多年仍可形成可觀水量和腐蝕暴露，因此應同時描述瞬時量與累積量。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以容積計時或流量計記錄同一漏點並保留水頭條件；若出現短時乾燥被當成修復成功，水頭回升後漏水恢復，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漏水量級與時間窗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drop frequency depends on outlet geometry and needs calibration before conversion to flow. Collection windows should capture variability and comparisons require similar head and environment. A small persistent leak can create substantial volume and corrosion exposure, so describe instantaneous and accumulated quantities. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure the same leak by timed volume or flow meter and retain head conditions. If a short dry interval is treated as repair success before leakage returns with rising head, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Leakage scale and time windows” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：dailyVolume=0.5 L/min*1440 min/day=720 L/day=0.72 m3/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: dailyVolume=0.5 L/min*1440 min/day=720 L/day=0.72 m3/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「漏水量很小就不會累積成任何耐久問題」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small leak can never accumulate into a durability problem" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漏水量級與時間窗」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Leakage scale and time windows”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 漏水量級與時間窗
knowledge.text: 水滴頻率受滴頭形狀影響，不能不經校正就換成流量。集水時間窗需要涵蓋變化，維修前後也應使用相似水頭與環境；小流量持續多年仍可形成可觀水量和腐蝕暴露，因此應同時描述瞬時量與累積量。
knowledge.textEn: Drop frequency depends on outlet geometry and needs calibration before conversion to flow. Collection windows should capture variability and comparisons require similar head and environment.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：漏水量很小就不會累積成任何耐久問題 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small leak can never accumulate into a durability problem Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「漏水量級與時間窗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Leakage scale and time windows" is correct?
options: 漏水量很小就不會累積成任何耐久問題
裂縫當下很細就表示它沒有任何活動
水滴頻率受滴頭形狀影響，不能不經校正就換成流量。
optionsEn: A small leak can never accumulate into a durability problem
A narrow crack at one instant proves it has no movement
Drop frequency depends on outlet geometry and needs calibration before conversion to flow.
quiz.explanation: 水滴頻率受滴頭形狀影響，不能不經校正就換成流量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Drop frequency depends on outlet geometry and needs calibration before conversion to flow. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 漏水量級與時間窗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Leakage scale and time windows: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「漏水量級與時間窗」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Leakage scale and time windows” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：dailyVolume=0.5 L/min*1440 min/day=720 L/day=0.72 m3/day。可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: dailyVolume=0.5 L/min*1440 min/day=720 L/day=0.72 m3/day. The visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以容積計時或流量計記錄同一漏點並保留水頭條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the same leak by timed volume or flow meter and retain head conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：dailyVolume=0.5 L/min*1440 min/day=720 L/day=0.72 m3/day。可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: dailyVolume=0.5 L/min*1440 min/day=720 L/day=0.72 m3/day. The visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「漏水量級與時間窗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Leakage scale and time windows", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：dailyVolume=0.5 L/min*1440 min/day=720 L/day=0.72 m3/day。
修後流量比較低就不必再記錄地下水頭
所有隧道出水口都應該封死才能改善結構
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: dailyVolume=0.5 L/min*1440 min/day=720 L/day=0.72 m3/day.
Lower post-repair flow removes the need to record groundwater head
Every tunnel water outlet should be sealed to improve the structure
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：dailyVolume=0.5 L/min*1440 min/day=720 L/day=0.72 m3/day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: dailyVolume=0.5 L/min*1440 min/day=720 L/day=0.72 m3/day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 漏水量級與時間窗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Leakage scale and time windows: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「漏水量級與時間窗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Leakage scale and time windows” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以容積計時或流量計記錄同一漏點並保留水頭條件。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「短時乾燥被當成修復成功，水頭回升後漏水恢復」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the same leak by timed volume or flow meter and retain head conditions. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A short dry interval is treated as repair success before leakage returns with rising head. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將以容積計時或流量計記錄同一漏點並保留水頭條件列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現短時乾燥被當成修復成功，水頭回升後漏水恢復，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Measure the same leak by timed volume or flow meter and retain head conditions. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a short dry interval is treated as repair success before leakage returns with rising head, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：短時乾燥被當成修復成功，水頭回升後漏水恢復。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A short dry interval is treated as repair success before leakage returns with rising head. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以容積計時或流量計記錄同一漏點並保留水頭條件。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「短時乾燥被當成修復成功，水頭回升後漏水恢復」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the same leak by timed volume or flow meter and retain head conditions. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A short dry interval is treated as repair success before leakage returns with rising head. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將以容積計時或流量計記錄同一漏點並保留水頭條件列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現短時乾燥被當成修復成功，水頭回升後漏水恢復，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Measure the same leak by timed volume or flow meter and retain head conditions. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a short dry interval is treated as repair success before leakage returns with rising head, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「漏水量級與時間窗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Leakage scale and time windows"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以容積計時或流量計記錄同一漏點並保留水頭條件。
完工當天表面乾燥就能保證全年水密合格
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Measure the same leak by timed volume or flow meter and retain head conditions.
A dry completion-day surface guarantees year-round watertightness
quiz.explanation: 以容積計時或流量計記錄同一漏點並保留水頭條件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the same leak by timed volume or flow meter and retain head conditions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 漏水量級與時間窗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Leakage scale and time windows: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「漏水量級與時間窗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Leakage scale and time windows” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 短時乾燥被當成修復成功，水頭回升後漏水恢復。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以容積計時或流量計記錄同一漏點並保留水頭條件，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A short dry interval is treated as repair success before leakage returns with rising head. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure the same leak by timed volume or flow meter and retain head conditions to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以容積計時或流量計記錄同一漏點並保留水頭條件；若出現短時乾燥被當成修復成功，水頭回升後漏水恢復，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a short dry interval is treated as repair success before leakage returns with rising head, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「漏水量很小就不會累積成任何耐久問題」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small leak can never accumulate into a durability problem" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 短時乾燥被當成修復成功，水頭回升後漏水恢復。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以容積計時或流量計記錄同一漏點並保留水頭條件，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A short dry interval is treated as repair success before leakage returns with rising head. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure the same leak by timed volume or flow meter and retain head conditions to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「漏水量級與時間窗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Leakage scale and time windows" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
裂縫當下很細就表示它沒有任何活動
短時乾燥被當成修復成功，水頭回升後漏水恢復。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A narrow crack at one instant proves it has no movement
A short dry interval is treated as repair success before leakage returns with rising head.
quiz.explanation: 短時乾燥被當成修復成功，水頭回升後漏水恢復。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A short dry interval is treated as repair success before leakage returns with rising head. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「裂縫活動與開合尺度」與「裂隙導流與非線性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Crack activity and opening scale" and "Fracture conductance and nonlinearity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 裂縫活動與開合尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Crack activity and opening scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「裂縫活動與開合尺度」如何影響既有隧道漏水修繕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crack activity and opening scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Leakage repair in existing tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 裂縫可能隨溫度、交通或地層變形反覆開合，靜態寬度不能代表活動範圍。修補材料需要適應裂縫位移而不只是填滿當下空隙；不同方向的剪移與張開也有不同界面需求，應在設計前取得可比時間序列。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以裂縫計對照溫度、荷載事件及相鄰結構位移；若出現活動裂縫採剛性填補後沿界面再裂，漏水很快回復，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「裂縫活動與開合尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cracks can cycle with temperature, traffic or ground movement; static width does not describe their range. Repair needs movement compatibility rather than simply filling the current void. Shear and opening impose different interface demands, requiring comparable time histories before selecting a system. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare crack-gauge records with temperature, load events and neighbouring movement. If rigid filling of an active crack fractures again along the interface and leakage returns, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crack activity and opening scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：openingRange=max-min=0.35 mm-0.20 mm=0.15 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: openingRange=max-min=0.35 mm-0.20 mm=0.15 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「裂縫當下很細就表示它沒有任何活動」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A narrow crack at one instant proves it has no movement" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「裂縫活動與開合尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Crack activity and opening scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 裂縫可能隨溫度、交通或地層變形反覆開合，靜態寬度不能代表活動範圍。修補材料需要適應裂縫位移而不只是填滿當下空隙；不同方向的剪移與張開也有不同界面需求，應在設計前取得可比時間序列。
knowledge.textEn: Cracks can cycle with temperature, traffic or ground movement; static width does not describe their range. Repair needs movement compatibility rather than simply filling the current void.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：裂縫當下很細就表示它沒有任何活動 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A narrow crack at one instant proves it has no movement Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「裂縫活動與開合尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Crack activity and opening scale" is correct?
options: 裂縫可能隨溫度、交通或地層變形反覆開合，靜態寬度不能代表活動範圍。
裂縫當下很細就表示它沒有任何活動

optionsEn: Cracks can cycle with temperature, traffic or ground movement; static width does not describe their range.

quiz.explanationEn: Cracks can cycle with temperature, traffic or ground movement; static width does not describe their range. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 裂縫活動與開合尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crack activity and opening scale: quantitative estimate

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「裂縫當下很細就表示它沒有任何活動」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A narrow crack at one instant proves it has no movement" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instructionEn: Ideal fracture flow varies cubically with aperture, so partial closure can strongly change discharge or redirect it. If a local flow decrease merely redirects water and leaves total inflow unchanged, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fracture conductance and nonlinearity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 在可比水頭下比較裂縫開口、流量及鄰近漏點變化。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「單點流量下降只是水路改道，總湧水量沒有改善」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare crack opening, flow and neighbouring leaks under comparable heads. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A local flow decrease merely redirects water and leaves total inflow unchanged. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 裂隙導流與非線性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fracture conductance and nonlinearity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裂隙導流與非線性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 單點流量下降只是水路改道，總湧水量沒有改善。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到在可比水頭下比較裂縫開口、流量及鄰近漏點變化，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水頭正規化與成效」與「修補材料與濕界面」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Head normalization and repair effect" and "Repair materials and wet interfaces": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水頭正規化與成效：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Head normalization and repair effect: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水頭正規化與成效」如何影響既有隧道漏水修繕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Head normalization and repair effect” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Leakage repair in existing tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 維修前後地下水頭不同時，流量變化混有外部驅動差異。線性導通度可在有限範圍比較同一路徑，但裂縫開合和多支路連通可能非線性；評估應保留原始水頭與流量，而不是只報一個百分比成效。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將修前後流量對水頭繪圖並比較可重疊範圍；若出現低水頭測得小流量被當成材料效果，高水頭時再度漏水，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水頭正規化與成效」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different groundwater heads mix external driving changes into before-after flow. Linear conductance can compare a path over a limited range, but opening and branching may be nonlinear. Preserve original head and flow rather than reporting only a percentage improvement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Plot before-after flow against head and compare overlapping ranges. If low-head low flow is credited to material performance and leakage returns at higher head, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Head normalization and repair effect” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：conductanceBefore=0.4 L/s/200 kPa=0.002 L/(s*kPa); after=0.6/300=0.002。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lower post-repair flow removes the need to record groundwater head" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水頭正規化與成效」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.titleEn: Head normalization and repair effect: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水頭正規化與成效」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Head normalization and repair effect” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將修前後流量對水頭繪圖並比較可重疊範圍。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「低水頭測得小流量被當成材料效果，高水頭時再度漏水」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot before-after flow against head and compare overlapping ranges. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Low-head low flow is credited to material performance and leakage returns at higher head. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將修前後流量對水頭繪圖並比較可重疊範圍列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現低水頭測得小流量被當成材料效果，高水頭時再度漏水，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Plot before-after flow against head and compare overlapping ranges. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If low-head low flow is credited to material performance and leakage returns at higher head, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：低水頭測得小流量被當成材料效果，高水頭時再度漏水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Low-head low flow is credited to material performance and leakage returns at higher head. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水頭正規化與成效」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Head normalization and repair effect"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
將修前後流量對水頭繪圖並比較可重疊範圍。
漏水量很小就不會累積成任何耐久問題
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Plot before-after flow against head and compare overlapping ranges.
A small leak can never accumulate into a durability problem
quiz.explanation: 將修前後流量對水頭繪圖並比較可重疊範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot before-after flow against head and compare overlapping ranges. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水頭正規化與成效：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Head normalization and repair effect: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水頭正規化與成效」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Head normalization and repair effect” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 低水頭測得小流量被當成材料效果，高水頭時再度漏水。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將修前後流量對水頭繪圖並比較可重疊範圍，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Low-head low flow is credited to material performance and leakage returns at higher head. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to plot before-after flow against head and compare overlapping ranges to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將修前後流量對水頭繪圖並比較可重疊範圍；若出現低水頭測得小流量被當成材料效果，高水頭時再度漏水，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If low-head low flow is credited to material performance and leakage returns at higher head, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「修後流量比較低就不必再記錄地下水頭」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lower post-repair flow removes the need to record groundwater head" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 低水頭測得小流量被當成材料效果，高水頭時再度漏水。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將修前後流量對水頭繪圖並比較可重疊範圍，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Low-head low flow is credited to material performance and leakage returns at higher head. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to plot before-after flow against head and compare overlapping ranges to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水頭正規化與成效」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Head normalization and repair effect" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
乾燥試驗黏得牢就能保證潮濕裂縫修補有效
低水頭測得小流量被當成材料效果，高水頭時再度漏水。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Strong dry adhesion guarantees effective repair of a wet crack
Low-head low flow is credited to material performance and leakage returns at higher head.
quiz.explanation: 低水頭測得小流量被當成材料效果，高水頭時再度漏水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Low-head low flow is credited to material performance and leakage returns at higher head. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 修補材料與濕界面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Repair materials and wet interfaces: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「修補材料與濕界面」如何影響既有隧道漏水修繕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Repair materials and wet interfaces” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Leakage repair in existing tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 材料能否在潮濕界面形成有效密封取決於化學相容、黏結及變形能力，不由單一強度決定。水流可能帶走未穩定材料，基底污染則形成薄弱層；試驗應重現服務環境和裂縫活動，而不是只測乾燥室內黏著。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較濕態黏結、變形循環及水質相容試驗證據；若出現乾態合格材料在濕界面剝離，留下隱藏通水薄層，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「修補材料與濕界面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sealing a wet interface depends on chemistry, bond and movement capacity rather than one strength. Flow can remove unstable material and contamination creates a weak layer. Tests should represent service moisture and movement instead of only dry laboratory adhesion. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare wet bond, movement cycling and water-chemistry compatibility evidence. If a material passing dry tests debonds wet and leaves a hidden water-conducting layer, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Repair materials and wet interfaces” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：retainedBond=wetBond/dryBond=0.8 MPa/1.6 MPa=0.50。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: retainedBond=wetBond/dryBond=0.8 MPa/1.6 MPa=0.50.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「乾燥試驗黏得牢就能保證潮濕裂縫修補有效」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Strong dry adhesion guarantees effective repair of a wet crack" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「修補材料與濕界面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Repair materials and wet interfaces”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 修補材料與濕界面
knowledge.text: 材料能否在潮濕界面形成有效密封取決於化學相容、黏結及變形能力，不由單一強度決定。水流可能帶走未穩定材料，基底污染則形成薄弱層；試驗應重現服務環境和裂縫活動，而不是只測乾燥室內黏著。
knowledge.textEn: Sealing a wet interface depends on chemistry, bond and movement capacity rather than one strength. Flow can remove unstable material and contamination creates a weak layer.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：乾燥試驗黏得牢就能保證潮濕裂縫修補有效 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Strong dry adhesion guarantees effective repair of a wet crack Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「修補材料與濕界面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Repair materials and wet interfaces" is correct?
options: 材料能否在潮濕界面形成有效密封取決於化學相容、黏結及變形能力，不由單一強度決定。
乾燥試驗黏得牢就能保證潮濕裂縫修補有效
所有隧道出水口都應該封死才能改善結構
optionsEn: Sealing a wet interface depends on chemistry, bond and movement capacity rather than one strength.
Strong dry adhesion guarantees effective repair of a wet crack
Every tunnel water outlet should be sealed to improve the structure
quiz.explanation: 材料能否在潮濕界面形成有效密封取決於化學相容、黏結及變形能力，不由單一強度決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Sealing a wet interface depends on chemistry, bond and movement capacity rather than one strength. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 修補材料與濕界面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Repair materials and wet interfaces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「修補材料與濕界面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Repair materials and wet interfaces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：retainedBond=wetBond/dryBond=0.8 MPa/1.6 MPa=0.50。可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: retainedBond=wetBond/dryBond=0.8 MPa/1.6 MPa=0.50. The visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較濕態黏結、變形循環及水質相容試驗證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare wet bond, movement cycling and water-chemistry compatibility evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：retainedBond=wetBond/dryBond=0.8 MPa/1.6 MPa=0.50。可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: retainedBond=wetBond/dryBond=0.8 MPa/1.6 MPa=0.50. The visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「修補材料與濕界面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Repair materials and wet interfaces", which statement holds?
options: 完工當天表面乾燥就能保證全年水密合格
原創教學假設：retainedBond=wetBond/dryBond=0.8 MPa/1.6 MPa=0.50。
只要隧道表面有水就一定是地下水穿過裂縫
optionsEn: A dry completion-day surface guarantees year-round watertightness
Original teaching assumptions: retainedBond=wetBond/dryBond=0.8 MPa/1.6 MPa=0.50.
Any water on a tunnel surface must be groundwater passing through a crack
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：retainedBond=wetBond/dryBond=0.8 MPa/1.6 MPa=0.50。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: retainedBond=wetBond/dryBond=0.8 MPa/1.6 MPa=0.50. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 修補材料與濕界面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Repair materials and wet interfaces: failure diagnosis

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「排水保留與壓力轉移」與「腐蝕暴露與污染物質量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drainage preservation and pressure transfer" and "Corrosion exposure and contaminant mass": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 排水保留與壓力轉移：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「排水保留與壓力轉移」如何影響既有隧道漏水修繕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drainage preservation and pressure transfer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Leakage repair in existing tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 某些出水口本來承擔洩壓功能，封閉後水壓可能轉移到襯砌或相鄰接縫。修繕應先確認設計水路，不能把所有流出都當成缺陷；需要在漏水控制和結構承壓之間保持一致，並考慮排水堵塞情境。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照原排水圖、封堵前後水壓及相鄰接縫反應；若出現封住唯一洩壓出口後產生新裂縫，局部變乾卻整體惡化，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水保留與壓力轉移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Some outlets provide intended pressure relief; closing them transfers pressure to lining or adjacent joints. Identify the designed water path before calling all discharge defective. Keep leakage control consistent with structural pressure resistance, including a blocked-drain scenario rather than local appearance alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare original drainage drawings, pressure changes and neighbouring-joint responses. If closing the only relief outlet creates new cracks despite a dry local surface, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drainage preservation and pressure transfer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, headIncrease=3 m; pressureIncrease=rho*g*headIncrease=1000*9.81*3=29430 Pa=29.43 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs rho=1000 kg/m3, g=9.81 m/s2, headIncrease=3 m; pressureIncrease=rho*g*headIncrease=1000*9.81*3=29430 Pa=29.43 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有隧道出水口都應該封死才能改善結構」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every tunnel water outlet should be sealed to improve the structure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排水保留與壓力轉移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drainage preservation and pressure transfer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 排水保留與壓力轉移

steps.title: 排水保留與壓力轉移：定量估算
