quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Corrosion exposure and contaminant mass"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以代表性水樣、接觸時間及鋼材厚度量測追蹤暴露。
修後流量比較低就不必再記錄地下水頭
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Track exposure using representative water samples, contact duration and steel thickness.
Lower post-repair flow removes the need to record groundwater head
quiz.explanation: 以代表性水樣、接觸時間及鋼材厚度量測追蹤暴露。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Track exposure using representative water samples, contact duration and steel thickness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 腐蝕暴露與污染物質量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Corrosion exposure and contaminant mass: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「腐蝕暴露與污染物質量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Corrosion exposure and contaminant mass” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只清除鏽跡未處理水路，持續腐蝕使截面逐漸減少。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以代表性水樣、接觸時間及鋼材厚度量測追蹤暴露，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rust removal without water-path control allows continuing corrosion and section loss. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to track exposure using representative water samples, contact duration and steel thickness to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察以代表性水樣、接觸時間及鋼材厚度量測追蹤暴露；若出現只清除鏽跡未處理水路，持續腐蝕使截面逐漸減少，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If rust removal without water-path control allows continuing corrosion and section loss, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「把表面鏽斑清乾淨就表示腐蝕問題已解決」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Cleaning visible rust stains proves the corrosion problem is resolved" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只清除鏽跡未處理水路，持續腐蝕使截面逐漸減少。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到以代表性水樣、接觸時間及鋼材厚度量測追蹤暴露，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Rust removal without water-path control allows continuing corrosion and section loss. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to track exposure using representative water samples, contact duration and steel thickness to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「腐蝕暴露與污染物質量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Corrosion exposure and contaminant mass" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
完工當天表面乾燥就能保證全年水密合格
只清除鏽跡未處理水路，持續腐蝕使截面逐漸減少。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A dry completion-day surface guarantees year-round watertightness
Rust removal without water-path control allows continuing corrosion and section loss.
quiz.explanation: 只清除鏽跡未處理水路，持續腐蝕使截面逐漸減少。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rust removal without water-path control allows continuing corrosion and section loss. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「維修驗證與觀察期間」與「修繕履歷與重複缺陷」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Repair verification and observation period" and "Repair history and recurrent defects": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 維修驗證與觀察期間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Repair verification and observation period: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「維修驗證與觀察期間」如何影響既有隧道漏水修繕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Repair verification and observation period” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Leakage repair in existing tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 修補完成時的乾燥只證明當下狀態，應經過能代表服務水頭與溫度變化的觀察。驗證範圍要包含相鄰漏點和排水總量，避免水路轉移被當成成功；測試條件與材料養護階段也應保持可追溯。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項核對高低水頭、溫度循環及相鄰區域的觀察紀錄；若出現只在乾季驗收造成假性成功，濕季服務條件尚未驗證，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「維修驗證與觀察期間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A dry surface at completion establishes only that moment. Observe conditions representative of service head and temperature, including neighbouring leaks and total drainage so rerouting is not mistaken for success. Retain test conditions and material-curing stages for reproducible interpretation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit observations across required heads, thermal cycles and adjacent areas. If dry-season acceptance creates false success while wet-season service conditions remain unverified, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Repair verification and observation period” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：observationCoverage=observedRequiredConditions/requiredConditions=3/4=75 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: observationCoverage=observedRequiredConditions/requiredConditions=3/4=75 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完工當天表面乾燥就能保證全年水密合格」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A dry completion-day surface guarantees year-round watertightness" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「維修驗證與觀察期間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Repair verification and observation period”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 維修驗證與觀察期間
knowledge.text: 修補完成時的乾燥只證明當下狀態，應經過能代表服務水頭與溫度變化的觀察。驗證範圍要包含相鄰漏點和排水總量，避免水路轉移被當成成功；測試條件與材料養護階段也應保持可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: A dry surface at completion establishes only that moment. Observe conditions representative of service head and temperature, including neighbouring leaks and total drainage so rerouting is not mistaken for success.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完工當天表面乾燥就能保證全年水密合格 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A dry completion-day surface guarantees year-round watertightness Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「維修驗證與觀察期間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Repair verification and observation period" is correct?
options: 修補完成時的乾燥只證明當下狀態，應經過能代表服務水頭與溫度變化的觀察。
完工當天表面乾燥就能保證全年水密合格
同一位置再次漏水只需要原方法再做一次
optionsEn: A dry surface at completion establishes only that moment.
A dry completion-day surface guarantees year-round watertightness
A recurring leak only requires repeating the original repair method
quiz.explanation: 修補完成時的乾燥只證明當下狀態，應經過能代表服務水頭與溫度變化的觀察。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A dry surface at completion establishes only that moment. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 維修驗證與觀察期間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Repair verification and observation period: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「維修驗證與觀察期間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Repair verification and observation period” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：observationCoverage=observedRequiredConditions/requiredConditions=3/4=75 percent。可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: observationCoverage=observedRequiredConditions/requiredConditions=3/4=75 percent. The visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐項核對高低水頭、溫度循環及相鄰區域的觀察紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit observations across required heads, thermal cycles and adjacent areas.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：observationCoverage=observedRequiredConditions/requiredConditions=3/4=75 percent。可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: observationCoverage=observedRequiredConditions/requiredConditions=3/4=75 percent. The visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「維修驗證與觀察期間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Repair verification and observation period", which statement holds?
options: 漏水量很小就不會累積成任何耐久問題
原創教學假設：observationCoverage=observedRequiredConditions/requiredConditions=3/4=75 percent。
某個漏點不再出水就能證明水源已被完全封住
optionsEn: A small leak can never accumulate into a durability problem
Original teaching assumptions: observationCoverage=observedRequiredConditions/requiredConditions=3/4=75 percent.
One dry outlet proves the complete water source has been sealed
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：observationCoverage=observedRequiredConditions/requiredConditions=3/4=75 percent。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: observationCoverage=observedRequiredConditions/requiredConditions=3/4=75 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 維修驗證與觀察期間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Repair verification and observation period: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「維修驗證與觀察期間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Repair verification and observation period” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對高低水頭、溫度循環及相鄰區域的觀察紀錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只在乾季驗收造成假性成功，濕季服務條件尚未驗證」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit observations across required heads, thermal cycles and adjacent areas. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Dry-season acceptance creates false success while wet-season service conditions remain unverified. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將逐項核對高低水頭、溫度循環及相鄰區域的觀察紀錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只在乾季驗收造成假性成功，濕季服務條件尚未驗證，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Audit observations across required heads, thermal cycles and adjacent areas. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If dry-season acceptance creates false success while wet-season service conditions remain unverified, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只在乾季驗收造成假性成功，濕季服務條件尚未驗證。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Dry-season acceptance creates false success while wet-season service conditions remain unverified. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐項核對高低水頭、溫度循環及相鄰區域的觀察紀錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只在乾季驗收造成假性成功，濕季服務條件尚未驗證」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Audit observations across required heads, thermal cycles and adjacent areas. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Dry-season acceptance creates false success while wet-season service conditions remain unverified. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將逐項核對高低水頭、溫度循環及相鄰區域的觀察紀錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只在乾季驗收造成假性成功，濕季服務條件尚未驗證，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Audit observations across required heads, thermal cycles and adjacent areas. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If dry-season acceptance creates false success while wet-season service conditions remain unverified, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「維修驗證與觀察期間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Repair verification and observation period"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
乾燥試驗黏得牢就能保證潮濕裂縫修補有效
逐項核對高低水頭、溫度循環及相鄰區域的觀察紀錄。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Strong dry adhesion guarantees effective repair of a wet crack
Audit observations across required heads, thermal cycles and adjacent areas.
quiz.explanation: 逐項核對高低水頭、溫度循環及相鄰區域的觀察紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit observations across required heads, thermal cycles and adjacent areas. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 維修驗證與觀察期間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Repair verification and observation period: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「維修驗證與觀察期間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Repair verification and observation period” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只在乾季驗收造成假性成功，濕季服務條件尚未驗證。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐項核對高低水頭、溫度循環及相鄰區域的觀察紀錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Dry-season acceptance creates false success while wet-season service conditions remain unverified. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit observations across required heads, thermal cycles and adjacent areas to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項核對高低水頭、溫度循環及相鄰區域的觀察紀錄；若出現只在乾季驗收造成假性成功，濕季服務條件尚未驗證，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If dry-season acceptance creates false success while wet-season service conditions remain unverified, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完工當天表面乾燥就能保證全年水密合格」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A dry completion-day surface guarantees year-round watertightness" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只在乾季驗收造成假性成功，濕季服務條件尚未驗證。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐項核對高低水頭、溫度循環及相鄰區域的觀察紀錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Dry-season acceptance creates false success while wet-season service conditions remain unverified. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit observations across required heads, thermal cycles and adjacent areas to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「維修驗證與觀察期間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Repair verification and observation period" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只在乾季驗收造成假性成功，濕季服務條件尚未驗證。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
同一位置再次漏水只需要原方法再做一次
optionsEn: Dry-season acceptance creates false success while wet-season service conditions remain unverified.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A recurring leak only requires repeating the original repair method
quiz.explanation: 只在乾季驗收造成假性成功，濕季服務條件尚未驗證。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Dry-season acceptance creates false success while wet-season service conditions remain unverified. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 修繕履歷與重複缺陷：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Repair history and recurrent defects: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「修繕履歷與重複缺陷」如何影響既有隧道漏水修繕的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Repair history and recurrent defects” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Leakage repair in existing tunnels”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 反覆漏水可能來自原水路未辨認、持續位移或材料不相容，重做同一修法未必有效。履歷須連結缺陷位置、材料、施工條件和後續水頭，才能比較原因；沒有完整版本的修補圖會讓新團隊誤把舊補丁當成原始構造。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將每次修補範圍、材料批次及復發條件按位置索引；若出現反覆覆貼掩蓋原裂縫與排水路徑，使診斷越來越困難，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「修繕履歷與重複缺陷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Recurring leakage can reflect unidentified paths, ongoing movement or incompatibility, so repeating the same treatment may fail. Link defect locations, materials, installation conditions and later heads. Without revision-controlled maps a new team can mistake an old patch for original construction. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Index repair extents, material batches and recurrence conditions by location. If repeated overlays conceal original cracks and drainage paths and make diagnosis progressively harder, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Repair history and recurrent defects” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：recurrenceFraction=recurringLocations/repairedLocations=4/20=20 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: recurrenceFraction=recurringLocations/repairedLocations=4/20=20 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一位置再次漏水只需要原方法再做一次」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A recurring leak only requires repeating the original repair method" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「修繕履歷與重複缺陷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Repair history and recurrent defects”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 修繕履歷與重複缺陷

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一位置再次漏水只需要原方法再做一次 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A recurring leak only requires repeating the original repair method Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「修繕履歷與重複缺陷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Repair history and recurrent defects" is correct?
options: 同一位置再次漏水只需要原方法再做一次
反覆漏水可能來自原水路未辨認、持續位移或材料不相容，重做同一修法未必有效。

Recurring leakage can reflect unidentified paths, ongoing movement or incompatibility, so repeating the same treatment may fail.
Any water on a tunnel surface must be groundwater passing through a crack
quiz.explanation: 反覆漏水可能來自原水路未辨認、持續位移或材料不相容，重做同一修法未必有效。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 修繕履歷與重複缺陷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Repair history and recurrent defects: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「修繕履歷與重複缺陷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Repair history and recurrent defects” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：recurrenceFraction=recurringLocations/repairedLocations=4/20=20 percent。可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: recurrenceFraction=recurringLocations/repairedLocations=4/20=20 percent. The visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將每次修補範圍、材料批次及復發條件按位置索引。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Index repair extents, material batches and recurrence conditions by location.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：recurrenceFraction=recurringLocations/repairedLocations=4/20=20 percent。可見出水口不一定是入水缺陷，修補不得破壞原有洩壓與排水路徑。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

The visible outlet need not be the entry defect; repair must preserve intended pressure relief and drainage. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「修繕履歷與重複缺陷」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Repair history and recurrent defects", which statement holds?
options: 裂縫當下很細就表示它沒有任何活動
修後流量比較低就不必再記錄地下水頭
原創教學假設：recurrenceFraction=recurringLocations/repairedLocations=4/20=20 percent。
optionsEn: A narrow crack at one instant proves it has no movement
Lower post-repair flow removes the need to record groundwater head
Original teaching assumptions: recurrenceFraction=recurringLocations/repairedLocations=4/20=20 percent.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：recurrenceFraction=recurringLocations/repairedLocations=4/20=20 percent。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: recurrenceFraction=recurringLocations/repairedLocations=4/20=20 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 修繕履歷與重複缺陷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Repair history and recurrent defects: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「修繕履歷與重複缺陷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Repair history and recurrent defects” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將每次修補範圍、材料批次及復發條件按位置索引。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「反覆覆貼掩蓋原裂縫與排水路徑，使診斷越來越困難」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Index repair extents, material batches and recurrence conditions by location. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Repeated overlays conceal original cracks and drainage paths and make diagnosis progressively harder. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將每次修補範圍、材料批次及復發條件按位置索引列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現反覆覆貼掩蓋原裂縫與排水路徑，使診斷越來越困難，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Index repair extents, material batches and recurrence conditions by location. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If repeated overlays conceal original cracks and drainage paths and make diagnosis progressively harder, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反覆覆貼掩蓋原裂縫與排水路徑，使診斷越來越困難。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated overlays conceal original cracks and drainage paths and make diagnosis progressively harder. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將每次修補範圍、材料批次及復發條件按位置索引。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「反覆覆貼掩蓋原裂縫與排水路徑，使診斷越來越困難」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Index repair extents, material batches and recurrence conditions by location. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Repeated overlays conceal original cracks and drainage paths and make diagnosis progressively harder. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將將每次修補範圍、材料批次及復發條件按位置索引列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現反覆覆貼掩蓋原裂縫與排水路徑，使診斷越來越困難，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If repeated overlays conceal original cracks and drainage paths and make diagnosis progressively harder, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「修繕履歷與重複缺陷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 將每次修補範圍、材料批次及復發條件按位置索引。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A recurring leak only requires repeating the original repair method" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 反覆覆貼掩蓋原裂縫與排水路徑，使診斷越來越困難。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將每次修補範圍、材料批次及復發條件按位置索引，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Repeated overlays conceal original cracks and drainage paths and make diagnosis progressively harder. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to index repair extents, material batches and recurrence conditions by location to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「修繕履歷與重複缺陷」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Repair history and recurrent defects" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
反覆覆貼掩蓋原裂縫與排水路徑，使診斷越來越困難。
只要隧道表面有水就一定是地下水穿過裂縫
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Repeated overlays conceal original cracks and drainage paths and make diagnosis progressively harder.
Any water on a tunnel surface must be groundwater passing through a crack
quiz.explanation: 反覆覆貼掩蓋原裂縫與排水路徑，使診斷越來越困難。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeated overlays conceal original cracks and drainage paths and make diagnosis progressively harder. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 明挖覆蓋隧道施工
summary: 本課以整合明挖隧道的地表界面、支撐、水壓與回填階段為主線，從開挖尺度與地表影響與側向土壓與變形條件建立系統邊界，再把箱體自重與施工抗浮、支撐拆換與荷載轉移連到地表恢復與地下資產交接。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on integrate surface interfaces, bracing, water pressure and backfilling in cut-and-cover tunnels. It begins with Excavation scale and surface impact and Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions, links Box weight and temporary flotation and Brace removal and load transfer, and ends with Surface restoration and underground handover. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查開挖尺度與地表影響：V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3；再獨立檢查側向土壓與變形條件：resultant=0.5*Ka*gamma*H^2=0.5*0.33*18 kN/m3*(8 m)^2=190.1 kN/m。長 100 m、深 8 m，寬由 14 增為 16 m，土方由 11200 增為 12800 m3，增加 14.3%；支撐跨距及水力影響不只按體積同比放大。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 將將建物水準、傾斜與原有裂縫圖按結構跨間比較作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。
workedExample.textEn: All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Excavation scale and surface impact: V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3. Independently check Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions: resultant=0.5*Ka*gamma*H^2=0.5*0.33*18 kN/m3*(8 m)^2=190.1 kN/m. At 100 m length and 8 m depth, widening from 14 to 16 m raises excavation from 11200 to 12800 m3, by 14.3%; brace spans and hydraulic effects do not merely scale with volume. The two results are not a complete design because excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. Use compare building levels, tilt and baseline cracks by structural bay as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「開挖尺度與地表影響」與「側向土壓與變形條件」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Excavation scale and surface impact" and "Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 開挖尺度與地表影響：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Excavation scale and surface impact: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「開挖尺度與地表影響」如何影響明挖覆蓋隧道施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Excavation scale and surface impact” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cut-and-cover tunnel construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 明挖把地下結構施工直接連到地表交通、管線和鄰房，開挖寬度也改變支撐跨距與土體卸載。土方體積只是物流量級，不能代表所有變形風險；工法選擇應把永久箱體、臨時圍護和地表使用需求放在同一斷面。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標；若出現只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「開挖尺度與地表影響」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cut-and-cover directly couples underground construction to traffic, utilities and neighbours. Width changes brace spans and unloading as well as spoil volume. Volume describes logistics rather than all deformation risks; compare the permanent box, temporary retention and surface-use demands in one section. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates. If a spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Excavation scale and surface impact” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「土方體積相同就代表兩個明挖工程風險相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal excavation volume means identical risk for two cut-and-cover projects" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「開挖尺度與地表影響」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Excavation scale and surface impact”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 開挖尺度與地表影響
knowledge.text: 明挖把地下結構施工直接連到地表交通、管線和鄰房，開挖寬度也改變支撐跨距與土體卸載。土方體積只是物流量級，不能代表所有變形風險；工法選擇應把永久箱體、臨時圍護和地表使用需求放在同一斷面。
knowledge.textEn: Cut-and-cover directly couples underground construction to traffic, utilities and neighbours. Width changes brace spans and unloading as well as spoil volume.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：土方體積相同就代表兩個明挖工程風險相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal excavation volume means identical risk for two cut-and-cover projects Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

optionsEn: Equal excavation volume means identical risk for two cut-and-cover projects

steps.title: 開挖尺度與地表影響：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Excavation scale and surface impact: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「開挖尺度與地表影響」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Excavation scale and surface impact” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「開挖尺度與地表影響」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Uncracked box walls guarantee every penetration remains watertight

quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：V=L*B*H=100 m*14 m*8 m=11200 m3。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 開挖尺度與地表影響：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Excavation scale and surface impact: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「開挖尺度與地表影響」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Excavation scale and surface impact” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「開挖尺度與地表影響」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Excavation scale and surface impact"?

optionsEn: Compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Small average settlement guarantees no damage to neighbouring buildings
quiz.explanation: 比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 開挖尺度與地表影響：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Excavation scale and surface impact: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「開挖尺度與地表影響」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Excavation scale and surface impact” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標；若出現只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「土方體積相同就代表兩個明挖工程風險相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal excavation volume means identical risk for two cut-and-cover projects" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到比對探測管線、道路分期及開挖邊界的共同座標，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: A spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare detected utilities, road stages and excavation limits in shared coordinates to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「開挖尺度與地表影響」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Excavation scale and surface impact" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損。
所有擋土牆都可以直接使用完全主動土壓
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement.
Every retaining wall can directly use fully active earth pressure
quiz.explanation: 只按土方安排忽略管線支承，既有設施因卸載或位移受損。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A spoil-only plan misses utility support and damages services through unloading or movement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 側向土壓與變形條件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「側向土壓與變形條件」如何影響明挖覆蓋隧道施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cut-and-cover tunnel construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 主動土壓需要足夠牆體位移才可動員，鄰房敏感區的剛性支撐未必允許達到這個狀態。地表超載與水壓應分開處理，不能將總壓力都乘同一係數；簡化三角分布只用來理解量級，支撐牆需考慮分階段受力。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將牆體測斜與土層、超載及水位狀態共同比對；若出現用主動壓力描述幾乎不動的牆，低估支撐反力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「側向土壓與變形條件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Active pressure requires sufficient wall movement, which stiff restraint near sensitive buildings may prevent. Treat surcharge and water separately rather than multiplying total pressure by one coefficient. A triangular diagram gives scale, while a supported wall needs staged force redistribution and movement compatibility. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare wall inclinometers with strata, surcharge and groundwater conditions. If active pressure applied to a nearly restrained wall understates brace reactions, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：resultant=0.5*Ka*gamma*H^2=0.5*0.33*18 kN/m3*(8 m)^2=190.1 kN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: resultant=0.5*Ka*gamma*H^2=0.5*0.33*18 kN/m3*(8 m)^2=190.1 kN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有擋土牆都可以直接使用完全主動土壓」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every retaining wall can directly use fully active earth pressure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「側向土壓與變形條件」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 側向土壓與變形條件
knowledge.titleEn: Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions
knowledge.text: 主動土壓需要足夠牆體位移才可動員，鄰房敏感區的剛性支撐未必允許達到這個狀態。地表超載與水壓應分開處理，不能將總壓力都乘同一係數；簡化三角分布只用來理解量級，支撐牆需考慮分階段受力。
knowledge.textEn: Active pressure requires sufficient wall movement, which stiff restraint near sensitive buildings may prevent. Treat surcharge and water separately rather than multiplying total pressure by one coefficient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有擋土牆都可以直接使用完全主動土壓 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every retaining wall can directly use fully active earth pressure Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「側向土壓與變形條件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions" is correct?
options: 所有擋土牆都可以直接使用完全主動土壓
支撐荷重變大就只能是土壓增加
主動土壓需要足夠牆體位移才可動員，鄰房敏感區的剛性支撐未必允許達到這個狀態。
optionsEn: Every retaining wall can directly use fully active earth pressure
Increasing brace force can only mean increasing earth pressure
Active pressure requires sufficient wall movement, which stiff restraint near sensitive buildings may prevent.
quiz.explanation: 主動土壓需要足夠牆體位移才可動員，鄰房敏感區的剛性支撐未必允許達到這個狀態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Active pressure requires sufficient wall movement, which stiff restraint near sensitive buildings may prevent. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 側向土壓與變形條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「側向土壓與變形條件」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：resultant=0.5*Ka*gamma*H^2=0.5*0.33*18 kN/m3*(8 m)^2=190.1 kN/m。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: resultant=0.5*Ka*gamma*H^2=0.5*0.33*18 kN/m3*(8 m)^2=190.1 kN/m. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將牆體測斜與土層、超載及水位狀態共同比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare wall inclinometers with strata, surcharge and groundwater conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：resultant=0.5*Ka*gamma*H^2=0.5*0.33*18 kN/m3*(8 m)^2=190.1 kN/m。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: resultant=0.5*Ka*gamma*H^2=0.5*0.33*18 kN/m3*(8 m)^2=190.1 kN/m. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「側向土壓與變形條件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：resultant=0.5*Ka*gamma*H^2=0.5*0.33*18 kN/m3*(8 m)^2=190.1 kN/m。
竣工抗浮合格就能保證每個施工階段都抗浮

Passing permanent flotation checks guarantees every construction stage resists uplift
A freshly cast permanent slab immediately replaces every temporary brace
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：resultant=0.5*Ka*gamma*H^2=0.5*0.33*18 kN/m3*(8 m)^2=190.1 kN/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: resultant=0.5*Ka*gamma*H^2=0.5*0.33*18 kN/m3*(8 m)^2=190.1 kN/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 側向土壓與變形條件：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「側向土壓與變形條件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lateral soil pressure and movement conditions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將牆體測斜與土層、超載及水位狀態共同比對。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「用主動壓力描述幾乎不動的牆，低估支撐反力」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare wall inclinometers with strata, surcharge and groundwater conditions. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Active pressure applied to a nearly restrained wall understates brace reactions. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將牆體測斜與土層、超載及水位狀態共同比對列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現用主動壓力描述幾乎不動的牆，低估支撐反力，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare wall inclinometers with strata, surcharge and groundwater conditions. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If active pressure applied to a nearly restrained wall understates brace reactions, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用主動壓力描述幾乎不動的牆，低估支撐反力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Active pressure applied to a nearly restrained wall understates brace reactions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將牆體測斜與土層、超載及水位狀態共同比對；若出現用主動壓力描述幾乎不動的牆，低估支撐反力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If active pressure applied to a nearly restrained wall understates brace reactions, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有擋土牆都可以直接使用完全主動土壓」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every retaining wall can directly use fully active earth pressure" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用主動壓力描述幾乎不動的牆，低估支撐反力。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將牆體測斜與土層、超載及水位狀態共同比對，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Active pressure applied to a nearly restrained wall understates brace reactions. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare wall inclinometers with strata, surcharge and groundwater conditions to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「側向土壓與變形條件」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

用主動壓力描述幾乎不動的牆，低估支撐反力。

Increasing brace force can only mean increasing earth pressure
Active pressure applied to a nearly restrained wall understates brace reactions.

quiz.explanationEn: Active pressure applied to a nearly restrained wall understates brace reactions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「支撐軸力與溫度」與「底部隆起與抗浮區分」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Brace force and temperature" and "Base heave and uplift distinction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支撐軸力與溫度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Brace force and temperature: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支撐軸力與溫度」如何影響明挖覆蓋隧道施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Brace force and temperature” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cut-and-cover tunnel construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼支撐除了承受地層作用，也會隨溫度伸縮，受到拘束時產生額外軸力。荷重增加可能是熱效應而非牆後土壓增加，零點時間因此重要；比較力值要同步看溫度、牆移和接頭滑移，避免用單支荷重計判斷地層。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步量測支撐溫度、軸力及兩端牆體位移；若出現日照升溫造成力峰被誤判地層失穩，錯誤調整支撐，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支撐軸力與溫度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steel braces expand thermally and develop extra force when restrained. A force increase can reflect temperature rather than rising earth pressure, making zero time important. Compare force with temperature, wall movement and joint slip instead of diagnosing ground solely from one load cell. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure brace temperature, axial force and both wall-end movements simultaneously. If solar heating creates a force peak mistaken for ground instability and prompts an incorrect brace change, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Brace force and temperature” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：fullRestraintForce=E*A*alpha*dT=200 GPa*0.01 m2*12e-6/K*10 K=240 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: fullRestraintForce=E*A*alpha*dT=200 GPa*0.01 m2*12e-6/K*10 K=240 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支撐荷重變大就只能是土壓增加」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing brace force can only mean increasing earth pressure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支撐軸力與溫度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Brace force and temperature”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支撐軸力與溫度

knowledge.textEn: Steel braces expand thermally and develop extra force when restrained. A force increase can reflect temperature rather than rising earth pressure, making zero time important.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支撐荷重變大就只能是土壓增加 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

支撐荷重變大就只能是土壓增加
基底往上動的所有原因都屬同一種失效
optionsEn: Steel braces expand thermally and develop extra force when restrained.
Increasing brace force can only mean increasing earth pressure
Every cause of upward base movement is the same failure mechanism

steps.title: 支撐軸力與溫度：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支撐軸力與溫度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Brace force and temperature” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：fullRestraintForce=E*A*alpha*dT=200 GPa*0.01 m2*12e-6/K*10 K=240 kN。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: fullRestraintForce=E*A*alpha*dT=200 GPa*0.01 m2*12e-6/K*10 K=240 kN. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測支撐溫度、軸力及兩端牆體位移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure brace temperature, axial force and both wall-end movements simultaneously.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：fullRestraintForce=E*A*alpha*dT=200 GPa*0.01 m2*12e-6/K*10 K=240 kN。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支撐軸力與溫度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 支撐軸力與溫度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Brace force and temperature: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支撐軸力與溫度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Brace force and temperature” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測支撐溫度、軸力及兩端牆體位移。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「日照升溫造成力峰被誤判地層失穩，錯誤調整支撐」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同步量測支撐溫度、軸力及兩端牆體位移列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現日照升溫造成力峰被誤判地層失穩，錯誤調整支撐，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Measure brace temperature, axial force and both wall-end movements simultaneously. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. steps.failure: 注意干擾：日照升溫造成力峰被誤判地層失穩，錯誤調整支撐。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支撐軸力與溫度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

基底往上動的所有原因都屬同一種失效
optionsEn: Solar heating creates a force peak mistaken for ground instability and prompts an incorrect brace change.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Every cause of upward base movement is the same failure mechanism

quiz.explanationEn: Solar heating creates a force peak mistaken for ground instability and prompts an incorrect brace change. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 底部隆起與抗浮區分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Base heave and uplift distinction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「底部隆起與抗浮區分」如何影響明挖覆蓋隧道施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Base heave and uplift distinction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cut-and-cover tunnel construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 軟黏土底部隆起與承壓水造成的水力抬升有不同機制，不能以同一重量比處理。開挖卸載降低上覆應力，地層剪切與水壓都可能變得重要；調查需把不排水強度、滲透層和測壓水位分開建模。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較底部位移、分層孔壓及地層強度資料；若出現把水力抬升當普通沉陷調整標高，未處理真正水壓，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「底部隆起與抗浮區分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Undrained clay heave and hydraulic uplift are different mechanisms and cannot share one simple weight ratio. Excavation removes overburden, increasing the importance of shear stability and pore pressure. Model undrained strength, permeable layers and piezometric level separately rather than merging all bottom movement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare base movement, interval pore pressures and ground-strength evidence. If hydraulic uplift is treated as ordinary settlement correction without addressing the pressure source, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Base heave and uplift distinction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：waterUplift=gammaW*h*A=9.81 kN/m3*5 m*100 m2=4905 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: waterUplift=gammaW*h*A=9.81 kN/m3*5 m*100 m2=4905 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基底往上動的所有原因都屬同一種失效」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every cause of upward base movement is the same failure mechanism" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「底部隆起與抗浮區分」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Base heave and uplift distinction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 底部隆起與抗浮區分
knowledge.text: 軟黏土底部隆起與承壓水造成的水力抬升有不同機制，不能以同一重量比處理。開挖卸載降低上覆應力，地層剪切與水壓都可能變得重要；調查需把不排水強度、滲透層和測壓水位分開建模。
knowledge.textEn: Undrained clay heave and hydraulic uplift are different mechanisms and cannot share one simple weight ratio. Excavation removes overburden, increasing the importance of shear stability and pore pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基底往上動的所有原因都屬同一種失效 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every cause of upward base movement is the same failure mechanism Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「底部隆起與抗浮區分」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

軟黏土底部隆起與承壓水造成的水力抬升有不同機制，不能以同一重量比處理。

optionsEn: Every cause of upward base movement is the same failure mechanism
Undrained clay heave and hydraulic uplift are different mechanisms and cannot share one simple weight ratio.
Passing permanent flotation checks guarantees every construction stage resists uplift
quiz.explanation: 軟黏土底部隆起與承壓水造成的水力抬升有不同機制，不能以同一重量比處理。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 底部隆起與抗浮區分：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Base heave and uplift distinction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「底部隆起與抗浮區分」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Base heave and uplift distinction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：waterUplift=gammaW*h*A=9.81 kN/m3*5 m*100 m2=4905 kN。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: waterUplift=gammaW*h*A=9.81 kN/m3*5 m*100 m2=4905 kN. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較底部位移、分層孔壓及地層強度資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare base movement, interval pore pressures and ground-strength evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：waterUplift=gammaW*h*A=9.81 kN/m3*5 m*100 m2=4905 kN。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。

Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「底部隆起與抗浮區分」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
