quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：waterUplift=gammaW*h*A=9.81 kN/m3*5 m*100 m2=4905 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: waterUplift=gammaW*h*A=9.81 kN/m3*5 m*100 m2=4905 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 底部隆起與抗浮區分：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Base heave and uplift distinction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「底部隆起與抗浮區分」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Base heave and uplift distinction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較底部位移、分層孔壓及地層強度資料。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把水力抬升當普通沉陷調整標高，未處理真正水壓」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare base movement, interval pore pressures and ground-strength evidence. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Hydraulic uplift is treated as ordinary settlement correction without addressing the pressure source. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將比較底部位移、分層孔壓及地層強度資料列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把水力抬升當普通沉陷調整標高，未處理真正水壓，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare base movement, interval pore pressures and ground-strength evidence. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If hydraulic uplift is treated as ordinary settlement correction without addressing the pressure source, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把水力抬升當普通沉陷調整標高，未處理真正水壓。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Hydraulic uplift is treated as ordinary settlement correction without addressing the pressure source. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較底部位移、分層孔壓及地層強度資料。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「把水力抬升當普通沉陷調整標高，未處理真正水壓」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare base movement, interval pore pressures and ground-strength evidence. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Hydraulic uplift is treated as ordinary settlement correction without addressing the pressure source. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將比較底部位移、分層孔壓及地層強度資料列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現把水力抬升當普通沉陷調整標高，未處理真正水壓，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare base movement, interval pore pressures and ground-strength evidence. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If hydraulic uplift is treated as ordinary settlement correction without addressing the pressure source, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察比較底部位移、分層孔壓及地層強度資料；若出現把水力抬升當普通沉陷調整標高，未處理真正水壓，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.objective: 說明「箱體自重與施工抗浮」如何影響明挖覆蓋隧道施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Box weight and temporary flotation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cut-and-cover tunnel construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 永久覆土可提供重量，但施工中尚未回填時並不存在這份抗浮作用。空箱體、局部回填與封頂後各有不同邊界，水位也可能回升；重量帳必須只計入當階段確實存在且可傳力的部分，不得提前借用竣工狀態。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐階段核對實際重量、回填範圍與可達水位；若出現尚未回填便使用永久覆土重量，空箱體出現抬升，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「箱體自重與施工抗浮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Permanent cover supplies weight but is absent before backfilling. Empty boxes, partial fill and completed roofs have different boundaries and may encounter rising groundwater. Count only weight physically present and connected in each stage rather than borrowing resistance from the completed structure. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit actual weight, backfill extent and possible water levels at every stage. If using future cover weight allows an unbackfilled box to lift, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Box weight and temporary flotation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：weightToUplift=presentWeight/uplift=6000 kN/4905 kN=1.223, not a code factor。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: weightToUplift=presentWeight/uplift=6000 kN/4905 kN=1.223, not a code factor.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「竣工抗浮合格就能保證每個施工階段都抗浮」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing permanent flotation checks guarantees every construction stage resists uplift" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「箱體自重與施工抗浮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Box weight and temporary flotation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 箱體自重與施工抗浮
knowledge.text: 永久覆土可提供重量，但施工中尚未回填時並不存在這份抗浮作用。空箱體、局部回填與封頂後各有不同邊界，水位也可能回升；重量帳必須只計入當階段確實存在且可傳力的部分，不得提前借用竣工狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Permanent cover supplies weight but is absent before backfilling. Empty boxes, partial fill and completed roofs have different boundaries and may encounter rising groundwater.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：竣工抗浮合格就能保證每個施工階段都抗浮 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing permanent flotation checks guarantees every construction stage resists uplift Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「箱體自重與施工抗浮」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Box weight and temporary flotation" is correct?
options: 竣工抗浮合格就能保證每個施工階段都抗浮
箱體牆面不裂就能保證所有穿牆位置都不漏
永久覆土可提供重量，但施工中尚未回填時並不存在這份抗浮作用。
optionsEn: Passing permanent flotation checks guarantees every construction stage resists uplift
Uncracked box walls guarantee every penetration remains watertight
Permanent cover supplies weight but is absent before backfilling.
quiz.explanation: 永久覆土可提供重量，但施工中尚未回填時並不存在這份抗浮作用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Permanent cover supplies weight but is absent before backfilling. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 箱體自重與施工抗浮：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Box weight and temporary flotation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「箱體自重與施工抗浮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Box weight and temporary flotation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：weightToUplift=presentWeight/uplift=6000 kN/4905 kN=1.223, not a code factor。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: weightToUplift=presentWeight/uplift=6000 kN/4905 kN=1.223, not a code factor. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐階段核對實際重量、回填範圍與可達水位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit actual weight, backfill extent and possible water levels at every stage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：weightToUplift=presentWeight/uplift=6000 kN/4905 kN=1.223, not a code factor。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: weightToUplift=presentWeight/uplift=6000 kN/4905 kN=1.223, not a code factor. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「箱體自重與施工抗浮」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Box weight and temporary flotation", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：weightToUplift=presentWeight/uplift=6000 kN/4905 kN=1.223, not a code factor。
平均沉陷很小就代表鄰房一定沒有損傷
道路恢復平整就表示全部地下工程已完成驗證
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: weightToUplift=presentWeight/uplift=6000 kN/4905 kN=1.223, not a code factor.
Small average settlement guarantees no damage to neighbouring buildings
A smooth restored road proves all underground works have been verified
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：weightToUplift=presentWeight/uplift=6000 kN/4905 kN=1.223, not a code factor。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: weightToUplift=presentWeight/uplift=6000 kN/4905 kN=1.223, not a code factor. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 箱體自重與施工抗浮：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Box weight and temporary flotation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「箱體自重與施工抗浮」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Box weight and temporary flotation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐階段核對實際重量、回填範圍與可達水位。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「尚未回填便使用永久覆土重量，空箱體出現抬升」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit actual weight, backfill extent and possible water levels at every stage. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Using future cover weight allows an unbackfilled box to lift. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將逐階段核對實際重量、回填範圍與可達水位列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現尚未回填便使用永久覆土重量，空箱體出現抬升，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Audit actual weight, backfill extent and possible water levels at every stage. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If using future cover weight allows an unbackfilled box to lift, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：尚未回填便使用永久覆土重量，空箱體出現抬升。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using future cover weight allows an unbackfilled box to lift. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐階段核對實際重量、回填範圍與可達水位。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「尚未回填便使用永久覆土重量，空箱體出現抬升」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Audit actual weight, backfill extent and possible water levels at every stage. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Using future cover weight allows an unbackfilled box to lift. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將逐階段核對實際重量、回填範圍與可達水位列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現尚未回填便使用永久覆土重量，空箱體出現抬升，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Audit actual weight, backfill extent and possible water levels at every stage. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If using future cover weight allows an unbackfilled box to lift, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「箱體自重與施工抗浮」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Box weight and temporary flotation"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
逐階段核對實際重量、回填範圍與可達水位。
所有擋土牆都可以直接使用完全主動土壓
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Audit actual weight, backfill extent and possible water levels at every stage.
Every retaining wall can directly use fully active earth pressure
quiz.explanation: 逐階段核對實際重量、回填範圍與可達水位。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit actual weight, backfill extent and possible water levels at every stage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 箱體自重與施工抗浮：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Box weight and temporary flotation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「箱體自重與施工抗浮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Box weight and temporary flotation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 尚未回填便使用永久覆土重量，空箱體出現抬升。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐階段核對實際重量、回填範圍與可達水位，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using future cover weight allows an unbackfilled box to lift. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit actual weight, backfill extent and possible water levels at every stage to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察逐階段核對實際重量、回填範圍與可達水位；若出現尚未回填便使用永久覆土重量，空箱體出現抬升，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If using future cover weight allows an unbackfilled box to lift, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「竣工抗浮合格就能保證每個施工階段都抗浮」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing permanent flotation checks guarantees every construction stage resists uplift" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 尚未回填便使用永久覆土重量，空箱體出現抬升。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到逐階段核對實際重量、回填範圍與可達水位，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Using future cover weight allows an unbackfilled box to lift. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit actual weight, backfill extent and possible water levels at every stage to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「箱體自重與施工抗浮」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Box weight and temporary flotation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
箱體牆面不裂就能保證所有穿牆位置都不漏
尚未回填便使用永久覆土重量，空箱體出現抬升。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Uncracked box walls guarantee every penetration remains watertight
Using future cover weight allows an unbackfilled box to lift.
quiz.explanation: 尚未回填便使用永久覆土重量，空箱體出現抬升。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using future cover weight allows an unbackfilled box to lift. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 防水接縫與穿牆構件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Waterproof joints and penetrations: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「防水接縫與穿牆構件」如何影響明挖覆蓋隧道施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Waterproof joints and penetrations” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cut-and-cover tunnel construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 明挖箱體常有施工縫、伸縮縫及大量管線穿牆，止水連續性由這些界面控制。接縫位移與水壓可能同時存在，單獨材料試驗不能證明安裝系統；驗證需把預埋位置、固定狀態及兩側結構變形連在一起。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對止水帶連續、穿牆套管及接縫變形紀錄；若出現穿牆套管與止水細部不連續，漏水沿界面繞過膜材，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「防水接縫與穿牆構件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cut-and-cover boxes contain construction joints, movement joints and penetrations that govern waterproof continuity. Movement and pressure can coexist, so isolated material tests do not prove installation. Link embedded position, restraint and deformation of adjacent structure rather than checking the seal alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit waterstop continuity, wall sleeves and joint-movement records. If a discontinuous sleeve detail lets water bypass the membrane along an interface, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Waterproof joints and penetrations” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：jointStrain=movement/freeSealLength=4 mm/80 mm=0.05。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: jointStrain=movement/freeSealLength=4 mm/80 mm=0.05.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「箱體牆面不裂就能保證所有穿牆位置都不漏」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uncracked box walls guarantee every penetration remains watertight" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 防水接縫與穿牆構件
knowledge.text: 明挖箱體常有施工縫、伸縮縫及大量管線穿牆，止水連續性由這些界面控制。接縫位移與水壓可能同時存在，單獨材料試驗不能證明安裝系統；驗證需把預埋位置、固定狀態及兩側結構變形連在一起。
knowledge.textEn: Cut-and-cover boxes contain construction joints, movement joints and penetrations that govern waterproof continuity. Movement and pressure can coexist, so isolated material tests do not prove installation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Uncracked box walls guarantee every penetration remains watertight Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 防水接縫與穿牆構件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Waterproof joints and penetrations: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「防水接縫與穿牆構件」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Waterproof joints and penetrations” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：jointStrain=movement/freeSealLength=4 mm/80 mm=0.05。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: jointStrain=movement/freeSealLength=4 mm/80 mm=0.05. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對止水帶連續、穿牆套管及接縫變形紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Audit waterstop continuity, wall sleeves and joint-movement records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 防水接縫與穿牆構件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Waterproof joints and penetrations: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「防水接縫與穿牆構件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Waterproof joints and penetrations” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對止水帶連續、穿牆套管及接縫變形紀錄。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「穿牆套管與止水細部不連續，漏水沿界面繞過膜材」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit waterstop continuity, wall sleeves and joint-movement records. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A discontinuous sleeve detail lets water bypass the membrane along an interface. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對止水帶連續、穿牆套管及接縫變形紀錄列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現穿牆套管與止水細部不連續，漏水沿界面繞過膜材，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Audit waterstop continuity, wall sleeves and joint-movement records. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a discontinuous sleeve detail lets water bypass the membrane along an interface, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：穿牆套管與止水細部不連續，漏水沿界面繞過膜材。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A discontinuous sleeve detail lets water bypass the membrane along an interface. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: A discontinuous sleeve detail lets water bypass the membrane along an interface. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

steps.title: 防水接縫與穿牆構件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Waterproof joints and penetrations: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「防水接縫與穿牆構件」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Waterproof joints and penetrations” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 穿牆套管與止水細部不連續，漏水沿界面繞過膜材。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對止水帶連續、穿牆套管及接縫變形紀錄，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A discontinuous sleeve detail lets water bypass the membrane along an interface. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit waterstop continuity, wall sleeves and joint-movement records to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對止水帶連續、穿牆套管及接縫變形紀錄；若出現穿牆套管與止水細部不連續，漏水沿界面繞過膜材，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If a discontinuous sleeve detail lets water bypass the membrane along an interface, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「箱體牆面不裂就能保證所有穿牆位置都不漏」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uncracked box walls guarantee every penetration remains watertight" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「支撐拆換與荷載轉移」與「鄰房沉陷與角變形」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Brace removal and load transfer" and "Neighbour settlement and angular distortion": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支撐拆換與荷載轉移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Brace removal and load transfer: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支撐拆換與荷載轉移」如何影響明挖覆蓋隧道施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Brace removal and load transfer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cut-and-cover tunnel construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 臨時支撐拆除將側向荷載轉到永久樓板和牆，混凝土齡期與接頭完成度決定能否接手。竣工樓板存在不代表當天已具備預期剛度，開口也會切斷壓力路徑；拆換模型需按實際順序逐階段檢核。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照樓板成熟證據、接頭完成及拆換前後應變；若出現接頭尚未傳力就拆支撐，牆移突增並使樓板邊緣開裂，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支撐拆換與荷載轉移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Removing temporary braces transfers lateral actions to slabs and walls whose age and joint completion govern engagement. A slab's presence does not prove its intended stiffness, and openings interrupt compression paths. Assess removal in the actual sequence rather than using only the final configuration. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare slab maturity, joint completion and strains before and after load transfer. If removing a brace before joint engagement increases wall movement and cracks slab edges, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Brace removal and load transfer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：transferredReaction=removedBraceForce/engagedSlabWidth=900 kN/6 m=150 kN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: transferredReaction=removedBraceForce/engagedSlabWidth=900 kN/6 m=150 kN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「永久樓板澆置完成就能立即取代全部臨時支撐」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.textEn: Removing temporary braces transfers lateral actions to slabs and walls whose age and joint completion govern engagement. A slab's presence does not prove its intended stiffness, and openings interrupt compression paths.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Brace removal and load transfer" is correct?
options: 永久樓板澆置完成就能立即取代全部臨時支撐
臨時支撐拆除將側向荷載轉到永久樓板和牆，混凝土齡期與接頭完成度決定能否接手。
平均沉陷很小就代表鄰房一定沒有損傷
optionsEn: A freshly cast permanent slab immediately replaces every temporary brace
Removing temporary braces transfers lateral actions to slabs and walls whose age and joint completion govern engagement.
Small average settlement guarantees no damage to neighbouring buildings
quiz.explanation: 臨時支撐拆除將側向荷載轉到永久樓板和牆，混凝土齡期與接頭完成度決定能否接手。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Removing temporary braces transfers lateral actions to slabs and walls whose age and joint completion govern engagement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支撐拆換與荷載轉移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Brace removal and load transfer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支撐拆換與荷載轉移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Brace removal and load transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：transferredReaction=removedBraceForce/engagedSlabWidth=900 kN/6 m=150 kN/m。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: transferredReaction=removedBraceForce/engagedSlabWidth=900 kN/6 m=150 kN/m. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照樓板成熟證據、接頭完成及拆換前後應變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare slab maturity, joint completion and strains before and after load transfer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：transferredReaction=removedBraceForce/engagedSlabWidth=900 kN/6 m=150 kN/m。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: transferredReaction=removedBraceForce/engagedSlabWidth=900 kN/6 m=150 kN/m. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支撐拆換與荷載轉移」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Brace removal and load transfer", which statement holds?
options: 道路恢復平整就表示全部地下工程已完成驗證
所有擋土牆都可以直接使用完全主動土壓
原創教學假設：transferredReaction=removedBraceForce/engagedSlabWidth=900 kN/6 m=150 kN/m。
optionsEn: A smooth restored road proves all underground works have been verified
Every retaining wall can directly use fully active earth pressure
Original teaching assumptions: transferredReaction=removedBraceForce/engagedSlabWidth=900 kN/6 m=150 kN/m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：transferredReaction=removedBraceForce/engagedSlabWidth=900 kN/6 m=150 kN/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: transferredReaction=removedBraceForce/engagedSlabWidth=900 kN/6 m=150 kN/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支撐拆換與荷載轉移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Brace removal and load transfer: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支撐拆換與荷載轉移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Brace removal and load transfer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照樓板成熟證據、接頭完成及拆換前後應變。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「接頭尚未傳力就拆支撐，牆移突增並使樓板邊緣開裂」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare slab maturity, joint completion and strains before and after load transfer. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Removing a brace before joint engagement increases wall movement and cracks slab edges. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照樓板成熟證據、接頭完成及拆換前後應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現接頭尚未傳力就拆支撐，牆移突增並使樓板邊緣開裂，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare slab maturity, joint completion and strains before and after load transfer. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If removing a brace before joint engagement increases wall movement and cracks slab edges, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接頭尚未傳力就拆支撐，牆移突增並使樓板邊緣開裂。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Removing a brace before joint engagement increases wall movement and cracks slab edges. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照樓板成熟證據、接頭完成及拆換前後應變。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「接頭尚未傳力就拆支撐，牆移突增並使樓板邊緣開裂」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare slab maturity, joint completion and strains before and after load transfer. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Removing a brace before joint engagement increases wall movement and cracks slab edges. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將對照樓板成熟證據、接頭完成及拆換前後應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現接頭尚未傳力就拆支撐，牆移突增並使樓板邊緣開裂，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Compare slab maturity, joint completion and strains before and after load transfer. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If removing a brace before joint engagement increases wall movement and cracks slab edges, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支撐拆換與荷載轉移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Brace removal and load transfer"?
options: 對照樓板成熟證據、接頭完成及拆換前後應變。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
基底往上動的所有原因都屬同一種失效
optionsEn: Compare slab maturity, joint completion and strains before and after load transfer.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Every cause of upward base movement is the same failure mechanism
quiz.explanation: 對照樓板成熟證據、接頭完成及拆換前後應變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare slab maturity, joint completion and strains before and after load transfer. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支撐拆換與荷載轉移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Brace removal and load transfer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支撐拆換與荷載轉移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Brace removal and load transfer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接頭尚未傳力就拆支撐，牆移突增並使樓板邊緣開裂。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照樓板成熟證據、接頭完成及拆換前後應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Removing a brace before joint engagement increases wall movement and cracks slab edges. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare slab maturity, joint completion and strains before and after load transfer to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照樓板成熟證據、接頭完成及拆換前後應變；若出現接頭尚未傳力就拆支撐，牆移突增並使樓板邊緣開裂，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If removing a brace before joint engagement increases wall movement and cracks slab edges, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「永久樓板澆置完成就能立即取代全部臨時支撐」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A freshly cast permanent slab immediately replaces every temporary brace" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接頭尚未傳力就拆支撐，牆移突增並使樓板邊緣開裂。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照樓板成熟證據、接頭完成及拆換前後應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Removing a brace before joint engagement increases wall movement and cracks slab edges. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare slab maturity, joint completion and strains before and after load transfer to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支撐拆換與荷載轉移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Brace removal and load transfer" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
接頭尚未傳力就拆支撐，牆移突增並使樓板邊緣開裂。
平均沉陷很小就代表鄰房一定沒有損傷
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Removing a brace before joint engagement increases wall movement and cracks slab edges.
Small average settlement guarantees no damage to neighbouring buildings
quiz.explanation: 接頭尚未傳力就拆支撐，牆移突增並使樓板邊緣開裂。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Removing a brace before joint engagement increases wall movement and cracks slab edges. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鄰房沉陷與角變形：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Neighbour settlement and angular distortion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鄰房沉陷與角變形」如何影響明挖覆蓋隧道施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Neighbour settlement and angular distortion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cut-and-cover tunnel construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 總沉陷與差異沉陷對建物的影響不同，剛體下沉可能不造成同樣裂縫，而局部角變形會擠壓門窗或拉開砌體。量測點需與建物結構分區相連，原有裂縫也應先記錄；不能把單一最大沉陷值當成全部損傷指標。兩測點沉陷差除跨距是平均沉陷坡度；要判別造成損傷的角變形，還須區分整體剛體傾斜與局部變形。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將建物水準、傾斜與原有裂縫圖按結構跨間比較；若出現平均沉陷小但局部差異大，砌體開裂被單一數值漏判，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鄰房沉陷與角變形」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Total and differential settlements affect buildings differently: rigid movement can produce less cracking than local distortion. Connect survey points to structural divisions and document existing cracks. One maximum settlement value does not capture deformation patterns or establish damage causation by itself. Settlement difference divided by span is a mean settlement slope; damage-related angular distortion requires separating overall rigid-body tilt from local deformation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare building levels, tilt and baseline cracks by structural bay. If small mean settlement hides local differential movement that cracks masonry, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Neighbour settlement and angular distortion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：meanSettlementSlope=settlementDifference/span=6 mm/12000 mm=0.0005 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: meanSettlementSlope=settlementDifference/span=6 mm/12000 mm=0.0005 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均沉陷很小就代表鄰房一定沒有損傷」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Small average settlement guarantees no damage to neighbouring buildings" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鄰房沉陷與角變形」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Neighbour settlement and angular distortion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鄰房沉陷與角變形
knowledge.text: 總沉陷與差異沉陷對建物的影響不同，剛體下沉可能不造成同樣裂縫，而局部角變形會擠壓門窗或拉開砌體。量測點需與建物結構分區相連，原有裂縫也應先記錄；不能把單一最大沉陷值當成全部損傷指標。
knowledge.textEn: Total and differential settlements affect buildings differently: rigid movement can produce less cracking than local distortion. Connect survey points to structural divisions and document existing cracks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均沉陷很小就代表鄰房一定沒有損傷 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Small average settlement guarantees no damage to neighbouring buildings Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鄰房沉陷與角變形」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Neighbour settlement and angular distortion" is correct?
options: 平均沉陷很小就代表鄰房一定沒有損傷

總沉陷與差異沉陷對建物的影響不同，剛體下沉可能不造成同樣裂縫，而局部角變形會擠壓門窗或拉開砌體。
optionsEn: Small average settlement guarantees no damage to neighbouring buildings
Faster completion of backfilling guarantees safer construction stages
Total and differential settlements affect buildings differently: rigid movement can produce less cracking than local distortion.
quiz.explanation: 總沉陷與差異沉陷對建物的影響不同，剛體下沉可能不造成同樣裂縫，而局部角變形會擠壓門窗或拉開砌體。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Total and differential settlements affect buildings differently: rigid movement can produce less cracking than local distortion. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鄰房沉陷與角變形：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Neighbour settlement and angular distortion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鄰房沉陷與角變形」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Neighbour settlement and angular distortion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: meanSettlementSlope=settlementDifference/span=6 mm/12000 mm=0.0005 rad; rigid-body tilt has not been removed. steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 鄰房沉陷與角變形：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鄰房沉陷與角變形」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Neighbour settlement and angular distortion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將建物水準、傾斜與原有裂縫圖按結構跨間比較。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「平均沉陷小但局部差異大，砌體開裂被單一數值漏判」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare building levels, tilt and baseline cracks by structural bay. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Small mean settlement hides local differential movement that cracks masonry. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將建物水準、傾斜與原有裂縫圖按結構跨間比較列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現平均沉陷小但局部差異大，砌體開裂被單一數值漏判，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare building levels, tilt and baseline cracks by structural bay. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If small mean settlement hides local differential movement that cracks masonry, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均沉陷小但局部差異大，砌體開裂被單一數值漏判。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Small mean settlement hides local differential movement that cracks masonry. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 鄰房沉陷與角變形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Neighbour settlement and angular distortion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鄰房沉陷與角變形」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Neighbour settlement and angular distortion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均沉陷小但局部差異大，砌體開裂被單一數值漏判。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將建物水準、傾斜與原有裂縫圖按結構跨間比較，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Small mean settlement hides local differential movement that cracks masonry. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare building levels, tilt and baseline cracks by structural bay to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察將建物水準、傾斜與原有裂縫圖按結構跨間比較；若出現平均沉陷小但局部差異大，砌體開裂被單一數值漏判，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If small mean settlement hides local differential movement that cracks masonry, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均沉陷很小就代表鄰房一定沒有損傷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small average settlement guarantees no damage to neighbouring buildings" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 平均沉陷小但局部差異大，砌體開裂被單一數值漏判。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到將建物水準、傾斜與原有裂縫圖按結構跨間比較，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backfill compaction and roof loading” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cut-and-cover tunnel construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.

steps.instructionEn: Backfill adds construction plant and compaction effects as well as permanent overburden; asymmetric placement changes lateral loading. Fill stiffness and drainage govern later settlement, beyond one density result. Check plant position and cover depth together when assessing temporary roof demand. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare lift levels, equipment locations and roof strains. If concentrated plant above thin cover overloads the roof despite acceptable average fill, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Backfill compaction and roof loading” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：overburdenPressure=unitWeight*depth=20 kN/m3*2 m=40 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: overburdenPressure=unitWeight*depth=20 kN/m3*2 m=40 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「回填越快完成就能保證施工階段更安全」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Backfill compaction and roof loading”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：overburdenPressure=unitWeight*depth=20 kN/m3*2 m=40 kPa。開挖、結構施工與回填具有不同荷載路徑，竣工模型不能取代施工模型。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: overburdenPressure=unitWeight*depth=20 kN/m3*2 m=40 kPa. Excavation, structural work and backfilling have different load paths; the final model does not replace staged models. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「回填壓實與箱頂荷載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 回填壓實與箱頂荷載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Backfill compaction and roof loading: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「回填壓實與箱頂荷載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Backfill compaction and roof loading” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照分層回填高程、機具位置及箱頂應變。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「薄覆土上集中機具荷載讓箱頂局部超載，平均覆土帳未反映」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare lift levels, equipment locations and roof strains. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Concentrated plant above thin cover overloads the roof despite acceptable average fill. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照分層回填高程、機具位置及箱頂應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現薄覆土上集中機具荷載讓箱頂局部超載，平均覆土帳未反映，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Compare lift levels, equipment locations and roof strains. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If concentrated plant above thin cover overloads the roof despite acceptable average fill, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：薄覆土上集中機具荷載讓箱頂局部超載，平均覆土帳未反映。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Concentrated plant above thin cover overloads the roof despite acceptable average fill. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Compare lift levels, equipment locations and roof strains. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Concentrated plant above thin cover overloads the roof despite acceptable average fill. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

quiz.question: 要驗證「回填壓實與箱頂荷載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Backfill compaction and roof loading"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
箱體牆面不裂就能保證所有穿牆位置都不漏
對照分層回填高程、機具位置及箱頂應變。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Uncracked box walls guarantee every penetration remains watertight
Compare lift levels, equipment locations and roof strains.
quiz.explanation: 對照分層回填高程、機具位置及箱頂應變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare lift levels, equipment locations and roof strains. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 回填壓實與箱頂荷載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Backfill compaction and roof loading: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「回填壓實與箱頂荷載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Backfill compaction and roof loading” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 薄覆土上集中機具荷載讓箱頂局部超載，平均覆土帳未反映。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照分層回填高程、機具位置及箱頂應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Concentrated plant above thin cover overloads the roof despite acceptable average fill. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare lift levels, equipment locations and roof strains to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察對照分層回填高程、機具位置及箱頂應變；若出現薄覆土上集中機具荷載讓箱頂局部超載，平均覆土帳未反映，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If concentrated plant above thin cover overloads the roof despite acceptable average fill, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「回填越快完成就能保證施工階段更安全」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Faster completion of backfilling guarantees safer construction stages" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 薄覆土上集中機具荷載讓箱頂局部超載，平均覆土帳未反映。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照分層回填高程、機具位置及箱頂應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Concentrated plant above thin cover overloads the roof despite acceptable average fill. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare lift levels, equipment locations and roof strains to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「回填壓實與箱頂荷載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Backfill compaction and roof loading" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 薄覆土上集中機具荷載讓箱頂局部超載，平均覆土帳未反映。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
道路恢復平整就表示全部地下工程已完成驗證
optionsEn: Concentrated plant above thin cover overloads the roof despite acceptable average fill.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A smooth restored road proves all underground works have been verified
quiz.explanation: 薄覆土上集中機具荷載讓箱頂局部超載，平均覆土帳未反映。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Concentrated plant above thin cover overloads the roof despite acceptable average fill. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 地表恢復與地下資產交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Surface restoration and underground handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地表恢復與地下資產交接」如何影響明挖覆蓋隧道施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Surface restoration and underground handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cut-and-cover tunnel construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 道路恢復後，地下接縫、排水和檢查孔可能變得難以接近，維護動線須在交接時確認。竣工圖應記錄實際高程與管線改道，不能只保留原設計；地表平順也不能證明回填長期不沉陷，需建立後續比較基準。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點；若出現維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地表恢復與地下資產交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After road restoration, joints, drains and access points become harder to reach, making maintenance access part of handover. Record as-built levels and utility diversions rather than design alone. A smooth surface does not establish long-term fill stability, so retain a postconstruction baseline. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit as-built utilities, inspection access and road-settlement reference points. If road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Surface restoration and underground handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Inputs independent component standard uncertainties=0.01,0.02,0.02 m; combinedStandardUncertainty=sqrt(0.01^2+0.02^2+0.02^2)=0.03 m for assumed independent components; not a measured survey-closure residual。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs independent component standard uncertainties=0.01,0.02,0.02 m; combinedStandardUncertainty=sqrt(0.01^2+0.02^2+0.02^2)=0.03 m for assumed independent components; not a measured survey-closure residual.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「道路恢復平整就表示全部地下工程已完成驗證」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A smooth restored road proves all underground works have been verified" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地表恢復與地下資產交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Surface restoration and underground handover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: After road restoration, joints, drains and access points become harder to reach, making maintenance access part of handover. Record as-built levels and utility diversions rather than design alone.

knowledge.text: 誤解：道路恢復平整就表示全部地下工程已完成驗證 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「地表恢復與地下資產交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地表恢復與地下資產交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

竣工抗浮合格就能保證每個施工階段都抗浮

optionsEn: Increasing brace force can only mean increasing earth pressure
Passing permanent flotation checks guarantees every construction stage resists uplift

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inputs independent component standard uncertainties=0.01,0.02,0.02 m; combinedStandardUncertainty=sqrt(0.01^2+0.02^2+0.02^2)=0.03 m for assumed independent components; not a measured survey-closure residual. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地表恢復與地下資產交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Surface restoration and underground handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地表恢復與地下資產交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Surface restoration and underground handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Audit as-built utilities, inspection access and road-settlement reference points. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Audit as-built utilities, inspection access and road-settlement reference points. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Audit as-built utilities, inspection access and road-settlement reference points. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Audit as-built utilities, inspection access and road-settlement reference points. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地表恢復與地下資產交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Surface restoration and underground handover"?
options: 核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
永久樓板澆置完成就能立即取代全部臨時支撐
optionsEn: Audit as-built utilities, inspection access and road-settlement reference points.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A freshly cast permanent slab immediately replaces every temporary brace
quiz.explanation: 核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Audit as-built utilities, inspection access and road-settlement reference points. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地表恢復與地下資產交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Surface restoration and underground handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地表恢復與地下資產交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Surface restoration and underground handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit as-built utilities, inspection access and road-settlement reference points to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點；若出現維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「道路恢復平整就表示全部地下工程已完成驗證」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A smooth restored road proves all underground works have been verified" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到核對竣工管線、檢查通道及道路沉陷基準點，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to audit as-built utilities, inspection access and road-settlement reference points to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地表恢復與地下資產交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Surface restoration and underground handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理。
土方體積相同就代表兩個明挖工程風險相同
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection.
Equal excavation volume means identical risk for two cut-and-cover projects
quiz.explanation: 維修口被道路設施遮住，使早期堵塞無法檢查清理。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Road installations conceal maintenance openings and prevent early blockage inspection. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
